  return closeUnixFile(id);
}










































static int dotlockCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut) {
  int rc =0         ;
  int reserved = 0;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (14<<8));; };

  assert( pFile );
  reserved =((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)((const char*)pFile->lockingContext,0)==0;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST WR-LOCK %d %d %d (dotlock)\n", pFile->h, rc, reserved);
  *pResOut = reserved;
  return rc;
}




























static int dotlockLock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  char *zLockFile = (char *)pFile->lockingContext;
  int rc =0         ;





  if( pFile->eFileLock >0        ){
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;


    utime(zLockFile, NULL);

    utimes(zLockFile, NULL);

    return 0        ;
  }


  rc =((int(*)(const char*,mode_t))aSyscall[18].pCurrent)(zLockFile,0777);
  if( rc<0 ){

    int tErrno = errno;
    if( EEXIST == tErrno ){
      rc =5           ;
    } else {
      rc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,(10 | (15<<8))    );
      if( rc!=5           ){
        storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
      }
    }
    return rc;
  }


  pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
  return rc;
}










static int dotlockUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  char *zLockFile = (char *)pFile->lockingContext;
  int rc;

  assert( pFile );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK  %d %d was %d pid=%d (dotlock)\n", pFile->h, eFileLock, 
pFile->eFileLock, (pid_t)1)               ;
  assert( eFileLock<=1           );


  if( pFile->eFileLock==eFileLock ){
    return 0        ;
  }




  if( eFileLock==1           ){
    pFile->eFileLock =1           ;
    return 0        ;
  }


  assert( eFileLock==0       );
  rc =((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[19].pCurrent)(zLockFile);
  if( rc<0 ){
    int tErrno = errno;
    if( tErrno==ENOENT ){
      rc =0         ;
    }else{
      rc =(10 | (8<<8))       ;
      storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
    }
    return rc;
  }
  pFile->eFileLock =0       ;
  return 0        ;
}




static int dotlockClose(sqlite3_file *id) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  assert( id!=0 );
  dotlockUnlock(id,0       );
  sqlite3_free(pFile->lockingContext);
  return closeUnixFile(id);
}























static int robust_flock(int fd, int op){
  int rc;
  do{ rc = flock(fd,op); }while( rc<0 && errno==EINTR );
  return rc;
}











static int flockCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut){
  int rc =0         ;
  int reserved = 0;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (14<<8));; };

  assert( pFile );


  if( pFile->eFileLock>1           ){
    reserved = 1;
  }


  if( !reserved ){

    int lrc =flock(pFile->h,LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)         ;
    if( !lrc ){

      lrc =flock(pFile->h,LOCK_UN)         ;
      if ( lrc ) {
        int tErrno = errno;

        lrc =(10 | (8<<8))       ;
        storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
        rc = lrc;
      }
    } else {
      int tErrno = errno;
      reserved = 1;

      lrc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,(10 | (15<<8))    );
      if(((lrc != 0) && (lrc != 5))){
        storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
        rc = lrc;
      }
    }
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST WR-LOCK %d %d %d (flock)\n", pFile->h, rc, reserved);


  if( (rc & 0xff) ==10            ){
    rc =0         ;
    reserved=1;
  }

  *pResOut = reserved;
  return rc;
}






























static int flockLock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  int rc =0         ;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

  assert( pFile );



  if (pFile->eFileLock >0       ) {
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
    return 0        ;
  }



  if (flock(pFile->h,LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)        ) {
    int tErrno = errno;

    rc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,(10 | (15<<8))    );
    if(((rc != 0) && (rc != 5))){
      storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
    }
  } else {

    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK    %d %s %s (flock)\n", pFile->h, azFileLock(eFileLock), 
rc==0 ? "ok" : "failed")                    ;

  if( (rc & 0xff) ==10            ){
    rc =5           ;
  }

  return rc;
}









static int flockUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

  assert( pFile );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK  %d %d was %d pid=%d (flock)\n", pFile->h, eFileLock, 
pFile->eFileLock, (pid_t)1)               ;
  assert( eFileLock<=1           );


  if( pFile->eFileLock==eFileLock ){
    return 0        ;
  }


  if (eFileLock==1          ) {
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
    return 0        ;
  }


  if(flock(pFile->h,LOCK_UN)          ){

    return 0        ;

    return(10 | (8<<8))       ;
  }else{
    pFile->eFileLock =0       ;
    return 0        ;
  }
}




static int flockClose(sqlite3_file *id) {
  assert( id!=0 );
  flockUnlock(id,0       );
  return closeUnixFile(id);
}
























static int semXCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut) {
  int rc =0         ;
  int reserved = 0;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (14<<8));; };

  assert( pFile );


  if( pFile->eFileLock>1           ){
    reserved = 1;
  }


  if( !reserved ){
    sem_t *pSem = pFile->pInode->pSem;

    if( sem_trywait(pSem)==-1 ){
      int tErrno = errno;
      if( EAGAIN != tErrno ){
        rc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,(10 | (14<<8))                 );
        storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
      } else {

        reserved = (pFile->eFileLock <1           );
      }
    }else{

      sem_post(pSem);
    }
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST WR-LOCK %d %d %d (sem)\n", pFile->h, rc, reserved);

  *pResOut = reserved;
  return rc;
}






























static int semXLock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  sem_t *pSem = pFile->pInode->pSem;
  int rc =0         ;



  if (pFile->eFileLock >0       ) {
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
    rc =0         ;
    goto sem_end_lock;
  }


  if( sem_trywait(pSem)==-1 ){
    rc =5           ;
    goto sem_end_lock;
  }


  pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;

 sem_end_lock:
  return rc;
}








static int semXUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  sem_t *pSem = pFile->pInode->pSem;

  assert( pFile );
  assert( pSem );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK  %d %d was %d pid=%d (sem)\n", pFile->h, eFileLock, 
pFile->eFileLock, (pid_t)1)               ;
  assert( eFileLock<=1           );


  if( pFile->eFileLock==eFileLock ){
    return 0        ;
  }


  if (eFileLock==1          ) {
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
    return 0        ;
  }


  if ( sem_post(pSem)==-1 ) {
    int rc, tErrno = errno;
    rc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,(10 | (8<<8))       );
    if(((rc != 0) && (rc != 5))){
      storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
    }
    return rc;
  }
  pFile->eFileLock =0       ;
  return 0        ;
}




static int semXClose(sqlite3_file *id) {
  if( id ){
    unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
    semXUnlock(id,0       );
    assert( pFile );
    assert( unixFileMutexNotheld(pFile) );
    unixEnterMutex();
    releaseInodeInfo(pFile);
    unixLeaveMutex();
    closeUnixFile(id);
  }
  return 0        ;
}























typedef struct afpLockingContext afpLockingContext;
struct afpLockingContext {
  int reserved;
  const char *dbPath;
};

struct ByteRangeLockPB2
{
  unsigned long long offset;
  unsigned long long length;
  unsigned long long retRangeStart;
  unsigned char unLockFlag;
  unsigned char startEndFlag;
  int fd;
};









static int afpSetLock(
  const char *path,
  unixFile *pFile,
  unsigned long long offset,
  unsigned long long length,
  int setLockFlag
){
  struct ByteRangeLockPB2 pb;
  int err;

  pb.unLockFlag = setLockFlag ? 0 : 1;
  pb.startEndFlag = 0;
  pb.offset = offset;
  pb.length = length;
  pb.fd = pFile->h;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("AFPSETLOCK [%s] for %d%s in range %llx:%llx\n", 
(setLockFlag?"ON":"OFF"), pFile->h, (pb.fd==-1?"[testval-1]":""), 
offset, length)     ;
  err = fsctl(path,_IOWR('z', 23, struct ByteRangeLockPB2),&pb,0);
  if ( err==-1 ) {
    int rc;
    int tErrno = errno;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("AFPSETLOCK failed to fsctl() '%s' %d %s\n", 
path, tErrno, strerror(tErrno))              ;

    rc =5           ;

    rc = sqliteErrorFromPosixError(tErrno,
                    setLockFlag ?(10 | (15<<8))     :(10 | (8<<8))       );

    if(((rc != 0) && (rc != 5))){
      storeLastErrno(pFile, tErrno);
    }
    return rc;
  } else {
    return 0        ;
  }
}







static int afpCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut){
  int rc =0         ;
  int reserved = 0;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  afpLockingContext *context;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (14<<8));; };

  assert( pFile );
  context = (afpLockingContext *) pFile->lockingContext;
  if( context->reserved ){
    *pResOut = 1;
    return 0        ;
  }
                                                ;

  if( pFile->pInode->eFileLock>1           ){
    reserved = 1;
  }



  if( !reserved ){

    int lrc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+1),1,1);
    if(0         ==lrc ){


      lrc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+1),1,0);
    } else {

      reserved = 1;
    }
    if(((lrc != 0) && (lrc != 5))){
      rc=lrc;
    }
  }

                                                ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST WR-LOCK %d %d %d (afp)\n", pFile->h, rc, reserved);

  *pResOut = reserved;
  return rc;
}

























static int afpLock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock){
  int rc =0         ;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  unixInodeInfo *pInode = pFile->pInode;
  afpLockingContext *context = (afpLockingContext *) pFile->lockingContext;

  assert( pFile );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK    %d %s was %s(%s,%d) pid=%d (afp)\n", pFile->h, 
azFileLock(eFileLock), azFileLock(pFile->eFileLock), 
azFileLock(pInode->eFileLock), pInode->nShared , (pid_t)1)               ;





  if( pFile->eFileLock>=eFileLock ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK    %d %s ok (already held) (afp)\n", pFile->h, 
azFileLock(eFileLock))            ;
    return 0        ;
  }






  assert( pFile->eFileLock!=0       || eFileLock==1           );
  assert( eFileLock!=3            );
  assert( eFileLock!=2             || pFile->eFileLock==1           );



  pInode = pFile->pInode;
                                         ;




  if( (pFile->eFileLock!=pInode->eFileLock &&
       (pInode->eFileLock>=3            || eFileLock>1          ))
     ){
    rc =5           ;
    goto afp_end_lock;
  }





  if( eFileLock==1           &&
     (pInode->eFileLock==1           || pInode->eFileLock==2            ) ){
    assert( eFileLock==1           );
    assert( pFile->eFileLock==0 );
    assert( pInode->nShared>0 );
    pFile->eFileLock =1           ;
    pInode->nShared++;
    pInode->nLock++;
    goto afp_end_lock;
  }





  if( eFileLock==1
      || (eFileLock==4              && pFile->eFileLock<3           )
  ){
    int failed;
    failed = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,(0x40000000) , 1, 1);
    if (failed) {
      rc = failed;
      goto afp_end_lock;
    }
  }




  if( eFileLock==1           ){
    int lrc1, lrc2, lrc1Errno = 0;
    long lk, mask;

    assert( pInode->nShared==0 );
    assert( pInode->eFileLock==0 );

    mask = (sizeof(long)==8) ?(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)):0x7fffffff;


    lk = random();
    pInode->sharedByte = (lk & mask)%(510         - 1);
    lrc1 = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,
((0x40000000)+2)      +pInode->sharedByte, 1, 1);
    if(((lrc1 != 0) && (lrc1 != 5))){
      lrc1Errno = pFile->lastErrno;
    }

    lrc2 = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,(0x40000000) , 1, 0);

    if(((lrc1 != 0) && (lrc1 != 5))){
      storeLastErrno(pFile, lrc1Errno);
      rc = lrc1;
      goto afp_end_lock;
    } else if(((lrc2 != 0) && (lrc2 != 5))){
      rc = lrc2;
      goto afp_end_lock;
    } else if( lrc1 !=0          ) {
      rc = lrc1;
    } else {
      pFile->eFileLock =1           ;
      pInode->nLock++;
      pInode->nShared = 1;
    }
  }else if( eFileLock==4              && pInode->nShared>1 ){


    rc =5           ;
  }else{




    int failed = 0;
    assert( 0!=pFile->eFileLock );
    if (eFileLock >=2              && pFile->eFileLock <2             ) {

        failed = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+1),1,1);
      if( !failed ){
        context->reserved = 1;
      }
    }
    if (!failed && eFileLock ==4              ) {





      if( !(failed = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+2)+
                         pInode->sharedByte, 1, 0)) ){
        int failed2 =0         ;

        failed = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+2),
510                                       , 1);
        if( failed && (failed2 = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,
((0x40000000)+2)                    + pInode->sharedByte, 1, 1)) ){



          rc = ((failed & 0xff) ==10           ) ? failed2 :
(10 | (15<<8))                  ;
          goto afp_end_lock;
        }
      }else{
        rc = failed;
      }
    }
    if( failed ){
      rc = failed;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
    pInode->eFileLock = eFileLock;
  }else if( eFileLock==4              ){
    pFile->eFileLock =3            ;
    pInode->eFileLock =3            ;
  }

afp_end_lock:
                                         ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK    %d %s %s (afp)\n", pFile->h, azFileLock(eFileLock), 
rc==0 ? "ok" : "failed")                  ;
  return rc;
}








static int afpUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  int rc =0         ;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  unixInodeInfo *pInode;
  afpLockingContext *context = (afpLockingContext *) pFile->lockingContext;
  int skipShared = 0;

  int h = pFile->h;


  assert( pFile );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK  %d %d was %d(%d,%d) pid=%d (afp)\n", pFile->h, eFileLock, 
pFile->eFileLock, pFile->pInode->eFileLock, pFile->pInode->nShared, 
(pid_t)1)               ;

  assert( eFileLock<=1           );
  if( pFile->eFileLock<=eFileLock ){
    return 0        ;
  }
  pInode = pFile->pInode;
                                         ;
  assert( pInode->nShared!=0 );
  if( pFile->eFileLock>1           ){
    assert( pInode->eFileLock==pFile->eFileLock );
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1) ;
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); h=(-1); }
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0) ;










    assert( pFile->inNormalWrite==0
           || pFile->dbUpdate==0
           || pFile->transCntrChng==1 );
    pFile->inNormalWrite = 0;


    if( pFile->eFileLock==4              ){
      rc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+2),510      , 0);
      if( rc==0         && (eFileLock==1           || pInode->nShared>1) ){

        int sharedLockByte =((0x40000000)+2)+pInode->sharedByte;
        rc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile, sharedLockByte, 1, 1);
      } else {
        skipShared = 1;
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         && pFile->eFileLock>=3            ){
      rc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,(0x40000000) , 1, 0);
    }
    if( rc==0         && pFile->eFileLock>=2             && context->reserved ){
      rc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile,((0x40000000)+1),1,0);
      if( !rc ){
        context->reserved = 0;
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         && (eFileLock==1           || pInode->nShared>1)){
      pInode->eFileLock =1           ;
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         && eFileLock==0       ){





    unsigned long long sharedLockByte =((0x40000000)+2)+pInode->sharedByte;
    pInode->nShared--;
    if( pInode->nShared==0 ){
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)   ;
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); h=(-1); }
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)   ;
      if( !skipShared ){
        rc = afpSetLock(context->dbPath, pFile, sharedLockByte, 1, 0);
      }
      if( !rc ){
        pInode->eFileLock =0       ;
        pFile->eFileLock =0       ;
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      pInode->nLock--;
      assert( pInode->nLock>=0 );
      if( pInode->nLock==0 ) closePendingFds(pFile);
    }
  }

                                         ;
  if( rc==0         ){
    pFile->eFileLock = eFileLock;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int afpClose(sqlite3_file *id) {
  int rc =0         ;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  assert( id!=0 );
  afpUnlock(id,0       );
  assert( unixFileMutexNotheld(pFile) );
  unixEnterMutex();
  if( pFile->pInode ){
    unixInodeInfo *pInode = pFile->pInode;
                                           ;
    if( pInode->nLock ){





      setPendingFd(pFile);
    }
                                           ;
  }
  releaseInodeInfo(pFile);
  sqlite3_free(pFile->lockingContext);
  rc = closeUnixFile(id);
  unixLeaveMutex();
  return rc;
}






















static int nfsUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock){
  return posixUnlock(id, eFileLock, 1);
}

































static int seekAndRead(unixFile *id, sqlite3_int64 offset, void *pBuf, int cnt){
  int got;
  int prior = 0;

  i64 newOffset;

g_start=sqlite3Hwtime();
  assert( cnt==(cnt&0x1ffff) );
  assert( id->h>2 );
  do{

    got =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t,off_t))aSyscall[9].pCurrent)(id->h,pBuf,cnt,offset);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); got = -1; };

    got =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t,off64_t))aSyscall[10].pCurrent)(id->h,pBuf,cnt,offset);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); got = -1; };

    newOffset =lseek64(id->h,offset, SEEK_SET);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); newOffset = -1; };
    if( newOffset<0 ){
      storeLastErrno((unixFile*)id, errno);
      return -1;
    }
    got =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t))aSyscall[8].pCurrent)(id->h,pBuf,cnt);

    if( got==cnt ) break;
    if( got<0 ){
      if( errno==EINTR ){ got = 1; continue; }
      prior = 0;
      storeLastErrno((unixFile*)id,  errno);
      break;
    }else if( got>0 ){
      cnt -= got;
      offset += got;
      prior += got;
      pBuf = (void*)(got + (char*)pBuf);
    }
  }while( got>0 );
g_elapsed=sqlite3Hwtime()-g_start;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ    %-3d %5d %7lld %llu\n", 
id->h, got+prior, offset-prior, g_elapsed)                 ;
  return got+prior;
}






static int unixRead(
  sqlite3_file *id,
  void *pBuf,
  int amt,
  sqlite3_int64 offset
){
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile *)id;
  int got;
  assert( id );
  assert( offset>=0 );
  assert( amt>0 );




  assert( pFile->pPreallocatedUnused==0
       || offset>=(0x40000000)+512
       || offset+amt<=(0x40000000)
  );





  if( offset<pFile->mmapSize ){
    if( offset+amt <= pFile->mmapSize ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBuf);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]); int xxn=(amt);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      return 0        ;
    }else{
      int nCopy = pFile->mmapSize - offset;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBuf);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]); int xxn=(nCopy);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pBuf = &((u8 *)pBuf)[nCopy];
      amt -= nCopy;
      offset += nCopy;
    }
  }


  got = seekAndRead(pFile, offset, pBuf, amt);
  if( got==amt ){
    return 0        ;
  }else if( got<0 ){







    switch( pFile->lastErrno ){
      case ERANGE:
      case EIO:

      case ENXIO:


      case EDEVERR:

        return(10 | (33<<8))         ;
    }
    return(10 | (1<<8))     ;
  }else{
    storeLastErrno(pFile, 0);

    memset(&((char*)pBuf)[got], 0, amt-got);
    return(10 | (2<<8))           ;
  }
}








static int seekAndWriteFd(
  int fd,
  i64 iOff,
  const void *pBuf,
  int nBuf,
  int *piErrno
){
  int rc = 0;

  assert( nBuf==(nBuf&0x1ffff) );
  assert( fd>2 );
  assert( piErrno!=0 );
  nBuf &= 0x1ffff;
g_start=sqlite3Hwtime();


  do{ rc = (int)((ssize_t(*)(int,const void*,size_t,off_t)) aSyscall[12].pCurrent)(fd,pBuf,nBuf,iOff);}while(rc<0&&errno==EINTR);

  do{ rc = (int)((ssize_t(*)(int,const void*,size_t,off64_t)) aSyscall[13].pCurrent)(fd,pBuf,nBuf,iOff);}while(rc<0&&errno==EINTR);

  do{
    i64 iSeek =lseek64(fd,iOff, SEEK_SET);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); iSeek = -1; };
    if( iSeek<0 ){
      rc = -1;
      break;
    }
    rc =((ssize_t(*)(int,const void*,size_t))aSyscall[11].pCurrent)(fd,pBuf,nBuf);
  }while( rc<0 && errno==EINTR );


g_elapsed=sqlite3Hwtime()-g_start;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE   %-3d %5d %7lld %llu\n", fd, rc, iOff, g_elapsed);

  if( rc<0 ) *piErrno = errno;
  return rc;
}









static int seekAndWrite(unixFile *id, i64 offset, const void *pBuf, int cnt){
  return seekAndWriteFd(id->h, offset, pBuf, cnt, &id->lastErrno);
}






static int unixWrite(
  sqlite3_file *id,
  const void *pBuf,
  int amt,
  sqlite3_int64 offset
){
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  int wrote = 0;
  assert( id );
  assert( amt>0 );




  assert( pFile->pPreallocatedUnused==0
       || offset>=(0x40000000)+512
       || offset+amt<=(0x40000000)
  );









  if( pFile->inNormalWrite ){
    pFile->dbUpdate = 1;
    if( offset<=24 && offset+amt>=27 ){
      int rc;
      char oldCntr[4];
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)   ;
      rc = seekAndRead(pFile, 24, oldCntr, 4);
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)   ;
      if( rc!=4 || memcmp(oldCntr, &((char*)pBuf)[24 -offset],4)!=0 ){
        pFile->transCntrChng = 1;
      }
    }
  }





  if( offset<pFile->mmapSize ){
    if( offset+amt <= pFile->mmapSize ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pBuf); int xxn=(amt);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      return 0        ;
    }else{
      int nCopy = pFile->mmapSize - offset;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pBuf); int xxn=(nCopy);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pBuf = &((u8 *)pBuf)[nCopy];
      amt -= nCopy;
      offset += nCopy;
    }
  }


  while( (wrote = seekAndWrite(pFile, offset, pBuf, amt))<amt && wrote>0 ){
    amt -= wrote;
    offset += wrote;
    pBuf = &((char*)pBuf)[wrote];
  }
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); ( wrote=(-1), amt=1 ); };
if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending ){ if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending == 1 ){ local_ioerr(); sqlite3_diskfull = 1; sqlite3_io_error_hit = 1; ( wrote=0, amt=1 ); }else{ sqlite3_diskfull_pending--; } };

  if( amt>wrote ){
    if( wrote<0 && pFile->lastErrno!=ENOSPC ){

      return(10 | (3<<8))      ;
    }else{
      storeLastErrno(pFile, 0);
      return 13         ;
    }
  }

  return 0        ;
}






           int sqlite3_sync_count = 0;
           int sqlite3_fullsync_count = 0;
















































static int full_fsync(int fd, int fullSync, int dataOnly){
  int rc;






(void)(fd)            ;
(void)(fullSync)            ;
(void)(dataOnly)            ;

(void)(dataOnly)            ;

(void)(fullSync)            ;
(void)(dataOnly)            ;







  if( fullSync ) sqlite3_fullsync_count++;
  sqlite3_sync_count++;








  {
    struct stat buf;
    rc = osFstat(fd, &buf);
  }

  if( fullSync ){
    rc =lockTrace(fd,F_FULLFSYNC, 0);
  }else{
    rc = 1;
  }








  if( rc ) rc = fsync(fd);





  rc = fsync(fd);

  rc =fsync     (fd);

  if( rc==-1 && errno==ENOTSUP ){
    rc = fsync(fd);
  }



  if(1           && rc!= -1 ){
    rc = 0;
  }
  return rc;
}
























static int openDirectory(const char *zFilename, int *pFd){
  int ii;
  int fd = -1;
  char zDirname[512         +1];

  sqlite3_snprintf(512         , zDirname, "%s", zFilename);
  for(ii=(int)strlen(zDirname); ii>0 && zDirname[ii]!='/'; ii--);
  if( ii>0 ){
    zDirname[ii] = '\0';
  }else{
    if( zDirname[0]!='/' ) zDirname[0] = '.';
    zDirname[1] = 0;
  }
  fd = robust_open(zDirname, O_RDONLY|0       , 0);
  if( fd>=0 ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPENDIR %-3d %s\n", fd, zDirname);
  }
  *pFd = fd;
  if( fd>=0 ) return 0        ;
  return unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"openDirectory",zDirname,__LINE__);
}
















static int unixSync(sqlite3_file *id, int flags){
  int rc;
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;

  int isDataOnly = (flags&0x00010             );
  int isFullsync = (flags&0x0F)==0x00003         ;


  assert((flags&0x0F)==0x00002
      || (flags&0x0F)==0x00003
  );




if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending ){ if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending == 1 ){ local_ioerr(); sqlite3_diskfull = 1; sqlite3_io_error_hit = 1; return 13; }else{ sqlite3_diskfull_pending--; } };

  assert( pFile );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC    %-3d\n", pFile->h);
  rc = full_fsync(pFile->h, isFullsync, isDataOnly);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); rc=1; };
  if( rc ){
    storeLastErrno(pFile, errno);
    return unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (4<<8)),"full_fsync",pFile->zPath,__LINE__);
  }





  if( pFile->ctrlFlags &0x08              ){
    int dirfd;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DIRSYNC %s (have_fullfsync=%d fullsync=%d)\n", pFile->zPath, 
1, isFullsync)                          ;
    rc =((int(*)(const char*,int*))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(pFile->zPath,&dirfd);
    if( rc==0         ){
      full_fsync(dirfd, 0, 0);
      robust_close(pFile, dirfd, __LINE__);
    }else{
      assert( rc==14              );
      rc =0         ;
    }
    pFile->ctrlFlags &= ~0x08            ;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int unixTruncate(sqlite3_file *id, i64 nByte){
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile *)id;
  int rc;
  assert( pFile );
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (6<<8)); };






  if( pFile->szChunk>0 ){
    nByte = ((nByte + pFile->szChunk - 1)/pFile->szChunk) * pFile->szChunk;
  }

  rc = robust_ftruncate(pFile->h, nByte);
  if( rc ){
    storeLastErrno(pFile, errno);
    return unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (6<<8)),"ftruncate",pFile->zPath,__LINE__);
  }else{








    if( pFile->inNormalWrite && nByte==0 ){
      pFile->transCntrChng = 1;
    }







    if( nByte<pFile->mmapSize ){
      pFile->mmapSize = nByte;
    }


    return 0        ;
  }
}




static int unixFileSize(sqlite3_file *id, i64 *pSize){
  int rc;
  struct stat buf;
  assert( id );
  rc = osFstat(((unixFile*)id)->h, &buf);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); rc=1; };
  if( rc!=0 ){
    storeLastErrno((unixFile*)id, errno);
    return(10 | (7<<8))      ;
  }
  *pSize = buf.st_size;







  if( *pSize==1 ) *pSize = 0;


  return 0        ;
}

static int fcntlSizeHint(unixFile *pFile, i64 nByte){
  if( pFile->szChunk>0 ){
    i64 nSize;
    struct stat buf;

    if( osFstat(pFile->h, &buf) ){
      return(10 | (7<<8))      ;
    }

    nSize = ((nByte+pFile->szChunk-1) / pFile->szChunk) * pFile->szChunk;
    if( nSize>(i64)buf.st_size ){





      int err;
      do{
        err =((int(*)(int,off_t,off_t))aSyscall[15].pCurrent)(pFile->h,buf.st_size,nSize-buf.st_size);
      }while( err==EINTR );
      if( err && err!=EINVAL ) return(10 | (3<<8))      ;








      int nBlk = buf.st_blksize;
      int nWrite = 0;
      i64 iWrite;

      iWrite = (buf.st_size/nBlk)*nBlk + nBlk - 1;
      assert( iWrite>=buf.st_size );
      assert( ((iWrite+1)%nBlk)==0 );
      for(         ; iWrite<nSize+nBlk-1; iWrite+=nBlk ){
        if( iWrite>=nSize ) iWrite = nSize - 1;
        nWrite = seekAndWrite(pFile, iWrite, "", 1);
        if( nWrite!=1 ) return(10 | (3<<8))      ;
      }

    }
  }


  if( pFile->mmapSizeMax>0 && nByte>pFile->mmapSize ){
    int rc;
    if( pFile->szChunk<=0 ){
      if( robust_ftruncate(pFile->h, nByte) ){
        storeLastErrno(pFile, errno);
        return unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (6<<8)),"ftruncate",pFile->zPath,__LINE__);
      }
    }

    rc = unixMapfile(pFile, nByte);
    return rc;
  }


  return 0        ;
}







static void unixModeBit(unixFile *pFile, unsigned char mask, int *pArg){
  if( *pArg<0 ){
    *pArg = (pFile->ctrlFlags & mask)!=0;
  }else if( (*pArg)==0 ){
    pFile->ctrlFlags &= ~mask;
  }else{
    pFile->ctrlFlags |= mask;
  }
}


static int unixGetTempname(int nBuf, char *zBuf);

 static int unixFcntlExternalReader(unixFile*, int*);





static int unixFileControl(sqlite3_file *id, int op, void *pArg){
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  switch( op ){

    case 31                             : {
      int rc =((int(*)(int,int,...))aSyscall[28].pCurrent)(pFile->h,_IO(0xf5, 1));
      return rc ?(10 | (29<<8))             :0         ;
    }
    case 32                              : {
      int rc =((int(*)(int,int,...))aSyscall[28].pCurrent)(pFile->h,_IO(0xf5, 2));
      return rc ?(10 | (30<<8))              :0         ;
    }
    case 33                                : {
      int rc =((int(*)(int,int,...))aSyscall[28].pCurrent)(pFile->h,_IO(0xf5, 5));
      return rc ?(10 | (31<<8))                :0         ;
    }


    case 1                     : {
      *(int*)pArg = pFile->eFileLock;
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 4                      : {
      *(int*)pArg = pFile->lastErrno;
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 6                      : {
      pFile->szChunk = *(int *)pArg;
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 5                     : {
      int rc;
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)   ;
      rc = fcntlSizeHint(pFile, *(i64 *)pArg);
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)   ;
      return rc;
    }
    case 10                      : {
      unixModeBit(pFile,0x04                 , (int*)pArg);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 13                              : {
      unixModeBit(pFile,0x10          , (int*)pArg);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 12                  : {
      *(char**)pArg = sqlite3_mprintf("%s", pFile->pVfs->zName);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 16                       : {
      char *zTFile = sqlite3_malloc64( pFile->pVfs->mxPathname );
      if( zTFile ){
        unixGetTempname(pFile->pVfs->mxPathname, zTFile);
        *(char**)pArg = zTFile;
      }
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 20                    : {
      *(int*)pArg = fileHasMoved(pFile);
      return 0        ;
    }

    case 34                       : {
      int iOld = pFile->iBusyTimeout;
      pFile->iBusyTimeout = *(int*)pArg;
      *(int*)pArg = iOld;
      return 0        ;
    }


    case 18                    : {
      i64 newLimit = *(i64*)pArg;
      int rc =0         ;
      if( newLimit>(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMmap){
        newLimit =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMmap;
      }




      if( newLimit>0 && sizeof(size_t)<8 ){
        newLimit = (newLimit & 0x7FFFFFFF);
      }

      *(i64*)pArg = pFile->mmapSizeMax;
      if( newLimit>=0 && newLimit!=pFile->mmapSizeMax && pFile->nFetchOut==0 ){
        pFile->mmapSizeMax = newLimit;
        if( pFile->mmapSize>0 ){
          unixUnmapfile(pFile);
          rc = unixMapfile(pFile, -1);
        }
      }
      return rc;
    }







    case 0xca093fa0               : {
      ((unixFile*)id)->dbUpdate = 0;
      return 0        ;
    }


    case 3                             :
    case 2                             : {
      return proxyFileControl(id,op,pArg);
    }


    case 40                          : {

      return unixFcntlExternalReader((unixFile*)id, (int*)pArg);

      *(int*)pArg = 0;
      return 0        ;

    }
  }
  return 12             ;
}











static void setDeviceCharacteristics(unixFile *pFd){
  assert( pFd->deviceCharacteristics==0 || pFd->sectorSize!=0 );
  if( pFd->sectorSize==0 ){

    int res;
    u32 f = 0;


    res =((int(*)(int,int,...))aSyscall[28].pCurrent)(pFd->h,_IOR(0xf5, 12, u32),&f);
    if( res==0 && (f &0x0004                    ) ){
      pFd->deviceCharacteristics =0x00004000                ;
    }



    if( pFd->ctrlFlags &0x10           ){
      pFd->deviceCharacteristics |=0x00001000                       ;
    }

    pFd->sectorSize =4096                       ;
  }
}



static void setDeviceCharacteristics(unixFile *pFile){
  if( pFile->sectorSize == 0 ){
    struct statvfs fsInfo;


    pFile->sectorSize =4096                       ;
    pFile->deviceCharacteristics = 0;
    if( fstatvfs(pFile->h, &fsInfo) == -1 ) {
      return;
    }

    if( !strcmp(fsInfo.f_basetype, "tmp") ) {
      pFile->sectorSize = fsInfo.f_bsize;
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =
0x00000010                    |
0x00000200                       |

0x00000400                      |

        0;
    }else if( strstr(fsInfo.f_basetype, "etfs") ){
      pFile->sectorSize = fsInfo.f_bsize;
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =

        (pFile->sectorSize / 512 *0x00000002             ) |
0x00000200                       |

0x00000400                      |

        0;
    }else if( !strcmp(fsInfo.f_basetype, "qnx6") ){
      pFile->sectorSize = fsInfo.f_bsize;
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =
0x00000001                  |
0x00000200                       |

0x00000400                      |

        0;
    }else if( !strcmp(fsInfo.f_basetype, "qnx4") ){
      pFile->sectorSize = fsInfo.f_bsize;
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =

        ((pFile->sectorSize / 512 *0x00000002             ) << 1) - 2 |
0x00000400                      |

        0;
    }else if( strstr(fsInfo.f_basetype, "dos") ){
      pFile->sectorSize = fsInfo.f_bsize;
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =

        ((pFile->sectorSize / 512 *0x00000002             ) << 1) - 2 |
0x00000400                      |

        0;
    }else{
      pFile->deviceCharacteristics =
0x00000002                     |
0x00000200                       |

        0;
    }
  }


  if( pFile->sectorSize % 512 != 0 ){
    pFile->deviceCharacteristics = 0;
    pFile->sectorSize =4096                       ;
  }
}












static int unixSectorSize(sqlite3_file *id){
  unixFile *pFd = (unixFile*)id;
  setDeviceCharacteristics(pFd);
  return pFd->sectorSize;
}














static int unixDeviceCharacteristics(sqlite3_file *id){
  unixFile *pFd = (unixFile*)id;
  setDeviceCharacteristics(pFd);
  return pFd->deviceCharacteristics;
}









static int unixGetpagesize(void){

  return 1024;

  return getpagesize();

  return (int)sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);

}


































struct unixShmNode {
  unixInodeInfo *pInode;
  sqlite3_mutex *pShmMutex;
  char *zFilename;
  int hShm;
  int szRegion;
  u16 nRegion;
  u8 isReadonly;
  u8 isUnlocked;
  char **apRegion;
  int nRef;
  unixShm *pFirst;
  int aLock[8               ];

  u8 exclMask;
  u8 sharedMask;
  u8 nextShmId;

};














struct unixShm {
  unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  unixShm *pNext;
  u8 hasMutex;
  u8 id;
  u16 sharedMask;
  u16 exclMask;
};















static int unixFcntlExternalReader(unixFile *pFile, int *piOut){
  int rc =0         ;
  *piOut = 0;
  if( pFile->pShm){
    unixShmNode *pShmNode = pFile->pShm->pShmNode;
    struct flock f;

    memset(&f, 0, sizeof(f));
    f.l_type =1       ;
    f.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
    f.l_start =((22 +8)*4)    + 3;
    f.l_len =8                 - 3;

                                            ;
    if(lockTrace(pShmNode->hShm,12     , &f)<0 ){
      rc =(10 | (15<<8))    ;
    }else{
      *piOut = (f.l_type!=2      );
    }
                                            ;
  }

  return rc;
}








static int unixShmSystemLock(
  unixFile *pFile,
  int lockType,
  int ofst,
  int n
){
  unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  struct flock f;
  int rc =0         ;


  pShmNode = pFile->pInode->pShmNode;
  assert( pShmNode->nRef==0 ||((void)(pShmNode->pShmMutex),1)          );
  assert( pShmNode->nRef>0 || unixMutexHeld() );


  assert( n==1 || lockType!=0       );


  assert( n>=1 && n<=8                );

  if( pShmNode->hShm>=0 ){
    int res;

    f.l_type = lockType;
    f.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
    f.l_start = ofst;
    f.l_len = n;
    res =lockTrace(pShmNode->hShm,13,&f)                   ;
    if( res==-1 ){

      rc = (pFile->iBusyTimeout ?(5 | (3<<8))         :5           );

      rc =5           ;

    }
  }



  { u16 mask;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-LOCK ");
  mask = ofst>31 ? 0xffff : (1<<(ofst+n)) - (1<<ofst);
  if( rc==0         ){
    if( lockType==2       ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("unlock %d ok", ofst);
      pShmNode->exclMask &= ~mask;
      pShmNode->sharedMask &= ~mask;
    }else if( lockType==0       ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("read-lock %d ok", ofst);
      pShmNode->exclMask &= ~mask;
      pShmNode->sharedMask |= mask;
    }else{
      assert( lockType==1       );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("write-lock %d ok", ofst);
      pShmNode->exclMask |= mask;
      pShmNode->sharedMask &= ~mask;
    }
  }else{
    if( lockType==2       ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("unlock %d failed", ofst);
    }else if( lockType==0       ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("read-lock failed");
    }else{
      assert( lockType==1       );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("write-lock %d failed", ofst);
    }
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf (" - afterwards %03x,%03x\n", 
pShmNode->sharedMask, pShmNode->exclMask)            ;
  }


  return rc;
}










static int unixShmRegionPerMap(void){
  int shmsz = 32*1024;
  int pgsz =((int(*)(void))aSyscall[25].pCurrent)();
  assert( ((pgsz-1)&pgsz)==0 );
  if( pgsz<shmsz ) return 1;
  return pgsz/shmsz;
}







static void unixShmPurge(unixFile *pFd){
  unixShmNode *p = pFd->pInode->pShmNode;
  assert( unixMutexHeld() );
  if( p &&(1)                 ){
    int nShmPerMap = unixShmRegionPerMap();
    int i;
    assert( p->pInode==pFd->pInode );
                                    ;
    for(i=0; i<p->nRegion; i+=nShmPerMap){
      if( p->hShm>=0 ){
((int(*)(void*,size_t))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(p->apRegion[i],p->szRegion);
      }else{
        sqlite3_free(p->apRegion[i]);
      }
    }
    sqlite3_free(p->apRegion);
    if( p->hShm>=0 ){
      robust_close(pFd, p->hShm, __LINE__);
      p->hShm = -1;
    }
    p->pInode->pShmNode = 0;
    sqlite3_free(p);
  }
}










static int unixLockSharedMemory(unixFile *pDbFd, unixShmNode *pShmNode){
  struct flock lock;
  int rc =0         ;



















  lock.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
  lock.l_start =(((22 +8)*4)+8);
  lock.l_len = 1;
  lock.l_type =1       ;
  if(lockTrace(pShmNode->hShm,12     , &lock)!=0 ) {
    rc =(10 | (15<<8))    ;
  }else if( lock.l_type==2       ){
    if( pShmNode->isReadonly ){
      pShmNode->isUnlocked = 1;
      rc =(8 | (5<<8))             ;
    }else{
      rc = unixShmSystemLock(pDbFd,1       ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);





      if( rc==0         && robust_ftruncate(pShmNode->hShm, 3) ){
        rc =unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (18<<8)),"ftruncate",pShmNode->zFilename,__LINE__);
      }
    }
  }else if( lock.l_type==1       ){
    rc =5           ;
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( lock.l_type==2       || lock.l_type==0       );
    rc = unixShmSystemLock(pDbFd,0       ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
  }
  return rc;
}




































static int unixOpenSharedMemory(unixFile *pDbFd){
  struct unixShm *p = 0;
  struct unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  int rc =0         ;
  unixInodeInfo *pInode;
  char *zShm;
  int nShmFilename;


  p = sqlite3_malloc64( sizeof(*p) );
  if( p==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
  assert( pDbFd->pShm==0 );




  assert( unixFileMutexNotheld(pDbFd) );
  unixEnterMutex();
  pInode = pDbFd->pInode;
  pShmNode = pInode->pShmNode;
  if( pShmNode==0 ){
    struct stat sStat;

    const char *zBasePath = pDbFd->zPath;






    if( osFstat(pDbFd->h, &sStat) ){
      rc =(10 | (7<<8))      ;
      goto shm_open_err;
    }


    nShmFilename = sizeof(SQLITE_SHM_DIRECTORY) + 31;

    nShmFilename = 6 + (int)strlen(zBasePath);

    pShmNode = sqlite3_malloc64( sizeof(*pShmNode) + nShmFilename );
    if( pShmNode==0 ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      goto shm_open_err;
    }
    memset(pShmNode, 0, sizeof(*pShmNode)+nShmFilename);
    zShm = pShmNode->zFilename = (char*)&pShmNode[1];

    sqlite3_snprintf(nShmFilename, zShm,
                     SQLITE_SHM_DIRECTORY "/sqlite-shm-%x-%x",
                     (u32)sStat.st_ino, (u32)sStat.st_dev);

    sqlite3_snprintf(nShmFilename, zShm, "%s-shm", zBasePath);
                                          ;

    pShmNode->hShm = -1;
    pDbFd->pInode->pShmNode = pShmNode;
    pShmNode->pInode = pDbFd->pInode;
    if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex){
      pShmNode->pShmMutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                    ;
      if( pShmNode->pShmMutex==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
        goto shm_open_err;
      }
    }

    if( pInode->bProcessLock==0 ){
      if( 0==sqlite3_uri_boolean(pDbFd->zPath, "readonly_shm", 0) ){
        pShmNode->hShm = robust_open(zShm, O_RDWR|O_CREAT|0         ,
                                     (sStat.st_mode&0777));
      }
      if( pShmNode->hShm<0 ){
        pShmNode->hShm = robust_open(zShm, O_RDONLY|0         ,
                                     (sStat.st_mode&0777));
        if( pShmNode->hShm<0 ){
          rc =unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"open",zShm,__LINE__);
          goto shm_open_err;
        }
        pShmNode->isReadonly = 1;
      }





      robustFchown(pShmNode->hShm, sStat.st_uid, sStat.st_gid);

      rc = unixLockSharedMemory(pDbFd, pShmNode);
      if( rc!=0         && rc!=(8 | (5<<8))             ) goto shm_open_err;
    }
  }


  p->pShmNode = pShmNode;

  p->id = pShmNode->nextShmId++;

  pShmNode->nRef++;
  pDbFd->pShm = p;
  unixLeaveMutex();








                                          ;
  p->pNext = pShmNode->pFirst;
  pShmNode->pFirst = p;
                                          ;
  return rc;


shm_open_err:
  unixShmPurge(pDbFd);
  sqlite3_free(p);
  unixLeaveMutex();
  return rc;
}




















static int unixShmMap(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int iRegion,
  int szRegion,
  int bExtend,
  void volatile **pp
){
  unixFile *pDbFd = (unixFile*)fd;
  unixShm *p;
  unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nShmPerMap = unixShmRegionPerMap();
  int nReqRegion;


  if( pDbFd->pShm==0 ){
    rc = unixOpenSharedMemory(pDbFd);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  }

  p = pDbFd->pShm;
  pShmNode = p->pShmNode;
                                          ;
  if( pShmNode->isUnlocked ){
    rc = unixLockSharedMemory(pDbFd, pShmNode);
    if( rc!=0         ) goto shmpage_out;
    pShmNode->isUnlocked = 0;
  }
  assert( szRegion==pShmNode->szRegion || pShmNode->nRegion==0 );
  assert( pShmNode->pInode==pDbFd->pInode );
  assert( pShmNode->hShm>=0 || pDbFd->pInode->bProcessLock==1 );
  assert( pShmNode->hShm<0 || pDbFd->pInode->bProcessLock==0 );


  nReqRegion = ((iRegion+nShmPerMap) / nShmPerMap) * nShmPerMap;

  if( pShmNode->nRegion<nReqRegion ){
    char **apNew;
    int nByte = nReqRegion*szRegion;
    struct stat sStat;

    pShmNode->szRegion = szRegion;

    if( pShmNode->hShm>=0 ){




      if( osFstat(pShmNode->hShm, &sStat) ){
        rc =(10 | (19<<8))       ;
        goto shmpage_out;
      }

      if( sStat.st_size<nByte ){



        if( !bExtend ){
          goto shmpage_out;
        }








        else{
          static const int pgsz = 4096;
          int iPg;


          assert( (nByte % pgsz)==0 );
          for(iPg=(sStat.st_size/pgsz); iPg<(nByte/pgsz); iPg++){
            int x = 0;
            if( seekAndWriteFd(pShmNode->hShm, iPg*pgsz + pgsz-1,"",1,&x)!=1 ){
              const char *zFile = pShmNode->zFilename;
              rc =unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (19<<8)),"write",zFile,__LINE__);
              goto shmpage_out;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }


    apNew = (char **)sqlite3_realloc(
        pShmNode->apRegion, nReqRegion*sizeof(char *)
    );
    if( !apNew ){
      rc =sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
      goto shmpage_out;
    }
    pShmNode->apRegion = apNew;
    while( pShmNode->nRegion<nReqRegion ){
      int nMap = szRegion*nShmPerMap;
      int i;
      void *pMem;
      if( pShmNode->hShm>=0 ){
        pMem =((void*(*)(void*,size_t,int,int,int,off_t))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)(0,nMap,
            pShmNode->isReadonly ? PROT_READ : PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,
            MAP_SHARED, pShmNode->hShm, szRegion*(i64)pShmNode->nRegion
        );
        if( pMem==MAP_FAILED ){
          rc =unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (21<<8)),"mmap",pShmNode->zFilename,__LINE__);
          goto shmpage_out;
        }
      }else{
        pMem = sqlite3_malloc64(nMap);
        if( pMem==0 ){
          rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
          goto shmpage_out;
        }
        memset(pMem, 0, nMap);
      }

      for(i=0; i<nShmPerMap; i++){
        pShmNode->apRegion[pShmNode->nRegion+i] = &((char*)pMem)[szRegion*i];
      }
      pShmNode->nRegion += nShmPerMap;
    }
  }

shmpage_out:
  if( pShmNode->nRegion>iRegion ){
    *pp = pShmNode->apRegion[iRegion];
  }else{
    *pp = 0;
  }
  if( pShmNode->isReadonly && rc==0         ) rc =8               ;
                                          ;
  return rc;
}









static int assertLockingArrayOk(unixShmNode *pShmNode){
  unixShm *pX;
  int aLock[8               ];
  assert(((void)(pShmNode->pShmMutex),1)          );

  memset(aLock, 0, sizeof(aLock));
  for(pX=pShmNode->pFirst; pX; pX=pX->pNext){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<8               ; i++){
      if( pX->exclMask & (1<<i) ){
        assert( aLock[i]==0 );
        aLock[i] = -1;
      }else if( pX->sharedMask & (1<<i) ){
        assert( aLock[i]>=0 );
        aLock[i]++;
      }
    }
  }

  assert( 0==memcmp(pShmNode->aLock, aLock, sizeof(aLock)) );
  return (memcmp(pShmNode->aLock, aLock, sizeof(aLock))==0);
}










static int unixShmLock(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int ofst,
  int n,
  int flags
){
  unixFile *pDbFd = (unixFile*)fd;
  unixShm *p;
  unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  int rc =0         ;
  u16 mask;
  int *aLock;

  p = pDbFd->pShm;
  if( p==0 ) return(10 | (20<<8))       ;
  pShmNode = p->pShmNode;
  if((0)                 ) return(10 | (20<<8))       ;
  aLock = pShmNode->aLock;

  assert( pShmNode==pDbFd->pInode->pShmNode );
  assert( pShmNode->pInode==pDbFd->pInode );
  assert( ofst>=0 && ofst+n<=8                );
  assert( n>=1 );
  assert( flags==(2               |4                 )
       || flags==(2               |8                    )
       || flags==(1                 |4                 )
       || flags==(1                 |8                    ) );
  assert( n==1 || (flags &8                    )!=0 );
  assert( pShmNode->hShm>=0 || pDbFd->pInode->bProcessLock==1 );
  assert( pShmNode->hShm<0 || pDbFd->pInode->bProcessLock==0 );















  assert( (flags &1                 ) || pDbFd->iBusyTimeout==0 || (
         (ofst!=2)
      && (ofst!=1 || (p->exclMask|p->sharedMask)==0)
      && (ofst!=0 || (p->exclMask|p->sharedMask)<3)
      && (ofst<3  || (p->exclMask|p->sharedMask)<(1<<ofst))
  ));


  mask = (1<<(ofst+n)) - (1<<ofst);
  assert( n>1 || mask==(1<<ofst) );
                                          ;
  assert( assertLockingArrayOk(pShmNode) );
  if( flags &1                  ){
    if( (p->exclMask|p->sharedMask) & mask ){
      int ii;
      int bUnlock = 1;

      for(ii=ofst; ii<ofst+n; ii++){
        if( aLock[ii]>((p->sharedMask & (1<<ii)) ? 1 : 0) ){
          bUnlock = 0;
        }
      }

      if( bUnlock ){
        rc = unixShmSystemLock(pDbFd,2       , ofst+((22 +8)*4)  , n);
        if( rc==0         ){
          memset(&aLock[ofst], 0, sizeof(int)*n);
        }
      }else if((1)                                ){
        assert( n==1 && aLock[ofst]>1 );
        aLock[ofst]--;
      }


      if( rc==0         ){
        p->exclMask &= ~mask;
        p->sharedMask &= ~mask;
      }
    }
  }else if( flags &4                  ){
    assert( n==1 );
    assert( (p->exclMask & (1<<ofst))==0 );
    if( (p->sharedMask & mask)==0 ){
      if( aLock[ofst]<0 ){
        rc =5           ;
      }else if( aLock[ofst]==0 ){
        rc = unixShmSystemLock(pDbFd,0       , ofst+((22 +8)*4)  , n);
      }


      if( rc==0         ){
        p->sharedMask |= mask;
        aLock[ofst]++;
      }
    }
  }else{


    int ii;
    for(ii=ofst; ii<ofst+n; ii++){
      assert( (p->sharedMask & mask)==0 );
      if((1)                                 && aLock[ii] ){
        rc =5           ;
        break;
      }
    }



    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = unixShmSystemLock(pDbFd,1       , ofst+((22 +8)*4)  , n);
      if( rc==0         ){
        assert( (p->sharedMask & mask)==0 );
        p->exclMask |= mask;
        for(ii=ofst; ii<ofst+n; ii++){
          aLock[ii] = -1;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  assert( assertLockingArrayOk(pShmNode) );
                                          ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-LOCK shmid-%d, pid-%d got %03x,%03x\n", 
p->id, (pid_t)1, p->sharedMask, p->exclMask)               ;
  return rc;
}







static void unixShmBarrier(
  sqlite3_file *fd
){
(void)(fd)            ;
                        ;
  assert( fd->pMethods->xLock==nolockLock
       || unixFileMutexNotheld((unixFile*)fd)
  );
  unixEnterMutex();
  unixLeaveMutex();
}








static int unixShmUnmap(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int deleteFlag
){
  unixShm *p;
  unixShmNode *pShmNode;
  unixShm **pp;
  unixFile *pDbFd;

  pDbFd = (unixFile*)fd;
  p = pDbFd->pShm;
  if( p==0 ) return 0        ;
  pShmNode = p->pShmNode;

  assert( pShmNode==pDbFd->pInode->pShmNode );
  assert( pShmNode->pInode==pDbFd->pInode );



                                          ;
  for(pp=&pShmNode->pFirst; (*pp)!=p; pp = &(*pp)->pNext){}
  *pp = p->pNext;


  sqlite3_free(p);
  pDbFd->pShm = 0;
                                          ;



  assert( unixFileMutexNotheld(pDbFd) );
  unixEnterMutex();
  assert( pShmNode->nRef>0 );
  pShmNode->nRef--;
  if( pShmNode->nRef==0 ){
    if( deleteFlag && pShmNode->hShm>=0 ){
((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[16].pCurrent)(pShmNode->zFilename);
    }
    unixShmPurge(pDbFd);
  }
  unixLeaveMutex();

  return 0        ;
}













static void unixUnmapfile(unixFile *pFd){
  assert( pFd->nFetchOut==0 );
  if( pFd->pMapRegion ){
((int(*)(void*,size_t))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(pFd->pMapRegion,pFd->mmapSizeActual);
    pFd->pMapRegion = 0;
    pFd->mmapSize = 0;
    pFd->mmapSizeActual = 0;
  }
}
















static void unixRemapfile(
  unixFile *pFd,
  i64 nNew
){
  const char *zErr = "mmap";
  int h = pFd->h;
  u8 *pOrig = (u8 *)pFd->pMapRegion;
  i64 nOrig = pFd->mmapSizeActual;
  u8 *pNew = 0;
  int flags = PROT_READ;

  assert( pFd->nFetchOut==0 );
  assert( nNew>pFd->mmapSize );
  assert( nNew<=pFd->mmapSizeMax );
  assert( nNew>0 );
  assert( pFd->mmapSizeActual>=pFd->mmapSize );
  assert( MAP_FAILED!=0 );


  if( (pFd->ctrlFlags &0x02            )==0 ) flags |= PROT_WRITE;


  if( pOrig ){

    i64 nReuse = pFd->mmapSize;

    const int szSyspage =((int(*)(void))aSyscall[25].pCurrent)();
    i64 nReuse = (pFd->mmapSize & ~(szSyspage-1));

    u8 *pReq = &pOrig[nReuse];


    if( nReuse!=nOrig ){
((int(*)(void*,size_t))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(pReq,nOrig-nReuse);
    }


    pNew =((void*(*)(void*,size_t,size_t,int,...))aSyscall[24].pCurrent)(pOrig,nReuse,nNew,MREMAP_MAYMOVE);
    zErr = "mremap";

    pNew =((void*(*)(void*,size_t,int,int,int,off_t))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)(pReq,nNew-nReuse,flags,MAP_SHARED,h,nReuse);
    if( pNew!=MAP_FAILED ){
      if( pNew!=pReq ){
((int(*)(void*,size_t))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(pNew,nNew-nReuse);
        pNew = 0;
      }else{
        pNew = pOrig;
      }
    }



    if( pNew==MAP_FAILED || pNew==0 ){
((int(*)(void*,size_t))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(pOrig,nReuse);
    }
  }


  if( pNew==0 ){
    pNew =((void*(*)(void*,size_t,int,int,int,off_t))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)(0,nNew,flags,MAP_SHARED,h,0);
  }

  if( pNew==MAP_FAILED ){
    pNew = 0;
    nNew = 0;
unixLogErrorAtLine(0,zErr,pFd->zPath,__LINE__);




    pFd->mmapSizeMax = 0;
  }
  pFd->pMapRegion = (void *)pNew;
  pFd->mmapSize = pFd->mmapSizeActual = nNew;
}

















static int unixMapfile(unixFile *pFd, i64 nMap){
  assert( nMap>=0 || pFd->nFetchOut==0 );
  assert( nMap>0 || (pFd->mmapSize==0 && pFd->pMapRegion==0) );
  if( pFd->nFetchOut>0 ) return 0        ;

  if( nMap<0 ){
    struct stat statbuf;
    if( osFstat(pFd->h, &statbuf) ){
      return(10 | (7<<8))      ;
    }
    nMap = statbuf.st_size;
  }
  if( nMap>pFd->mmapSizeMax ){
    nMap = pFd->mmapSizeMax;
  }

  assert( nMap>0 || (pFd->mmapSize==0 && pFd->pMapRegion==0) );
  if( nMap!=pFd->mmapSize ){
    unixRemapfile(pFd, nMap);
  }

  return 0        ;
}














static int unixFetch(sqlite3_file *fd, i64 iOff, int nAmt, void **pp){

  unixFile *pFd = (unixFile *)fd;

  *pp = 0;


  if( pFd->mmapSizeMax>0 ){
    if( pFd->pMapRegion==0 ){
      int rc = unixMapfile(pFd, -1);
      if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    }
    if( pFd->mmapSize >= iOff+nAmt ){
      *pp = &((u8 *)pFd->pMapRegion)[iOff];
      pFd->nFetchOut++;
    }
  }

  return 0        ;
}











static int unixUnfetch(sqlite3_file *fd, i64 iOff, void *p){

  unixFile *pFd = (unixFile *)fd;
(void)(iOff)            ;




  assert( (p==0)==(pFd->nFetchOut==0) );


  assert( p==0 || p==&((u8 *)pFd->pMapRegion)[iOff] );

  if( p ){
    pFd->nFetchOut--;
  }else{
    unixUnmapfile(pFd);
  }

  assert( pFd->nFetchOut>=0 );

(void)(fd)            ;
(void)(p)            ;
(void)(iOff)            ;

  return 0        ;
}

static const sqlite3_io_methods *autolockIoFinderImpl(
  const char *filePath,
  unixFile *pNew
){
  static const struct Mapping {
    const char *zFilesystem;
    const sqlite3_io_methods *pMethods;
  } aMap[] = {
    { "hfs",    &posixIoMethods },
    { "ufs",    &posixIoMethods },
    { "afpfs",  &afpIoMethods },
    { "smbfs",  &afpIoMethods },
    { "webdav", &nolockIoMethods },
    { 0, 0 }
  };
  int i;
  struct statfs fsInfo;
  struct flock lockInfo;

  if( !filePath ){


    return &nolockIoMethods;
  }
  if( statfs(filePath, &fsInfo) != -1 ){
    if( fsInfo.f_flags & MNT_RDONLY ){
      return &nolockIoMethods;
    }
    for(i=0; aMap[i].zFilesystem; i++){
      if( strcmp(fsInfo.f_fstypename, aMap[i].zFilesystem)==0 ){
        return aMap[i].pMethods;
      }
    }
  }





  lockInfo.l_len = 1;
  lockInfo.l_start = 0;
  lockInfo.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
  lockInfo.l_type =0       ;
  if(lockTrace(pNew->h,12     , &lockInfo)!=-1 ) {
    if( strcmp(fsInfo.f_fstypename, "nfs")==0 ){
      return &nfsIoMethods;
    } else {
      return &posixIoMethods;
    }
  }else{
    return &dotlockIoMethods;
  }
}
static const sqlite3_io_methods
  *(*const autolockIoFinder)(const char*,unixFile*) = autolockIoFinderImpl;









static const sqlite3_io_methods *vxworksIoFinderImpl(
  const char *filePath,
  unixFile *pNew
){
  struct flock lockInfo;

  if( !filePath ){


    return &nolockIoMethods;
  }




  lockInfo.l_len = 1;
  lockInfo.l_start = 0;
  lockInfo.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
  lockInfo.l_type =0       ;
  if(lockTrace(pNew->h,12     , &lockInfo)!=-1 ) {
    return &posixIoMethods;
  }else{
    return &semIoMethods;
  }
}
static const sqlite3_io_methods
  *(*const vxworksIoFinder)(const char*,unixFile*) = vxworksIoFinderImpl;






typedef const sqlite3_io_methods *(*finder_type)(const char*,unixFile*);












static int fillInUnixFile(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  int h,
  sqlite3_file *pId,
  const char *zFilename,
  int ctrlFlags
){
  const sqlite3_io_methods *pLockingStyle;
  unixFile *pNew = (unixFile *)pId;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pNew->pInode==NULL );


  assert( zFilename!=0 || (ctrlFlags &0x80            )!=0 );

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN    %-3d %s\n", h, zFilename);
  pNew->h = h;
  pNew->pVfs = pVfs;
  pNew->zPath = zFilename;
  pNew->ctrlFlags = (u8)ctrlFlags;

  pNew->mmapSizeMax =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szMmap;

  if( sqlite3_uri_boolean(((ctrlFlags &0x40         ) ? zFilename : 0),
                           "psow",1                          ) ){
    pNew->ctrlFlags |=0x10          ;
  }
  if( strcmp(pVfs->zName,"unix-excl")==0 ){
    pNew->ctrlFlags |=0x01          ;
  }


  pNew->pId = vxworksFindFileId(zFilename);
  if( pNew->pId==0 ){
    ctrlFlags |=0x80            ;
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }


  if( ctrlFlags &0x80             ){
    pLockingStyle = &nolockIoMethods;
  }else{
    pLockingStyle = (**(finder_type*)pVfs->pAppData)(zFilename, pNew);




    pNew->lockingContext = (void*)zFilename;

  }

  if( pLockingStyle == &posixIoMethods

    || pLockingStyle == &nfsIoMethods

  ){
    unixEnterMutex();
    rc = findInodeInfo(pNew, &pNew->pInode);
    if( rc!=0         ){


















      robust_close(pNew, h, __LINE__);
      h = -1;
    }
    unixLeaveMutex();
  }


  else if( pLockingStyle == &afpIoMethods ){



    afpLockingContext *pCtx;
    pNew->lockingContext = pCtx = sqlite3_malloc64( sizeof(*pCtx) );
    if( pCtx==0 ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }else{



      pCtx->dbPath = zFilename;
      pCtx->reserved = 0;
      srandomdev();
      unixEnterMutex();
      rc = findInodeInfo(pNew, &pNew->pInode);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        sqlite3_free(pNew->lockingContext);
        robust_close(pNew, h, __LINE__);
        h = -1;
      }
      unixLeaveMutex();
    }
  }


  else if( pLockingStyle == &dotlockIoMethods ){



    char *zLockFile;
    int nFilename;
    assert( zFilename!=0 );
    nFilename = (int)strlen(zFilename) + 6;
    zLockFile = (char *)sqlite3_malloc64(nFilename);
    if( zLockFile==0 ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }else{
      sqlite3_snprintf(nFilename, zLockFile, "%s"".lock"        , zFilename);
    }
    pNew->lockingContext = zLockFile;
  }


  else if( pLockingStyle == &semIoMethods ){



    unixEnterMutex();
    rc = findInodeInfo(pNew, &pNew->pInode);
    if( (rc==0        ) && (pNew->pInode->pSem==NULL) ){
      char *zSemName = pNew->pInode->aSemName;
      int n;
      sqlite3_snprintf(512         , zSemName, "/%s.sem",
                       pNew->pId->zCanonicalName);
      for( n=1; zSemName[n]; n++ )
        if( zSemName[n]=='/' ) zSemName[n] = '_';
      pNew->pInode->pSem = sem_open(zSemName, O_CREAT, 0666, 1);
      if( pNew->pInode->pSem == SEM_FAILED ){
        rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
        pNew->pInode->aSemName[0] = '\0';
      }
    }
    unixLeaveMutex();
  }


  storeLastErrno(pNew, 0);

  if( rc!=0         ){
    if( h>=0 ) robust_close(pNew, h, __LINE__);
    h = -1;
((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[16].pCurrent)(zFilename);
    pNew->ctrlFlags |=0x20            ;
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
    if( h>=0 ) robust_close(pNew, h, __LINE__);
  }else{
    pId->pMethods = pLockingStyle;
sqlite3_open_file_count+=(+1);
    verifyDbFile(pNew);
  }
  return rc;
}




static const char *azTempDirs[] = {
  0,
  0,
  "/var/tmp",
  "/usr/tmp",
  "/tmp",
  "."
};




static void unixTempFileInit(void){
  azTempDirs[0] = getenv("SQLITE_TMPDIR");
  azTempDirs[1] = getenv("TMPDIR");
}





static const char *unixTempFileDir(void){
  unsigned int i = 0;
  struct stat buf;
  const char *zDir = sqlite3_temp_directory;

  while(1){
    if( zDir!=0
     &&((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)(zDir,&buf)==0
     && S_ISDIR(buf.st_mode)
     &&((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zDir,03)==0
    ){
      return zDir;
    }
    if( i>=sizeof(azTempDirs)/sizeof(azTempDirs[0]) ) break;
    zDir = azTempDirs[i++];
  }
  return 0;
}






static int unixGetTempname(int nBuf, char *zBuf){
  const char *zDir;
  int iLimit = 0;
  int rc =0         ;





  zBuf[0] = 0;
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return 10; };

                                                                     ;
  zDir = unixTempFileDir();
  if( zDir==0 ){
    rc =(10 | (25<<8))           ;
  }else{
    do{
      u64 r;
      sqlite3_randomness(sizeof(r), &r);
      assert( nBuf>2 );
      zBuf[nBuf-2] = 0;
      sqlite3_snprintf(nBuf, zBuf, "%s/"SQLITE_TEMP_FILE_PREFIX"%llx%c",
                       zDir, r, 0);
      if( zBuf[nBuf-2]!=0 || (iLimit++)>10 ){
        rc =1            ;
        break;
      }
    }while(((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zBuf,0)==0);
  }
                                                                     ;
  return rc;
}







static int proxyTransformUnixFile(unixFile*, const char*);


















static UnixUnusedFd *findReusableFd(const char *zPath, int flags){
  UnixUnusedFd *pUnused = 0;







  struct stat sStat;

  unixEnterMutex();









  if( inodeList!=0 && 0==((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)(zPath,&sStat)){
    unixInodeInfo *pInode;

    pInode = inodeList;
    while( pInode && (pInode->fileId.dev!=sStat.st_dev
                     || pInode->fileId.ino!=(u64)sStat.st_ino) ){
       pInode = pInode->pNext;
    }
    if( pInode ){
      UnixUnusedFd **pp;
      assert(((void)(pInode->pLockMutex),1)             );
                                             ;
      flags &= (0x00000001          |0x00000002           );
      for(pp=&pInode->pUnused; *pp && (*pp)->flags!=flags; pp=&((*pp)->pNext));
      pUnused = *pp;
      if( pUnused ){
        *pp = pUnused->pNext;
      }
                                             ;
    }
  }
  unixLeaveMutex();

  return pUnused;
}




static int getFileMode(
  const char *zFile,
  mode_t *pMode,
  uid_t *pUid,
  gid_t *pGid
){
  struct stat sStat;
  int rc =0         ;
  if( 0==((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)(zFile,&sStat)){
    *pMode = sStat.st_mode & 0777;
    *pUid = sStat.st_uid;
    *pGid = sStat.st_gid;
  }else{
    rc =(10 | (7<<8))      ;
  }
  return rc;
}






















static int findCreateFileMode(
  const char *zPath,
  int flags,
  mode_t *pMode,
  uid_t *pUid,
  gid_t *pGid
){
  int rc =0         ;
  *pMode = 0;
  *pUid = 0;
  *pGid = 0;
  if( flags & (0x00080000     |0x00000800              ) ){
    char zDb[512         +1];
    int nDb;



















    nDb = sqlite3Strlen30(zPath) - 1;
    while( nDb>0 && zPath[nDb]!='.' ){
      if( zPath[nDb]=='-' ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(zDb);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zPath); int xxn=(nDb);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        zDb[nDb] = '\0';
        rc = getFileMode(zDb, pMode, pUid, pGid);
        break;
      }
      nDb--;
    }
  }else if( flags &0x00000008                 ){
    *pMode = 0600;
  }else if( flags &0x00000040       ){




    const char *z = sqlite3_uri_parameter(zPath, "modeof");
    if( z ){
      rc = getFileMode(z, pMode, pUid, pGid);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}























static int unixOpen(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zPath,
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  int flags,
  int *pOutFlags
){
  unixFile *p = (unixFile *)pFile;
  int fd = -1;
  int openFlags = 0;
  int eType = flags&0x0FFF00;
  int noLock;
  int rc =0         ;
  int ctrlFlags = 0;

  int isExclusive  = (flags &0x00000010            );
  int isDelete     = (flags &0x00000008                );
  int isCreate     = (flags &0x00000004         );
  int isReadonly   = (flags &0x00000001           );
  int isReadWrite  = (flags &0x00000002            );

  int isAutoProxy  = (flags &0x00000020            );


  struct statfs fsInfo;






  int isNewJrnl = (isCreate && (
        eType==0x00004000
     || eType==0x00000800
     || eType==0x00080000
  ));




  char zTmpname[512         +2];
  const char *zName = zPath;








  assert((isReadonly==0 || isReadWrite==0) && (isReadWrite || isReadonly));
  assert(isCreate==0 || isReadWrite);
  assert(isExclusive==0 || isCreate);
  assert(isDelete==0 || isCreate);



  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00000100          );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00000800               );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00004000                );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00080000      );


  assert( eType==0x00000100               || eType==0x00000200
       || eType==0x00000800               || eType==0x00001000
       || eType==0x00002000               || eType==0x00004000
       || eType==0x00000400               || eType==0x00080000
  );






  if( randomnessPid!=(pid_t)1    ){
    randomnessPid =(pid_t)1    ;
    sqlite3_randomness(0,0);
  }
  memset(p, 0, sizeof(unixFile));



  assert( zName==0 );


  if( eType==0x00000100          ){
    UnixUnusedFd *pUnused;
    pUnused = findReusableFd(zName, flags);
    if( pUnused ){
      fd = pUnused->fd;
    }else{
      pUnused = sqlite3_malloc64(sizeof(*pUnused));
      if( !pUnused ){
        return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      }
    }
    p->pPreallocatedUnused = pUnused;




    assert( (flags &0x00000040      ) || zName[strlen(zName)+1]==0 );

  }else if( !zName ){

    assert(isDelete && !isNewJrnl);
    rc = unixGetTempname(pVfs->mxPathname, zTmpname);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      return rc;
    }
    zName = zTmpname;



    assert( zName[strlen(zName)+1]==0 );
  }





  if( isReadonly )  openFlags |= O_RDONLY;
  if( isReadWrite ) openFlags |= O_RDWR;
  if( isCreate )    openFlags |= O_CREAT;
  if( isExclusive ) openFlags |= (O_EXCL|0         );
  openFlags |= (0          |0       |0         );

  if( fd<0 ){
    mode_t openMode;
    uid_t uid;
    gid_t gid;
    rc = findCreateFileMode(zName, flags, &openMode, &uid, &gid);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      assert( !p->pPreallocatedUnused );
      assert( eType==0x00080000      || eType==0x00000800               );
      return rc;
    }
    fd = robust_open(zName, openFlags, openMode);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPENX   %-3d %s 0%o\n", fd, zName, openFlags);
    assert( !isExclusive || (openFlags & O_CREAT)!=0 );
    if( fd<0 ){
      if( isNewJrnl && errno==EACCES &&((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zName,F_OK)){


        rc =(8 | (6<<8))              ;
      }else if( errno!=EISDIR && isReadWrite ){

        flags &= ~(0x00000002           |0x00000004        );
        openFlags &= ~(O_RDWR|O_CREAT);
        flags |=0x00000001           ;
        openFlags |= O_RDONLY;
        isReadonly = 1;
        fd = robust_open(zName, openFlags, openMode);
      }
    }
    if( fd<0 ){
      int rc2 =unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"open",zName,__LINE__);
      if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
      goto open_finished;
    }













    if( openMode && (flags & (0x00080000     |0x00000800              ))!=0 ){
      robustFchown(fd, uid, gid);
    }
  }
  assert( fd>=0 );
  if( pOutFlags ){
    *pOutFlags = flags;
  }

  if( p->pPreallocatedUnused ){
    p->pPreallocatedUnused->fd = fd;
    p->pPreallocatedUnused->flags =
                          flags & (0x00000001          |0x00000002           );
  }

  if( isDelete ){

    zPath = zName;

    zPath = sqlite3_mprintf("%s", zName);
    if( zPath==0 ){
      robust_close(p, fd, __LINE__);
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }

((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[16].pCurrent)(zName);

  }

  else{
    p->openFlags = openFlags;
  }



  if( fstatfs(fd, &fsInfo) == -1 ){
    storeLastErrno(p, errno);
    robust_close(p, fd, __LINE__);
    return(10 | (13<<8))      ;
  }
  if (0 == strncmp("msdos", fsInfo.f_fstypename, 5)) {
    ((unixFile*)pFile)->fsFlags |=0x1                     ;
  }
  if (0 == strncmp("exfat", fsInfo.f_fstypename, 5)) {
    ((unixFile*)pFile)->fsFlags |=0x1                     ;
  }



  if( isDelete )                ctrlFlags |=0x20            ;
  if( isReadonly )              ctrlFlags |=0x02            ;
  noLock = eType!=0x00000100         ;
  if( noLock )                  ctrlFlags |=0x80            ;
  if( isNewJrnl )               ctrlFlags |=0x08             ;
  if( flags &0x00000040       ) ctrlFlags |=0x40         ;



  isAutoProxy = 1;

  if( isAutoProxy && (zPath!=NULL) && (!noLock) && pVfs->xOpen ){
    char *envforce = getenv("SQLITE_FORCE_PROXY_LOCKING");
    int useProxy = 0;



    if( envforce!=NULL ){
      useProxy = atoi(envforce)>0;
    }else{
      useProxy = !(fsInfo.f_flags&MNT_LOCAL);
    }
    if( useProxy ){
      rc = fillInUnixFile(pVfs, fd, pFile, zPath, ctrlFlags);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = proxyTransformUnixFile((unixFile*)pFile, ":auto:");
        if( rc!=0         ){




          unixClose(pFile);
          return rc;
        }
      }
      goto open_finished;
    }
  }


  assert( zPath==0 || zPath[0]=='/'
      || eType==0x00004000                || eType==0x00000800
  );
  rc = fillInUnixFile(pVfs, fd, pFile, zPath, ctrlFlags);

open_finished:
  if( rc!=0         ){
    sqlite3_free(p->pPreallocatedUnused);
  }
  return rc;
}






static int unixDelete(
  sqlite3_vfs *NotUsed,
  const char *zPath,
  int dirSync
){
  int rc =0         ;
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (10<<8)); };
  if(((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[16].pCurrent)(zPath)==(-1)){
    if( errno==ENOENT

        ||((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zPath,0)!=0

    ){
      rc =(10 | (23<<8))            ;
    }else{
      rc =unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (10<<8)),"unlink",zPath,__LINE__);
    }
    return rc;
  }

  if( (dirSync & 1)!=0 ){
    int fd;
    rc =((int(*)(const char*,int*))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(zPath,&fd);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( full_fsync(fd,0,0) ){
        rc =unixLogErrorAtLine((10 | (5<<8)),"fsync",zPath,__LINE__);
      }
      robust_close(0, fd, __LINE__);
    }else{
      assert( rc==14              );
      rc =0         ;
    }
  }

  return rc;
}











static int unixAccess(
  sqlite3_vfs *NotUsed,
  const char *zPath,
  int flags,
  int *pResOut
){
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (13<<8));; };
  assert( pResOut!=0 );



  assert( flags==0                    || flags==1                       );

  if( flags==0                    ){
    struct stat buf;
    *pResOut = 0==((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)(zPath,&buf)&&
                (!S_ISREG(buf.st_mode) || buf.st_size>0);
  }else{
    *pResOut =((int(*)(const char*,int))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zPath,W_OK|R_OK)==0;
  }
  return 0        ;
}




typedef struct DbPath DbPath;
struct DbPath {
  int rc;
  int nSymlink;
  char *zOut;
  int nOut;
  int nUsed;
};


static void appendAllPathElements(DbPath*,const char*);




static void appendOnePathElement(
  DbPath *pPath,
  const char *zName,
  int nName
){
  assert( nName>0 );
  assert( zName!=0 );
  if( zName[0]=='.' ){
    if( nName==1 ) return;
    if( zName[1]=='.' && nName==2 ){
      if( pPath->nUsed>1 ){
        assert( pPath->zOut[0]=='/' );
        while( pPath->zOut[--pPath->nUsed]!='/' ){}
      }
      return;
    }
  }
  if( pPath->nUsed + nName + 2 >= pPath->nOut ){
    pPath->rc =1            ;
    return;
  }
  pPath->zOut[pPath->nUsed++] = '/';
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pPath->zOut[pPath->nUsed]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zName); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pPath->nUsed += nName;

  if( pPath->rc==0         ){
    const char *zIn;
    struct stat buf;
    pPath->zOut[pPath->nUsed] = 0;
    zIn = pPath->zOut;
    if(((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[27].pCurrent)(zIn,&buf)!=0){
      if( errno!=ENOENT ){
        pPath->rc =unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"lstat",zIn,__LINE__);
      }
    }else if( S_ISLNK(buf.st_mode) ){
      ssize_t got;
      char zLnk[FILENAME_MAX      +2];
      if( pPath->nSymlink++ >200                 ){
        pPath->rc =sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
        return;
      }
      got =((ssize_t(*)(const char*,char*,size_t))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(zIn,zLnk,sizeof(zLnk)-2);
      if( got<=0 || got>=(ssize_t)sizeof(zLnk)-2 ){
        pPath->rc =unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"readlink",zIn,__LINE__);
        return;
      }
      zLnk[got] = 0;
      if( zLnk[0]=='/' ){
        pPath->nUsed = 0;
      }else{
        pPath->nUsed -= nName + 1;
      }
      appendAllPathElements(pPath, zLnk);
    }
  }

}




static void appendAllPathElements(
  DbPath *pPath,
  const char *zPath
){
  int i = 0;
  int j = 0;
  do{
    while( zPath[i] && zPath[i]!='/' ){ i++; }
    if( i>j ){
      appendOnePathElement(pPath, &zPath[j], i-j);
    }
    j = i+1;
  }while( zPath[i++] );
}










static int unixFullPathname(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zPath,
  int nOut,
  char *zOut
){
  DbPath path;
(void)(pVfs)            ;
  path.rc = 0;
  path.nUsed = 0;
  path.nSymlink = 0;
  path.nOut = nOut;
  path.zOut = zOut;
  if( zPath[0]!='/' ){
    char zPwd[FILENAME_MAX      +2];
    if(((char*(*)(char*,size_t))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(zPwd,sizeof(zPwd)-2)==0){
      return unixLogErrorAtLine(sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__),"getcwd",zPath,__LINE__);
    }
    appendAllPathElements(&path, zPwd);
  }
  appendAllPathElements(&path, zPath);
  zOut[path.nUsed] = 0;
  if( path.rc || path.nUsed<2 ) return sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
  if( path.nSymlink ) return(0 | (2<<8))      ;
  return 0        ;
}

}

static int unixRandomness(sqlite3_vfs *NotUsed, int nBuf, char *zBuf){
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  assert((size_t)nBuf>=(sizeof(time_t)+sizeof(int)));













  memset(zBuf, 0, nBuf);
  randomnessPid =(pid_t)1    ;

  {
    int fd, got;
    fd = robust_open("/dev/urandom", O_RDONLY, 0);
    if( fd<0 ){
      time_t t;
      time(&t);
{char*xxd=(char*)(zBuf);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&t); int xxn=(sizeof(t));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
{char*xxd=(char*)(&zBuf[sizeof(t)]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&randomnessPid); int xxn=(sizeof(randomnessPid));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      assert( sizeof(t)+sizeof(randomnessPid)<=(size_t)nBuf );
      nBuf = sizeof(t) + sizeof(randomnessPid);
    }else{
      do{ got =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t))aSyscall[8].pCurrent)(fd,zBuf,nBuf);}while(got<0&&errno==EINTR);
      robust_close(0, fd, __LINE__);
    }
  }

  return nBuf;
}










static int unixSleep(sqlite3_vfs *NotUsed, int microseconds){

  struct timespec sp;

  sp.tv_sec = microseconds / 1000000;
  sp.tv_nsec = (microseconds % 1000000) * 1000;
  nanosleep(&sp, NULL);
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  return microseconds;

  if( microseconds>=1000000 ) sleep(microseconds/1000000);
  if( microseconds%1000000 ) usleep(microseconds%1000000);
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  return microseconds;

  int seconds = (microseconds+999999)/1000000;
  sleep(seconds);
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  return seconds*1000000;

}







           int sqlite3_current_time = 0;












static int unixCurrentTimeInt64(sqlite3_vfs *NotUsed, sqlite3_int64 *piNow){
  static const sqlite3_int64 unixEpoch = 24405875*(sqlite3_int64)8640000;
  int rc =0         ;

  time_t t;
  time(&t);
  *piNow = ((sqlite3_int64)t)*1000 + unixEpoch;

  struct timespec sNow;
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &sNow);
  *piNow = unixEpoch + 1000*(sqlite3_int64)sNow.tv_sec + sNow.tv_nsec/1000000;

  struct timeval sNow;
  (void)gettimeofday(&sNow, 0);
  *piNow = unixEpoch + 1000*(sqlite3_int64)sNow.tv_sec + sNow.tv_usec/1000;



  if( sqlite3_current_time ){
    *piNow = 1000*(sqlite3_int64)sqlite3_current_time + unixEpoch;
  }

(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  return rc;
}

  int rc;
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  rc = unixCurrentTimeInt64(0, &i);
  *prNow = i/86400000.0;
  return rc;
}
