typedef struct proxyLockingContext proxyLockingContext;
struct proxyLockingContext {
  unixFile *conchFile;
  char *conchFilePath;
  unixFile *lockProxy;
  char *lockProxyPath;
  char *dbPath;
  int conchHeld;
  int nFails;
  void *oldLockingContext;
  sqlite3_io_methods const *pOldMethod;
};






static int proxyGetLockPath(const char *dbPath, char *lPath, size_t maxLen){
  int len;
  int dbLen;
  int i;


  len = strlcpy(lPath, LOCKPROXYDIR, maxLen);


  {
    if( !confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR, lPath, maxLen) ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("GETLOCKPATH  failed %s errno=%d pid=%d\n", 
lPath, errno, (pid_t)1)                   ;
      return(10 | (15<<8))    ;
    }
    len = strlcat(lPath, "sqliteplocks", maxLen);
  }

  len = strlcpy(lPath, "/tmp/", maxLen);



  if( lPath[len-1]!='/' ){
    len = strlcat(lPath, "/", maxLen);
  }


  dbLen = (int)strlen(dbPath);
  for( i=0; i<dbLen && (i+len+7)<(int)maxLen; i++){
    char c = dbPath[i];
    lPath[i+len] = (c=='/')?'_':c;
  }
  lPath[i+len]='\0';
  strlcat(lPath, ":auto:", maxLen);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("GETLOCKPATH  proxy lock path=%s pid=%d\n", lPath, (pid_t)1);
  return 0        ;
}




static int proxyCreateLockPath(const char *lockPath){
  int i, len;
  char buf[MAXPATHLEN];
  int start = 0;

  assert(lockPath!=NULL);

  len = (int)strlen(lockPath);
  buf[0] = lockPath[0];
  for( i=1; i<len; i++ ){
    if( lockPath[i] == '/' && (i - start > 0) ){

      if( i-start>2 || (i-start==1 && buf[start] != '.' && buf[start] != '/')
         || (i-start==2 && buf[start] != '.' && buf[start+1] != '.') ){
        buf[i]='\0';
        if(((int(*)(const char*,mode_t))aSyscall[18].pCurrent)(buf,0755)){
          int err=errno;
          if( err!=EEXIST ) {
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("CREATELOCKPATH  FAILED creating %s, " 
"'%s' proxy lock path=%s pid=%d\n", 
buf, strerror(err), lockPath, (pid_t)1)                         ;
            return err;
          }
        }
      }
      start=i+1;
    }
    buf[i] = lockPath[i];
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("CREATELOCKPATH  proxy lock path=%s pid=%d\n",lockPath,(pid_t)1);
  return 0;
}








static int proxyCreateUnixFile(
    const char *path,
    unixFile **ppFile,
    int islockfile
) {
  int fd = -1;
  unixFile *pNew;
  int rc =0         ;
  int openFlags = O_RDWR | O_CREAT |0          ;
  sqlite3_vfs dummyVfs;
  int terrno = 0;
  UnixUnusedFd *pUnused = NULL;







  pUnused = findReusableFd(path, openFlags);
  if( pUnused ){
    fd = pUnused->fd;
  }else{
    pUnused = sqlite3_malloc64(sizeof(*pUnused));
    if( !pUnused ){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
  }
  if( fd<0 ){
    fd = robust_open(path, openFlags, 0);
    terrno = errno;
    if( fd<0 && errno==ENOENT && islockfile ){
      if( proxyCreateLockPath(path) ==0          ){
        fd = robust_open(path, openFlags, 0);
      }
    }
  }
  if( fd<0 ){
    openFlags = O_RDONLY |0          ;
    fd = robust_open(path, openFlags, 0);
    terrno = errno;
  }
  if( fd<0 ){
    if( islockfile ){
      return 5          ;
    }
    switch (terrno) {
      case EACCES:
        return 3          ;
      case EIO:
        return(10 | (15<<8))    ;
      default:
        return sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
    }
  }

  pNew = (unixFile *)sqlite3_malloc64(sizeof(*pNew));
  if( pNew==NULL ){
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    goto end_create_proxy;
  }
  memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(unixFile));
  pNew->openFlags = openFlags;
  memset(&dummyVfs, 0, sizeof(dummyVfs));
  dummyVfs.pAppData = (void*)&autolockIoFinder;
  dummyVfs.zName = "dummy";
  pUnused->fd = fd;
  pUnused->flags = openFlags;
  pNew->pPreallocatedUnused = pUnused;

  rc = fillInUnixFile(&dummyVfs, fd, (sqlite3_file*)pNew, path, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    *ppFile = pNew;
    return 0        ;
  }
end_create_proxy:
  robust_close(pNew, fd, __LINE__);
  sqlite3_free(pNew);
  sqlite3_free(pUnused);
  return rc;
}



           int sqlite3_hostid_num = 0;






extern int gethostuuid(uuid_t id, const struct timespec *wait);





static int proxyGetHostID(unsigned char *pHostID, int *pError){
  assert(16              == sizeof(uuid_t));
  memset(pHostID, 0,16              );

  {
    struct timespec timeout = {1, 0};
    if( gethostuuid(pHostID, &timeout) ){
      int err = errno;
      if( pError ){
        *pError = err;
      }
      return 10          ;
    }
  }

(void)(pError)            ;



  if( sqlite3_hostid_num != 0){
    pHostID[0] = (char)(pHostID[0] + (char)(sqlite3_hostid_num & 0xFF));
  }


  return 0        ;
}














static int proxyBreakConchLock(unixFile *pFile, uuid_t myHostID){
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
  unixFile *conchFile = pCtx->conchFile;
  char tPath[MAXPATHLEN];
  char buf[(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN)];
  char *cPath = pCtx->conchFilePath;
  size_t readLen = 0;
  size_t pathLen = 0;
  char errmsg[64] = "";
  int fd = -1;
  int rc = -1;
(void)(myHostID)            ;


  pathLen = strlcpy(tPath, cPath, MAXPATHLEN);
  if( pathLen>MAXPATHLEN || pathLen<6 ||
     (strlcpy(&tPath[pathLen-5], "break", 6) != 5) ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(errmsg),errmsg,"path error (len %d)",(int)pathLen);
    goto end_breaklock;
  }

  readLen =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t,off_t))aSyscall[9].pCurrent)(conchFile->h,buf,(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN),0);
  if( readLen<(1 +16)         ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(errmsg),errmsg,"read error (len %d)",(int)readLen);
    goto end_breaklock;
  }

  fd = robust_open(tPath, (O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|0         ), 0);
  if( fd<0 ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(errmsg), errmsg, "create failed (%d)", errno);
    goto end_breaklock;
  }
  if(((ssize_t(*)(int,const void*,size_t,off_t)) aSyscall[12].pCurrent)(fd,buf,readLen,0)!=(ssize_t)readLen){
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(errmsg), errmsg, "write failed (%d)", errno);
    goto end_breaklock;
  }
  if( rename(tPath, cPath) ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(errmsg), errmsg, "rename failed (%d)", errno);
    goto end_breaklock;
  }
  rc = 0;
  fprintf(stderr, "broke stale lock on %s\n", cPath);
  robust_close(pFile, conchFile->h, __LINE__);
  conchFile->h = fd;
  conchFile->openFlags = O_RDWR | O_CREAT;

end_breaklock:
  if( rc ){
    if( fd>=0 ){
((int(*)(const char*))aSyscall[16].pCurrent)(tPath);
      robust_close(pFile, fd, __LINE__);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "failed to break stale lock on %s, %s\n", cPath, errmsg);
  }
  return rc;
}




static int proxyConchLock(unixFile *pFile, uuid_t myHostID, int lockType){
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
  unixFile *conchFile = pCtx->conchFile;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nTries = 0;
  struct timespec conchModTime;

  memset(&conchModTime, 0, sizeof(conchModTime));
  do {
    rc = conchFile->pMethod->xLock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile, lockType);
    nTries ++;
    if( rc==5           ){






      struct stat buf;
      if( osFstat(conchFile->h, &buf) ){
        storeLastErrno(pFile, errno);
        return(10 | (15<<8))    ;
      }

      if( nTries==1 ){
        conchModTime = buf.st_mtimespec;
        unixSleep(0,500000);
        continue;
      }

      assert( nTries>1 );
      if( conchModTime.tv_sec != buf.st_mtimespec.tv_sec ||
         conchModTime.tv_nsec != buf.st_mtimespec.tv_nsec ){
        return 5          ;
      }

      if( nTries==2 ){
        char tBuf[(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN)];
        int len =((ssize_t(*)(int,void*,size_t,off_t))aSyscall[9].pCurrent)(conchFile->h,tBuf,(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN),0);
        if( len<0 ){
          storeLastErrno(pFile, errno);
          return(10 | (15<<8))    ;
        }
        if( len>(1 +16)         && tBuf[0]==(char)2                 ){

          if( 0!=memcmp(&tBuf[1              ], myHostID,16              ) ){
            return 5          ;
          }
        }else{

          return 5          ;
        }
        unixSleep(0,10000000);
        continue;
      }

      assert( nTries==3 );
      if( 0==proxyBreakConchLock(pFile, myHostID) ){
        rc =0         ;
        if( lockType==4              ){
          rc = conchFile->pMethod->xLock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile,1           );
        }
        if( !rc ){
          rc = conchFile->pMethod->xLock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile, lockType);
        }
      }
    }
  } while( rc==5           && nTries<3 );

  return rc;
}







static int proxyTakeConch(unixFile *pFile){
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;

  if( pCtx->conchHeld!=0 ){
    return 0        ;
  }else{
    unixFile *conchFile = pCtx->conchFile;
    uuid_t myHostID;
    int pError = 0;
    char readBuf[(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN)];
    char lockPath[MAXPATHLEN];
    char *tempLockPath = NULL;
    int rc =0         ;
    int createConch = 0;
    int hostIdMatch = 0;
    int readLen = 0;
    int tryOldLockPath = 0;
    int forceNewLockPath = 0;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TAKECONCH  %d for %s pid=%d\n", conchFile->h, 
(pCtx->lockProxyPath ? pCtx->lockProxyPath : ":auto:"), 
(pid_t)1)                 ;

    rc = proxyGetHostID(myHostID, &pError);
    if( (rc&0xff)==10           ){
      storeLastErrno(pFile, pError);
      goto end_takeconch;
    }
    rc = proxyConchLock(pFile, myHostID,1           );
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto end_takeconch;
    }

    readLen = seekAndRead((unixFile*)conchFile, 0, readBuf,(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN));
    if( readLen<0 ){

      storeLastErrno(pFile, conchFile->lastErrno);
      rc =(10 | (1<<8))     ;
      goto end_takeconch;
    }else if( readLen<=(1              +16             ) ||
             readBuf[0]!=(char)2                  ){



      createConch = 1;
    }




    do {

      if( !createConch && !forceNewLockPath ){
        hostIdMatch = !memcmp(&readBuf[1              ], myHostID,
16                                               );

        if( !pCtx->lockProxyPath ){



          if( hostIdMatch ){
            size_t pathLen = (readLen -(1 +16)         );

            if( pathLen>=MAXPATHLEN ){
              pathLen=MAXPATHLEN-1;
            }
{char*xxd=(char*)(lockPath);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&readBuf[(1 +16)]); int xxn=(pathLen);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
            lockPath[pathLen] = 0;
            tempLockPath = lockPath;
            tryOldLockPath = 1;

            goto end_takeconch;
          }
        }else if( hostIdMatch
               && !strncmp(pCtx->lockProxyPath, &readBuf[(1 +16)        ],
                           readLen-(1 +16)        )
        ){

          goto end_takeconch;
        }
      }


      if( (conchFile->openFlags&O_RDWR) == 0 ){
        rc =5           ;
        goto end_takeconch;
      }


      if( !pCtx->lockProxyPath ){
        proxyGetLockPath(pCtx->dbPath, lockPath, MAXPATHLEN);
        tempLockPath = lockPath;

      }





      futimes(conchFile->h, NULL);
      if( hostIdMatch && !createConch ){
        if( conchFile->pInode && conchFile->pInode->nShared>1 ){


          rc =5           ;
        } else {
          rc = proxyConchLock(pFile, myHostID,4              );
        }
      }else{
        rc = proxyConchLock(pFile, myHostID,4              );
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        char writeBuffer[(1 +16 +MAXPATHLEN)];
        int writeSize = 0;

        writeBuffer[0] = (char)2                 ;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&writeBuffer[1]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(myHostID); int xxn=(16);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        if( pCtx->lockProxyPath!=NULL ){
          strlcpy(&writeBuffer[(1 +16)        ], pCtx->lockProxyPath,
                  MAXPATHLEN);
        }else{
          strlcpy(&writeBuffer[(1 +16)        ], tempLockPath, MAXPATHLEN);
        }
        writeSize =(1 +16)          + strlen(&writeBuffer[(1 +16)        ]);
        robust_ftruncate(conchFile->h, writeSize);
        rc = unixWrite((sqlite3_file *)conchFile, writeBuffer, writeSize, 0);
        full_fsync(conchFile->h,0,0);



        if( rc==0         && createConch ){
          struct stat buf;
          int err = osFstat(pFile->h, &buf);
          if( err==0 ){
            mode_t cmode = buf.st_mode&(S_IRUSR|S_IWUSR | S_IRGRP|S_IWGRP |
                                        S_IROTH|S_IWOTH);


((int(*)(int,mode_t))aSyscall[14].pCurrent)(conchFile->h,cmode);

            do{
              rc =((int(*)(int,mode_t))aSyscall[14].pCurrent)(conchFile->h,cmode);
            }while( rc==(-1) && errno==EINTR );
            if( rc!=0 ){
              int code = errno;
              fprintf(stderr, "fchmod %o FAILED with %d %s\n",
                      cmode, code, strerror(code));
            } else {
              fprintf(stderr, "fchmod %o SUCCEDED\n",cmode);
            }
          }else{
            int code = errno;
            fprintf(stderr, "STAT FAILED[%d] with %d %s\n",
                    err, code, strerror(code));

          }
        }
      }
      conchFile->pMethod->xUnlock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile,1           );

    end_takeconch:
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRANSPROXY: CLOSE  %d\n", pFile->h);
      if( rc==0         && pFile->openFlags ){
        int fd;
        if( pFile->h>=0 ){
          robust_close(pFile, pFile->h, __LINE__);
        }
        pFile->h = -1;
        fd = robust_open(pCtx->dbPath, pFile->openFlags, 0);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRANSPROXY: OPEN  %d\n", fd);
        if( fd>=0 ){
          pFile->h = fd;
        }else{
          rc=sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);

        }
      }
      if( rc==0         && !pCtx->lockProxy ){
        char *path = tempLockPath ? tempLockPath : pCtx->lockProxyPath;
        rc = proxyCreateUnixFile(path, &pCtx->lockProxy, 1);
        if( rc!=0         && rc!=7            && tryOldLockPath ){



          forceNewLockPath = 1;
          tryOldLockPath = 0;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if( rc==0         ){



        if( tempLockPath ){
          pCtx->lockProxyPath = sqlite3DbStrDup(0, tempLockPath);
          if( !pCtx->lockProxyPath ){
            rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
          }
        }
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        pCtx->conchHeld = 1;

        if( pCtx->lockProxy->pMethod == &afpIoMethods ){
          afpLockingContext *afpCtx;
          afpCtx = (afpLockingContext *)pCtx->lockProxy->lockingContext;
          afpCtx->dbPath = pCtx->lockProxyPath;
        }
      } else {
        conchFile->pMethod->xUnlock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile,0       );
      }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TAKECONCH  %d %s\n", conchFile->h, 
rc==0?"ok":"failed")                        ;
      return rc;
    } while (1);

  }
}




static int proxyReleaseConch(unixFile *pFile){
  int rc =0         ;
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx;
  unixFile *conchFile;

  pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
  conchFile = pCtx->conchFile;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("RELEASECONCH  %d for %s pid=%d\n", conchFile->h, 
(pCtx->lockProxyPath ? pCtx->lockProxyPath : ":auto:"), 
(pid_t)1)               ;
  if( pCtx->conchHeld>0 ){
    rc = conchFile->pMethod->xUnlock((sqlite3_file*)conchFile,0       );
  }
  pCtx->conchHeld = 0;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("RELEASECONCH  %d %s\n", conchFile->h, 
(rc==0 ? "ok" : "failed"))                    ;
  return rc;
}












static int proxyCreateConchPathname(char *dbPath, char **pConchPath){
  int i;
  int len = (int)strlen(dbPath);
  char *conchPath;



  *pConchPath = conchPath = (char *)sqlite3_malloc64(len + 8);
  if( conchPath==0 ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
{char*xxd=(char*)(conchPath);const char*xxs=(const char*)(dbPath); int xxn=(len+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};


  for( i=(len-1); i>=0; i-- ){
    if( conchPath[i]=='/' ){
      i++;
      break;
    }
  }
  conchPath[i]='.';
  while ( i<len ){
    conchPath[i+1]=dbPath[i];
    i++;
  }


{char*xxd=(char*)(&conchPath[i+1]);const char*xxs=(const char*)("-conch"); int xxn=(7);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  assert( (int)strlen(conchPath) == len+7 );

  return 0        ;
}





static int switchLockProxyPath(unixFile *pFile, const char *path) {
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext*)pFile->lockingContext;
  char *oldPath = pCtx->lockProxyPath;
  int rc =0         ;

  if( pFile->eFileLock!=0       ){
    return 5          ;
  }


  if( !path || path[0]=='\0' || !strcmp(path, ":auto:") ||
    (oldPath && !strncmp(oldPath, path, MAXPATHLEN)) ){
    return 0        ;
  }else{
    unixFile *lockProxy = pCtx->lockProxy;
    pCtx->lockProxy=NULL;
    pCtx->conchHeld = 0;
    if( lockProxy!=NULL ){
      rc=lockProxy->pMethod->xClose((sqlite3_file *)lockProxy);
      if( rc ) return rc;
      sqlite3_free(lockProxy);
    }
    sqlite3_free(oldPath);
    pCtx->lockProxyPath = sqlite3DbStrDup(0, path);
  }

  return rc;
}








static int proxyGetDbPathForUnixFile(unixFile *pFile, char *dbPath){

  if( pFile->pMethod == &afpIoMethods ){


    assert( (int)strlen((char*)pFile->lockingContext)<=MAXPATHLEN );
    strlcpy(dbPath, ((afpLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext)->dbPath,
            MAXPATHLEN);
  } else

  if( pFile->pMethod == &dotlockIoMethods ){


    int len = strlen((char *)pFile->lockingContext) - strlen(".lock"       );
{char*xxd=(char*)(dbPath);const char*xxs=(const char*)((char *)pFile->lockingContext); int xxn=(len + 1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }else{

    assert( strlen((char*)pFile->lockingContext)<=MAXPATHLEN );
    strlcpy(dbPath, (char *)pFile->lockingContext, MAXPATHLEN);
  }
  return 0        ;
}









static int proxyTransformUnixFile(unixFile *pFile, const char *path) {
  proxyLockingContext *pCtx;
  char dbPath[MAXPATHLEN+1];
  char *lockPath=NULL;
  int rc =0         ;

  if( pFile->eFileLock!=0       ){
    return 5          ;
  }
  proxyGetDbPathForUnixFile(pFile, dbPath);
  if( !path || path[0]=='\0' || !strcmp(path, ":auto:") ){
    lockPath=NULL;
  }else{
    lockPath=(char *)path;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRANSPROXY  %d for %s pid=%d\n", pFile->h, 
(lockPath ? lockPath : ":auto:"), (pid_t)1)               ;

  pCtx = sqlite3_malloc64( sizeof(*pCtx) );
  if( pCtx==0 ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  memset(pCtx, 0, sizeof(*pCtx));

  rc = proxyCreateConchPathname(dbPath, &pCtx->conchFilePath);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = proxyCreateUnixFile(pCtx->conchFilePath, &pCtx->conchFile, 0);
    if( rc==14              && ((pFile->openFlags&O_RDWR) == 0) ){





      struct statfs fsInfo;
      struct stat conchInfo;
      int goLockless = 0;

      if(((int(*)(const char*,struct stat*))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)(pCtx->conchFilePath,&conchInfo)==-1){
        int err = errno;
        if( (err==ENOENT) && (statfs(dbPath, &fsInfo) != -1) ){
          goLockless = (fsInfo.f_flags&MNT_RDONLY) == MNT_RDONLY;
        }
      }
      if( goLockless ){
        pCtx->conchHeld = -1;
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         && lockPath ){
    pCtx->lockProxyPath = sqlite3DbStrDup(0, lockPath);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    pCtx->dbPath = sqlite3DbStrDup(0, dbPath);
    if( pCtx->dbPath==NULL ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         ){



    pCtx->oldLockingContext = pFile->lockingContext;
    pFile->lockingContext = pCtx;
    pCtx->pOldMethod = pFile->pMethod;
    pFile->pMethod = &proxyIoMethods;
  }else{
    if( pCtx->conchFile ){
      pCtx->conchFile->pMethod->xClose((sqlite3_file *)pCtx->conchFile);
      sqlite3_free(pCtx->conchFile);
    }
    sqlite3DbFree(0, pCtx->lockProxyPath);
    sqlite3_free(pCtx->conchFilePath);
    sqlite3_free(pCtx);
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRANSPROXY  %d %s\n", pFile->h, 
(rc==0 ? "ok" : "failed"))                    ;
  return rc;
}






static int proxyFileControl(sqlite3_file *id, int op, void *pArg){
  switch( op ){
    case 2                             : {
      unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
      if( pFile->pMethod == &proxyIoMethods ){
        proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext*)pFile->lockingContext;
        proxyTakeConch(pFile);
        if( pCtx->lockProxyPath ){
          *(const char **)pArg = pCtx->lockProxyPath;
        }else{
          *(const char **)pArg = ":auto: (not held)";
        }
      } else {
        *(const char **)pArg = NULL;
      }
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 3                             : {
      unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
      int rc =0         ;
      int isProxyStyle = (pFile->pMethod == &proxyIoMethods);
      if( pArg==NULL || (const char *)pArg==0 ){
        if( isProxyStyle ){




          rc =1                                                ;
        }else{

          rc =0         ;
        }
      }else{
        const char *proxyPath = (const char *)pArg;
        if( isProxyStyle ){
          proxyLockingContext *pCtx =
            (proxyLockingContext*)pFile->lockingContext;
          if( !strcmp(pArg, ":auto:")
           || (pCtx->lockProxyPath &&
               !strncmp(pCtx->lockProxyPath, proxyPath, MAXPATHLEN))
          ){
            rc =0         ;
          }else{
            rc = switchLockProxyPath(pFile, proxyPath);
          }
        }else{

          rc = proxyTransformUnixFile(pFile, proxyPath);
        }
      }
      return rc;
    }
    default: {
      assert( 0 );
    }
  }
                 assert(0);
  return 1           ;
}














static int proxyCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  int rc = proxyTakeConch(pFile);
  if( rc==0         ){
    proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
    if( pCtx->conchHeld>0 ){
      unixFile *proxy = pCtx->lockProxy;
      return proxy->pMethod->xCheckReservedLock((sqlite3_file*)proxy, pResOut);
    }else{
      pResOut=0;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

























static int proxyLock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  int rc = proxyTakeConch(pFile);
  if( rc==0         ){
    proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
    if( pCtx->conchHeld>0 ){
      unixFile *proxy = pCtx->lockProxy;
      rc = proxy->pMethod->xLock((sqlite3_file*)proxy, eFileLock);
      pFile->eFileLock = proxy->eFileLock;
    }else{

    }
  }
  return rc;
}









static int proxyUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int eFileLock) {
  unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
  int rc = proxyTakeConch(pFile);
  if( rc==0         ){
    proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
    if( pCtx->conchHeld>0 ){
      unixFile *proxy = pCtx->lockProxy;
      rc = proxy->pMethod->xUnlock((sqlite3_file*)proxy, eFileLock);
      pFile->eFileLock = proxy->eFileLock;
    }else{

    }
  }
  return rc;
}




static int proxyClose(sqlite3_file *id) {
  if((1)         ){
    unixFile *pFile = (unixFile*)id;
    proxyLockingContext *pCtx = (proxyLockingContext *)pFile->lockingContext;
    unixFile *lockProxy = pCtx->lockProxy;
    unixFile *conchFile = pCtx->conchFile;
    int rc =0         ;

    if( lockProxy ){
      rc = lockProxy->pMethod->xUnlock((sqlite3_file*)lockProxy,0       );
      if( rc ) return rc;
      rc = lockProxy->pMethod->xClose((sqlite3_file*)lockProxy);
      if( rc ) return rc;
      sqlite3_free(lockProxy);
      pCtx->lockProxy = 0;
    }
    if( conchFile ){
      if( pCtx->conchHeld ){
        rc = proxyReleaseConch(pFile);
        if( rc ) return rc;
      }
      rc = conchFile->pMethod->xClose((sqlite3_file*)conchFile);
      if( rc ) return rc;
      sqlite3_free(conchFile);
    }
    sqlite3DbFree(0, pCtx->lockProxyPath);
    sqlite3_free(pCtx->conchFilePath);
    sqlite3DbFree(0, pCtx->dbPath);

    pFile->lockingContext = pCtx->oldLockingContext;
    pFile->pMethod = pCtx->pOldMethod;
    sqlite3_free(pCtx);
    return pFile->pMethod->xClose(id);
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static int winSetSystemCall(
  sqlite3_vfs *pNotUsed,
  const char *zName,
  sqlite3_syscall_ptr pNewFunc
){
  unsigned int i;
  int rc =12              ;

(void)(pNotUsed)            ;
  if( zName==0 ){



    rc =0         ;
    for(i=0; i<sizeof(aSyscall)/sizeof(aSyscall[0]); i++){
      if( aSyscall[i].pDefault ){
        aSyscall[i].pCurrent = aSyscall[i].pDefault;
      }
    }
  }else{



    for(i=0; i<sizeof(aSyscall)/sizeof(aSyscall[0]); i++){
      if( strcmp(zName, aSyscall[i].zName)==0 ){
        if( aSyscall[i].pDefault==0 ){
          aSyscall[i].pDefault = aSyscall[i].pCurrent;
        }
        rc =0         ;
        if( pNewFunc==0 ) pNewFunc = aSyscall[i].pDefault;
        aSyscall[i].pCurrent = pNewFunc;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}






static sqlite3_syscall_ptr winGetSystemCall(
  sqlite3_vfs *pNotUsed,
  const char *zName
){
  unsigned int i;

(void)(pNotUsed)            ;
  for(i=0; i<sizeof(aSyscall)/sizeof(aSyscall[0]); i++){
    if( strcmp(zName, aSyscall[i].zName)==0 ) return aSyscall[i].pCurrent;
  }
  return 0;
}







static const char *winNextSystemCall(sqlite3_vfs *p, const char *zName){
  int i = -1;

(void)(p)            ;
  if( zName ){
    for(i=0; i<((int)(sizeof(aSyscall)/sizeof(aSyscall[0])))-1;i++){
      if( strcmp(zName, aSyscall[i].zName)==0 ) break;
    }
  }
  for(i++; i<((int)(sizeof(aSyscall)/sizeof(aSyscall[0])));i++){
    if( aSyscall[i].pCurrent!=0 ) return aSyscall[i].zName;
  }
  return 0;
}









           int sqlite3_win32_compact_heap(LPUINT pnLargest){
  int rc =0         ;
  UINT nLargest = 0;
  HANDLE hHeap;

assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  hHeap =win_mem_data.hHeap;
  assert( hHeap!=0 );
  assert( hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),NULL));


  if( (nLargest=((UINT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD))aSyscall[43].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0)))==0){
    DWORD lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    if( lastErrno==NO_ERROR ){
      sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to HeapCompact (no space), heap=%p",
                  (void*)hHeap);
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }else{
      sqlite3_log(1           , "failed to HeapCompact (%lu), heap=%p",
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(void*)hHeap);
      rc =1            ;
    }
  }

  sqlite3_log(12             , "failed to HeapCompact, heap=%p",
              (void*)hHeap);
  rc =12              ;

  if( pnLargest ) *pnLargest = nLargest;
  return rc;
}







           int sqlite3_win32_reset_heap(){
  int rc;




                               ;
                           ;
assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  if(win_mem_data.hHeap!=NULL&&win_mem_data.bOwned&&sqlite3_memory_used()==0){







    assert(win_mem_data.hHeap!=NULL);
    assert(win_mem_data.bOwned);
    assert( sqlite3_memory_used()==0 );
    winMemShutdown(&win_mem_data     );
    assert(win_mem_data.hHeap==NULL);
    assert( !win_mem_data.bOwned);
    assert( sqlite3_memory_used()==0 );
    rc = winMemInit(&win_mem_data     );
    assert( rc!=0         ||win_mem_data.hHeap!=NULL);
    assert( rc!=0         ||win_mem_data.bOwned);
    assert( rc!=0         || sqlite3_memory_used()==0 );
  }else{



    rc =5           ;
  }
                           ;
                               ;
  return rc;
}

           int sqlite3_win32_is_nt(void){





  return 1;

  if(InterlockedCompareExchange   (&sqlite3_os_type, 0, 0)==0 ){

    OSVERSIONINFOA sInfo;
    sInfo.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof(sInfo);
((BOOL(WINAPI*)( LPOSVERSIONINFOA))aSyscall[34].pCurrent)(&sInfo);
InterlockedCompareExchange      (&sqlite3_os_type,
        (sInfo.dwPlatformId == VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT) ? 2 : 1, 0);

    OSVERSIONINFOW sInfo;
    sInfo.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof(sInfo);
((BOOL(WINAPI*)( LPOSVERSIONINFOW))aSyscall[35].pCurrent)(&sInfo);
InterlockedCompareExchange      (&sqlite3_os_type,
        (sInfo.dwPlatformId == VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT) ? 2 : 1, 0);

  }
  return InterlockedCompareExchange  (&sqlite3_os_type, 2, 2)==2;

  return InterlockedCompareExchange  (&sqlite3_os_type, 2, 2)==2;





  return 1;

}





static void *winMemMalloc(int nBytes){
  HANDLE hHeap;
  void *p;

assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  hHeap =win_mem_data.hHeap;
  assert( hHeap!=0 );
  assert( hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),NULL));

  assert( nBytes>=0 );
  p =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, SIZE_T))aSyscall[36].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),(SIZE_T)nBytes);
  if( !p ){
    sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to HeapAlloc %u bytes (%lu), heap=%p",
                nBytes,((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(void*)hHeap);
  }
  return p;
}




static void winMemFree(void *pPrior){
  HANDLE hHeap;

assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  hHeap =win_mem_data.hHeap;
  assert( hHeap!=0 );
  assert( hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),pPrior));

  if( !pPrior ) return;
  if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,LPVOID))aSyscall[39].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),pPrior)){
    sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to HeapFree block %p (%lu), heap=%p",
                pPrior,((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(void*)hHeap);
  }
}




static void *winMemRealloc(void *pPrior, int nBytes){
  HANDLE hHeap;
  void *p;

assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  hHeap =win_mem_data.hHeap;
  assert( hHeap!=0 );
  assert( hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),pPrior));

  assert( nBytes>=0 );
  if( !pPrior ){
    p =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, SIZE_T))aSyscall[36].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),(SIZE_T)nBytes);
  }else{
    p =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,LPVOID, SIZE_T))aSyscall[40].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),pPrior,(SIZE_T)nBytes);
  }
  if( !p ){
    sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to %s %u bytes (%lu), heap=%p",
                pPrior ? "HeapReAlloc" : "HeapAlloc", nBytes,((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
                (void*)hHeap);
  }
  return p;
}




static int winMemSize(void *p){
  HANDLE hHeap;
  SIZE_T n;

assert( win_mem_data.magic1==0x42b2830b ); assert( win_mem_data.magic2==0xbd4d7cf4 );;
  hHeap =win_mem_data.hHeap;
  assert( hHeap!=0 );
  assert( hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),p));

  if( !p ) return 0;
  n =((SIZE_T(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[41].pCurrent)(hHeap,(0),p);
  if( n==(SIZE_T)-1 ){
    sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to HeapSize block %p (%lu), heap=%p",
                p,((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(void*)hHeap);
    return 0;
  }
  return (int)n;
}




static int winMemRoundup(int n){
  return n;
}




static int winMemInit(void *pAppData){
  winMemData *pWinMemData = (winMemData *)pAppData;

  if( !pWinMemData ) return 1           ;
  assert( pWinMemData->magic1==0x42b2830b    );
  assert( pWinMemData->magic2==0xbd4d7cf4    );


  if( !pWinMemData->hHeap ){
    DWORD dwInitialSize =(((2000)) * (65536) + ((4194304)));
    DWORD dwMaximumSize = (DWORD)(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nHeap;
    if( dwMaximumSize==0 ){
      dwMaximumSize =(0)                        ;
    }else if( dwInitialSize>dwMaximumSize ){
      dwInitialSize = dwMaximumSize;
    }
    pWinMemData->hHeap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(DWORD,SIZE_T, SIZE_T))aSyscall[37].pCurrent)((0),
                                      dwInitialSize, dwMaximumSize);
    if( !pWinMemData->hHeap ){
      sqlite3_log(7           ,
          "failed to HeapCreate (%lu), flags=%u, initSize=%lu, maxSize=%lu",
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(0), dwInitialSize,
          dwMaximumSize);
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    pWinMemData->bOwned = TRUE;
    assert( pWinMemData->bOwned );
  }

  pWinMemData->hHeap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[74].pCurrent)();
  if( !pWinMemData->hHeap ){
    sqlite3_log(7           ,
        "failed to GetProcessHeap (%lu)",((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)());
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  pWinMemData->bOwned = FALSE;
  assert( !pWinMemData->bOwned );

  assert( pWinMemData->hHeap!=0 );
  assert( pWinMemData->hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

  assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(pWinMemData->hHeap,(0),NULL));

  return 0        ;
}




static void winMemShutdown(void *pAppData){
  winMemData *pWinMemData = (winMemData *)pAppData;

  if( !pWinMemData ) return;
  assert( pWinMemData->magic1==0x42b2830b    );
  assert( pWinMemData->magic2==0xbd4d7cf4    );

  if( pWinMemData->hHeap ){
    assert( pWinMemData->hHeap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );

    assert(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD, LPCVOID))aSyscall[42].pCurrent)(pWinMemData->hHeap,(0),NULL));

    if( pWinMemData->bOwned ){
      if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[38].pCurrent)(pWinMemData->hHeap)){
        sqlite3_log(7           , "failed to HeapDestroy (%lu), heap=%p",
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),(void*)pWinMemData->hHeap);
      }
      pWinMemData->bOwned = FALSE;
    }
    pWinMemData->hHeap = NULL;
  }
}









static         const sqlite3_mem_methods *sqlite3MemGetWin32(void){
  static const sqlite3_mem_methods winMemMethods = {
    winMemMalloc,
    winMemFree,
    winMemRealloc,
    winMemSize,
    winMemRoundup,
    winMemInit,
    winMemShutdown,
    &win_mem_data
  };
  return &winMemMethods;
}

static         void sqlite3MemSetDefault(void){
  sqlite3_config(4                   , sqlite3MemGetWin32());
}







static LPWSTR winUtf8ToUnicode(const char *zText){
  int nChar;
  LPWSTR zWideText;

  nChar =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCSTR,int,LPWSTR, int))aSyscall[50].pCurrent)(CP_UTF8,0,zText,-1,NULL,0);
  if( nChar==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zWideText = sqlite3MallocZero( nChar*sizeof(WCHAR) );
  if( zWideText==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  nChar =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCSTR,int,LPWSTR, int))aSyscall[50].pCurrent)(CP_UTF8,0,zText,-1,zWideText,
                                nChar);
  if( nChar==0 ){
    sqlite3_free(zWideText);
    zWideText = 0;
  }
  return zWideText;
}






static char *winUnicodeToUtf8(LPCWSTR zWideText){
  int nByte;
  char *zText;

  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCWSTR,int,LPSTR,int, LPCSTR,LPBOOL))aSyscall[60].pCurrent)(CP_UTF8,0,zWideText,-1,0,0,0,0);
  if( nByte == 0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zText = sqlite3MallocZero( nByte );
  if( zText==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCWSTR,int,LPSTR,int, LPCSTR,LPBOOL))aSyscall[60].pCurrent)(CP_UTF8,0,zWideText,-1,zText,nByte,
                                0, 0);
  if( nByte == 0 ){
    sqlite3_free(zText);
    zText = 0;
  }
  return zText;
}







static LPWSTR winMbcsToUnicode(const char *zText, int useAnsi){
  int nByte;
  LPWSTR zMbcsText;
  int codepage = useAnsi ? CP_ACP : CP_OEMCP;

  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCSTR,int,LPWSTR, int))aSyscall[50].pCurrent)(codepage,0,zText,-1,NULL,
                                0)*sizeof(WCHAR);
  if( nByte==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zMbcsText = sqlite3MallocZero( nByte*sizeof(WCHAR) );
  if( zMbcsText==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCSTR,int,LPWSTR, int))aSyscall[50].pCurrent)(codepage,0,zText,-1,zMbcsText,
                                nByte);
  if( nByte==0 ){
    sqlite3_free(zMbcsText);
    zMbcsText = 0;
  }
  return zMbcsText;
}







static char *winUnicodeToMbcs(LPCWSTR zWideText, int useAnsi){
  int nByte;
  char *zText;
  int codepage = useAnsi ? CP_ACP : CP_OEMCP;

  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCWSTR,int,LPSTR,int, LPCSTR,LPBOOL))aSyscall[60].pCurrent)(codepage,0,zWideText,-1,0,0,0,0);
  if( nByte == 0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zText = sqlite3MallocZero( nByte );
  if( zText==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  nByte =((int(WINAPI*)(UINT,DWORD,LPCWSTR,int,LPSTR,int, LPCSTR,LPBOOL))aSyscall[60].pCurrent)(codepage,0,zWideText,-1,zText,
                                nByte, 0, 0);
  if( nByte == 0 ){
    sqlite3_free(zText);
    zText = 0;
  }
  return zText;
}






static char *winMbcsToUtf8(const char *zText, int useAnsi){
  char *zTextUtf8;
  LPWSTR zTmpWide;

  zTmpWide = winMbcsToUnicode(zText, useAnsi);
  if( zTmpWide==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zTextUtf8 = winUnicodeToUtf8(zTmpWide);
  sqlite3_free(zTmpWide);
  return zTextUtf8;
}






static char *winUtf8ToMbcs(const char *zText, int useAnsi){
  char *zTextMbcs;
  LPWSTR zTmpWide;

  zTmpWide = winUtf8ToUnicode(zText);
  if( zTmpWide==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zTextMbcs = winUnicodeToMbcs(zTmpWide, useAnsi);
  sqlite3_free(zTmpWide);
  return zTextMbcs;
}

           int sqlite3_win32_set_directory8(
  unsigned long type,
  const char *zValue
){
  char **ppDirectory = 0;
  int rc;

  rc = sqlite3_initialize();
  if( rc ) return rc;

                                                                     ;
  if( type==1                                ){
    ppDirectory = &sqlite3_data_directory;
  }else if( type==2                                ){
    ppDirectory = &sqlite3_temp_directory;
  }
  assert( !ppDirectory || type==1
          || type==2
  );
  assert( !ppDirectory ||1                                                   );
  if( ppDirectory ){
    char *zCopy = 0;
    if( zValue && zValue[0] ){
      zCopy = sqlite3_mprintf("%s", zValue);
      if ( zCopy==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
        goto set_directory8_done;
      }
    }
    sqlite3_free(*ppDirectory);
    *ppDirectory = zCopy;
    rc =0         ;
  }else{
    rc =1            ;
  }
set_directory8_done:
                                                                     ;
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_win32_set_directory16(
  unsigned long type,
  const void *zValue
){
  int rc;
  char *zUtf8 = 0;
  if( zValue ){
    zUtf8 = sqlite3_win32_unicode_to_utf8(zValue);
    if( zUtf8==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  rc = sqlite3_win32_set_directory8(type, zUtf8);
  if( zUtf8 ) sqlite3_free(zUtf8);
  return rc;
}








           int sqlite3_win32_set_directory(
  unsigned long type,
  void *zValue
){
  return sqlite3_win32_set_directory16(type, zValue);
}






static int winGetLastErrorMsg(DWORD lastErrno, int nBuf, char *zBuf){




  DWORD dwLen = 0;
  char *zOut = 0;

  if((1)       ){

    WCHAR zTempWide[(1024)                       +1];
    dwLen =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD,LPCVOID,DWORD,DWORD,LPWSTR, DWORD,va_list*))aSyscall[15].pCurrent)(FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM|
                             FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
                             NULL,
                             lastErrno,
                             0,
                             zTempWide,
(1024)                                                    ,
                             0);

    LPWSTR zTempWide = NULL;
    dwLen =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD,LPCVOID,DWORD,DWORD,LPWSTR, DWORD,va_list*))aSyscall[15].pCurrent)(FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER|
                             FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM |
                             FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
                             NULL,
                             lastErrno,
                             0,
                             (LPWSTR) &zTempWide,
                             0,
                             0);

    if( dwLen > 0 ){

                                ;
      zOut = winUnicodeToUtf8(zTempWide);
                              ;


((HLOCAL(WINAPI*)(HLOCAL))aSyscall[46].pCurrent)(zTempWide);

    }
  }

  else{
    char *zTemp = NULL;
    dwLen =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD,LPCVOID,DWORD,DWORD,LPSTR, DWORD,va_list*))aSyscall[14].pCurrent)(FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER|
                             FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM |
                             FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
                             NULL,
                             lastErrno,
                             0,
                             (LPSTR) &zTemp,
                             0,
                             0);
    if( dwLen > 0 ){

                                ;
      zOut = winMbcsToUtf8(zTemp,1                   );
                              ;

((HLOCAL(WINAPI*)(HLOCAL))aSyscall[46].pCurrent)(zTemp);
    }
  }

  if( 0 == dwLen ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(nBuf, zBuf, "OsError 0x%lx (%lu)", lastErrno, lastErrno);
  }else{

    sqlite3_snprintf(nBuf, zBuf, "%s", zOut);

    sqlite3_free(zOut);
  }
  return 0;
}

















static int winLogErrorAtLine(
  int errcode,
  DWORD lastErrno,
  const char *zFunc,
  const char *zPath,
  int iLine
){
  char zMsg[500];
  int i;

  zMsg[0] = 0;
  winGetLastErrorMsg(lastErrno, sizeof(zMsg), zMsg);
  assert( errcode!=0         );
  if( zPath==0 ) zPath = "";
  for(i=0; zMsg[i] && zMsg[i]!='\r' && zMsg[i]!='\n'; i++){}
  zMsg[i] = 0;
  sqlite3_log(errcode,
      "os_win.c:%d: (%lu) %s(%s) - %s",
      iLine, lastErrno, zFunc, zPath, zMsg
  );

  return errcode;
}













static int winIoerrRetry =10                       ;
static int winIoerrRetryDelay =25                             ;
































static int winRetryIoerr(int *pnRetry, DWORD *pError){
  DWORD e =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
  if( *pnRetry>=winIoerrRetry ){
    if( pError ){
      *pError = e;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  if((((e)==ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED) || ((e)==ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION) || ((e)==ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) || ((e)==ERROR_DEV_NOT_EXIST) || ((e)==ERROR_NETNAME_DELETED) || ((e)==ERROR_SEM_TIMEOUT) || ((e)==ERROR_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE))){
    sqlite3_win32_sleep(winIoerrRetryDelay*(1 +*pnRetry));
    ++*pnRetry;
    return 1;
  }

  else if( winIoerrCanRetry2(e) ){
    sqlite3_win32_sleep(winIoerrRetryDelay*(1 +*pnRetry));
    ++*pnRetry;
    return 1;
  }

  if( pError ){
    *pError = e;
  }
  return 0;
}




static void winLogIoerr(int nRetry, int lineno){
  if( nRetry ){
    sqlite3_log(27           ,
      "delayed %dms for lock/sharing conflict at line %d",
      winIoerrRetryDelay*nRetry*(nRetry+1)/2, lineno
    );
  }
}












struct tm *__cdecl localtime(const time_t *t)
{
  static struct tm y;
  FILETIME uTm, lTm;
  SYSTEMTIME pTm;
  sqlite3_int64 t64;
  t64 = *t;
  t64 = (t64 + 11644473600)*10000000;
  uTm.dwLowDateTime = (DWORD)(t64 & 0xFFFFFFFF);
  uTm.dwHighDateTime= (DWORD)(t64 >> 32);
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(CONST FILETIME*, LPFILETIME))aSyscall[11].pCurrent)(&uTm,&lTm);
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(CONST FILETIME*, LPSYSTEMTIME))aSyscall[12].pCurrent)(&lTm,&pTm);
  y.tm_year = pTm.wYear - 1900;
  y.tm_mon = pTm.wMonth - 1;
  y.tm_wday = pTm.wDayOfWeek;
  y.tm_mday = pTm.wDay;
  y.tm_hour = pTm.wHour;
  y.tm_min = pTm.wMinute;
  y.tm_sec = pTm.wSecond;
  return &y;
}











static void winceMutexAcquire(HANDLE h){
   DWORD dwErr;
   do {
     dwErr =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, DWORD))aSyscall[63].pCurrent)(h,INFINITE);
   } while (dwErr != WAIT_OBJECT_0 && dwErr != WAIT_ABANDONED);
}









static int winceCreateLock(const char *zFilename, winFile *pFile){
  LPWSTR zTok;
  LPWSTR zName;
  DWORD lastErrno;
  BOOL bLogged = FALSE;
  BOOL bInit = TRUE;

  zName = winUtf8ToUnicode(zFilename);
  if( zName==0 ){

    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }


  memset(&pFile->local, 0, sizeof(pFile->local));



  zTok =((LPWSTR(WINAPI*)(LPWSTR))aSyscall[1].pCurrent)(zName);
  for (;*zTok;zTok++){
    if (*zTok == '\\') *zTok = '_';
  }


  pFile->hMutex =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES,BOOL, LPCWSTR))aSyscall[8].pCurrent)(NULL,FALSE,zName);
  if (!pFile->hMutex){
    pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    sqlite3_free(zName);
    return winLogErrorAtLine(10,pFile->lastErrno,
"winceCreateLock1",zFilename,__LINE__)               ;
  }


  winceMutexAcquire(pFile->hMutex);





((LPWSTR(WINAPI*)(LPWSTR))aSyscall[2].pCurrent)(zName);
  pFile->hShared =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,LPCWSTR))aSyscall[7].pCurrent)(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE,NULL,
                                        PAGE_READWRITE, 0, sizeof(winceLock),
                                        zName);



  lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
  if (lastErrno == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS){
    bInit = FALSE;
  }

  sqlite3_free(zName);


  if( pFile->hShared ){
    pFile->shared = (winceLock*)((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, SIZE_T))aSyscall[49].pCurrent)(pFile->hShared,
             FILE_MAP_READ|FILE_MAP_WRITE, 0, 0, sizeof(winceLock));

    if( !pFile->shared ){
      pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
winLogErrorAtLine(10,pFile->lastErrno,
"winceCreateLock2",zFilename,__LINE__)          ;
      bLogged = TRUE;
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->hShared);
      pFile->hShared = NULL;
    }
  }


  if( pFile->hShared==NULL ){
    if( !bLogged ){
      pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
winLogErrorAtLine(10,pFile->lastErrno,
"winceCreateLock3",zFilename,__LINE__)          ;
      bLogged = TRUE;
    }
ReleaseMutex(pFile->hMutex)         ;
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->hMutex);
    pFile->hMutex = NULL;
    return 10          ;
  }


  if( bInit ){
    memset(pFile->shared, 0, sizeof(winceLock));
  }

ReleaseMutex(pFile->hMutex)       ;
  return 0        ;
}




static void winceDestroyLock(winFile *pFile){
  if (pFile->hMutex){

    winceMutexAcquire(pFile->hMutex);



    if (pFile->local.nReaders){
      pFile->shared->nReaders --;
    }
    if (pFile->local.bReserved){
      pFile->shared->bReserved = FALSE;
    }
    if (pFile->local.bPending){
      pFile->shared->bPending = FALSE;
    }
    if (pFile->local.bExclusive){
      pFile->shared->bExclusive = FALSE;
    }


((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCVOID))aSyscall[59].pCurrent)(pFile->shared);
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->hShared);


ReleaseMutex(pFile->hMutex)         ;
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->hMutex);
    pFile->hMutex = NULL;
  }
}




static BOOL winceLockFile(
  LPHANDLE phFile,
  DWORD dwFileOffsetLow,
  DWORD dwFileOffsetHigh,
  DWORD nNumberOfBytesToLockLow,
  DWORD nNumberOfBytesToLockHigh
){
  winFile *pFile =(winFile*)&((char*)phFile)[-(int)((int)((char*)&((winFile*)0)->h))];
  BOOL bReturn = FALSE;

(void)(dwFileOffsetHigh)            ;
(void)(nNumberOfBytesToLockHigh)            ;

  if (!pFile->hMutex) return TRUE;
  winceMutexAcquire(pFile->hMutex);


  if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)((0x40000000)+2)
       && nNumberOfBytesToLockLow == (DWORD)510        ){
    if (pFile->shared->nReaders == 0 && pFile->shared->bExclusive == 0){
       pFile->shared->bExclusive = TRUE;
       pFile->local.bExclusive = TRUE;
       bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }


  else if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)((0x40000000)+2)&&
           nNumberOfBytesToLockLow == 1){
    if (pFile->shared->bExclusive == 0){
      pFile->local.nReaders ++;
      if (pFile->local.nReaders == 1){
        pFile->shared->nReaders ++;
      }
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }


  else if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)(0x40000000)
           && nNumberOfBytesToLockLow == 1){

    if (pFile->shared->bPending == 0) {
      pFile->shared->bPending = TRUE;
      pFile->local.bPending = TRUE;
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }


  else if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)((0x40000000)+1)
           && nNumberOfBytesToLockLow == 1){
    if (pFile->shared->bReserved == 0) {
      pFile->shared->bReserved = TRUE;
      pFile->local.bReserved = TRUE;
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }

ReleaseMutex(pFile->hMutex)       ;
  return bReturn;
}




static BOOL winceUnlockFile(
  LPHANDLE phFile,
  DWORD dwFileOffsetLow,
  DWORD dwFileOffsetHigh,
  DWORD nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow,
  DWORD nNumberOfBytesToUnlockHigh
){
  winFile *pFile =(winFile*)&((char*)phFile)[-(int)((int)((char*)&((winFile*)0)->h))];
  BOOL bReturn = FALSE;

(void)(dwFileOffsetHigh)            ;
(void)(nNumberOfBytesToUnlockHigh)            ;

  if (!pFile->hMutex) return TRUE;
  winceMutexAcquire(pFile->hMutex);


  if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)((0x40000000)+2)){

    if (pFile->local.bExclusive){
      assert(nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow == (DWORD)510        );
      pFile->local.bExclusive = FALSE;
      pFile->shared->bExclusive = FALSE;
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }


    else if (pFile->local.nReaders){
      assert(nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow == (DWORD)510
             || nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow == 1);
      pFile->local.nReaders --;
      if (pFile->local.nReaders == 0)
      {
        pFile->shared->nReaders --;
      }
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }


  else if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)(0x40000000)
           && nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow == 1){
    if (pFile->local.bPending){
      pFile->local.bPending = FALSE;
      pFile->shared->bPending = FALSE;
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }

  else if (dwFileOffsetLow == (DWORD)((0x40000000)+1)
           && nNumberOfBytesToUnlockLow == 1){
    if (pFile->local.bReserved) {
      pFile->local.bReserved = FALSE;
      pFile->shared->bReserved = FALSE;
      bReturn = TRUE;
    }
  }

ReleaseMutex(pFile->hMutex)       ;
  return bReturn;
}

    return((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[48].pCurrent)(*phFile,flags,0,numBytesLow,numBytesHigh,&ovlp);
  }else{
    return((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, DWORD))aSyscall[47].pCurrent)(*phFile,offsetLow,offsetHigh,numBytesLow,
                      numBytesHigh);
  }

}

  LPHANDLE phFile,
  DWORD offsetLow,
  DWORD offsetHigh,
  DWORD numBytesLow,
  DWORD numBytesHigh
){





  return winceUnlockFile(phFile, offsetLow, offsetHigh,
                         numBytesLow, numBytesHigh);

  if((1)       ){
    OVERLAPPED ovlp;
    memset(&ovlp, 0, sizeof(OVERLAPPED));
    ovlp.Offset = offsetLow;
    ovlp.OffsetHigh = offsetHigh;
    return((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[58].pCurrent)(*phFile,0,numBytesLow,numBytesHigh,&ovlp);
  }else{
    return((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, DWORD))aSyscall[57].pCurrent)(*phFile,offsetLow,offsetHigh,numBytesLow,
                        numBytesHigh);
  }

}


















static int winSeekFile(winFile *pFile, sqlite3_int64 iOffset){

  LONG upperBits;
  LONG lowerBits;
  DWORD dwRet;
  DWORD lastErrno;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SEEK file=%p, offset=%lld\n", pFile->h, iOffset);

  upperBits = (LONG)((iOffset>>32) & 0x7fffffff);
  lowerBits = (LONG)(iOffset & 0xffffffff);








  dwRet =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LONG,PLONG, DWORD))aSyscall[54].pCurrent)(pFile->h,lowerBits,&upperBits,FILE_BEGIN);

  if( (dwRet==((DWORD)-1)
      && ((lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)())!=NO_ERROR))){
    pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (22<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winSeekFile",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)        ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SEEK file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_SEEK\n", pFile->h);
    return 1;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SEEK file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
  return 0;





  LARGE_INTEGER x;
  BOOL bRet;

  x.QuadPart = iOffset;
  bRet =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LARGE_INTEGER, PLARGE_INTEGER,DWORD))aSyscall[65].pCurrent)(pFile->h,x,0,FILE_BEGIN);

  if(!bRet){
    pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (22<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winSeekFile",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)        ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SEEK file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_SEEK\n", pFile->h);
    return 1;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SEEK file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
  return 0;

}



static int winMapfile(winFile*, sqlite3_int64);
static int winUnmapfile(winFile*);













static int winClose(sqlite3_file *id){
  int rc, cnt = 0;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;

  assert( id!=0 );

  assert( pFile->pShm==0 );

  assert( pFile->h!=NULL && pFile->h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("CLOSE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);


  winUnmapfile(pFile);


  do{
    rc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->h);

  }while( rc==0 && ++cnt <3                 && (sqlite3_win32_sleep(100), 1) );


  {
    winVfsAppData *pAppData = (winVfsAppData*)pFile->pVfs->pAppData;
    if( pAppData==NULL || !pAppData->bNoLock ){
      winceDestroyLock(pFile);
    }
  }
  if( pFile->zDeleteOnClose ){
    int cnt = 0;
    while(
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR))aSyscall[10].pCurrent)(pFile->zDeleteOnClose)==0
        &&((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR))aSyscall[21].pCurrent)(pFile->zDeleteOnClose)!=0xffffffff
        && cnt++ <3
    ){
       sqlite3_win32_sleep(100);
    }
    sqlite3_free(pFile->zDeleteOnClose);
  }

  if( rc ){
    pFile->h = NULL;
  }
sqlite3_open_file_count+=(-1);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("CLOSE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h, rc ? "ok" : "failed");
  return rc ?0
            :winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (16<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winClose",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)                  ;
}






static int winRead(
  sqlite3_file *id,
  void *pBuf,
  int amt,
  sqlite3_int64 offset
){

  OVERLAPPED overlapped;

  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  DWORD nRead;
  int nRetry = 0;

  assert( id!=0 );
  assert( amt>0 );
  assert( offset>=0 );
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (1<<8)); };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, buffer=%p, amount=%d, " 
"offset=%lld, lock=%d\n", ((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, 
pFile->h, pBuf, amt, offset, pFile->locktype)            ;




  if( offset<pFile->mmapSize ){
    if( offset+amt <= pFile->mmapSize ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBuf);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]); int xxn=(amt);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ-MMAP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }else{
      int nCopy = (int)(pFile->mmapSize - offset);
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBuf);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]); int xxn=(nCopy);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pBuf = &((u8 *)pBuf)[nCopy];
      amt -= nCopy;
      offset += nCopy;
    }
  }



  if( winSeekFile(pFile, offset) ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_FULL\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return 13         ;
  }
  while( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPVOID,DWORD,LPDWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[52].pCurrent)(pFile->h,pBuf,amt,&nRead,0)){

  memset(&overlapped, 0, sizeof(OVERLAPPED));
  overlapped.Offset = (LONG)(offset & 0xffffffff);
  overlapped.OffsetHigh = (LONG)((offset>>32) & 0x7fffffff);
  while( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPVOID,DWORD,LPDWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[52].pCurrent)(pFile->h,pBuf,amt,&nRead,&overlapped)&&
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)()!=ERROR_HANDLE_EOF){

    DWORD lastErrno;
    if( winRetryIoerr(&nRetry, &lastErrno) ) continue;
    pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_READ\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (1<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winRead",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
  }
  winLogIoerr(nRetry, __LINE__);
  if( nRead<(DWORD)amt ){

    memset(&((char*)pBuf)[nRead], 0, amt-nRead);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_SHORT_READ\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return(10 | (2<<8))           ;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
  return 0        ;
}





static int winWrite(
  sqlite3_file *id,
  const void *pBuf,
  int amt,
  sqlite3_int64 offset
){
  int rc = 0;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  int nRetry = 0;

  assert( amt>0 );
  assert( pFile );
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (3<<8)); };
if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending ){ if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending == 1 ){ local_ioerr(); sqlite3_diskfull = 1; sqlite3_io_error_hit = 1; return 13; }else{ sqlite3_diskfull_pending--; } };

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, buffer=%p, amount=%d, " 
"offset=%lld, lock=%d\n", ((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, 
pFile->h, pBuf, amt, offset, pFile->locktype)            ;




  if( offset<pFile->mmapSize ){
    if( offset+amt <= pFile->mmapSize ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pBuf); int xxn=(amt);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE-MMAP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }else{
      int nCopy = (int)(pFile->mmapSize - offset);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&((u8 *)(pFile->pMapRegion))[offset]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pBuf); int xxn=(nCopy);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pBuf = &((u8 *)pBuf)[nCopy];
      amt -= nCopy;
      offset += nCopy;
    }
  }



  rc = winSeekFile(pFile, offset);
  if( rc==0 ){

  {


    OVERLAPPED overlapped;

    u8 *aRem = (u8 *)pBuf;
    int nRem = amt;
    DWORD nWrite;
    DWORD lastErrno = NO_ERROR;


    memset(&overlapped, 0, sizeof(OVERLAPPED));
    overlapped.Offset = (LONG)(offset & 0xffffffff);
    overlapped.OffsetHigh = (LONG)((offset>>32) & 0x7fffffff);


    while( nRem>0 ){

      if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPCVOID,DWORD,LPDWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[61].pCurrent)(pFile->h,aRem,nRem,&nWrite,0)){

      if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPCVOID,DWORD,LPDWORD, LPOVERLAPPED))aSyscall[61].pCurrent)(pFile->h,aRem,nRem,&nWrite,&overlapped)){

        if( winRetryIoerr(&nRetry, &lastErrno) ) continue;
        break;
      }
      assert( nWrite==0 || nWrite<=(DWORD)nRem );
      if( nWrite==0 || nWrite>(DWORD)nRem ){
        lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
        break;
      }

      offset += nWrite;
      overlapped.Offset = (LONG)(offset & 0xffffffff);
      overlapped.OffsetHigh = (LONG)((offset>>32) & 0x7fffffff);

      aRem += nWrite;
      nRem -= nWrite;
    }
    if( nRem>0 ){
      pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
      rc = 1;
    }
  }

  if( rc ){
    if(   ( pFile->lastErrno==ERROR_HANDLE_DISK_FULL )
       || ( pFile->lastErrno==ERROR_DISK_FULL )){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_FULL\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
      return winLogErrorAtLine(13,pFile->lastErrno,
"winWrite1",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_WRITE\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (3<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winWrite2",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
  }else{
    winLogIoerr(nRetry, __LINE__);
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("WRITE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
  return 0        ;
}




static int winTruncate(sqlite3_file *id, sqlite3_int64 nByte){
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  int rc =0         ;
  DWORD lastErrno;

  sqlite3_int64 oldMmapSize;
  if( pFile->nFetchOut>0 ){

















    return 0        ;
  }


  assert( pFile );
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (6<<8)); };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRUNCATE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, size=%lld, lock=%d\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h, nByte, pFile->locktype);






  if( pFile->szChunk>0 ){
    nByte = ((nByte + pFile->szChunk - 1)/pFile->szChunk) * pFile->szChunk;
  }


  if( pFile->pMapRegion ){
    oldMmapSize = pFile->mmapSize;
  }else{
    oldMmapSize = 0;
  }
  winUnmapfile(pFile);



  if( winSeekFile(pFile, nByte) ){
    rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (6<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winTruncate1",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)             ;
  }else if( 0==((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[53].pCurrent)(pFile->h)&&
            ((lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)())!=ERROR_USER_MAPPED_FILE)){
    pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
    rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (6<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winTruncate2",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)             ;
  }


  if( rc==0         && oldMmapSize>0 ){
    if( oldMmapSize>nByte ){
      winMapfile(pFile, -1);
    }else{
      winMapfile(pFile, oldMmapSize);
    }
  }


if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TRUNCATE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
  return rc;
}






           int sqlite3_sync_count = 0;
           int sqlite3_fullsync_count = 0;





static int winSync(sqlite3_file *id, int flags){




  BOOL rc;







  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;

(void)(id)            ;


  assert( pFile );

  assert((flags&0x0F)==0x00002
      || (flags&0x0F)==0x00003
  );




if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending ){ if( sqlite3_diskfull_pending == 1 ){ local_ioerr(); sqlite3_diskfull = 1; sqlite3_io_error_hit = 1; return 13; }else{ sqlite3_diskfull_pending--; } };

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, flags=%x, lock=%d\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h, flags, 
pFile->locktype)            ;


(void)(flags)            ;

  if( (flags&0x0F)==0x00003          ){
    sqlite3_fullsync_count++;
  }
  sqlite3_sync_count++;






if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC-NOP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
  return 0        ;


  if( pFile->pMapRegion ){
    if(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCVOID,SIZE_T))aSyscall[79].pCurrent)(pFile->pMapRegion,0)){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC-MMAP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, pMapRegion=%p, " 
"rc=SQLITE_OK\n", ((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), 
pFile, pFile->pMapRegion)                ;
    }else{
      pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC-MMAP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, pMapRegion=%p, " 
"rc=SQLITE_IOERR_MMAP\n", ((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), 
pFile, pFile->pMapRegion)                ;
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (24<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winSync1",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
  }

  rc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[13].pCurrent)(pFile->h);
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); rc=FALSE; };
  if( rc ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return 0        ;
  }else{
    pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SYNC pid=%lu, pFile=%p, file=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_FSYNC\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->h);
    return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (4<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winSync2",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
  }

}




static int winFileSize(sqlite3_file *id, sqlite3_int64 *pSize){
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( id!=0 );
  assert( pSize!=0 );
if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (7<<8)); };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SIZE file=%p, pSize=%p\n", pFile->h, pSize);


  {
    FILE_STANDARD_INFO info;
    if(((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, FILE_INFO_BY_HANDLE_CLASS,LPVOID,DWORD))aSyscall[66].pCurrent)(pFile->h,FileStandardInfo,
                                     &info, sizeof(info)) ){
      *pSize = info.EndOfFile.QuadPart;
    }else{
      pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (7<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winFileSize",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
    }
  }

  {
    DWORD upperBits;
    DWORD lowerBits;
    DWORD lastErrno;

    lowerBits =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPDWORD))aSyscall[23].pCurrent)(pFile->h,&upperBits);
    *pSize = (((sqlite3_int64)upperBits)<<32) + lowerBits;
    if(   (lowerBits == INVALID_FILE_SIZE)
       && ((lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)())!=NO_ERROR)){
      pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (7<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winFileSize",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
    }
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SIZE file=%p, pSize=%p, *pSize=%lld, rc=%s\n", 
pFile->h, pSize, *pSize, sqlite3ErrName(rc))            ;
  return rc;
}





































static int winGetReadLock(winFile *pFile){
  int res;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ-LOCK file=%p, lock=%d\n", pFile->h, pFile->locktype);
  if((1)       ){





    res = winceLockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+2),0,1,0);

    res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1)                     ,((0x40000000)+2),0,
510                              , 0);

  }

  else{
    int lk;
    sqlite3_randomness(sizeof(lk), &lk);
    pFile->sharedLockByte = (short)((lk & 0x7fffffff)%(510         - 1));
    res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1 | 2)               ,
((0x40000000)+2)                  +pFile->sharedLockByte, 0, 1, 0);
  }

  if( res == 0 ){
    pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();

  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ-LOCK file=%p, result=%d\n", pFile->h, res);
  return res;
}




static int winUnlockReadLock(winFile *pFile){
  int res;
  DWORD lastErrno;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ-UNLOCK file=%p, lock=%d\n", pFile->h, pFile->locktype);
  if((1)       ){
    res = winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+2),0,510       , 0);
  }

  else{
    res = winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+2)+pFile->sharedLockByte,0,1,0);
  }

  if( res==0 && ((lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)())!=ERROR_NOT_LOCKED)){
    pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (8<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winUnlockReadLock",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)        ;
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("READ-UNLOCK file=%p, result=%d\n", pFile->h, res);
  return res;
}



























static int winLock(sqlite3_file *id, int locktype){
  int rc =0         ;
  int res = 1;
  int newLocktype;
  int gotPendingLock = 0;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  DWORD lastErrno = NO_ERROR;

  assert( id!=0 );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK file=%p, oldLock=%d(%d), newLock=%d\n", 
pFile->h, pFile->locktype, pFile->sharedLockByte, locktype)            ;





  if( pFile->locktype>=locktype ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK-HELD file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
    return 0        ;
  }



  if( (pFile->ctrlFlags &0x02           )!=0 && locktype>=2             ){
    return(10 | (15<<8))    ;
  }



  assert( pFile->locktype!=0       || locktype==1           );
  assert( locktype!=3            );
  assert( locktype!=2             || pFile->locktype==1           );





  newLocktype = pFile->locktype;
  if( pFile->locktype==0
   || (locktype==4              && pFile->locktype<=2            )
  ){
    int cnt = 3;
    while( cnt-->0 && (res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1 | 2)               ,
(0x40000000)                                         , 0, 1, 0))==0 ){






      lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK-PENDING-FAIL file=%p, count=%d, result=%d\n", 
pFile->h, cnt, res)                ;
      if( lastErrno==ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE ){
        pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
        rc =(10 | (15<<8))    ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK-FAIL file=%p, count=%d, rc=%s\n", 
pFile->h, cnt, sqlite3ErrName(rc))                  ;
        return rc;
      }
      if( cnt ) sqlite3_win32_sleep(1);
    }
    gotPendingLock = res;
    if( !res ){
      lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    }
  }



  if( locktype==1           && res ){
    assert( pFile->locktype==0       );
    res = winGetReadLock(pFile);
    if( res ){
      newLocktype =1           ;
    }else{
      lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    }
  }



  if( locktype==2             && res ){
    assert( pFile->locktype==1           );
    res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1 | 2)               ,((0x40000000)+1),0,1, 0);
    if( res ){
      newLocktype =2             ;
    }else{
      lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    }
  }



  if( locktype==4              && res ){
    newLocktype =3            ;
    gotPendingLock = 0;
  }



  if( locktype==4              && res ){
    assert( pFile->locktype>=1           );
    res = winUnlockReadLock(pFile);
    res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1 | 2)               ,((0x40000000)+2),0,
510                              , 0);
    if( res ){
      newLocktype =4              ;
    }else{
      lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
      winGetReadLock(pFile);
    }
  }




  if( gotPendingLock && locktype==1           ){
    winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,(0x40000000) , 0, 1, 0);
  }




  if( res ){
    rc =0         ;
  }else{
    pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
    rc =5           ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK-FAIL file=%p, wanted=%d, got=%d\n", 
pFile->h, locktype, newLocktype)              ;
  }
  pFile->locktype = (u8)newLocktype;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("LOCK file=%p, lock=%d, rc=%s\n", 
pFile->h, pFile->locktype, sqlite3ErrName(rc))            ;
  return rc;
}






static int winCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *id, int *pResOut){
  int res;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (14<<8));; };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST-WR-LOCK file=%p, pResOut=%p\n", pFile->h, pResOut);

  assert( id!=0 );
  if( pFile->locktype>=2             ){
    res = 1;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST-WR-LOCK file=%p, result=%d (local)\n", pFile->h, res);
  }else{
    res = winLockFile(&pFile->h,(1)                     ,((0x40000000)+1),0,1,0);
    if( res ){
      winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+1),0,1, 0);
    }
    res = !res;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST-WR-LOCK file=%p, result=%d (remote)\n", pFile->h, res);
  }
  *pResOut = res;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEST-WR-LOCK file=%p, pResOut=%p, *pResOut=%d, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
pFile->h, pResOut, *pResOut)            ;
  return 0        ;
}












static int winUnlock(sqlite3_file *id, int locktype){
  int type;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  int rc =0         ;
  assert( pFile!=0 );
  assert( locktype<=1           );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK file=%p, oldLock=%d(%d), newLock=%d\n", 
pFile->h, pFile->locktype, pFile->sharedLockByte, locktype)            ;
  type = pFile->locktype;
  if( type>=4              ){
    winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+2),0,510       , 0);
    if( locktype==1           && !winGetReadLock(pFile) ){


      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (8<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winUnlock",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
    }
  }
  if( type>=2             ){
    winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,((0x40000000)+1),0,1, 0);
  }
  if( locktype==0       && type>=1           ){
    winUnlockReadLock(pFile);
  }
  if( type>=3            ){
    winUnlockFile(&pFile->h,(0x40000000) , 0, 1, 0);
  }
  pFile->locktype = (u8)locktype;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNLOCK file=%p, lock=%d, rc=%s\n", 
pFile->h, pFile->locktype, sqlite3ErrName(rc))            ;
  return rc;
}

static void winModeBit(winFile *pFile, unsigned char mask, int *pArg){
  if( *pArg<0 ){
    *pArg = (pFile->ctrlFlags & mask)!=0;
  }else if( (*pArg)==0 ){
    pFile->ctrlFlags &= ~mask;
  }else{
    pFile->ctrlFlags |= mask;
  }
}
