static int winFileControl(sqlite3_file *id, int op, void *pArg){
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, op=%d, pArg=%p\n", pFile->h, op, pArg);
  switch( op ){
    case 1                     : {
      *(int*)pArg = pFile->locktype;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 4                      : {
      *(int*)pArg = (int)pFile->lastErrno;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 6                      : {
      pFile->szChunk = *(int *)pArg;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 5                     : {
      if( pFile->szChunk>0 ){
        sqlite3_int64 oldSz;
        int rc = winFileSize(id, &oldSz);
        if( rc==0         ){
          sqlite3_int64 newSz = *(sqlite3_int64*)pArg;
          if( newSz>oldSz ){
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)         ;
            rc = winTruncate(id, newSz);
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)         ;
          }
        }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=%s\n", pFile->h, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
        return rc;
      }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 10                      : {
      winModeBit(pFile,0x04                , (int*)pArg);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 13                              : {
      winModeBit(pFile,0x10         , (int*)pArg);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 12                  : {
      *(char**)pArg = sqlite3_mprintf("%s", pFile->pVfs->zName);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 9                          : {
      int *a = (int*)pArg;
      if( a[0]>0 ){
        winIoerrRetry = a[0];
      }else{
        a[0] = winIoerrRetry;
      }
      if( a[1]>0 ){
        winIoerrRetryDelay = a[1];
      }else{
        a[1] = winIoerrRetryDelay;
      }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }
    case 29                           : {
      LPHANDLE phFile = (LPHANDLE)pArg;
      *phFile = pFile->h;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", pFile->h);
      return 0        ;
    }

    case 23                           : {
      LPHANDLE phFile = (LPHANDLE)pArg;
      HANDLE hOldFile = pFile->h;
      pFile->h = *phFile;
      *phFile = hOldFile;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL oldFile=%p, newFile=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
hOldFile, pFile->h)                ;
      return 0        ;
    }

    case 16                       : {
      char *zTFile = 0;
      int rc = winGetTempname(pFile->pVfs, &zTFile);
      if( rc==0         ){
        *(char**)pArg = zTFile;
      }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=%s\n", pFile->h, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return rc;
    }

    case 18                    : {
      i64 newLimit = *(i64*)pArg;
      int rc =0         ;
      if( newLimit>(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMmap){
        newLimit =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMmap;
      }




      if( newLimit>0 && sizeof(SIZE_T)<8 ){
        newLimit = (newLimit & 0x7FFFFFFF);
      }

      *(i64*)pArg = pFile->mmapSizeMax;
      if( newLimit>=0 && newLimit!=pFile->mmapSizeMax && pFile->nFetchOut==0 ){
        pFile->mmapSizeMax = newLimit;
        if( pFile->mmapSize>0 ){
          winUnmapfile(pFile);
          rc = winMapfile(pFile, -1);
        }
      }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=%s\n", pFile->h, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return rc;
    }

  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FCNTL file=%p, rc=SQLITE_NOTFOUND\n", pFile->h);
  return 12             ;
}











static int winSectorSize(sqlite3_file *id){
  (void)id;
  return 4096                      ;
}




static int winDeviceCharacteristics(sqlite3_file *id){
  winFile *p = (winFile*)id;
  return 0x00000800                         |
         ((p->ctrlFlags &0x10         )?0x00001000                      :0);
}







static SYSTEM_INFO winSysInfo;
















static sqlite3_mutex *winBigLock = 0;
static void winShmEnterMutex(void){
                                 ;
}
static void winShmLeaveMutex(void){
                                 ;
}

static int winShmMutexHeld(void) {
  return((void)(winBigLock),1)         ;
}

























struct winShmNode {
  sqlite3_mutex *mutex;
  char *zFilename;
  winFile hFile;

  int szRegion;
  int nRegion;
  u8 isReadonly;
  u8 isUnlocked;

  struct ShmRegion {
    HANDLE hMap;
    void *pMap;
  } *aRegion;
  DWORD lastErrno;

  int nRef;
  winShm *pFirst;
  winShmNode *pNext;

  u8 nextShmId;

};






static winShmNode *winShmNodeList = 0;














struct winShm {
  winShmNode *pShmNode;
  winShm *pNext;
  u8 hasMutex;
  u16 sharedMask;
  u16 exclMask;

  u8 id;

};













static int winShmSystemLock(
  winShmNode *pFile,
  int lockType,
  int ofst,
  int nByte
){
  int rc = 0;


  assert( pFile->nRef==0 ||((void)(pFile->mutex),1)          );

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-LOCK file=%p, lock=%d, offset=%d, size=%d\n", 
pFile->hFile.h, lockType, ofst, nByte)            ;


  if( lockType==1            ){
    rc = winUnlockFile(&pFile->hFile.h, ofst, 0, nByte, 0);
  }else{

    DWORD dwFlags =1                         ;
    if( lockType ==3             ) dwFlags |=2                       ;
    rc = winLockFile(&pFile->hFile.h, dwFlags, ofst, 0, nByte, 0);
  }

  if( rc!= 0 ){
    rc =0         ;
  }else{
    pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
    rc =5           ;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-LOCK file=%p, func=%s, errno=%lu, rc=%s\n", 
pFile->hFile.h, (lockType == 1) ? "winUnlockFile" : 
"winLockFile", pFile->lastErrno, sqlite3ErrName(rc))            ;

  return rc;
}


static int winOpen(sqlite3_vfs*,const char*,sqlite3_file*,int,int*);
static int winDelete(sqlite3_vfs *,const char*,int);







static void winShmPurge(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, int deleteFlag){
  winShmNode **pp;
  winShmNode *p;
  assert( winShmMutexHeld() );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-PURGE pid=%lu, deleteFlag=%d\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), deleteFlag);
  pp = &winShmNodeList;
  while( (p = *pp)!=0 ){
    if( p->nRef==0 ){
      int i;
      if( p->mutex ){                             ; }
      for(i=0; i<p->nRegion; i++){
        BOOL bRc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCVOID))aSyscall[59].pCurrent)(p->aRegion[i].pMap);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-PURGE-UNMAP pid=%lu, region=%d, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), i, bRc ? "ok" : "failed");
(void)(bRc)                       ;
        bRc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(p->aRegion[i].hMap);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-PURGE-CLOSE pid=%lu, region=%d, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), i, bRc ? "ok" : "failed");
(void)(bRc)                       ;
      }
      if( p->hFile.h!=NULL && p->hFile.h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ){
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)     ;
        winClose((sqlite3_file *)&p->hFile);
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)     ;
      }
      if( deleteFlag ){
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(1)     ;
                                  ;
        winDelete(pVfs, p->zFilename, 0);
                                ;
sqlite3_io_error_benign=(0)     ;
      }
      *pp = p->pNext;
      sqlite3_free(p->aRegion);
      sqlite3_free(p);
    }else{
      pp = &p->pNext;
    }
  }
}










static int winLockSharedMemory(winShmNode *pShmNode){
  int rc = winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,3            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( pShmNode->isReadonly ){
      pShmNode->isUnlocked = 1;
      winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,1            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
      return(8 | (5<<8))             ;
    }else if( winTruncate((sqlite3_file*)&pShmNode->hFile, 0) ){
      winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,1            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (18<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winLockSharedMemory",pShmNode->zFilename,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,1            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
  }

  return winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,2            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
}








static int winOpenSharedMemory(winFile *pDbFd){
  struct winShm *p;
  winShmNode *pShmNode = 0;
  int rc =0         ;
  winShmNode *pNew;
  int nName;

  assert( pDbFd->pShm==0 );




  p = sqlite3MallocZero( sizeof(*p) );
  if( p==0 ) return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  nName = sqlite3Strlen30(pDbFd->zPath);
  pNew = sqlite3MallocZero( sizeof(*pShmNode) + nName + 17 );
  if( pNew==0 ){
    sqlite3_free(p);
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  pNew->zFilename = (char*)&pNew[1];
  sqlite3_snprintf(nName+15, pNew->zFilename, "%s-shm", pDbFd->zPath);
                                                   ;




  winShmEnterMutex();
  for(pShmNode = winShmNodeList; pShmNode; pShmNode=pShmNode->pNext){



    if( sqlite3StrICmp(pShmNode->zFilename, pNew->zFilename)==0 ) break;
  }
  if( pShmNode ){
    sqlite3_free(pNew);
  }else{
    int inFlags =0x00080000      ;
    int outFlags = 0;

    pShmNode = pNew;
    pNew = 0;
    ((winFile*)(&pShmNode->hFile))->h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    pShmNode->pNext = winShmNodeList;
    winShmNodeList = pShmNode;

    if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex){
      pShmNode->mutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                    ;
      if( pShmNode->mutex==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
        goto shm_open_err;
      }
    }

    if( 0==sqlite3_uri_boolean(pDbFd->zPath, "readonly_shm", 0) ){
      inFlags |=0x00000002             |0x00000004         ;
    }else{
      inFlags |=0x00000001           ;
    }
    rc = winOpen(pDbFd->pVfs, pShmNode->zFilename,
                 (sqlite3_file*)&pShmNode->hFile,
                 inFlags, &outFlags);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine(rc,((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),"winOpenShm",
pShmNode->zFilename,__LINE__)              ;
      goto shm_open_err;
    }
    if( outFlags==0x00000001           ) pShmNode->isReadonly = 1;

    rc = winLockSharedMemory(pShmNode);
    if( rc!=0         && rc!=(8 | (5<<8))             ) goto shm_open_err;
  }


  p->pShmNode = pShmNode;

  p->id = pShmNode->nextShmId++;

  pShmNode->nRef++;
  pDbFd->pShm = p;
  winShmLeaveMutex();








                                      ;
  p->pNext = pShmNode->pFirst;
  pShmNode->pFirst = p;
                                      ;
  return rc;


shm_open_err:
  winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,1            ,(((22 +8)*4)+8),1);
  winShmPurge(pDbFd->pVfs, 0);
  sqlite3_free(p);
  sqlite3_free(pNew);
  winShmLeaveMutex();
  return rc;
}





static int winShmUnmap(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int deleteFlag
){
  winFile *pDbFd;
  winShm *p;
  winShmNode *pShmNode;
  winShm **pp;

  pDbFd = (winFile*)fd;
  p = pDbFd->pShm;
  if( p==0 ) return 0        ;
  pShmNode = p->pShmNode;



                                      ;
  for(pp=&pShmNode->pFirst; (*pp)!=p; pp = &(*pp)->pNext){}
  *pp = p->pNext;


  sqlite3_free(p);
  pDbFd->pShm = 0;
                                      ;



  winShmEnterMutex();
  assert( pShmNode->nRef>0 );
  pShmNode->nRef--;
  if( pShmNode->nRef==0 ){
    winShmPurge(pDbFd->pVfs, deleteFlag);
  }
  winShmLeaveMutex();

  return 0        ;
}




static int winShmLock(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int ofst,
  int n,
  int flags
){
  winFile *pDbFd = (winFile*)fd;
  winShm *p = pDbFd->pShm;
  winShm *pX;
  winShmNode *pShmNode;
  int rc =0         ;
  u16 mask;

  if( p==0 ) return(10 | (20<<8))       ;
  pShmNode = p->pShmNode;
  if((0)                 ) return(10 | (20<<8))       ;

  assert( ofst>=0 && ofst+n<=8                );
  assert( n>=1 );
  assert( flags==(2               |4                 )
       || flags==(2               |8                    )
       || flags==(1                 |4                 )
       || flags==(1                 |8                    ) );
  assert( n==1 || (flags &8                    )!=0 );

  mask = (u16)((1U<<(ofst+n)) - (1U<<ofst));
  assert( n>1 || mask==(1<<ofst) );
                                      ;
  if( flags &1                  ){
    u16 allMask = 0;


    for(pX=pShmNode->pFirst; pX; pX=pX->pNext){
      if( pX==p ) continue;
      assert( (pX->exclMask & (p->exclMask|p->sharedMask))==0 );
      allMask |= pX->sharedMask;
    }


    if( (mask & allMask)==0 ){
      rc = winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,1            , ofst+((22 +8)*4) , n);
    }else{
      rc =0         ;
    }


    if( rc==0         ){
      p->exclMask &= ~mask;
      p->sharedMask &= ~mask;
    }
  }else if( flags &4                  ){
    u16 allShared = 0;





    for(pX=pShmNode->pFirst; pX; pX=pX->pNext){
      if( (pX->exclMask & mask)!=0 ){
        rc =5           ;
        break;
      }
      allShared |= pX->sharedMask;
    }


    if( rc==0         ){
      if( (allShared & mask)==0 ){
        rc = winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,2            , ofst+((22 +8)*4) , n);
      }else{
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }


    if( rc==0         ){
      p->sharedMask |= mask;
    }
  }else{



    for(pX=pShmNode->pFirst; pX; pX=pX->pNext){
      if( (pX->exclMask & mask)!=0 || (pX->sharedMask & mask)!=0 ){
        rc =5           ;
        break;
      }
    }




    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = winShmSystemLock(pShmNode,3            , ofst+((22 +8)*4) , n);
      if( rc==0         ){
        assert( (p->sharedMask & mask)==0 );
        p->exclMask |= mask;
      }
    }
  }
                                      ;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-LOCK pid=%lu, id=%d, sharedMask=%03x, exclMask=%03x, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), p->id, p->sharedMask, p->exclMask, 
sqlite3ErrName(rc))            ;
  return rc;
}







static void winShmBarrier(
  sqlite3_file *fd
){
(void)(fd)            ;
                        ;
  winShmEnterMutex();
  winShmLeaveMutex();
}




















static int winShmMap(
  sqlite3_file *fd,
  int iRegion,
  int szRegion,
  int isWrite,
  void volatile **pp
){
  winFile *pDbFd = (winFile*)fd;
  winShm *pShm = pDbFd->pShm;
  winShmNode *pShmNode;
  DWORD protect = PAGE_READWRITE;
  DWORD flags = FILE_MAP_WRITE | FILE_MAP_READ;
  int rc =0         ;

  if( !pShm ){
    rc = winOpenSharedMemory(pDbFd);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    pShm = pDbFd->pShm;
    assert( pShm!=0 );
  }
  pShmNode = pShm->pShmNode;

                                      ;
  if( pShmNode->isUnlocked ){
    rc = winLockSharedMemory(pShmNode);
    if( rc!=0         ) goto shmpage_out;
    pShmNode->isUnlocked = 0;
  }
  assert( szRegion==pShmNode->szRegion || pShmNode->nRegion==0 );

  if( pShmNode->nRegion<=iRegion ){
    struct ShmRegion *apNew;
    int nByte = (iRegion+1)*szRegion;
    sqlite3_int64 sz;

    pShmNode->szRegion = szRegion;





    rc = winFileSize((sqlite3_file *)&pShmNode->hFile, &sz);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (19<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winShmMap1",pDbFd->zPath,__LINE__)               ;
      goto shmpage_out;
    }

    if( sz<nByte ){






      if( !isWrite ) goto shmpage_out;
      rc = winTruncate((sqlite3_file *)&pShmNode->hFile, nByte);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (19<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winShmMap2",pDbFd->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
        goto shmpage_out;
      }
    }


    apNew = (struct ShmRegion *)sqlite3_realloc64(
        pShmNode->aRegion, (iRegion+1)*sizeof(apNew[0])
    );
    if( !apNew ){
      rc =sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
      goto shmpage_out;
    }
    pShmNode->aRegion = apNew;

    if( pShmNode->isReadonly ){
      protect = PAGE_READONLY;
      flags = FILE_MAP_READ;
    }

    while( pShmNode->nRegion<=iRegion ){
      HANDLE hMap = NULL;
      void *pMap = 0;


      hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES,ULONG,ULONG64,LPCWSTR))aSyscall[75].pCurrent)(pShmNode->hFile.h,
          NULL, protect, nByte, NULL
      );

      hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,LPCWSTR))aSyscall[7].pCurrent)(pShmNode->hFile.h,
          NULL, protect, 0, nByte, NULL
      );

      hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,LPCSTR))aSyscall[6].pCurrent)(pShmNode->hFile.h,
          NULL, protect, 0, nByte, NULL
      );

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-MAP-CREATE pid=%lu, region=%d, size=%d, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pShmNode->nRegion, nByte, 
hMap ? "ok" : "failed")                ;
      if( hMap ){
        int iOffset = pShmNode->nRegion*szRegion;
        int iOffsetShift = iOffset % winSysInfo.dwAllocationGranularity;

        pMap =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,ULONG,ULONG64, SIZE_T))aSyscall[67].pCurrent)(hMap,flags,
            iOffset - iOffsetShift, szRegion + iOffsetShift
        );

        pMap =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, SIZE_T))aSyscall[49].pCurrent)(hMap,flags,
            0, iOffset - iOffsetShift, szRegion + iOffsetShift
        );

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("SHM-MAP-MAP pid=%lu, region=%d, offset=%d, size=%d, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pShmNode->nRegion, iOffset, 
szRegion, pMap ? "ok" : "failed")                  ;
      }
      if( !pMap ){
        pShmNode->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
        rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (21<<8)),pShmNode->lastErrno,
"winShmMap3",pDbFd->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
        if( hMap )((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(hMap);
        goto shmpage_out;
      }

      pShmNode->aRegion[pShmNode->nRegion].pMap = pMap;
      pShmNode->aRegion[pShmNode->nRegion].hMap = hMap;
      pShmNode->nRegion++;
    }
  }

shmpage_out:
  if( pShmNode->nRegion>iRegion ){
    int iOffset = iRegion*szRegion;
    int iOffsetShift = iOffset % winSysInfo.dwAllocationGranularity;
    char *p = (char *)pShmNode->aRegion[iRegion].pMap;
    *pp = (void *)&p[iOffsetShift];
  }else{
    *pp = 0;
  }
  if( pShmNode->isReadonly && rc==0         ) rc =8               ;
                                      ;
  return rc;
}












static int winUnmapfile(winFile *pFile){
  assert( pFile!=0 );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNMAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, hMap=%p, pMapRegion=%p, " 
"mmapSize=%lld, mmapSizeMax=%lld\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->hMap, pFile->pMapRegion, 
pFile->mmapSize, pFile->mmapSizeMax)            ;
  if( pFile->pMapRegion ){
    if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCVOID))aSyscall[59].pCurrent)(pFile->pMapRegion)){
      pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNMAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, pMapRegion=%p, " 
"rc=SQLITE_IOERR_MMAP\n", ((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, 
pFile->pMapRegion)                ;
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (24<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winUnmapfile1",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    pFile->pMapRegion = 0;
    pFile->mmapSize = 0;
  }
  if( pFile->hMap!=NULL ){
    if( !((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFile->hMap)){
      pFile->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNMAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, hMap=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_MMAP\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile, pFile->hMap);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (24<<8)),pFile->lastErrno,
"winUnmapfile2",pFile->zPath,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    pFile->hMap = NULL;
  }
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNMAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFile);
  return 0        ;
}

















static int winMapfile(winFile *pFd, sqlite3_int64 nByte){
  sqlite3_int64 nMap = nByte;
  int rc;

  assert( nMap>=0 || pFd->nFetchOut==0 );
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("MAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, size=%lld\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd, nByte);

  if( pFd->nFetchOut>0 ) return 0        ;

  if( nMap<0 ){
    rc = winFileSize((sqlite3_file*)pFd, &nMap);
    if( rc ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("MAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_FSTAT\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd);
      return(10 | (7<<8))      ;
    }
  }
  if( nMap>pFd->mmapSizeMax ){
    nMap = pFd->mmapSizeMax;
  }
  nMap &= ~(sqlite3_int64)(winSysInfo.dwPageSize - 1);

  if( nMap==0 && pFd->mmapSize>0 ){
    winUnmapfile(pFd);
  }
  if( nMap!=pFd->mmapSize ){
    void *pNew = 0;
    DWORD protect = PAGE_READONLY;
    DWORD flags = FILE_MAP_READ;

    winUnmapfile(pFd);

    if( (pFd->ctrlFlags &0x02           )==0 ){
      protect = PAGE_READWRITE;
      flags |= FILE_MAP_WRITE;
    }


    pFd->hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES,ULONG,ULONG64,LPCWSTR))aSyscall[75].pCurrent)(pFd->h,NULL,protect,nMap,NULL);

    pFd->hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,LPCWSTR))aSyscall[7].pCurrent)(pFd->h,NULL,protect,
                                (DWORD)((nMap>>32) & 0xffffffff),
                                (DWORD)(nMap & 0xffffffff), NULL);

    pFd->hMap =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, DWORD,DWORD,DWORD,LPCSTR))aSyscall[6].pCurrent)(pFd->h,NULL,protect,
                                (DWORD)((nMap>>32) & 0xffffffff),
                                (DWORD)(nMap & 0xffffffff), NULL);

    if( pFd->hMap==NULL ){
      pFd->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (24<<8)),pFd->lastErrno,
"winMapfile1",pFd->zPath,__LINE__)               ;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("MAP-FILE-CREATE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return 0        ;
    }
    assert( (nMap % winSysInfo.dwPageSize)==0 );
    assert( sizeof(SIZE_T)==sizeof(sqlite3_int64) || nMap<=0xffffffff );

    pNew =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,ULONG,ULONG64, SIZE_T))aSyscall[67].pCurrent)(pFd->hMap,flags,0,(SIZE_T)nMap);

    pNew =((LPVOID(WINAPI*)(HANDLE,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, SIZE_T))aSyscall[49].pCurrent)(pFd->hMap,flags,0,0,(SIZE_T)nMap);

    if( pNew==NULL ){
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(pFd->hMap);
      pFd->hMap = NULL;
      pFd->lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
      rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (24<<8)),pFd->lastErrno,
"winMapfile2",pFd->zPath,__LINE__)               ;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("MAP-FILE-MAP pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return 0        ;
    }
    pFd->pMapRegion = pNew;
    pFd->mmapSize = nMap;
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("MAP-FILE pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd);
  return 0        ;
}














static int winFetch(sqlite3_file *fd, i64 iOff, int nAmt, void **pp){

  winFile *pFd = (winFile*)fd;

  *pp = 0;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FETCH pid=%lu, pFile=%p, offset=%lld, amount=%d, pp=%p\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), fd, iOff, nAmt, pp);


  if( pFd->mmapSizeMax>0 ){
    if( pFd->pMapRegion==0 ){
      int rc = winMapfile(pFd, -1);
      if( rc!=0         ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FETCH pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=%s\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
        return rc;
      }
    }
    if( pFd->mmapSize >= iOff+nAmt ){
      assert( pFd->pMapRegion!=0 );
      *pp = &((u8 *)pFd->pMapRegion)[iOff];
      pFd->nFetchOut++;
    }
  }


if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("FETCH pid=%lu, pFile=%p, pp=%p, *pp=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), fd, pp, *pp);
  return 0        ;
}











static int winUnfetch(sqlite3_file *fd, i64 iOff, void *p){

  winFile *pFd = (winFile*)fd;




  assert( (p==0)==(pFd->nFetchOut==0) );


  assert( p==0 || p==&((u8 *)pFd->pMapRegion)[iOff] );

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNFETCH pid=%lu, pFile=%p, offset=%lld, p=%p\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), pFd, iOff, p);

  if( p ){
    pFd->nFetchOut--;
  }else{




    winUnmapfile(pFd);
  }

  assert( pFd->nFetchOut>=0 );


if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("UNFETCH pid=%lu, pFile=%p, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)(), fd);
  return 0        ;
}

static char *winConvertToUtf8Filename(const void *zFilename){
  char *zConverted = 0;
  if((1)       ){
    zConverted = winUnicodeToUtf8(zFilename);
  }

  else{
    zConverted = winMbcsToUtf8(zFilename,1                   );
  }


  return zConverted;
}








static void *winConvertFromUtf8Filename(const char *zFilename){
  void *zConverted = 0;
  if((1)       ){
    zConverted = winUtf8ToUnicode(zFilename);
  }

  else{
    zConverted = winUtf8ToMbcs(zFilename,1                   );
  }


  return zConverted;
}






static int winMakeEndInDirSep(int nBuf, char *zBuf){
  if( zBuf ){
    int nLen = sqlite3Strlen30(zBuf);
    if( nLen>0 ){
      if((((zBuf[nLen-1]) == '/') || ((zBuf[nLen-1]) == '\\'))){
        return 1;
      }else if( nLen+1<nBuf ){
        zBuf[nLen] ='\\'           ;
        zBuf[nLen+1] = '\0';
        return 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}







static int winTempDirDefined(void){
                                                                     ;
  if( sqlite3_temp_directory!=0 ) return 1;
                                                                     ;
  return 0;
}





static int winGetTempname(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, char **pzBuf){
  static char zChars[] =
    "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    "0123456789";
  size_t i, j;
  int nPre = sqlite3Strlen30("etilqs_"              );
  int nMax, nBuf, nDir, nLen;
  char *zBuf;





if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return 10; };




  nMax = pVfs->mxPathname; nBuf = nMax + 2;
  zBuf = sqlite3MallocZero( nBuf );
  if( !zBuf ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }





  nDir = nMax - (nPre + 15);
  assert( nDir>0 );
  if( winTempDirDefined() ){
    int nDirLen = sqlite3Strlen30(sqlite3_temp_directory);
    if( nDirLen>0 ){
      if( !(((sqlite3_temp_directory[nDirLen-1]) == '/') || ((sqlite3_temp_directory[nDirLen-1]) == '\\'))){
        nDirLen++;
      }
      if( nDirLen>nDir ){
                                                                           ;
        sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_ERROR\n");
        return winLogErrorAtLine(1,0,"winGetTempname1",0,__LINE__);
      }
      sqlite3_snprintf(nMax, zBuf, "%s", sqlite3_temp_directory);
    }
                                                                       ;
  }


  else{
    static const char *azDirs[] = {
       0,
       0,
       0,
       0,
       0,
       "/var/tmp",
       "/usr/tmp",
       "/tmp",
       ".",
       0
    };
    unsigned int i;
    const char *zDir = 0;

    if( !azDirs[0] ) azDirs[0] = getenv("SQLITE_TMPDIR");
    if( !azDirs[1] ) azDirs[1] = getenv("TMPDIR");
    if( !azDirs[2] ) azDirs[2] = getenv("TMP");
    if( !azDirs[3] ) azDirs[3] = getenv("TEMP");
    if( !azDirs[4] ) azDirs[4] = getenv("USERPROFILE");
    for(i=0; i<sizeof(azDirs)/sizeof(azDirs[0]); zDir=azDirs[i++]){
      void *zConverted;
      if( zDir==0 ) continue;





      if( winIsDriveLetterAndColon(zDir) ){
        zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zDir);
        if( !zConverted ){
          sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
          return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
        }
        if( winIsDir(zConverted) ){
          sqlite3_snprintf(nMax, zBuf, "%s", zDir);
          sqlite3_free(zConverted);
          break;
        }
        sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      }else{
        zConverted = sqlite3MallocZero( nMax+1 );
        if( !zConverted ){
          sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
          return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
        }
        if( cygwin_conv_path(
(1)                      ? CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_W : CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_A, zDir,
                zConverted, nMax+1)<0 ){
          sqlite3_free(zConverted);
          sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_CONVPATH\n");
          return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (26<<8)),(DWORD)errno,
"winGetTempname2",zDir,__LINE__)                     ;
        }
        if( winIsDir(zConverted) ){




          char *zUtf8 = winConvertToUtf8Filename(zConverted);
          if( !zUtf8 ){
            sqlite3_free(zConverted);
            sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
            return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
          }
          sqlite3_snprintf(nMax, zBuf, "%s", zUtf8);
          sqlite3_free(zUtf8);
          sqlite3_free(zConverted);
          break;
        }
        sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      }
    }
  }

  else if((1)       ){
    char *zMulti;
    LPWSTR zWidePath = sqlite3MallocZero( nMax*sizeof(WCHAR) );
    if( !zWidePath ){
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    if(((DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD,LPWSTR))aSyscall[32].pCurrent)(nMax,zWidePath)==0){
      sqlite3_free(zWidePath);
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_GETTEMPPATH\n");
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (25<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winGetTempname2",0,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    zMulti = winUnicodeToUtf8(zWidePath);
    if( zMulti ){
      sqlite3_snprintf(nMax, zBuf, "%s", zMulti);
      sqlite3_free(zMulti);
      sqlite3_free(zWidePath);
    }else{
      sqlite3_free(zWidePath);
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
  }

  else{
    char *zUtf8;
    char *zMbcsPath = sqlite3MallocZero( nMax );
    if( !zMbcsPath ){
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    if(((DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD,LPSTR))aSyscall[31].pCurrent)(nMax,zMbcsPath)==0){
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_GETTEMPPATH\n");
      return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (25<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winGetTempname3",0,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    zUtf8 = winMbcsToUtf8(zMbcsPath,1                   );
    if( zUtf8 ){
      sqlite3_snprintf(nMax, zBuf, "%s", zUtf8);
      sqlite3_free(zUtf8);
    }else{
      sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n");
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
  }








  if( !winMakeEndInDirSep(nDir+1, zBuf) ){
    sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_ERROR\n");
    return winLogErrorAtLine(1,0,"winGetTempname4",0,__LINE__);
  }












  nLen = sqlite3Strlen30(zBuf);
  if( (nLen + nPre + 17) > nBuf ){
    sqlite3_free(zBuf);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME rc=SQLITE_ERROR\n");
    return winLogErrorAtLine(1,0,"winGetTempname5",0,__LINE__);
  }

  sqlite3_snprintf(nBuf-16 -nLen,zBuf+nLen,"etilqs_"               );

  j = sqlite3Strlen30(zBuf);
  sqlite3_randomness(15, &zBuf[j]);
  for(i=0; i<15; i++, j++){
    zBuf[j] = (char)zChars[ ((unsigned char)zBuf[j])%(sizeof(zChars)-1) ];
  }
  zBuf[j] = 0;
  zBuf[j+1] = 0;
  *pzBuf = zBuf;

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("TEMP-FILENAME name=%s, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", zBuf);
  return 0        ;
}






static int winIsDir(const void *zConverted){
  DWORD attr;
  int rc = 0;
  DWORD lastErrno;

  if((1)       ){
    int cnt = 0;
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA sAttrData;
    memset(&sAttrData, 0, sizeof(sAttrData));
    while( !(rc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,GET_FILEEX_INFO_LEVELS, LPVOID))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,
                             GetFileExInfoStandard,
                             &sAttrData)) && winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) ){}
    if( !rc ){
      return 0;
    }
    attr = sAttrData.dwFileAttributes;

  }else{
    attr =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR))aSyscall[20].pCurrent)((char*)zConverted);

  }
  return (attr!=((DWORD)-1)            ) && (attr&FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY);
}


static int winAccess(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zFilename,
  int flags,
  int *pResOut
);




static int winOpen(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zName,
  sqlite3_file *id,
  int flags,
  int *pOutFlags
){
  HANDLE h;
  DWORD lastErrno = 0;
  DWORD dwDesiredAccess;
  DWORD dwShareMode;
  DWORD dwCreationDisposition;
  DWORD dwFlagsAndAttributes = 0;

  int isTemp = 0;

  winVfsAppData *pAppData;
  winFile *pFile = (winFile*)id;
  void *zConverted;
  const char *zUtf8Name = zName;
  int cnt = 0;




  char *zTmpname = 0;

  int rc =0         ;

  int eType = flags&0xFFFFFF00;


  int isExclusive  = (flags &0x00000010            );
  int isDelete     = (flags &0x00000008                );
  int isCreate     = (flags &0x00000004         );
  int isReadonly   = (flags &0x00000001           );
  int isReadWrite  = (flags &0x00000002            );


  int isOpenJournal = (isCreate && (
        eType==0x00004000
     || eType==0x00000800
     || eType==0x00080000
  ));


if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN name=%s, pFile=%p, flags=%x, pOutFlags=%p\n", 
zUtf8Name, id, flags, pOutFlags)            ;








  assert((isReadonly==0 || isReadWrite==0) && (isReadWrite || isReadonly));
  assert(isCreate==0 || isReadWrite);
  assert(isExclusive==0 || isCreate);
  assert(isDelete==0 || isCreate);



  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00000100          );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00000800               );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00004000                );
  assert( (!isDelete && zName) || eType!=0x00080000      );


  assert( eType==0x00000100               || eType==0x00000200
       || eType==0x00000800               || eType==0x00001000
       || eType==0x00002000               || eType==0x00004000
       || eType==0x00000400               || eType==0x00080000
  );

  assert( pFile!=0 );
  memset(pFile, 0, sizeof(winFile));
  pFile->h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;


  if( !zUtf8Name && !sqlite3_temp_directory ){
    sqlite3_log(1           ,
        "sqlite3_temp_directory variable should be set for WinRT");
  }





  if( !zUtf8Name ){
    assert( isDelete && !isOpenJournal );
    rc = winGetTempname(pVfs, &zTmpname);
    if( rc!=0         ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN name=%s, rc=%s", zUtf8Name, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return rc;
    }
    zUtf8Name = zTmpname;
  }





  assert( (eType!=0x00000100         ) || (flags &0x00000040      ) ||
       zUtf8Name[sqlite3Strlen30(zUtf8Name)+1]==0 );


  zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zUtf8Name);
  if( zConverted==0 ){
    sqlite3_free(zTmpname);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN name=%s, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM", zUtf8Name);
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }

  if( winIsDir(zConverted) ){
    sqlite3_free(zConverted);
    sqlite3_free(zTmpname);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN name=%s, rc=SQLITE_CANTOPEN_ISDIR", zUtf8Name);
    return(14 | (2<<8))         ;
  }

  if( isReadWrite ){
    dwDesiredAccess = GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE;
  }else{
    dwDesiredAccess = GENERIC_READ;
  }





  if( isExclusive ){


    dwCreationDisposition = CREATE_NEW;
  }else if( isCreate ){

    dwCreationDisposition = OPEN_ALWAYS;
  }else{

    dwCreationDisposition = OPEN_EXISTING;
  }

  if( 0==sqlite3_uri_boolean(zName, "exclusive", 0) ){
    dwShareMode = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE;
  }else{
    dwShareMode = 0;
  }

  if( isDelete ){

    dwFlagsAndAttributes = FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN;
    isTemp = 1;

    dwFlagsAndAttributes = FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TEMPORARY
                               | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN
                               | FILE_FLAG_DELETE_ON_CLOSE;

  }else{
    dwFlagsAndAttributes = FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL;
  }



  dwFlagsAndAttributes |= FILE_FLAG_RANDOM_ACCESS;


  if((1)       ){

    CREATEFILE2_EXTENDED_PARAMETERS extendedParameters;
    extendedParameters.dwSize = sizeof(CREATEFILE2_EXTENDED_PARAMETERS);
    extendedParameters.dwFileAttributes =
            dwFlagsAndAttributes &(0x0003FFF7)        ;
    extendedParameters.dwFileFlags = dwFlagsAndAttributes &(0xFF3C0000)   ;
    extendedParameters.dwSecurityQosFlags = SECURITY_ANONYMOUS;
    extendedParameters.lpSecurityAttributes = NULL;
    extendedParameters.hTemplateFile = NULL;
    do{
      h =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,DWORD,DWORD,DWORD, LPCREATEFILE2_EXTENDED_PARAMETERS))aSyscall[68].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,
                        dwDesiredAccess,
                        dwShareMode,
                        dwCreationDisposition,
                        &extendedParameters);
      if( h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) break;
      if( isReadWrite ){
        int rc2, isRO = 0;
                                  ;
        rc2 = winAccess(pVfs, zName,2                  , &isRO);
                                ;
        if( rc2==0         && isRO ) break;
      }
    }while( winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) );

    do{
      h =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,DWORD,DWORD, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES,DWORD,DWORD,HANDLE))aSyscall[5].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,
                        dwDesiredAccess,
                        dwShareMode, NULL,
                        dwCreationDisposition,
                        dwFlagsAndAttributes,
                        NULL);
      if( h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) break;
      if( isReadWrite ){
        int rc2, isRO = 0;
                                  ;
        rc2 = winAccess(pVfs, zName,2                  , &isRO);
                                ;
        if( rc2==0         && isRO ) break;
      }
    }while( winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) );

  }

  else{
    do{
      h =((HANDLE(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR,DWORD,DWORD, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES,DWORD,DWORD,HANDLE))aSyscall[4].pCurrent)((LPCSTR)zConverted,
                        dwDesiredAccess,
                        dwShareMode, NULL,
                        dwCreationDisposition,
                        dwFlagsAndAttributes,
                        NULL);
      if( h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) break;
      if( isReadWrite ){
        int rc2, isRO = 0;
                                  ;
        rc2 = winAccess(pVfs, zName,2                  , &isRO);
                                ;
        if( rc2==0         && isRO ) break;
      }
    }while( winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) );
  }

  winLogIoerr(cnt, __LINE__);

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN file=%p, name=%s, access=%lx, rc=%s\n", h, zUtf8Name, 
dwDesiredAccess, (h==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ? "failed" : "ok")            ;

  if( h==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ){
    sqlite3_free(zConverted);
    sqlite3_free(zTmpname);
    if( isReadWrite && !isExclusive ){
      return winOpen(pVfs, zName, id,
         ((flags|0x00000001          ) &
                     ~(0x00000004        |0x00000002           )),
         pOutFlags);
    }else{
      pFile->lastErrno = lastErrno;
winLogErrorAtLine(14,pFile->lastErrno,"winOpen",zUtf8Name,__LINE__)       ;
      return sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
    }
  }

  if( pOutFlags ){
    if( isReadWrite ){
      *pOutFlags =0x00000002            ;
    }else{
      *pOutFlags =0x00000001           ;
    }
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN file=%p, name=%s, access=%lx, pOutFlags=%p, *pOutFlags=%d, " 
"rc=%s\n", h, zUtf8Name, dwDesiredAccess, pOutFlags, pOutFlags ? 
*pOutFlags : 0, (h==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ? "failed" : "ok")            ;

  pAppData = (winVfsAppData*)pVfs->pAppData;


  {
    if( isReadWrite && eType==0x00000100
         && ((pAppData==NULL) || !pAppData->bNoLock)
         && (rc = winceCreateLock(zName, pFile))!=0
    ){
((BOOL(WINAPI*)(HANDLE))aSyscall[3].pCurrent)(h);
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      sqlite3_free(zTmpname);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("OPEN-CE-LOCK name=%s, rc=%s\n", zName, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
      return rc;
    }
  }
  if( isTemp ){
    pFile->zDeleteOnClose = zConverted;
  }else

  {
    sqlite3_free(zConverted);
  }

  sqlite3_free(zTmpname);
  id->pMethods = pAppData ? pAppData->pMethod : &winIoMethod;
  pFile->pVfs = pVfs;
  pFile->h = h;
  if( isReadonly ){
    pFile->ctrlFlags |=0x02           ;
  }
  if( (flags &0x00000100          )
   && sqlite3_uri_boolean(zName, "psow",1                          )
  ){
    pFile->ctrlFlags |=0x10         ;
  }
  pFile->lastErrno = NO_ERROR;
  pFile->zPath = zName;

  pFile->hMap = NULL;
  pFile->pMapRegion = 0;
  pFile->mmapSize = 0;
  pFile->mmapSizeMax =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szMmap;


sqlite3_open_file_count+=(+1);
  return rc;
}













static int winDelete(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zFilename,
  int syncDir
){
  int cnt = 0;
  int rc;
  DWORD attr;
  DWORD lastErrno = 0;
  void *zConverted;
(void)(pVfs)            ;
(void)(syncDir)            ;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (10<<8)); };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DELETE name=%s, syncDir=%d\n", zFilename, syncDir);

  zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zFilename);
  if( zConverted==0 ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DELETE name=%s, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n", zFilename);
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  if((1)       ){
    do {

      WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA sAttrData;
      memset(&sAttrData, 0, sizeof(sAttrData));
      if (((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,GET_FILEEX_INFO_LEVELS, LPVOID))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)(zConverted,GetFileExInfoStandard,
                                  &sAttrData) ){
        attr = sAttrData.dwFileAttributes;
      }else{
        lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
        if( lastErrno==ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
         || lastErrno==ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND ){
          rc =(10 | (23<<8))            ;
        }else{
          rc =1            ;
        }
        break;
      }

      attr =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR))aSyscall[21].pCurrent)(zConverted);

      if ( attr==((DWORD)-1)             ){
        lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
        if( lastErrno==ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
         || lastErrno==ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND ){
          rc =(10 | (23<<8))            ;
        }else{
          rc =1            ;
        }
        break;
      }
      if ( attr&FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY ){
        rc =1            ;
        break;
      }
      if (((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR))aSyscall[10].pCurrent)(zConverted)){
        rc =0         ;
        break;
      }
      if ( !winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) ){
        rc =1            ;
        break;
      }
    } while(1);
  }

  else{
    do {
      attr =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR))aSyscall[20].pCurrent)(zConverted);
      if ( attr==((DWORD)-1)             ){
        lastErrno =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
        if( lastErrno==ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
         || lastErrno==ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND ){
          rc =(10 | (23<<8))            ;
        }else{
          rc =1            ;
        }
        break;
      }
      if ( attr&FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY ){
        rc =1            ;
        break;
      }
      if (((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR))aSyscall[9].pCurrent)(zConverted)){
        rc =0         ;
        break;
      }
      if ( !winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) ){
        rc =1            ;
        break;
      }
    } while(1);
  }

  if( rc && rc!=(10 | (23<<8))            ){
    rc =winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (10<<8)),lastErrno,"winDelete",zFilename,__LINE__);
  }else{
    winLogIoerr(cnt, __LINE__);
  }
  sqlite3_free(zConverted);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DELETE name=%s, rc=%s\n", zFilename, sqlite3ErrName(rc));
  return rc;
}




static int winAccess(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zFilename,
  int flags,
  int *pResOut
){
  DWORD attr;
  int rc = 0;
  DWORD lastErrno = 0;
  void *zConverted;
(void)(pVfs)            ;

if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return (10 | (13<<8));; };
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("ACCESS name=%s, flags=%x, pResOut=%p\n", 
zFilename, flags, pResOut)            ;

  zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zFilename);
  if( zConverted==0 ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("ACCESS name=%s, rc=SQLITE_IOERR_NOMEM\n", zFilename);
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  if((1)       ){
    int cnt = 0;
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA sAttrData;
    memset(&sAttrData, 0, sizeof(sAttrData));
    while( !(rc =((BOOL(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,GET_FILEEX_INFO_LEVELS, LPVOID))aSyscall[22].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,
                             GetFileExInfoStandard,
                             &sAttrData)) && winRetryIoerr(&cnt, &lastErrno) ){}
    if( rc ){



      if(    flags==0
          && sAttrData.nFileSizeHigh==0
          && sAttrData.nFileSizeLow==0 ){
        attr =((DWORD)-1)             ;
      }else{
        attr = sAttrData.dwFileAttributes;
      }
    }else{
      winLogIoerr(cnt, __LINE__);
      if( lastErrno!=ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND && lastErrno!=ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND ){
        sqlite3_free(zConverted);
        return winLogErrorAtLine((10 | (13<<8)),lastErrno,"winAccess",
zFilename,__LINE__)                  ;
      }else{
        attr =((DWORD)-1)             ;
      }
    }
  }

  else{
    attr =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR))aSyscall[20].pCurrent)((char*)zConverted);
  }

  sqlite3_free(zConverted);
  switch( flags ){
    case 2                 :
    case 0                   :
      rc = attr!=((DWORD)-1)            ;
      break;
    case 1                      :
      rc = attr!=((DWORD)-1)             &&
             (attr & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY)==0;
      break;
    default:
      assert(!"Invalid flags argument");
  }
  *pResOut = rc;
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("ACCESS name=%s, pResOut=%p, *pResOut=%d, rc=SQLITE_OK\n", 
zFilename, pResOut, *pResOut)            ;
  return 0        ;
}





static BOOL winIsLongPathPrefix(
  const char *zPathname
){
  return ( zPathname[0]=='\\' && zPathname[1]=='\\'
        && zPathname[2]=='?'  && zPathname[3]=='\\' );
}





static BOOL winIsDriveLetterAndColon(
  const char *zPathname
){
  return ((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(zPathname[0])]&0x02)&&zPathname[1]==':');
}







static BOOL winIsVerbatimPathname(
  const char *zPathname
){







  if ((((zPathname[0]) == '/') || ((zPathname[0]) == '\\'))){
    return TRUE;
  }







  if ( winIsDriveLetterAndColon(zPathname) ){
    return TRUE;
  }





  return FALSE;
}






static int winFullPathnameNoMutex(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zRelative,
  int nFull,
  char *zFull
){

  DWORD nByte;
  void *zConverted;
  char *zOut;





  if( zRelative[0]=='/' && (winIsDriveLetterAndColon(zRelative+1)
       || winIsLongPathPrefix(zRelative+1)) ){
    zRelative++;
  }


if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return 1; };
(void)(nFull)            ;
  assert( nFull>=pVfs->mxPathname );
  if ( sqlite3_data_directory && !winIsVerbatimPathname(zRelative) ){






    char *zOut = sqlite3MallocZero( pVfs->mxPathname+1 );
    if( !zOut ){
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    if( cygwin_conv_path(
            ((1)      ? CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_W : CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_A) |
            CCP_RELATIVE, zRelative, zOut, pVfs->mxPathname+1)<0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zOut);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (4<<8)),(DWORD)errno,
"winFullPathname1",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }else{
      char *zUtf8 = winConvertToUtf8Filename(zOut);
      if( !zUtf8 ){
        sqlite3_free(zOut);
        return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
      }
      sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s%c%s",
                       sqlite3_data_directory,'\\'           , zUtf8);
      sqlite3_free(zUtf8);
      sqlite3_free(zOut);
    }
  }else{
    char *zOut = sqlite3MallocZero( pVfs->mxPathname+1 );
    if( !zOut ){
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    if( cygwin_conv_path(
            ((1)      ? CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_W : CCP_POSIX_TO_WIN_A),
            zRelative, zOut, pVfs->mxPathname+1)<0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zOut);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (4<<8)),(DWORD)errno,
"winFullPathname2",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }else{
      char *zUtf8 = winConvertToUtf8Filename(zOut);
      if( !zUtf8 ){
        sqlite3_free(zOut);
        return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
      }
      sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s",zUtf8);
      sqlite3_free(zUtf8);
      sqlite3_free(zOut);
    }
  }
  return 0        ;



if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return 1; };


  if ( sqlite3_data_directory && !winIsVerbatimPathname(zRelative) ){






    sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s%c%s",
                     sqlite3_data_directory,'\\'           , zRelative);
  }else{
    sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s",zRelative);
  }
  return 0        ;








if( (sqlite3_io_error_persist && sqlite3_io_error_hit) || sqlite3_io_error_pending-- == 1 ) { local_ioerr(); return 1; };
  if ( sqlite3_data_directory && !winIsVerbatimPathname(zRelative) ){






    sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s%c%s",
                     sqlite3_data_directory,'\\'           , zRelative);
    return 0        ;
  }
  zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zRelative);
  if( zConverted==0 ){
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  if((1)       ){
    LPWSTR zTemp;
    nByte =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,DWORD,LPWSTR, LPWSTR*))aSyscall[25].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,0,0,0);
    if( nByte==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (3<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winFullPathname1",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    nByte += 3;
    zTemp = sqlite3MallocZero( nByte*sizeof(zTemp[0]) );
    if( zTemp==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    nByte =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR,DWORD,LPWSTR, LPWSTR*))aSyscall[25].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,nByte,zTemp,0);
    if( nByte==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      sqlite3_free(zTemp);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (3<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winFullPathname2",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    sqlite3_free(zConverted);
    zOut = winUnicodeToUtf8(zTemp);
    sqlite3_free(zTemp);
  }

  else{
    char *zTemp;
    nByte =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR,DWORD,LPSTR, LPSTR*))aSyscall[24].pCurrent)((char*)zConverted,0,0,0);
    if( nByte==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (3<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winFullPathname3",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    nByte += 3;
    zTemp = sqlite3MallocZero( nByte*sizeof(zTemp[0]) );
    if( zTemp==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    nByte =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR,DWORD,LPSTR, LPSTR*))aSyscall[24].pCurrent)((char*)zConverted,nByte,zTemp,0);
    if( nByte==0 ){
      sqlite3_free(zConverted);
      sqlite3_free(zTemp);
      return winLogErrorAtLine((14 | (3<<8)),((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)(),
"winFullPathname4",zRelative,__LINE__)                 ;
    }
    sqlite3_free(zConverted);
    zOut = winMbcsToUtf8(zTemp,1                   );
    sqlite3_free(zTemp);
  }

  if( zOut ){
    sqlite3_snprintf(((nFull)<(pVfs->mxPathname)?(nFull):(pVfs->mxPathname)),zFull,"%s",zOut);
    sqlite3_free(zOut);
    return 0        ;
  }else{
    return sqlite3IoerrnomemError(__LINE__);
  }

}
static int winFullPathname(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zRelative,
  int nFull,
  char *zFull
){
  int rc;


                             ;
  rc = winFullPathnameNoMutex(pVfs, zRelative, nFull, zFull);
                             ;
  return rc;
}






static void *winDlOpen(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, const char *zFilename){
  HANDLE h;

  int nFull = pVfs->mxPathname+1;
  char *zFull = sqlite3MallocZero( nFull );
  void *zConverted = 0;
  if( zFull==0 ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DLOPEN name=%s, handle=%p\n", zFilename, (void*)0);
    return 0;
  }
  if( winFullPathname(pVfs, zFilename, nFull, zFull)!=0         ){
    sqlite3_free(zFull);
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DLOPEN name=%s, handle=%p\n", zFilename, (void*)0);
    return 0;
  }
  zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zFull);
  sqlite3_free(zFull);

  void *zConverted = winConvertFromUtf8Filename(zFilename);
(void)(pVfs)            ;

  if( zConverted==0 ){
if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DLOPEN name=%s, handle=%p\n", zFilename, (void*)0);
    return 0;
  }
  if((1)       ){

    h =((HMODULE(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR, DWORD))aSyscall[69].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted,0);

    h =((HMODULE(WINAPI*)(LPCWSTR))aSyscall[45].pCurrent)((LPCWSTR)zConverted);

  }

  else{
    h =((HMODULE(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR))aSyscall[44].pCurrent)((char*)zConverted);
  }

if( sqlite3OSTrace ) sqlite3DebugPrintf ("DLOPEN name=%s, handle=%p\n", zFilename, (void*)h);
  sqlite3_free(zConverted);
  return (void*)h;
}

typedef struct EntropyGatherer EntropyGatherer;
struct EntropyGatherer {
  unsigned char *a;
  int na;
  int i;
  int nXor;
};



static void xorMemory(EntropyGatherer *p, unsigned char *x, int sz){
  int j, k;
  for(j=0, k=p->i; j<sz; j++){
    p->a[k++] ^= x[j];
    if( k>=p->na ) k = 0;
  }
  p->i = k;
  p->nXor += sz;
}





static int winRandomness(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, int nBuf, char *zBuf){

(void)(pVfs)            ;
  memset(zBuf, 0, nBuf);
  return nBuf;

  EntropyGatherer e;
(void)(pVfs)            ;
  memset(zBuf, 0, nBuf);
  e.a = (unsigned char*)zBuf;
  e.na = nBuf;
  e.nXor = 0;
  e.i = 0;
  {
    SYSTEMTIME x;
((VOID(WINAPI*)(LPSYSTEMTIME))aSyscall[29].pCurrent)(&x);
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&x, sizeof(SYSTEMTIME));
  }
  {
    DWORD pid =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[17].pCurrent)();
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&pid, sizeof(DWORD));
  }

  {
    ULONGLONG cnt =((ULONGLONG(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[70].pCurrent)();
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&cnt, sizeof(ULONGLONG));
  }

  {
    DWORD cnt =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[33].pCurrent)();
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&cnt, sizeof(DWORD));
  }

  {
    LARGE_INTEGER i;
((BOOL(WINAPI*)( LARGE_INTEGER*))aSyscall[51].pCurrent)(&i);
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&i, sizeof(LARGE_INTEGER));
  }

  {
    UUID id;
    memset(&id, 0, sizeof(UUID));
((RPC_STATUS(RPC_ENTRY*)(UUID*))aSyscall[77].pCurrent)(&id);
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&id, sizeof(UUID));
    memset(&id, 0, sizeof(UUID));
((RPC_STATUS(RPC_ENTRY*)(UUID*))aSyscall[78].pCurrent)(&id);
    xorMemory(&e, (unsigned char*)&id, sizeof(UUID));
  }

  return e.nXor>nBuf ? nBuf : e.nXor;

}





static int winSleep(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, int microsec){
  sqlite3_win32_sleep((microsec+999)/1000);
(void)(pVfs)            ;
  return ((microsec+999)/1000)*1000;
}







           int sqlite3_current_time = 0;












static int winCurrentTimeInt64(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, sqlite3_int64 *piNow){



  FILETIME ft;
  static const sqlite3_int64 winFiletimeEpoch = 23058135*(sqlite3_int64)8640000;

  static const sqlite3_int64 unixEpoch = 24405875*(sqlite3_int64)8640000;


  static const sqlite3_int64 max32BitValue =
      (sqlite3_int64)2000000000 + (sqlite3_int64)2000000000 +
      (sqlite3_int64)294967296;


  SYSTEMTIME time;
((VOID(WINAPI*)(LPSYSTEMTIME))aSyscall[29].pCurrent)(&time);

  if (!((BOOL(WINAPI*)(CONST SYSTEMTIME*, LPFILETIME))aSyscall[56].pCurrent)(&time,&ft)){
    return 1           ;
  }

((VOID(WINAPI*)( LPFILETIME))aSyscall[30].pCurrent)(&ft);


  *piNow = winFiletimeEpoch +
            ((((sqlite3_int64)ft.dwHighDateTime)*max32BitValue) +
               (sqlite3_int64)ft.dwLowDateTime)/(sqlite3_int64)10000;


  if( sqlite3_current_time ){
    *piNow = 1000*(sqlite3_int64)sqlite3_current_time + unixEpoch;
  }

(void)(pVfs)            ;
  return 0        ;
}






static int winCurrentTime(sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,sqlite_int64*prNow){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_int64 i;
  rc = winCurrentTimeInt64(pVfs, &i);
  if( !rc ){
    *prNow = i/86400000.0;
  }
  return rc;
}

  DWORD e =((DWORD(WINAPI*)(VOID))aSyscall[26].pCurrent)();
(void)(pVfs)            ;
  if( nBuf>0 ) winGetLastErrorMsg(e, nBuf, zBuf);
  return e;
}

    winDelete,

    winFullPathname,
0            ,
0             ,
0           ,
0             ,

static int memdbClose(sqlite3_file *pFile){
  MemStore *p = ((MemFile*)pFile)->pStore;
  if( p->zFName ){
    int i;

    sqlite3_mutex *pVfsMutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                         ;

                                  ;
    for(i=0;(1)                         ; i++){
      if( memdb_g.apMemStore[i]==p ){
        memdbEnter(p);
        if( p->nRef==1 ){
          memdb_g.apMemStore[i] = memdb_g.apMemStore[--memdb_g.nMemStore];
          if( memdb_g.nMemStore==0 ){
            sqlite3_free(memdb_g.apMemStore);
            memdb_g.apMemStore = 0;
          }
        }
        break;
      }
    }
                                  ;
  }else{
    memdbEnter(p);
  }
  p->nRef--;
  if( p->nRef<=0 ){
    if( p->mFlags &1                               ){
      sqlite3_free(p->aData);
    }
    memdbLeave(p);
                                 ;
    sqlite3_free(p);
  }else{
    memdbLeave(p);
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static int memdbEnlarge(MemStore *p, sqlite3_int64 newSz){
  unsigned char *pNew;
  if( (p->mFlags &2                             )==0 ||(0)                ){
    return 13         ;
  }
  if( newSz>p->szMax ){
    return 13         ;
  }
  newSz *= 2;
  if( newSz>p->szMax ) newSz = p->szMax;
  pNew = sqlite3Realloc(p->aData, newSz);
  if( pNew==0 ) return(10 | (12<<8))     ;
  p->aData = pNew;
  p->szAlloc = newSz;
  return 0        ;
}

     && (rc = memdbEnlarge(p, iOfst+iAmt))!=0

static int memdbLock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int eLock){
  MemFile *pThis = (MemFile*)pFile;
  MemStore *p = pThis->pStore;
  int rc =0         ;
  if( eLock<=pThis->eLock ) return 0        ;
  memdbEnter(p);

  assert( p->nWrLock==0 || p->nWrLock==1 );
  assert( pThis->eLock<=1                  || p->nWrLock==1 );
  assert( pThis->eLock==0                || p->nRdLock>=1 );

  if( eLock>1                  && (p->mFlags &4                           ) ){
    rc =8               ;
  }else{
    switch( eLock ){
      case 1                 : {
        assert( pThis->eLock==0                );
        if( p->nWrLock>0 ){
          rc =5           ;
        }else{
          p->nRdLock++;
        }
        break;
      };

      case 2                   :
      case 3                  : {
        assert( pThis->eLock>=1                  );
        if((1)                                       ){
          if( p->nWrLock>0 ){
            rc =5           ;
          }else{
            p->nWrLock = 1;
          }
        }
        break;
      }

      default: {
        assert(  eLock==4                     );
        assert( pThis->eLock>=1                  );
        if( p->nRdLock>1 ){
          rc =5           ;
        }else if( pThis->eLock==1                  ){
          p->nWrLock = 1;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         ) pThis->eLock = eLock;
  memdbLeave(p);
  return rc;
}




static int memdbUnlock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int eLock){
  MemFile *pThis = (MemFile*)pFile;
  MemStore *p = pThis->pStore;
  if( eLock>=pThis->eLock ) return 0        ;
  memdbEnter(p);

  assert( eLock==1                  || eLock==0                );
  if( eLock==1                  ){
    if((1)                                      ){
      p->nWrLock--;
    }
  }else{
    if( pThis->eLock>1                  ){
      p->nWrLock--;
    }
    p->nRdLock--;
  }

  pThis->eLock = eLock;
  memdbLeave(p);
  return 0        ;
}

  *pResOut = 0;
  return 0        ;
}






static int memdbFileControl(sqlite3_file *pFile, int op, void *pArg){
  MemStore *p = ((MemFile*)pFile)->pStore;
  int rc =12              ;
  memdbEnter(p);
  if( op==12                   ){
    *(char**)pArg = sqlite3_mprintf("memdb(%p,%lld)", p->aData, p->sz);
    rc =0         ;
  }
  if( op==36                      ){
    sqlite3_int64 iLimit = *(sqlite3_int64*)pArg;
    if( iLimit<p->sz ){
      if( iLimit<0 ){
        iLimit = p->szMax;
      }else{
        iLimit = p->sz;
      }
    }
    p->szMax = iLimit;
    *(sqlite3_int64*)pArg = iLimit;
    rc =0         ;
  }
  memdbLeave(p);
  return rc;
}

static int memdbFetch(
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  sqlite3_int64 iOfst,
  int iAmt,
  void **pp
){
  MemStore *p = ((MemFile*)pFile)->pStore;
  memdbEnter(p);
  if( iOfst+iAmt>p->sz || (p->mFlags &2                             )!=0 ){
    *pp = 0;
  }else{
    p->nMmap++;
    *pp = (void*)(p->aData + iOfst);
  }
  memdbLeave(p);
  return 0        ;
}

}




static int memdbOpen(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zName,
  sqlite3_file *pFd,
  int flags,
  int *pOutFlags
){
  MemFile *pFile = (MemFile*)pFd;
  MemStore *p = 0;
  int szName;
(void)(pVfs)            ;

  memset(pFile, 0, sizeof(*pFile));
  szName = sqlite3Strlen30(zName);
  if( szName>1 && (zName[0]=='/' || zName[0]=='\\') ){
    int i;

    sqlite3_mutex *pVfsMutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                         ;

                                  ;
    for(i=0; i<memdb_g.nMemStore; i++){
      if( strcmp(memdb_g.apMemStore[i]->zFName,zName)==0 ){
        p = memdb_g.apMemStore[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    if( p==0 ){
      MemStore **apNew;
      p = sqlite3Malloc( sizeof(*p) + szName + 3 );
      if( p==0 ){
                                      ;
        return 7           ;
      }
      apNew = sqlite3Realloc(memdb_g.apMemStore,
                             sizeof(apNew[0])*(memdb_g.nMemStore+1) );
      if( apNew==0 ){
        sqlite3_free(p);
                                      ;
        return 7           ;
      }
      apNew[memdb_g.nMemStore++] = p;
      memdb_g.apMemStore = apNew;
      memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
      p->mFlags =2                             |1                             ;
      p->szMax =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMemdbSize;
      p->zFName = (char*)&p[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zFName);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zName); int xxn=(szName+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      p->pMutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                    ;
      if( p->pMutex==0 ){
        memdb_g.nMemStore--;
        sqlite3_free(p);
                                      ;
        return 7           ;
      }
      p->nRef = 1;
      memdbEnter(p);
    }else{
      memdbEnter(p);
      p->nRef++;
    }
                                  ;
  }else{
    p = sqlite3Malloc( sizeof(*p) );
    if( p==0 ){
      return 7           ;
    }
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
    p->mFlags =2                              |1                              ;
    p->szMax =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMemdbSize;
  }
  pFile->pStore = p;
  if( pOutFlags!=0 ){
    *pOutFlags = flags |0x00000080         ;
  }
  pFd->pMethods = &memdb_io_methods;
  memdbLeave(p);
  return 0        ;
}
