static MemFile *memdbFromDbSchema(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSchema){
  MemFile *p = 0;
  MemStore *pStore;
  int rc = sqlite3_file_control(db, zSchema,7                         , &p);
  if( rc ) return 0;
  if( p->base.pMethods!=&memdb_io_methods ) return 0;
  pStore = p->pStore;
  memdbEnter(pStore);
  if( pStore->zFName!=0 ) p = 0;
  memdbLeave(pStore);
  return p;
}




           unsigned char *sqlite3_serialize(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zSchema,
  sqlite3_int64 *piSize,
  unsigned int mFlags
){
  MemFile *p;
  int iDb;
  Btree *pBt;
  sqlite3_int64 sz;
  int szPage = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  unsigned char *pOut;
  char *zSql;
  int rc;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }


  if( zSchema==0 ) zSchema = db->aDb[0].zDbSName;
  p = memdbFromDbSchema(db, zSchema);
  iDb = sqlite3FindDbName(db, zSchema);
  if( piSize ) *piSize = -1;
  if( iDb<0 ) return 0;
  if( p ){
    MemStore *pStore = p->pStore;
    assert( pStore->pMutex==0 );
    if( piSize ) *piSize = pStore->sz;
    if( mFlags &0x001                    ){
      pOut = pStore->aData;
    }else{
      pOut = sqlite3_malloc64( pStore->sz );
      if( pOut ){char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pStore->aData); int xxn=(pStore->sz);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }
    return pOut;
  }
  pBt = db->aDb[iDb].pBt;
  if( pBt==0 ) return 0;
  szPage = sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(pBt);
  zSql = sqlite3_mprintf("PRAGMA \"%w\".page_count", zSchema);
  rc = zSql ? sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, zSql, -1, &pStmt, 0) :7            ;
  sqlite3_free(zSql);
  if( rc ) return 0;
  rc = sqlite3_step(pStmt);
  if( rc!=100        ){
    pOut = 0;
  }else{
    sz = sqlite3_column_int64(pStmt, 0)*szPage;
    if( piSize ) *piSize = sz;
    if( mFlags &0x001                    ){
      pOut = 0;
    }else{
      pOut = sqlite3_malloc64( sz );
      if( pOut ){
        int nPage = sqlite3_column_int(pStmt, 0);
        Pager *pPager = sqlite3BtreePager(pBt);
        int pgno;
        for(pgno=1; pgno<=nPage; pgno++){
          DbPage *pPage = 0;
          unsigned char *pTo = pOut + szPage*(sqlite3_int64)(pgno-1);
          rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pPager, pgno, (DbPage**)&pPage, 0);
          if( rc==0         ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pTo);const char*xxs=(const char*)(sqlite3PagerGetData(pPage)); int xxn=(szPage);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          }else{
            memset(pTo, 0, szPage);
          }
          sqlite3PagerUnref(pPage);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  sqlite3_finalize(pStmt);
  return pOut;
}



           int sqlite3_deserialize(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zSchema,
  unsigned char *pData,
  sqlite3_int64 szDb,
  sqlite3_int64 szBuf,
  unsigned mFlags
){
  MemFile *p;
  char *zSql;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  int rc;
  int iDb;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
  if( szDb<0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  if( szBuf<0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);


                                ;
  if( zSchema==0 ) zSchema = db->aDb[0].zDbSName;
  iDb = sqlite3FindDbName(db, zSchema);
if( iDb==1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( iDb<2 && iDb!=0 ){
    rc =1            ;
    goto end_deserialize;
  }
  zSql = sqlite3_mprintf("ATTACH x AS %Q", zSchema);
  if( zSql==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, zSql, -1, &pStmt, 0);
    sqlite3_free(zSql);
  }
  if( rc ) goto end_deserialize;
  db->init.iDb = (u8)iDb;
  db->init.reopenMemdb = 1;
  rc = sqlite3_step(pStmt);
  db->init.reopenMemdb = 0;
  if( rc!=101         ){
    rc =1            ;
    goto end_deserialize;
  }
  p = memdbFromDbSchema(db, zSchema);
  if( p==0 ){
    rc =1            ;
  }else{
    MemStore *pStore = p->pStore;
    pStore->aData = pData;
    pData = 0;
    pStore->sz = szDb;
    pStore->szAlloc = szBuf;
    pStore->szMax = szBuf;
    if( pStore->szMax<(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMemdbSize){
      pStore->szMax =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMemdbSize;
    }
    pStore->mFlags = mFlags;
    rc =0         ;
  }

end_deserialize:
  sqlite3_finalize(pStmt);
  if( pData && (mFlags &1                              )!=0 ){
    sqlite3_free(pData);
  }
                                ;
  return rc;
}




static         int 0                                      {
  return pVfs==&memdb_vfs;
}





static         int sqlite3MemdbInit(void){
  sqlite3_vfs *pLower = sqlite3_vfs_find(0);
  unsigned int sz;
  if((0)               ) return 1           ;
  sz = pLower->szOsFile;
  memdb_vfs.pAppData = pLower;




  if( sz<sizeof(MemFile) ) sz = sizeof(MemFile);
  memdb_vfs.szOsFile = sz;
  return sqlite3_vfs_register(&memdb_vfs, 0);
}

































































































struct Bitvec {
  u32 iSize;
  u32 nSet;


  u32 iDivisor;



  union {
u8               aBitmap[((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u8))];
    u32 aHash[((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32))];
    Bitvec *apSub[((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(Bitvec *))];
  } u;
};






static         Bitvec *sqlite3BitvecCreate(u32 iSize){
  Bitvec *p;
  assert( sizeof(*p)==512       );
  p = sqlite3MallocZero( sizeof(*p) );
  if( p ){
    p->iSize = iSize;
  }
  return p;
}






static         int sqlite3BitvecTestNotNull(Bitvec *p, u32 i){
  assert( p!=0 );
  i--;
  if( i>=p->iSize ) return 0;
  while( p->iDivisor ){
    u32 bin = i/p->iDivisor;
    i = i%p->iDivisor;
    p = p->u.apSub[bin];
    if (!p) {
      return 0;
    }
  }
  if( p->iSize<=(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u8))*8)){
    return (p->u.aBitmap[i/8            ] & (1<<(i&(8            -1))))!=0;
  } else{
    u32 h =(((i++)*1)%((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32)));
    while( p->u.aHash[h] ){
      if( p->u.aHash[h]==i ) return 1;
      h = (h+1) %((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32));
    }
    return 0;
  }
}
static         int sqlite3BitvecTest(Bitvec *p, u32 i){
  return p!=0 && sqlite3BitvecTestNotNull(p,i);
}













static         int sqlite3BitvecSet(Bitvec *p, u32 i){
  u32 h;
  if( p==0 ) return 0        ;
  assert( i>0 );
  assert( i<=p->iSize );
  i--;
  while((p->iSize >(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u8))*8))&&p->iDivisor){
    u32 bin = i/p->iDivisor;
    i = i%p->iDivisor;
    if( p->u.apSub[bin]==0 ){
      p->u.apSub[bin] = sqlite3BitvecCreate( p->iDivisor );
      if( p->u.apSub[bin]==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    p = p->u.apSub[bin];
  }
  if( p->iSize<=(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u8))*8)){
    p->u.aBitmap[i/8            ] |= 1 << (i&(8            -1));
    return 0        ;
  }
  h =(((i++)*1)%((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32)));



  if( !p->u.aHash[h] ){
    if (p->nSet<(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32))-1)){
      goto bitvec_set_end;
    } else {
      goto bitvec_set_rehash;
    }
  }


  do {
    if( p->u.aHash[h]==i ) return 0        ;
    h++;
    if( h>=((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32)))h=0;
  } while( p->u.aHash[h] );



bitvec_set_rehash:
  if( p->nSet>=(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32))/2)){
    unsigned int j;
    int rc;
    u32 *aiValues =alloca(sizeof(p->u.aHash))                  ;
    if( aiValues==0 ){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(aiValues);const char*xxs=(const char*)(p->u.aHash); int xxn=(sizeof(p->u.aHash));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      memset(p->u.apSub, 0, sizeof(p->u.apSub));
      p->iDivisor = (p->iSize +((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(Bitvec *))-1)/((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(Bitvec *));
      rc = sqlite3BitvecSet(p, i);
      for(j=0; j<((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32));j++){
        if( aiValues[j] ) rc |= sqlite3BitvecSet(p, aiValues[j]);
      }
                                   ;
      return rc;
    }
  }
bitvec_set_end:
  p->nSet++;
  p->u.aHash[h] = i;
  return 0        ;
}







static         void sqlite3BitvecClear(Bitvec *p, u32 i, void *pBuf){
  if( p==0 ) return;
  assert( i>0 );
  i--;
  while( p->iDivisor ){
    u32 bin = i/p->iDivisor;
    i = i%p->iDivisor;
    p = p->u.apSub[bin];
    if (!p) {
      return;
    }
  }
  if( p->iSize<=(((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u8))*8)){
    p->u.aBitmap[i/8            ] &= ~(1 << (i&(8            -1)));
  }else{
    unsigned int j;
    u32 *aiValues = pBuf;
{char*xxd=(char*)(aiValues);const char*xxs=(const char*)(p->u.aHash); int xxn=(sizeof(p->u.aHash));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    memset(p->u.aHash, 0, sizeof(p->u.aHash));
    p->nSet = 0;
    for(j=0; j<((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32));j++){
      if( aiValues[j] && aiValues[j]!=(i+1) ){
        u32 h =(((aiValues[j]-1)*1)%((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32)));
        p->nSet++;
        while( p->u.aHash[h] ){
          h++;
          if( h>=((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(u32)))h=0;
        }
        p->u.aHash[h] = aiValues[j];
      }
    }
  }
}




static         void sqlite3BitvecDestroy(Bitvec *p){
  if( p==0 ) return;
  if( p->iDivisor ){
    unsigned int i;
    for(i=0; i<((((512 -(3*sizeof(u32)))/sizeof(Bitvec*))*sizeof(Bitvec*))/sizeof(Bitvec *));i++){
      sqlite3BitvecDestroy(p->u.apSub[i]);
    }
  }
  sqlite3_free(p);
}





static         u32 sqlite3BitvecSize(Bitvec *p){
  return p->iSize;
}










































static         int sqlite3BitvecBuiltinTest(int sz, int *aOp){
  Bitvec *pBitvec = 0;
  unsigned char *pV = 0;
  int rc = -1;
  int i, nx, pc, op;
  void *pTmpSpace;



  pBitvec = sqlite3BitvecCreate( sz );
  pV = sqlite3MallocZero( (sz+7)/8 + 1 );
  pTmpSpace = sqlite3_malloc64(512      );
  if( pBitvec==0 || pV==0 || pTmpSpace==0  ) goto bitvec_end;


  sqlite3BitvecSet(0, 1);
  sqlite3BitvecClear(0, 1, pTmpSpace);


  pc = i = 0;
  while( (op = aOp[pc])!=0 ){
    switch( op ){
      case 1:
      case 2:
      case 5: {
        nx = 4;
        i = aOp[pc+2] - 1;
        aOp[pc+2] += aOp[pc+3];
        break;
      }
      case 3:
      case 4:
      default: {
        nx = 2;
        sqlite3_randomness(sizeof(i), &i);
        break;
      }
    }
    if( (--aOp[pc+1]) > 0 ) nx = 0;
    pc += nx;
    i = (i & 0x7fffffff)%sz;
    if( (op & 1)!=0 ){
pV[(i+1)>>3] |= (1<<((i+1)&7));
      if( op!=5 ){
        if( sqlite3BitvecSet(pBitvec, i+1) ) goto bitvec_end;
      }
    }else{
pV[(i+1)>>3] &= ~(1<<((i+1)&7));
      sqlite3BitvecClear(pBitvec, i+1, pTmpSpace);
    }
  }






  rc = sqlite3BitvecTest(0,0) + sqlite3BitvecTest(pBitvec, sz+1)
          + sqlite3BitvecTest(pBitvec, 0)
          + (sqlite3BitvecSize(pBitvec) - sz);
  for(i=1; i<=sz; i++){
    if(  ((pV[i>>3]&(1<<(i&7)))!=0)!=sqlite3BitvecTest(pBitvec,i)){
      rc = i;
      break;
    }
  }


bitvec_end:
  sqlite3_free(pTmpSpace);
  sqlite3_free(pV);
  sqlite3BitvecDestroy(pBitvec);
  return rc;
}












































struct PCache {
  PgHdr *pDirty, *pDirtyTail;
  PgHdr *pSynced;
  i64 nRefSum;
  int szCache;
  int szSpill;
  int szPage;
  int szExtra;
  u8 bPurgeable;
  u8 eCreate;
  int (*xStress)(void*,PgHdr*);
  void *pStress;
  sqlite3_pcache *pCache;
};











  int sqlite3PcacheTrace = 2;
  int sqlite3PcacheMxDump = 9999;

  static void pcachePageTrace(int i, sqlite3_pcache_page *pLower){
    PgHdr *pPg;
    unsigned char *a;
    int j;
    pPg = (PgHdr*)pLower->pExtra;
    printf("%3lld: nRef %2d flgs %02x data ", i, pPg->nRef, pPg->flags);
    a = (unsigned char *)pLower->pBuf;
    for(j=0; j<12; j++) printf("%02x", a[j]);
    printf(" ptr %p\n", pPg);
  }
  static void pcacheDump(PCache *pCache){
    int N;
    int i;
    sqlite3_pcache_page *pLower;

    if( sqlite3PcacheTrace<2 ) return;
    if( pCache->pCache==0 ) return;
    N = sqlite3PcachePagecount(pCache);
    if( N>sqlite3PcacheMxDump ) N = sqlite3PcacheMxDump;
    for(i=1; i<=N; i++){
       pLower =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xFetch(pCache->pCache,i,0);
       if( pLower==0 ) continue;
       pcachePageTrace(i, pLower);
       if( ((PgHdr*)pLower)->pPage==0 ){
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xUnpin(pCache->pCache,pLower,0);
       }
    }
  }











static int pageOnDirtyList(PCache *pCache, PgHdr *pPg){
  PgHdr *p;
  for(p=pCache->pDirty; p; p=p->pDirtyNext){
    if( p==pPg ) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}












static         int sqlite3PcachePageSanity(PgHdr *pPg){
  PCache *pCache;
  assert( pPg!=0 );
  assert( pPg->pgno>0 || pPg->pPager==0 );
  pCache = pPg->pCache;
  assert( pCache!=0 );
  if( pPg->flags &0x001        ){
    assert( (pPg->flags &0x002       )==0 );
    assert( !pageOnDirtyList(pCache, pPg) );
  }else{
    assert( (pPg->flags &0x002       )!=0 );
    assert( pPg->pDirtyNext==0 || pPg->pDirtyNext->pDirtyPrev==pPg );
    assert( pPg->pDirtyPrev==0 || pPg->pDirtyPrev->pDirtyNext==pPg );
    assert( pPg->pDirtyPrev!=0 || pCache->pDirty==pPg );
    assert( pageOnDirtyList(pCache, pPg) );
  }

  if( pPg->flags &0x004            ){
    assert( pPg->flags &0x002        );
  }

















  return 1;
}
















static void pcacheManageDirtyList(PgHdr *pPage, u8 addRemove){
  PCache *p = pPage->pCache;

if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.DIRTYLIST.%s %d\n", p, 
addRemove==1 ? "REMOVE" : addRemove==2 ? "ADD" : "FRONT", 
pPage->pgno);}               ;
  if( addRemove &1                        ){
    assert( pPage->pDirtyNext || pPage==p->pDirtyTail );
    assert( pPage->pDirtyPrev || pPage==p->pDirty );


    if( p->pSynced==pPage ){
      p->pSynced = pPage->pDirtyPrev;
    }

    if( pPage->pDirtyNext ){
      pPage->pDirtyNext->pDirtyPrev = pPage->pDirtyPrev;
    }else{
      assert( pPage==p->pDirtyTail );
      p->pDirtyTail = pPage->pDirtyPrev;
    }
    if( pPage->pDirtyPrev ){
      pPage->pDirtyPrev->pDirtyNext = pPage->pDirtyNext;
    }else{




      assert( pPage==p->pDirty );
      p->pDirty = pPage->pDirtyNext;
      assert( p->bPurgeable || p->eCreate==2 );
      if( p->pDirty==0 ){
        assert( p->bPurgeable==0 || p->eCreate==1 );
        p->eCreate = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  if( addRemove &2                     ){
    pPage->pDirtyPrev = 0;
    pPage->pDirtyNext = p->pDirty;
    if( pPage->pDirtyNext ){
      assert( pPage->pDirtyNext->pDirtyPrev==0 );
      pPage->pDirtyNext->pDirtyPrev = pPage;
    }else{
      p->pDirtyTail = pPage;
      if( p->bPurgeable ){
        assert( p->eCreate==2 );
        p->eCreate = 1;
      }
    }
    p->pDirty = pPage;






    if( !p->pSynced
     && 0==(pPage->flags&0x008          )
    ){
      p->pSynced = pPage;
    }
  }
               ;
}





static void pcacheUnpin(PgHdr *p){
  if( p->pCache->bPurgeable ){
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.UNPIN %d\n", p->pCache, p->pgno);};
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xUnpin(p->pCache->pCache,p->pPage,0);
                         ;
  }
}





static int numberOfCachePages(PCache *p){
  if( p->szCache>=0 ){


    return p->szCache;
  }else{
    i64 n;




    n = ((-1024*(i64)p->szCache)/(p->szPage+p->szExtra));
    if( n>1000000000 ) n = 1000000000;
    return (int)n;
  }
}






static         int sqlite3PcacheInitialize(void){
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xInit==0){



    sqlite3PCacheSetDefault();
    assert((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xInit!=0);
  }
  return(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xInit((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.pArg);
}
static         void sqlite3PcacheShutdown(void){
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xShutdown){

(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xShutdown((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.pArg);
  }
}




static         int sqlite3PcacheSize(void){ return sizeof(PCache); }













static         int sqlite3PcacheOpen(
  int szPage,
  int szExtra,
  int bPurgeable,
  int (*xStress)(void*,PgHdr*),
  void *pStress,
  PCache *p
){
  memset(p, 0, sizeof(PCache));
  p->szPage = 1;
  p->szExtra = szExtra;
  assert( szExtra>=8 );
  p->bPurgeable = bPurgeable;
  p->eCreate = 2;
  p->xStress = xStress;
  p->pStress = pStress;
  p->szCache = 100;
  p->szSpill = 1;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.OPEN szPage %d bPurgeable %d\n",p,szPage,bPurgeable);};
  return sqlite3PcacheSetPageSize(p, szPage);
}





static         int sqlite3PcacheSetPageSize(PCache *pCache, int szPage){
  assert( pCache->nRefSum==0 && pCache->pDirty==0 );
  if( pCache->szPage ){
    sqlite3_pcache *pNew;
    pNew =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xCreate(
                szPage, pCache->szExtra +(((sizeof(PgHdr))+7)&~7),
                pCache->bPurgeable
    );
    if( pNew==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xCachesize(pNew,numberOfCachePages(pCache));
    if( pCache->pCache ){
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xDestroy(pCache->pCache);
    }
    pCache->pCache = pNew;
    pCache->szPage = szPage;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.PAGESIZE %d\n",pCache,szPage);};
  }
  return 0        ;
}

























static         sqlite3_pcache_page *sqlite3PcacheFetch(
  PCache *pCache,
  Pgno pgno,
  int createFlag
){
  int eCreate;
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pRes;

  assert( pCache!=0 );
  assert( pCache->pCache!=0 );
  assert( createFlag==3 || createFlag==0 );
  assert( pCache->eCreate==((pCache->bPurgeable && pCache->pDirty) ? 1 : 2) );








  eCreate = createFlag & pCache->eCreate;
  assert( eCreate==0 || eCreate==1 || eCreate==2 );
  assert( createFlag==0 || pCache->eCreate==eCreate );
  assert( createFlag==0 || eCreate==1 +(!pCache->bPurgeable||!pCache->pDirty));
  pRes =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xFetch(pCache->pCache,pgno,eCreate);
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.FETCH %d%s (result: %p) ",pCache,pgno, 
createFlag?" create":"",pRes);}              ;
                             ;
  return pRes;
}












static         int sqlite3PcacheFetchStress(
  PCache *pCache,
  Pgno pgno,
  sqlite3_pcache_page **ppPage
){
  PgHdr *pPg;
  if( pCache->eCreate==2 ) return 0;

  if( sqlite3PcachePagecount(pCache)>pCache->szSpill ){









    for(pPg=pCache->pSynced;
        pPg && (pPg->nRef || (pPg->flags&0x008          ));
        pPg=pPg->pDirtyPrev
    );
    pCache->pSynced = pPg;
    if( !pPg ){
      for(pPg=pCache->pDirtyTail; pPg && pPg->nRef; pPg=pPg->pDirtyPrev);
    }
    if( pPg ){
      int rc;

      sqlite3_log(13         ,
                  "spill page %d making room for %d - cache used: %d/%d",
                  pPg->pgno, pgno,
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xPagecount(pCache->pCache),
                numberOfCachePages(pCache));

if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.SPILL %d\n",pCache,pPg->pgno);};
      rc = pCache->xStress(pCache->pStress, pPg);
                        ;
      if( rc!=0         && rc!=5           ){
        return rc;
      }
    }
  }
  *ppPage =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xFetch(pCache->pCache,pgno,2);
  return *ppPage==0 ?sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__):0 ;
}










static __attribute__((noinline))PgHdr*pcacheFetchFinishWithInit(
  PCache *pCache,
  Pgno pgno,
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pPage
){
  PgHdr *pPgHdr;
  assert( pPage!=0 );
  pPgHdr = (PgHdr*)pPage->pExtra;
  assert( pPgHdr->pPage==0 );
  memset(&pPgHdr->pDirty, 0, sizeof(PgHdr) -((int)((char*)&((PgHdr*)0)->pDirty)));
  pPgHdr->pPage = pPage;
  pPgHdr->pData = pPage->pBuf;
  pPgHdr->pExtra = (void *)&pPgHdr[1];
  memset(pPgHdr->pExtra, 0, 8);
  pPgHdr->pCache = pCache;
  pPgHdr->pgno = pgno;
  pPgHdr->flags =0x001       ;
  return sqlite3PcacheFetchFinish(pCache,pgno,pPage);
}







static         PgHdr *sqlite3PcacheFetchFinish(
  PCache *pCache,
  Pgno pgno,
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pPage
){
  PgHdr *pPgHdr;

  assert( pPage!=0 );
  pPgHdr = (PgHdr *)pPage->pExtra;

  if( !pPgHdr->pPage ){
    return pcacheFetchFinishWithInit(pCache, pgno, pPage);
  }
  pCache->nRefSum++;
  pPgHdr->nRef++;
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(pPgHdr) );
  return pPgHdr;
}





static         void __attribute__((noinline))sqlite3PcacheRelease(PgHdr*p){
  assert( p->nRef>0 );
  p->pCache->nRefSum--;
  if( (--p->nRef)==0 ){
    if( p->flags&0x001       ){
      pcacheUnpin(p);
    }else{
      pcacheManageDirtyList(p,3                      );
      assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
    }
  }
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheRef(PgHdr *p){
  assert(p->nRef>0);
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  p->nRef++;
  p->pCache->nRefSum++;
}






static         void sqlite3PcacheDrop(PgHdr *p){
  assert( p->nRef==1 );
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  if( p->flags&0x002       ){
    pcacheManageDirtyList(p,1                       );
  }
  p->pCache->nRefSum--;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xUnpin(p->pCache->pCache,p->pPage,1);
}





static         void sqlite3PcacheMakeDirty(PgHdr *p){
  assert( p->nRef>0 );
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  if( p->flags & (0x001      |0x010           ) ){
    p->flags &= ~0x010           ;
    if( p->flags &0x001        ){
      p->flags ^= (0x002      |0x001      );
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.DIRTY %d\n",p->pCache,p->pgno);};
      assert( (p->flags & (0x002      |0x001      ))==0x002       );
      pcacheManageDirtyList(p,2                    );
      assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
    }
    assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  }
}





static         void sqlite3PcacheMakeClean(PgHdr *p){
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  assert( (p->flags &0x002       )!=0 );
  assert( (p->flags &0x001       )==0 );
  pcacheManageDirtyList(p,1                       );
  p->flags &= ~(0x002      |0x008          |0x004          );
  p->flags |=0x001       ;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.CLEAN %d\n",p->pCache,p->pgno);};
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  if( p->nRef==0 ){
    pcacheUnpin(p);
  }
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheCleanAll(PCache *pCache){
  PgHdr *p;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.CLEAN-ALL\n",pCache);};
  while( (p = pCache->pDirty)!=0 ){
    sqlite3PcacheMakeClean(p);
  }
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheClearWritable(PCache *pCache){
  PgHdr *p;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.CLEAR-WRITEABLE\n",pCache);};
  for(p=pCache->pDirty; p; p=p->pDirtyNext){
    p->flags &= ~(0x008          |0x004          );
  }
  pCache->pSynced = pCache->pDirtyTail;
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheClearSyncFlags(PCache *pCache){
  PgHdr *p;
  for(p=pCache->pDirty; p; p=p->pDirtyNext){
    p->flags &= ~0x008          ;
  }
  pCache->pSynced = pCache->pDirtyTail;
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheMove(PgHdr *p, Pgno newPgno){
  PCache *pCache = p->pCache;
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pOther;
  assert( p->nRef>0 );
  assert( newPgno>0 );
  assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.MOVE %d -> %d\n",pCache,p->pgno,newPgno);};
  pOther =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xFetch(pCache->pCache,newPgno,0);
  if( pOther ){
    PgHdr *pXPage = (PgHdr*)pOther->pExtra;
    assert( pXPage->nRef==0 );
    pXPage->nRef++;
    pCache->nRefSum++;
    sqlite3PcacheDrop(pXPage);
  }
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xRekey(pCache->pCache,p->pPage,p->pgno,newPgno);
  p->pgno = newPgno;
  if( (p->flags&0x002      ) && (p->flags&0x008          ) ){
    pcacheManageDirtyList(p,3                      );
    assert( sqlite3PcachePageSanity(p) );
  }
}










static         void sqlite3PcacheTruncate(PCache *pCache, Pgno pgno){
  if( pCache->pCache ){
    PgHdr *p;
    PgHdr *pNext;
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.TRUNCATE %d\n",pCache,pgno);};
    for(p=pCache->pDirty; p; p=pNext){
      pNext = p->pDirtyNext;




      assert( p->pgno>0 );
      if( p->pgno>pgno ){
        assert( p->flags&0x002       );
        sqlite3PcacheMakeClean(p);
      }
    }
    if( pgno==0 && pCache->nRefSum ){
      sqlite3_pcache_page *pPage1;
      pPage1 =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xFetch(pCache->pCache,1,0);
      if((1)             ){

        memset(pPage1->pBuf, 0, pCache->szPage);
        pgno = 1;
      }
    }
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xTruncate(pCache->pCache,pgno+1);
  }
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheClose(PCache *pCache){
  assert( pCache->pCache!=0 );
if(sqlite3PcacheTrace){sqlite3DebugPrintf ("%p.CLOSE\n",pCache);};
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xDestroy(pCache->pCache);
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheClear(PCache *pCache){
  sqlite3PcacheTruncate(pCache, 0);
}





static PgHdr *pcacheMergeDirtyList(PgHdr *pA, PgHdr *pB){
  PgHdr result, *pTail;
  pTail = &result;
  assert( pA!=0 && pB!=0 );
  for(;;){
    if( pA->pgno<pB->pgno ){
      pTail->pDirty = pA;
      pTail = pA;
      pA = pA->pDirty;
      if( pA==0 ){
        pTail->pDirty = pB;
        break;
      }
    }else{
      pTail->pDirty = pB;
      pTail = pB;
      pB = pB->pDirty;
      if( pB==0 ){
        pTail->pDirty = pA;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return result.pDirty;
}












static PgHdr *pcacheSortDirtyList(PgHdr *pIn){
  PgHdr *a[32           ], *p;
  int i;
  memset(a, 0, sizeof(a));
  while( pIn ){
    p = pIn;
    pIn = p->pDirty;
    p->pDirty = 0;
    for(i=0;(1)                       ; i++){
      if( a[i]==0 ){
        a[i] = p;
        break;
      }else{
        p = pcacheMergeDirtyList(a[i], p);
        a[i] = 0;
      }
    }
    if((0)                        ){



      a[i] = pcacheMergeDirtyList(a[i], p);
    }
  }
  p = a[0];
  for(i=1; i<32           ; i++){
    if( a[i]==0 ) continue;
    p = p ? pcacheMergeDirtyList(p, a[i]) : a[i];
  }
  return p;
}




static         PgHdr *sqlite3PcacheDirtyList(PCache *pCache){
  PgHdr *p;
  for(p=pCache->pDirty; p; p=p->pDirtyNext){
    p->pDirty = p->pDirtyNext;
  }
  return pcacheSortDirtyList(pCache->pDirty);
}







static         i64 sqlite3PcacheRefCount(PCache *pCache){
  return pCache->nRefSum;
}




static         i64 sqlite3PcachePageRefcount(PgHdr *p){
  return p->nRef;
}




static         int sqlite3PcachePagecount(PCache *pCache){
  assert( pCache->pCache!=0 );
  return(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xPagecount(pCache->pCache);
}





static         int sqlite3PcacheGetCachesize(PCache *pCache){
  return numberOfCachePages(pCache);
}





static         void sqlite3PcacheSetCachesize(PCache *pCache, int mxPage){
  assert( pCache->pCache!=0 );
  pCache->szCache = mxPage;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xCachesize(pCache->pCache,
                                         numberOfCachePages(pCache));
}






static         int sqlite3PcacheSetSpillsize(PCache *p, int mxPage){
  int res;
  assert( p->pCache!=0 );
  if( mxPage ){
    if( mxPage<0 ){
      mxPage = (int)((-1024*(i64)mxPage)/(p->szPage+p->szExtra));
    }
    p->szSpill = mxPage;
  }
  res = numberOfCachePages(p);
  if( res<p->szSpill ) res = p->szSpill;
  return res;
}




static         void sqlite3PcacheShrink(PCache *pCache){
  assert( pCache->pCache!=0 );
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xShrink(pCache->pCache);
}





static         int sqlite3HeaderSizePcache(void){ return(((sizeof(PgHdr))+7)&~7);}





static         int sqlite3PCachePercentDirty(PCache *pCache){
  PgHdr *pDirty;
  int nDirty = 0;
  int nCache = numberOfCachePages(pCache);
  for(pDirty=pCache->pDirty; pDirty; pDirty=pDirty->pDirtyNext) nDirty++;
  return nCache ? (int)(((i64)nDirty * 100) / nCache) : 0;
}





static         int sqlite3PCacheIsDirty(PCache *pCache){
  return (pCache->pDirty!=0);
}








static         void sqlite3PcacheIterateDirty(PCache *pCache, void (*xIter)(PgHdr *)){
  PgHdr *pDirty;
  for(pDirty=pCache->pDirty; pDirty; pDirty=pDirty->pDirtyNext){
    xIter(pDirty);
  }
}

























































































typedef struct PCache1 PCache1;
typedef struct PgHdr1 PgHdr1;
typedef struct PgFreeslot PgFreeslot;
typedef struct PGroup PGroup;



























struct PgHdr1 {
  sqlite3_pcache_page page;
  unsigned int iKey;
  u16 isBulkLocal;
  u16 isAnchor;
  PgHdr1 *pNext;
  PCache1 *pCache;
  PgHdr1 *pLruNext;
  PgHdr1 *pLruPrev;

};






























struct PGroup {
  sqlite3_mutex *mutex;
  unsigned int nMaxPage;
  unsigned int nMinPage;
  unsigned int mxPinned;
  unsigned int nPurgeable;
  PgHdr1 lru;
};









struct PCache1 {






  PGroup *pGroup;
  unsigned int *pnPurgeable;
  int szPage;
  int szExtra;
  int szAlloc;
  int bPurgeable;
  unsigned int nMin;
  unsigned int nMax;
  unsigned int n90pct;
  unsigned int iMaxKey;
  unsigned int nPurgeableDummy;




  unsigned int nRecyclable;
  unsigned int nPage;
  unsigned int nHash;
  PgHdr1 **apHash;
  PgHdr1 *pFree;
  void *pBulk;
};





struct PgFreeslot {
  PgFreeslot *pNext;
};




static const      struct PCacheGlobal {
  PGroup grp;






  int isInit;
  int separateCache;
  int nInitPage;
  int szSlot;
  int nSlot;
  int nReserve;
  void *pStart, *pEnd;

  sqlite3_mutex *mutex;
  PgFreeslot *pFree;
  int nFreeSlot;




  int bUnderPressure;
} pcache1_g;


































static         void sqlite3PCacheBufferSetup(void *pBuf, int sz, int n){
  if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).isInit){
    PgFreeslot *p;
    if( pBuf==0 ) sz = n = 0;
    if( n==0 ) sz = 0;
    sz =((sz)&~7)      ;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).szSlot=sz;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nSlot=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot=n;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nReserve=n>90?10:(n/10 +1);
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pStart=pBuf;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree=0;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).bUnderPressure=0;
    while( n-- ){
      p = (PgFreeslot*)pBuf;
      p->pNext =((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree=p;
      pBuf = (void*)&((char*)pBuf)[sz];
    }
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pEnd=pBuf;
  }
}





static int pcache1InitBulk(PCache1 *pCache){
  i64 szBulk;
  char *zBulk;
  if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage==0)return 0;

  if( pCache->nMax<3 ) return 0;
                            ;
  if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage>0){
    szBulk = pCache->szAlloc * (i64)((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage;
  }else{
    szBulk = -1024 * (i64)((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage;
  }
  if( szBulk > pCache->szAlloc*(i64)pCache->nMax ){
    szBulk = pCache->szAlloc*(i64)pCache->nMax;
  }
  zBulk = pCache->pBulk = sqlite3Malloc( szBulk );
                          ;
  if( zBulk ){
    int nBulk = sqlite3MallocSize(zBulk)/pCache->szAlloc;
    do{
      PgHdr1 *pX = (PgHdr1*)&zBulk[pCache->szPage];
      pX->page.pBuf = zBulk;
      pX->page.pExtra = &pX[1];
      pX->isBulkLocal = 1;
      pX->isAnchor = 0;
      pX->pNext = pCache->pFree;
      pX->pLruPrev = 0;
      pCache->pFree = pX;
      zBulk += pCache->szAlloc;
    }while( --nBulk );
  }
  return pCache->pFree!=0;
}










static void *pcache1Alloc(int nByte){
  void *p = 0;
  assert(((void)(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.mutex),1));
  if( nByte<=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).szSlot){
                                      ;
    p = (PgHdr1 *)((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree;
    if( p ){
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree->pNext;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot--;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).bUnderPressure=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot<((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nReserve;
      assert(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot>=0);
      sqlite3StatusHighwater(7                           , nByte);
      sqlite3StatusUp(1                           , 1);
    }
                                      ;
  }
  if( p==0 ){



    p = sqlite3Malloc(nByte);

    if( p ){
      int sz = sqlite3MallocSize(p);
                                        ;
      sqlite3StatusHighwater(7                           , nByte);
      sqlite3StatusUp(2                               , sz);
                                        ;
    }

                                             ;
  }
  return p;
}




static void pcache1Free(void *p){
  if( p==0 ) return;
  if((((uptr)(p)>=(uptr)(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pStart))&&((uptr)(p)<(uptr)(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pEnd)))){
    PgFreeslot *pSlot;
                                      ;
    sqlite3StatusDown(1                           , 1);
    pSlot = (PgFreeslot*)p;
    pSlot->pNext =((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pFree=pSlot;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot++;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).bUnderPressure=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot<((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nReserve;
    assert(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nFreeSlot<=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nSlot);
                                      ;
  }else{
    assert(1                                          );
                                           ;

    {
      int nFreed = 0;
      nFreed = sqlite3MallocSize(p);
                                        ;
      sqlite3StatusDown(2                               , nFreed);
                                        ;
    }

    sqlite3_free(p);
  }
}





static int pcache1MemSize(void *p){
  if( p>=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pStart&&p<((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).pEnd){
    return((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).szSlot;
  }else{
    int iSize;
    assert(1                                          );
                                           ;
    iSize = sqlite3MallocSize(p);
                                             ;
    return iSize;
  }
}





static PgHdr1 *pcache1AllocPage(PCache1 *pCache, int benignMalloc){
  PgHdr1 *p = 0;
  void *pPg;

  assert(((void)(pCache->pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  if( pCache->pFree || (pCache->nPage==0 && pcache1InitBulk(pCache)) ){
    assert( pCache->pFree!=0 );
    p = pCache->pFree;
    pCache->pFree = p->pNext;
    p->pNext = 0;
  }else{




    assert(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache==0);
    assert( pCache->pGroup==&((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp);
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;

    if( benignMalloc ){                           ; }
    pPg = pcache1Alloc(pCache->szAlloc);
    if( benignMalloc ){                         ; }

assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;

    if( pPg==0 ) return 0;
    p = (PgHdr1 *)&((u8 *)pPg)[pCache->szPage];
    p->page.pBuf = pPg;
    p->page.pExtra = &p[1];
    p->isBulkLocal = 0;
    p->isAnchor = 0;
    p->pLruPrev = 0;
  }
  (*pCache->pnPurgeable)++;
  return p;
}




static void pcache1FreePage(PgHdr1 *p){
  PCache1 *pCache;
  assert( p!=0 );
  pCache = p->pCache;
  assert(((void)(p->pCache->pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  if( p->isBulkLocal ){
    p->pNext = pCache->pFree;
    pCache->pFree = p;
  }else{
    pcache1Free(p->page.pBuf);
  }
  (*pCache->pnPurgeable)--;
}






static         void *sqlite3PageMalloc(int sz){
  assert( sz<=65536 +8);
  return pcache1Alloc(sz);
}




static         void sqlite3PageFree(void *p){
  pcache1Free(p);
}


















static int pcache1UnderMemoryPressure(PCache1 *pCache){
  if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nSlot&&(pCache->szPage+pCache->szExtra)<=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).szSlot){
    return((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).bUnderPressure;
  }else{
    return sqlite3HeapNearlyFull();
  }
}










static void pcache1ResizeHash(PCache1 *p){
  PgHdr1 **apNew;
  unsigned int nNew;
  unsigned int i;

  assert(((void)(p->pGroup->mutex),1)          );

  nNew = p->nHash*2;
  if( nNew<256 ){
    nNew = 256;
  }

assert((p->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  if( p->nHash ){                           ; }
  apNew = (PgHdr1 **)sqlite3MallocZero(sizeof(PgHdr1 *)*nNew);
  if( p->nHash ){                         ; }
assert((p->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  if( apNew ){
    for(i=0; i<p->nHash; i++){
      PgHdr1 *pPage;
      PgHdr1 *pNext = p->apHash[i];
      while( (pPage = pNext)!=0 ){
        unsigned int h = pPage->iKey % nNew;
        pNext = pPage->pNext;
        pPage->pNext = apNew[h];
        apNew[h] = pPage;
      }
    }
    sqlite3_free(p->apHash);
    p->apHash = apNew;
    p->nHash = nNew;
  }
}








static PgHdr1 *pcache1PinPage(PgHdr1 *pPage){
  assert( pPage!=0 );
  assert(((pPage)->pLruNext!=0)   );
  assert( pPage->pLruNext );
  assert( pPage->pLruPrev );
  assert(((void)(pPage->pCache->pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  pPage->pLruPrev->pLruNext = pPage->pLruNext;
  pPage->pLruNext->pLruPrev = pPage->pLruPrev;
  pPage->pLruNext = 0;


  assert( pPage->isAnchor==0 );
  assert( pPage->pCache->pGroup->lru.isAnchor==1 );
  pPage->pCache->nRecyclable--;
  return pPage;
}









static void pcache1RemoveFromHash(PgHdr1 *pPage, int freeFlag){
  unsigned int h;
  PCache1 *pCache = pPage->pCache;
  PgHdr1 **pp;

  assert(((void)(pCache->pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  h = pPage->iKey % pCache->nHash;
  for(pp=&pCache->apHash[h]; (*pp)!=pPage; pp=&(*pp)->pNext);
  *pp = (*pp)->pNext;

  pCache->nPage--;
  if( freeFlag ) pcache1FreePage(pPage);
}





static void pcache1EnforceMaxPage(PCache1 *pCache){
  PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;
  PgHdr1 *p;
  assert(((void)(pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  while( pGroup->nPurgeable>pGroup->nMaxPage
      && (p=pGroup->lru.pLruPrev)->isAnchor==0
  ){
    assert( p->pCache->pGroup==pGroup );
    assert(((p)->pLruNext!=0)   );
    pcache1PinPage(p);
    pcache1RemoveFromHash(p, 1);
  }
  if( pCache->nPage==0 && pCache->pBulk ){
    sqlite3_free(pCache->pBulk);
    pCache->pBulk = pCache->pFree = 0;
  }
}








static void pcache1TruncateUnsafe(
  PCache1 *pCache,
  unsigned int iLimit
){
int nPage = 0;
  unsigned int h, iStop;
  assert(((void)(pCache->pGroup->mutex),1)          );
  assert( pCache->iMaxKey >= iLimit );
  assert( pCache->nHash > 0 );
  if( pCache->iMaxKey - iLimit < pCache->nHash ){




    h = iLimit % pCache->nHash;
    iStop = pCache->iMaxKey % pCache->nHash;
nPage = -10;
  }else{


    h = pCache->nHash/2;
    iStop = h - 1;
  }
  for(;;){
    PgHdr1 **pp;
    PgHdr1 *pPage;
    assert( h<pCache->nHash );
    pp = &pCache->apHash[h];
    while( (pPage = *pp)!=0 ){
      if( pPage->iKey>=iLimit ){
        pCache->nPage--;
        *pp = pPage->pNext;
        if(((pPage)->pLruNext!=0)   ) pcache1PinPage(pPage);
        pcache1FreePage(pPage);
      }else{
        pp = &pPage->pNext;
if( nPage>=0 ) nPage++;
      }
    }
    if( h==iStop ) break;
    h = (h+1) % pCache->nHash;
  }
  assert( nPage<0 || pCache->nPage==(unsigned)nPage );
}







static int pcache1Init(void *NotUsed){
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  assert(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).isInit==0);
  memset(&((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))),0,sizeof(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g))))));

















((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache=0;

((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache=(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pPage==0
                          ||(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex>0;

((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache=(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pPage==0;



  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex){
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.mutex=((sqlite3_mutex*)8);
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).mutex=((sqlite3_mutex*)8);
  }

  if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache
   &&(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nPage!=0
   &&(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pPage==0
  ){
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage=(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nPage;
  }else{
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).nInitPage=0;
  }
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.mxPinned=10;
((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).isInit=1;
  return 0        ;
}






static void pcache1Shutdown(void *NotUsed){
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  assert(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).isInit!=0);
  memset(&((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))),0,sizeof(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g))))));
}


static void pcache1Destroy(sqlite3_pcache *p);






static sqlite3_pcache *pcache1Create(int szPage, int szExtra, int bPurgeable){
  PCache1 *pCache;
  PGroup *pGroup;
  int sz;

  assert( (szPage & (szPage-1))==0 && szPage>=512 && szPage<=65536 );
  assert( szExtra < 300 );

  sz = sizeof(PCache1) + sizeof(PGroup)*((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache;
  pCache = (PCache1 *)sqlite3MallocZero(sz);
  if( pCache ){
    if(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).separateCache){
      pGroup = (PGroup*)&pCache[1];
      pGroup->mxPinned = 10;
    }else{
      pGroup = &((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp;
    }
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
    if( pGroup->lru.isAnchor==0 ){
      pGroup->lru.isAnchor = 1;
      pGroup->lru.pLruPrev = pGroup->lru.pLruNext = &pGroup->lru;
    }
    pCache->pGroup = pGroup;
    pCache->szPage = szPage;
    pCache->szExtra = szExtra;
    pCache->szAlloc = szPage + szExtra +(((sizeof(PgHdr1))+7)&~7);
    pCache->bPurgeable = (bPurgeable ? 1 : 0);
    pcache1ResizeHash(pCache);
    if( bPurgeable ){
      pCache->nMin = 10;
      pGroup->nMinPage += pCache->nMin;
      pGroup->mxPinned = pGroup->nMaxPage + 10 - pGroup->nMinPage;
      pCache->pnPurgeable = &pGroup->nPurgeable;
    }else{
      pCache->pnPurgeable = &pCache->nPurgeableDummy;
    }
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
    if( pCache->nHash==0 ){
      pcache1Destroy((sqlite3_pcache*)pCache);
      pCache = 0;
    }
  }
  return (sqlite3_pcache *)pCache;
}






static void pcache1Cachesize(sqlite3_pcache *p, int nMax){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  u32 n;
  assert( nMax>=0 );
  if( pCache->bPurgeable ){
    PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
    n = (u32)nMax;
    if( n > 0x7fff0000 - pGroup->nMaxPage + pCache->nMax ){
      n = 0x7fff0000 - pGroup->nMaxPage + pCache->nMax;
    }
    pGroup->nMaxPage += (n - pCache->nMax);
    pGroup->mxPinned = pGroup->nMaxPage + 10 - pGroup->nMinPage;
    pCache->nMax = n;
    pCache->n90pct = pCache->nMax*9/10;
    pcache1EnforceMaxPage(pCache);
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
  }
}






static void pcache1Shrink(sqlite3_pcache *p){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1*)p;
  if( pCache->bPurgeable ){
    PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;
    unsigned int savedMaxPage;
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
    savedMaxPage = pGroup->nMaxPage;
    pGroup->nMaxPage = 0;
    pcache1EnforceMaxPage(pCache);
    pGroup->nMaxPage = savedMaxPage;
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0)   ;
  }
}




static int pcache1Pagecount(sqlite3_pcache *p){
  int n;
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1*)p;
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  n = pCache->nPage;
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  return n;
}










static __attribute__((noinline))PgHdr1*pcache1FetchStage2(
  PCache1 *pCache,
  unsigned int iKey,
  int createFlag
){
  unsigned int nPinned;
  PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;
  PgHdr1 *pPage = 0;


  assert( pCache->nPage >= pCache->nRecyclable );
  nPinned = pCache->nPage - pCache->nRecyclable;
  assert( pGroup->mxPinned == pGroup->nMaxPage + 10 - pGroup->nMinPage );
  assert( pCache->n90pct == pCache->nMax*9/10 );
  if( createFlag==1 && (
        nPinned>=pGroup->mxPinned
     || nPinned>=pCache->n90pct
     || (pcache1UnderMemoryPressure(pCache) && pCache->nRecyclable<nPinned)
  )){
    return 0;
  }

  if( pCache->nPage>=pCache->nHash ) pcache1ResizeHash(pCache);
  assert( pCache->nHash>0 && pCache->apHash );


  if( pCache->bPurgeable
   && !pGroup->lru.pLruPrev->isAnchor
   && ((pCache->nPage+1>=pCache->nMax) || pcache1UnderMemoryPressure(pCache))
  ){
    PCache1 *pOther;
    pPage = pGroup->lru.pLruPrev;
    assert(((pPage)->pLruNext!=0)   );
    pcache1RemoveFromHash(pPage, 0);
    pcache1PinPage(pPage);
    pOther = pPage->pCache;
    if( pOther->szAlloc != pCache->szAlloc ){
      pcache1FreePage(pPage);
      pPage = 0;
    }else{
      pGroup->nPurgeable -= (pOther->bPurgeable - pCache->bPurgeable);
    }
  }




  if( !pPage ){
    pPage = pcache1AllocPage(pCache, createFlag==1);
  }

  if( pPage ){
    unsigned int h = iKey % pCache->nHash;
    pCache->nPage++;
    pPage->iKey = iKey;
    pPage->pNext = pCache->apHash[h];
    pPage->pCache = pCache;
    pPage->pLruNext = 0;


    *(void **)pPage->page.pExtra = 0;
    pCache->apHash[h] = pPage;
    if( iKey>pCache->iMaxKey ){
      pCache->iMaxKey = iKey;
    }
  }
  return pPage;
}




























































static PgHdr1 *pcache1FetchNoMutex(
  sqlite3_pcache *p,
  unsigned int iKey,
  int createFlag
){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  PgHdr1 *pPage = 0;


  pPage = pCache->apHash[iKey % pCache->nHash];
  while( pPage && pPage->iKey!=iKey ){ pPage = pPage->pNext; }





  if( pPage ){
    if(((pPage)->pLruNext!=0)   ){
      return pcache1PinPage(pPage);
    }else{
      return pPage;
    }
  }else if( createFlag ){

    return pcache1FetchStage2(pCache, iKey, createFlag);
  }else{
    return 0;
  }
}

static PgHdr1 *pcache1FetchWithMutex(
  sqlite3_pcache *p,
  unsigned int iKey,
  int createFlag
){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  PgHdr1 *pPage;

assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  pPage = pcache1FetchNoMutex(p, iKey, createFlag);
  assert( pPage==0 || pCache->iMaxKey>=iKey );
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  return pPage;
}

static sqlite3_pcache_page *pcache1Fetch(
  sqlite3_pcache *p,
  unsigned int iKey,
  int createFlag
){

  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;


  assert(((int)((char*)&((PgHdr1*)0)->page))==0);
  assert( pCache->bPurgeable || createFlag!=1 );
  assert( pCache->bPurgeable || pCache->nMin==0 );
  assert( pCache->bPurgeable==0 || pCache->nMin==10 );
  assert( pCache->nMin==0 || pCache->bPurgeable );
  assert( pCache->nHash>0 );

  if( pCache->pGroup->mutex ){
    return (sqlite3_pcache_page*)pcache1FetchWithMutex(p, iKey, createFlag);
  }else

  {
    return (sqlite3_pcache_page*)pcache1FetchNoMutex(p, iKey, createFlag);
  }
}







static void pcache1Unpin(
  sqlite3_pcache *p,
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pPg,
  int reuseUnlikely
){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  PgHdr1 *pPage = (PgHdr1 *)pPg;
  PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;

  assert( pPage->pCache==pCache );
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0) ;




  assert( pPage->pLruNext==0 );
  assert(((pPage)->pLruNext==0) );

  if( reuseUnlikely || pGroup->nPurgeable>pGroup->nMaxPage ){
    pcache1RemoveFromHash(pPage, 1);
  }else{

    PgHdr1 **ppFirst = &pGroup->lru.pLruNext;
    pPage->pLruPrev = &pGroup->lru;
    (pPage->pLruNext = *ppFirst)->pLruPrev = pPage;
    *ppFirst = pPage;
    pCache->nRecyclable++;
  }

assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
}




static void pcache1Rekey(
  sqlite3_pcache *p,
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pPg,
  unsigned int iOld,
  unsigned int iNew
){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  PgHdr1 *pPage = (PgHdr1 *)pPg;
  PgHdr1 **pp;
  unsigned int hOld, hNew;
  assert( pPage->iKey==iOld );
  assert( pPage->pCache==pCache );
  assert( iOld!=iNew );

assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;

  assert( pcache1FetchNoMutex(p, iOld, 0)==pPage );
  hOld = iOld%pCache->nHash;
  pp = &pCache->apHash[hOld];
  while( (*pp)!=pPage ){
    pp = &(*pp)->pNext;
  }
  *pp = pPage->pNext;

  assert( pcache1FetchNoMutex(p, iNew, 0)==0 );
  hNew = iNew%pCache->nHash;
  pPage->iKey = iNew;
  pPage->pNext = pCache->apHash[hNew];
  pCache->apHash[hNew] = pPage;
  if( iNew>pCache->iMaxKey ){
    pCache->iMaxKey = iNew;
  }

assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
}








static void pcache1Truncate(sqlite3_pcache *p, unsigned int iLimit){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  if( iLimit<=pCache->iMaxKey ){
    pcache1TruncateUnsafe(pCache, iLimit);
    pCache->iMaxKey = iLimit-1;
  }
assert((pCache->pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
}






static void pcache1Destroy(sqlite3_pcache *p){
  PCache1 *pCache = (PCache1 *)p;
  PGroup *pGroup = pCache->pGroup;
  assert( pCache->bPurgeable || (pCache->nMax==0 && pCache->nMin==0) );
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  if( pCache->nPage ) pcache1TruncateUnsafe(pCache, 0);
  assert( pGroup->nMaxPage >= pCache->nMax );
  pGroup->nMaxPage -= pCache->nMax;
  assert( pGroup->nMinPage >= pCache->nMin );
  pGroup->nMinPage -= pCache->nMin;
  pGroup->mxPinned = pGroup->nMaxPage + 10 - pGroup->nMinPage;
  pcache1EnforceMaxPage(pCache);
assert((pGroup)->mutex==0) ;
  sqlite3_free(pCache->pBulk);
  sqlite3_free(pCache->apHash);
  sqlite3_free(pCache);
}






static         void sqlite3PCacheSetDefault(void){
  static const sqlite3_pcache_methods2 defaultMethods = {
    1,
    0,
    pcache1Init,
    pcache1Shutdown,
    pcache1Create,
    pcache1Cachesize,
    pcache1Pagecount,
    pcache1Fetch,
    pcache1Unpin,
    pcache1Rekey,
    pcache1Truncate,
    pcache1Destroy,
    pcache1Shrink
  };
  sqlite3_config(18                   , &defaultMethods);
}




static         int sqlite3HeaderSizePcache1(void){ return(((sizeof(PgHdr1))+7)&~7);}





static         sqlite3_mutex *sqlite3Pcache1Mutex(void){
  return((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).mutex;
}











static         int sqlite3PcacheReleaseMemory(int nReq){
  int nFree = 0;
  assert(((void)(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.mutex),1));
  assert(((void)(((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).mutex),1));
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pPage==0){
    PgHdr1 *p;
assert((&((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp)->mutex==0);
    while( (nReq<0 || nFree<nReq)
       &&  (p=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.lru.pLruPrev)!=0
       &&  p->isAnchor==0
    ){
      nFree += pcache1MemSize(p->page.pBuf);
      assert(((p)->pLruNext!=0)   );
      pcache1PinPage(p);
      pcache1RemoveFromHash(p, 1);
    }
assert((&((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp)->mutex==0);
  }
  return nFree;
}







static         void sqlite3PcacheStats(
  int *pnCurrent,
  int *pnMax,
  int *pnMin,
  int *pnRecyclable
){
  PgHdr1 *p;
  int nRecyclable = 0;
  for(p=((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.lru.pLruNext;p&&!p->isAnchor;p=p->pLruNext){
    assert(((p)->pLruNext!=0)   );
    nRecyclable++;
  }
  *pnCurrent =((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.nPurgeable;
  *pnMax = (int)((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.nMaxPage;
  *pnMin = (int)((*(struct PCacheGlobal*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(pcache1_g), sizeof(pcache1_g)))).grp.nMinPage;
  *pnRecyclable = nRecyclable;
}

























































































struct RowSetEntry {
  i64 v;
  struct RowSetEntry *pRight;
  struct RowSetEntry *pLeft;
};







struct RowSetChunk {
  struct RowSetChunk *pNextChunk;
  struct RowSetEntry aEntry[((1024 -8)/sizeof(struct RowSetEntry))];
};






struct RowSet {
  struct RowSetChunk *pChunk;
  sqlite3 *db;
  struct RowSetEntry *pEntry;
  struct RowSetEntry *pLast;
  struct RowSetEntry *pFresh;
  struct RowSetEntry *pForest;
  u16 nFresh;
  u16 rsFlags;
  int iBatch;
};











static         RowSet *sqlite3RowSetInit(sqlite3 *db){
  RowSet *p = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(db, sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    int N = sqlite3DbMallocSize(db, p);
    p->pChunk = 0;
    p->db = db;
    p->pEntry = 0;
    p->pLast = 0;
    p->pForest = 0;
    p->pFresh = (struct RowSetEntry*)((((sizeof(*p))+7)&~7)+(char*)p);
    p->nFresh = (u16)((N -(((sizeof(*p))+7)&~7))/sizeof(struct RowSetEntry));
    p->rsFlags =0x01          ;
    p->iBatch = 0;
  }
  return p;
}






static         void sqlite3RowSetClear(void *pArg){
  RowSet *p = (RowSet*)pArg;
  struct RowSetChunk *pChunk, *pNextChunk;
  for(pChunk=p->pChunk; pChunk; pChunk = pNextChunk){
    pNextChunk = pChunk->pNextChunk;
    sqlite3DbFree(p->db, pChunk);
  }
  p->pChunk = 0;
  p->nFresh = 0;
  p->pEntry = 0;
  p->pLast = 0;
  p->pForest = 0;
  p->rsFlags =0x01          ;
}






static         void sqlite3RowSetDelete(void *pArg){
  sqlite3RowSetClear(pArg);
  sqlite3DbFree(((RowSet*)pArg)->db, pArg);
}









static struct RowSetEntry *rowSetEntryAlloc(RowSet *p){
  assert( p!=0 );
  if( p->nFresh==0 ){


    struct RowSetChunk *pNew;
    pNew = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(p->db, sizeof(*pNew));
    if( pNew==0 ){
      return 0;
    }
    pNew->pNextChunk = p->pChunk;
    p->pChunk = pNew;
    p->pFresh = pNew->aEntry;
    p->nFresh =((1024 -8)/sizeof(struct RowSetEntry));
  }
  p->nFresh--;
  return p->pFresh++;
}







static         void sqlite3RowSetInsert(RowSet *p, i64 rowid){
  struct RowSetEntry *pEntry;
  struct RowSetEntry *pLast;


  assert( p!=0 && (p->rsFlags &0x02        )==0 );

  pEntry = rowSetEntryAlloc(p);
  if( pEntry==0 ) return;
  pEntry->v = rowid;
  pEntry->pRight = 0;
  pLast = p->pLast;
  if( pLast ){
    if( rowid<=pLast->v ){


      p->rsFlags &= ~0x01         ;
    }
    pLast->pRight = pEntry;
  }else{
    p->pEntry = pEntry;
  }
  p->pLast = pEntry;
}







static struct RowSetEntry *rowSetEntryMerge(
  struct RowSetEntry *pA,
  struct RowSetEntry *pB
){
  struct RowSetEntry head;
  struct RowSetEntry *pTail;

  pTail = &head;
  assert( pA!=0 && pB!=0 );
  for(;;){
    assert( pA->pRight==0 || pA->v<=pA->pRight->v );
    assert( pB->pRight==0 || pB->v<=pB->pRight->v );
    if( pA->v<=pB->v ){
      if( pA->v<pB->v ) pTail = pTail->pRight = pA;
      pA = pA->pRight;
      if( pA==0 ){
        pTail->pRight = pB;
        break;
      }
    }else{
      pTail = pTail->pRight = pB;
      pB = pB->pRight;
      if( pB==0 ){
        pTail->pRight = pA;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return head.pRight;
}





static struct RowSetEntry *rowSetEntrySort(struct RowSetEntry *pIn){
  unsigned int i;
  struct RowSetEntry *pNext, *aBucket[40];

  memset(aBucket, 0, sizeof(aBucket));
  while( pIn ){
    pNext = pIn->pRight;
    pIn->pRight = 0;
    for(i=0; aBucket[i]; i++){
      pIn = rowSetEntryMerge(aBucket[i], pIn);
      aBucket[i] = 0;
    }
    aBucket[i] = pIn;
    pIn = pNext;
  }
  pIn = aBucket[0];
  for(i=1; i<sizeof(aBucket)/sizeof(aBucket[0]); i++){
    if( aBucket[i]==0 ) continue;
    pIn = pIn ? rowSetEntryMerge(pIn, aBucket[i]) : aBucket[i];
  }
  return pIn;
}







static void rowSetTreeToList(
  struct RowSetEntry *pIn,
  struct RowSetEntry **ppFirst,
  struct RowSetEntry **ppLast
){
  assert( pIn!=0 );
  if( pIn->pLeft ){
    struct RowSetEntry *p;
    rowSetTreeToList(pIn->pLeft, ppFirst, &p);
    p->pRight = pIn;
  }else{
    *ppFirst = pIn;
  }
  if( pIn->pRight ){
    rowSetTreeToList(pIn->pRight, &pIn->pRight, ppLast);
  }else{
    *ppLast = pIn;
  }
  assert( (*ppLast)->pRight==0 );
}















static struct RowSetEntry *rowSetNDeepTree(
  struct RowSetEntry **ppList,
  int iDepth
){
  struct RowSetEntry *p;
  struct RowSetEntry *pLeft;
  if( *ppList==0 ){

    return 0;
  }
  if( iDepth>1 ){



    pLeft = rowSetNDeepTree(ppList, iDepth-1);
    p = *ppList;
    if( p==0 ){


      return pLeft;
    }
    p->pLeft = pLeft;
    *ppList = p->pRight;
    p->pRight = rowSetNDeepTree(ppList, iDepth-1);
  }else{
    p = *ppList;
    *ppList = p->pRight;
    p->pLeft = p->pRight = 0;
  }
  return p;
}





static struct RowSetEntry *rowSetListToTree(struct RowSetEntry *pList){
  int iDepth;
  struct RowSetEntry *p;
  struct RowSetEntry *pLeft;

  assert( pList!=0 );
  p = pList;
  pList = p->pRight;
  p->pLeft = p->pRight = 0;
  for(iDepth=1; pList; iDepth++){
    pLeft = p;
    p = pList;
    pList = p->pRight;
    p->pLeft = pLeft;
    p->pRight = rowSetNDeepTree(&pList, iDepth);
  }
  return p;
}














static         int sqlite3RowSetNext(RowSet *p, i64 *pRowid){
  assert( p!=0 );
  assert( p->pForest==0 );


  if( (p->rsFlags &0x02        )==0 ){
    if( (p->rsFlags &0x01          )==0 ){
      p->pEntry = rowSetEntrySort(p->pEntry);
    }
    p->rsFlags |=0x01          |0x02       ;
  }


  if( p->pEntry ){
    *pRowid = p->pEntry->v;
    p->pEntry = p->pEntry->pRight;
    if( p->pEntry==0 ){

      sqlite3RowSetClear(p);
    }
    return 1;
  }else{
    return 0;
  }
}









static         int sqlite3RowSetTest(RowSet *pRowSet, int iBatch, sqlite3_int64 iRowid){
  struct RowSetEntry *p, *pTree;


  assert( pRowSet!=0 && (pRowSet->rsFlags &0x02        )==0 );




  if( iBatch!=pRowSet->iBatch ){
    p = pRowSet->pEntry;
    if( p ){
      struct RowSetEntry **ppPrevTree = &pRowSet->pForest;
      if( (pRowSet->rsFlags &0x01          )==0 ){

        p = rowSetEntrySort(p);
      }
      for(pTree = pRowSet->pForest; pTree; pTree=pTree->pRight){
        ppPrevTree = &pTree->pRight;
        if( pTree->pLeft==0 ){
          pTree->pLeft = rowSetListToTree(p);
          break;
        }else{
          struct RowSetEntry *pAux, *pTail;
          rowSetTreeToList(pTree->pLeft, &pAux, &pTail);
          pTree->pLeft = 0;
          p = rowSetEntryMerge(pAux, p);
        }
      }
      if( pTree==0 ){
        *ppPrevTree = pTree = rowSetEntryAlloc(pRowSet);
        if( pTree ){
          pTree->v = 0;
          pTree->pRight = 0;
          pTree->pLeft = rowSetListToTree(p);
        }
      }
      pRowSet->pEntry = 0;
      pRowSet->pLast = 0;
      pRowSet->rsFlags |=0x01          ;
    }
    pRowSet->iBatch = iBatch;
  }




  for(pTree = pRowSet->pForest; pTree; pTree=pTree->pRight){
    p = pTree->pLeft;
    while( p ){
      if( p->v<iRowid ){
        p = p->pRight;
      }else if( p->v>iRowid ){
        p = p->pLeft;
      }else{
        return 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

static         int sqlite3PagerDirectReadOk(Pager *pPager, Pgno pgno){
  if( pPager->fd->pMethods==0 ) return 0;
  if( sqlite3PCacheIsDirty(pPager->pPCache) ) return 0;

  if( pPager->pWal ){
    u32 iRead = 0;
    int rc;
    rc =0                                               ;
    return (rc==0         && iRead==0);
  }

  return 1;
}





















static int assert_pager_state(Pager *p){
  Pager *pPager = p;


  assert( p->eState==0
       || p->eState==1
       || p->eState==2
       || p->eState==3
       || p->eState==4
       || p->eState==5
       || p->eState==6
  );





  assert( p->tempFile==0 || p->eLock==4              );
  assert( p->tempFile==0 || pPager->changeCountDone );




  assert( p->journalMode==2                     || p->useJournal );
  assert( p->journalMode!=2                     || !((p->jfd)->pMethods!=0));









  if(0      ){
    assert( !((p->fd)->pMethods!=0));
    assert( p->noSync );
    assert( p->journalMode==2
         || p->journalMode==4
    );
    assert( p->eState!=6           && p->eState!=0          );
    assert(((p)->pWal!=0) ==0 );
  }




  assert( pPager->changeCountDone==0 || pPager->eLock>=2             );
  assert( p->eLock!=3            );

  switch( p->eState ){
    case 0         :
      assert( !0     );
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      assert( sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache)==0 || pPager->tempFile );
      break;

    case 1           :
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      assert( p->eLock!=(4 +1)       );
      assert( p->eLock>=1           );
      break;

    case 2                  :
      assert( p->eLock!=(4 +1)       );
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      if( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) ){
        assert( p->eLock>=2             );
      }
      assert( pPager->dbSize==pPager->dbOrigSize );
      assert( pPager->dbOrigSize==pPager->dbFileSize );
      assert( pPager->dbOrigSize==pPager->dbHintSize );
      assert( pPager->setSuper==0 );
      break;

    case 3                    :
      assert( p->eLock!=(4 +1)       );
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      if( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) ){





        assert( p->eLock>=2             );
        assert(((p->jfd)->pMethods!=0)
             || p->journalMode==2
             || p->journalMode==5
        );
      }
      assert( pPager->dbOrigSize==pPager->dbFileSize );
      assert( pPager->dbOrigSize==pPager->dbHintSize );
      break;

    case 4                 :
      assert( p->eLock==4              );
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      assert( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) );
      assert( p->eLock>=4              );
      assert(((p->jfd)->pMethods!=0)
           || p->journalMode==2
           || p->journalMode==5
           || (sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(p->fd)&0x00004000               )
      );
      assert( pPager->dbOrigSize<=pPager->dbHintSize );
      break;

    case 5                    :
      assert( p->eLock==4              );
      assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
      assert( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) );
      assert(((p->jfd)->pMethods!=0)
           || p->journalMode==2
           || p->journalMode==5
           || (sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(p->fd)&0x00004000               )
      );
      break;

    case 6          :




      assert( pPager->errCode!=0         );
      assert( sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache)>0 || pPager->tempFile );
      break;
  }

  return 1;
}















char *print_pager_state(Pager *p){
  static char zRet[1024];

  sqlite3_snprintf(1024, zRet,
      "Filename:      %s\n"
      "State:         %s errCode=%d\n"
      "Lock:          %s\n"
      "Locking mode:  locking_mode=%s\n"
      "Journal mode:  journal_mode=%s\n"
      "Backing store: tempFile=%d memDb=%d useJournal=%d\n"
      "Journal:       journalOff=%lld journalHdr=%lld\n"
      "Size:          dbsize=%d dbOrigSize=%d dbFileSize=%d\n"
      , p->zFilename
      , p->eState==0                     ? "OPEN" :
        p->eState==1                     ? "READER" :
        p->eState==2                     ? "WRITER_LOCKED" :
        p->eState==3                     ? "WRITER_CACHEMOD" :
        p->eState==4                     ? "WRITER_DBMOD" :
        p->eState==5                     ? "WRITER_FINISHED" :
        p->eState==6                     ? "ERROR" : "?error?"
      , (int)p->errCode
      , p->eLock==0               ? "NO_LOCK" :
        p->eLock==2               ? "RESERVED" :
        p->eLock==4               ? "EXCLUSIVE" :
        p->eLock==1               ? "SHARED" :
        p->eLock==(4 +1)          ? "UNKNOWN" : "?error?"
      , p->exclusiveMode ? "exclusive" : "normal"
      , p->journalMode==4                          ? "memory" :
        p->journalMode==2                          ? "off" :
        p->journalMode==0                          ? "delete" :
        p->journalMode==1                          ? "persist" :
        p->journalMode==3                          ? "truncate" :
        p->journalMode==5                          ? "wal" : "?error?"
      , (int)p->tempFile, (int)p->memDb, (int)p->useJournal
      , p->journalOff, p->journalHdr
      , (int)p->dbSize, (int)p->dbOrigSize, (int)p->dbFileSize
  );

  return zRet;
}
