static int syncJournal(Pager *pPager, int newHdr){
  int rc;

  assert( pPager->eState==3
       || pPager->eState==4
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) );

  rc = sqlite3PagerExclusiveLock(pPager);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

  if( !pPager->noSync ){
    assert( !pPager->tempFile );
    if(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)&&pPager->journalMode!=4                  ){
      const int iDc = sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(pPager->fd);
      assert(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0));

      if( 0==(iDc&0x00000200              ) ){






















        i64 iNextHdrOffset;
        u8 aMagic[8];
        u8 zHeader[sizeof(aJournalMagic)+4];

{char*xxd=(char*)(zHeader);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aJournalMagic); int xxn=(sizeof(aJournalMagic));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
sqlite3Put4byte((u8*)&zHeader[sizeof(aJournalMagic)],pPager->nRec);

        iNextHdrOffset = journalHdrOffset(pPager);
        rc = sqlite3OsRead(pPager->jfd, aMagic, 8, iNextHdrOffset);
        if( rc==0         && 0==memcmp(aMagic, aJournalMagic, 8) ){
          static const u8 zerobyte = 0;
          rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pPager->jfd, &zerobyte, 1, iNextHdrOffset);
        }
        if( rc!=0         && rc!=(10 | (2<<8))           ){
          return rc;
        }












        if( pPager->fullSync && 0==(iDc&0x00000400             ) ){
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("SYNC journal of %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("JSYNC %p\n", pPager); }
          rc = sqlite3OsSync(pPager->jfd, pPager->syncFlags);
          if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
        }
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("JHDR %p %lld\n", pPager, pPager->journalHdr); };
        rc = sqlite3OsWrite(
            pPager->jfd, zHeader, sizeof(zHeader), pPager->journalHdr
        );
        if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
      }
      if( 0==(iDc&0x00000400             ) ){
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("SYNC journal of %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("JSYNC %p\n", pPager); }
        rc = sqlite3OsSync(pPager->jfd, pPager->syncFlags|
          (pPager->syncFlags==0x00003         ?0x00010             :0)
        );
        if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
      }

      pPager->journalHdr = pPager->journalOff;
      if( newHdr && 0==(iDc&0x00000200              ) ){
        pPager->nRec = 0;
        rc = writeJournalHdr(pPager);
        if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
      }
    }else{
      pPager->journalHdr = pPager->journalOff;
    }
  }





  sqlite3PcacheClearSyncFlags(pPager->pPCache);
  pPager->eState =4                  ;
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  return 0        ;
}

































static int pager_write_pagelist(Pager *pPager, PgHdr *pList){
  int rc =0         ;


  assert( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) );
  assert( pPager->tempFile || pPager->eState==4                  );
  assert( pPager->eLock==4              );
  assert(((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||pList->pDirty==0);





  if( !((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)){
    assert( pPager->tempFile && rc==0         );
    rc = pagerOpentemp(pPager, pPager->fd, pPager->vfsFlags);
  }




  assert( rc!=0         ||((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0));
  if( rc==0
   && pPager->dbHintSize<pPager->dbSize
   && (pList->pDirty || pList->pgno>pPager->dbHintSize)
  ){
    sqlite3_int64 szFile = pPager->pageSize * (sqlite3_int64)pPager->dbSize;
    sqlite3OsFileControlHint(pPager->fd,5                      , &szFile);
    pPager->dbHintSize = pPager->dbSize;
  }

  while( rc==0         && pList ){
    Pgno pgno = pList->pgno;









    if( pgno<=pPager->dbSize && 0==(pList->flags&0x010           ) ){
      i64 offset = (pgno-1)*(i64)pPager->pageSize;
      char *pData;

      assert( (pList->flags&0x008          )==0 );
      if( pList->pgno==1 ) pager_write_changecounter(pList);

      pData = pList->pData;


      rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pPager->fd, pData, pPager->pageSize, offset);





      if( pgno==1 ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pPager->dbFileVers);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&pData[24]); int xxn=(sizeof(pPager->dbFileVers));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      }
      if( pgno>pPager->dbFileSize ){
        pPager->dbFileSize = pgno;
      }
      pPager->aStat[2               ]++;


      sqlite3BackupUpdate(pPager->pBackup, pgno, (u8*)pList->pData);

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("STORE %d page %d hash(%08x)\n", 
(((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pgno, 0); }                     ;
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("PGOUT %p %d\n", pPager, pgno); };
sqlite3_pager_writedb_count++                ;
    }else{
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("NOSTORE %d page %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pgno); };
    }
                             ;
    pList = pList->pDirty;
  }

  return rc;
}









static int openSubJournal(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( !((pPager->sjfd)->pMethods!=0)){
    const int flags =0x00002000               |0x00000002
      |0x00000004          |0x00000010
      |0x00000008                ;
    int nStmtSpill = sqlite3Config.nStmtSpill;
    if( pPager->journalMode==4                        || pPager->subjInMemory ){
      nStmtSpill = -1;
    }
    rc = sqlite3JournalOpen(pPager->pVfs, 0, pPager->sjfd, flags, nStmtSpill);
  }
  return rc;
}












static int subjournalPage(PgHdr *pPg){
  int rc =0         ;
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  if( pPager->journalMode!=2                     ){


    assert( pPager->useJournal );
    assert(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)||((pPager)->pWal!=0));
    assert(((pPager->sjfd)->pMethods!=0)||pPager->nSubRec==0);
    assert(((pPager)->pWal!=0)
         || pageInJournal(pPager, pPg)
         || pPg->pgno>pPager->dbOrigSize
    );
    rc = openSubJournal(pPager);



    if( rc==0         ){
      void *pData = pPg->pData;
      i64 offset = (i64)pPager->nSubRec*(4 +pPager->pageSize);
      char *pData2;
      pData2 = pData;
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("STMT-JOURNAL %d page %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPg->pgno); };
      rc = write32bits(pPager->sjfd, offset, pPg->pgno);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pPager->sjfd, pData2, pPager->pageSize, offset+4);
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    pPager->nSubRec++;
    assert( pPager->nSavepoint>0 );
    rc = addToSavepointBitvecs(pPager, pPg->pgno);
  }
  return rc;
}
static int subjournalPageIfRequired(PgHdr *pPg){
  if( subjRequiresPage(pPg) ){
    return subjournalPage(pPg);
  }else{
    return 0        ;
  }
}




















static int pagerStress(void *p, PgHdr *pPg){
  Pager *pPager = (Pager *)p;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pPg->pPager==pPager );
  assert( pPg->flags&0x002       );

















  if((0)                     ) return 0        ;
if( pPager->doNotSpill & 0x02 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pPager->doNotSpill & 0x01 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pPager->doNotSpill & 0x04 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( pPager->doNotSpill
   && ((pPager->doNotSpill & (0x02              |0x01         ))!=0
      || (pPg->flags &0x008           )!=0)
  ){
    return 0        ;
  }

  pPager->aStat[3               ]++;
  pPg->pDirty = 0;
  if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){

    rc = subjournalPageIfRequired(pPg);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc =0                                 ;
    }
  }else{


    if( pPager->tempFile==0 ){
      rc = sqlite3JournalCreate(pPager->jfd);
      if( rc!=0         ) return pager_error(pPager, rc);
    }



    if( pPg->flags&0x008
     || pPager->eState==3
    ){
      rc = syncJournal(pPager, 1);
    }


    if( rc==0         ){
      assert( (pPg->flags&0x008          )==0 );
      rc = pager_write_pagelist(pPager, pPg);
    }
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("STRESS %d page %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPg->pgno); };
    sqlite3PcacheMakeClean(pPg);
  }

  return pager_error(pPager, rc);
}




static         int sqlite3PagerFlush(Pager *pPager){
  int rc = pPager->errCode;
  if( !0     ){
    PgHdr *pList = sqlite3PcacheDirtyList(pPager->pPCache);
    assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
    while( rc==0         && pList ){
      PgHdr *pNext = pList->pDirty;
      if( pList->nRef==0 ){
        rc = pagerStress((void*)pPager, pList);
      }
      pList = pNext;
    }
  }

  return rc;
}

































static         int sqlite3PagerOpen(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  Pager **ppPager,
  const char *zFilename,
  int nExtra,
  int flags,
  int vfsFlags,
  void (*xReinit)(DbPage*)
){
  u8 *pPtr;
  Pager *pPager = 0;
  int rc =0         ;
  int tempFile = 0;
  int memDb = 0;

  int memJM = 0;



  int readOnly = 0;
  int journalFileSize;
  char *zPathname = 0;
  int nPathname = 0;
  int useJournal = (flags &0x0001             )==0;
  int pcacheSize = sqlite3PcacheSize();
  u32 szPageDflt =65536                    ;
  const char *zUri = 0;
  int nUriByte = 1;



  journalFileSize =(((sqlite3JournalSize(pVfs))+7)&~7);


  *ppPager = 0;


  if( flags &0x0002        ){
    memDb = 1;
    if( zFilename && zFilename[0] ){
      zPathname = sqlite3DbStrDup(0, zFilename);
      if( zPathname==0  ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      nPathname = sqlite3Strlen30(zPathname);
      zFilename = 0;
    }
  }






  if( zFilename && zFilename[0] ){
    const char *z;
    nPathname = pVfs->mxPathname+1;
    zPathname = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(0, nPathname*2);
    if( zPathname==0 ){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    zPathname[0] = 0;
    rc = sqlite3OsFullPathname(pVfs, zFilename, nPathname, zPathname);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      if( rc==(0 | (2<<8))      ){
        if( vfsFlags &0x01000000            ){
          rc =(14 | (6<<8))           ;
        }else{
          rc =0         ;
        }
      }
    }
    nPathname = sqlite3Strlen30(zPathname);
    z = zUri = &zFilename[sqlite3Strlen30(zFilename)+1];
    while( *z ){
      z += strlen(z)+1;
      z += strlen(z)+1;
    }
    nUriByte = (int)(&z[1] - zUri);
    assert( nUriByte>=1 );
    if( rc==0         && nPathname+8>pVfs->mxPathname ){






      rc =sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
    }
    if( rc!=0         ){
      sqlite3DbFree(0, zPathname);
      return rc;
    }
  }













































  pPtr = (u8 *)sqlite3MallocZero(
(((sizeof(*pPager))+7)&~7)  +
(((pcacheSize)+7)&~7)  +
(((pVfs->szOsFile)+7)&~7)  +
    journalFileSize * 2 +
    sizeof(pPager) +
    4 +
    nPathname + 1 +
    nUriByte +
    nPathname + 8 + 1 +

    nPathname + 4 + 1 +

    3
  );
  assert(((((uptr)(((void*)(intptr_t)(journalFileSize))) - (uptr)0)&3)==0));
  if( !pPtr ){
    sqlite3DbFree(0, zPathname);
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  pPager = (Pager*)pPtr;                  pPtr +=(((sizeof(*pPager))+7)&~7);
  pPager->pPCache = (PCache*)pPtr;        pPtr +=(((pcacheSize)+7)&~7);
  pPager->fd = (sqlite3_file*)pPtr;       pPtr +=(((pVfs->szOsFile)+7)&~7);
  pPager->sjfd = (sqlite3_file*)pPtr;     pPtr += journalFileSize;
  pPager->jfd =  (sqlite3_file*)pPtr;     pPtr += journalFileSize;
  assert(((((uptr)(pPager->jfd) - (uptr)0)&3)==0));
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&pPager); int xxn=(sizeof(pPager));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=sizeof(pPager);


                                          pPtr += 4;
  pPager->zFilename = (char*)pPtr;
  if( nPathname>0 ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zPathname); int xxn=(nPathname);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=nPathname+1;
    if( zUri ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zUri); int xxn=(nUriByte);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=nUriByte;
    }else{
                                          pPtr++;
    }
  }



  if( nPathname>0 ){
    pPager->zJournal = (char*)pPtr;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zPathname); int xxn=(nPathname);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=nPathname;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)("-journal"); int xxn=(8);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=8 +1;

                                                  ;
    pPtr = (u8*)(pPager->zJournal + sqlite3Strlen30(pPager->zJournal)+1);

  }else{
    pPager->zJournal = 0;
  }



  if( nPathname>0 ){
    pPager->zWal = (char*)pPtr;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zPathname); int xxn=(nPathname);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=nPathname;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPtr);const char*xxs=(const char*)("-wal"); int xxn=(4);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};pPtr+=4 +1;

                                               ;
    pPtr = (u8*)(pPager->zWal + sqlite3Strlen30(pPager->zWal)+1);

  }else{
    pPager->zWal = 0;
  }

  (void)pPtr;

  if( nPathname ) sqlite3DbFree(0, zPathname);
  pPager->pVfs = pVfs;
  pPager->vfsFlags = vfsFlags;



  if( zFilename && zFilename[0] ){
    int fout = 0;
    rc = sqlite3OsOpen(pVfs, pPager->zFilename, pPager->fd, vfsFlags, &fout);
    assert( !memDb );

    pPager->memVfs =0      = (fout&0x00000080        )!=0;

    readOnly = (fout&0x00000001          )!=0;









    if( rc==0         ){
      int iDc = sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(pPager->fd);
      if( !readOnly ){
        setSectorSize(pPager);
        assert(65536                   <=65536                       );
        if( szPageDflt<pPager->sectorSize ){
          if( pPager->sectorSize>65536                        ){
            szPageDflt =65536                        ;
          }else{
            szPageDflt = (u32)pPager->sectorSize;
          }
        }

        {
          int ii;
          assert(0x00000002            ==(512>>8));
          assert(0x00000100            ==(65536>>8));
          assert(65536                       <=65536);
          for(ii=szPageDflt; ii<=65536                       ; ii=ii*2){
            if( iDc&(0x00000001         |(ii>>8)) ){
              szPageDflt = ii;
            }
          }
        }

      }
      pPager->noLock = sqlite3_uri_boolean(pPager->zFilename, "nolock", 0);
      if( (iDc &0x00002000             )!=0
       || sqlite3_uri_boolean(pPager->zFilename, "immutable", 0) ){
          vfsFlags |=0x00000001           ;
          goto act_like_temp_file;
      }
    }
  }else{










act_like_temp_file:
    tempFile = 1;
    pPager->eState =1            ;
    pPager->eLock =4              ;
    pPager->noLock = 1;
    readOnly = (vfsFlags&0x00000001          );
  }




  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( pPager->memDb==0 );
    rc = sqlite3PagerSetPagesize(pPager, &szPageDflt, -1);
if( rc!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    nExtra =(((nExtra)+7)&~7);
    assert( nExtra>=8 && nExtra<1000 );
    rc = sqlite3PcacheOpen(szPageDflt, nExtra, !memDb,
                       !memDb?pagerStress:0, (void *)pPager, pPager->pPCache);
  }



  if( rc!=0         ){
    sqlite3OsClose(pPager->fd);
    sqlite3PageFree(pPager->pTmpSpace);
    sqlite3_free(pPager);
    return rc;
  }

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("OPEN %d %s\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPager->zFilename); };
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("OPEN %p %s\n", pPager, pPager->zFilename); }

  pPager->useJournal = (u8)useJournal;






  pPager->mxPgno =1073741823            ;


  pPager->tempFile = (u8)tempFile;
  assert( tempFile==0
          || tempFile==1                           );
  assert(1                           ==1 );
  pPager->exclusiveMode = (u8)tempFile;
  pPager->changeCountDone = pPager->tempFile;
  pPager->memDb = (u8)memDb;
  pPager->readOnly = (u8)readOnly;
  assert( useJournal || pPager->tempFile );
  sqlite3PagerSetFlags(pPager, (3                         +1)|0x20            );



  pPager->nExtra = (u16)nExtra;
  pPager->journalSizeLimit =-1                                ;
  assert(((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||tempFile);
  setSectorSize(pPager);
  if( !useJournal ){
    pPager->journalMode =2                     ;
  }else if( memDb ||0      ){
    pPager->journalMode =4                        ;
  }


  pPager->xReiniter = xReinit;
  setGetterMethod(pPager);



  *ppPager = pPager;
  return 0        ;
}






           sqlite3_file *sqlite3_database_file_object(const char *zName){
  Pager *pPager;
  while( zName[-1]!=0 || zName[-2]!=0 || zName[-3]!=0 || zName[-4]!=0 ){
    zName--;
  }
  pPager = *(Pager**)(zName - 4 - sizeof(Pager*));
  return pPager->fd;
}

































static int hasHotJournal(Pager *pPager, int *pExists){
  sqlite3_vfs * const pVfs = pPager->pVfs;
  int rc =0         ;
  int exists = 1;
  int jrnlOpen = !!((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0);

  assert( pPager->useJournal );
  assert(((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0));
  assert( pPager->eState==0          );

  assert( jrnlOpen==0 || ( sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(pPager->jfd) &
0x00000800
  ));

  *pExists = 0;
  if( !jrnlOpen ){
    rc = sqlite3OsAccess(pVfs, pPager->zJournal,0                    , &exists);
  }
  if( rc==0         && exists ){
    int locked = 0;









    rc = sqlite3OsCheckReservedLock(pPager->fd, &locked);
    if( rc==0         && !locked ){
      Pgno nPage;

      assert( pPager->tempFile==0 );
      rc = pagerPagecount(pPager, &nPage);
      if( rc==0         ){








        if( nPage==0 && !jrnlOpen ){
                                    ;
          if( pagerLockDb(pPager,2             )==0         ){
            sqlite3OsDelete(pVfs, pPager->zJournal, 0);
            if( !pPager->exclusiveMode ) pagerUnlockDb(pPager,1           );
          }
                                  ;
        }else{






          if( !jrnlOpen ){
            int f =0x00000001           |0x00000800              ;
            rc = sqlite3OsOpen(pVfs, pPager->zJournal, pPager->jfd, f, &f);
          }
          if( rc==0         ){
            u8 first = 0;
            rc = sqlite3OsRead(pPager->jfd, (void *)&first, 1, 0);
            if( rc==(10 | (2<<8))           ){
              rc =0         ;
            }
            if( !jrnlOpen ){
              sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
            }
            *pExists = (first!=0);
          }else if( rc==14              ){









            *pExists = 1;
            rc =0         ;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}




























static         int sqlite3PagerSharedLock(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;





  assert( sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache)==0 );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->eState==0          || pPager->eState==1            );
  assert( pPager->errCode==0         );

  if( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) && pPager->eState==0          ){
    int bHotJournal = 1;

    assert( !0     );
    assert( pPager->tempFile==0 || pPager->eLock==4              );

    rc = pager_wait_on_lock(pPager,1           );
    if( rc!=0         ){
      assert( pPager->eLock==0       || pPager->eLock==(4 +1)       );
      goto failed;
    }




    if( pPager->eLock<=1           ){
      rc = hasHotJournal(pPager, &bHotJournal);
    }
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto failed;
    }
    if( bHotJournal ){
      if( pPager->readOnly ){
        rc =(8 | (3<<8))             ;
        goto failed;
      }
















      rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,4              );
      if( rc!=0         ){
        goto failed;
      }














      if( !((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)&&pPager->journalMode!=2              ){
        sqlite3_vfs * const pVfs = pPager->pVfs;
        int bExists;
        rc = sqlite3OsAccess(
            pVfs, pPager->zJournal,0                    , &bExists);
        if( rc==0         && bExists ){
          int fout = 0;
          int f =0x00000002            |0x00000800              ;
          assert( !pPager->tempFile );
          rc = sqlite3OsOpen(pVfs, pPager->zJournal, pPager->jfd, f, &fout);
          assert( rc!=0         ||((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0));
          if( rc==0         && fout&0x00000001           ){
            rc =sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
            sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
          }
        }
      }









      if(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)){
        assert( rc==0         );
        rc = pagerSyncHotJournal(pPager);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = pager_playback(pPager, !pPager->tempFile);
          pPager->eState =0          ;
        }
      }else if( !pPager->exclusiveMode ){
        pagerUnlockDb(pPager,1           );
      }

      if( rc!=0         ){
















        pager_error(pPager, rc);
        goto failed;
      }

      assert( pPager->eState==0          );
      assert( (pPager->eLock==1          )
           || (pPager->exclusiveMode && pPager->eLock>1          )
      );
    }

    if( !pPager->tempFile && pPager->hasHeldSharedLock ){
















      char dbFileVers[sizeof(pPager->dbFileVers)];

if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("CKVERS %p %d\n", pPager, sizeof(dbFileVers)); };
      rc = sqlite3OsRead(pPager->fd, &dbFileVers, sizeof(dbFileVers), 24);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        if( rc!=(10 | (2<<8))           ){
          goto failed;
        }
        memset(dbFileVers, 0, sizeof(dbFileVers));
      }

      if( memcmp(pPager->dbFileVers, dbFileVers, sizeof(dbFileVers))!=0 ){
        pager_reset(pPager);







        if(((pPager)->bUseFetch)){
          sqlite3OsUnfetch(pPager->fd, 0, 0);
        }
      }
    }




    rc =0                             ;

    assert( pPager->pWal==0 || rc==0         );

  }

  if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){
    assert( rc==0         );
    rc =0                                 ;
  }

  if( pPager->tempFile==0 && pPager->eState==0          && rc==0         ){
    rc = pagerPagecount(pPager, &pPager->dbSize);
  }

 failed:
  if( rc!=0         ){
    assert( !0     );
    pager_unlock(pPager);
    assert( pPager->eState==0          );
  }else{
    pPager->eState =1            ;
    pPager->hasHeldSharedLock = 1;
  }
  return rc;
}









static void pagerUnlockIfUnused(Pager *pPager){
  if( sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache)==0 ){
    assert( pPager->nMmapOut==0 );
    pagerUnlockAndRollback(pPager);
  }
}


























































static int getPageNormal(
  Pager *pPager,
  Pgno pgno,
  DbPage **ppPage,
  int flags
){
  int rc =0         ;
  PgHdr *pPg;
  u8 noContent;
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pBase;

  assert( pPager->errCode==0         );
  assert( pPager->eState>=1            );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->hasHeldSharedLock==1 );

  if( pgno==0 ) return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  pBase = sqlite3PcacheFetch(pPager->pPCache, pgno, 3);
  if( pBase==0 ){
    pPg = 0;
    rc = sqlite3PcacheFetchStress(pPager->pPCache, pgno, &pBase);
    if( rc!=0         ) goto pager_acquire_err;
    if( pBase==0 ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      goto pager_acquire_err;
    }
  }
  pPg = *ppPage = sqlite3PcacheFetchFinish(pPager->pPCache, pgno, pBase);
  assert( pPg==(*ppPage) );
  assert( pPg->pgno==pgno );
  assert( pPg->pPager==pPager || pPg->pPager==0 );

  noContent = (flags &0x01                )!=0;
  if( pPg->pPager && !noContent ){


    assert( pgno!=((pPager)->lckPgno)   );
    pPager->aStat[0             ]++;
    return 0        ;

  }else{






    if( pgno==((pPager)->lckPgno)   ){
      rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
      goto pager_acquire_err;
    }

    pPg->pPager = pPager;

    assert( !((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||!0);
    if( !((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||pPager->dbSize<pgno||noContent){
      if( pgno>pPager->mxPgno ){
        rc =13          ;
        goto pager_acquire_err;
      }
      if( noContent ){






                                  ;
        if( pgno<=pPager->dbOrigSize ){
rc =                       sqlite3BitvecSet(pPager->pInJournal, pgno);
if( rc==7 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        }
rc =                     addToSavepointBitvecs(pPager, pgno);
if( rc==7 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
                                ;
      }
      memset(pPg->pData, 0, pPager->pageSize);
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("ZERO %p %d\n", pPager, pgno); };
    }else{
      assert( pPg->pPager==pPager );
      pPager->aStat[1              ]++;
      rc = readDbPage(pPg);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        goto pager_acquire_err;
      }
    }
                           ;
  }
  return 0        ;

pager_acquire_err:
  assert( rc!=0         );
  if( pPg ){
    sqlite3PcacheDrop(pPg);
  }
  pagerUnlockIfUnused(pPager);
  *ppPage = 0;
  return rc;
}



static int getPageMMap(
  Pager *pPager,
  Pgno pgno,
  DbPage **ppPage,
  int flags
){
  int rc =0         ;
  PgHdr *pPg = 0;
  u32 iFrame = 0;





  const int bMmapOk = (pgno>1
   && (pPager->eState==1            || (flags &0x02               ))
  );

  assert(((pPager)->bUseFetch));





  if( pgno<=1 && pgno==0 ){
    return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  }
  assert( pPager->eState>=1            );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->hasHeldSharedLock==1 );
  assert( pPager->errCode==0         );

  if( bMmapOk &&((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){
    rc =0                                                ;
    if( rc!=0         ){
      *ppPage = 0;
      return rc;
    }
  }
  if( bMmapOk && iFrame==0 ){
    void *pData = 0;
    rc = sqlite3OsFetch(pPager->fd,
        (i64)(pgno-1) * pPager->pageSize, pPager->pageSize, &pData
    );
    if( rc==0         && pData ){
      if( pPager->eState>1            || pPager->tempFile ){
        pPg = sqlite3PagerLookup(pPager, pgno);
      }
      if( pPg==0 ){
        rc = pagerAcquireMapPage(pPager, pgno, pData, &pPg);
      }else{
        sqlite3OsUnfetch(pPager->fd, (i64)(pgno-1)*pPager->pageSize, pData);
      }
      if( pPg ){
        assert( rc==0         );
        *ppPage = pPg;
        return 0        ;
      }
    }
    if( rc!=0         ){
      *ppPage = 0;
      return rc;
    }
  }
  return getPageNormal(pPager, pgno, ppPage, flags);
}



static int getPageError(
  Pager *pPager,
  Pgno pgno,
  DbPage **ppPage,
  int flags
){
(void)(pgno)            ;
(void)(flags)            ;
  assert( pPager->errCode!=0         );
  *ppPage = 0;
  return pPager->errCode;
}




static         int sqlite3PagerGet(
  Pager *pPager,
  Pgno pgno,
  DbPage **ppPage,
  int flags
){

  return pPager->xGet(pPager, pgno, ppPage, flags);
}












static         DbPage *sqlite3PagerLookup(Pager *pPager, Pgno pgno){
  sqlite3_pcache_page *pPage;
  assert( pPager!=0 );
  assert( pgno!=0 );
  assert( pPager->pPCache!=0 );
  pPage = sqlite3PcacheFetch(pPager->pPCache, pgno, 0);
  assert( pPage==0 || pPager->hasHeldSharedLock );
  if( pPage==0 ) return 0;
  return sqlite3PcacheFetchFinish(pPager->pPCache, pgno, pPage);
}













static         void sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(DbPage *pPg){
Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  assert( pPg!=0 );
  if( pPg->flags &0x020       ){
    assert( pPg->pgno!=1 );
    pagerReleaseMapPage(pPg);
  }else{
    sqlite3PcacheRelease(pPg);
  }

  assert( sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache)>0 );
}
static         void sqlite3PagerUnref(DbPage *pPg){
  if( pPg ) sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPg);
}
static         void sqlite3PagerUnrefPageOne(DbPage *pPg){
  Pager *pPager;
  assert( pPg!=0 );
  assert( pPg->pgno==1 );
  assert( (pPg->flags &0x020      )==0 );
  pPager = pPg->pPager;
  sqlite3PcacheRelease(pPg);
  pagerUnlockIfUnused(pPager);
}























static int pager_open_journal(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_vfs * const pVfs = pPager->pVfs;

  assert( pPager->eState==2                   );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->pInJournal==0 );




  if((0)                     ) return pPager->errCode;

  if( !((pPager)->pWal!=0) && pPager->journalMode!=2                     ){
    pPager->pInJournal = sqlite3BitvecCreate(pPager->dbSize);
    if( pPager->pInJournal==0 ){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }


    if( !((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)){
      if( pPager->journalMode==4                        ){
        sqlite3MemJournalOpen(pPager->jfd);
      }else{
        int flags =0x00000002            |0x00000004        ;
        int nSpill;

        if( pPager->tempFile ){
          flags |= (0x00000008               |0x00001000              );
          flags |=0x00000010            ;
          nSpill = sqlite3Config.nStmtSpill;
        }else{
          flags |=0x00000800               ;
          nSpill = jrnlBufferSize(pPager);
        }



        rc = databaseIsUnmoved(pPager);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = sqlite3JournalOpen (
              pVfs, pPager->zJournal, pPager->jfd, flags, nSpill
          );
        }
      }
      assert( rc!=0         ||((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0));
    }





    if( rc==0         ){

      pPager->nRec = 0;
      pPager->journalOff = 0;
      pPager->setSuper = 0;
      pPager->journalHdr = 0;
      rc = writeJournalHdr(pPager);
    }
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
    sqlite3BitvecDestroy(pPager->pInJournal);
    pPager->pInJournal = 0;
    pPager->journalOff = 0;
  }else{
    assert( pPager->eState==2                   );
    pPager->eState =3                     ;
  }

  return rc;
}


















static         int sqlite3PagerBegin(Pager *pPager, int exFlag, int subjInMemory){
  int rc =0         ;

  if( pPager->errCode ) return pPager->errCode;
  assert( pPager->eState>=1            && pPager->eState<6           );
  pPager->subjInMemory = (u8)subjInMemory;

  if( pPager->eState==1            ){
    assert( pPager->pInJournal==0 );

    if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){



      if( pPager->exclusiveMode &&0                                          ){
        rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,4              );
        if( rc!=0         ){
          return rc;
        }
        (void)0                                       ;
      }






      rc =0                                             ;
    }else{





      rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,2             );
      if( rc==0         && exFlag ){
        rc = pager_wait_on_lock(pPager,4              );
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){









      pPager->eState =2                   ;
      pPager->dbHintSize = pPager->dbSize;
      pPager->dbFileSize = pPager->dbSize;
      pPager->dbOrigSize = pPager->dbSize;
      pPager->journalOff = 0;
    }

    assert( rc==0         || pPager->eState==1            );
    assert( rc!=0         || pPager->eState==2                   );
    assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  }

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("TRANSACTION %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };
  return rc;
}




static __attribute__((noinline))int pagerAddPageToRollbackJournal(PgHdr*pPg){
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  int rc;
  u32 cksum;
  char *pData2;
  i64 iOff = pPager->journalOff;




  assert( pPg->pgno!=((pPager)->lckPgno)   );

  assert( pPager->journalHdr<=pPager->journalOff );
  pData2 = pPg->pData;
  cksum = pager_cksum(pPager, (u8*)pData2);








  pPg->flags |=0x008           ;

  rc = write32bits(pPager->jfd, iOff, pPg->pgno);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pPager->jfd, pData2, pPager->pageSize, iOff+4);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  rc = write32bits(pPager->jfd, iOff+pPager->pageSize+4, cksum);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("JOUT %p %d %lld %d\n", pPager, pPg->pgno, 
pPager->journalOff, pPager->pageSize); }         ;
sqlite3_pager_writej_count++            ;
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("JOURNAL %d page %d needSync=%d hash(%08x)\n", 
(((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPg->pgno, 
((pPg->flags&0x008)?1:0), 0); }                                 ;

  pPager->journalOff += 8 + pPager->pageSize;
  pPager->nRec++;
  assert( pPager->pInJournal!=0 );
  rc = sqlite3BitvecSet(pPager->pInJournal, pPg->pgno);
if( rc==7 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  assert( rc==0         || rc==7            );
  rc |= addToSavepointBitvecs(pPager, pPg->pgno);
  assert( rc==0         || rc==7            );
  return rc;
}








static int pager_write(PgHdr *pPg){
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  int rc =0         ;





  assert( pPager->eState==2
       || pPager->eState==3
       || pPager->eState==4
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->errCode==0 );
  assert( pPager->readOnly==0 );
checkPage(pPg)   ;










  if( pPager->eState==2                   ){
    rc = pager_open_journal(pPager);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  }
  assert( pPager->eState>=3                     );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );


  sqlite3PcacheMakeDirty(pPg);





  assert( (pPager->pInJournal!=0) ==((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0));
  if( pPager->pInJournal!=0
   && sqlite3BitvecTestNotNull(pPager->pInJournal, pPg->pgno)==0
  ){
    assert(((pPager)->pWal!=0) ==0 );
    if( pPg->pgno<=pPager->dbOrigSize ){
      rc = pagerAddPageToRollbackJournal(pPg);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        return rc;
      }
    }else{
      if( pPager->eState!=4                  ){
        pPg->flags |=0x008           ;
      }
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("APPEND %d page %d needSync=%d\n", 
(((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPg->pgno, 
((pPg->flags&0x008)?1:0)); }                     ;
    }
  }






  pPg->flags |=0x004           ;




  if( pPager->nSavepoint>0 ){
    rc = subjournalPageIfRequired(pPg);
  }


  if( pPager->dbSize<pPg->pgno ){
    pPager->dbSize = pPg->pgno;
  }
  return rc;
}












static __attribute__((noinline))int pagerWriteLargeSector(PgHdr*pPg){
  int rc =0         ;
  Pgno nPageCount;
  Pgno pg1;
  int nPage = 0;
  int ii;
  int needSync = 0;
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  Pgno nPagePerSector = (pPager->sectorSize/pPager->pageSize);





  assert( !0     );
  assert( (pPager->doNotSpill &0x04             )==0 );
  pPager->doNotSpill |=0x04             ;





  pg1 = ((pPg->pgno-1) & ~(nPagePerSector-1)) + 1;

  nPageCount = pPager->dbSize;
  if( pPg->pgno>nPageCount ){
    nPage = (pPg->pgno - pg1)+1;
  }else if( (pg1+nPagePerSector-1)>nPageCount ){
    nPage = nPageCount+1 -pg1;
  }else{
    nPage = nPagePerSector;
  }
  assert(nPage>0);
  assert(pg1<=pPg->pgno);
  assert((pg1+nPage)>pPg->pgno);

  for(ii=0; ii<nPage && rc==0        ; ii++){
    Pgno pg = pg1+ii;
    PgHdr *pPage;
    if( pg==pPg->pgno || !sqlite3BitvecTest(pPager->pInJournal, pg) ){
      if( pg!=((pPager)->lckPgno)   ){
        rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pPager, pg, &pPage, 0);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = pager_write(pPage);
          if( pPage->flags&0x008           ){
            needSync = 1;
          }
          sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPage);
        }
      }
    }else if( (pPage = sqlite3PagerLookup(pPager, pg))!=0 ){
      if( pPage->flags&0x008           ){
        needSync = 1;
      }
      sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPage);
    }
  }







  if( rc==0         && needSync ){
    assert( !0     );
    for(ii=0; ii<nPage; ii++){
      PgHdr *pPage = sqlite3PagerLookup(pPager, pg1+ii);
      if( pPage ){
        pPage->flags |=0x008           ;
        sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPage);
      }
    }
  }

  assert( (pPager->doNotSpill &0x04             )!=0 );
  pPager->doNotSpill &= ~0x04            ;
  return rc;
}















static         int sqlite3PagerWrite(PgHdr *pPg){
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  assert( (pPg->flags &0x020      )==0 );
  assert( pPager->eState>=2                   );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  if( (pPg->flags &0x004           )!=0 && pPager->dbSize>=pPg->pgno ){
    if( pPager->nSavepoint ) return subjournalPageIfRequired(pPg);
    return 0        ;
  }else if( pPager->errCode ){
    return pPager->errCode;
  }else if( pPager->sectorSize > (u32)pPager->pageSize ){
    assert( pPager->tempFile==0 );
    return pagerWriteLargeSector(pPg);
  }else{
    return pager_write(pPg);
  }
}







static         int sqlite3PagerIswriteable(DbPage *pPg){
  return pPg->flags &0x004           ;
}






















static         void sqlite3PagerDontWrite(PgHdr *pPg){
  Pager *pPager = pPg->pPager;
  if( !pPager->tempFile && (pPg->flags&0x002      ) && pPager->nSavepoint==0 ){
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("DONT_WRITE page %d of %d\n", pPg->pgno, (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("CLEAN %p %d\n", pPager, pPg->pgno); }
    pPg->flags |=0x010            ;
    pPg->flags &= ~0x004          ;
if( pPg->flags & 0x008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
                           ;
  }
}























static int pager_incr_changecounter(Pager *pPager, int isDirectMode){
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pPager->eState==3
       || pPager->eState==4
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );













  assert( isDirectMode==0 );
(void)(isDirectMode)            ;




  if( !pPager->changeCountDone && pPager->dbSize>0 ){
    PgHdr *pPgHdr;

    assert( !pPager->tempFile &&((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0));


    rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pPager, 1, &pPgHdr, 0);
    assert( pPgHdr==0 || rc==0         );






    if( !0           &&(1)                    ){
      rc = sqlite3PagerWrite(pPgHdr);
    }

    if( rc==0         ){

      pager_write_changecounter(pPgHdr);


      if(0            ){
        const void *zBuf;
        assert( pPager->dbFileSize>0 );
        zBuf = pPgHdr->pData;
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pPager->fd, zBuf, pPager->pageSize, 0);
          pPager->aStat[2               ]++;
        }
        if( rc==0         ){



          const void *pCopy = (const void *)&((const char *)zBuf)[24];
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pPager->dbFileVers);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pCopy); int xxn=(sizeof(pPager->dbFileVers));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          pPager->changeCountDone = 1;
        }
      }else{
        pPager->changeCountDone = 1;
      }
    }


    sqlite3PagerUnref(pPgHdr);
  }
  return rc;
}








static         int sqlite3PagerSync(Pager *pPager, const char *zSuper){
  int rc =0         ;
  void *pArg = (void*)zSuper;
  rc = sqlite3OsFileControl(pPager->fd,21                , pArg);
  if( rc==12              ) rc =0         ;
  if( rc==0         && !pPager->noSync ){
    assert( !0     );
    rc = sqlite3OsSync(pPager->fd, pPager->syncFlags);
  }
  return rc;
}












static         int sqlite3PagerExclusiveLock(Pager *pPager){
  int rc = pPager->errCode;
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( pPager->eState==3
         || pPager->eState==4
         || pPager->eState==2
    );
    assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
    if( 0==((pPager)->pWal!=0) ){
      rc = pager_wait_on_lock(pPager,4              );
    }
  }
  return rc;
}



























static         int sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseOne(
  Pager *pPager,
  const char *zSuper,
  int noSync
){
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pPager->eState==2
       || pPager->eState==3
       || pPager->eState==4
       || pPager->eState==6
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );


  if((0)                     ) return pPager->errCode;


  if(0                     ) return 10          ;

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("DATABASE SYNC: File=%s zSuper=%s nSize=%d\n", 
pPager->zFilename, zSuper, pPager->dbSize); }    ;


  if( pPager->eState<3                     ) return 0        ;

  assert(0     ==0 || pPager->tempFile );
  assert(((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||pPager->tempFile);
  if( 0==pagerFlushOnCommit(pPager, 1) ){



    sqlite3BackupRestart(pPager->pBackup);
  }else{
    PgHdr *pList;
    if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){
      PgHdr *pPageOne = 0;
      pList = sqlite3PcacheDirtyList(pPager->pPCache);
      if( pList==0 ){


        rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pPager, 1, &pPageOne, 0);
        pList = pPageOne;
        pList->pDirty = 0;
      }
      assert( rc==0         );
      if((1)            ){
        rc =0                                                ;
      }
      sqlite3PagerUnref(pPageOne);
      if( rc==0         ){
        sqlite3PcacheCleanAll(pPager->pPCache);
      }
    }else{





      sqlite3_file *fd = pPager->fd;
      int bBatch = zSuper==0
        && (sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(fd) &0x00004000                )
        && !pPager->noSync
        && sqlite3JournalIsInMemory(pPager->jfd);




























      if(0      ==0 ){
        PgHdr *pPg;
        assert(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)
            || pPager->journalMode==2
            || pPager->journalMode==5
            );
        if( !zSuper &&((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)
         && pPager->journalOff==jrnlBufferSize(pPager)
         && pPager->dbSize>=pPager->dbOrigSize
         && (!(pPg = sqlite3PcacheDirtyList(pPager->pPCache)) || 0==pPg->pDirty)
        ){






          rc = pager_incr_changecounter(pPager, 1);
        }else{
          rc = sqlite3JournalCreate(pPager->jfd);
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = pager_incr_changecounter(pPager, 0);
          }
        }
      }


      if( zSuper ){
        rc = sqlite3JournalCreate(pPager->jfd);
        if( rc!=0         ) goto commit_phase_one_exit;
        assert(0      ==0 );
      }

      rc = pager_incr_changecounter(pPager, 0);

      if( rc!=0         ) goto commit_phase_one_exit;





      rc = writeSuperJournal(pPager, zSuper);
      if( rc!=0         ) goto commit_phase_one_exit;












      rc = syncJournal(pPager, 0);
      if( rc!=0         ) goto commit_phase_one_exit;

      pList = sqlite3PcacheDirtyList(pPager->pPCache);

      if(0       ){
        rc = sqlite3OsFileControl(fd,31                              , 0);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = pager_write_pagelist(pPager, pList);
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = sqlite3OsFileControl(fd,32                               , 0);
          }
          if( rc!=0         ){
            sqlite3OsFileControlHint(fd,33                                 , 0);
          }
        }

        if( (rc&0xFF)==10           && rc!=(10 | (12<<8))     ){
          rc = sqlite3JournalCreate(pPager->jfd);
          if( rc!=0         ){
            sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
            goto commit_phase_one_exit;
          }
0                = 0;
        }else{
          sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
        }
      }


      if(0      ==0 ){
        rc = pager_write_pagelist(pPager, pList);
      }
      if( rc!=0         ){
        assert( rc!=(10 | (11<<8))       );
        goto commit_phase_one_exit;
      }
      sqlite3PcacheCleanAll(pPager->pPCache);







      if( pPager->dbSize>pPager->dbFileSize ){
        Pgno nNew = pPager->dbSize - (pPager->dbSize==((pPager)->lckPgno)  );
        assert( pPager->eState==4                  );
        rc = pager_truncate(pPager, nNew);
        if( rc!=0         ) goto commit_phase_one_exit;
      }


      if( !noSync ){
        rc = sqlite3PagerSync(pPager, zSuper);
      }
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("DBSYNC %p\n", pPager); }
    }
  }

commit_phase_one_exit:
  if( rc==0         && !((pPager)->pWal!=0) ){
    pPager->eState =5                     ;
  }
  return rc;
}

















static         int sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseTwo(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;




  if((0)                     ) return pPager->errCode;
  pPager->iDataVersion++;

  assert( pPager->eState==2
       || pPager->eState==5
       || (((pPager)->pWal!=0) && pPager->eState==3                    )
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );












  if( pPager->eState==2
   && pPager->exclusiveMode
   && pPager->journalMode==1
  ){
    assert( pPager->journalOff==(pPager->sectorSize)   || !pPager->journalOff );
    pPager->eState =1            ;
    return 0        ;
  }

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("COMMIT %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };
  rc = pager_end_transaction(pPager, pPager->setSuper, 1);
  return pager_error(pPager, rc);
}



























static         int sqlite3PagerRollback(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;
if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("ROLLBACK %d\n", (((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd)))); };





  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  if( pPager->eState==6           ) return pPager->errCode;
  if( pPager->eState<=1            ) return 0        ;

  if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){
    int rc2;
    rc = sqlite3PagerSavepoint(pPager,2                  , -1);
    rc2 = pager_end_transaction(pPager, pPager->setSuper, 0);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }else if( !((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)||pPager->eState==2            ){
    int eState = pPager->eState;
    rc = pager_end_transaction(pPager, 0, 0);
    if( !0     && eState>2                   ){




      pPager->errCode =4            ;
      pPager->eState =6           ;
      setGetterMethod(pPager);
      return rc;
    }
  }else{
    rc = pager_playback(pPager, 0);
  }

  assert( pPager->eState==1            || rc!=0         );
  assert( rc==0         || rc==13          || rc==11
          || rc==7            || (rc&0xFF)==10
          || rc==14
  );




  return pager_error(pPager, rc);
}





static         u8 sqlite3PagerIsreadonly(Pager *pPager){

}

}






static         int sqlite3PagerMemUsed(Pager *pPager){
  int perPageSize = pPager->pageSize + pPager->nExtra
    + (int)(sizeof(PgHdr) + 5*sizeof(void*));
  return perPageSize*sqlite3PcachePagecount(pPager->pPCache)
           + sqlite3MallocSize(pPager)
           + pPager->pageSize;
}




static         int sqlite3PagerPageRefcount(DbPage *pPage){
  return sqlite3PcachePageRefcount(pPage);
}





static         int *sqlite3PagerStats(Pager *pPager){
  static int a[11];
  a[0] = sqlite3PcacheRefCount(pPager->pPCache);
  a[1] = sqlite3PcachePagecount(pPager->pPCache);
  a[2] = sqlite3PcacheGetCachesize(pPager->pPCache);
  a[3] = pPager->eState==0          ? -1 : (int) pPager->dbSize;
  a[4] = pPager->eState;
  a[5] = pPager->errCode;
  a[6] = pPager->aStat[0             ];
  a[7] = pPager->aStat[1              ];
  a[8] = 0;
  a[9] = pPager->nRead;
  a[10] = pPager->aStat[2               ];
  return a;
}













static         void sqlite3PagerCacheStat(Pager *pPager, int eStat, int reset, int *pnVal){

  assert( eStat==7
       || eStat==8
       || eStat==9
       || eStat==9                          +1
  );

  assert(7                         +1==8                          );
  assert(7                         +2==9                           );
  assert(0              ==0 &&1               ==1
           &&2                ==2 &&3                ==3 );

  eStat -=7                         ;
  *pnVal += pPager->aStat[eStat];
  if( reset ){
    pPager->aStat[eStat] = 0;
  }
}

}











static __attribute__((noinline))int pagerOpenSavepoint(Pager*pPager,int nSavepoint){
  int rc =0         ;
  int nCurrent = pPager->nSavepoint;
  int ii;
  PagerSavepoint *aNew;

  assert( pPager->eState>=2                   );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( nSavepoint>nCurrent && pPager->useJournal );





  aNew = (PagerSavepoint *)sqlite3Realloc(
      pPager->aSavepoint, sizeof(PagerSavepoint)*nSavepoint
  );
  if( !aNew ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  memset(&aNew[nCurrent], 0, (nSavepoint-nCurrent) * sizeof(PagerSavepoint));
  pPager->aSavepoint = aNew;


  for(ii=nCurrent; ii<nSavepoint; ii++){
    aNew[ii].nOrig = pPager->dbSize;
    if(((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)&&pPager->journalOff>0){
      aNew[ii].iOffset = pPager->journalOff;
    }else{
      aNew[ii].iOffset =(pPager->sectorSize)   ;
    }
    aNew[ii].iSubRec = pPager->nSubRec;
    aNew[ii].pInSavepoint = sqlite3BitvecCreate(pPager->dbSize);
    aNew[ii].bTruncateOnRelease = 1;
    if( !aNew[ii].pInSavepoint ){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ){
                                                          ;
    }
    pPager->nSavepoint = ii+1;
  }
  assert( pPager->nSavepoint==nSavepoint );
                                  ;
  return rc;
}
static         int sqlite3PagerOpenSavepoint(Pager *pPager, int nSavepoint){
  assert( pPager->eState>=2                   );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );

  if( nSavepoint>pPager->nSavepoint && pPager->useJournal ){
    return pagerOpenSavepoint(pPager, nSavepoint);
  }else{
    return 0        ;
  }
}
































static         int sqlite3PagerSavepoint(Pager *pPager, int op, int iSavepoint){
  int rc = pPager->errCode;


  if( op==1                 ) rc =0         ;


  assert( op==1                 || op==2                  );
  assert( iSavepoint>=0 || op==2                  );

  if( rc==0         && iSavepoint<pPager->nSavepoint ){
    int ii;
    int nNew;





    nNew = iSavepoint + (( op==1                 ) ? 0 : 1);
    for(ii=nNew; ii<pPager->nSavepoint; ii++){
      sqlite3BitvecDestroy(pPager->aSavepoint[ii].pInSavepoint);
    }
    pPager->nSavepoint = nNew;



    if( op==1                 ){
      PagerSavepoint *pRel = &pPager->aSavepoint[nNew];
      if( pRel->bTruncateOnRelease &&((pPager->sjfd)->pMethods!=0)){

        if( sqlite3JournalIsInMemory(pPager->sjfd) ){
          i64 sz = (pPager->pageSize+4)*(i64)pRel->iSubRec;
          rc = sqlite3OsTruncate(pPager->sjfd, sz);
          assert( rc==0         );
        }
        pPager->nSubRec = pRel->iSubRec;
      }
    }





    else if(((pPager)->pWal!=0)  ||((pPager->jfd)->pMethods!=0)){
      PagerSavepoint *pSavepoint = (nNew==0)?0:&pPager->aSavepoint[nNew-1];
      rc = pagerPlaybackSavepoint(pPager, pSavepoint);
      assert(rc!=101        );
    }






    else if(
        pPager->journalMode==2
     && pPager->eState>=3
    ){
      pPager->errCode =4            ;
      pPager->eState =6           ;
      setGetterMethod(pPager);
    }

  }

  return rc;
}

  }else{
    return pPager->zFilename;
  }
}

static         int sqlite3PagerMovepage(Pager *pPager, DbPage *pPg, Pgno pgno, int isCommit){
  PgHdr *pPgOld;
  Pgno needSyncPgno = 0;
  int rc;
  Pgno origPgno;

  assert( pPg->nRef>0 );
  assert( pPager->eState==3
       || pPager->eState==4
  );
  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );




  assert( pPager->tempFile || !0     );
  if( pPager->tempFile ){
    rc = sqlite3PagerWrite(pPg);
    if( rc ) return rc;
  }



















  if( (pPg->flags &0x002       )!=0
   &&0         !=(rc = subjournalPageIfRequired(pPg))
  ){
    return rc;
  }

if( sqlite3PagerTrace ){ printf ("MOVE %d page %d (needSync=%d) moves to %d\n", 
(((int)(intptr_t)(pPager->fd))), pPg->pgno, (pPg->flags&0x008)?1:0, pgno); };
if( sqlite3IoTrace ){ sqlite3IoTrace ("MOVE %p %d %d\n", pPager, pPg->pgno, pgno); }








  if( (pPg->flags&0x008          ) && !isCommit ){
    needSyncPgno = pPg->pgno;
    assert( pPager->journalMode==2                     ||
            pageInJournal(pPager, pPg) || pPg->pgno>pPager->dbOrigSize );
    assert( pPg->flags&0x002       );
  }






  pPg->flags &= ~0x008          ;
  pPgOld = sqlite3PagerLookup(pPager, pgno);
  assert( !pPgOld || pPgOld->nRef==1 ||(sqlite3Config.neverCorrupt==0));
  if( pPgOld ){
    if((0)                    ){
      sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPgOld);
      return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
    }
    pPg->flags |= (pPgOld->flags&0x008          );
    if( pPager->tempFile ){


      sqlite3PcacheMove(pPgOld, pPager->dbSize+1);
    }else{
      sqlite3PcacheDrop(pPgOld);
    }
  }

  origPgno = pPg->pgno;
  sqlite3PcacheMove(pPg, pgno);
  sqlite3PcacheMakeDirty(pPg);





  if( pPager->tempFile && pPgOld ){
    sqlite3PcacheMove(pPgOld, origPgno);
    sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPgOld);
  }

  if( needSyncPgno ){














    PgHdr *pPgHdr;
    rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pPager, needSyncPgno, &pPgHdr, 0);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      if( needSyncPgno<=pPager->dbOrigSize ){
        assert( pPager->pTmpSpace!=0 );
        sqlite3BitvecClear(pPager->pInJournal, needSyncPgno, pPager->pTmpSpace);
      }
      return rc;
    }
    pPgHdr->flags |=0x008           ;
    sqlite3PcacheMakeDirty(pPgHdr);
    sqlite3PagerUnrefNotNull(pPgHdr);
  }

  return 0        ;
}

  pPg->flags = flags;
  sqlite3PcacheMove(pPg, iNew);
}

static         int sqlite3PagerLockingMode(Pager *pPager, int eMode){
  assert( eMode==-1
            || eMode==0
            || eMode==1                           );
  assert(-1                      <0 );
  assert(0                        >=0 &&1                           >=0 );
  assert( pPager->exclusiveMode || 0==0                                  );
  if( eMode>=0 && !pPager->tempFile && !0                                  ){
    pPager->exclusiveMode = (u8)eMode;
  }
  return (int)pPager->exclusiveMode;
}





















static         int sqlite3PagerSetJournalMode(Pager *pPager, int eMode){
  u8 eOld = pPager->journalMode;


  assert(      eMode==0
            || eMode==1
            || eMode==2
            || eMode==3
            || eMode==4
            || eMode==5                                   );





  assert( pPager->tempFile==0 || eMode!=5                     );




  if(0      ){
    assert( eOld==4                        || eOld==2                     );
    if( eMode!=4                        && eMode!=2                     ){
      eMode = eOld;
    }
  }

  if( eMode!=eOld ){


    assert( pPager->eState!=6           );
    pPager->journalMode = (u8)eMode;





    assert( (3                          & 5)==1 );
    assert( (1                         & 5)==1 );
    assert( (0                        & 5)==0 );
    assert( (4                        & 5)==4 );
    assert( (2                     & 5)==0 );
    assert( (5                     & 5)==5 );

    assert(((pPager->fd)->pMethods!=0)||pPager->exclusiveMode);
    if( !pPager->exclusiveMode && (eOld & 5)==1 && (eMode & 1)==0 ){








      sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
      if( pPager->eLock>=2             ){
        sqlite3OsDelete(pPager->pVfs, pPager->zJournal, 0);
      }else{
        int rc =0         ;
        int state = pPager->eState;
        assert( state==0          || state==1            );
        if( state==0          ){
          rc = sqlite3PagerSharedLock(pPager);
        }
        if( pPager->eState==1            ){
          assert( rc==0         );
          rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,2             );
        }
        if( rc==0         ){
          sqlite3OsDelete(pPager->pVfs, pPager->zJournal, 0);
        }
        if( rc==0         && state==1            ){
          pagerUnlockDb(pPager,1           );
        }else if( state==0          ){
          pager_unlock(pPager);
        }
        assert( state==pPager->eState );
      }
    }else if( eMode==2                     ){
      sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);
    }
  }


  return (int)pPager->journalMode;
}

}

  return 1;
}

     ;

static         int sqlite3PagerWalSupported(Pager *pPager){
  const sqlite3_io_methods *pMethods = pPager->fd->pMethods;
  if( pPager->noLock ) return 0;
  return pPager->exclusiveMode || (pMethods->iVersion>=2 && pMethods->xShmMap);
}





static int pagerExclusiveLock(Pager *pPager){
  int rc;

  assert( pPager->eLock==1           || pPager->eLock==4              );
  rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,4              );
  if( rc!=0         ){


    pagerUnlockDb(pPager,1           );
  }

  return rc;
}







static int pagerOpenWal(Pager *pPager){
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pPager->pWal==0 && pPager->tempFile==0 );
  assert( pPager->eLock==1           || pPager->eLock==4              );






  if( pPager->exclusiveMode ){
    rc = pagerExclusiveLock(pPager);
  }




  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3WalOpen(pPager->pVfs, 
        pPager->fd, pPager->zWal, pPager->exclusiveMode, 
        pPager->journalSizeLimit, &pPager->pWal 
    );
  }
  pagerFixMaplimit(pPager);

  return rc;
}

















static         int sqlite3PagerOpenWal(
  Pager *pPager,
  int *pbOpen
){
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( assert_pager_state(pPager) );
  assert( pPager->eState==0            || pbOpen );
  assert( pPager->eState==1            || !pbOpen );
  assert( pbOpen==0 || *pbOpen==0 );
  assert( pbOpen!=0 || (!pPager->tempFile && !pPager->pWal) );

  if( !pPager->tempFile && !pPager->pWal ){
    if( !sqlite3PagerWalSupported(pPager) ) return 14             ;


    sqlite3OsClose(pPager->jfd);

    rc = pagerOpenWal(pPager);
    if( rc==0         ){
      pPager->journalMode =5                     ;
      pPager->eState =0          ;
    }
  }else{
    *pbOpen = 1;
  }

  return rc;
}










static         int sqlite3PagerCloseWal(Pager *pPager, sqlite3 *db){
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pPager->journalMode==5                     );





  if( !pPager->pWal ){
    int logexists = 0;
    rc = pagerLockDb(pPager,1           );
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sqlite3OsAccess(
          pPager->pVfs, pPager->zWal,0                    , &logexists
      );
    }
    if( rc==0         && logexists ){
      rc = pagerOpenWal(pPager);
    }
  }




  if( rc==0         && pPager->pWal ){
    rc = pagerExclusiveLock(pPager);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc =0
                                                                    ;
      pPager->pWal = 0;
      pagerFixMaplimit(pPager);
      if( rc && !pPager->exclusiveMode ) pagerUnlockDb(pPager,1           );
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

    rc = sqlite3WalWriteLock(pPager->pWal, bLock);
  }
  return rc;
}

static         int sqlite3WalTrace = 0;












































typedef struct WalIndexHdr WalIndexHdr;
typedef struct WalIterator WalIterator;
typedef struct WalCkptInfo WalCkptInfo;















struct WalIndexHdr {
  u32 iVersion;
  u32 unused;
  u32 iChange;
  u8 isInit;
  u8 bigEndCksum;
  u16 szPage;
  u32 mxFrame;
  u32 nPage;
  u32 aFrameCksum[2];
  u32 aSalt[2];
  u32 aCksum[2];
};




























































struct WalCkptInfo {
  u32 nBackfill;
  u32 aReadMark[(8 -3)     ];
  u8 aLock[8               ];
  u32 nBackfillAttempted;
  u32 notUsed0;
};









































































































struct Wal {
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs;
  sqlite3_file *pDbFd;
  sqlite3_file *pWalFd;
  u32 iCallback;
  i64 mxWalSize;
  int nWiData;
  int szFirstBlock;
  volatile u32 **apWiData;
  u32 szPage;
  i16 readLock;
  u8 syncFlags;
  u8 exclusiveMode;
  u8 writeLock;
  u8 ckptLock;
  u8 readOnly;
  u8 truncateOnCommit;
  u8 syncHeader;
  u8 padToSectorBoundary;
  u8 bShmUnreliable;
  WalIndexHdr hdr;
  u32 minFrame;
  u32 iReCksum;
  const char *zWalName;
  u32 nCkpt;

  u8 lockError;


  WalIndexHdr *pSnapshot;


  sqlite3 *db;

};



















typedef u16 ht_slot;
















struct WalIterator {
  u32 iPrior;
  int nSegment;
  struct WalSegment {
    int iNext;
    ht_slot *aIndex;
    u32 *aPgno;
    int nEntry;
    int iZero;
  } aSegment[1];
};











































static __attribute__((noinline))int walIndexPageRealloc(
  Wal *pWal,
  int iPage,
  volatile u32 **ppPage
){
  int rc =0         ;


  if( pWal->nWiData<=iPage ){
    sqlite3_int64 nByte = sizeof(u32*)*(iPage+1);
    volatile u32 **apNew;
    apNew = (volatile u32 **)sqlite3Realloc((void *)pWal->apWiData, nByte);
    if( !apNew ){
      *ppPage = 0;
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    memset((void*)&apNew[pWal->nWiData], 0,
           sizeof(u32*)*(iPage+1 -pWal->nWiData));
    pWal->apWiData = apNew;
    pWal->nWiData = iPage+1;
  }


  assert( pWal->apWiData[iPage]==0 );
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode==2                   ){
    pWal->apWiData[iPage] = (u32 volatile *)sqlite3MallocZero(( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) ));
    if( !pWal->apWiData[iPage] ) rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }else{
    rc = sqlite3OsShmMap(pWal->pDbFd, iPage,( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) ),
        pWal->writeLock, (void volatile **)&pWal->apWiData[iPage]
    );
    assert( pWal->apWiData[iPage]!=0
         || rc!=0
         || (pWal->writeLock==0 && iPage==0) );
if( pWal->apWiData[iPage]==0 && rc==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( iPage>0 &&0                     ) rc =7            ;
    }else if( (rc&0xff)==8               ){
      pWal->readOnly |=2              ;
      if( rc==8               ){
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
  }

  *ppPage = pWal->apWiData[iPage];
  assert( iPage==0 || *ppPage || rc!=0         );
  return rc;
}
static int walIndexPage(
  Wal *pWal,
  int iPage,
  volatile u32 **ppPage
){
  if( pWal->nWiData<=iPage || (*ppPage = pWal->apWiData[iPage])==0 ){
    return walIndexPageRealloc(pWal, iPage, ppPage);
  }
  return 0        ;
}




static volatile WalCkptInfo *walCkptInfo(Wal *pWal){
  assert( pWal->nWiData>0 && pWal->apWiData[0] );
  return (volatile WalCkptInfo*)&(pWal->apWiData[0][sizeof(WalIndexHdr)/2]);
}




static volatile WalIndexHdr *walIndexHdr(Wal *pWal){
  assert( pWal->nWiData>0 && pWal->apWiData[0] );
  return (volatile WalIndexHdr*)pWal->apWiData[0];
}






















static void walChecksumBytes(
  int nativeCksum,
  u8 *a,
  int nByte,
  const u32 *aIn,
  u32 *aOut
){
  u32 s1, s2;
  u32 *aData = (u32 *)a;
  u32 *aEnd = (u32 *)&a[nByte];

  if( aIn ){
    s1 = aIn[0];
    s2 = aIn[1];
  }else{
    s1 = s2 = 0;
  }

  assert( nByte>=8 );
  assert( (nByte&0x00000007)==0 );
  assert( nByte<=65536 );

  if( nativeCksum ){
    do {
      s1 += *aData++ + s2;
      s2 += *aData++ + s1;
    }while( aData<aEnd );
  }else{
    do {
      s1 +=( (((aData[0])&0x000000FF)<<24) + (((aData[0])&0x0000FF00)<<8) + (((aData[0])&0x00FF0000)>>8) + (((aData[0])&0xFF000000)>>24) )+s2;
      s2 +=( (((aData[1])&0x000000FF)<<24) + (((aData[1])&0x0000FF00)<<8) + (((aData[1])&0x00FF0000)>>8) + (((aData[1])&0xFF000000)>>24) )+s1;
      aData += 2;
    }while( aData<aEnd );
  }

  aOut[0] = s1;
  aOut[1] = s2;
}





static void walShmBarrier(Wal *pWal){
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode!=2                   ){
    sqlite3OsShmBarrier(pWal->pDbFd);
  }
}



















static __attribute__((no_sanitize_thread))void walIndexWriteHdr(Wal*pWal){
  volatile WalIndexHdr *aHdr = walIndexHdr(pWal);
  const int nCksum =((int)((char*)&((WalIndexHdr*)0)->aCksum));

  assert( pWal->writeLock );
  pWal->hdr.isInit = 1;
  pWal->hdr.iVersion =3007000              ;
  walChecksumBytes(1, (u8*)&pWal->hdr, nCksum, 0, pWal->hdr.aCksum);

{char*xxd=(char*)((void*)&aHdr[1]);const char*xxs=(const char*)((const void*)&pWal->hdr); int xxn=(sizeof(WalIndexHdr));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  walShmBarrier(pWal);
{char*xxd=(char*)((void*)&aHdr[0]);const char*xxs=(const char*)((const void*)&pWal->hdr); int xxn=(sizeof(WalIndexHdr));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
}














static void walEncodeFrame(
  Wal *pWal,
  u32 iPage,
  u32 nTruncate,
  u8 *aData,
  u8 *aFrame
){
  int nativeCksum;
  u32 *aCksum = pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum;
  assert(24                ==24 );
  sqlite3Put4byte(&aFrame[0], iPage);
  sqlite3Put4byte(&aFrame[4], nTruncate);
  if( pWal->iReCksum==0 ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&aFrame[8]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pWal->hdr.aSalt); int xxn=(8);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};

    nativeCksum = (pWal->hdr.bigEndCksum==1               );
    walChecksumBytes(nativeCksum, aFrame, 8, aCksum, aCksum);
    walChecksumBytes(nativeCksum, aData, pWal->szPage, aCksum, aCksum);

    sqlite3Put4byte(&aFrame[16], aCksum[0]);
    sqlite3Put4byte(&aFrame[20], aCksum[1]);
  }else{
    memset(&aFrame[8], 0, 16);
  }
}






static int walDecodeFrame(
  Wal *pWal,
  u32 *piPage,
  u32 *pnTruncate,
  u8 *aData,
  u8 *aFrame
){
  int nativeCksum;
  u32 *aCksum = pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum;
  u32 pgno;
  assert(24                ==24 );




  if( memcmp(&pWal->hdr.aSalt, &aFrame[8], 8)!=0 ){
    return 0;
  }



  pgno = sqlite3Get4byte(&aFrame[0]);
  if( pgno==0 ){
    return 0;
  }






  nativeCksum = (pWal->hdr.bigEndCksum==1               );
  walChecksumBytes(nativeCksum, aFrame, 8, aCksum, aCksum);
  walChecksumBytes(nativeCksum, aData, pWal->szPage, aCksum, aCksum);
  if( aCksum[0]!=sqlite3Get4byte(&aFrame[16])
   || aCksum[1]!=sqlite3Get4byte(&aFrame[20])
  ){

    return 0;
  }




  *piPage = pgno;
  *pnTruncate = sqlite3Get4byte(&aFrame[4]);
  return 1;
}







static const char *walLockName(int lockIdx){
  if( lockIdx==0              ){
    return "WRITE-LOCK";
  }else if( lockIdx==1             ){
    return "CKPT-LOCK";
  }else if( lockIdx==2                ){
    return "RECOVER-LOCK";
  }else{
    static char zName[15];
    sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(zName), zName, "READ-LOCK[%d]",
                     lockIdx-(3 +(0))        );
    return zName;
  }
}










static int walLockShared(Wal *pWal, int lockIdx){
  int rc;
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode ) return 0        ;
  rc = sqlite3OsShmLock(pWal->pDbFd, lockIdx, 1,
2                                       |4                 );
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: acquire SHARED-%s %s\n", pWal, 
walLockName(lockIdx), rc ? "failed" : "ok")             ;
pWal->lockError = (u8)(rc!=0 && (rc&0xFF)!=5);
  return rc;
}
static void walUnlockShared(Wal *pWal, int lockIdx){
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode ) return;
  (void)sqlite3OsShmLock(pWal->pDbFd, lockIdx, 1,
1                                          |4                 );
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: release SHARED-%s\n", pWal, walLockName(lockIdx));
}
static int walLockExclusive(Wal *pWal, int lockIdx, int n){
  int rc;
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode ) return 0        ;
  rc = sqlite3OsShmLock(pWal->pDbFd, lockIdx, n,
2                                       |8                    );
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: acquire EXCLUSIVE-%s cnt=%d %s\n", pWal, 
walLockName(lockIdx), n, rc ? "failed" : "ok")             ;
pWal->lockError = (u8)(rc!=0 && (rc&0xFF)!=5);
  return rc;
}
static void walUnlockExclusive(Wal *pWal, int lockIdx, int n){
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode ) return;
  (void)sqlite3OsShmLock(pWal->pDbFd, lockIdx, n,
1                                          |8                    );
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: release EXCLUSIVE-%s cnt=%d\n", pWal, 
walLockName(lockIdx), n)              ;
}






static int walHash(u32 iPage){
  assert( iPage>0 );
  assert( ((4096*2)        & ((4096*2)       -1))==0 );
  return (iPage*383             ) & ((4096*2)       -1);
}
static int walNextHash(int iPriorHash){
  return (iPriorHash+1)&((4096*2)       -1);
}






typedef struct WalHashLoc WalHashLoc;
struct WalHashLoc {
  volatile ht_slot *aHash;
  volatile u32 *aPgno;
  u32 iZero;
};















static int walHashGet(
  Wal *pWal,
  int iHash,
  WalHashLoc *pLoc
){
  int rc;

  rc = walIndexPage(pWal, iHash, &pLoc->aPgno);
  assert( rc==0         || iHash>0 );

  if( pLoc->aPgno ){
    pLoc->aHash = (volatile ht_slot *)&pLoc->aPgno[4096           ];
    if( iHash==0 ){
      pLoc->aPgno = &pLoc->aPgno[(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)];
      pLoc->iZero = 0;
    }else{
      pLoc->iZero =(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+(iHash-1)*4096;
    }
  }else if((0)                   ){
    rc =1            ;
  }
  return rc;
}







static int walFramePage(u32 iFrame){
  int iHash = (iFrame+4096           -(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))-1)/4096;
  assert( (iHash==0 || iFrame>(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32))))
       && (iHash>=1 || iFrame<=(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32))))
       && (iHash<=1 || iFrame>((4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+4096))
       && (iHash>=2 || iFrame<=(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+4096)
       && (iHash<=2 || iFrame>((4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+2*4096))
  );
  assert( iHash>=0 );
  return iHash;
}




static u32 walFramePgno(Wal *pWal, u32 iFrame){
  int iHash = walFramePage(iFrame);
  if( iHash==0 ){
    return pWal->apWiData[0][(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)+iFrame-1];
  }
  return pWal->apWiData[iHash][(iFrame-1 -(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32))))%4096];
}













static void walCleanupHash(Wal *pWal){
  WalHashLoc sLoc;
  int iLimit = 0;
  int nByte;
  int i;

  assert( pWal->writeLock );
if( pWal->hdr.mxFrame==(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))-1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pWal->hdr.mxFrame==(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32))) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pWal->hdr.mxFrame==(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

  if( pWal->hdr.mxFrame==0 ) return;





  assert( pWal->nWiData>walFramePage(pWal->hdr.mxFrame) );
  assert( pWal->apWiData[walFramePage(pWal->hdr.mxFrame)] );
  i = walHashGet(pWal, walFramePage(pWal->hdr.mxFrame), &sLoc);
  if((0)       ) return;




  iLimit = pWal->hdr.mxFrame - sLoc.iZero;
  assert( iLimit>0 );
  for(i=0; i<(4096*2)       ; i++){
    if( sLoc.aHash[i]>iLimit ){
      sLoc.aHash[i] = 0;
    }
  }




  nByte = (int)((char *)sLoc.aHash - (char *)&sLoc.aPgno[iLimit]);
  assert( nByte>=0 );
  memset((void *)&sLoc.aPgno[iLimit], 0, nByte);





  if( iLimit ){
    int j;
    int iKey;
    for(j=0; j<iLimit; j++){
      for(iKey=walHash(sLoc.aPgno[j]);sLoc.aHash[iKey];iKey=walNextHash(iKey)){
        if( sLoc.aHash[iKey]==j+1 ) break;
      }
      assert( sLoc.aHash[iKey]==j+1 );
    }
  }

}






static int walIndexAppend(Wal *pWal, u32 iFrame, u32 iPage){
  int rc;
  WalHashLoc sLoc;

  rc = walHashGet(pWal, walFramePage(iFrame), &sLoc);




  if( rc==0         ){
    int iKey;
    int idx;
    int nCollide;

    idx = iFrame - sLoc.iZero;
    assert( idx <=(4096*2)        /2 + 1 );




    if( idx==1 ){
      int nByte = (int)((u8*)&sLoc.aHash[(4096*2)       ] - (u8*)sLoc.aPgno);
      assert( nByte>=0 );
      memset((void*)sLoc.aPgno, 0, nByte);
    }







    if( sLoc.aPgno[idx-1] ){
      walCleanupHash(pWal);
      assert( !sLoc.aPgno[idx-1] );
    }


    nCollide = idx;
    for(iKey=walHash(iPage); sLoc.aHash[iKey]; iKey=walNextHash(iKey)){
      if( (nCollide--)==0 ) return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
    }
    sLoc.aPgno[idx-1] = iPage;
__atomic_store_n((&sLoc.aHash[iKey]),((ht_slot)idx),__ATOMIC_RELAXED);





    {
      int i;
      int nEntry = 0;
      for(i=0; i<(4096*2)       ; i++){ if( sLoc.aHash[i] ) nEntry++; }
      assert( nEntry==idx );
    }






    if( (idx&0x3ff)==0 ){
      int i;
      for(i=0; i<idx; i++){
        for(iKey=walHash(sLoc.aPgno[i]);
            sLoc.aHash[iKey];
            iKey=walNextHash(iKey)){
          if( sLoc.aHash[iKey]==i+1 ) break;
        }
        assert( sLoc.aHash[iKey]==i+1 );
      }
    }

  }

  return rc;
}












static int walIndexRecover(Wal *pWal){
  int rc;
  i64 nSize;
  u32 aFrameCksum[2] = {0, 0};
  int iLock;







  assert( pWal->ckptLock==1 || pWal->ckptLock==0 );
  assert(1                 ==0             +1 );
  assert(1             ==1                 );
  assert( pWal->writeLock );
  iLock =1                  + pWal->ckptLock;
  rc = walLockExclusive(pWal, iLock,(3 +(0))         -iLock);
  if( rc ){
    return rc;
  }

if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: recovery begin...\n", pWal);

  memset(&pWal->hdr, 0, sizeof(WalIndexHdr));

  rc = sqlite3OsFileSize(pWal->pWalFd, &nSize);
  if( rc!=0         ){
    goto recovery_error;
  }

  if( nSize>32          ){
    u8 aBuf[32         ];
    u32 *aPrivate = 0;
    u8 *aFrame = 0;
    int szFrame;
    u8 *aData;
    int szPage;
    u32 magic;
    u32 version;
    int isValid;
    u32 iPg;
    u32 iLastFrame;


    rc = sqlite3OsRead(pWal->pWalFd, aBuf,32          , 0);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto recovery_error;
    }






    magic = sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[0]);
    szPage = sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[8]);
    if( (magic&0xFFFFFFFE)!=0x377f0682
     || szPage&(szPage-1)
     || szPage>65536
     || szPage<512
    ){
      goto finished;
    }
    pWal->hdr.bigEndCksum = (u8)(magic&0x00000001);
    pWal->szPage = szPage;
    pWal->nCkpt = sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[12]);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pWal->hdr.aSalt);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aBuf[16]); int xxn=(8);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};


    walChecksumBytes(pWal->hdr.bigEndCksum==1               ,
        aBuf,32          -2*4, 0, pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum
    );
    if( pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[0]!=sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[24])
     || pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[1]!=sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[28])
    ){
      goto finished;
    }



    version = sqlite3Get4byte(&aBuf[4]);
    if( version!=3007000         ){
      rc =sqlite3CantopenError(__LINE__);
      goto finished;
    }


    szFrame = szPage +24                ;
    aFrame = (u8 *)sqlite3_malloc64(szFrame +( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) ));
    if( !aFrame ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      goto recovery_error;
    }
    aData = &aFrame[24               ];
    aPrivate = (u32*)&aData[szPage];


    iLastFrame = (nSize -32          ) / szFrame;
    for(iPg=0; iPg<=(u32)walFramePage(iLastFrame); iPg++){
      u32 *aShare;
      u32 iFrame;
      u32 iLast =((iLastFrame)<((4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+iPg*4096)?(iLastFrame):((4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+iPg*4096));
      u32 iFirst = 1 + (iPg==0?0:(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32)))+(iPg-1)*4096);
      u32 nHdr, nHdr32;
      rc = walIndexPage(pWal, iPg, (volatile u32**)&aShare);
      assert( aShare!=0 || rc!=0         );
      if( aShare==0 ) break;
      pWal->apWiData[iPg] = aPrivate;

      for(iFrame=iFirst; iFrame<=iLast; iFrame++){
        i64 iOffset =( 32 + ((iFrame)-1)*(i64)((szPage)+24) );
        u32 pgno;
        u32 nTruncate;


        rc = sqlite3OsRead(pWal->pWalFd, aFrame, szFrame, iOffset);
        if( rc!=0         ) break;
        isValid = walDecodeFrame(pWal, &pgno, &nTruncate, aData, aFrame);
        if( !isValid ) break;
        rc = walIndexAppend(pWal, iFrame, pgno);
        if((0)                   ) break;


        if( nTruncate ){
          pWal->hdr.mxFrame = iFrame;
          pWal->hdr.nPage = nTruncate;
          pWal->hdr.szPage = (u16)((szPage&0xff00) | (szPage>>16));
if( szPage<=32768 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( szPage>=65536 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
          aFrameCksum[0] = pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[0];
          aFrameCksum[1] = pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[1];
        }
      }
      pWal->apWiData[iPg] = aShare;
      nHdr = (iPg==0 ?(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo)):0);
      nHdr32 = nHdr / sizeof(u32);









{char*xxd=(char*)(&aShare[nHdr32]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aPrivate[nHdr32]); int xxn=(( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) )-nHdr);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};






      {
        int i;
        for(i=nHdr32; i<( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) )/sizeof(u32);i++){
          if( aShare[i]!=aPrivate[i] ){



            aShare[i] = aPrivate[i];
          }
        }
      }

      if( iFrame<=iLast ) break;
    }

    sqlite3_free(aFrame);
  }

finished:
  if( rc==0         ){
    volatile WalCkptInfo *pInfo;
    int i;
    pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[0] = aFrameCksum[0];
    pWal->hdr.aFrameCksum[1] = aFrameCksum[1];
    walIndexWriteHdr(pWal);





    pInfo = walCkptInfo(pWal);
    pInfo->nBackfill = 0;
    pInfo->nBackfillAttempted = pWal->hdr.mxFrame;
    pInfo->aReadMark[0] = 0;
    for(i=1; i<(8 -3)     ; i++){
      rc = walLockExclusive(pWal,(3 +(i))         , 1);
      if( rc==0         ){
        if( i==1 && pWal->hdr.mxFrame ){
          pInfo->aReadMark[i] = pWal->hdr.mxFrame;
        }else{
          pInfo->aReadMark[i] =0xffffffff        ;
        }
        walUnlockExclusive(pWal,(3 +(i))         , 1);
      }else if( rc!=5           ){
        goto recovery_error;
      }
    }






    if( pWal->hdr.nPage ){
      sqlite3_log((27 | (1<<8))            ,
          "recovered %d frames from WAL file %s",
          pWal->hdr.mxFrame, pWal->zWalName
      );
    }
  }

recovery_error:
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%p: recovery %s\n", pWal, rc ? "failed" : "ok");
  walUnlockExclusive(pWal, iLock,(3 +(0))         -iLock);
  return rc;
}




static void walIndexClose(Wal *pWal, int isDelete){
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode==2                   || pWal->bShmUnreliable ){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<pWal->nWiData; i++){
      sqlite3_free((void *)pWal->apWiData[i]);
      pWal->apWiData[i] = 0;
    }
  }
  if( pWal->exclusiveMode!=2                   ){
    sqlite3OsShmUnmap(pWal->pDbFd, isDelete);
  }
}
















static         int sqlite3WalOpen( 
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs, 
  sqlite3_file *pDbFd, 
  const char *zWalName, 
  int bNoShm, 
  i64 mxWalSize, 
  Wal **ppWal 
){
  int rc;
  Wal *pRet;
  int flags;

  assert( zWalName && zWalName[0] );
  assert( pDbFd );










  assert(    48 ==  sizeof(WalIndexHdr)  );
  assert(    40 ==  sizeof(WalCkptInfo)  );
  assert(   120 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock))));
  assert(   136 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo)));
  assert(  4096 ==4096                   );
  assert(  4062 ==(4096 - ((sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +sizeof(WalCkptInfo))/sizeof(u32))));
  assert(  8192 ==(4096*2)               );
  assert(   383 ==383                    );
  assert( 32768 ==( sizeof(ht_slot)*(4096*2) + 4096*sizeof(u32) ));
  assert(     8 ==8                      );
  assert(     5 ==(8 -3)                 );
  assert(    24 ==24                     );
  assert(    32 ==32                     );
  assert(   120 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+0);
  assert(   121 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+1);
  assert(   122 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+2);
  assert(   123 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+(3 +(0)));
  assert(   124 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+(3 +(1)));
  assert(   125 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+(3 +(2)));
  assert(   126 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+(3 +(3)));
  assert(   127 ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock)))+(3 +(4)));








  assert(((22 +8)*4)  ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock))));


  assert(((22 +8)*4)   ==(sizeof(WalIndexHdr)*2 +((int)((char*)&((WalCkptInfo*)0)->aLock))));




  *ppWal = 0;
  pRet = (Wal*)sqlite3MallocZero(sizeof(Wal) + pVfs->szOsFile);
  if( !pRet ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }

  pRet->pVfs = pVfs;
  pRet->pWalFd = (sqlite3_file *)&pRet[1];
  pRet->pDbFd = pDbFd;
  pRet->readLock = -1;
  pRet->mxWalSize = mxWalSize;
  pRet->zWalName = zWalName;
  pRet->syncHeader = 1;
  pRet->padToSectorBoundary = 1;
  pRet->exclusiveMode = (bNoShm ?2                   :0               );


  flags = (0x00000002           |0x00000004        |0x00080000     );
  rc = sqlite3OsOpen(pVfs, zWalName, pRet->pWalFd, flags, &flags);
  if( rc==0         && flags&0x00000001           ){
    pRet->readOnly =1          ;
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
    walIndexClose(pRet, 0);
    sqlite3OsClose(pRet->pWalFd);
    sqlite3_free(pRet);
  }else{
    int iDC = sqlite3OsDeviceCharacteristics(pDbFd);
    if( iDC &0x00000400               ){ pRet->syncHeader = 0; }
    if( iDC &0x00001000                        ){
      pRet->padToSectorBoundary = 0;
    }
    *ppWal = pRet;
if(sqlite3WalTrace) printf ("WAL%d: opened\n", pRet);
  }
  return rc;
}
