  pp = sqlite3PagerBackupPtr(sqlite3BtreePager(p->pSrc));
  p->pNext = *pp;
  *pp = p;
  p->isAttached = 1;
}




           int sqlite3_backup_step(sqlite3_backup *p, int nPage){
  int rc;
  int destMode;
  int pgszSrc = 0;
  int pgszDest = 0;


  if( p==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                       ;
                            ;
  if( p->pDestDb ){
                                          ;
  }

  rc = p->rc;
  if( !isFatalError(rc) ){
    Pager * const pSrcPager = sqlite3BtreePager(p->pSrc);
    Pager * const pDestPager = sqlite3BtreePager(p->pDest);
    int ii;
    int nSrcPage = -1;
    int bCloseTrans = 0;




    if( p->pDestDb && p->pSrc->pBt->inTransaction==2           ){
      rc =5           ;
    }else{
      rc =0         ;
    }





    if( rc==0         &&0               ==sqlite3BtreeTxnState(p->pSrc) ){
      rc = sqlite3BtreeBeginTrans(p->pSrc, 0, 0);
      bCloseTrans = 1;
    }







    if( p->bDestLocked==0 && rc==0         && setDestPgsz(p)==7            ){
      rc =7            ;
    }


    if(0         ==rc && p->bDestLocked==0
     &&0         ==(rc = sqlite3BtreeBeginTrans(p->pDest, 2,
                                                (int*)&p->iDestSchema))
    ){
      p->bDestLocked = 1;
    }



    pgszSrc = sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(p->pSrc);
    pgszDest = sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(p->pDest);
    destMode = sqlite3PagerGetJournalMode(sqlite3BtreePager(p->pDest));
    if(0         ==rc && destMode==5                     && pgszSrc!=pgszDest ){
      rc =8               ;
    }




    nSrcPage = (int)sqlite3BtreeLastPage(p->pSrc);
    assert( nSrcPage>=0 );
    for(ii=0; (nPage<0 || ii<nPage) && p->iNext<=(Pgno)nSrcPage && !rc; ii++){
      const Pgno iSrcPg = p->iNext;
      if( iSrcPg!=((Pgno)(((0x40000000)/((p->pSrc->pBt)->pageSize))+1))){
        DbPage *pSrcPg;
        rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pSrcPager, iSrcPg, &pSrcPg,0x02              );
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = backupOnePage(p, iSrcPg, sqlite3PagerGetData(pSrcPg), 0);
          sqlite3PagerUnref(pSrcPg);
        }
      }
      p->iNext++;
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      p->nPagecount = nSrcPage;
      p->nRemaining = nSrcPage+1 -p->iNext;
      if( p->iNext>(Pgno)nSrcPage ){
        rc =101         ;
      }else if( !p->isAttached ){
        attachBackupObject(p);
      }
    }






    if( rc==101         ){
      if( nSrcPage==0 ){
        rc = sqlite3BtreeNewDb(p->pDest);
        nSrcPage = 1;
      }
      if( rc==0         || rc==101         ){
        rc = sqlite3BtreeUpdateMeta(p->pDest,1,p->iDestSchema+1);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        if( p->pDestDb ){
          sqlite3ResetAllSchemasOfConnection(p->pDestDb);
        }
        if( destMode==5                     ){
          rc = sqlite3BtreeSetVersion(p->pDest, 2);
        }
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        int nDestTruncate;












        assert( pgszSrc==sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(p->pSrc) );
        assert( pgszDest==sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(p->pDest) );
        if( pgszSrc<pgszDest ){
          int ratio = pgszDest/pgszSrc;
          nDestTruncate = (nSrcPage+ratio-1)/ratio;
          if( nDestTruncate==(int)((Pgno)(((0x40000000)/((p->pDest->pBt)->pageSize))+1))){
            nDestTruncate--;
          }
        }else{
          nDestTruncate = nSrcPage * (pgszSrc/pgszDest);
        }
        assert( nDestTruncate>0 );

        if( pgszSrc<pgszDest ){









          const i64 iSize = (i64)pgszSrc * (i64)nSrcPage;
          sqlite3_file * const pFile = sqlite3PagerFile(pDestPager);
          Pgno iPg;
          int nDstPage;
          i64 iOff;
          i64 iEnd;

          assert( pFile );
          assert( nDestTruncate==0
              || (i64)nDestTruncate*(i64)pgszDest >= iSize || (
                nDestTruncate==(int)(((Pgno)(((0x40000000)/((p->pDest->pBt)->pageSize))+1))-1)
             && iSize>=(0x40000000) && iSize<=(0x40000000)+pgszDest
          ));







          sqlite3PagerPagecount(pDestPager, &nDstPage);
          for(iPg=nDestTruncate; rc==0         && iPg<=(Pgno)nDstPage; iPg++){
            if( iPg!=((Pgno)(((0x40000000)/((p->pDest->pBt)->pageSize))+1))){
              DbPage *pPg;
              rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pDestPager, iPg, &pPg, 0);
              if( rc==0         ){
                rc = sqlite3PagerWrite(pPg);
                sqlite3PagerUnref(pPg);
              }
            }
          }
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseOne(pDestPager, 0, 1);
          }


          iEnd =(((0x40000000) + pgszDest)<(iSize)?((0x40000000) + pgszDest):(iSize));
          for(
            iOff=(0x40000000)+pgszSrc;
            rc==0         && iOff<iEnd;
            iOff+=pgszSrc
          ){
            PgHdr *pSrcPg = 0;
            const Pgno iSrcPg = (Pgno)((iOff/pgszSrc)+1);
            rc = sqlite3PagerGet(pSrcPager, iSrcPg, &pSrcPg, 0);
            if( rc==0         ){
              u8 *zData = sqlite3PagerGetData(pSrcPg);
              rc = sqlite3OsWrite(pFile, zData, pgszSrc, iOff);
            }
            sqlite3PagerUnref(pSrcPg);
          }
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = backupTruncateFile(pFile, iSize);
          }


          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = sqlite3PagerSync(pDestPager, 0);
          }
        }else{
          sqlite3PagerTruncateImage(pDestPager, nDestTruncate);
          rc = sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseOne(pDestPager, 0, 0);
        }


        if(0         ==rc
         &&0         ==(rc = sqlite3BtreeCommitPhaseTwo(p->pDest, 0))
        ){
          rc =101         ;
        }
      }
    }






    if( bCloseTrans ){
int rc2                  ;
rc2 =                    sqlite3BtreeCommitPhaseOne(p->pSrc, 0);
rc2 |=                   sqlite3BtreeCommitPhaseTwo(p->pSrc, 0);
      assert( rc2==0         );
    }

    if( rc==(10 | (12<<8))     ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    p->rc = rc;
  }
  if( p->pDestDb ){
                                          ;
  }
                            ;
                                       ;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_backup_finish(sqlite3_backup *p){
  sqlite3_backup **pp;
  sqlite3 *pSrcDb;
  int rc;


  if( p==0 ) return 0        ;
  pSrcDb = p->pSrcDb;
                                    ;
                            ;
  if( p->pDestDb ){
                                          ;
  }


  if( p->pDestDb ){
    p->pSrc->nBackup--;
  }
  if( p->isAttached ){
    pp = sqlite3PagerBackupPtr(sqlite3BtreePager(p->pSrc));
    assert( pp!=0 );
    while( *pp!=p ){
      pp = &(*pp)->pNext;
      assert( pp!=0 );
    }
    *pp = p->pNext;
  }


  sqlite3BtreeRollback(p->pDest,0         , 0);


  rc = (p->rc==101        ) ?0          : p->rc;
  if( p->pDestDb ){
    sqlite3Error(p->pDestDb, rc);


    sqlite3LeaveMutexAndCloseZombie(p->pDestDb);
  }
                            ;
  if( p->pDestDb ){



    sqlite3_free(p);
  }
  sqlite3LeaveMutexAndCloseZombie(pSrcDb);
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_backup_remaining(sqlite3_backup *p){

  if( p==0 ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  return p->nRemaining;
}





           int sqlite3_backup_pagecount(sqlite3_backup *p){

  if( p==0 ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  return p->nPagecount;
}













static __attribute__((noinline))void backupUpdate(
  sqlite3_backup *p,
  Pgno iPage,
  const u8 *aData
){
  assert( p!=0 );
  do{
    assert(((void)(p->pSrc->pBt->mutex),1)          );
    if( !isFatalError(p->rc) && iPage<p->iNext ){




      int rc;
      assert( p->pDestDb );
                                            ;
      rc = backupOnePage(p, iPage, aData, 1);
                                            ;
      assert( rc!=5           && rc!=6             );
      if( rc!=0         ){
        p->rc = rc;
      }
    }
  }while( (p = p->pNext)!=0 );
}
static         void sqlite3BackupUpdate(sqlite3_backup *pBackup, Pgno iPage, const u8 *aData){
  if( pBackup ) backupUpdate(pBackup, iPage, aData);
}












static         void sqlite3BackupRestart(sqlite3_backup *pBackup){
  sqlite3_backup *p;
  for(p=pBackup; p; p=p->pNext){
    assert(((void)(p->pSrc->pBt->mutex),1)          );
    p->iNext = 1;
  }
}










static         int sqlite3BtreeCopyFile(Btree *pTo, Btree *pFrom){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_file *pFd;
  sqlite3_backup b;
                        ;
                          ;

  assert( sqlite3BtreeTxnState(pTo)==2                );
  pFd = sqlite3PagerFile(sqlite3BtreePager(pTo));
  if( pFd->pMethods ){
    i64 nByte = sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize(pFrom)*(i64)sqlite3BtreeLastPage(pFrom);
    rc = sqlite3OsFileControl(pFd,11                     , &nByte);
    if( rc==12              ) rc =0         ;
    if( rc ) goto copy_finished;
  }






  memset(&b, 0, sizeof(b));
  b.pSrcDb = pFrom->db;
  b.pSrc = pFrom;
  b.pDest = pTo;
  b.iNext = 1;







  sqlite3_backup_step(&b, 0x7FFFFFFF);
  assert( b.rc!=0         );

  rc = sqlite3_backup_finish(&b);
  if( rc==0         ){
    pTo->pBt->btsFlags &= ~0x0002            ;
  }else{
    sqlite3PagerClearCache(sqlite3BtreePager(b.pDest));
  }

  assert( sqlite3BtreeTxnState(pTo)!=2                );
copy_finished:
                          ;
                        ;
  return rc;
}




































static         int sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(Mem *p){



  assert( (p->flags &0x1000  )==0 || p->xDel!=0 );





  assert( (p->flags &0x1000  )==0 || p->szMalloc==0 );


  assert((((p->flags & (0x0004|0x0008|0x0020))&((p->flags & (0x0004|0x0008|0x0020))-1))==0));

  if( p->flags &0x0001    ){

    assert( (p->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0002 |0x0010  |0x8000 ))==0 );






    if( (p->flags & (0x0200  |0x0800     ))==(0x0200  |0x0800     ) ){


      assert( ((p->flags&0x1000 )!=0 ? 1 : 0) +
              ((p->flags&0x4000   )!=0 ? 1 : 0) +
              ((p->flags&0x2000    )!=0 ? 1 : 0) <= 1 );


      assert( (p->flags & ~(0x0001  |0x0200  |0x0800     |0x0040
                           |0x1000 |0x4000   |0x2000    ))==0 );
    }else{


    }
  }else{

    assert( (p->flags &0x0100      )==0 );
  }


  assert( p->szMalloc==0
       || (p->flags==0x0000
           && p->szMalloc<=sqlite3DbMallocSize(p->db,p->zMalloc))
       || p->szMalloc==sqlite3DbMallocSize(p->db,p->zMalloc));









  if( (p->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  )) && p->n>0 ){
    assert(
      ((p->szMalloc>0 && p->z==p->zMalloc)? 1 : 0) +
      ((p->flags&0x1000 )!=0 ? 1 : 0) +
      ((p->flags&0x4000   )!=0 ? 1 : 0) +
      ((p->flags&0x2000    )!=0 ? 1 : 0) == 1
    );
  }
  return 1;
}






static void vdbeMemRenderNum(int sz, char *zBuf, Mem *p){
  StrAccum acc;
  assert( p->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     ) );
  assert( sz>22 );
  if( p->flags &0x0004   ){



    i64 x;
    assert( (p->flags&0x0004 )*2==sizeof(x) );
{char*xxd=(char*)(&x);const char*xxs=(const char*)((char*)&p->u); int xxn=((p->flags&0x0004)*2);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    p->n = sqlite3Int64ToText(x, zBuf);

    p->n = sqlite3Int64ToText(p->u.i, zBuf);

  }else{
    sqlite3StrAccumInit(&acc, 0, zBuf, sz, 0);
    sqlite3_str_appendf(&acc, "%!.15g",
         (p->flags &0x0020      )!=0 ? (sqlite_int64)p->u.i:p->u.r);
    assert( acc.zText==zBuf && acc.mxAlloc<=0 );
    zBuf[acc.nChar] = 0;
    p->n = acc.nChar;
  }
}
























static         int sqlite3VdbeMemValidStrRep(Mem *p){
  Mem tmp;
  char zBuf[100];
  char *z;
  int i, j, incr;
  if( (p->flags &0x0002  )==0 ) return 1;
  if( p->flags &0x0200    ){


    if( p->szMalloc>0 && p->z==p->zMalloc ){
      assert( p->enc==1           || p->szMalloc >= ((p->n+1)&~1)+2 );
      assert( p->enc!=1           || p->szMalloc >= p->n+1 );
    }
    assert( p->z[p->n]==0 );
    assert( p->enc==1           || p->z[(p->n+1)&~1]==0 );
    assert( p->enc==1           || p->z[((p->n+1)&~1)+1]==0 );
  }
  if( (p->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     ))==0 ) return 1;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&tmp);const char*xxs=(const char*)(p); int xxn=(sizeof(tmp));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  vdbeMemRenderNum(sizeof(zBuf), zBuf, &tmp);
  z = p->z;
  i = j = 0;
  incr = 1;
  if( p->enc!=1           ){
    incr = 2;
    if( p->enc==3              ) z++;
  }
  while( zBuf[j] ){
    if( zBuf[j++]!=z[i] ) return 0;
    i += incr;
  }
  return 1;
}















static         int sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(Mem *pMem, int desiredEnc){

  int rc;

  assert( pMem!=0 );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pMem) );
  assert( desiredEnc==1           || desiredEnc==2
           || desiredEnc==3              );
  if( !(pMem->flags&0x0002 ) ){
    pMem->enc = desiredEnc;
    return 0        ;
  }
  if( pMem->enc==desiredEnc ){
    return 0        ;
  }
  assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );

  return 1           ;





  rc = sqlite3VdbeMemTranslate(pMem, (u8)desiredEnc);
  assert(rc==0            || rc==7           );
  assert(rc==0            || pMem->enc!=desiredEnc);
  assert(rc==7            || pMem->enc==desiredEnc);
  return rc;

}









static __attribute__((noinline))int sqlite3VdbeMemGrow(Mem*pMem, int n, int bPreserve){
  assert( sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(pMem) );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pMem) );
if( pMem->db==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };



  assert( bPreserve==0 || pMem->flags&(0x0010  |0x0002 ) );
if( bPreserve && pMem->z==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

  assert( pMem->szMalloc==0
       || (pMem->flags==0x0000
           && pMem->szMalloc<=sqlite3DbMallocSize(pMem->db,pMem->zMalloc))
       || pMem->szMalloc==sqlite3DbMallocSize(pMem->db,pMem->zMalloc));
  if( pMem->szMalloc>0 && bPreserve && pMem->z==pMem->zMalloc ){
    if( pMem->db ){
      pMem->z = pMem->zMalloc = sqlite3DbReallocOrFree(pMem->db, pMem->z, n);
    }else{
      pMem->zMalloc = sqlite3Realloc(pMem->z, n);
      if( pMem->zMalloc==0 ) sqlite3_free(pMem->z);
      pMem->z = pMem->zMalloc;
    }
    bPreserve = 0;
  }else{
    if( pMem->szMalloc>0 ) sqlite3DbFreeNN(pMem->db, pMem->zMalloc);
    pMem->zMalloc = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(pMem->db, n);
  }
  if( pMem->zMalloc==0 ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pMem);
    pMem->z = 0;
    pMem->szMalloc = 0;
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }else{
    pMem->szMalloc = sqlite3DbMallocSize(pMem->db, pMem->zMalloc);
  }

  if( bPreserve && pMem->z ){
    assert( pMem->z!=pMem->zMalloc );
{char*xxd=(char*)(pMem->zMalloc);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pMem->z); int xxn=(pMem->n);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }
  if( (pMem->flags&0x1000 )!=0 ){
    assert( pMem->xDel!=0 && pMem->xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
    pMem->xDel((void *)(pMem->z));
  }

  pMem->z = pMem->zMalloc;
  pMem->flags &= ~(0x1000 |0x4000   |0x2000    );
  return 0        ;
}














static         int sqlite3VdbeMemClearAndResize(Mem *pMem, int szNew){
  assert((sqlite3Config.neverCorrupt==0)||szNew>0);
  assert( (pMem->flags &0x1000  )==0 || pMem->szMalloc==0 );
  if( pMem->szMalloc<szNew ){
    return sqlite3VdbeMemGrow(pMem, szNew, 0);
  }
  assert( (pMem->flags &0x1000  )==0 );
  pMem->z = pMem->zMalloc;
  pMem->flags &= (0x0001  |0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     );
  return 0        ;
}










static __attribute__((noinline))int vdbeMemAddTerminator(Mem*pMem){
  if( sqlite3VdbeMemGrow(pMem, pMem->n+3, 1) ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  pMem->z[pMem->n] = 0;
  pMem->z[pMem->n+1] = 0;
  pMem->z[pMem->n+2] = 0;
  pMem->flags |=0x0200   ;
  return 0        ;
}







static         int sqlite3VdbeMemMakeWriteable(Mem *pMem){
  assert( pMem!=0 );
  assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );

  }
  pMem->flags &= ~0x4000   ;

  pMem->pScopyFrom = 0;


  return 0        ;
}

static         int sqlite3VdbeMemStringify(Mem *pMem, u8 enc, u8 bForce){
  const int nByte = 32;

  assert( pMem!=0 );
  assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( !(pMem->flags&0x0400  ) );
  assert( !(pMem->flags&(0x0002 |0x0010  )) );
  assert( pMem->flags&(0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     ) );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pMem) );
  assert(((((uptr)(pMem) - (uptr)0)&3)==0));


  if( sqlite3VdbeMemClearAndResize(pMem, nByte) ){
    pMem->enc = 0;
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }

  vdbeMemRenderNum(nByte, pMem->z, pMem);
  assert( pMem->z!=0 );
  assert( pMem->n==(strlen(pMem->z)&0x3fffffff));
  pMem->enc =1           ;
  pMem->flags |=0x0002  |0x0200  ;
  if( bForce ) pMem->flags &= ~(0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     );
  sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pMem, enc);
  return 0        ;
}

  if( pMem->szMalloc>0 ) sqlite3DbFreeNN(pMem->db, pMem->zMalloc);
{char*xxd=(char*)(pMem);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&t); int xxn=(sizeof(t));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  return ctx.isError;

static __attribute__((noinline))void vdbeMemClearExternAndSetNull(Mem*p){
  assert( p->db==0 ||((void)(p->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert((((p)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0));
  if( p->flags&0x8000  ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemFinalize(p, p->u.pDef);
    assert( (p->flags &0x8000  )==0 );
if( p->flags & 0x1000 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  }
  if( p->flags&0x1000  ){
    assert( p->xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear)&&p->xDel!=0);
    p->xDel((void *)p->z);
  }
  p->flags =0x0001   ;
}









static __attribute__((noinline))void vdbeMemClear(Mem*p){
  if((((p)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0)){
    vdbeMemClearExternAndSetNull(p);
  }
  if( p->szMalloc ){
    sqlite3DbFreeNN(p->db, p->zMalloc);
    p->szMalloc = 0;
  }
  p->z = 0;
}

}






static __attribute__((noinline))i64 doubleToInt64(sqlite_int64 r){


  return r;








  static const i64 maxInt =(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32));
  static const i64 minInt =(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));

  if( r<=(sqlite_int64)minInt){
    return minInt;
  }else if( r>=(sqlite_int64)maxInt){
    return maxInt;
  }else{
    return (i64)r;
  }

}












static __attribute__((noinline))i64 memIntValue(const Mem*pMem){
  i64 value = 0;
  sqlite3Atoi64(pMem->z, &value, pMem->n, pMem->enc);
  return value;
}
static         i64 sqlite3VdbeIntValue(const Mem *pMem){
  int flags;
  assert( pMem!=0 );
  assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert(((((uptr)(pMem) - (uptr)0)&3)==0));
  flags = pMem->flags;
  if( flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
if( flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    return pMem->u.i;
  }else if( flags &0x0008    ){
    return doubleToInt64(pMem->u.r);
  }else if( (flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ))!=0 && pMem->z!=0 ){
    return memIntValue(pMem);
  }else{
    return 0;
  }
}

  return val;
}

  }else if( pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
if( pMem->flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    return (sqlite_int64)pMem->u.i;

  }else{

    return (sqlite_int64)0;
  }
}

      pMem->u.i = ix;
((pMem)->flags = ((pMem)->flags&~(0x0dbf|0x0400))|0x0004);
    }
  }

static         int sqlite3RealSameAsInt(sqlite_int64 r1,sqlite3_int64 i){
sqlite_int64 r2=(sqlite_int64)i;
  return r1==0.0
      || (memcmp(&r1, &r2, sizeof(r1))==0
          && i >= -2251799813685248LL && i < 2251799813685248LL);
}





static         i64 sqlite3RealToI64(sqlite_int64 r){
  if( r<=(sqlite_int64)(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))))return(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));
  if( r>=(sqlite_int64)(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)))return(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32));
  return (i64)r;
}









static         int sqlite3VdbeMemNumerify(Mem *pMem){
  assert( pMem!=0 );
if( pMem->flags & 0x0004 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0001 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( (pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     |0x0001  ))==0 ){
    int rc;
    sqlite3_int64 ix;
    assert( (pMem->flags & (0x0010  |0x0002 ))!=0 );
    assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );
    rc = sqlite3AtoF(pMem->z, &pMem->u.r, pMem->n, pMem->enc);
    if( ((rc==0 || rc==1) && sqlite3Atoi64(pMem->z, &ix, pMem->n, pMem->enc)<=1)
     || sqlite3RealSameAsInt(pMem->u.r, (ix = sqlite3RealToI64(pMem->u.r)))
    ){
      pMem->u.i = ix;
((pMem)->flags = ((pMem)->flags&~(0x0dbf|0x0400))|0x0004);
    }else{
((pMem)->flags = ((pMem)->flags&~(0x0dbf|0x0400))|0x0008);
    }
  }
  assert( (pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     |0x0001  ))!=0 );
  pMem->flags &= ~(0x0002 |0x0010  |0x0400  );
  return 0        ;
}








static         int sqlite3VdbeMemCast(Mem *pMem, u8 aff, u8 encoding){
  if( pMem->flags &0x0001    ) return 0        ;
  switch( aff ){
    case 0x41           : {
      if( (pMem->flags &0x0010   )==0 ){
        sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pMem,0x42            , encoding);
        assert( pMem->flags &0x0002   || pMem->db->mallocFailed );
        if( pMem->flags &0x0002   )((pMem)->flags = ((pMem)->flags&~(0x0dbf|0x0400))|0x0010);
      }else{
        pMem->flags &= ~(0x0dbf      &~0x0010  );
      }
      break;
    }
    case 0x43              : {
      sqlite3VdbeMemNumerify(pMem);
      break;
    }
    case 0x44              : {
      sqlite3VdbeMemIntegerify(pMem);
      break;
    }
    case 0x45           : {
      sqlite3VdbeMemRealify(pMem);
      break;
    }
    default: {
      assert( aff==0x42            );
      assert(0x0002  ==(0x0010  >>3) );
      pMem->flags |= (pMem->flags&0x0010  )>>3;
      sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pMem,0x42            , encoding);
      assert( pMem->flags &0x0002   || pMem->db->mallocFailed );
      pMem->flags &= ~(0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     |0x0010  |0x0400  );
      if( encoding!=1           ) pMem->n &= ~1;
      return sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pMem, encoding);
    }
  }
  return 0        ;
}

  pMem->enc =1           ;
  return 0        ;
}

static         int sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(const Mem *pMem){

static         int sqlite3VdbeMemTooBig(Mem *p){
  assert( p->db!=0 );
  if( p->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ) ){
    int n = p->n;

      n += p->u.nZero;
    }
    return n>p->db->aLimit[0                  ];
  }
  return 0;
}










static         void sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(Vdbe *pVdbe, Mem *pMem){
  int i;
  Mem *pX;
  for(i=1, pX=pVdbe->aMem+1; i<pVdbe->nMem; i++, pX++){
    if( pX->pScopyFrom==pMem ){
      u16 mFlags;
      if( pVdbe->db->flags &((u64)(0x0400000)<<32)){
printf                    ("Invalidate R[%d] due to change in R[%d]\n",
          (int)(pX - pVdbe->aMem), (int)(pMem - pVdbe->aMem));
      }






      mFlags = pMem->flags & pX->flags & pX->mScopyFlags;
      assert( (mFlags&(0x0004 |0x0020     ))==0 || pMem->u.i==pX->u.i );



      pX->flags =0x0000        ;
      pX->pScopyFrom = 0;
    }
  }
  pMem->pScopyFrom = 0;
}

static         void sqlite3VdbeMemShallowCopy(Mem *pTo, const Mem *pFrom, int srcType){

  assert( pTo->db==pFrom->db );
  if((((pTo)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0)){vdbeClrCopy(pTo,pFrom,srcType);return;}

    pTo->flags |= srcType;
  }
}

static         int sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr(
  Mem *pMem,
  const char *z,
  i64 n,
  u8 enc,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){
  i64 nByte = n;
  int iLimit;
  u16 flags;

  assert( pMem!=0 );
  assert( pMem->db==0 ||((void)(pMem->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pMem) );
  assert( enc!=0 || n>=0 );


  if( !z ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pMem);
    return 0        ;
  }

  if( pMem->db ){
    iLimit = pMem->db->aLimit[0                  ];
  }else{
    iLimit =1000000000        ;
  }
  if( nByte<0 ){
    assert( enc!=0 );
    if( enc==1           ){
      nByte = strlen(z);
    }else{
      for(nByte=0; nByte<=iLimit && (z[nByte] | z[nByte+1]); nByte+=2){}
    }
    flags=0x0002  |0x0200  ;
  }else if( enc==0 ){
    flags =0x0010   ;
    enc =1           ;
  }else{
    flags =0x0002  ;
  }
  if( nByte>iLimit ){
    if( xDel && xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1)){
      if( xDel==((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear)){
        sqlite3DbFree(pMem->db, (void*)z);
      }else{
        xDel((void*)z);
      }
    }
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pMem);
    return sqlite3ErrorToParser(pMem->db,18            );
  }





  if( xDel==((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1)){
    i64 nAlloc = nByte;
    if( flags&0x0200   ){
      nAlloc += (enc==1          ?1:2);
    }
if( nAlloc==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( nAlloc==31 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( nAlloc==32 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    if( sqlite3VdbeMemClearAndResize(pMem, (int)((nAlloc)>(32)?(nAlloc):(32)))){
      return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
{char*xxd=(char*)(pMem->z);const char*xxs=(const char*)(z); int xxn=(nAlloc);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }else{
    sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(pMem);
    pMem->z = (char *)z;
    if( xDel==((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear)){
      pMem->zMalloc = pMem->z;
      pMem->szMalloc = sqlite3DbMallocSize(pMem->db, pMem->zMalloc);
    }else{
      pMem->xDel = xDel;
      flags |= ((xDel==((sqlite3_destructor_type)0))?0x2000:0x1000);
    }
  }

  pMem->n = (int)(nByte & 0x7fffffff);
  pMem->flags = flags;
  pMem->enc = enc;


  if( enc>1           && sqlite3VdbeMemHandleBom(pMem) ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }



  return 0        ;
}
















static         int sqlite3VdbeMemFromBtree(
  BtCursor *pCur,
  u32 offset,
  u32 amt,
  Mem *pMem
){
  int rc;
  pMem->flags =0x0001   ;
  if( sqlite3BtreeMaxRecordSize(pCur)<offset+amt ){
    return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  }
  if(0         ==(rc = sqlite3VdbeMemClearAndResize(pMem, amt+1)) ){
    rc = sqlite3BtreePayload(pCur, offset, amt, pMem->z);
    if( rc==0         ){
      pMem->z[amt] = 0;
      pMem->flags =0x0010   ;
      pMem->n = (int)amt;
    }else{
      sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(pMem);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}
static         int sqlite3VdbeMemFromBtreeZeroOffset(
  BtCursor *pCur,
  u32 amt,
  Mem *pMem
){
  u32 available = 0;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( sqlite3BtreeCursorIsValid(pCur) );
  assert( !(((pMem)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0));



  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pMem) );
  pMem->z = (char *)sqlite3BtreePayloadFetch(pCur, &available);
  assert( pMem->z!=0 );

  if( amt<=available ){
    pMem->flags =0x0010   |0x4000   ;
    pMem->n = (int)amt;
  }else{
    rc = sqlite3VdbeMemFromBtree(pCur, 0, amt, pMem);
  }

  return rc;
}






static __attribute__((noinline))const void*valueToText(sqlite3_value*pVal,u8 enc){
  assert( pVal!=0 );
  assert( pVal->db==0 ||((void)(pVal->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( (enc&3)==(enc&~8                   ) );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pVal) );
  assert( (pVal->flags & (0x0001  ))==0 );
  if( pVal->flags & (0x0010  |0x0002 ) ){
    if((((pVal)->flags&0x0400)?0:0))return 0;
    pVal->flags |=0x0002  ;
    if( pVal->enc != (enc & ~8                   ) ){
      sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pVal, enc & ~8                   );
    }
    if( (enc &8                    )!=0 && 1==(1&((int)(intptr_t)(pVal->z))) ){
      assert( (pVal->flags & (0x4000   |0x2000    ))!=0 );
      if( sqlite3VdbeMemMakeWriteable(pVal)!=0         ){
        return 0;
      }
    }
    sqlite3VdbeMemNulTerminate(pVal);
  }else{
    sqlite3VdbeMemStringify(pVal, enc, 0);
    assert( 0==(1&((int)(intptr_t)(pVal->z))) );
  }
  assert(pVal->enc==(enc & ~8                   ) || pVal->db==0
              || pVal->db->mallocFailed );
  if( pVal->enc==(enc & ~8                   ) ){
    assert( sqlite3VdbeMemValidStrRep(pVal) );
    return pVal->z;
  }else{
    return 0;
  }
}











static         const void *sqlite3ValueText(sqlite3_value* pVal, u8 enc){
  if( !pVal ) return 0;
  assert( pVal->db==0 ||((void)(pVal->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( (enc&3)==(enc&~8                   ) );
  assert( !sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(pVal) );
  if( (pVal->flags&(0x0002 |0x0200  ))==(0x0002 |0x0200  ) && pVal->enc==enc ){
    assert( sqlite3VdbeMemValidStrRep(pVal) );
    return pVal->z;
  }
  if( pVal->flags&0x0001   ){
    return 0;
  }
  return valueToText(pVal, enc);
}




static         sqlite3_value *sqlite3ValueNew(sqlite3 *db){
  Mem *p = sqlite3DbMallocZero(db, sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    p->flags =0x0001   ;
    p->db = db;
  }
  return p;
}





struct ValueNewStat4Ctx {
  Parse *pParse;
  Index *pIdx;
  UnpackedRecord **ppRec;
  int iVal;
};












static sqlite3_value *valueNew(sqlite3 *db, struct ValueNewStat4Ctx *p){

  if( p ){
    UnpackedRecord *pRec = p->ppRec[0];

    if( pRec==0 ){
      Index *pIdx = p->pIdx;
      int nByte;
      int i;
      int nCol = pIdx->nColumn;

      nByte = sizeof(Mem) * nCol +(((sizeof(UnpackedRecord))+7)&~7);
      pRec = (UnpackedRecord*)sqlite3DbMallocZero(db, nByte);
      if( pRec ){
        pRec->pKeyInfo = sqlite3KeyInfoOfIndex(p->pParse, pIdx);
        if( pRec->pKeyInfo ){
          assert( pRec->pKeyInfo->nAllField==nCol );
          assert( pRec->pKeyInfo->enc==((db)->enc));
          pRec->aMem = (Mem *)((u8*)pRec +(((sizeof(UnpackedRecord))+7)&~7));
          for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
            pRec->aMem[i].flags =0x0001   ;
            pRec->aMem[i].db = db;
          }
        }else{
          sqlite3DbFreeNN(db, pRec);
          pRec = 0;
        }
      }
      if( pRec==0 ) return 0;
      p->ppRec[0] = pRec;
    }

    pRec->nField = p->iVal+1;
    return &pRec->aMem[p->iVal];
  }

(void)(p)            ;

  return sqlite3ValueNew(db);
}






















static int valueFromFunction(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const Expr *p,
  u8 enc,
  u8 aff,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal,
  struct ValueNewStat4Ctx *pCtx
){
  sqlite3_context ctx;
  sqlite3_value **apVal = 0;
  int nVal = 0;
  FuncDef *pFunc = 0;
  sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
  int rc =0         ;
  ExprList *pList = 0;
  int i;

  assert( pCtx!=0 );
  assert( (p->flags &0x010000     )==0 );
  assert((((p)->flags&0x001000)==0));
  pList = p->x.pList;
  if( pList ) nVal = pList->nExpr;
  assert( !(((p)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
  pFunc = sqlite3FindFunction(db, p->u.zToken, nVal, enc, 0);
  assert( pFunc );
  if( (pFunc->funcFlags & (0x0800              |0x2000             ))==0
   || (pFunc->funcFlags &0x0020               )
  ){
    return 0        ;
  }

  if( pList ){
    apVal = (sqlite3_value**)sqlite3DbMallocZero(db, sizeof(apVal[0]) * nVal);
    if( apVal==0 ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      goto value_from_function_out;
    }
    for(i=0; i<nVal; i++){
      rc = sqlite3ValueFromExpr(db, pList->a[i].pExpr, enc, aff, &apVal[i]);
      if( apVal[i]==0 || rc!=0         ) goto value_from_function_out;
    }
  }

  pVal = valueNew(db, pCtx);
  if( pVal==0 ){
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    goto value_from_function_out;
  }

  memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(ctx));
  ctx.pOut = pVal;
  ctx.pFunc = pFunc;
  ctx.enc =((db)->enc);
  pFunc->xSFunc(&ctx, nVal, apVal);
  if( ctx.isError ){
    rc = ctx.isError;
    sqlite3ErrorMsg(pCtx->pParse, "%s", sqlite3_value_text(pVal));
  }else{
    sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pVal, aff,1           );
    assert( rc==0         );
    assert( enc==pVal->enc
         || (pVal->flags &0x0002  )==0
         || db->mallocFailed  );

    rc = sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pVal, enc);
    if( rc==0         && sqlite3VdbeMemTooBig(pVal) ){
      rc =18            ;
      pCtx->pParse->nErr++;
    }

  }

 value_from_function_out:
  if( rc!=0         ){
    pVal = 0;
    pCtx->pParse->rc = rc;
  }
  if( apVal ){
    for(i=0; i<nVal; i++){
      sqlite3ValueFree(apVal[i]);
    }
    sqlite3DbFreeNN(db, apVal);
  }

  *ppVal = pVal;
  return rc;
}














static int valueFromExpr(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const Expr *pExpr,
  u8 enc,
  u8 affinity,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal,
  struct ValueNewStat4Ctx *pCtx
){
  int op;
  char *zVal = 0;
  sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
  int negInt = 1;
  const char *zNeg = "";
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pExpr!=0 );
  while( (op = pExpr->op)==174      || op==181     ) pExpr = pExpr->pLeft;
  if( op==176         ) op = pExpr->op2;





  assert( (pExpr->flags &0x010000     )==0 || pCtx==0 );

  if( op==36      ){
    u8 aff;
    assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
    aff = sqlite3AffinityType(pExpr->u.zToken,0);
    rc = valueFromExpr(db, pExpr->pLeft, enc, aff, ppVal, pCtx);
if( rc!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    if( *ppVal ){
      sqlite3VdbeMemCast(*ppVal, aff, enc);
      sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(*ppVal, affinity, enc);
    }
    return rc;
  }




  if( op==173
   && (pExpr->pLeft->op==155        || pExpr->pLeft->op==153     ) ){
    pExpr = pExpr->pLeft;
    op = pExpr->op;
    negInt = -1;
    zNeg = "-";
  }

  if( op==117       || op==153      || op==155        ){
    pVal = valueNew(db, pCtx);
    if( pVal==0 ) goto no_mem;
    if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)     ){
      sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(pVal, (i64)pExpr->u.iValue*negInt);
    }else{
      zVal = sqlite3MPrintf(db, "%s%s", zNeg, pExpr->u.zToken);
      if( zVal==0 ) goto no_mem;
      sqlite3ValueSetStr(pVal, -1, zVal,1           ,((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
    }
    if( (op==155        || op==153      ) && affinity==0x41            ){
      sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pVal,0x43               ,1           );
    }else{
      sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pVal, affinity,1           );
    }
    assert( (pVal->flags &0x0020      )==0 );
    if( pVal->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     |0x0008  ) ){
if( pVal->flags & 0x0004 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pVal->flags & 0x0008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      pVal->flags &= ~0x0002 ;
    }
    if( enc!=1           ){
      rc = sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pVal, enc);
    }
  }else if( op==173       ) {

    if(0         ==valueFromExpr(db,pExpr->pLeft,enc,affinity,&pVal,pCtx)
     && pVal!=0
    ){
      sqlite3VdbeMemNumerify(pVal);
      if( pVal->flags &0x0008    ){
        pVal->u.r = -pVal->u.r;
      }else if( pVal->u.i==(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)))){

        pVal->u.r = -(sqlite_int64)(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));

        pVal->u.r =(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32));

((pVal)->flags = ((pVal)->flags&~(0x0dbf|0x0400))|0x0008);
      }else{
        pVal->u.i = -pVal->u.i;
      }
      sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pVal, affinity, enc);
    }
  }else if( op==121     ){
    pVal = valueNew(db, pCtx);
    if( pVal==0 ) goto no_mem;
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pVal);
  }

  else if( op==154     ){
    int nVal;
    assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
    assert( pExpr->u.zToken[0]=='x' || pExpr->u.zToken[0]=='X' );
    assert( pExpr->u.zToken[1]=='\'' );
    pVal = valueNew(db, pCtx);
    if( !pVal ) goto no_mem;
    zVal = &pExpr->u.zToken[2];
    nVal = sqlite3Strlen30(zVal)-1;
    assert( zVal[nVal]=='\'' );
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr(pVal, sqlite3HexToBlob(db, zVal, nVal), nVal/2,
                         0,((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
  }


  else if( op==172         && pCtx!=0 ){
    rc =0                                                        ;
  }

  else if( op==170          ){
    assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
    pVal = valueNew(db, pCtx);
    if( pVal ){
      pVal->flags =0x0004  ;
      pVal->u.i = pExpr->u.zToken[4]==0;
    }
  }

  *ppVal = pVal;
  return rc;

no_mem:

  if( pCtx==0 ||(0)                           )

    sqlite3OomFault(db);
  sqlite3DbFree(db, zVal);
  assert( *ppVal==0 );

  if( pCtx==0 ) sqlite3ValueFree(pVal);

  assert( pCtx==0 ); sqlite3ValueFree(pVal);

  return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
}











static         int sqlite3ValueFromExpr(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const Expr *pExpr,
  u8 enc,
  u8 affinity,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal
){
  return pExpr ? valueFromExpr(db, pExpr, enc, affinity, ppVal, 0) : 0;
}




















static int stat4ValueFromExpr(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  u8 affinity,
  struct ValueNewStat4Ctx *pAlloc,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal
){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;


  pExpr = sqlite3ExprSkipCollate(pExpr);

  assert( pExpr==0 || pExpr->op!=176         || pExpr->op2!=156         );
  if( !pExpr ){
    pVal = valueNew(db, pAlloc);
    if( pVal ){
      sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull((Mem*)pVal);
    }
  }else if( pExpr->op==156         && (db->flags &0x00800000        )==0 ){
    Vdbe *v;
    int iBindVar = pExpr->iColumn;
    sqlite3VdbeSetVarmask(pParse->pVdbe, iBindVar);
    if( (v = pParse->pReprepare)!=0 ){
      pVal = valueNew(db, pAlloc);
      if( pVal ){
        rc = sqlite3VdbeMemCopy((Mem*)pVal, &v->aVar[iBindVar-1]);
        sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(pVal, affinity,((db)->enc));
        pVal->db = pParse->db;
      }
    }
  }else{
    rc = valueFromExpr(db, pExpr,((db)->enc),affinity,&pVal,pAlloc);
  }

  assert( pVal==0 || pVal->db==db );
  *ppVal = pVal;
  return rc;
}



































static         int sqlite3Stat4ProbeSetValue(
  Parse *pParse,
  Index *pIdx,
  UnpackedRecord **ppRec,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int nElem,
  int iVal,
  int *pnExtract
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int nExtract = 0;

  if( pExpr==0 || pExpr->op!=138       ){
    int i;
    struct ValueNewStat4Ctx alloc;

    alloc.pParse = pParse;
    alloc.pIdx = pIdx;
    alloc.ppRec = ppRec;

    for(i=0; i<nElem; i++){
      sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
      Expr *pElem = (pExpr ? sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pExpr, i) : 0);
      u8 aff = sqlite3IndexColumnAffinity(pParse->db, pIdx, iVal+i);
      alloc.iVal = iVal+i;
      rc = stat4ValueFromExpr(pParse, pElem, aff, &alloc, &pVal);
      if( !pVal ) break;
      nExtract++;
    }
  }

  *pnExtract = nExtract;
  return rc;
}











static         int sqlite3Stat4ValueFromExpr(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  u8 affinity,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal
){
  return stat4ValueFromExpr(pParse, pExpr, affinity, 0, ppVal);
}









static         int sqlite3Stat4Column(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const void *pRec,
  int nRec,
  int iCol,
  sqlite3_value **ppVal
){
  u32 t = 0;
  int nHdr;
  int iHdr;
  int iField;
  int szField = 0;
  int i;
  u8 *a = (u8*)pRec;
  Mem *pMem = *ppVal;

  assert( iCol>0 );
  iHdr =(u8)((*(a)<(u8)0x80)?((nHdr)=(u32)*(a)),1:sqlite3GetVarint32((a),(u32 *)&(nHdr)));
  if( nHdr>nRec || iHdr>=nHdr ) return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  iField = nHdr;
  for(i=0; i<=iCol; i++){
    iHdr +=(u8)((*(&a[iHdr])<(u8)0x80)?((t)=(u32)*(&a[iHdr])),1:sqlite3GetVarint32((&a[iHdr]),(u32 *)&(t)));
if( iHdr==nHdr ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( iHdr==nHdr+1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    if( iHdr>nHdr ) return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
    szField = sqlite3VdbeSerialTypeLen(t);
    iField += szField;
  }
if( iField==nRec ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( iField==nRec+1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( iField>nRec ) return sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  if( pMem==0 ){
    pMem = *ppVal = sqlite3ValueNew(db);
    if( pMem==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  sqlite3VdbeSerialGet(&a[iField-szField], t, pMem);
  pMem->enc =((db)->enc);
  return 0        ;
}






static         void sqlite3Stat4ProbeFree(UnpackedRecord *pRec){
  if( pRec ){
    int i;
    int nCol = pRec->pKeyInfo->nAllField;
    Mem *aMem = pRec->aMem;
    sqlite3 *db = aMem[0].db;
    for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
      sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(&aMem[i]);
    }
    sqlite3KeyInfoUnref(pRec->pKeyInfo);
    sqlite3DbFreeNN(db, pRec);
  }
}





static         void sqlite3ValueSetStr(
  sqlite3_value *v,
  int n,
  const void *z,
  u8 enc,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){
  if( v ) sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr((Mem *)v, z, n, enc, xDel);
}




static         void sqlite3ValueFree(sqlite3_value *v){
  if( !v ) return;
  sqlite3VdbeMemRelease((Mem *)v);
  sqlite3DbFreeNN(((Mem*)v)->db, v);
}






static __attribute__((noinline))int valueBytes(sqlite3_value*pVal,u8 enc){
  return valueToText(pVal, enc)!=0 ? pVal->n : 0;
}
static         int sqlite3ValueBytes(sqlite3_value *pVal, u8 enc){
  Mem *p = (Mem*)pVal;
  assert( (p->flags &0x0001   )==0 || (p->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ))==0 );
  if( (p->flags &0x0002  )!=0 && pVal->enc==enc ){
    return p->n;
  }
  if( (p->flags &0x0002  )!=0 && enc!=1           && pVal->enc!=1           ){
    return p->n;
  }
  if( (p->flags &0x0010   )!=0 ){
    if( p->flags &0x0400    ){
      return p->n + p->u.nZero;
    }else{
      return p->n;
    }
  }
  if( p->flags &0x0001    ) return 0;
  return valueBytes(pVal, enc);
}

static         Vdbe *sqlite3VdbeCreate(Parse *pParse){
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
  Vdbe *p;
  p = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(db, sizeof(Vdbe) );
  if( p==0 ) return 0;
  memset(&p->aOp, 0, sizeof(Vdbe)-((int)((char*)&((Vdbe*)0)->aOp)));
  p->db = db;
  if( db->pVdbe ){
    db->pVdbe->ppVPrev = &p->pVNext;
  }
  p->pVNext = db->pVdbe;
  p->ppVPrev = &db->pVdbe;
  db->pVdbe = p;
  assert( p->eVdbeState==0               );
  p->pParse = pParse;
  pParse->pVdbe = p;
  assert( pParse->aLabel==0 );
  assert( pParse->nLabel==0 );
  assert( p->nOpAlloc==0 );
  assert( pParse->szOpAlloc==0 );
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(p,8       , 0, 1);
  return p;
}




static         Parse *sqlite3VdbeParser(Vdbe *p){
  return p->pParse;
}




static         void sqlite3VdbeError(Vdbe *p, const char *zFormat, ...){
  va_list ap;
  sqlite3DbFree(p->db, p->zErrMsg);
  va_start(ap, zFormat);
  p->zErrMsg = sqlite3VMPrintf(p->db, zFormat, ap);
  va_end(ap);
}




static         void sqlite3VdbeSetSql(Vdbe *p, const char *z, int n, u8 prepFlags){
  if( p==0 ) return;
  p->prepFlags = prepFlags;
  if( (prepFlags &0x80                   )==0 ){
    p->expmask = 0;
  }
  assert( p->zSql==0 );
  p->zSql = sqlite3DbStrNDup(p->db, z, n);
}





static         void sqlite3VdbeAddDblquoteStr(sqlite3 *db, Vdbe *p, const char *z){
  if( p ){
    int n = sqlite3Strlen30(z);
    DblquoteStr *pStr = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(db,
                            sizeof(*pStr)+n+1 -sizeof(pStr->z));
    if( pStr ){
      pStr->pNextStr = p->pDblStr;
      p->pDblStr = pStr;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pStr->z);const char*xxs=(const char*)(z); int xxn=(n+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }
  }
}







static         int sqlite3VdbeUsesDoubleQuotedString(
  Vdbe *pVdbe,
  const char *zId
){
  DblquoteStr *pStr;
  assert( zId!=0 );
  if( pVdbe->pDblStr==0 ) return 0;
  for(pStr=pVdbe->pDblStr; pStr; pStr=pStr->pNextStr){
    if( strcmp(zId, pStr->z)==0 ) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}












static         void sqlite3VdbeSwap(Vdbe *pA, Vdbe *pB){
  Vdbe tmp, *pTmp, **ppTmp;
  char *zTmp;
  assert( pA->db==pB->db );
  tmp = *pA;
  *pA = *pB;
  *pB = tmp;
  pTmp = pA->pVNext;
  pA->pVNext = pB->pVNext;
  pB->pVNext = pTmp;
  ppTmp = pA->ppVPrev;
  pA->ppVPrev = pB->ppVPrev;
  pB->ppVPrev = ppTmp;
  zTmp = pA->zSql;
  pA->zSql = pB->zSql;
  pB->zSql = zTmp;

  zTmp = pA->zNormSql;
  pA->zNormSql = pB->zNormSql;
  pB->zNormSql = zTmp;

  pB->expmask = pA->expmask;
  pB->prepFlags = pA->prepFlags;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pB->aCounter);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pA->aCounter); int xxn=(sizeof(pB->aCounter));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pB->aCounter[5                          ]++;
}











static int growOpArray(Vdbe *v, int nOp){
  VdbeOp *pNew;
  Parse *p = v->pParse;









  sqlite3_int64 nNew = (v->nOpAlloc>=512 ? 2*(sqlite3_int64)v->nOpAlloc
                        : (sqlite3_int64)v->nOpAlloc+nOp);

  sqlite3_int64 nNew = (v->nOpAlloc ? 2*(sqlite3_int64)v->nOpAlloc
                        : (sqlite3_int64)(1024/sizeof(Op)));
(void)(nOp)            ;



  if( nNew > p->db->aLimit[5                   ] ){
    sqlite3OomFault(p->db);
    return 7           ;
  }

  assert( nOp<=(int)(1024/sizeof(Op)) );
  assert( nNew>=(v->nOpAlloc+nOp) );
  pNew = sqlite3DbRealloc(p->db, v->aOp, nNew*sizeof(Op));
  if( pNew ){
    p->szOpAlloc = sqlite3DbMallocSize(p->db, pNew);
    v->nOpAlloc = p->szOpAlloc/sizeof(Op);
    v->aOp = pNew;
  }
  return (pNew ?0          :sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__));
}













static void test_addop_breakpoint(int pc, Op *pOp){
  static int n = 0;
  (void)pc;
  (void)pOp;
  n++;
}


















static __attribute__((noinline))int growOp3(Vdbe*p,int op,int p1,int p2,int p3){
  assert( p->nOpAlloc<=p->nOp );
  if( growOpArray(p, 1) ) return 1;
  assert( p->nOpAlloc>p->nOp );
  return sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(p, op, p1, p2, p3);
}
static         int sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(Vdbe *p, int op, int p1, int p2, int p3){
  int i;
  VdbeOp *pOp;

  i = p->nOp;
  assert( p->eVdbeState==0               );
  assert( op>=0 && op<0xff );
  if( p->nOpAlloc<=i ){
    return growOp3(p, op, p1, p2, p3);
  }
  assert( p->aOp!=0 );
  p->nOp++;
  pOp = &p->aOp[i];
  assert( pOp!=0 );
  pOp->opcode = (u8)op;
  pOp->p5 = 0;
  pOp->p1 = p1;
  pOp->p2 = p2;
  pOp->p3 = p3;
  pOp->p4.p = 0;
  pOp->p4type =0          ;

  pOp->zComment = 0;


  pOp->nExec = 0;
  pOp->nCycle = 0;


  if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32) ){
    sqlite3VdbePrintOp(0, i, &p->aOp[i]);
    test_addop_breakpoint(i, &p->aOp[i]);
  }


  pOp->iSrcLine = 0;

  return i;
}

}

static         int sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(Vdbe *p, int op, int p1, int p2){

}

static         void sqlite3VdbeMultiLoad(Vdbe *p, int iDest, const char *zTypes, ...){
  va_list ap;
  int i;
  char c;
  va_start(ap, zTypes);
  for(i=0; (c = zTypes[i])!=0; i++){
    if( c=='s' ){
      const char *z = va_arg(ap, const char*);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(p, z==0 ?75       :117        , 0, iDest+i, 0, z, 0);
    }else if( c=='i' ){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(p,71         , va_arg(ap, int), iDest+i);
    }else{
      goto skip_op_resultrow;
    }
  }
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(p,84           , iDest, i);
skip_op_resultrow:
  va_end(ap);
}




static         int sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(
  Vdbe *p,
  int op,
  int p1,
  int p2,
  int p3,
  const char *zP4,
  int p4type
){
  int addr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(p, op, p1, p2, p3);
  sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(p, addr, zP4, p4type);
  return addr;
}











static         int sqlite3VdbeAddFunctionCall(
  Parse *pParse,
  int p1,
  int p2,
  int p3,
  int nArg,
  const FuncDef *pFunc,
  int eCallCtx
){
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  int nByte;
  int addr;
  sqlite3_context *pCtx;
  assert( v );
  nByte = sizeof(*pCtx) + (nArg-1)*sizeof(sqlite3_value*);
  pCtx = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(pParse->db, nByte);
  if( pCtx==0 ){
    assert( pParse->db->mallocFailed );
    freeEphemeralFunction(pParse->db, (FuncDef*)pFunc);
    return 0;
  }
  pCtx->pOut = 0;
  pCtx->pFunc = (FuncDef*)pFunc;
  pCtx->pVdbe = 0;
  pCtx->isError = 0;
  pCtx->argc = nArg;
  pCtx->iOp = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
  addr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v, eCallCtx ?65           :66          ,
                           p1, p2, p3, (char*)pCtx,(-15)      );
  sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, eCallCtx &0x00002e   );
  sqlite3MayAbort(pParse);
  return addr;
}

  return sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(p, op, p1, p2, p3, p4copy, p4type);
}

static __attribute__((noinline))void resizeResolveLabel(Parse*p,Vdbe*v,int j){
  int nNewSize = 10 - p->nLabel;
  p->aLabel = sqlite3DbReallocOrFree(p->db, p->aLabel,
                     nNewSize*sizeof(p->aLabel[0]));
  if( p->aLabel==0 ){
    p->nLabelAlloc = 0;
  }else{

    int i;
    for(i=p->nLabelAlloc; i<nNewSize; i++) p->aLabel[i] = -1;

    if( nNewSize>=100 && (nNewSize/100)>(p->nLabelAlloc/100) ){
      sqlite3ProgressCheck(p);
    }
    p->nLabelAlloc = nNewSize;
    p->aLabel[j] = v->nOp;
  }
}
static         void sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(Vdbe *v, int x){
  Parse *p = v->pParse;
  int j =(~(x))  ;
  assert( v->eVdbeState==0               );
  assert( j<-p->nLabel );
  assert( j>=0 );

  if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32) ){
    printf("RESOLVE LABEL %d to %d\n", x, v->nOp);
  }

  if( p->nLabelAlloc + p->nLabel < 0 ){
    resizeResolveLabel(p,v,j);
  }else{
    assert( p->aLabel[j]==(-1) );
    p->aLabel[j] = v->nOp;
  }
}

typedef struct VdbeOpIter VdbeOpIter;
struct VdbeOpIter {
  Vdbe *v;
  SubProgram **apSub;
  int nSub;
  int iAddr;
  int iSub;
};
static Op *opIterNext(VdbeOpIter *p){
  Vdbe *v = p->v;
  Op *pRet = 0;
  Op *aOp;
  int nOp;

  if( p->iSub<=p->nSub ){

    if( p->iSub==0 ){
      aOp = v->aOp;
      nOp = v->nOp;
    }else{
      aOp = p->apSub[p->iSub-1]->aOp;
      nOp = p->apSub[p->iSub-1]->nOp;
    }
    assert( p->iAddr<nOp );

    pRet = &aOp[p->iAddr];
    p->iAddr++;
    if( p->iAddr==nOp ){
      p->iSub++;
      p->iAddr = 0;
    }

    if( pRet->p4type==(-4)          ){
      int nByte = (p->nSub+1)*sizeof(SubProgram*);
      int j;
      for(j=0; j<p->nSub; j++){
        if( p->apSub[j]==pRet->p4.pProgram ) break;
      }
      if( j==p->nSub ){
        p->apSub = sqlite3DbReallocOrFree(v->db, p->apSub, nByte);
        if( !p->apSub ){
          pRet = 0;
        }else{
          p->apSub[p->nSub++] = pRet->p4.pProgram;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return pRet;
}
























static         int sqlite3VdbeAssertMayAbort(Vdbe *v, int mayAbort){
  int hasAbort = 0;
  int hasFkCounter = 0;
  int hasCreateTable = 0;
  int hasCreateIndex = 0;
  int hasInitCoroutine = 0;
  Op *pOp;
  VdbeOpIter sIter;

  if( v==0 ) return 0;
  memset(&sIter, 0, sizeof(sIter));
  sIter.v = v;

  while( (pOp = opIterNext(&sIter))!=0 ){
    int opcode = pOp->opcode;
    if( opcode==144        || opcode==7          || opcode==176
     || opcode==172
     || opcode==171
     || opcode==149
     || opcode==66          || opcode==65
     || ((opcode==70      || opcode==69           )
      && ((pOp->p1)!=0         && pOp->p2==2       ))
    ){
      hasAbort = 1;
      break;
    }
    if( opcode==147            && pOp->p3==1            ) hasCreateTable = 1;
    if( mayAbort ){




      if( opcode==147            && pOp->p3==2             ) hasCreateIndex = 1;
      if( opcode==145      ) hasCreateIndex = 1;
    }
    if( opcode==11               ) hasInitCoroutine = 1;

    if( opcode==158          && pOp->p1==0 && pOp->p2==1 ){
      hasFkCounter = 1;
    }

  }
  sqlite3DbFree(v->db, sIter.apSub);






  return ( v->db->mallocFailed || hasAbort==mayAbort || hasFkCounter
        || (hasCreateTable && hasInitCoroutine) || hasCreateIndex
  );
}

static void resolveP2Values(Vdbe *p, int *pMaxFuncArgs){
  int nMaxArgs = *pMaxFuncArgs;
  Op *pOp;
  Parse *pParse = p->pParse;
  int *aLabel = pParse->aLabel;
  p->readOnly = 1;
  p->bIsReader = 0;
  pOp = &p->aOp[p->nOp-1];
  assert( p->aOp[0].opcode==8       );
  while( 1                                                        ){






    if( pOp->opcode<=64                    ){


      switch( pOp->opcode ){
        case 2             : {
          if( pOp->p2!=0 ) p->readOnly = 0;
__attribute__((fallthrough));
        }
        case 1            :
        case 0           : {
          p->bIsReader = 1;
          break;
        }

        case 3            :

        case 5        :
        case 4             : {
          p->readOnly = 0;
          p->bIsReader = 1;
          break;
        }
        case 8      : {
          assert( pOp->p2>=0 );
          goto resolve_p2_values_loop_exit;
        }

        case 7         : {
          if( pOp->p2>nMaxArgs ) nMaxArgs = pOp->p2;
          break;
        }
        case 6         : {
          int n;
          assert( (pOp - p->aOp) >= 3 );
          assert( pOp[-1].opcode==71         );
          n = pOp[-1].p1;
          if( n>nMaxArgs ) nMaxArgs = n;

__attribute__((fallthrough));
        }

        default: {
          if( pOp->p2<0 ){



            assert( (sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOp->opcode] &0x01       )!=0 );
            assert((~(pOp->p2))  <-pParse->nLabel );
            pOp->p2 = aLabel[(~(pOp->p2)) ];
          }
          break;
        }
      }



      assert( (sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOp->opcode]&0x01      )==0 || pOp->p2>=0);
    }
    assert( pOp>p->aOp );
    pOp--;
  }
resolve_p2_values_loop_exit:
  if( aLabel ){
    sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(p->db, pParse->aLabel);
    pParse->aLabel = 0;
  }
  pParse->nLabel = 0;
  *pMaxFuncArgs = nMaxArgs;
  assert( p->bIsReader!=0 ||sqlite3DbMaskAllZero(p->btreeMask));
}






















static         void




 {
  VdbeOp *pOp;
  Parse *pParse;
  int i;
  sqlite3_str *pErr = 0;
  assert( v!=0 );
  pParse = v->pParse;
  assert( pParse!=0 );
  if( pParse->nErr ) return;
  assert( iLast>=iFirst );
  assert( iLast<v->nOp );
  pOp = &v->aOp[iFirst];
  for(i=iFirst; i<=iLast; i++, pOp++){
    if( (sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOp->opcode] &0x01       )!=0 ){
      int iDest = pOp->p2;
      if( iDest==0 ) continue;
      if( pOp->opcode==10       ) continue;
      if( iDest<0 ){
        int j =(~(iDest))  ;
        assert( j>=0 );
        if( j>=-pParse->nLabel || pParse->aLabel[j]<0 ){
          continue;
        }
        iDest = pParse->aLabel[j];
      }
      if( iDest<iFirst || iDest>iLast ){
        int j = iDest;
        for(; j<v->nOp; j++){
          VdbeOp *pX = &v->aOp[j];
          if( pX->opcode==67        ){
            if( pX->p1==iRetReg ) break;
            continue;
          }
          if( pX->opcode==184     ) continue;
          if( pX->opcode==185        ) continue;
          if( pErr==0 ){
            pErr = sqlite3_str_new(0);
          }else{
            sqlite3_str_appendchar(pErr, 1, '\n');
          }
          sqlite3_str_appendf(pErr,
              "Opcode at %d jumps to %d which is outside the "
              "subroutine at %d..%d",
              i, iDest, iFirst, iLast);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if( pErr ){
    char *zErr = sqlite3_str_finish(pErr);
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,70      ,2               ,2        , 0, zErr, 0);
    sqlite3_free(zErr);
    sqlite3MayAbort(pParse);
  }
}

static         VdbeOp *sqlite3VdbeTakeOpArray(Vdbe *p, int *pnOp, int *pnMaxArg){
  VdbeOp *aOp = p->aOp;
  assert( aOp && !p->db->mallocFailed );


  assert(sqlite3DbMaskAllZero(p->btreeMask));

  resolveP2Values(p, pnMaxArg);
  *pnOp = p->nOp;
  p->aOp = 0;
  return aOp;
}








static         VdbeOp *sqlite3VdbeAddOpList(
  Vdbe *p,
  int nOp,
  VdbeOpList const *aOp,
  int iLineno
){
  int i;
  VdbeOp *pOut, *pFirst;
  assert( nOp>0 );
  assert( p->eVdbeState==0               );
  if( p->nOp + nOp > p->nOpAlloc && growOpArray(p, nOp) ){
    return 0;
  }
  pFirst = pOut = &p->aOp[p->nOp];
  for(i=0; i<nOp; i++, aOp++, pOut++){
    pOut->opcode = aOp->opcode;
    pOut->p1 = aOp->p1;
    pOut->p2 = aOp->p2;
    assert( aOp->p2>=0 );
    if( (sqlite3OpcodeProperty[aOp->opcode] &0x01       )!=0 && aOp->p2>0 ){
      pOut->p2 += p->nOp;
    }
    pOut->p3 = aOp->p3;
    pOut->p4type =0          ;
    pOut->p4.p = 0;
    pOut->p5 = 0;

    pOut->zComment = 0;


    pOut->iSrcLine = iLineno+i;

    (void)iLineno;


    if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32) ){
      sqlite3VdbePrintOp(0, i+p->nOp, &p->aOp[i+p->nOp]);
    }

  }
  p->nOp += nOp;
  return pFirst;
}

static         void sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn(Vdbe *p, int iDest){
  VdbeOp *pOp = sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(p);
  if( pOp->p3==iDest && pOp->opcode==94        ){
    pOp->p5 |=0x80             ;
  }
}





static         void sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(Vdbe *p, int addr){
  sqlite3VdbeChangeP2(p, addr, p->nOp);
}














static         void sqlite3VdbeJumpHereOrPopInst(Vdbe *p, int addr){
  if( addr==p->nOp-1 ){
    assert( p->aOp[addr].opcode==15
         || p->aOp[addr].opcode==16
         || p->aOp[addr].opcode==49          );
    assert( p->aOp[addr].p4type==0 );

    sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(p)->iSrcLine = 0;

    p->nOp--;
  }else{
    sqlite3VdbeChangeP2(p, addr, p->nOp);
  }
}






static void freeEphemeralFunction(sqlite3 *db, FuncDef *pDef){
  assert( db!=0 );
  if( (pDef->funcFlags &0x0010            )!=0 ){
    sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, pDef);
  }
}




static __attribute__((noinline))void freeP4Mem(sqlite3*db,Mem*p){
  if( p->szMalloc ) sqlite3DbFree(db, p->zMalloc);
  sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, p);
}
static __attribute__((noinline))void freeP4FuncCtx(sqlite3*db,sqlite3_context*p){
  assert( db!=0 );
  freeEphemeralFunction(db, p->pFunc);
  sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, p);
}
static void freeP4(sqlite3 *db, int p4type, void *p4){
  assert( db );
  switch( p4type ){
    case(-15)      : {
      freeP4FuncCtx(db, (sqlite3_context*)p4);
      break;
    }
    case(-12)   :
    case(-13)    :
    case(-6)       :
    case(-14)       : {
      if( p4 ) sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, p4);
      break;
    }
    case(-8)       : {
      if( db->pnBytesFreed==0 ) sqlite3KeyInfoUnref((KeyInfo*)p4);
      break;
    }

    case(-9)    : {
      sqlite3ExprDelete(db, (Expr*)p4);
      break;
    }

    case(-7)       : {
      freeEphemeralFunction(db, (FuncDef*)p4);
      break;
    }
    case(-10)  : {
      if( db->pnBytesFreed==0 ){
        sqlite3ValueFree((sqlite3_value*)p4);
      }else{
        freeP4Mem(db, (Mem*)p4);
      }
      break;
    }
    case(-11)    : {
      if( db->pnBytesFreed==0 )                                ;
      break;
    }
  }
}






static void vdbeFreeOpArray(sqlite3 *db, Op *aOp, int nOp){
  assert( nOp>=0 );
  assert( db!=0 );
  if( aOp ){
    Op *pOp = &aOp[nOp-1];
    while(1){
      if( pOp->p4type <=(-6)           ) freeP4(db, pOp->p4type, pOp->p4.p);

      sqlite3DbFree(db, pOp->zComment);

      if( pOp==aOp ) break;
      pOp--;
    }
    sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, aOp);
  }
}






static         void sqlite3VdbeLinkSubProgram(Vdbe *pVdbe, SubProgram *p){
  p->pNext = pVdbe->pProgram;
  pVdbe->pProgram = p;
}




static         int sqlite3VdbeHasSubProgram(Vdbe *pVdbe){
  return pVdbe->pProgram!=0;
}




static         int sqlite3VdbeChangeToNoop(Vdbe *p, int addr){
  VdbeOp *pOp;
  if( p->db->mallocFailed ) return 0;
  assert( addr>=0 && addr<p->nOp );
  pOp = &p->aOp[addr];
  freeP4(p->db, pOp->p4type, pOp->p4.p);
  pOp->p4type =0          ;
  pOp->p4.z = 0;
  pOp->opcode =184     ;
  return 1;
}





static         int sqlite3VdbeDeletePriorOpcode(Vdbe *p, u8 op){
  if( p->nOp>0 && p->aOp[p->nOp-1].opcode==op ){
    return sqlite3VdbeChangeToNoop(p, p->nOp-1);
  }else{
    return 0;
  }
}






static         void





 {
  if( N==0 ||(((pParse->db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00400000))!=0)         ) return;
  assert( pParse->pVdbe );
  assert( iFirst>=1 );
  assert( iFirst+N-1<=pParse->nMem );
  if( N<=31 && mask!=0 ){
    while( N>0 && (mask&1)!=0 ){
      mask >>= 1;
      iFirst++;
      N--;
    }
    while( N>0 && N<=32 && (mask &(((unsigned int)1)<<(N-1)))!=0){
      mask &= ~(((unsigned int)1)<<(N-1));
      N--;
    }
  }
  if( N>0 ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(pParse->pVdbe,183           , iFirst, N, *(int*)&mask);
    if( bUndefine ) sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(pParse->pVdbe, 1);
  }
}




















static void __attribute__((noinline))vdbeChangeP4Full(
  Vdbe *p,
  Op *pOp,
  const char *zP4,
  int n
){
  if( pOp->p4type ){
    freeP4(p->db, pOp->p4type, pOp->p4.p);
    pOp->p4type = 0;
    pOp->p4.p = 0;
  }
  if( n<0 ){
    sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(p, (int)(pOp - p->aOp), zP4, n);
  }else{
    if( n==0 ) n = sqlite3Strlen30(zP4);
    pOp->p4.z = sqlite3DbStrNDup(p->db, zP4, n);
    pOp->p4type =(-6)       ;
  }
}
static         void sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(Vdbe *p, int addr, const char *zP4, int n){
  Op *pOp;
  sqlite3 *db;
  assert( p!=0 );
  db = p->db;
  assert( p->eVdbeState==0               );
  assert( p->aOp!=0 || db->mallocFailed );
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    if( n!=(-11)   ) freeP4(db, n, (void*)*(char**)&zP4);
    return;
  }
  assert( p->nOp>0 );
  assert( addr<p->nOp );
  if( addr<0 ){
    addr = p->nOp - 1;
  }
  pOp = &p->aOp[addr];
  if( n>=0 || pOp->p4type ){
    vdbeChangeP4Full(p, pOp, zP4, n);
    return;
  }
  if( n==(-3)     ){


    pOp->p4.i =((int)(intptr_t)(zP4)) ;
    pOp->p4type =(-3)     ;
  }else if( zP4!=0 ){
    assert( n<0 );
    pOp->p4.p = (void*)zP4;
    pOp->p4type = (signed char)n;
    if( n==(-11)   )                              ;
  }
}










static         void sqlite3VdbeAppendP4(Vdbe *p, void *pP4, int n){
  VdbeOp *pOp;
  assert( n!=(-3)     && n!=(-11)   );
  assert( n<=0 );
  if( p->db->mallocFailed ){
    freeP4(p->db, n, pP4);
  }else{
    assert( pP4!=0 || n==(-6)       );
    assert( p->nOp>0 );
    pOp = &p->aOp[p->nOp-1];
    assert( pOp->p4type==0          );
    pOp->p4type = n;
    pOp->p4.p = pP4;
  }
}





static         void sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo(Parse *pParse, Index *pIdx){
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  KeyInfo *pKeyInfo;
  assert( v!=0 );
  assert( pIdx!=0 );
  pKeyInfo = sqlite3KeyInfoOfIndex(pParse, pIdx);
  if( pKeyInfo ) sqlite3VdbeAppendP4(v, pKeyInfo,(-8)       );
}








static void vdbeVComment(Vdbe *p, const char *zFormat, va_list ap){
  assert( p->nOp>0 || p->aOp==0 );
  assert( p->aOp==0 || p->aOp[p->nOp-1].zComment==0 || p->pParse->nErr>0 );
  if( p->nOp ){
    assert( p->aOp );
    sqlite3DbFree(p->db, p->aOp[p->nOp-1].zComment);
    p->aOp[p->nOp-1].zComment = sqlite3VMPrintf(p->db, zFormat, ap);
  }
}
static         void sqlite3VdbeComment(Vdbe *p, const char *zFormat, ...){
  va_list ap;
  if( p ){
    va_start(ap, zFormat);
    vdbeVComment(p, zFormat, ap);
    va_end(ap);
  }
}
static         void sqlite3VdbeNoopComment(Vdbe *p, const char *zFormat, ...){
  va_list ap;
  if( p ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(p,184     );
    va_start(ap, zFormat);
    vdbeVComment(p, zFormat, ap);
    va_end(ap);
  }
}






static         void sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(Vdbe *v, int iLine){
  sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(v)->iSrcLine = iLine;
}















static         VdbeOp *sqlite3VdbeGetOp(Vdbe *p, int addr){


  static VdbeOp dummy;
  assert( p->eVdbeState==0               );
  assert( (addr>=0 && addr<p->nOp) || p->db->mallocFailed );
  if( p->db->mallocFailed ){
    return (VdbeOp*)&dummy;
  }else{
    return &p->aOp[addr];
  }
}



VdbeOp * sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(Vdbe *p){
  return sqlite3VdbeGetOp(p, p->nOp - 1);
}






static int translateP(char c, const Op *pOp){
  if( c=='1' ) return pOp->p1;
  if( c=='2' ) return pOp->p2;
  if( c=='3' ) return pOp->p3;
  if( c=='4' ) return pOp->p4.i;
  return pOp->p5;
}














static         char *sqlite3VdbeDisplayComment(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const Op *pOp,
  const char *zP4
){
  const char *zOpName;
  const char *zSynopsis;
  int nOpName;
  int ii;
  char zAlt[50];
  StrAccum x;

  sqlite3StrAccumInit(&x, 0, 0, 0,1000000000        );
  zOpName = sqlite3OpcodeName(pOp->opcode);
  nOpName = sqlite3Strlen30(zOpName);
  if( zOpName[nOpName+1] ){
    int seenCom = 0;
    char c;
    zSynopsis = zOpName + nOpName + 1;
    if( strncmp(zSynopsis,"IF ",3)==0 ){
      sqlite3_snprintf(sizeof(zAlt), zAlt, "if %s goto P2", zSynopsis+3);
      zSynopsis = zAlt;
    }
    for(ii=0; (c = zSynopsis[ii])!=0; ii++){
      if( c=='P' ){
        c = zSynopsis[++ii];
        if( c=='4' ){
          sqlite3_str_appendall(&x, zP4);
        }else if( c=='X' ){
          if( pOp->zComment && pOp->zComment[0] ){
            sqlite3_str_appendall(&x, pOp->zComment);
            seenCom = 1;
            break;
          }
        }else{
          int v1 = translateP(c, pOp);
          int v2;
          if( strncmp(zSynopsis+ii+1, "@P", 2)==0 ){
            ii += 3;
            v2 = translateP(zSynopsis[ii], pOp);
            if( strncmp(zSynopsis+ii+1,"+1",2)==0 ){
              ii += 2;
              v2++;
            }
            if( v2<2 ){
              sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d", v1);
            }else{
              sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d..%d", v1, v1+v2-1);
            }
          }else if( strncmp(zSynopsis+ii+1, "@NP", 3)==0 ){
            sqlite3_context *pCtx = pOp->p4.pCtx;
            if( pOp->p4type!=(-15)      || pCtx->argc==1 ){
              sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d", v1);
            }else if( pCtx->argc>1 ){
              sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d..%d", v1, v1+pCtx->argc-1);
            }else if( x.accError==0 ){
              assert( x.nChar>2 );
              x.nChar -= 2;
              ii++;
            }
            ii += 3;
          }else{
            sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d", v1);
            if( strncmp(zSynopsis+ii+1, "..P3", 4)==0 && pOp->p3==0 ){
              ii += 4;
            }
          }
        }
      }else{
        sqlite3_str_appendchar(&x, 1, c);
      }
    }
    if( !seenCom && pOp->zComment ){
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "; %s", pOp->zComment);
    }
  }else if( pOp->zComment ){
    sqlite3_str_appendall(&x, pOp->zComment);
  }
  if( (x.accError &7            )!=0 && db!=0 ){
    sqlite3OomFault(db);
  }
  return sqlite3StrAccumFinish(&x);
}







static void displayP4Expr(StrAccum *p, Expr *pExpr){
  const char *zOp = 0;
  switch( pExpr->op ){
    case 117      :
      assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
      sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "%Q", pExpr->u.zToken);
      break;
    case 155       :
      sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "%d", pExpr->u.iValue);
      break;
    case 121    :
      sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "NULL");
      break;
    case 176        : {
      sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "r[%d]", pExpr->iTable);
      break;
    }
    case 167      : {
      if( pExpr->iColumn<0 ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "rowid");
      }else{
        sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "c%d", (int)pExpr->iColumn);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 56   :      zOp = "LT";      break;
    case 55   :      zOp = "LE";      break;
    case 54   :      zOp = "GT";      break;
    case 57   :      zOp = "GE";      break;
    case 52   :      zOp = "NE";      break;
    case 53   :      zOp = "EQ";      break;
    case 45   :      zOp = "IS";      break;
    case 171     :   zOp = "ISNOT";   break;
    case 44    :     zOp = "AND";     break;
    case 43   :      zOp = "OR";      break;
    case 106    :    zOp = "ADD";     break;
    case 108    :    zOp = "MUL";     break;
    case 107     :   zOp = "SUB";     break;
    case 110   :     zOp = "REM";     break;
    case 102      :  zOp = "BITAND";  break;
    case 103     :   zOp = "BITOR";   break;
    case 109     :   zOp = "DIV";     break;
    case 104      :  zOp = "LSHIFT";  break;
    case 105      :  zOp = "RSHIFT";  break;
    case 111      :  zOp = "CONCAT";  break;
    case 173      :  zOp = "MINUS";   break;
    case 174     :   zOp = "PLUS";    break;
    case 114      :  zOp = "BITNOT";  break;
    case 19    :     zOp = "NOT";     break;
    case 50       :  zOp = "ISNULL";  break;
    case 51        : zOp = "NOTNULL"; break;

    default:
      sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "%s", "expr");
      break;
  }

  if( zOp ){
    sqlite3_str_appendf(p, "%s(", zOp);
    displayP4Expr(p, pExpr->pLeft);
    if( pExpr->pRight ){
      sqlite3_str_append(p, ",", 1);
      displayP4Expr(p, pExpr->pRight);
    }
    sqlite3_str_append(p, ")", 1);
  }
}








static         char *sqlite3VdbeDisplayP4(sqlite3 *db, Op *pOp){
  char *zP4 = 0;
  StrAccum x;

  sqlite3StrAccumInit(&x, 0, 0, 0,1000000000        );
  switch( pOp->p4type ){
    case(-8)       : {
      int j;
      KeyInfo *pKeyInfo = pOp->p4.pKeyInfo;
      assert( pKeyInfo->aSortFlags!=0 );
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "k(%d", pKeyInfo->nKeyField);
      for(j=0; j<pKeyInfo->nKeyField; j++){
        CollSeq *pColl = pKeyInfo->aColl[j];
        const char *zColl = pColl ? pColl->zName : "";
        if( strcmp(zColl, "BINARY")==0 ) zColl = "B";
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, ",%s%s%s",
               (pKeyInfo->aSortFlags[j] &0x01               ) ? "-" : "",
               (pKeyInfo->aSortFlags[j] &0x02                  )? "N." : "",
               zColl);
      }
      sqlite3_str_append(&x, ")", 1);
      break;
    }

    case(-9)    : {
      displayP4Expr(&x, pOp->p4.pExpr);
      break;
    }

    case(-2)       : {
      static const char *const encnames[] = {"?", "8", "16LE", "16BE"};
      CollSeq *pColl = pOp->p4.pColl;
      assert( pColl->enc<4 );
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%.18s-%s", pColl->zName,
                          encnames[pColl->enc]);
      break;
    }
    case(-7)       : {
      FuncDef *pDef = pOp->p4.pFunc;
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%s(%d)", pDef->zName, pDef->nArg);
      break;
    }
    case(-15)      : {
      FuncDef *pDef = pOp->p4.pCtx->pFunc;
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%s(%d)", pDef->zName, pDef->nArg);
      break;
    }
    case(-13)    : {
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%lld", *pOp->p4.pI64);
      break;
    }
    case(-3)     : {
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%d", pOp->p4.i);
      break;
    }
    case(-12)   : {
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%.16g", *pOp->p4.pReal);
      break;
    }
    case(-10)  : {
      Mem *pMem = pOp->p4.pMem;
      if( pMem->flags &0x0002   ){
        zP4 = pMem->z;
      }else if( pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%lld", pMem->u.i);
      }else if( pMem->flags &0x0008    ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%.16g", pMem->u.r);
      }else if( pMem->flags &0x0001    ){
        zP4 = "NULL";
      }else{
        assert( pMem->flags &0x0010    );
        zP4 = "(blob)";
      }
      break;
    }

    case(-11)   : {
      sqlite3_vtab *pVtab = pOp->p4.pVtab->pVtab;
      sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "vtab:%p", pVtab);
      break;
    }

    case(-14)       : {
      u32 i;
      u32 *ai = pOp->p4.ai;
      u32 n = ai[0];

      for(i=1; i<=n; i++){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&x, "%c%u", (i==1 ? '[' : ','), ai[i]);
      }
      sqlite3_str_append(&x, "]", 1);
      break;
    }
    case(-4)          : {
      zP4 = "program";
      break;
    }
    case(-5)     : {
      zP4 = pOp->p4.pTab->zName;
      break;
    }
    default: {
      zP4 = pOp->p4.z;
    }
  }
  if( zP4 ) sqlite3_str_appendall(&x, zP4);
  if( (x.accError &7            )!=0 ){
    sqlite3OomFault(db);
  }
  return sqlite3StrAccumFinish(&x);
}










static         void sqlite3VdbeUsesBtree(Vdbe *p, int i){
  assert( i>=0 && i<p->db->nDb && i<(int)sizeof(yDbMask)*8 );
  assert( i<(int)sizeof(p->btreeMask)*8 );
(p->btreeMask)[(i)/8]|=(1<<((i)&7));
  if( i!=1 &&0                                        ){
(p->lockMask)[(i)/8]|=(1<<((i)&7));
  }
}
