           void sqlite3_result_text64(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  const char *z,
  sqlite3_uint64 n,
  void (*xDel)(void *),
  unsigned char enc
){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
  if( enc!=1           ){
    if( enc==4            ) enc =3                  ;
    n &= ~(u64)1;
  }
  if( n>0x7fffffff ){
    (void)invokeValueDestructor(z, xDel, pCtx);
  }else{
    setResultStrOrError(pCtx, z, (int)n, enc, xDel);
  }
}

           void sqlite3_result_text16(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  const void *z,
  int n,
  void (*xDel)(void *)
){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  setResultStrOrError(pCtx, z, n & ~(u64)1,3                  , xDel);
}
           void sqlite3_result_text16be(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  const void *z,
  int n,
  void (*xDel)(void *)
){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  setResultStrOrError(pCtx, z, n & ~(u64)1,3              , xDel);
}
           void sqlite3_result_text16le(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  const void *z,
  int n,
  void (*xDel)(void *)
){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  setResultStrOrError(pCtx, z, n & ~(u64)1,2              , xDel);
}

           void sqlite3_result_value(sqlite3_context *pCtx, sqlite3_value *pValue){
  Mem *pOut = pCtx->pOut;
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  sqlite3VdbeMemCopy(pOut, pValue);
  sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pOut, pCtx->enc);
  if( sqlite3VdbeMemTooBig(pOut) ){
    sqlite3_result_error_toobig(pCtx);
  }
}
           void sqlite3_result_zeroblob(sqlite3_context *pCtx, int n){
  sqlite3_result_zeroblob64(pCtx, n>0 ? n : 0);
}
           int sqlite3_result_zeroblob64(sqlite3_context *pCtx, u64 n){
  Mem *pOut = pCtx->pOut;
  assert(((void)(pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  if( n>(u64)pOut->db->aLimit[0                  ] ){
    sqlite3_result_error_toobig(pCtx);
    return 18           ;
  }

  sqlite3VdbeMemSetZeroBlob(pCtx->pOut, (int)n);
  return 0        ;

  return sqlite3VdbeMemSetZeroBlob(pCtx->pOut, (int)n);

}
           void sqlite3_result_error_code(sqlite3_context *pCtx, int errCode){
  pCtx->isError = errCode ? errCode : -1;

  if( pCtx->pVdbe ) pCtx->pVdbe->rcApp = errCode;

  if( pCtx->pOut->flags &0x0001    ){
    setResultStrOrError(pCtx, sqlite3ErrStr(errCode), -1,1           ,
((sqlite3_destructor_type)0)         );
  }
}


           void sqlite3_result_error_toobig(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  pCtx->isError =18            ;
  sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr(pCtx->pOut, "string or blob too big", -1,
1                                 ,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
}


           void sqlite3_result_error_nomem(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pCtx->pOut);
  pCtx->isError =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  sqlite3OomFault(pCtx->pOut->db);
}






static         void sqlite3ResultIntReal(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
  if( pCtx->pOut->flags &0x0004   ){
    pCtx->pOut->flags &= ~0x0004 ;
    pCtx->pOut->flags |=0x0020      ;
  }
}







static int doWalCallbacks(sqlite3 *db){
  int rc =0         ;

  int i;
  for(i=0; i<db->nDb; i++){
    Btree *pBt = db->aDb[i].pBt;
    if( pBt ){
      int nEntry;
                            ;
      nEntry = sqlite3PagerWalCallback(sqlite3BtreePager(pBt));
                            ;
      if( nEntry>0 && db->xWalCallback && rc==0         ){
        rc = db->xWalCallback(db->pWalArg, db, db->aDb[i].zDbSName, nEntry);
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}











static int sqlite3Step(Vdbe *p){
  sqlite3 *db;
  int rc;

  assert(p);
  db = p->db;
  if( p->eVdbeState!=2              ){
    restart_step:
    if( p->eVdbeState==1                ){
      if( p->expired ){
        p->rc =17            ;
        rc =1            ;
        if( (p->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 ){





          rc = sqlite3VdbeTransferError(p);
        }
        goto end_of_step;
      }





      if( db->nVdbeActive==0 ){
__atomic_store_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),(0),__ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      }

      assert( db->nVdbeWrite>0 || db->autoCommit==0
          || (db->nDeferredCons==0 && db->nDeferredImmCons==0)
      );


      if( (db->mTrace & (0x02                |0x80                 ))!=0
          && !db->init.busy && p->zSql ){
        sqlite3OsCurrentTimeInt64(db->pVfs, &p->startTime);
      }else{
        assert( p->startTime==0 );
      }


      db->nVdbeActive++;
      if( p->readOnly==0 ) db->nVdbeWrite++;
      if( p->bIsReader ) db->nVdbeRead++;
      p->pc = 0;
      p->eVdbeState =2              ;
    }else

    if((1)                                     ){

















      if( (rc = p->rc&0xff)==5           || rc==6             ){
        sqlite3_reset((sqlite3_stmt*)p);
      }else{
        return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
      }

      sqlite3_reset((sqlite3_stmt*)p);

      assert( p->eVdbeState==1                );
      goto restart_step;
    }
  }


  p->rcApp =0         ;


  if( p->explain ){
    rc = sqlite3VdbeList(p);
  }else

  {
    db->nVdbeExec++;
    rc = sqlite3VdbeExec(p);
    db->nVdbeExec--;
  }

  if( rc==100        ){
    assert( p->rc==0         );
    assert( db->mallocFailed==0 );
    db->errCode =100        ;
    return 100       ;
  }else{


if( ((p)->startTime)>0 ){ invokeProfileCallback(db,p); };

    p->pResultRow = 0;
    if( rc==101         && db->autoCommit ){
      assert( p->rc==0         );
      p->rc = doWalCallbacks(db);
      if( p->rc!=0         ){
        rc =1            ;
      }
    }else if( rc!=101         && (p->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 ){




      rc = sqlite3VdbeTransferError(p);
    }
  }

  db->errCode = rc;
  if(7            ==sqlite3ApiExit(p->db, p->rc) ){
    p->rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    if( (p->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 ) rc = p->rc;
  }
end_of_step:


  assert( (p->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0
       || rc==100         || rc==101           || rc==1
       || (rc&0xff)==5           || rc==21
  );
  return (rc&db->errMask);
}






           int sqlite3_step(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  int rc =0         ;
  Vdbe *v = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  int cnt = 0;
  sqlite3 *db;

  if( vdbeSafetyNotNull(v) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
  db = v->db;
                                ;
  while( (rc = sqlite3Step(v))==17
         && cnt++ <50                       ){
    int savedPc = v->pc;
    rc = sqlite3Reprepare(v);
    if( rc!=0         ){








      const char *zErr = (const char *)sqlite3_value_text(db->pErr);
      sqlite3DbFree(db, v->zErrMsg);
      if( !db->mallocFailed ){
        v->zErrMsg = sqlite3DbStrDup(db, zErr);
        v->rc = rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
      } else {
        v->zErrMsg = 0;
        v->rc = rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
      }
      break;
    }
    sqlite3_reset(pStmt);
    if( savedPc>=0 ){




      v->minWriteFileFormat = 254;
    }
    assert( v->expired==0 );
  }
                                ;
  return rc;
}






           void *sqlite3_user_data(sqlite3_context *p){
  assert( p && p->pFunc );
  return p->pFunc->pUserData;
}











           sqlite3 *sqlite3_context_db_handle(sqlite3_context *p){
  assert( p && p->pOut );
  return p->pOut->db;
}















           int sqlite3_vtab_nochange(sqlite3_context *p){
  assert( p );
  return sqlite3_value_nochange(p->pOut);
}








static         void sqlite3VdbeValueListFree(void *pToDelete){
  sqlite3_free(pToDelete);
}





static int valueFromValueList(
  sqlite3_value *pVal,
  sqlite3_value **ppOut,
  int bNext
){
  int rc;
  ValueList *pRhs;

  *ppOut = 0;
  if( pVal==0 ) return 21           ;
  if( (pVal->flags &0x1000  )==0 || pVal->xDel!=sqlite3VdbeValueListFree ){
    return 1           ;
  }else{
    assert( (pVal->flags&(0x0dbf      |0x0200  |0x0800     )) ==
                 (0x0001  |0x0200  |0x0800     ) );
    assert( pVal->eSubtype=='p' );
    assert( pVal->u.zPType!=0 && strcmp(pVal->u.zPType,"ValueList")==0 );
    pRhs = (ValueList*)pVal->z;
  }
  if( bNext ){
    rc = sqlite3BtreeNext(pRhs->pCsr, 0);
  }else{
    int dummy = 0;
    rc = sqlite3BtreeFirst(pRhs->pCsr, &dummy);
    assert( rc==0         || sqlite3BtreeEof(pRhs->pCsr) );
    if( sqlite3BtreeEof(pRhs->pCsr) ) rc =101         ;
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    u32 sz;
    Mem sMem;
    memset(&sMem, 0, sizeof(sMem));
    sz = sqlite3BtreePayloadSize(pRhs->pCsr);
    rc = sqlite3VdbeMemFromBtreeZeroOffset(pRhs->pCsr,(int)sz,&sMem);
    if( rc==0         ){
      u8 *zBuf = (u8*)sMem.z;
      u32 iSerial;
      sqlite3_value *pOut = pRhs->pOut;
      int iOff = 1 +(u8)((*(&zBuf[1])<(u8)0x80)?((iSerial)=(u32)*(&zBuf[1])),1:sqlite3GetVarint32((&zBuf[1]),(u32 *)&(iSerial)));
      sqlite3VdbeSerialGet(&zBuf[iOff], iSerial, pOut);
      pOut->enc =((pOut->db)->enc);
      if( (pOut->flags &0x4000    )!=0 && sqlite3VdbeMemMakeWriteable(pOut) ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        *ppOut = pOut;
      }
    }
    sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(&sMem);
  }
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_vtab_in_first(sqlite3_value *pVal, sqlite3_value **ppOut){
  return valueFromValueList(pVal, ppOut, 0);
}





           int sqlite3_vtab_in_next(sqlite3_value *pVal, sqlite3_value **ppOut){
  return valueFromValueList(pVal, ppOut, 1);
}








static         sqlite3_int64 sqlite3StmtCurrentTime(sqlite3_context *p){
  int rc;

  sqlite3_int64 *piTime = &p->pVdbe->iCurrentTime;
  assert( p->pVdbe!=0 );

  sqlite3_int64 iTime = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 *piTime = p->pVdbe!=0 ? &p->pVdbe->iCurrentTime : &iTime;

  if( *piTime==0 ){
    rc = sqlite3OsCurrentTimeInt64(p->pOut->db->pVfs, piTime);
    if( rc ) *piTime = 0;
  }
  return *piTime;
}





static __attribute__((noinline))void*createAggContext(sqlite3_context*p,int nByte){
  Mem *pMem = p->pMem;
  assert( (pMem->flags &0x8000  )==0 );
  if( nByte<=0 ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pMem);
    pMem->z = 0;
  }else{
    sqlite3VdbeMemClearAndResize(pMem, nByte);
    pMem->flags =0x8000  ;
    pMem->u.pDef = p->pFunc;
    if( pMem->z ){
      memset(pMem->z, 0, nByte);
    }
  }
  return (void*)pMem->z;
}






           void *sqlite3_aggregate_context(sqlite3_context *p, int nByte){
  assert( p && p->pFunc && p->pFunc->xFinalize );
  assert(((void)(p->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );
if( nByte<0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( (p->pMem->flags &0x8000  )==0 ){
    return createAggContext(p, nByte);
  }else{
    return (void*)p->pMem->z;
  }
}











           void *sqlite3_get_auxdata(sqlite3_context *pCtx, int iArg){
  AuxData *pAuxData;

  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );

  if( pCtx->pVdbe==0 ) return 0;

  assert( pCtx->pVdbe!=0 );

  for(pAuxData=pCtx->pVdbe->pAuxData; pAuxData; pAuxData=pAuxData->pNextAux){
    if(  pAuxData->iAuxArg==iArg && (pAuxData->iAuxOp==pCtx->iOp || iArg<0) ){
      return pAuxData->pAux;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}












           void sqlite3_set_auxdata(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int iArg,
  void *pAux,
  void (*xDelete)(void*)
){
  AuxData *pAuxData;
  Vdbe *pVdbe = pCtx->pVdbe;

  assert(((void)(pCtx->pOut->db->mutex),1)          );

  if( pVdbe==0 ) goto failed;

  assert( pVdbe!=0 );


  for(pAuxData=pVdbe->pAuxData; pAuxData; pAuxData=pAuxData->pNextAux){
    if( pAuxData->iAuxArg==iArg && (pAuxData->iAuxOp==pCtx->iOp || iArg<0) ){
      break;
    }
  }
  if( pAuxData==0 ){
    pAuxData = sqlite3DbMallocZero(pVdbe->db, sizeof(AuxData));
    if( !pAuxData ) goto failed;
    pAuxData->iAuxOp = pCtx->iOp;
    pAuxData->iAuxArg = iArg;
    pAuxData->pNextAux = pVdbe->pAuxData;
    pVdbe->pAuxData = pAuxData;
    if( pCtx->isError==0 ) pCtx->isError = -1;
  }else if( pAuxData->xDeleteAux ){
    pAuxData->xDeleteAux(pAuxData->pAux);
  }

  pAuxData->pAux = pAux;
  pAuxData->xDeleteAux = xDelete;
  return;

failed:
  if( xDelete ){
    xDelete(pAux);
  }
}











           int sqlite3_aggregate_count(sqlite3_context *p){
  assert( p && p->pMem && p->pFunc && p->pFunc->xFinalize );
  return p->pMem->n;
}





           int sqlite3_column_count(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  Vdbe *pVm = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  return pVm ? pVm->nResColumn : 0;
}





           int sqlite3_data_count(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  Vdbe *pVm = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  if( pVm==0 || pVm->pResultRow==0 ) return 0;
  return pVm->nResColumn;
}




static const Mem *columnNullValue(void){









  static const Mem nullMem

    __attribute__((aligned(8)))

    = {
                            {0},
                            (char*)0,
                            (int)0,
                            (u16)0x0001  ,
                            (u8)0,
                            (u8)0,
                            (sqlite3*)0,
                            (int)0,
                            (u32)0,
                            (char*)0,
                            (void(*)(void*))0,

                            (Mem*)0,
                            0,

      };
  return &nullMem;
}







static Mem *columnMem(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i){
  Vdbe *pVm;
  Mem *pOut;

  pVm = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  if( pVm==0 ) return (Mem*)columnNullValue();
  assert( pVm->db );
                                     ;
  if( pVm->pResultRow!=0 && i<pVm->nResColumn && i>=0 ){
    pOut = &pVm->pResultRow[i];
  }else{
    sqlite3Error(pVm->db,25           );
    pOut = (Mem*)columnNullValue();
  }
  return pOut;
}



















static void columnMallocFailure(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt)
{





  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  if( p ){
    assert( p->db!=0 );
    assert(((void)(p->db->mutex),1)          );
    p->rc = sqlite3ApiExit(p->db, p->rc);
                                     ;
  }
}





           const void *sqlite3_column_blob(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i){
  const void *val;
  val = sqlite3_value_blob( columnMem(pStmt,i) );




  columnMallocFailure(pStmt);
  return val;
}

sqlite_int64 val=sqlite3_value_double(columnMem(pStmt,i));

           sqlite3_value *sqlite3_column_value(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i){

static const void *columnName(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int N,
  int useUtf16,
  int useType
){
  const void *ret;
  Vdbe *p;
  int n;
  sqlite3 *db;

  if( pStmt==0 ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  ret = 0;
  p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  db = p->db;
  assert( db!=0 );
  n = sqlite3_column_count(pStmt);
  if( N<n && N>=0 ){
    N += useType*n;
                                  ;
    assert( db->mallocFailed==0 );

    if( useUtf16 ){
      ret = sqlite3_value_text16((sqlite3_value*)&p->aColName[N]);
    }else

    {
      ret = sqlite3_value_text((sqlite3_value*)&p->aColName[N]);
    }



    if( db->mallocFailed ){
      sqlite3OomClear(db);
      ret = 0;
    }
                                  ;
  }
  return ret;
}

static int vdbeUnbind(Vdbe *p, unsigned int i){
  Mem *pVar;
  if( vdbeSafetyNotNull(p) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
                                   ;
  if( p->eVdbeState!=1                ){
    sqlite3Error(p->db,21            );
                                     ;
    sqlite3_log(21           ,
        "bind on a busy prepared statement: [%s]", p->zSql);
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
  if( i>=(unsigned int)p->nVar ){
    sqlite3Error(p->db,25           );
                                     ;
    return 25          ;
  }
  pVar = &p->aVar[i];
  sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(pVar);
  pVar->flags =0x0001   ;
  p->db->errCode =0         ;










  assert( (p->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 || p->expmask==0 );
  if( p->expmask!=0 && (p->expmask & (i>=31 ? 0x80000000 : (u32)1<<i))!=0 ){
    p->expired = 1;
  }
  return 0        ;
}




static int bindText(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const void *zData,
  i64 nData,
  void (*xDel)(void*),
  u8 encoding
){
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  Mem *pVar;
  int rc;

  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){
    if( zData!=0 ){
      pVar = &p->aVar[i-1];
      rc = sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr(pVar, zData, nData, encoding, xDel);
      if( rc==0         && encoding!=0 ){
        rc = sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pVar,((p->db)->enc));
      }
      if( rc ){
        sqlite3Error(p->db, rc);
        rc = sqlite3ApiExit(p->db, rc);
      }
    }
                                     ;
  }else if( xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)0)&&xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1)){
    xDel((void*)zData);
  }
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_bind_blob(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const void *zData,
  int nData,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){

  if( nData<0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

  return bindText(pStmt, i, zData, nData, xDel, 0);
}
           int sqlite3_bind_blob64(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const void *zData,
  sqlite3_uint64 nData,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){
  assert( xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
  return bindText(pStmt, i, zData, nData, xDel, 0);
}
           int sqlite3_bind_double(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i,sqlite_int64 rValue){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64     (&p->aVar[i-1], rValue);
                                     ;
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_int(sqlite3_stmt *p, int i, int iValue){
  return sqlite3_bind_int64(p, i, (i64)iValue);
}
           int sqlite3_bind_int64(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i, sqlite_int64 iValue){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(&p->aVar[i-1], iValue);
                                     ;
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_null(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){
                                     ;
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_pointer(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  void *pPtr,
  const char *zPTtype,
  void (*xDestructor)(void*)
){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetPointer(&p->aVar[i-1], pPtr, zPTtype, xDestructor);
                                     ;
  }else if( xDestructor ){
    xDestructor(pPtr);
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_text(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const char *zData,
  int nData,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){
  return bindText(pStmt, i, zData, nData, xDel,1           );
}
           int sqlite3_bind_text64(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const char *zData,
  sqlite3_uint64 nData,
  void (*xDel)(void*),
  unsigned char enc
){
  assert( xDel!=((sqlite3_destructor_type)sqlite3OomClear));
  if( enc!=1           ){
    if( enc==4            ) enc =3                  ;
    nData &= ~(u16)1;
  }
  return bindText(pStmt, i, zData, nData, xDel, enc);
}

           int sqlite3_bind_text16(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  const void *zData,
  int n,
  void (*xDel)(void*)
){
  return bindText(pStmt, i, zData, n & ~(u64)1, xDel,3                  );
}

           int sqlite3_bind_value(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i, const sqlite3_value *pValue){
  int rc;
  switch( sqlite3_value_type((sqlite3_value*)pValue) ){
    case 1             : {
      rc = sqlite3_bind_int64(pStmt, i, pValue->u.i);
      break;
    }
    case 2           : {
      assert( pValue->flags & (0x0008  |0x0020     ) );
      rc = sqlite3_bind_double(pStmt, i,
          (pValue->flags &0x0008   ) ? pValue->u.r : (sqlite_int64)pValue->u.i
      );
      break;
    }
    case 4          : {
      if( pValue->flags &0x0400    ){
        rc = sqlite3_bind_zeroblob(pStmt, i, pValue->u.nZero);
      }else{
        rc = sqlite3_bind_blob(pStmt, i, pValue->z, pValue->n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
      }
      break;
    }
    case 3          : {
      rc = bindText(pStmt,i,  pValue->z, pValue->n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1),
                              pValue->enc);
      break;
    }
    default: {
      rc = sqlite3_bind_null(pStmt, i);
      break;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_zeroblob(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i, int n){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
  rc = vdbeUnbind(p, (u32)(i-1));
  if( rc==0         ){

    sqlite3VdbeMemSetZeroBlob(&p->aVar[i-1], n);

    rc = sqlite3VdbeMemSetZeroBlob(&p->aVar[i-1], n);

                                     ;
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3_bind_zeroblob64(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i, sqlite3_uint64 n){
  int rc;
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
                                   ;
  if( n>(u64)p->db->aLimit[0                  ] ){
    rc =18            ;
  }else{
    assert( (n & 0x7FFFFFFF)==n );
    rc = sqlite3_bind_zeroblob(pStmt, i, n);
  }
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(p->db, rc);
                                   ;
  return rc;
}

static         int sqlite3TransferBindings(sqlite3_stmt *pFromStmt, sqlite3_stmt *pToStmt){
  Vdbe *pFrom = (Vdbe*)pFromStmt;
  Vdbe *pTo = (Vdbe*)pToStmt;
  int i;
  assert( pTo->db==pFrom->db );
  assert( pTo->nVar==pFrom->nVar );
                                     ;
  for(i=0; i<pFrom->nVar; i++){
    sqlite3VdbeMemMove(&pTo->aVar[i], &pFrom->aVar[i]);
  }
                                     ;
  return 0        ;
}














           int sqlite3_transfer_bindings(sqlite3_stmt *pFromStmt, sqlite3_stmt *pToStmt){
  Vdbe *pFrom = (Vdbe*)pFromStmt;
  Vdbe *pTo = (Vdbe*)pToStmt;
  if( pFrom->nVar!=pTo->nVar ){
    return 1           ;
  }
  assert( (pTo->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 || pTo->expmask==0 );
  if( pTo->expmask ){
    pTo->expired = 1;
  }
  assert( (pFrom->prepFlags &0x80                   )!=0 || pFrom->expmask==0 );
  if( pFrom->expmask ){
    pFrom->expired = 1;
  }
  return sqlite3TransferBindings(pFromStmt, pToStmt);
}

           sqlite3_stmt *sqlite3_next_stmt(sqlite3 *pDb, sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  sqlite3_stmt *pNext;

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(pDb) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

                                 ;
  if( pStmt==0 ){
    pNext = (sqlite3_stmt*)pDb->pVdbe;
  }else{
    pNext = (sqlite3_stmt*)((Vdbe*)pStmt)->pVNext;
  }
                                 ;
  return pNext;
}




           int sqlite3_stmt_status(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int op, int resetFlag){
  Vdbe *pVdbe = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  u32 v;

  if( !pStmt
   || (op!=99                        && (op<0||op>=((int)(sizeof(pVdbe->aCounter)/sizeof(pVdbe->aCounter[0])))))
  ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  if( op==99                        ){
    sqlite3 *db = pVdbe->db;
                                  ;
    v = 0;
    db->pnBytesFreed = (int*)&v;
    assert( db->lookaside.pEnd==db->lookaside.pTrueEnd );
    db->lookaside.pEnd = db->lookaside.pStart;
    sqlite3VdbeDelete(pVdbe);
    db->pnBytesFreed = 0;
    db->lookaside.pEnd = db->lookaside.pTrueEnd;
                                  ;
  }else{
    v = pVdbe->aCounter[op];
    if( resetFlag ) pVdbe->aCounter[op] = 0;
  }
  return (int)v;
}

}










           char *sqlite3_expanded_sql(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){

  return 0;

  char *z = 0;
  const char *zSql = sqlite3_sql(pStmt);
  if( zSql ){
    Vdbe *p = (Vdbe *)pStmt;
                                     ;
    z = sqlite3VdbeExpandSql(p, zSql);
                                     ;
  }
  return z;

}





           const char *sqlite3_normalized_sql(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){

  if( p==0 ) return 0;
  if( p->zNormSql==0 &&(1)                 ){
                                     ;
    p->zNormSql = sqlite3Normalize(p, p->zSql);
                                     ;
  }
  return p->zNormSql;
}








static UnpackedRecord *vdbeUnpackRecord(
  KeyInfo *pKeyInfo,
  int nKey,
  const void *pKey
){
  UnpackedRecord *pRet;

  pRet = sqlite3VdbeAllocUnpackedRecord(pKeyInfo);
  if( pRet ){
    memset(pRet->aMem, 0, sizeof(Mem)*(pKeyInfo->nKeyField+1));
    sqlite3VdbeRecordUnpack(pKeyInfo, nKey, pKey, pRet);
  }
  return pRet;
}





           int sqlite3_preupdate_old(sqlite3 *db, int iIdx, sqlite3_value **ppValue){
  PreUpdate *p = db->pPreUpdate;
  Mem *pMem;
  int rc =0         ;



  if( !p || p->op==18            ){
    rc =sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    goto preupdate_old_out;
  }
  if( p->pPk ){
    iIdx = sqlite3TableColumnToIndex(p->pPk, iIdx);
  }
  if( iIdx>=p->pCsr->nField || iIdx<0 ){
    rc =25           ;
    goto preupdate_old_out;
  }


  if( p->pUnpacked==0 ){
    u32 nRec;
    u8 *aRec;

    assert( p->pCsr->eCurType==0             );
    nRec = sqlite3BtreePayloadSize(p->pCsr->uc.pCursor);
    aRec = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(db, nRec);
    if( !aRec ) goto preupdate_old_out;
    rc = sqlite3BtreePayload(p->pCsr->uc.pCursor, 0, nRec, aRec);
    if( rc==0         ){
      p->pUnpacked = vdbeUnpackRecord(&p->keyinfo, nRec, aRec);
      if( !p->pUnpacked ) rc =7            ;
    }
    if( rc!=0         ){
      sqlite3DbFree(db, aRec);
      goto preupdate_old_out;
    }
    p->aRecord = aRec;
  }

  pMem = *ppValue = &p->pUnpacked->aMem[iIdx];
  if( iIdx==p->pTab->iPKey ){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(pMem, p->iKey1);
  }else if( iIdx>=p->pUnpacked->nField ){
    *ppValue = (sqlite3_value *)columnNullValue();
  }else if( p->pTab->aCol[iIdx].affinity==0x45            ){
    if( pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
if( pMem->flags & 0x0004 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      sqlite3VdbeMemRealify(pMem);
    }
  }

 preupdate_old_out:
  sqlite3Error(db, rc);
  return sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
}







           int sqlite3_preupdate_count(sqlite3 *db){
  PreUpdate *p = db->pPreUpdate;
  return (p ? p->keyinfo.nKeyField : 0);
}














           int sqlite3_preupdate_depth(sqlite3 *db){
  PreUpdate *p = db->pPreUpdate;
  return (p ? p->v->nFrame : 0);
}







           int sqlite3_preupdate_blobwrite(sqlite3 *db){
  PreUpdate *p = db->pPreUpdate;
  return (p ? p->iBlobWrite : -1);
}







           int sqlite3_preupdate_new(sqlite3 *db, int iIdx, sqlite3_value **ppValue){
  PreUpdate *p = db->pPreUpdate;
  int rc =0         ;
  Mem *pMem;

  if( !p || p->op==9             ){
    rc =sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    goto preupdate_new_out;
  }
  if( p->pPk && p->op!=23            ){
    iIdx = sqlite3TableColumnToIndex(p->pPk, iIdx);
  }
  if( iIdx>=p->pCsr->nField || iIdx<0 ){
    rc =25           ;
    goto preupdate_new_out;
  }

  if( p->op==18            ){


    UnpackedRecord *pUnpack = p->pNewUnpacked;
    if( !pUnpack ){
      Mem *pData = &p->v->aMem[p->iNewReg];
      rc =(((pData)->flags&0x0400)?0:0);
      if( rc!=0         ) goto preupdate_new_out;
      pUnpack = vdbeUnpackRecord(&p->keyinfo, pData->n, pData->z);
      if( !pUnpack ){
        rc =7            ;
        goto preupdate_new_out;
      }
      p->pNewUnpacked = pUnpack;
    }
    pMem = &pUnpack->aMem[iIdx];
    if( iIdx==p->pTab->iPKey ){
      sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(pMem, p->iKey2);
    }else if( iIdx>=pUnpack->nField ){
      pMem = (sqlite3_value *)columnNullValue();
    }
  }else{





    assert( p->op==23            );
    if( !p->aNew ){
      p->aNew = (Mem *)sqlite3DbMallocZero(db, sizeof(Mem) * p->pCsr->nField);
      if( !p->aNew ){
        rc =7            ;
        goto preupdate_new_out;
      }
    }
    assert( iIdx>=0 && iIdx<p->pCsr->nField );
    pMem = &p->aNew[iIdx];
    if( pMem->flags==0 ){
      if( iIdx==p->pTab->iPKey ){
        sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(pMem, p->iKey2);
      }else{
        rc = sqlite3VdbeMemCopy(pMem, &p->v->aMem[p->iNewReg+1 +iIdx]);
        if( rc!=0         ) goto preupdate_new_out;
      }
    }
  }
  *ppValue = pMem;

 preupdate_new_out:
  sqlite3Error(db, rc);
  return sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
}






           int sqlite3_stmt_scanstatus_v2(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int iScan,
  int iScanStatusOp,
  int flags,
  void *pOut
){
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  ScanStatus *pScan;
  int idx;

  if( iScan<0 ){
    int ii;
    if( iScanStatusOp==7                      ){
      i64 res = 0;
      for(ii=0; ii<p->nOp; ii++){
        res += p->aOp[ii].nCycle;
      }
      *(i64*)pOut = res;
      return 0;
    }
    return 1;
  }
  if( flags &0x0001                   ){
    idx = iScan;
    pScan = &p->aScan[idx];
  }else{


    for(idx=0; idx<p->nScan; idx++){
      pScan = &p->aScan[idx];
      if( pScan->zName ){
        iScan--;
        if( iScan<0 ) break;
      }
    }
  }
  if( idx>=p->nScan ) return 1;

  switch( iScanStatusOp ){
    case 0                    : {
      if( pScan->addrLoop>0 ){
        *(sqlite3_int64*)pOut = p->aOp[pScan->addrLoop].nExec;
      }else{
        *(sqlite3_int64*)pOut = -1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 1                     : {
      if( pScan->addrVisit>0 ){
        *(sqlite3_int64*)pOut = p->aOp[pScan->addrVisit].nExec;
      }else{
        *(sqlite3_int64*)pOut = -1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 2                  : {
sqlite_int64 r = 1.0;
      LogEst x = pScan->nEst;
      while( x<100 ){
        x += 10;
        r *= 0.5;
      }
      *(sqlite_int64*)pOut=r*sqlite3LogEstToInt(x);
      break;
    }
    case 3                   : {
      *(const char**)pOut = pScan->zName;
      break;
    }
    case 4                      : {
      if( pScan->addrExplain ){
        *(const char**)pOut = p->aOp[ pScan->addrExplain ].p4.z;
      }else{
        *(const char**)pOut = 0;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 5                       : {
      if( pScan->addrExplain ){
        *(int*)pOut = p->aOp[ pScan->addrExplain ].p1;
      }else{
        *(int*)pOut = -1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 6                       : {
      if( pScan->addrExplain ){
        *(int*)pOut = p->aOp[ pScan->addrExplain ].p2;
      }else{
        *(int*)pOut = -1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 7                     : {
      i64 res = 0;
      if( pScan->aAddrRange[0]==0 ){
        res = -1;
      }else{
        int ii;
        for(ii=0; ii<((int)(sizeof(pScan->aAddrRange)/sizeof(pScan->aAddrRange[0])));ii+=2){
          int iIns = pScan->aAddrRange[ii];
          int iEnd = pScan->aAddrRange[ii+1];
          if( iIns==0 ) break;
          if( iIns>0 ){
            while( iIns<=iEnd ){
              res += p->aOp[iIns].nCycle;
              iIns++;
            }
          }else{
            int iOp;
            for(iOp=0; iOp<p->nOp; iOp++){
              Op *pOp = &p->aOp[iOp];
              if( pOp->p1!=iEnd ) continue;
              if( (sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOp->opcode] &0x40         )==0 ){
                continue;
              }
              res += p->aOp[iOp].nCycle;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      *(i64*)pOut = res;
      break;
    }
    default: {
      return 1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}




           int sqlite3_stmt_scanstatus(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int iScan,
  int iScanStatusOp,
  void *pOut
){
  return sqlite3_stmt_scanstatus_v2(pStmt, iScan, iScanStatusOp, 0, pOut);
}




           void sqlite3_stmt_scanstatus_reset(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  Vdbe *p = (Vdbe*)pStmt;
  int ii;
  for(ii=0; ii<p->nOp; ii++){
    Op *pOp = &p->aOp[ii];
    pOp->nExec = 0;
    pOp->nCycle = 0;
  }
}
































static int findNextHostParameter(const char *zSql, int *pnToken){
  int tokenType;
  int nTotal = 0;
  int n;

  *pnToken = 0;
  while( zSql[0] ){
    n = sqlite3GetToken((u8*)zSql, &tokenType);
    assert( n>0 && tokenType!=184        );
    if( tokenType==156         ){
      *pnToken = n;
      break;
    }
    nTotal += n;
    zSql += n;
  }
  return nTotal;
}

























static         char *sqlite3VdbeExpandSql(
  Vdbe *p,
  const char *zRawSql
){
  sqlite3 *db;
  int idx = 0;
  int nextIndex = 1;
  int n;
  int nToken;
  int i;
  Mem *pVar;
  StrAccum out;

  Mem utf8;


  db = p->db;
  sqlite3StrAccumInit(&out, 0, 0, 0, db->aLimit[0                  ]);
  if( db->nVdbeExec>1 ){
    while( *zRawSql ){
      const char *zStart = zRawSql;
      while( *(zRawSql++)!='\n' && *zRawSql );
      sqlite3_str_append(&out, "-- ", 3);
      assert( (zRawSql - zStart) > 0 );
      sqlite3_str_append(&out, zStart, (int)(zRawSql-zStart));
    }
  }else if( p->nVar==0 ){
    sqlite3_str_append(&out, zRawSql, sqlite3Strlen30(zRawSql));
  }else{
    while( zRawSql[0] ){
      n = findNextHostParameter(zRawSql, &nToken);
      assert( n>0 );
      sqlite3_str_append(&out, zRawSql, n);
      zRawSql += n;
      assert( zRawSql[0] || nToken==0 );
      if( nToken==0 ) break;
      if( zRawSql[0]=='?' ){
        if( nToken>1 ){
          assert((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(zRawSql[1])]&0x04));
          sqlite3GetInt32(&zRawSql[1], &idx);
        }else{
          idx = nextIndex;
        }
      }else{
        assert( zRawSql[0]==':' || zRawSql[0]=='$' ||
                zRawSql[0]=='@' || zRawSql[0]=='#' );
if( zRawSql[0]==':' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( zRawSql[0]=='$' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( zRawSql[0]=='@' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( zRawSql[0]=='#' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        idx = sqlite3VdbeParameterIndex(p, zRawSql, nToken);
        assert( idx>0 );
      }
      zRawSql += nToken;
      nextIndex =((idx + 1)>(nextIndex)?(idx + 1):(nextIndex));
      assert( idx>0 && idx<=p->nVar );
      pVar = &p->aVar[idx-1];
      if( pVar->flags &0x0001    ){
        sqlite3_str_append(&out, "NULL", 4);
      }else if( pVar->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "%lld", pVar->u.i);
      }else if( pVar->flags &0x0008    ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "%!.15g", pVar->u.r);
      }else if( pVar->flags &0x0002   ){
        int nOut;

        u8 enc =((db)->enc);
        if( enc!=1           ){
          memset(&utf8, 0, sizeof(utf8));
          utf8.db = db;
          sqlite3VdbeMemSetStr(&utf8, pVar->z, pVar->n, enc,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
          if(7            ==sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(&utf8,1           ) ){
            out.accError =7            ;
            out.nAlloc = 0;
          }
          pVar = &utf8;
        }

        nOut = pVar->n;

        if( nOut>SQLITE_TRACE_SIZE_LIMIT ){
          nOut = SQLITE_TRACE_SIZE_LIMIT;
          while( nOut<pVar->n && (pVar->z[nOut]&0xc0)==0x80 ){ nOut++; }
        }

        sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "'%.*q'", nOut, pVar->z);

        if( nOut<pVar->n ){
          sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "/*+%d bytes*/", pVar->n-nOut);
        }


        if( enc!=1           ) sqlite3VdbeMemRelease(&utf8);

      }else if( pVar->flags &0x0400    ){
        sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "zeroblob(%d)", pVar->u.nZero);
      }else{
        int nOut;
        assert( pVar->flags &0x0010    );
        sqlite3_str_append(&out, "x'", 2);
        nOut = pVar->n;

        if( nOut>SQLITE_TRACE_SIZE_LIMIT ) nOut = SQLITE_TRACE_SIZE_LIMIT;

        for(i=0; i<nOut; i++){
          sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "%02x", pVar->z[i]&0xff);
        }
        sqlite3_str_append(&out, "'", 1);

        if( nOut<pVar->n ){
          sqlite3_str_appendf(&out, "/*+%d bytes*/", pVar->n-nOut);
        }

      }
    }
  }
  if( out.accError ) sqlite3_str_reset(&out);
  return sqlite3StrAccumFinish(&out);
}

    sqlite3_max_blobsize = p->n;
  }
}

static void test_trace_breakpoint(int pc, Op *pOp, Vdbe *v){
  static int n = 0;
  (void)pc;
  (void)pOp;
  (void)v;
  n++;
}











































  static void vdbeTakeBranch(u32 iSrcLine, u8 I, u8 M){
    u8 mNever;
    assert( I<=2 );
    assert( M<=4 );
    assert( I<M );

    I = 1<<I;




    mNever = iSrcLine >> 24;
    assert( (I & mNever)==0 );
    if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xVdbeBranch==0)return;












    I |= mNever;
    if( M==2 ) I |= 0x04;
    if( M==4 ){
      I |= 0x08;
      if( (mNever&0x08)!=0 && (I&0x05)!=0) I |= 0x05;
    }
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xVdbeBranch((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pVdbeBranchArg,
                                    iSrcLine&0xffffff, I, M);
  }
























static VdbeCursor *allocateCursor(
  Vdbe *p,
  int iCur,
  int nField,
  u8 eCurType
){


















  Mem *pMem = iCur>0 ? &p->aMem[p->nMem-iCur] : p->aMem;

  int nByte;
  VdbeCursor *pCx = 0;
  nByte =
(sizeof(VdbeCursor))              + 2*sizeof(u32)*nField +
      (eCurType==0            ?sqlite3BtreeCursorSize():0);

  assert( iCur>=0 && iCur<p->nCursor );
  if( p->apCsr[iCur] ){
    sqlite3VdbeFreeCursorNN(p, p->apCsr[iCur]);
    p->apCsr[iCur] = 0;
  }





  assert( pMem->flags==0x0000        );
  assert( (pMem->flags &0x1000  )==0 );
  assert( pMem->szMalloc==0 || pMem->z==pMem->zMalloc );
  if( pMem->szMalloc<nByte ){
    if( pMem->szMalloc>0 ){
      sqlite3DbFreeNN(pMem->db, pMem->zMalloc);
    }
    pMem->z = pMem->zMalloc = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(pMem->db, nByte);
    if( pMem->zMalloc==0 ){
      pMem->szMalloc = 0;
      return 0;
    }
    pMem->szMalloc = nByte;
  }

  p->apCsr[iCur] = pCx = (VdbeCursor*)pMem->zMalloc;
  memset(pCx, 0,((int)((char*)&((VdbeCursor*)0)->pAltCursor)));
  pCx->eCurType = eCurType;
  pCx->nField = nField;
  pCx->aOffset = &pCx->aType[nField];
  if( eCurType==0             ){
    pCx->uc.pCursor = (BtCursor*)
        &pMem->z[(sizeof(VdbeCursor))       +2*sizeof(u32)*nField];
    sqlite3BtreeCursorZero(pCx->uc.pCursor);
  }
  return pCx;
}







static int alsoAnInt(Mem *pRec,sqlite_int64 rValue,i64*piValue){
  i64 iValue;
  iValue = sqlite3RealToI64(rValue);
  if( sqlite3RealSameAsInt(rValue,iValue) ){
    *piValue = iValue;
    return 1;
  }
  return 0==sqlite3Atoi64(pRec->z, piValue, pRec->n, pRec->enc);
}
















static void applyNumericAffinity(Mem *pRec, int bTryForInt){
sqlite_int64 rValue;
  u8 enc = pRec->enc;
  int rc;
  assert( (pRec->flags & (0x0002 |0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     ))==0x0002  );
  rc = sqlite3AtoF(pRec->z, &rValue, pRec->n, enc);
  if( rc<=0 ) return;
  if( rc==1 && alsoAnInt(pRec, rValue, &pRec->u.i) ){
    pRec->flags |=0x0004  ;
  }else{
    pRec->u.r = rValue;
    pRec->flags |=0x0008   ;
    if( bTryForInt ) sqlite3VdbeIntegerAffinity(pRec);
  }




  pRec->flags &= ~0x0002 ;
}
























static void applyAffinity(
  Mem *pRec,
  char affinity,
  u8 enc
){
  if( affinity>=0x43               ){
    assert( affinity==0x44               || affinity==0x45
             || affinity==0x43               || affinity==0x46               );
    if( (pRec->flags &0x0004  )==0 ){
      if( (pRec->flags & (0x0008  |0x0020     ))==0 ){
        if( pRec->flags &0x0002   ) applyNumericAffinity(pRec,1);
      }else if( affinity<=0x45            ){
        sqlite3VdbeIntegerAffinity(pRec);
      }
    }
  }else if( affinity==0x42            ){





    if( 0==(pRec->flags&0x0002 ) ){
      if( (pRec->flags&(0x0008  |0x0004 |0x0020     )) ){
if( pRec->flags & 0x0004 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pRec->flags & 0x0008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pRec->flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        sqlite3VdbeMemStringify(pRec, enc, 1);
      }
    }
    pRec->flags &= ~(0x0008  |0x0004 |0x0020     );
  }
}







           int sqlite3_value_numeric_type(sqlite3_value *pVal){
  int eType = sqlite3_value_type(pVal);
  if( eType==3           ){
    Mem *pMem = (Mem*)pVal;
    applyNumericAffinity(pMem, 0);
    eType = sqlite3_value_type(pVal);
  }
  return eType;
}





static         void sqlite3ValueApplyAffinity(
  sqlite3_value *pVal,
  u8 affinity,
  u8 enc
){
  applyAffinity((Mem *)pVal, affinity, enc);
}







static u16 __attribute__((noinline))computeNumericType(Mem*pMem){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_int64 ix;
  assert( (pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     ))==0 );
  assert( (pMem->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ))!=0 );
  if((((pMem)->flags&0x0400)?0:0)){
    pMem->u.i = 0;
    return 0x0004 ;
  }
  rc = sqlite3AtoF(pMem->z, &pMem->u.r, pMem->n, pMem->enc);
  if( rc<=0 ){
    if( rc==0 && sqlite3Atoi64(pMem->z, &ix, pMem->n, pMem->enc)<=1 ){
      pMem->u.i = ix;
      return 0x0004 ;
    }else{
      return 0x0008  ;
    }
  }else if( rc==1 && sqlite3Atoi64(pMem->z, &ix, pMem->n, pMem->enc)==0 ){
    pMem->u.i = ix;
    return 0x0004 ;
  }
  return 0x0008  ;
}








static u16 numericType(Mem *pMem){
  assert( (pMem->flags &0x0001   )==0
       || pMem->db==0 || pMem->db->mallocFailed );
  if( pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     |0x0001  ) ){
if( pMem->flags & 0x0004 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0020 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    return pMem->flags & (0x0004 |0x0008  |0x0020     |0x0001  );
  }
  assert( pMem->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ) );
if( pMem->flags & 0x0002 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pMem->flags & 0x0010 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return computeNumericType(pMem);
  return 0;
}






static         void sqlite3VdbeMemPrettyPrint(Mem *pMem, StrAccum *pStr){
  int f = pMem->flags;
  static const char *const encnames[] = {"(X)", "(8)", "(16LE)", "(16BE)"};
  if( f&0x0010   ){
    int i;
    char c;
    if( f &0x1000   ){
      c = 'z';
      assert( (f & (0x2000    |0x4000   ))==0 );
    }else if( f &0x2000      ){
      c = 't';
      assert( (f & (0x1000 |0x4000   ))==0 );
    }else if( f &0x4000     ){
      c = 'e';
      assert( (f & (0x2000    |0x1000 ))==0 );
    }else{
      c = 's';
    }
    sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, "%cx[", c);
    for(i=0; i<25 && i<pMem->n; i++){
      sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, "%02X", ((int)pMem->z[i] & 0xFF));
    }
    sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, "|");
    for(i=0; i<25 && i<pMem->n; i++){
      char z = pMem->z[i];
      sqlite3_str_appendchar(pStr, 1, (z<32||z>126)?'.':z);
    }
    sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr,"]");
    if( f &0x0400    ){
      sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, "+%dz",pMem->u.nZero);
    }
  }else if( f &0x0002   ){
    int j;
    u8 c;
    if( f &0x1000   ){
      c = 'z';
      assert( (f & (0x2000    |0x4000   ))==0 );
    }else if( f &0x2000      ){
      c = 't';
      assert( (f & (0x1000 |0x4000   ))==0 );
    }else if( f &0x4000     ){
      c = 'e';
      assert( (f & (0x2000    |0x1000 ))==0 );
    }else{
      c = 's';
    }
    sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, " %c%d[", c, pMem->n);
    for(j=0; j<25 && j<pMem->n; j++){
      c = pMem->z[j];
      sqlite3_str_appendchar(pStr, 1, (c>=0x20&&c<=0x7f) ? c : '.');
    }
    sqlite3_str_appendf(pStr, "]%s", encnames[pMem->enc]);
  }
}






static void memTracePrint(Mem *p){
  if( p->flags &0x0000         ){
    printf(" undefined");
  }else if( p->flags &0x0001    ){
    printf(p->flags &0x0400    ? " NULL-nochng" : " NULL");
  }else if( (p->flags & (0x0004 |0x0002 ))==(0x0004 |0x0002 ) ){
    printf(" si:%lld", p->u.i);
  }else if( (p->flags & (0x0020     ))!=0 ){
    printf(" ir:%lld", p->u.i);
  }else if( p->flags &0x0004   ){
    printf(" i:%lld", p->u.i);

  }else if( p->flags &0x0008    ){
    printf(" r:%.17g", p->u.r);

  }else if( sqlite3VdbeMemIsRowSet(p) ){
    printf(" (rowset)");
  }else{
    StrAccum acc;
    char zBuf[1000];
    sqlite3StrAccumInit(&acc, 0, zBuf, sizeof(zBuf), 0);
    sqlite3VdbeMemPrettyPrint(p, &acc);
    printf(" %s", sqlite3StrAccumFinish(&acc));
  }
  if( p->flags &0x0800       ) printf(" subtype=0x%02x", p->eSubtype);
}
static void registerTrace(int iReg, Mem *p){
  printf("R[%d] = ", iReg);
  memTracePrint(p);
  if( p->pScopyFrom ){
    printf(" <== R[%d]", (int)(p->pScopyFrom - &p[-iReg]));
  }
  printf("\n");
  sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(p);
}
     void sqlite3PrintMem(Mem *pMem){
  memTracePrint(pMem);
  printf("\n");
  fflush(stdout);
}







static         void sqlite3VdbeRegisterDump(Vdbe *v){
  int i;
  for(i=1; i<v->nMem; i++) registerTrace(i, v->aMem+i);
}




















static int checkSavepointCount(sqlite3 *db){
  int n = 0;
  Savepoint *p;
  for(p=db->pSavepoint; p; p=p->pNext) n++;
  assert( n==(db->nSavepoint + db->isTransactionSavepoint) );
  return 1;
}






static __attribute__((noinline))Mem*out2PrereleaseWithClear(Mem*pOut){
  sqlite3VdbeMemSetNull(pOut);
  pOut->flags =0x0004  ;
  return pOut;
}
static Mem *out2Prerelease(Vdbe *p, VdbeOp *pOp){
  Mem *pOut;
  assert( pOp->p2>0 );
  assert( pOp->p2<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
  pOut = &p->aMem[pOp->p2];
sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(p,pOut);
  if((((pOut)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0)){
    return out2PrereleaseWithClear(pOut);
  }else{
    pOut->flags =0x0004  ;
    return pOut;
  }
}





static u64 filterHash(const Mem *aMem, const Op *pOp){
  int i, mx;
  u64 h = 0;

  assert( pOp->p4type==(-3)     );
  for(i=pOp->p3, mx=i+pOp->p4.i; i<mx; i++){
    const Mem *p = &aMem[i];
    if( p->flags & (0x0004 |0x0020     ) ){
      h += p->u.i;
    }else if( p->flags &0x0008    ){
      h += sqlite3VdbeIntValue(p);
    }else if( p->flags & (0x0002 |0x0010  ) ){

    }
  }
  return h;
}

                           "INT",
                           "REAL",
                           "TEXT",

                           "NULL"
  };

}





static         int sqlite3VdbeExec(
  Vdbe *p
){
  Op *aOp = p->aOp;
  Op *pOp = aOp;

  Op *pOrigOp;
  int nExtraDelete = 0;
  u8 iCompareIsInit = 0;

  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3 *db = p->db;
  u8 resetSchemaOnFault = 0;
  u8 encoding =((db)->enc);
  int iCompare = 0;
  u64 nVmStep = 0;

  u64 nProgressLimit;

  Mem *aMem = p->aMem;
  Mem *pIn1 = 0;
  Mem *pIn2 = 0;
  Mem *pIn3 = 0;
  Mem *pOut = 0;

  u64 *pnCycle = 0;



  assert( p->eVdbeState==2              );
  if((sqlite3DbMaskAllZero(p->lockMask)==0)){
                       ;
  }

  if( db->xProgress ){
    u32 iPrior = p->aCounter[4                        ];
    assert( 0 < db->nProgressOps );
    nProgressLimit = db->nProgressOps - (iPrior % db->nProgressOps);
  }else{
    nProgressLimit =(0xffffffff|(((u64)0xffffffff)<<32));
  }

  if( p->rc==7            ){


    goto no_mem;
  }
  assert( p->rc==0         || (p->rc&0xff)==5           );
if( p->rc!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  p->rc =0         ;
  assert( p->bIsReader || p->readOnly!=0 );
  p->iCurrentTime = 0;
  assert( p->explain==0 );
  db->busyHandler.nBusy = 0;
  if(__atomic_load_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),__ATOMIC_RELAXED))goto abort_due_to_interrupt;
                          ;

                            ;
  if( p->pc==0
   && (p->db->flags & (((u64)(0x0200000)<<32)|((u64)(0x1000000)<<32)|((u64)(0x0400000)<<32)))!=0
  ){
    int i;
    int once = 1;
    sqlite3VdbePrintSql(p);
    if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x0200000)<<32)){
      printf("VDBE Program Listing:\n");
      for(i=0; i<p->nOp; i++){
        sqlite3VdbePrintOp(stdout, i, &aOp[i]);
      }
    }
    if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x1000000)<<32)){
      for(i=0; i<p->nOp; i++){
        if( aOp[i].opcode==185        ){
          if( once ) printf("VDBE Query Plan:\n");
          printf("%s\n", aOp[i].p4.z);
          once = 0;
        }
      }
    }
    if( p->db->flags &((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))printf("VDBE Trace:\n");
  }
                          ;

  for(pOp=&aOp[p->pc]; 1; pOp++){


    assert( rc==0         );

    assert( pOp>=aOp && pOp<&aOp[p->nOp]);
    nVmStep++;

    pOp->nExec++;
    pnCycle = &pOp->nCycle;

    if( sqlite3NProfileCnt==0 )

      *pnCycle -= sqlite3Hwtime();





    if( db->flags &((u64)(0x0400000)<<32)){
      sqlite3VdbePrintOp(stdout, (int)(pOp - aOp), pOp);
      test_trace_breakpoint((int)(pOp - aOp),pOp,p);
    }







    if( sqlite3_interrupt_count>0 ){
      sqlite3_interrupt_count--;
      if( sqlite3_interrupt_count==0 ){
        sqlite3_interrupt(db);
      }
    }




    {
      u8 opProperty = sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOp->opcode];
      if( (opProperty &0x02      )!=0 ){
        assert( pOp->p1>0 );
        assert( pOp->p1<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
        assert(((&aMem[pOp->p1])->flags & 0x003f)!=0);
        assert( sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(&aMem[pOp->p1]) );
if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p1,&aMem[pOp->p1]);
      }
      if( (opProperty &0x04      )!=0 ){
        assert( pOp->p2>0 );
        assert( pOp->p2<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
        assert(((&aMem[pOp->p2])->flags & 0x003f)!=0);
        assert( sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(&aMem[pOp->p2]) );
if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p2,&aMem[pOp->p2]);
      }
      if( (opProperty &0x08      )!=0 ){
        assert( pOp->p3>0 );
        assert( pOp->p3<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
        assert(((&aMem[pOp->p3])->flags & 0x003f)!=0);
        assert( sqlite3VdbeCheckMemInvariants(&aMem[pOp->p3]) );
if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p3,&aMem[pOp->p3]);
      }
      if( (opProperty &0x10       )!=0 ){
        assert( pOp->p2>0 );
        assert( pOp->p2<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(p,&aMem[pOp->p2]);
      }
      if( (opProperty &0x20       )!=0 ){
        assert( pOp->p3>0 );
        assert( pOp->p3<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(p,&aMem[pOp->p3]);
      }
    }


    pOrigOp = pOp;


    switch( pOp->opcode ){
















































case 9      : {





  if( pOp->p5 ){
    assert( pOp->p2 < (int)(pOp - aOp) );
    assert( pOp->p2 > 1 );
    pOp = &aOp[pOp->p2 - 2];
    assert( pOp[1].opcode==183           );
    goto check_for_interrupt;
  }


jump_to_p2_and_check_for_interrupt:
  pOp = &aOp[pOp->p2 - 1];











check_for_interrupt:
  if(__atomic_load_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),__ATOMIC_RELAXED))goto abort_due_to_interrupt;







  while( nVmStep>=nProgressLimit && db->xProgress!=0 ){
    assert( db->nProgressOps!=0 );
    nProgressLimit += db->nProgressOps;
    if( db->xProgress(db->pProgressArg) ){
      nProgressLimit =(0xffffffff|(((u64)0xffffffff)<<32));
      rc =9                ;
      goto abort_due_to_error;
    }
  }


  break;
}






case 10      : {
  assert( pOp->p1>0 && pOp->p1<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
  pIn1 = &aMem[pOp->p1];
  assert((((pIn1)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0)==0);
sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(p,pIn1);
  pIn1->flags =0x0004  ;
  pIn1->u.i = (int)(pOp-aOp);
if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p1,pIn1);
  goto jump_to_p2_and_check_for_interrupt;
}























case 67       : {
  pIn1 = &aMem[pOp->p1];
  if( pIn1->flags &0x0004   ){
    if( pOp->p3 ){                      ; }
    pOp = &aOp[pIn1->u.i];
  }else if((1)              ){
                         ;
  }
  break;
}












case 11              : {
  assert( pOp->p1>0 &&  pOp->p1<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
  assert( pOp->p2>=0 && pOp->p2<p->nOp );
  assert( pOp->p3>=0 && pOp->p3<p->nOp );
  pOut = &aMem[pOp->p1];
  assert( !(((pOut)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0));
  pOut->u.i = pOp->p3 - 1;
  pOut->flags =0x0004  ;
  if( pOp->p2==0 ) break;



jump_to_p2:
  assert( pOp->p2>0 );
  assert( pOp->p2<p->nOp );
  pOp = &aOp[pOp->p2 - 1];
  break;
}









case 68             : {
  VdbeOp *pCaller;
  pIn1 = &aMem[pOp->p1];
  assert( pIn1->flags==0x0004  );
  assert( pIn1->u.i>=0 && pIn1->u.i<p->nOp );
  pCaller = &aOp[pIn1->u.i];
  assert( pCaller->opcode==12       );

case 12      : {
  int pcDest;
  pIn1 = &aMem[pOp->p1];
  assert((((pIn1)->flags&(0x8000|0x1000))!=0)==0);
  pIn1->flags =0x0004  ;
  pcDest = (int)pIn1->u.i;
  pIn1->u.i = (int)(pOp - aOp);
if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p1,pIn1);
  pOp = &aOp[pcDest];
  break;
}









case 69           : {
  pIn3 = &aMem[pOp->p3];

  if( pOp->p2==2        ){                              ; }

  if( (pIn3->flags &0x0001   )==0 ) break;

__attribute__((fallthrough));
}































case 70     : {
  VdbeFrame *pFrame;
  int pcx;


  if( pOp->p2==2        ){                              ; }





  assert( pOp->p1!=2               );

  if( p->pFrame && pOp->p1==0         ){

    pFrame = p->pFrame;
    p->pFrame = pFrame->pParent;
    p->nFrame--;
    sqlite3VdbeSetChanges(db, p->nChange);
    pcx = sqlite3VdbeFrameRestore(pFrame);
    if( pOp->p2==4         ){





      pcx = p->aOp[pcx].p2-1;
    }

    if( !pC->useRandomRowid ){
      rc = sqlite3BtreeLast(pC->uc.pCursor, &res);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        goto abort_due_to_error;
      }
      if( res ){
        v = 1;
      }else{
        assert( sqlite3BtreeCursorIsValid(pC->uc.pCursor) );
        v = sqlite3BtreeIntegerKey(pC->uc.pCursor);
        if( v>=0x7fffffff){
          pC->useRandomRowid = 1;
        }else{
          v++;
        }
      }
    }


    if( pOp->p3 ){

      assert( pOp->p3>0 );
      if( p->pFrame ){
        for(pFrame=p->pFrame; pFrame->pParent; pFrame=pFrame->pParent);

        assert( pOp->p3<=pFrame->nMem );
        pMem = &pFrame->aMem[pOp->p3];
      }else{

        assert( pOp->p3<=(p->nMem+1 - p->nCursor) );
        pMem = &aMem[pOp->p3];
sqlite3VdbeMemAboutToChange(p,pMem);
      }
      assert(((pMem)->flags & 0x003f)!=0);

if(db->flags&((u64)(0x0400000)<<32))registerTrace(pOp->p3,pMem);
      sqlite3VdbeMemIntegerify(pMem);
      assert( (pMem->flags &0x0004  )!=0 );
      if( pMem->u.i==0x7fffffff|| pC->useRandomRowid ){
        rc =13          ;
        goto abort_due_to_error;
      }
      if( v<pMem->u.i+1 ){
        v = pMem->u.i + 1;
      }
      pMem->u.i = v;
    }

    if( pC->useRandomRowid ){




      assert( pOp->p3==0 );

      cnt = 0;
      do{
        sqlite3_randomness(sizeof(v), &v);
        v &= (0x7fffffff>>1);v++;
      }while(  ((rc = sqlite3BtreeTableMoveto(pC->uc.pCursor, (u64)v,
                                                 0, &res))==0        )
            && (res==0)
            && (++cnt<100));
      if( rc ) goto abort_due_to_error;
      if( res==0 ){
        rc =13          ;
        goto abort_due_to_error;
      }
      assert( v>0 );
    }
    pC->deferredMoveto = 0;
    pC->cacheStatus =0           ;
  }
  pOut->u.i = v;
  break;
}






































case 128      : {

  x.nKey = pKey->u.i;

  if( pOp->p4type==(-5)     &&((db)->xPreUpdateCallback||(db)->xUpdateCallback)){

      sqlite3VdbePreUpdateHook(p,pC,18           ,zDb,pTab,x.nKey,pOp->p2,-1);
    }
    if( db->xUpdateCallback==0 || pTab->aCol==0 ){

      pTab = 0;
    }
  }
  if( pOp->p5 &0x40           ) break;


  assert( (pOp->p5 &0x20             )==0 || (pOp->p5 &0x01           )!=0 );
  if( pOp->p5 &0x01            ){
    p->nChange++;
    if( pOp->p5 &0x20              ) db->lastRowid = x.nKey;
  }
  assert( (pData->flags & (0x0010  |0x0002 ))!=0 || pData->n==0 );
  x.pData = pData->z;
  x.nData = pData->n;
  seekResult = ((pOp->p5 &0x10                 ) ? pC->seekResult : 0);
  if( pData->flags &0x0400    ){
    x.nZero = pData->u.nZero;
  }else{
    x.nZero = 0;
  }
  x.pKey = 0;
  assert(0x80            ==0x80             );
  rc = sqlite3BtreeInsert(pC->uc.pCursor, &x,
      (pOp->p5 & (0x08         |0x02               |0x80            )),
      seekResult
  );
  pC->deferredMoveto = 0;
  pC->cacheStatus =0           ;


  if( rc ) goto abort_due_to_error;
  if( pTab ){

    assert( pTab->aCol!=0 );
    db->xUpdateCallback(db->pUpdateArg,
           (pOp->p5 &0x04            ) ?23             :18            ,
           zDb, pTab->zName, x.nKey);
  }
  break;
}

    sqlite3VdbeMemReleaseMalloc(&m);

    sqlite3VdbeError(p, "%s", sqlite3_value_text(pMem));
    goto abort_due_to_error;
  }
  sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pMem, encoding);
updateMaxBlobsize(pMem)    ;
  break;
}













case 3            : {
  int i;
  int aRes[3];
  Mem *pMem;

  assert( p->readOnly==0 );
  aRes[0] = 0;
  aRes[1] = aRes[2] = -1;
  assert( pOp->p2==0
       || pOp->p2==1
       || pOp->p2==2
       || pOp->p2==3
  );
  rc = sqlite3Checkpoint(db, pOp->p1, pOp->p2, &aRes[1], &aRes[2]);
  if( rc ){
    if( rc!=5           ) goto abort_due_to_error;
    rc =0         ;
    aRes[0] = 1;
  }
  for(i=0, pMem = &aMem[pOp->p3]; i<3; i++, pMem++){
    sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(pMem, (i64)aRes[i]);
  }
  break;
};














case 4             : {
  Btree *pBt;
  Pager *pPager;
  int eNew;
  int eOld;

  const char *zFilename;


  pOut = out2Prerelease(p, pOp);
  eNew = pOp->p3;
  assert( eNew==0
       || eNew==3
       || eNew==1
       || eNew==2
       || eNew==4
       || eNew==5
       || eNew==(-1)
  );
  assert( pOp->p1>=0 && pOp->p1<db->nDb );
  assert( p->readOnly==0 );

  pBt = db->aDb[pOp->p1].pBt;
  pPager = sqlite3BtreePager(pBt);
  eOld = sqlite3PagerGetJournalMode(pPager);
  if( eNew==(-1)                    ) eNew = eOld;
  assert(1                            );
  if( !sqlite3PagerOkToChangeJournalMode(pPager) ) eNew = eOld;


  zFilename = sqlite3PagerFilename(pPager, 1);




  if( eNew==5
   && (sqlite3Strlen30(zFilename)==0
       || !sqlite3PagerWalSupported(pPager))
  ){
    eNew = eOld;
  }

  if( (eNew!=eOld)
   && (eOld==5                     || eNew==5                    )
  ){
    if( !db->autoCommit || db->nVdbeRead>1 ){
      rc =1            ;
      sqlite3VdbeError(p,
          "cannot change %s wal mode from within a transaction",
          (eNew==5                     ? "into" : "out of")
      );
      goto abort_due_to_error;
    }else{

      if( eOld==5                     ){





        rc = sqlite3PagerCloseWal(pPager, db);
        if( rc==0         ){
          sqlite3PagerSetJournalMode(pPager, eNew);
        }
      }else if( eOld==4                        ){


        sqlite3PagerSetJournalMode(pPager,2                     );
      }




      assert( sqlite3BtreeTxnState(pBt)!=2                );
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = sqlite3BtreeSetVersion(pBt, (eNew==5                     ? 2 : 1));
      }
    }
  }


  if( rc ) eNew = eOld;
  eNew = sqlite3PagerSetJournalMode(pPager, eNew);

  pOut->flags =0x0002  |0x2000    |0x0200  ;
  pOut->z = (char *)sqlite3JournalModename(eNew);
  pOut->n = sqlite3Strlen30(pOut->z);
  pOut->enc =1           ;
  sqlite3VdbeChangeEncoding(pOut, encoding);
  if( rc ) goto abort_due_to_error;
  break;
};












case 5        : {

                        pOp->p2 ? &aMem[pOp->p2] : 0);
  if( rc ) goto abort_due_to_error;
  break;
}

  }

case 166      : {

case 169         : {

case 6         : {

  break;

  Mem *pX;

       || pOp->p5==2        || pOp->p5==4         || pOp->p5==5

}













default: {
  assert( pOp->opcode==184     || pOp->opcode==185        );

  break;
}







    }


    *pnCycle += sqlite3NProfileCnt ? sqlite3NProfileCnt : sqlite3Hwtime();
    pnCycle = 0;

    *pnCycle += sqlite3Hwtime();
    pnCycle = 0;








    assert( pOp>=&aOp[-1] && pOp<&aOp[p->nOp-1] );


    if( db->flags &((u64)(0x0400000)<<32)){
      u8 opProperty = sqlite3OpcodeProperty[pOrigOp->opcode];
      if( rc!=0 ) printf("rc=%d\n",rc);
      if( opProperty & (0x10      ) ){
        registerTrace(pOrigOp->p2, &aMem[pOrigOp->p2]);
      }
      if( opProperty &0x20        ){
        registerTrace(pOrigOp->p3, &aMem[pOrigOp->p3]);
      }
      if( opProperty==0xff ){



        sqlite3VdbeRegisterDump(p);
      }
    }


  }




abort_due_to_error:
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }else if( rc==(10 | (33<<8))         ){
    rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
  }
  assert( rc );

  if( db->flags &((u64)(0x0400000)<<32)){
    const char *zTrace = p->zSql;
    if( zTrace==0 ){
      if( aOp[0].opcode==181      ){
        zTrace = aOp[0].p4.z;
      }
      if( zTrace==0 ) zTrace = "???";
    }
    printf("ABORT-due-to-error (rc=%d): %s\n", rc, zTrace);
  }

  if( p->zErrMsg==0 && rc!=(10 | (12<<8))     ){
    sqlite3VdbeError(p, "%s", sqlite3ErrStr(rc));
  }
  p->rc = rc;
  sqlite3SystemError(db, rc);
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  sqlite3_log(rc, "statement aborts at %d: [%s] %s",
                   (int)(pOp - aOp), p->zSql, p->zErrMsg);
  if( p->eVdbeState==2              ) sqlite3VdbeHalt(p);
  if( rc==(10 | (12<<8))     ) sqlite3OomFault(db);
  if( rc==11             && db->autoCommit==0 ){
    db->flags |=((u64)(0x00002)<<32) ;
  }
  rc =1            ;
  if( resetSchemaOnFault>0 ){
    sqlite3ResetOneSchema(db, resetSchemaOnFault-1);
  }




vdbe_return:

  if( pnCycle ){
    *pnCycle += sqlite3NProfileCnt ? sqlite3NProfileCnt : sqlite3Hwtime();
    pnCycle = 0;
  }

  if( pnCycle ){
    *pnCycle += sqlite3Hwtime();
    pnCycle = 0;
  }



  while( nVmStep>=nProgressLimit && db->xProgress!=0 ){
    nProgressLimit += db->nProgressOps;
    if( db->xProgress(db->pProgressArg) ){
      nProgressLimit =(0xffffffff|(((u64)0xffffffff)<<32));
      rc =9                ;
      goto abort_due_to_error;
    }
  }

  p->aCounter[4                        ] += (int)nVmStep;
  if((sqlite3DbMaskAllZero(p->lockMask)==0)){
                       ;
  }
  assert( rc!=0         || nExtraDelete==0
       || sqlite3_strlike("DELETE%",p->zSql,0)!=0
  );
  return rc;




too_big:
  sqlite3VdbeError(p, "string or blob too big");
  rc =18            ;
  goto abort_due_to_error;



no_mem:
  sqlite3OomFault(db);
  sqlite3VdbeError(p, "out of memory");
  rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  goto abort_due_to_error;




abort_due_to_interrupt:
  assert(__atomic_load_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),__ATOMIC_RELAXED));
  rc =9                ;
  goto abort_due_to_error;
}



























typedef struct Incrblob Incrblob;
struct Incrblob {
  int nByte;
  int iOffset;
  u16 iCol;
  BtCursor *pCsr;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  sqlite3 *db;
  char *zDb;
  Table *pTab;
};



















static int blobSeekToRow(Incrblob *p, sqlite3_int64 iRow, char **pzErr){
  int rc;
  char *zErr = 0;
  Vdbe *v = (Vdbe *)p->pStmt;




  v->aMem[1].flags =0x0004  ;
  v->aMem[1].u.i = iRow;





  if( v->pc>4 ){
    v->pc = 4;
    assert( v->aOp[v->pc].opcode==31           );
    rc = sqlite3VdbeExec(v);
  }else{
    rc = sqlite3_step(p->pStmt);
  }
  if( rc==100        ){
    VdbeCursor *pC = v->apCsr[0];
    u32 type;
    assert( pC!=0 );
    assert( pC->eCurType==0             );
    type = pC->nHdrParsed>p->iCol ? pC->aType[p->iCol] : 0;
if( pC->nHdrParsed==p->iCol ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pC->nHdrParsed==p->iCol+1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    if( type<12 ){
      zErr = sqlite3MPrintf(p->db, "cannot open value of type %s",
          type==0?"null": type==7?"real": "integer"
      );
      rc =1            ;
      sqlite3_finalize(p->pStmt);
      p->pStmt = 0;
    }else{
      p->iOffset = pC->aType[p->iCol + pC->nField];
      p->nByte = sqlite3VdbeSerialTypeLen(type);
      p->pCsr =  pC->uc.pCursor;
      sqlite3BtreeIncrblobCursor(p->pCsr);
    }
  }

  if( rc==100        ){
    rc =0         ;
  }else if( p->pStmt ){
    rc = sqlite3_finalize(p->pStmt);
    p->pStmt = 0;
    if( rc==0         ){
      zErr = sqlite3MPrintf(p->db, "no such rowid: %lld", iRow);
      rc =1            ;
    }else{
      zErr = sqlite3MPrintf(p->db, "%s", sqlite3_errmsg(p->db));
    }
  }

  assert( rc!=0         || zErr==0 );
  assert( rc!=100        && rc!=101         );

  *pzErr = zErr;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_blob_open(
  sqlite3* db,
  const char *zDb,
  const char *zTable,
  const char *zColumn,
  sqlite_int64 iRow,
  int wrFlag,
  sqlite3_blob **ppBlob
){
  int nAttempt = 0;
  int iCol;
  int rc =0         ;
  char *zErr = 0;
  Table *pTab;
  Incrblob *pBlob = 0;
  Parse sParse;


  if( ppBlob==0 ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

  *ppBlob = 0;

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) || zTable==0 ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

  wrFlag = !!wrFlag;

                                ;

  pBlob = (Incrblob *)sqlite3DbMallocZero(db, sizeof(Incrblob));
  while(1){
    sqlite3ParseObjectInit(&sParse,db);
    if( !pBlob ) goto blob_open_out;
    sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
    zErr = 0;

                            ;
    pTab = sqlite3LocateTable(&sParse, 0, zTable, zDb);
    if( pTab &&((pTab)->eTabType==1)){
      pTab = 0;
      sqlite3ErrorMsg(&sParse, "cannot open virtual table: %s", zTable);
    }
    if( pTab && !(((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)){
      pTab = 0;
      sqlite3ErrorMsg(&sParse, "cannot open table without rowid: %s", zTable);
    }

    if( pTab &&((pTab)->eTabType==2)){
      pTab = 0;
      sqlite3ErrorMsg(&sParse, "cannot open view: %s", zTable);
    }

    if( !pTab ){
      if( sParse.zErrMsg ){
        sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
        zErr = sParse.zErrMsg;
        sParse.zErrMsg = 0;
      }
      rc =1            ;
                              ;
      goto blob_open_out;
    }
    pBlob->pTab = pTab;
    pBlob->zDb = db->aDb[sqlite3SchemaToIndex(db, pTab->pSchema)].zDbSName;


    for(iCol=0; iCol<pTab->nCol; iCol++) {
      if( sqlite3StrICmp(pTab->aCol[iCol].zCnName, zColumn)==0 ){
        break;
      }
    }
    if( iCol==pTab->nCol ){
      sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
      zErr = sqlite3MPrintf(db, "no such column: \"%s\"", zColumn);
      rc =1            ;
                              ;
      goto blob_open_out;
    }




    if( wrFlag ){
      const char *zFault = 0;
      Index *pIdx;

      if( db->flags&0x00004000         ){




        FKey *pFKey;
        assert(((pTab)->eTabType==0)  );
        for(pFKey=pTab->u.tab.pFKey; pFKey; pFKey=pFKey->pNextFrom){
          int j;
          for(j=0; j<pFKey->nCol; j++){
            if( pFKey->aCol[j].iFrom==iCol ){
              zFault = "foreign key";
            }
          }
        }
      }

      for(pIdx=pTab->pIndex; pIdx; pIdx=pIdx->pNext){
        int j;
        for(j=0; j<pIdx->nKeyCol; j++){

          if( pIdx->aiColumn[j]==iCol || pIdx->aiColumn[j]==(-2)    ){
            zFault = "indexed";
          }
        }
      }
      if( zFault ){
        sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
        zErr = sqlite3MPrintf(db, "cannot open %s column for writing", zFault);
        rc =1            ;
                                ;
        goto blob_open_out;
      }
    }

    pBlob->pStmt = (sqlite3_stmt *)sqlite3VdbeCreate(&sParse);
    assert( pBlob->pStmt || db->mallocFailed );
    if( pBlob->pStmt ){
















      static const int iLn =(__LINE__+2)          ;
      static const VdbeOpList openBlob[] = {
        {169         ,      0, 0, 0},
        {112        ,       0, 0, 0},

        {31          ,      0, 5, 1},
        {94       ,         0, 0, 1},
        {84          ,      1, 0, 0},
        {70     ,           0, 0, 0},
      };
      Vdbe *v = (Vdbe *)pBlob->pStmt;
      int iDb = sqlite3SchemaToIndex(db, pTab->pSchema);
      VdbeOp *aOp;

      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v,2              , iDb, wrFlag,
                           pTab->pSchema->schema_cookie,
                           pTab->pSchema->iGeneration);
      sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, 1);
      assert( sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v)==2 || db->mallocFailed );
      aOp = sqlite3VdbeAddOpList(v,((int)(sizeof(openBlob)/sizeof(openBlob[0]))),openBlob,iLn);


      sqlite3VdbeUsesBtree(v, iDb);

      if( db->mallocFailed==0 ){
        assert( aOp!=0 );


        aOp[0].opcode =184     ;

        aOp[0].p1 = iDb;
        aOp[0].p2 = pTab->tnum;
        aOp[0].p3 = wrFlag;
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(v, 2, pTab->zName,0            );
      }
      if( db->mallocFailed==0 ){




        if( wrFlag ) aOp[1].opcode =113          ;
        aOp[1].p2 = pTab->tnum;
        aOp[1].p3 = iDb;








        aOp[1].p4type =(-3)     ;
        aOp[1].p4.i = pTab->nCol+1;
        aOp[3].p2 = pTab->nCol;

        sParse.nVar = 0;
        sParse.nMem = 1;
        sParse.nTab = 1;
        sqlite3VdbeMakeReady(v, &sParse);
      }
    }

    pBlob->iCol = iCol;
    pBlob->db = db;
                            ;
    if( db->mallocFailed ){
      goto blob_open_out;
    }
    rc = blobSeekToRow(pBlob, iRow, &zErr);
    if( (++nAttempt)>=50                      || rc!=17            ) break;
    sqlite3ParseObjectReset(&sParse);
  }

blob_open_out:
  if( rc==0         && db->mallocFailed==0 ){
    *ppBlob = (sqlite3_blob *)pBlob;
  }else{
    if( pBlob && pBlob->pStmt ) sqlite3VdbeFinalize((Vdbe *)pBlob->pStmt);
    sqlite3DbFree(db, pBlob);
  }
  sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db, rc, (zErr ? "%s" : 0), zErr);
  sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
  sqlite3ParseObjectReset(&sParse);
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
                                ;
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_blob_close(sqlite3_blob *pBlob){
  Incrblob *p = (Incrblob *)pBlob;
  int rc;
  sqlite3 *db;

  if( p ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = p->pStmt;
    db = p->db;
                                  ;
    sqlite3DbFree(db, p);
                                  ;
    rc = sqlite3_finalize(pStmt);
  }else{
    rc =0         ;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int blobReadWrite(
  sqlite3_blob *pBlob,
  void *z,
  int n,
  int iOffset,
  int (*xCall)(BtCursor*, u32, u32, void*)
){
  int rc;
  Incrblob *p = (Incrblob *)pBlob;
  Vdbe *v;
  sqlite3 *db;

  if( p==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  db = p->db;
                                ;
  v = (Vdbe*)p->pStmt;

  if( n<0 || iOffset<0 || ((sqlite3_int64)iOffset+n)>p->nByte ){

    rc =1            ;
  }else if( v==0 ){



    rc =4            ;
  }else{



    assert( db == v->db );
                                    ;


    if( xCall==sqlite3BtreePutData && db->xPreUpdateCallback ){













      sqlite3_int64 iKey;
      iKey = sqlite3BtreeIntegerKey(p->pCsr);
      assert( v->apCsr[0]!=0 );
      assert( v->apCsr[0]->eCurType==0             );
      sqlite3VdbePreUpdateHook(
          v, v->apCsr[0],9             , p->zDb, p->pTab, iKey, -1, p->iCol
      );
    }


    rc = xCall(p->pCsr, iOffset+p->iOffset, n, z);
                                    ;
    if( rc==4            ){
      sqlite3VdbeFinalize(v);
      p->pStmt = 0;
    }else{
      v->rc = rc;
    }
  }
  sqlite3Error(db, rc);
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
                                ;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_blob_read(sqlite3_blob *pBlob, void *z, int n, int iOffset){
  return blobReadWrite(pBlob, z, n, iOffset, sqlite3BtreePayloadChecked);
}




           int sqlite3_blob_write(sqlite3_blob *pBlob, const void *z, int n, int iOffset){
  return blobReadWrite(pBlob, (void *)z, n, iOffset, sqlite3BtreePutData);
}







           int sqlite3_blob_bytes(sqlite3_blob *pBlob){
  Incrblob *p = (Incrblob *)pBlob;
  return (p && p->pStmt) ? p->nByte : 0;
}











           int sqlite3_blob_reopen(sqlite3_blob *pBlob, sqlite3_int64 iRow){
  int rc;
  Incrblob *p = (Incrblob *)pBlob;
  sqlite3 *db;

  if( p==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  db = p->db;
                                ;

  if( p->pStmt==0 ){



    rc =4            ;
  }else{
    char *zErr;
    ((Vdbe*)p->pStmt)->rc =0         ;
    rc = blobSeekToRow(p, iRow, &zErr);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db, rc, (zErr ? "%s" : 0), zErr);
      sqlite3DbFree(db, zErr);
    }
    assert( rc!=17            );
  }

  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
  assert( rc==0         || p->pStmt==0 );
                                ;
  return rc;
}
