        *pValue = -v;
        rc = 1;
      }
      break;
    }
    default: break;
  }
  return rc;
}















static         int sqlite3ExprCanBeNull(const Expr *p){
  u8 op;
  assert( p!=0 );
  while( p->op==174      || p->op==173       ){
    p = p->pLeft;
    assert( p!=0 );
  }
  op = p->op;
  if( op==176         ) op = p->op2;
  switch( op ){
    case 155       :
    case 117      :
    case 153     :
    case 154    :
      return 0;
    case 167      :
      assert((((p)->flags&(0x1000000|0x2000000))==0));
      return(((p)->flags&(0x200000))!=0)      ||
             p->y.pTab==0 ||
             (p->iColumn>=0
              && p->y.pTab->aCol!=0
              && p->y.pTab->aCol[p->iColumn].notNull==0);
    default:
      return 1;
  }
}











static         int sqlite3ExprNeedsNoAffinityChange(const Expr *p, char aff){
  u8 op;
  int unaryMinus = 0;
  if( aff==0x41            ) return 1;
  while( p->op==174      || p->op==173       ){
    if( p->op==173       ) unaryMinus = 1;
    p = p->pLeft;
  }
  op = p->op;
  if( op==176         ) op = p->op2;
  switch( op ){
    case 155       : {
      return aff>=0x43              ;
    }
    case 153     : {
      return aff>=0x43              ;
    }
    case 117      : {
      return !unaryMinus && aff==0x42           ;
    }
    case 154    : {
      return !unaryMinus;
    }
    case 167      : {
      assert( p->iTable>=0 );
      return aff>=0x43               && p->iColumn<0;
    }
    default: {
      return 0;
    }
  }
}




static         int sqlite3IsRowid(const char *z){
  if( sqlite3StrICmp(z, "_ROWID_")==0 ) return 1;
  if( sqlite3StrICmp(z, "ROWID")==0 ) return 1;
  if( sqlite3StrICmp(z, "OID")==0 ) return 1;
  return 0;
}









static Select *isCandidateForInOpt(const Expr *pX){
  Select *p;
  SrcList *pSrc;
  ExprList *pEList;
  Table *pTab;
  int i;
  if( !(((pX)->flags&0x001000)!=0))return 0;
  if((((pX)->flags&(0x000040))!=0)       ) return 0;
  p = pX->x.pSelect;
  if( p->pPrior ) return 0;
  if( p->selFlags & (0x0000001  |0x0000008   ) ){
if( (p->selFlags & (0x0000001|0x0000008))==0x0000001 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( (p->selFlags & (0x0000001|0x0000008))==0x0000008 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    return 0;
  }
  assert( p->pGroupBy==0 );
  if( p->pLimit ) return 0;
  if( p->pWhere ) return 0;
  pSrc = p->pSrc;
  assert( pSrc!=0 );
  if( pSrc->nSrc!=1 ) return 0;
  if( pSrc->a[0].pSelect ) return 0;
  pTab = pSrc->a[0].pTab;
  assert( pTab!=0 );
  assert( !((pTab)->eTabType==2));
  if(((pTab)->eTabType==1))return 0;
  pEList = p->pEList;
  assert( pEList!=0 );

  for(i=0; i<pEList->nExpr; i++){
    Expr *pRes = pEList->a[i].pExpr;
    if( pRes->op!=167       ) return 0;
    assert( pRes->iTable==pSrc->a[0].iCursor );
  }
  return p;
}









static void sqlite3SetHasNullFlag(Vdbe *v, int iCur, int regHasNull){
  int addr1;
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         , 0, regHasNull);
  addr1 = sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,36        , iCur);sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , iCur, 0, regHasNull);
  sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v,0x80             );
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "first_entry_in(%d)", iCur);
  sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addr1);
}








static int sqlite3InRhsIsConstant(Expr *pIn){
  Expr *pLHS;
  int res;
  assert( !(((pIn)->flags&(0x001000))!=0)     );
  pLHS = pIn->pLeft;
  pIn->pLeft = 0;
  res = sqlite3ExprIsConstant(pIn);
  pIn->pLeft = pLHS;
  return res;
}






















































































static         int sqlite3FindInIndex(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pX,
  u32 inFlags,
  int *prRhsHasNull,
  int *aiMap,
  int *piTab
){
  Select *p;
  int eType = 0;
  int iTab;
  int mustBeUnique;
  Vdbe *v = sqlite3GetVdbe(pParse);

  assert( pX->op==49    );
  mustBeUnique = (inFlags &0x0004        )!=0;
  iTab = pParse->nTab++;






  if( prRhsHasNull &&(((pX)->flags&0x001000)!=0)){
    int i;
    ExprList *pEList = pX->x.pSelect->pEList;
    for(i=0; i<pEList->nExpr; i++){
      if( sqlite3ExprCanBeNull(pEList->a[i].pExpr) ) break;
    }
    if( i==pEList->nExpr ){
      prRhsHasNull = 0;
    }
  }




  if( pParse->nErr==0 && (p = isCandidateForInOpt(pX))!=0 ){
    sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
    Table *pTab;
    int iDb;
    ExprList *pEList = p->pEList;
    int nExpr = pEList->nExpr;

    assert( p->pEList!=0 );
    assert( p->pEList->a[0].pExpr!=0 );
    assert( p->pSrc!=0 );
    pTab = p->pSrc->a[0].pTab;


    iDb = sqlite3SchemaToIndex(db, pTab->pSchema);
    assert( iDb>=0 && iDb<(10 +2)       );
    sqlite3CodeVerifySchema(pParse, iDb);
                                                             ;

    assert(v);
    if( nExpr==1 && pEList->a[0].pExpr->iColumn<0 ){

      int iAddr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);

      sqlite3OpenTable(pParse, iTab, iDb, pTab,112         );
      eType =1              ;
sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 0, 
"USING ROWID SEARCH ON TABLE %s FOR IN-OPERATOR",pTab->zName)             ;
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, iAddr);
    }else{
      Index *pIdx;
      int affinity_ok = 1;
      int i;





      for(i=0; i<nExpr && affinity_ok; i++){
        Expr *pLhs = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pX->pLeft, i);
        int iCol = pEList->a[i].pExpr->iColumn;
        char idxaff = sqlite3TableColumnAffinity(pTab,iCol);
        char cmpaff = sqlite3CompareAffinity(pLhs, idxaff);
if( cmpaff==0x41 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( cmpaff==0x42 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        switch( cmpaff ){
          case 0x41           :
            break;
          case 0x42           :




            assert( idxaff==0x42            );
            break;
          default:
            affinity_ok =((idxaff)>=0x43)                 ;
        }
      }

      if( affinity_ok ){

        for(pIdx=pTab->pIndex; pIdx && eType==0; pIdx=pIdx->pNext){
          Bitmask colUsed;
          Bitmask mCol;
          if( pIdx->nColumn<nExpr ) continue;
          if( pIdx->pPartIdxWhere!=0 ) continue;


if( pIdx->nColumn==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))-2 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pIdx->nColumn==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))-1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
          if( pIdx->nColumn>=((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))-1)continue;
          if( mustBeUnique ){
            if( pIdx->nKeyCol>nExpr
             ||(pIdx->nColumn>nExpr && !((pIdx)->onError!=0))
            ){
              continue;
            }
          }

          colUsed = 0;
          for(i=0; i<nExpr; i++){
            Expr *pLhs = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pX->pLeft, i);
            Expr *pRhs = pEList->a[i].pExpr;
            CollSeq *pReq = sqlite3BinaryCompareCollSeq(pParse, pLhs, pRhs);
            int j;

            assert( pReq!=0 || pRhs->iColumn==(-1)     || pParse->nErr );
            for(j=0; j<nExpr; j++){
              if( pIdx->aiColumn[j]!=pRhs->iColumn ) continue;
              assert( pIdx->azColl[j] );
              if( pReq!=0 && sqlite3StrICmp(pReq->zName, pIdx->azColl[j])!=0 ){
                continue;
              }
              break;
            }
            if( j==nExpr ) break;
            mCol =(((Bitmask)1)<<(j));
            if( mCol & colUsed ) break;
            colUsed |= mCol;
            if( aiMap ) aiMap[i] = j;
          }

          assert( i==nExpr || colUsed!=((((Bitmask)1)<<(nExpr))-1));
          if( colUsed==((((Bitmask)1)<<(nExpr))-1)){

            int iAddr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 0, 
"USING INDEX %s FOR IN-OPERATOR",pIdx->zName)                               ;
            sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,112         , iTab, pIdx->tnum, iDb);
            sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo(pParse, pIdx);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "%s", pIdx->zName)      ;
            assert(4                    ==3                  +1 );
            eType =3                   + pIdx->aSortOrder[0];

            if( prRhsHasNull ){

              i64 mask = (1<<nExpr)-1;
              sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Dup8(v,123            ,
                  iTab, 0, 0, (u8*)&mask,(-13)    );

              *prRhsHasNull = ++pParse->nMem;
              if( nExpr==1 ){
                sqlite3SetHasNullFlag(v, iTab, *prRhsHasNull);
              }
            }
            sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, iAddr);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }








  if( eType==0
   && (inFlags &0x0001           )
   &&(((pX)->flags&0x001000)==0)
   && (!sqlite3InRhsIsConstant(pX) || pX->x.pList->nExpr<=2)
  ){
    pParse->nTab--;
    iTab = -1;
    eType =5             ;
  }

  if( eType==0 ){



    u32 savedNQueryLoop = pParse->nQueryLoop;
    int rMayHaveNull = 0;
    eType =2            ;
    if( inFlags &0x0004         ){
      pParse->nQueryLoop = 0;
    }else if( prRhsHasNull ){
      *prRhsHasNull = rMayHaveNull = ++pParse->nMem;
    }
    assert( pX->op==49    );
    sqlite3CodeRhsOfIN(pParse, pX, iTab);
    if( rMayHaveNull ){
      sqlite3SetHasNullFlag(v, iTab, rMayHaveNull);
    }
    pParse->nQueryLoop = savedNQueryLoop;
  }

  if( aiMap && eType!=3                  && eType!=4                   ){
    int i, n;
    n = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(pX->pLeft);
    for(i=0; i<n; i++) aiMap[i] = i;
  }
  *piTab = iTab;
  return eType;
}











static char *exprINAffinity(Parse *pParse, const Expr *pExpr){
  Expr *pLeft = pExpr->pLeft;
  int nVal = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(pLeft);
  Select *pSelect =(((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0)?pExpr->x.pSelect:0;
  char *zRet;

  assert( pExpr->op==49    );
  zRet = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(pParse->db, nVal+1);
  if( zRet ){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<nVal; i++){
      Expr *pA = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pLeft, i);
      char a = sqlite3ExprAffinity(pA);
      if( pSelect ){
        zRet[i] = sqlite3CompareAffinity(pSelect->pEList->a[i].pExpr, a);
      }else{
        zRet[i] = a;
      }
    }
    zRet[nVal] = '\0';
  }
  return zRet;
}









static         void sqlite3SubselectError(Parse *pParse, int nActual, int nExpect){
  if( pParse->nErr==0 ){
    const char *zFmt = "sub-select returns %d columns - expected %d";
    sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, zFmt, nActual, nExpect);
  }
}













static         void sqlite3VectorErrorMsg(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr){

  if((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0)){
    sqlite3SubselectError(pParse, pExpr->x.pSelect->pEList->nExpr, 1);
  }else

  {
    sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "row value misused");
  }
}
























static         void sqlite3CodeRhsOfIN(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int iTab
){
  int addrOnce = 0;
  int addr;
  Expr *pLeft;
  KeyInfo *pKeyInfo = 0;
  int nVal;
  Vdbe *v;

  v = pParse->pVdbe;
  assert( v!=0 );











  if( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000040))!=0)     && pParse->iSelfTab==0 ){




    if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x2000000))!=0)  ){
      addrOnce = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      if((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0)){
sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 0, "REUSE LIST SUBQUERY %d", 
pExpr->x.pSelect->selId)               ;
      }
      assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x2000000)!=0));
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,10       , pExpr->y.sub.regReturn,
                        pExpr->y.sub.iAddr);
      assert( iTab!=pExpr->iTable );
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,115        , iTab, pExpr->iTable);
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrOnce);
      return;
    }


    assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&0x1000000)!=0));
(pExpr)->flags|=(0x2000000)          ;
    assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x010000|0x004000))!=0)       );
    pExpr->y.sub.regReturn = ++pParse->nMem;
    pExpr->y.sub.iAddr =
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,74             , 0, pExpr->y.sub.regReturn) + 1;

    addrOnce = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  }


  pLeft = pExpr->pLeft;
  nVal = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(pLeft);




  pExpr->iTable = iTab;
  addr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,118              , pExpr->iTable, nVal);

  if((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0)){
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "Result of SELECT %u", pExpr->x.pSelect->selId);
  }else{
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "RHS of IN operator");
  }

  pKeyInfo = sqlite3KeyInfoAlloc(pParse->db, nVal, 1);

  if((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0)){





    Select *pSelect = pExpr->x.pSelect;
    ExprList *pEList = pSelect->pEList;

sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 1, "%sLIST SUBQUERY %d", 
addrOnce?"":"CORRELATED ", pSelect->selId 
)     ;


    if((1)                          ){
      Select *pCopy;
      SelectDest dest;
      int i;
      int rc;
      sqlite3SelectDestInit(&dest,11      , iTab);
      dest.zAffSdst = exprINAffinity(pParse, pExpr);
      pSelect->iLimit = 0;
if( pSelect->selFlags & 0x0000001 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pKeyInfo==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      pCopy = sqlite3SelectDup(pParse->db, pSelect, 0);
      rc = pParse->db->mallocFailed ? 1 :sqlite3Select(pParse, pCopy, &dest);
      sqlite3SelectDelete(pParse->db, pCopy);
      sqlite3DbFree(pParse->db, dest.zAffSdst);
      if( rc ){
        sqlite3KeyInfoUnref(pKeyInfo);
        return;
      }
      assert( pKeyInfo!=0 );
      assert( pEList!=0 );
      assert( pEList->nExpr>0 );
      assert( sqlite3KeyInfoIsWriteable(pKeyInfo) );
      for(i=0; i<nVal; i++){
        Expr *p = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pLeft, i);
        pKeyInfo->aColl[i] = sqlite3BinaryCompareCollSeq(
            pParse, p, pEList->a[i].pExpr
        );
      }
    }
  }else if((1)                        ){







    char affinity;
    int i;
    ExprList *pList = pExpr->x.pList;
    struct ExprList_item *pItem;
    int r1, r2;
    affinity = sqlite3ExprAffinity(pLeft);
    if( affinity<=0x40            ){
      affinity =0x41            ;
    }else if( affinity==0x45            ){
      affinity =0x43               ;
    }
    if( pKeyInfo ){
      assert( sqlite3KeyInfoIsWriteable(pKeyInfo) );
      pKeyInfo->aColl[0] = sqlite3ExprCollSeq(pParse, pExpr->pLeft);
    }


    r1 = sqlite3GetTempReg(pParse);
    r2 = sqlite3GetTempReg(pParse);
    for(i=pList->nExpr, pItem=pList->a; i>0; i--, pItem++){
      Expr *pE2 = pItem->pExpr;






      if( addrOnce && !sqlite3ExprIsConstant(pE2) ){
        sqlite3VdbeChangeToNoop(v, addrOnce-1);
        sqlite3VdbeChangeToNoop(v, addrOnce);
(pExpr)->flags&=~(0x2000000)               ;
        addrOnce = 0;
      }


      sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pE2, r1);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,97            , r1, 1, r2, &affinity, 1);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v,138          , iTab, r2, r1, 1);
    }
    sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, r1);
    sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, r2);
  }
  if( pKeyInfo ){
    sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(v, addr, (void *)pKeyInfo,(-8)       );
  }
  if( addrOnce ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,136        , iTab);
    sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrOnce);

    assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x2000000)!=0));
    assert( sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v,pExpr->y.sub.iAddr-1)->opcode==74
            || pParse->nErr );
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,67        , pExpr->y.sub.regReturn,
                      pExpr->y.sub.iAddr, 1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    sqlite3ClearTempRegCache(pParse);
  }
}

















static         int sqlite3CodeSubselect(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr){
  int addrOnce = 0;
  int rReg = 0;
  Select *pSel;
  SelectDest dest;
  int nReg;
  Expr *pLimit;

  int addrExplain;


  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  assert( v!=0 );
  if( pParse->nErr ) return 0;
if( pExpr->op==20 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pExpr->op==138 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  assert( pExpr->op==20        || pExpr->op==138       );
  assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)!=0));
  pSel = pExpr->x.pSelect;



  if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x2000000))!=0)  ){
sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 0, "REUSE SUBQUERY %d", pSel->selId)   ;
    assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x2000000)!=0));
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,10       , pExpr->y.sub.regReturn,
                      pExpr->y.sub.iAddr);
    return pExpr->iTable;
  }


  assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&0x1000000)!=0));
  assert( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x004000|0x010000))!=0)       );
(pExpr)->flags|=(0x2000000)        ;
  pExpr->y.sub.regReturn = ++pParse->nMem;
  pExpr->y.sub.iAddr =
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,74             , 0, pExpr->y.sub.regReturn) + 1;











  if( !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000040))!=0)     ){
    addrOnce = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  }











(addrExplain = sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 1, "%sSCALAR SUBQUERY %d", 
addrOnce?"":"CORRELATED ", pSel->selId))        ;
                                                                ;
  nReg = pExpr->op==138       ? pSel->pEList->nExpr : 1;
  sqlite3SelectDestInit(&dest, 0, pParse->nMem+1);
  pParse->nMem += nReg;
  if( pExpr->op==138       ){
    dest.eDest =10      ;
    dest.iSdst = dest.iSDParm;
    dest.nSdst = nReg;
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,75      , 0, dest.iSDParm, dest.iSDParm+nReg-1);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "Init subquery result");
  }else{
    dest.eDest =3          ;
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         , 0, dest.iSDParm);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "Init EXISTS result");
  }
  if( pSel->pLimit ){


    sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
    pLimit = sqlite3Expr(db,155        , "0");
    if( pLimit ){
      pLimit->affExpr =0x43               ;
      pLimit = sqlite3PExpr(pParse,52    ,
                            sqlite3ExprDup(db, pSel->pLimit->pLeft, 0), pLimit);
    }
    sqlite3ExprDeferredDelete(pParse, pSel->pLimit->pLeft);
    pSel->pLimit->pLeft = pLimit;
  }else{

    pLimit = sqlite3Expr(pParse->db,155        , "1");
    pSel->pLimit = sqlite3PExpr(pParse,148      , pLimit, 0);
  }
  pSel->iLimit = 0;
  if( sqlite3Select(pParse, pSel, &dest) ){
    pExpr->op2 = pExpr->op;
    pExpr->op =182      ;
    return 0;
  }
  pExpr->iTable = rReg = dest.iSDParm;
(pExpr)->vvaFlags|=(0x01)               ;
  if( addrOnce ){
    sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrOnce);
  }
                                                             ;


  assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x2000000)!=0));
  assert( sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v,pExpr->y.sub.iAddr-1)->opcode==74
          || pParse->nErr );
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,67        , pExpr->y.sub.regReturn,
                    pExpr->y.sub.iAddr, 1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  sqlite3ClearTempRegCache(pParse);
  return rReg;
}









static         int 0                                           {
  int nVector = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(pIn->pLeft);
  if((((pIn)->flags&0x001000)!=0)&&!pParse->db->mallocFailed){
    if( nVector!=pIn->x.pSelect->pEList->nExpr ){
      sqlite3SubselectError(pParse, pIn->x.pSelect->pEList->nExpr, nVector);
      return 1;
    }
  }else if( nVector!=1 ){
    sqlite3VectorErrorMsg(pParse, pIn->pLeft);
    return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}




























static void sqlite3ExprCodeIN(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int destIfFalse,
  int destIfNull
){
  int rRhsHasNull = 0;
  int eType;
  int rLhs;
  int rLhsOrig;
  Vdbe *v;
  int *aiMap = 0;
  char *zAff = 0;
  int nVector;
  int iDummy;
  Expr *pLeft;
  int i;
  int destStep2;
  int destStep6 = 0;
  int addrTruthOp;
  int destNotNull;
  int addrTop;
  int iTab = 0;
  u8 okConstFactor = pParse->okConstFactor;

  assert( !(((pExpr)->vvaFlags&(0x02))!=0)        );
  pLeft = pExpr->pLeft;
  if(0                                  ) return;
  zAff = exprINAffinity(pParse, pExpr);
  nVector = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(pExpr->pLeft);
  aiMap = (int*)sqlite3DbMallocZero(
      pParse->db, nVector*(sizeof(int) + sizeof(char)) + 1
  );
  if( pParse->db->mallocFailed ) goto sqlite3ExprCodeIN_oom_error;





  v = pParse->pVdbe;
  assert( v!=0 );
sqlite3VdbeNoopComment (v, "begin IN expr");
  eType = sqlite3FindInIndex(pParse, pExpr,
0x0002                                           |0x0001           ,
                             destIfFalse==destIfNull ? 0 : &rRhsHasNull,
                             aiMap, &iTab);

  assert( pParse->nErr || nVector==1 || eType==2
       || eType==3                  || eType==4
  );



  for(i=0; i<nVector; i++){
    int j, cnt;
    for(cnt=j=0; j<nVector; j++) if( aiMap[j]==i ) cnt++;
    assert( cnt==1 );
  }














  assert( pParse->okConstFactor==okConstFactor );
  pParse->okConstFactor = 0;
  rLhsOrig = exprCodeVector(pParse, pLeft, &iDummy);
  pParse->okConstFactor = okConstFactor;
  for(i=0; i<nVector && aiMap[i]==i; i++){}
  if( i==nVector ){

    rLhs = rLhsOrig;
  }else{

    rLhs = sqlite3GetTempRange(pParse, nVector);
    for(i=0; i<nVector; i++){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,80      , rLhsOrig+i, rLhs+aiMap[i], 0);
    }
  }







  if( eType==5             ){
    ExprList *pList;
    CollSeq *pColl;
    int labelOk = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
    int r2, regToFree;
    int regCkNull = 0;
    int ii;
    assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)==0));
    pList = pExpr->x.pList;
    pColl = sqlite3ExprCollSeq(pParse, pExpr->pLeft);
    if( destIfNull!=destIfFalse ){
      regCkNull = sqlite3GetTempReg(pParse);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,102       , rLhs, rLhs, regCkNull);
    }
    for(ii=0; ii<pList->nExpr; ii++){
      r2 = sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(pParse, pList->a[ii].pExpr, &regToFree);
      if( regCkNull && sqlite3ExprCanBeNull(pList->a[ii].pExpr) ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,102       , regCkNull, r2, regCkNull);
      }
      sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regToFree);
      if( ii<pList->nExpr-1 || destIfNull!=destIfFalse ){
        int op = rLhs!=r2 ?53     :51         ;
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v, op, rLhs, labelOk, r2,
                          (void*)pColl,(-2)       );
if(ii<pList->nExpr-1 && op==53)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(ii==pList->nExpr-1 && op==53)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(ii<pList->nExpr-1 && op==51)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(ii==pList->nExpr-1 && op==51)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, zAff[0]);
      }else{
        int op = rLhs!=r2 ?52     :50        ;
        assert( destIfNull==destIfFalse );
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v, op, rLhs, destIfFalse, r2,
                          (void*)pColl,(-2)       );
if(op==52)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(op==50)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, zAff[0] |0x10              );
      }
    }
    if( regCkNull ){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,50        , regCkNull, destIfNull);sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, destIfFalse);
    }
    sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, labelOk);
    sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regCkNull);
    goto sqlite3ExprCodeIN_finished;
  }





  if( destIfNull==destIfFalse ){
    destStep2 = destIfFalse;
  }else{
    destStep2 = destStep6 = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
  }
  for(i=0; i<nVector; i++){
    Expr *p = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pExpr->pLeft, i);
    if( pParse->nErr ) goto sqlite3ExprCodeIN_oom_error;
    if( sqlite3ExprCanBeNull(p) ){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,50        , rLhs+i, destStep2);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    }
  }





  if( eType==1              ){



    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,30           , iTab, destIfFalse, rLhs);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    addrTruthOp = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,9       );
  }else{
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,96          , rLhs, nVector, 0, zAff, nVector);
    if( destIfFalse==destIfNull ){

      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v,28          , iTab, destIfFalse,
                           rLhs, nVector);sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      goto sqlite3ExprCodeIN_finished;
    }

    addrTruthOp = sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v,29       , iTab, 0,
                                      rLhs, nVector);sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  }




  if( rRhsHasNull && nVector==1 ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,51         , rRhsHasNull, destIfFalse);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  }




  if( destIfFalse==destIfNull ) sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, destIfFalse);








  if( destStep6 ) sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, destStep6);
  addrTop = sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,36        , iTab, destIfFalse);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
  if( nVector>1 ){
    destNotNull = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
  }else{


    destNotNull = destIfFalse;
  }
  for(i=0; i<nVector; i++){
    Expr *p;
    CollSeq *pColl;
    int r3 = sqlite3GetTempReg(pParse);
    p = sqlite3VectorFieldSubexpr(pLeft, i);
    pColl = sqlite3ExprCollSeq(pParse, p);
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , iTab, i, r3);
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,52    , rLhs+i, destNotNull, r3,
                      (void*)pColl,(-2)       );
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, r3);
  }
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,9       , 0, destIfNull);
  if( nVector>1 ){
    sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, destNotNull);
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,39      , iTab, addrTop+1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);



    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,9       , 0, destIfFalse);
  }


  sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrTruthOp);

sqlite3ExprCodeIN_finished:
  if( rLhs!=rLhsOrig ) sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, rLhs);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "end IN expr");
sqlite3ExprCodeIN_oom_error:
  sqlite3DbFree(pParse->db, aiMap);
  sqlite3DbFree(pParse->db, zAff);
}











static void codeReal(Vdbe *v, const char *z, int negateFlag, int iMem){
  if((1)           ){
sqlite_int64 value;
    sqlite3AtoF(z, &value, sqlite3Strlen30(z),1           );
    assert( !0                   );
    if( negateFlag ) value = -value;
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Dup8(v,153     , 0, iMem, 0, (u8*)&value,(-12)   );
  }
}









static void codeInteger(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int negFlag, int iMem){
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  if( pExpr->flags &0x000800     ){
    int i = pExpr->u.iValue;
    assert( i>=0 );
    if( negFlag ) i = -i;
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         , i, iMem);
  }else{
    int c;
    i64 value;
    const char *z = pExpr->u.zToken;
    assert( z!=0 );
    c = sqlite3DecOrHexToI64(z, &value);
    if( (c==3 && !negFlag) || (c==2) || (negFlag && value==(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))))){

      sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "oversized integer: %s%#T", negFlag?"-":"",pExpr);


      if( sqlite3_strnicmp(z,"0x",2)==0 ){
        sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "hex literal too big: %s%#T",
                        negFlag?"-":"",pExpr);
      }else

      {
        codeReal(v, z, negFlag, iMem);
      }

    }else{
      if( negFlag ){ value = c==3 ?(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))):-value;}
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Dup8(v,72       , 0, iMem, 0, (u8*)&value,(-13)    );
    }
  }
}





static         void sqlite3ExprCodeLoadIndexColumn(
  Parse *pParse,
  Index *pIdx,
  int iTabCur,
  int iIdxCol,
  int regOut
){
  i16 iTabCol = pIdx->aiColumn[iIdxCol];
  if( iTabCol==(-2)    ){
    assert( pIdx->aColExpr );
    assert( pIdx->aColExpr->nExpr>iIdxCol );
    pParse->iSelfTab = iTabCur + 1;
    sqlite3ExprCodeCopy(pParse, pIdx->aColExpr->a[iIdxCol].pExpr, regOut);
    pParse->iSelfTab = 0;
  }else{
    sqlite3ExprCodeGetColumnOfTable(pParse->pVdbe, pIdx->pTable, iTabCur,
                                    iTabCol, regOut);
  }
}






static         void sqlite3ExprCodeGeneratedColumn(
  Parse *pParse,
  Table *pTab,
  Column *pCol,
  int regOut
){
  int iAddr;
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  int nErr = pParse->nErr;
  assert( v!=0 );
  assert( pParse->iSelfTab!=0 );
  if( pParse->iSelfTab>0 ){
    iAddr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,20           , pParse->iSelfTab-1, 0, regOut);
  }else{
    iAddr = 0;
  }
  sqlite3ExprCodeCopy(pParse, sqlite3ColumnExpr(pTab,pCol), regOut);
  if( pCol->affinity>=0x42            ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,96          , regOut, 1, 0, &pCol->affinity, 1);
  }
  if( iAddr ) sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, iAddr);
  if( pParse->nErr>nErr ) pParse->db->errByteOffset = -1;
}





static         void sqlite3ExprCodeGetColumnOfTable(
  Vdbe *v,
  Table *pTab,
  int iTabCur,
  int iCol,
  int regOut
){
  Column *pCol;
  assert( v!=0 );
  assert( pTab!=0 );
  assert( iCol!=(-2)    );
  if( iCol<0 || iCol==pTab->iPKey ){
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,135      , iTabCur, regOut);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "%s.rowid", pTab->zName);
  }else{
    int op;
    int x;
    if(((pTab)->eTabType==1)){
      op =175        ;
      x = iCol;

    }else if( (pCol = &pTab->aCol[iCol])->colFlags &0x0020           ){
      Parse *pParse = sqlite3VdbeParser(v);
      if( pCol->colFlags &0x0100        ){
        sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "generated column loop on \"%s\"",
                        pCol->zCnName);
      }else{
        int savedSelfTab = pParse->iSelfTab;
        pCol->colFlags |=0x0100       ;
        pParse->iSelfTab = iTabCur+1;
        sqlite3ExprCodeGeneratedColumn(pParse, pTab, pCol, regOut);
        pParse->iSelfTab = savedSelfTab;
        pCol->colFlags &= ~0x0100      ;
      }
      return;

    }else if( !(((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)){
if( iCol!=(iCol) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      x = sqlite3TableColumnToIndex(sqlite3PrimaryKeyIndex(pTab), iCol);
      op =94        ;
    }else{
      x =(iCol)                                 ;
if( x!=iCol ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      op =94        ;
    }
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v, op, iTabCur, x, regOut);
    sqlite3ColumnDefault(v, pTab, iCol, regOut);
  }
}








static         int sqlite3ExprCodeGetColumn(
  Parse *pParse,
  Table *pTab,
  int iColumn,
  int iTable,
  int iReg,
  u8 p5
){
  assert( pParse->pVdbe!=0 );
  sqlite3ExprCodeGetColumnOfTable(pParse->pVdbe, pTab, iTable, iColumn, iReg);
  if( p5 ){
    VdbeOp *pOp = sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(pParse->pVdbe);
    if( pOp->opcode==94        ) pOp->p5 = p5;
  }
  return iReg;
}





static         void sqlite3ExprCodeMove(Parse *pParse, int iFrom, int iTo, int nReg){
  sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(pParse->pVdbe,79      , iFrom, iTo, nReg);
}






static void exprToRegister(Expr *pExpr, int iReg){
  Expr *p = sqlite3ExprSkipCollateAndLikely(pExpr);
  if((0)          ) return;
  p->op2 = p->op;
  p->op =176         ;
  p->iTable = iReg;
(p)->flags&=~(0x002000)        ;
}











static int exprCodeVector(Parse *pParse, Expr *p, int *piFreeable){
  int iResult;
  int nResult = sqlite3ExprVectorSize(p);
  if( nResult==1 ){
    iResult = sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(pParse, p, piFreeable);
  }else{
    *piFreeable = 0;
    if( p->op==138       ){

      iResult = 0;

      iResult = sqlite3CodeSubselect(pParse, p);

    }else{
      int i;
      iResult = pParse->nMem+1;
      pParse->nMem += nResult;
      assert((((p)->flags&0x001000)==0));
      for(i=0; i<nResult; i++){
        sqlite3ExprCodeFactorable(pParse, p->x.pList->a[i].pExpr, i+iResult);
      }
    }
  }
  return iResult;
}





static void setDoNotMergeFlagOnCopy(Vdbe *v){
  if( sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(v)->opcode==80      ){
    sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, 1);
  }
}





static int exprCodeInlineFunction(
  Parse *pParse,
  ExprList *pFarg,
  int iFuncId,
  int target
){
  int nFarg;
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  assert( v!=0 );
  assert( pFarg!=0 );
  nFarg = pFarg->nExpr;
  assert( nFarg>0 );
  switch( iFuncId ){
    case 0                  : {




      int endCoalesce = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
      int i;
      assert( nFarg>=2 );
      sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pFarg->a[0].pExpr, target);
      for(i=1; i<nFarg; i++){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,51         , target, endCoalesce);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pFarg->a[i].pExpr, target);
      }
      setDoNotMergeFlagOnCopy(v);
      sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, endCoalesce);
      break;
    }
    case 5             : {
      Expr caseExpr;
      memset(&caseExpr, 0, sizeof(caseExpr));
      caseExpr.op =157     ;
      caseExpr.x.pList = pFarg;
      return sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, &caseExpr, target);
    }

    case 6                       : {
      Expr *pArg = pFarg->a[0].pExpr;
      if( pArg->op==167       && pArg->iTable>=0 ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,93        , pArg->iTable, pArg->iColumn, target);
      }else{
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,75      , 0, target);
      }
      break;
    }

    default: {



      assert( nFarg==1 || nFarg==2 );
      target = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pFarg->a[0].pExpr, target);
      break;
    }






    case 3                      : {

      assert( nFarg==2 );
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         ,
         sqlite3ExprCompare(0,pFarg->a[0].pExpr, pFarg->a[1].pExpr,-1),
         target);
      break;
    }

    case 2                           : {

      assert( nFarg==2 );
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         ,
         sqlite3ExprImpliesExpr(pParse,pFarg->a[0].pExpr, pFarg->a[1].pExpr,-1),
         target);
      break;
    }

    case 1                             : {

      Expr *pA1;
      assert( nFarg==2 );
      pA1 = pFarg->a[1].pExpr;
      if( pA1->op==167       ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         ,
           sqlite3ExprImpliesNonNullRow(pFarg->a[0].pExpr,pA1->iTable),
           target);
      }else{
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,75      , 0, target);
      }
      break;
    }

    case 4                  : {




      const char *azAff[] = { "blob", "text", "numeric", "integer",
                              "real", "flexnum" };
      char aff;
      assert( nFarg==1 );
      aff = sqlite3ExprAffinity(pFarg->a[0].pExpr);
      assert( aff<=0x40
           || (aff>=0x41            && aff<=0x46              ) );
      sqlite3VdbeLoadString(v, target,
              (aff<=0x40           ) ? "none" : azAff[aff-0x41           ]);
      break;
    }

  }
  return target;
}







static __attribute__((noinline))int sqlite3IndexedExprLookup(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int target
){
  IndexedExpr *p;
  Vdbe *v;
  for(p=pParse->pIdxEpr; p; p=p->pIENext){
    u8 exprAff;
    int iDataCur = p->iDataCur;
    if( iDataCur<0 ) continue;
    if( pParse->iSelfTab ){
      if( p->iDataCur!=pParse->iSelfTab-1 ) continue;
      iDataCur = -1;
    }
    if( sqlite3ExprCompare(0, pExpr, p->pExpr, iDataCur)!=0 ) continue;
    assert( p->aff>=0x41            && p->aff<=0x43               );
    exprAff = sqlite3ExprAffinity(pExpr);
    if( (exprAff<=0x41            && p->aff!=0x41           )
     || (exprAff==0x42            && p->aff!=0x42           )
     || (exprAff>=0x43               && p->aff!=0x43              )
    ){

      continue;
    }

    v = pParse->pVdbe;
    assert( v!=0 );
    if( p->bMaybeNullRow ){



      int addr = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,20           , p->iIdxCur, addr+3, target);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , p->iIdxCur, p->iIdxCol, target);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "%s expr-column %d", p->zIdxName, p->iIdxCol);
      sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, 0);
      p = pParse->pIdxEpr;
      pParse->pIdxEpr = 0;
      sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pExpr, target);
      pParse->pIdxEpr = p;
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addr+2);
    }else{
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , p->iIdxCur, p->iIdxCol, target);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "%s expr-column %d", p->zIdxName, p->iIdxCol);
    }
    return target;
  }
  return -1;
}













static         int sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int target){
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  int op;
  int inReg = target;
  int regFree1 = 0;
  int regFree2 = 0;
  int r1, r2;
  Expr tempX;
  int p5 = 0;

  assert( target>0 && target<=pParse->nMem );
  assert( v!=0 );

expr_code_doover:
  if( pExpr==0 ){
    op =121     ;
  }else if( pParse->pIdxEpr!=0
   && !(((pExpr)->flags&(0x800000))!=0)
   && (r1 = sqlite3IndexedExprLookup(pParse, pExpr, target))>=0
  ){
    return r1;
  }else{
    assert( !(((pExpr)->vvaFlags&(0x02))!=0)        );
    op = pExpr->op;
  }
  switch( op ){
    case 169          : {
      AggInfo *pAggInfo = pExpr->pAggInfo;
      struct AggInfo_col *pCol;
      assert( pAggInfo!=0 );
      assert( pExpr->iAgg>=0 && pExpr->iAgg<pAggInfo->nColumn );
      pCol = &pAggInfo->aCol[pExpr->iAgg];
      if( !pAggInfo->directMode ){
        return(assert((pAggInfo)->iFirstReg),(pAggInfo)->iFirstReg+(pExpr->iAgg));
      }else if( pAggInfo->useSortingIdx ){
        Table *pTab = pCol->pTab;
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , pAggInfo->sortingIdxPTab,
                              pCol->iSorterColumn, target);
        if( pTab==0 ){

        }else if( pCol->iColumn<0 ){
sqlite3VdbeComment (v,"%s.rowid",pTab->zName)    ;
        }else{
sqlite3VdbeComment (v,"%s.%s", 
pTab->zName, pTab->aCol[pCol->iColumn].zCnName)               ;
          if( pTab->aCol[pCol->iColumn].affinity==0x45            ){
            sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,87              , target);
          }
        }
        return target;
      }else if( pExpr->y.pTab==0 ){


        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , pExpr->iTable, pExpr->iColumn, target);
        return target;
      }

__attribute__((fallthrough));
    }
    case 167      : {
      int iTab = pExpr->iTable;
      int iReg;
      if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x000020))!=0)     ){






        int aff;
        iReg = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pExpr->pLeft,target);
        assert((((pExpr)->flags&(0x1000000|0x2000000))==0));
        assert( pExpr->y.pTab!=0 );
        aff = sqlite3TableColumnAffinity(pExpr->y.pTab, pExpr->iColumn);
        if( aff>0x41            ){
          static const char zAff[] = "B\000C\000D\000E\000F";
          assert(0x41            =='A' );
          assert(0x42            =='B' );
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,96          , iReg, 1, 0,
                            &zAff[(aff-'B')*2],(-1)      );
        }
        return iReg;
      }
      if( iTab<0 ){
        if( pParse->iSelfTab<0 ){






          Column *pCol;
          Table *pTab;
          int iSrc;
          int iCol = pExpr->iColumn;
          assert((((pExpr)->flags&(0x1000000|0x2000000))==0));
          pTab = pExpr->y.pTab;
          assert( pTab!=0 );
          assert( iCol>=(-1)     );
          assert( iCol<pTab->nCol );
          if( iCol<0 ){
            return -1 -pParse->iSelfTab;
          }
          pCol = pTab->aCol + iCol;
if( iCol!=(iCol) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
          iSrc =(iCol)                                   - pParse->iSelfTab;

          if( pCol->colFlags &0x0060             ){
            if( pCol->colFlags &0x0100        ){
              sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "generated column loop on \"%s\"",
                              pCol->zCnName);
              return 0;
            }
            pCol->colFlags |=0x0100       ;
            if( pCol->colFlags &0x0080            ){
              sqlite3ExprCodeGeneratedColumn(pParse, pTab, pCol, iSrc);
            }
            pCol->colFlags &= ~(0x0100      |0x0080          );
            return iSrc;
          }else

          if( pCol->affinity==0x45            ){
            sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,81       , iSrc, target);
            sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,87              , target);
            return target;
          }else{
            return iSrc;
          }
        }else{


          iTab = pParse->iSelfTab - 1;
        }
      }
      assert((((pExpr)->flags&(0x1000000|0x2000000))==0));
      assert( pExpr->y.pTab!=0 );
      iReg = sqlite3ExprCodeGetColumn(pParse, pExpr->y.pTab,
                               pExpr->iColumn, iTab, target,
                               pExpr->op2);
      return iReg;
    }
    case 155       : {
      codeInteger(pParse, pExpr, 0, target);
      return target;
    }
    case 170         : {
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,71         , sqlite3ExprTruthValue(pExpr), target);
      return target;
    }

    case 153     : {

    case 117      : {

      if( iCol>=0 && pTab->aCol[iCol].affinity==0x45            ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,87              , target);
      }

      break;
    }

    case 177      : {
      sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "row value misused");
      break;
    }







    case 179           : {
      int addrINR;
      u8 okConstFactor = pParse->okConstFactor;
      AggInfo *pAggInfo = pExpr->pAggInfo;
      if( pAggInfo ){
        assert( pExpr->iAgg>=0 && pExpr->iAgg<pAggInfo->nColumn );
        if( !pAggInfo->directMode ){
          inReg =(assert((pAggInfo)->iFirstReg),(pAggInfo)->iFirstReg+(pExpr->iAgg));
          break;
        }
        if( pExpr->pAggInfo->useSortingIdx ){
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , pAggInfo->sortingIdxPTab,
                            pAggInfo->aCol[pExpr->iAgg].iSorterColumn,
                            target);
          inReg = target;
          break;
        }
      }
      addrINR = sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,20           , pExpr->iTable, 0, target);







      pParse->okConstFactor = 0;
      inReg = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pExpr->pLeft, target);
      pParse->okConstFactor = okConstFactor;
      if( inReg!=target ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,81       , inReg, target);
        inReg = target;
      }
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrINR);
      break;
    }






















    case 157    : {
      int endLabel;
      int nextCase;
      int nExpr;
      int i;
      ExprList *pEList;
      struct ExprList_item *aListelem;
      Expr opCompare;
      Expr *pX;
      Expr *pTest = 0;
      Expr *pDel = 0;
      sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;

      assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)==0)&&pExpr->x.pList!=0);
      assert(pExpr->x.pList->nExpr > 0);
      pEList = pExpr->x.pList;
      aListelem = pEList->a;
      nExpr = pEList->nExpr;
      endLabel = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
      if( (pX = pExpr->pLeft)!=0 ){
        pDel = sqlite3ExprDup(db, pX, 0);
        if( db->mallocFailed ){
          sqlite3ExprDelete(db, pDel);
          break;
        }
if( pX->op==167 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        exprToRegister(pDel, exprCodeVector(pParse, pDel, &regFree1));
if( regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        memset(&opCompare, 0, sizeof(opCompare));
        opCompare.op =53    ;
        opCompare.pLeft = pDel;
        pTest = &opCompare;




        regFree1 = 0;
      }

          opCompare.pRight = aListelem[i].pExpr;
        }else{
          pTest = aListelem[i].pExpr;

        sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, endLabel);
        sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, nextCase);
      }
      if( (nExpr&1)!=0 ){
        sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pEList->a[nExpr-1].pExpr, target);
      }else{
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,75      , 0, target);
      }
      sqlite3ExprDelete(db, pDel);
      setDoNotMergeFlagOnCopy(v);
      sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, endLabel);

    case 71      : {
      assert( pExpr->affExpr==1
           || pExpr->affExpr==2
           || pExpr->affExpr==3
           || pExpr->affExpr==4
      );
      if( !pParse->pTriggerTab && !pParse->nested ){
        sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse,
                       "RAISE() may only be used within a trigger-program");
        return 0;
      }
      if( pExpr->affExpr==2        ){

      }else{

             pParse->pTriggerTab ?(19 | (7<<8))              :1            ,

    }

  }
  sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regFree1);
  sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regFree2);
  return inReg;
}


















static         int sqlite3ExprCodeRunJustOnce(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int regDest
){
  ExprList *p;
  assert(((pParse)->okConstFactor));
  p = pParse->pConstExpr;
  if( regDest<0 && p ){
    struct ExprList_item *pItem;
    int i;
    for(pItem=p->a, i=p->nExpr; i>0; pItem++, i--){
      if( pItem->fg.reusable
       && sqlite3ExprCompare(0,pItem->pExpr,pExpr,-1)==0
      ){
        return pItem->u.iConstExprReg;
      }
    }
  }
  pExpr = sqlite3ExprDup(pParse->db, pExpr, 0);
  if( pExpr!=0 &&(((pExpr)->flags&(0x000008))!=0)    ){
    Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
    int addr;
    assert( v );
    addr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    pParse->okConstFactor = 0;
    if( !pParse->db->mallocFailed ){
      if( regDest<0 ) regDest = ++pParse->nMem;
      sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pExpr, regDest);
    }
    pParse->okConstFactor = 1;
    sqlite3ExprDelete(pParse->db, pExpr);
    sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addr);
  }else{
    p = sqlite3ExprListAppend(pParse, p, pExpr);
    if( p ){
       struct ExprList_item *pItem = &p->a[p->nExpr-1];
       pItem->fg.reusable = regDest<0;
       if( regDest<0 ) regDest = ++pParse->nMem;
       pItem->u.iConstExprReg = regDest;
    }
    pParse->pConstExpr = p;
  }
  return regDest;
}














static         int sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int *pReg){
  int r2;
  pExpr = sqlite3ExprSkipCollateAndLikely(pExpr);
  if(((pParse)->okConstFactor)
   &&(1)
   && pExpr->op!=176
   && sqlite3ExprIsConstantNotJoin(pExpr)
  ){
    *pReg  = 0;
    r2 = sqlite3ExprCodeRunJustOnce(pParse, pExpr, -1);
  }else{
    int r1 = sqlite3GetTempReg(pParse);
    r2 = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pExpr, r1);
    if( r2==r1 ){
      *pReg = r1;
    }else{
      sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, r1);
      *pReg = 0;
    }
  }
  return r2;
}






static         void sqlite3ExprCode(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int target){
  int inReg;

  assert( pExpr==0 || !(((pExpr)->vvaFlags&(0x02))!=0)        );
  assert( target>0 && target<=pParse->nMem );
  assert( pParse->pVdbe!=0 || pParse->db->mallocFailed );
  if( pParse->pVdbe==0 ) return;
  inReg = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pExpr, target);
  if( inReg!=target ){
    u8 op;
    if((1)            &&(((pExpr)->flags&(0x400000))!=0)    ){
      op =80      ;
    }else{
      op =81       ;
    }
    sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(pParse->pVdbe, op, inReg, target);
  }
}






static         void sqlite3ExprCodeCopy(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int target){
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
  pExpr = sqlite3ExprDup(db, pExpr, 0);
  if( !db->mallocFailed ) sqlite3ExprCode(pParse, pExpr, target);
  sqlite3ExprDelete(db, pExpr);
}







static         void sqlite3ExprCodeFactorable(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int target){
  if( pParse->okConstFactor && sqlite3ExprIsConstantNotJoin(pExpr) ){
    sqlite3ExprCodeRunJustOnce(pParse, pExpr, target);
  }else{
    sqlite3ExprCodeCopy(pParse, pExpr, target);
  }
}





















static         int sqlite3ExprCodeExprList(
  Parse *pParse,
  ExprList *pList,
  int target,
  int srcReg,
  u8 flags
){
  struct ExprList_item *pItem;
  int i, j, n;
  u8 copyOp = (flags &0x01            ) ?80       :81       ;
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  assert( pList!=0 );
  assert( target>0 );
  assert( pParse->pVdbe!=0 );
  n = pList->nExpr;
  if( !((pParse)->okConstFactor))flags&=~0x02              ;
  for(pItem=pList->a, i=0; i<n; i++, pItem++){
    Expr *pExpr = pItem->pExpr;

    if( pItem->fg.bSorterRef ){
      i--;
      n--;
    }else

    if( (flags &0x04            )!=0 && (j = pItem->u.x.iOrderByCol)>0 ){
      if( flags &0x08                 ){
        i--;
        n--;
      }else{
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v, copyOp, j+srcReg-1, target+i);
      }
    }else if( (flags &0x02               )!=0
           && sqlite3ExprIsConstantNotJoin(pExpr)
    ){
      sqlite3ExprCodeRunJustOnce(pParse, pExpr, target+i);
    }else{
      int inReg = sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, pExpr, target+i);
      if( inReg!=target+i ){
        VdbeOp *pOp;
        if( copyOp==80
         && (pOp=sqlite3VdbeGetLastOp(v))->opcode==80
         && pOp->p1+pOp->p3+1==inReg
         && pOp->p2+pOp->p3+1==target+i
         && pOp->p5==0
        ){
          pOp->p3++;
        }else{
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v, copyOp, inReg, target+i);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return n;
}





















static void exprCodeBetween(
  Parse *pParse,
  Expr *pExpr,
  int dest,
  void (*xJump)(Parse*,Expr*,int,int),
  int jumpIfNull
){

  Expr compLeft;
  Expr compRight;
  int regFree1 = 0;
  Expr *pDel = 0;
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;

  memset(&compLeft, 0, sizeof(Expr));
  memset(&compRight, 0, sizeof(Expr));
  memset(&exprAnd, 0, sizeof(Expr));

  assert((((pExpr)->flags&0x001000)==0));
  pDel = sqlite3ExprDup(db, pExpr->pLeft, 0);
  if( db->mallocFailed==0 ){
    exprAnd.op =44     ;
    exprAnd.pLeft = &compLeft;
    exprAnd.pRight = &compRight;
    compLeft.op =57    ;
    compLeft.pLeft = pDel;
    compLeft.pRight = pExpr->x.pList->a[0].pExpr;
    compRight.op =55    ;
    compRight.pLeft = pDel;
    compRight.pRight = pExpr->x.pList->a[1].pExpr;
    exprToRegister(pDel, exprCodeVector(pParse, pDel, &regFree1));
    if( xJump ){
      xJump(pParse, &exprAnd, dest, jumpIfNull);
    }else{





      pDel->flags |=0x000001   ;
      sqlite3ExprCodeTarget(pParse, &exprAnd, dest);
    }
    sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regFree1);
  }
  sqlite3ExprDelete(db, pDel);


if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfTrue && jumpIfNull==0 && regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfTrue && jumpIfNull==0 && regFree1!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfTrue && jumpIfNull!=0 && regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfTrue && jumpIfNull!=0 && regFree1!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfFalse && jumpIfNull==0 && regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfFalse && jumpIfNull==0 && regFree1!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfFalse && jumpIfNull!=0 && regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==sqlite3ExprIfFalse && jumpIfNull!=0 && regFree1!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( xJump==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
}

      sqlite3ExprIfFalse(pParse, pExpr->pLeft, dest, jumpIfNull);

      assert(57   ==57   );if( op==57 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };if(op==57)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);

if(op==53 && jumpIfNull!=0x80)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      assert(52   ==52   );if( op==52 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

if(op==52 && jumpIfNull!=0x80)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(op==52 && jumpIfNull==0x80)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if( regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( regFree2==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      break;
    }
    case 50       :
    case 51        : {
      r1 = sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(pParse, pExpr->pLeft, &regFree1);
      sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn(v, r1);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v, op, r1, dest);
if( op==50 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };if(op==50)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if( op==51 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };if(op==51)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if( regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      break;
    }
    case 48        : {
if( jumpIfNull==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      exprCodeBetween(pParse, pExpr, dest, sqlite3ExprIfFalse, jumpIfNull);
      break;
    }

    case 49   : {
      if( jumpIfNull ){
        sqlite3ExprCodeIN(pParse, pExpr, dest, dest);
      }else{
        int destIfNull = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
        sqlite3ExprCodeIN(pParse, pExpr, dest, destIfNull);
        sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, destIfNull);
      }
      break;
    }

    default: {
    default_expr:
      if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x000001|0x20000000))==0x20000000)){
        sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, dest);
      }else if((((pExpr)->flags&(0x000001|0x10000000))==0x10000000)){

      }else{
        r1 = sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(pParse, pExpr, &regFree1);
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,17       , r1, dest, jumpIfNull!=0);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if( regFree1==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( jumpIfNull==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regFree1);
  sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(pParse, regFree2);
}






static         void sqlite3ExprIfFalseDup(Parse *pParse, Expr *pExpr, int dest,int jumpIfNull){
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
  Expr *pCopy = sqlite3ExprDup(db, pExpr, 0);
  if( db->mallocFailed==0 ){
    sqlite3ExprIfFalse(pParse, pCopy, dest, jumpIfNull);
  }
  sqlite3ExprDelete(db, pCopy);
}














static int exprCompareVariable(
  const Parse *pParse,
  const Expr *pVar,
  const Expr *pExpr
){
  int res = 0;
  int iVar;
  sqlite3_value *pL, *pR = 0;

  sqlite3ValueFromExpr(pParse->db, pExpr,1           ,0x41            , &pR);
  if( pR ){
    iVar = pVar->iColumn;
    sqlite3VdbeSetVarmask(pParse->pVdbe, iVar);
    pL = sqlite3VdbeGetBoundValue(pParse->pReprepare, iVar,0x41            );
    if( pL ){
      if( sqlite3_value_type(pL)==3           ){
        sqlite3_value_text(pL);
      }
      res =  0==sqlite3MemCompare(pL, pR, 0);
    }
    sqlite3ValueFree(pR);
    sqlite3ValueFree(pL);
  }

  return res;
}






























static         int sqlite3ExprCompare(
  const Parse *pParse,
  const Expr *pA,
  const Expr *pB,
  int iTab
){
  u32 combinedFlags;
  if( pA==0 || pB==0 ){
    return pB==pA ? 0 : 2;
  }
  if( pParse && pA->op==156         && exprCompareVariable(pParse, pA, pB) ){
    return 0;
  }
  combinedFlags = pA->flags | pB->flags;
  if( combinedFlags &0x000800     ){
    if( (pA->flags&pB->flags&0x000800   )!=0 && pA->u.iValue==pB->u.iValue ){
      return 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  if( pA->op!=pB->op || pA->op==71       ){
    if( pA->op==113        && sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, pA->pLeft,pB,iTab)<2 ){
      return 1;
    }
    if( pB->op==113        && sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, pA,pB->pLeft,iTab)<2 ){
      return 1;
    }
    if( pA->op==169           && pB->op==167
     && pB->iTable<0 && pA->iTable==iTab
    ){

    }else{
      return 2;
    }
  }
  assert( !(((pA)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
  assert( !(((pB)->flags&(0x000800))!=0)    );
  if( pA->u.zToken ){
    if( pA->op==172         || pA->op==168             ){
      if( sqlite3StrICmp(pA->u.zToken,pB->u.zToken)!=0 ) return 2;

      assert( pA->op==pB->op );
      if((((pA)->flags&(0x1000000))!=0) !=(((pB)->flags&(0x1000000))!=0) ){
        return 2;
      }
      if((((pA)->flags&(0x1000000))!=0)  ){
        if( sqlite3WindowCompare(pParse, pA->y.pWin, pB->y.pWin, 1)!=0 ){
          return 2;
        }
      }

    }else if( pA->op==121     ){
      return 0;
    }else if( pA->op==113        ){
      if( sqlite3_stricmp(pA->u.zToken,pB->u.zToken)!=0 ) return 2;
    }else
    if( pB->u.zToken!=0
     && pA->op!=167
     && pA->op!=169
     && strcmp(pA->u.zToken,pB->u.zToken)!=0
    ){
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if( (pA->flags & (0x000004   |0x000400   ))
     != (pB->flags & (0x000004   |0x000400   )) ) return 2;
  if((1)                                        ){
    if( combinedFlags &0x001000      ) return 2;
    if( (combinedFlags &0x000020    )==0
     && sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, pA->pLeft, pB->pLeft, iTab) ) return 2;
    if( sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, pA->pRight, pB->pRight, iTab) ) return 2;
    if( sqlite3ExprListCompare(pA->x.pList, pB->x.pList, iTab) ) return 2;
    if( pA->op!=117
     && pA->op!=170
     &&(1)
    ){
      if( pA->iColumn!=pB->iColumn ) return 2;
      if( pA->op2!=pB->op2 && pA->op==175      ) return 2;
      if( pA->op!=49    && pA->iTable!=pB->iTable && pA->iTable!=iTab ){
        return 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

















static         int sqlite3ExprListCompare(const ExprList *pA, const ExprList *pB, int iTab){
  int i;
  if( pA==0 && pB==0 ) return 0;
  if( pA==0 || pB==0 ) return 1;
  if( pA->nExpr!=pB->nExpr ) return 1;
  for(i=0; i<pA->nExpr; i++){
    int res;
    Expr *pExprA = pA->a[i].pExpr;
    Expr *pExprB = pB->a[i].pExpr;
    if( pA->a[i].fg.sortFlags!=pB->a[i].fg.sortFlags ) return 1;
    if( (res = sqlite3ExprCompare(0, pExprA, pExprB, iTab)) ) return res;
  }
  return 0;
}





static         int sqlite3ExprCompareSkip(Expr *pA,Expr *pB, int iTab){
  return sqlite3ExprCompare(0,
             sqlite3ExprSkipCollateAndLikely(pA),
             sqlite3ExprSkipCollateAndLikely(pB),
             iTab);
}







static int exprImpliesNotNull(
  const Parse *pParse,
  const Expr *p,
  const Expr *pNN,
  int iTab,
  int seenNot
){
  assert( p );
  assert( pNN );
  if( sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, p, pNN, iTab)==0 ){
    return pNN->op!=121    ;
  }
  switch( p->op ){
    case 49   : {
      if( seenNot &&(((p)->flags&(0x001000))!=0)      ) return 0;
      assert((((p)->flags&0x001000)!=0)||(p->x.pList!=0&&p->x.pList->nExpr>0));
      return exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pLeft, pNN, iTab, 1);
    }
    case 48        : {
      ExprList *pList;
      assert((((p)->flags&0x001000)==0));
      pList = p->x.pList;
      assert( pList!=0 );
      assert( pList->nExpr==2 );
      if( seenNot ) return 0;
      if( exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, pList->a[0].pExpr, pNN, iTab, 1)
       || exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, pList->a[1].pExpr, pNN, iTab, 1)
      ){
        return 1;
      }
      return exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pLeft, pNN, iTab, 1);
    }
    case 53   :
    case 52   :
    case 56   :
    case 55   :
    case 54   :
    case 57   :
    case 106    :
    case 107     :
    case 103     :
    case 104      :
    case 105      :
    case 111      :
      seenNot = 1;
__attribute__((fallthrough));
    case 108    :
    case 110   :
    case 102      :
    case 109     : {
      if( exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pRight, pNN, iTab, seenNot) ) return 1;
__attribute__((fallthrough));
    }
    case 181    :
    case 113       :
    case 174     :
    case 173      : {
      return exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pLeft, pNN, iTab, seenNot);
    }
    case 175     : {
      if( seenNot ) return 0;
      if( p->op2!=45    ) return 0;
      return exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pLeft, pNN, iTab, 1);
    }
    case 114      :
    case 19    : {
      return exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, p->pLeft, pNN, iTab, 1);
    }
  }
  return 0;
}


























static         int sqlite3ExprImpliesExpr(
  const Parse *pParse,
  const Expr *pE1,
  const Expr *pE2,
  int iTab
){
  if( sqlite3ExprCompare(pParse, pE1, pE2, iTab)==0 ){
    return 1;
  }
  if( pE2->op==43
   && (sqlite3ExprImpliesExpr(pParse, pE1, pE2->pLeft, iTab)
             || sqlite3ExprImpliesExpr(pParse, pE1, pE2->pRight, iTab) )
  ){
    return 1;
  }
  if( pE2->op==51
   && exprImpliesNotNull(pParse, pE1, pE2->pLeft, iTab, 0)
  ){
    return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

  switch( pExpr->op ){

if( pExpr->op==50 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

if( pExpr->op==45 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

      return 1        ;
    case 167      :

        pWalker->eCode = 1;
        return 2        ;
      }
      return 1        ;

    case 44    :

          sqlite3WalkExpr(pWalker, pExpr->pRight);

    case 48        :
      if( sqlite3WalkExpr(pWalker, pExpr->pLeft)==2         ){

    case 53   :

if( pExpr->op==53 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

if( pExpr->op==56 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
