    static const char zLabel[] = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwyxz"
                                           "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWYXZ";
    for(p=pWInfo->pLoops, i=0; p; p=p->pNextLoop, i++){
      p->cId = zLabel[i%(sizeof(zLabel)-1)];
      sqlite3WhereLoopPrint(p, pWC);
    }
  }
}


































static __attribute__((noinline))Bitmask whereOmitNoopJoin(
  WhereInfo *pWInfo,
  Bitmask notReady
){
  int i;
  Bitmask tabUsed;


  assert( pWInfo->nLevel>=2 );
  assert((((pWInfo->pParse->db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00000100))==0)          );



  assert( pWInfo->pResultSet!=0 );
  assert( 0==(pWInfo->wctrlFlags &0x0400             ) );

  tabUsed = sqlite3WhereExprListUsage(&pWInfo->sMaskSet, pWInfo->pResultSet);
  if( pWInfo->pOrderBy ){
    tabUsed |= sqlite3WhereExprListUsage(&pWInfo->sMaskSet, pWInfo->pOrderBy);
  }
  for(i=pWInfo->nLevel-1; i>=1; i--){
    WhereTerm *pTerm, *pEnd;
    SrcItem *pItem;
    WhereLoop *pLoop;
    pLoop = pWInfo->a[i].pWLoop;
    pItem = &pWInfo->pTabList->a[pLoop->iTab];
    if( (pItem->fg.jointype & (0x08   |0x10    ))!=0x08    ) continue;
    if( (pWInfo->wctrlFlags &0x0100              )==0
     && (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00001000   )==0
    ){
      continue;
    }
    if( (tabUsed & pLoop->maskSelf)!=0 ) continue;
    pEnd = pWInfo->sWC.a + pWInfo->sWC.nTerm;
    for(pTerm=pWInfo->sWC.a; pTerm<pEnd; pTerm++){
      if( (pTerm->prereqAll & pLoop->maskSelf)!=0 ){
        if( !(((pTerm->pExpr)->flags&(0x000001))!=0)
         || pTerm->pExpr->w.iJoin!=pItem->iCursor
        ){
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if( pTerm<pEnd ) continue;
if(sqlite3WhereTrace&(0xffffffff)) printf ("-> drop loop %c not used\n", pLoop->cId);
    notReady &= ~pLoop->maskSelf;
    for(pTerm=pWInfo->sWC.a; pTerm<pEnd; pTerm++){
      if( (pTerm->prereqAll & pLoop->maskSelf)!=0 ){
        pTerm->wtFlags |=0x0004     ;
      }
    }
    if( i!=pWInfo->nLevel-1 ){
      int nByte = (pWInfo->nLevel-1 -i)* sizeof(WhereLevel);
      memmove(&pWInfo->a[i], &pWInfo->a[i+1], nByte);
    }
    pWInfo->nLevel--;
    assert( pWInfo->nLevel>0 );
  }
  return notReady;
}



















static __attribute__((noinline))void whereCheckIfBloomFilterIsUseful(
  const WhereInfo *pWInfo
){
  int i;
  LogEst nSearch = 0;

  assert( pWInfo->nLevel>=2 );
  assert((((pWInfo->pParse->db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00080000))==0)         );
  for(i=0; i<pWInfo->nLevel; i++){
    WhereLoop *pLoop = pWInfo->a[i].pWLoop;
    const unsigned int reqFlags = (0x00800000    |0x00000001     );
    SrcItem *pItem = &pWInfo->pTabList->a[pLoop->iTab];
    Table *pTab = pItem->pTab;
    if( (pTab->tabFlags &0x00000010  )==0 ) break;
    pTab->tabFlags |=0x00000100   ;
    if( i>=1
     && (pLoop->wsFlags & reqFlags)==reqFlags

     &&(1)
    ){
      if( nSearch > pTab->nRowLogEst ){
if( pItem->fg.jointype & 0x08 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
        pLoop->wsFlags |=0x00400000        ;
        pLoop->wsFlags &= ~0x00000040    ;
if(sqlite3WhereTrace&(0xffffffff)) printf ( 
"-> use Bloom-filter on loop %c because there are ~%.1e " 
"lookups into %s which has only ~%.1e rows\n", 
pLoop->cId, (sqlite_int64)sqlite3LogEstToInt(nSearch), pTab->zName, 
(sqlite_int64)sqlite3LogEstToInt(pTab->nRowLogEst))      ;
      }
    }
    nSearch += pLoop->nOut;
  }
}





static void whereIndexedExprCleanup(sqlite3 *db, void *pObject){
  Parse *pParse = (Parse*)pObject;
  while( pParse->pIdxEpr!=0 ){
    IndexedExpr *p = pParse->pIdxEpr;
    pParse->pIdxEpr = p->pIENext;
    sqlite3ExprDelete(db, p->pExpr);
    sqlite3DbFreeNN(db, p);
  }
}












static __attribute__((noinline))void whereAddIndexedExpr(
  Parse *pParse,
  Index *pIdx,
  int iIdxCur,
  SrcItem *pTabItem
){
  int i;
  IndexedExpr *p;
  Table *pTab;
  assert( pIdx->bHasExpr );
  pTab = pIdx->pTable;
  for(i=0; i<pIdx->nColumn; i++){
    Expr *pExpr;
    int j = pIdx->aiColumn[i];
    int bMaybeNullRow;
    if( j==(-2)    ){
      pExpr = pIdx->aColExpr->a[i].pExpr;
if( pTabItem->fg.jointype & 0x08 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pTabItem->fg.jointype & 0x10 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pTabItem->fg.jointype & 0x40 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      bMaybeNullRow = (pTabItem->fg.jointype & (0x08   |0x40    |0x10    ))!=0;
    }else if( j>=0 && (pTab->aCol[j].colFlags &0x0020          )!=0 ){
      pExpr = sqlite3ColumnExpr(pTab, &pTab->aCol[j]);
      bMaybeNullRow = 0;
    }else{
      continue;
    }
    if( sqlite3ExprIsConstant(pExpr) ) continue;
    p = sqlite3DbMallocRaw(pParse->db,  sizeof(IndexedExpr));
    if( p==0 ) break;
    p->pIENext = pParse->pIdxEpr;

    if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x200 ){
printf                  ("New pParse->pIdxEpr term {%d,%d}\n", iIdxCur, i);
      if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x5000 ) sqlite3ShowExpr(pExpr);
    }

    p->pExpr = sqlite3ExprDup(pParse->db, pExpr, 0);
    p->iDataCur = pTabItem->iCursor;
    p->iIdxCur = iIdxCur;
    p->iIdxCol = i;
    p->bMaybeNullRow = bMaybeNullRow;
    if( sqlite3IndexAffinityStr(pParse->db, pIdx) ){
      p->aff = pIdx->zColAff[i];
    }

    p->zIdxName = pIdx->zName;

    pParse->pIdxEpr = p;
    if( p->pIENext==0 ){
      sqlite3ParserAddCleanup(pParse, whereIndexedExprCleanup, pParse);
    }
  }
}

























































































static         WhereInfo *sqlite3WhereBegin(
  Parse *pParse,
  SrcList *pTabList,
  Expr *pWhere,
  ExprList *pOrderBy,
  ExprList *pResultSet,
  Select *pSelect,
  u16 wctrlFlags,
  int iAuxArg

){
  int nByteWInfo;
  int nTabList;
  WhereInfo *pWInfo;
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  Bitmask notReady;
  WhereLoopBuilder sWLB;
  WhereMaskSet *pMaskSet;
  WhereLevel *pLevel;
  WhereLoop *pLoop;
  int ii;
  sqlite3 *db;
  int rc;
  u8 bFordelete = 0;

  assert( (wctrlFlags &0x0008                 )==0 || (
        (wctrlFlags &0x0004                )!=0
     && (wctrlFlags &0x0020             )==0
  ));


  assert( (wctrlFlags &0x0020             )==0
            || (wctrlFlags &0x4000          )==0 );


  db = pParse->db;
  memset(&sWLB, 0, sizeof(sWLB));


if( pOrderBy && pOrderBy->nExpr==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))-1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( pOrderBy && pOrderBy->nExpr>=((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8)))pOrderBy=0;




if( pTabList->nSrc==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8)) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( pTabList->nSrc>((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))){
    sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "at most %d tables in a join",((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8)));
    return 0;
  }






  nTabList = (wctrlFlags &0x0020             ) ? 1 : pTabList->nSrc;








  nByteWInfo =(sizeof(WhereInfo)+(nTabList-1)*sizeof(WhereLevel))        ;
  pWInfo = sqlite3DbMallocRawNN(db, nByteWInfo + sizeof(WhereLoop));
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    sqlite3DbFree(db, pWInfo);
    pWInfo = 0;
    goto whereBeginError;
  }
  pWInfo->pParse = pParse;
  pWInfo->pTabList = pTabList;
  pWInfo->pOrderBy = pOrderBy;

  pWInfo->pWhere = pWhere;

  pWInfo->pResultSet = pResultSet;
  pWInfo->aiCurOnePass[0] = pWInfo->aiCurOnePass[1] = -1;
  pWInfo->nLevel = nTabList;
  pWInfo->iBreak = pWInfo->iContinue = sqlite3VdbeMakeLabel(pParse);
  pWInfo->wctrlFlags = wctrlFlags;
  pWInfo->iLimit = iAuxArg;
  pWInfo->savedNQueryLoop = pParse->nQueryLoop;
  pWInfo->pSelect = pSelect;
  memset(&pWInfo->nOBSat, 0,
((int)((char*)&((WhereInfo*)0)->sWC))-((int)((char*)&((WhereInfo*)0)->nOBSat)));
  memset(&pWInfo->a[0], 0, sizeof(WhereLoop)+nTabList*sizeof(WhereLevel));
  assert( pWInfo->eOnePass==0           );
  pMaskSet = &pWInfo->sMaskSet;
  pMaskSet->n = 0;
  pMaskSet->ix[0] = -99;


  sWLB.pWInfo = pWInfo;
  sWLB.pWC = &pWInfo->sWC;
  sWLB.pNew = (WhereLoop*)(((char*)pWInfo)+nByteWInfo);
  assert(((((uptr)(sWLB.pNew) - (uptr)0)&3)==0));
  whereLoopInit(sWLB.pNew);

  sWLB.pNew->cId = '*';





  sqlite3WhereClauseInit(&pWInfo->sWC, pWInfo);
  sqlite3WhereSplit(&pWInfo->sWC, pWhere,44     );



  if( nTabList==0 ){
    if( pOrderBy ) pWInfo->nOBSat = pOrderBy->nExpr;
    if( (wctrlFlags &0x0100              )!=0
     &&(((db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00000010))==0)
    ){
      pWInfo->eDistinct =1                     ;
    }
sqlite3VdbeExplain (pParse, 0, "SCAN CONSTANT ROW")   ;
  }else{














    ii = 0;
    do{
      createMask(pMaskSet, pTabList->a[ii].iCursor);
      sqlite3WhereTabFuncArgs(pParse, &pTabList->a[ii], &pWInfo->sWC);
    }while( (++ii)<pTabList->nSrc );

    {
      Bitmask mx = 0;
      for(ii=0; ii<pTabList->nSrc; ii++){
        Bitmask m = sqlite3WhereGetMask(pMaskSet, pTabList->a[ii].iCursor);
        assert( m>=mx );
        mx = m;
      }
    }

  }


  sqlite3WhereExprAnalyze(pTabList, &pWInfo->sWC);
  if( pSelect && pSelect->pLimit ){
    sqlite3WhereAddLimit(&pWInfo->sWC, pSelect);
  }
  if( pParse->nErr ) goto whereBeginError;












  for(ii=0; ii<sWLB.pWC->nBase; ii++){
    WhereTerm *pT = &sWLB.pWC->a[ii];
    if( pT->wtFlags &0x0002        ) continue;
    if( pT->prereqAll==0 && (nTabList==0 || exprIsDeterministic(pT->pExpr)) ){
      sqlite3ExprIfFalse(pParse, pT->pExpr, pWInfo->iBreak,0x10              );
      pT->wtFlags |=0x0004     ;
    }
  }

  if( wctrlFlags &0x0100               ){
    if((((db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00000010))!=0)          ){


      wctrlFlags &= ~0x0100             ;
      pWInfo->wctrlFlags &= ~0x0100             ;
    }else if( isDistinctRedundant(pParse, pTabList, &pWInfo->sWC, pResultSet) ){

      pWInfo->eDistinct =1                     ;
    }else if( pOrderBy==0 ){

      pWInfo->wctrlFlags |=0x0080           ;
      pWInfo->pOrderBy = pResultSet;
    }
  }



  if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0xffffffff ){
printf                ("*** Optimizer Start *** (wctrlFlags: 0x%x",wctrlFlags);
    if( wctrlFlags &0x4000           ){
printf                  (", limit: %d", iAuxArg);
    }
printf                (")\n");
    if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x8000 ){
      Select sSelect;
      memset(&sSelect, 0, sizeof(sSelect));
      sSelect.selFlags =0x0080000     ;
      sSelect.pSrc = pTabList;
      sSelect.pWhere = pWhere;
      sSelect.pOrderBy = pOrderBy;
      sSelect.pEList = pResultSet;
      sqlite3TreeViewSelect(0, &sSelect, 0);
    }
    if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x4000 ){
printf                  ("---- WHERE clause at start of analysis:\n");
      sqlite3WhereClausePrint(sWLB.pWC);
    }
  }


  if( nTabList!=1 || whereShortCut(&sWLB)==0 ){
    rc = whereLoopAddAll(&sWLB);
    if( rc ) goto whereBeginError;







    if( sWLB.bldFlags2 &0x0004                ){
showAllWhereLoops(pWInfo,sWLB.pWC)          ;
if(sqlite3WhereTrace&(0xffffffff)) printf 
("**** Redo all loop computations due to" 
" TERM_HIGHTRUTH changes ****\n")             ;
      while( pWInfo->pLoops ){
        WhereLoop *p = pWInfo->pLoops;
        pWInfo->pLoops = p->pNextLoop;
        whereLoopDelete(db, p);
      }
      rc = whereLoopAddAll(&sWLB);
      if( rc ) goto whereBeginError;
    }

showAllWhereLoops(pWInfo,sWLB.pWC)        ;

    wherePathSolver(pWInfo, 0);
    if( db->mallocFailed ) goto whereBeginError;
    if( pWInfo->pOrderBy ){
       wherePathSolver(pWInfo, pWInfo->nRowOut+1);
       if( db->mallocFailed ) goto whereBeginError;
    }
  }
  if( pWInfo->pOrderBy==0 && (db->flags &0x00001000          )!=0 ){
     pWInfo->revMask =((Bitmask)-1);
  }
  if( pParse->nErr ){
    goto whereBeginError;
  }
  assert( db->mallocFailed==0 );

  if( sqlite3WhereTrace ){
printf                ("---- Solution nRow=%d", pWInfo->nRowOut);
    if( pWInfo->nOBSat>0 ){
printf                  (" ORDERBY=%d,0x%llx", pWInfo->nOBSat, pWInfo->revMask);
    }
    switch( pWInfo->eDistinct ){
      case 1                    : {
printf                    ("  DISTINCT=unique");
        break;
      }
      case 2                     : {
printf                    ("  DISTINCT=ordered");
        break;
      }
      case 3                       : {
printf                    ("  DISTINCT=unordered");
        break;
      }
    }
printf                ("\n");
    for(ii=0; ii<pWInfo->nLevel; ii++){
      sqlite3WhereLoopPrint(pWInfo->a[ii].pWLoop, sWLB.pWC);
    }
  }












  notReady = ~(Bitmask)0;
  if( pWInfo->nLevel>=2
   && pResultSet!=0
   && 0==(wctrlFlags &0x0400             )
   &&(((db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00000100))==0)
  ){
    notReady = whereOmitNoopJoin(pWInfo, notReady);
    nTabList = pWInfo->nLevel;
    assert( nTabList>0 );
  }




  if( pWInfo->nLevel>=2
   &&(((db)->dbOptFlags&(0x00080000))==0)
  ){
    whereCheckIfBloomFilterIsUseful(pWInfo);
  }


  if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x4000 ){
printf                ("---- WHERE clause at end of analysis:\n");
    sqlite3WhereClausePrint(sWLB.pWC);
  }
if(sqlite3WhereTrace&(0xffffffff)) printf ("*** Optimizer Finished ***\n");

  pWInfo->pParse->nQueryLoop += pWInfo->nRowOut;




















  assert( (wctrlFlags &0x0004                )==0 || pWInfo->nLevel==1 );
  if( (wctrlFlags &0x0004                )!=0 ){
    int wsFlags = pWInfo->a[0].pWLoop->wsFlags;
    int bOnerow = (wsFlags &0x00001000   )!=0;
    assert( !(wsFlags &0x00000400         ) ||((pTabList->a[0].pTab)->eTabType==1));
    if( bOnerow || (
        0!=(wctrlFlags &0x0008                 )
     && !((pTabList->a[0].pTab)->eTabType==1)
     && (0==(wsFlags &0x00002000     ) || (wctrlFlags &0x0010              ))
    )){
      pWInfo->eOnePass = bOnerow ?1               :2             ;
      if((((pTabList->a[0].pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)&&(wsFlags&0x00000040)){
        if( wctrlFlags &0x0008                  ){
          bFordelete =0x08             ;
        }
        pWInfo->a[0].pWLoop->wsFlags = (wsFlags & ~0x00000040    );
      }
    }
  }




  for(ii=0, pLevel=pWInfo->a; ii<nTabList; ii++, pLevel++){
    Table *pTab;
    int iDb;
    SrcItem *pTabItem;

    pTabItem = &pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom];
    pTab = pTabItem->pTab;
    iDb = sqlite3SchemaToIndex(db, pTab->pSchema);
    pLoop = pLevel->pWLoop;
    if( (pTab->tabFlags &0x00004000   )!=0 ||((pTab)->eTabType==2)){

    }else

    if( (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000400         )!=0 ){
      const char *pVTab = (const char *)((VTable*)0)              ;
      int iCur = pTabItem->iCursor;
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4(v,173      , iCur, 0, 0, pVTab,(-11)   );
    }else if(((pTab)->eTabType==1)){

    }else

    if( ((pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000040     )==0
         && (wctrlFlags &0x0020             )==0)
     || (pTabItem->fg.jointype & (0x40    |0x10    ))!=0
    ){
      int op =112         ;
      if( pWInfo->eOnePass!=0           ){
        op =113          ;
        pWInfo->aiCurOnePass[0] = pTabItem->iCursor;
      };
      sqlite3OpenTable(pParse, pTabItem->iCursor, iDb, pTab, op);
      assert( pTabItem->iCursor==pLevel->iTabCur );
if( pWInfo->eOnePass==0 && pTab->nCol==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))-1 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( pWInfo->eOnePass==0 && pTab->nCol==((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8)) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      if( pWInfo->eOnePass==0
       && pTab->nCol<((int)(sizeof(Bitmask)*8))
       && (pTab->tabFlags & (0x00000060     |0x00000080     ))==0
       && (pLoop->wsFlags & (0x00004000      |0x00400000       ))==0
      ){



        Bitmask b = pTabItem->colUsed;
        int n = 0;
        for(; b; b=b>>1, n++){}
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP4(v, -1,((void*)(intptr_t)(n)),(-3)    );
        assert( n<=pTab->nCol );
      }

      if( pLoop->u.btree.pIndex!=0 ){
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v,0x02          |bFordelete);
      }else

      {
        sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, bFordelete);
      }

      sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Dup8(v,123            , pTabItem->iCursor, 0, 0,
                            (const u8*)&pTabItem->colUsed,(-13)    );

    }else{
                                                               ;
    }
    if( pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000200     ){
      Index *pIx = pLoop->u.btree.pIndex;
      int iIndexCur;
      int op =112         ;

      assert( iAuxArg!=0 || (pWInfo->wctrlFlags &0x0004                )==0 );
      if( !(((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)&&((pIx)->idxType==2)
       && (wctrlFlags &0x0020             )!=0
      ){


        iIndexCur = pLevel->iTabCur;
        op = 0;
      }else if( pWInfo->eOnePass!=0           ){
        Index *pJ = pTabItem->pTab->pIndex;
        iIndexCur = iAuxArg;
        assert( wctrlFlags &0x0004                 );
        while((1)         && pJ!=pIx ){
          iIndexCur++;
          pJ = pJ->pNext;
        }
        op =113          ;
        pWInfo->aiCurOnePass[1] = iIndexCur;
      }else if( iAuxArg && (wctrlFlags &0x0020             )!=0 ){
        iIndexCur = iAuxArg;
        op =101          ;
      }else{
        iIndexCur = pParse->nTab++;
        if( pIx->bHasExpr &&(((db)->dbOptFlags&(0x01000000))==0)         ){
          whereAddIndexedExpr(pParse, pIx, iIndexCur, pTabItem);
        }
      }
      pLevel->iIdxCur = iIndexCur;
      assert( pIx!=0 );
      assert( pIx->pSchema==pTab->pSchema );
      assert( iIndexCur>=0 );
      if( op ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v, op, iIndexCur, pIx->tnum, iDb);
        sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo(pParse, pIx);
        if( (pLoop->wsFlags &0x0000000f       )!=0
         && (pLoop->wsFlags & (0x00000002        |0x00008000    ))==0
         && (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00080000         )==0
         && (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00100000        )==0
         && (pWInfo->wctrlFlags&0x0001           )==0
         && pWInfo->eDistinct!=2
        ){
          sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v,0x02          );
        }
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "%s", pIx->zName)  ;

        {
          u64 colUsed = 0;
          int ii, jj;
          for(ii=0; ii<pIx->nColumn; ii++){
            jj = pIx->aiColumn[ii];
            if( jj<0 ) continue;
            if( jj>63 ) jj = 63;
            if( (pTabItem->colUsed &(((Bitmask)1)<<(jj)))==0)continue;
            colUsed |= ((u64)1)<<(ii<63 ? ii : 63);
          }
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Dup8(v,123            , iIndexCur, 0, 0,
                                (u8*)&colUsed,(-13)    );
        }

      }
    }
    if( iDb>=0 ) sqlite3CodeVerifySchema(pParse, iDb);
    if( (pTabItem->fg.jointype &0x10     )!=0
     && (pLevel->pRJ = sqlite3WhereMalloc(pWInfo, sizeof(WhereRightJoin)))!=0
    ){
      WhereRightJoin *pRJ = pLevel->pRJ;
      pRJ->iMatch = pParse->nTab++;
      pRJ->regBloom = ++pParse->nMem;
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,77      , 65536, pRJ->regBloom);
      pRJ->regReturn = ++pParse->nMem;
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,75      , 0, pRJ->regReturn);
      assert( pTab==pTabItem->pTab );
      if((((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)){
        KeyInfo *pInfo;
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,118              , pRJ->iMatch, 1);
        pInfo = sqlite3KeyInfoAlloc(pParse->db, 1, 0);
        if( pInfo ){
          pInfo->aColl[0] = 0;
          pInfo->aSortFlags[0] = 0;
          sqlite3VdbeAppendP4(v, pInfo,(-8)       );
        }
      }else{
        Index *pPk = sqlite3PrimaryKeyIndex(pTab);
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,118              , pRJ->iMatch, pPk->nKeyCol);
        sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo(pParse, pPk);
      }
      pLoop->wsFlags &= ~0x00000040    ;



      pWInfo->nOBSat = 0;
      pWInfo->eDistinct =3                        ;
    }
  }
  pWInfo->iTop = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
  if( db->mallocFailed ) goto whereBeginError;





  for(ii=0; ii<nTabList; ii++){
    int addrExplain;
    int wsFlags;
    SrcItem *pSrc;
    if( pParse->nErr ) goto whereBeginError;
    pLevel = &pWInfo->a[ii];
    wsFlags = pLevel->pWLoop->wsFlags;
    pSrc = &pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom];
    if( pSrc->fg.isMaterialized ){
      if( pSrc->fg.isCorrelated ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,10       , pSrc->regReturn, pSrc->addrFillSub);
      }else{
        int iOnce = sqlite3VdbeAddOp0(v,15      );sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,10       , pSrc->regReturn, pSrc->addrFillSub);
        sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, iOnce);
      }
    }
    if( (wsFlags & (0x00004000      |0x00400000       ))!=0 ){
      if( (wsFlags &0x00004000       )!=0 ){

        constructAutomaticIndex(pParse, &pWInfo->sWC,
                  &pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom], notReady, pLevel);

      }else{
        sqlite3ConstructBloomFilter(pWInfo, ii, pLevel, notReady);
      }
      if( db->mallocFailed ) goto whereBeginError;
    }
    addrExplain =0

     ;
    pLevel->addrBody = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
    notReady = sqlite3WhereCodeOneLoopStart(pParse,v,pWInfo,ii,pLevel,notReady);
    pWInfo->iContinue = pLevel->addrCont;
    if( (wsFlags&0x00002000    )==0 && (wctrlFlags&0x0020            )==0 ){
((void)addrExplain)                                              ;
    }
  }


sqlite3VdbeNoopComment (v, "Begin WHERE-core");
  pWInfo->iEndWhere = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
  return pWInfo;


whereBeginError:
  if( pWInfo ){
    pParse->nQueryLoop = pWInfo->savedNQueryLoop;
    whereInfoFree(db, pWInfo);
  }
  return 0;
}











  static void sqlite3WhereOpcodeRewriteTrace(
    sqlite3 *db,
    int pc,
    VdbeOp *pOp
  ){
    if( (db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32))==0 ) return;
    sqlite3VdbePrintOp(0, pc, pOp);
  }







static int cursorIsOpen(Vdbe *v, int iCur, int k){
  while( k>=0 ){
    VdbeOp *pOp = sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v,k--);
    if( pOp->p1!=iCur ) continue;
    if( pOp->opcode==122      ) return 0;
    if( pOp->opcode==112         ) return 1;
    if( pOp->opcode==113          ) return 1;
    if( pOp->opcode==115        ) return 1;
    if( pOp->opcode==116              ) return 1;
    if( pOp->opcode==118              ) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}






static         void sqlite3WhereEnd(WhereInfo *pWInfo){
  Parse *pParse = pWInfo->pParse;
  Vdbe *v = pParse->pVdbe;
  int i;
  WhereLevel *pLevel;
  WhereLoop *pLoop;
  SrcList *pTabList = pWInfo->pTabList;
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
  int iEnd = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
  int nRJ = 0;



sqlite3VdbeNoopComment (v, "End WHERE-core");
  for(i=pWInfo->nLevel-1; i>=0; i--){
    int addr;
    pLevel = &pWInfo->a[i];
    if( pLevel->pRJ ){


      WhereRightJoin *pRJ = pLevel->pRJ;
      sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrCont);
      pLevel->addrCont = 0;
      pRJ->endSubrtn = sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,67        , pRJ->regReturn, pRJ->addrSubrtn, 1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      nRJ++;
    }
    pLoop = pLevel->pWLoop;
    if( pLevel->op!=184     ){

      int addrSeek = 0;
      Index *pIdx;
      int n;
      if( pWInfo->eDistinct==2
       && i==pWInfo->nLevel-1
       && (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000200    )!=0
       && (pIdx = pLoop->u.btree.pIndex)->hasStat1
       && (n = pLoop->u.btree.nDistinctCol)>0
       && pIdx->aiRowLogEst[n]>=36
      ){
        int r1 = pParse->nMem+1;
        int j, op;
        for(j=0; j<n; j++){
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,94        , pLevel->iIdxCur, j, r1+j);
        }
        pParse->nMem += n+1;
        op = pLevel->op==38      ?21         :24        ;
        addrSeek = sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v, op, pLevel->iIdxCur, 0, r1, n);
if(op==21)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(op==24)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,9       , 1, pLevel->p2);
      }


      if( pLevel->addrCont ) sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrCont);
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v, pLevel->op, pLevel->p1, pLevel->p2, pLevel->p3);
      sqlite3VdbeChangeP5(v, pLevel->p5);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(pLevel->op==39)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(pLevel->op==38)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(pLevel->op==63)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      if( pLevel->regBignull ){
        sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrBignull);
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,61              , pLevel->regBignull, pLevel->p2-1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      }

      if( addrSeek ) sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addrSeek);

    }else if( pLevel->addrCont ){
      sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrCont);
    }
    if( (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000800    )!=0 && pLevel->u.in.nIn>0 ){
      struct InLoop *pIn;
      int j;
      sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrNxt);
      for(j=pLevel->u.in.nIn, pIn=&pLevel->u.in.aInLoop[j-1]; j>0; j--, pIn--){
        assert( sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v, pIn->addrInTop+1)->opcode==50
                 || pParse->db->mallocFailed );
        sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, pIn->addrInTop+1);
        if( pIn->eEndLoopOp!=184     ){
          if( pIn->nPrefix ){
            int bEarlyOut =
                (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000400         )==0
                 && (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00040000        )!=0;
            if( pLevel->iLeftJoin ){








              sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,25           , pIn->iCur,
                  sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v) + 2 + bEarlyOut);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
            }
            if( bEarlyOut ){
              sqlite3VdbeAddOp4Int(v,26          , pLevel->iIdxCur,
                  sqlite3VdbeCurrentAddr(v)+2,
                  pIn->iBase, pIn->nPrefix);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);




              sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, pIn->addrInTop+1);
            }
          }
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v, pIn->eEndLoopOp, pIn->iCur, pIn->addrInTop);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(pIn->eEndLoopOp==38)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
if(pIn->eEndLoopOp==39)sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
        }
        sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, pIn->addrInTop-1);
      }
    }
    sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pLevel->addrBrk);
    if( pLevel->pRJ ){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,67        , pLevel->pRJ->regReturn, 0, 1);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    }
    if( pLevel->addrSkip ){
      sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, pLevel->addrSkip);
sqlite3VdbeComment (v, "next skip-scan on %s", pLoop->u.btree.pIndex->zName);
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, pLevel->addrSkip);
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, pLevel->addrSkip-2);
    }

    if( pLevel->addrLikeRep ){
      sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,61              , (int)(pLevel->iLikeRepCntr>>1),
                        pLevel->addrLikeRep);
sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
    }

    if( pLevel->iLeftJoin ){
      int ws = pLoop->wsFlags;
      addr = sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,59       , pLevel->iLeftJoin);sqlite3VdbeSetLineNumber(v,__LINE__);
      assert( (ws &0x00000040     )==0 || (ws &0x00000200    )!=0 );
      if( (ws &0x00000040     )==0 ){
        assert( pLevel->iTabCur==pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom].iCursor );
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,136        , pLevel->iTabCur);
      }
      if( (ws &0x00000200    )
       || ((ws &0x00002000     ) && pLevel->u.pCoveringIdx)
      ){
        if( ws &0x00002000      ){
          Index *pIx = pLevel->u.pCoveringIdx;
          int iDb = sqlite3SchemaToIndex(db, pIx->pSchema);
          sqlite3VdbeAddOp3(v,101          , pLevel->iIdxCur, pIx->tnum, iDb);
          sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo(pParse, pIx);
        }
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp1(v,136        , pLevel->iIdxCur);
      }
      if( pLevel->op==67        ){
        sqlite3VdbeAddOp2(v,10       , pLevel->p1, pLevel->addrFirst);
      }else{
        sqlite3VdbeGoto(v, pLevel->addrFirst);
      }
      sqlite3VdbeJumpHere(v, addr);
    }
sqlite3VdbeNoopComment (v, "End WHERE-loop%d: %s", i, 
pWInfo->pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom].pTab->zName)                      ;
  }

  assert( pWInfo->nLevel<=pTabList->nSrc );
  for(i=0, pLevel=pWInfo->a; i<pWInfo->nLevel; i++, pLevel++){
    int k, last;
    VdbeOp *pOp, *pLastOp;
    Index *pIdx = 0;
    SrcItem *pTabItem = &pTabList->a[pLevel->iFrom];
    Table *pTab = pTabItem->pTab;
    assert( pTab!=0 );
    pLoop = pLevel->pWLoop;





    if( pLevel->pRJ ){
      sqlite3WhereRightJoinLoop(pWInfo, i, pLevel);
      continue;
    }





    if( pTabItem->fg.viaCoroutine ){
if( pParse->db->mallocFailed ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      translateColumnToCopy(pParse, pLevel->addrBody, pLevel->iTabCur,
                            pTabItem->regResult, 0);
      continue;
    }












    if( pLoop->wsFlags & (0x00000200   |0x00000040    ) ){
      pIdx = pLoop->u.btree.pIndex;
    }else if( pLoop->wsFlags &0x00002000      ){
      pIdx = pLevel->u.pCoveringIdx;
    }
    if( pIdx
     && !db->mallocFailed
    ){
      if( pWInfo->eOnePass==0           || !(((pIdx->pTable)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)){
        last = iEnd;
      }else{
        last = pWInfo->iEndWhere;
      }
      if( pIdx->bHasExpr ){
        IndexedExpr *p = pParse->pIdxEpr;
        while( p ){
          if( p->iIdxCur==pLevel->iIdxCur ){

            if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x200 ){
printf                          ("Disable pParse->pIdxEpr term {%d,%d}\n",
                                  p->iIdxCur, p->iIdxCol);
              if( sqlite3WhereTrace & 0x5000 ) sqlite3ShowExpr(p->pExpr);
            }

            p->iDataCur = -1;
            p->iIdxCur = -1;
          }
          p = p->pIENext;
        }
      }
      k = pLevel->addrBody + 1;

      if( db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32) ){
        printf("TRANSLATE opcodes in range %d..%d\n", k, last-1);
      }

      pOp = sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v, k - 1);
      assert( pOp->opcode!=94        || pOp->p1!=pLevel->iTabCur );
      assert( pOp->opcode!=135       || pOp->p1!=pLevel->iTabCur );
      assert( pOp->opcode!=20           || pOp->p1!=pLevel->iTabCur );

      pOp = sqlite3VdbeGetOp(v, k);
      pLastOp = pOp + (last - k);
      assert( pOp<=pLastOp );
      do{
        if( pOp->p1!=pLevel->iTabCur ){

        }else if( pOp->opcode==94

         || pOp->opcode==93

        ){
          int x = pOp->p2;
          assert( pIdx->pTable==pTab );

          if( pOp->opcode==93        ){

          }else

          if( !(((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)){
            Index *pPk = sqlite3PrimaryKeyIndex(pTab);
            x = pPk->aiColumn[x];
            assert( x>=0 );
          }else{
if( x!=(x) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; } ;
            x =(x)                                 ;
          }
          x = sqlite3TableColumnToIndex(pIdx, x);
          if( x>=0 ){
            pOp->p2 = x;
            pOp->p1 = pLevel->iIdxCur;
                                          ;
          }else{





            assert( (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000040     )==0
                 || cursorIsOpen(v,pOp->p1,k)
                 || pOp->opcode==93
            );

            assert( (pLoop->wsFlags &0x00000040     )==0
                 || cursorIsOpen(v,pOp->p1,k)
            );

          }
        }else if( pOp->opcode==135      ){
          pOp->p1 = pLevel->iIdxCur;
          pOp->opcode =142         ;
                                        ;
        }else if( pOp->opcode==20           ){
          pOp->p1 = pLevel->iIdxCur;
                                        ;
        }

        k++;

      }while( (++pOp)<pLastOp );

      if( db->flags &((u64)(0x0800000)<<32) ) printf("TRANSLATE complete\n");

    }
  }




  sqlite3VdbeResolveLabel(v, pWInfo->iBreak);



  pParse->nQueryLoop = pWInfo->savedNQueryLoop;
  whereInfoFree(db, pWInfo);
  pParse->withinRJSubrtn -= nRJ;
  return;
}





















































































































































static void row_numberStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  i64 *p = (i64*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ) (*p)++;
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
}
static void row_numberValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  i64 *p = (i64*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
sqlite3_api->result_int64(pCtx,(p?*p : 0));
}





struct CallCount {
  i64 nValue;
  i64 nStep;
  i64 nTotal;
};







static void dense_rankStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ) p->nStep = 1;
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
}
static void dense_rankValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    if( p->nStep ){
      p->nValue++;
      p->nStep = 0;
    }
sqlite3_api->result_int64(pCtx,p->nValue);
  }
}






struct NthValueCtx {
  i64 nStep;
  sqlite3_value *pValue;
};
static void nth_valueStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct NthValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct NthValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    i64 iVal;
    switch(sqlite3_api->value_numeric_type(apArg[1])){
      case 1             :
        iVal =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apArg[1]);
        break;
      case 2           : {
sqlite_int64   fVal =sqlite3_api->value_double(apArg[1]);
        if( ((i64)fVal)!=fVal ) goto error_out;
        iVal = (i64)fVal;
        break;
      }
      default:
        goto error_out;
    }
    if( iVal<=0 ) goto error_out;

    p->nStep++;
    if( iVal==p->nStep ){
      p->pValue =sqlite3_api->value_dup(apArg[0]);
      if( !p->pValue ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem   (pCtx);
      }
    }
  }
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
  return;

 error_out:
sqlite3_api->result_error(
      pCtx, "second argument to nth_value must be a positive integer", -1
  );
}
static void nth_valueFinalizeFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct NthValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct NthValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,0);
  if( p && p->pValue ){
sqlite3_api->result_value(pCtx,p->pValue);
sqlite3_api->value_free(p->pValue);
    p->pValue = 0;
  }
}



static void first_valueStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct NthValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct NthValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p && p->pValue==0 ){
    p->pValue =sqlite3_api->value_dup(apArg[0]);
    if( !p->pValue ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (pCtx);
    }
  }
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
}
static void first_valueFinalizeFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct NthValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct NthValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p && p->pValue ){
sqlite3_api->result_value(pCtx,p->pValue);
sqlite3_api->value_free(p->pValue);
    p->pValue = 0;
  }
}









static void rankStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    p->nStep++;
    if( p->nValue==0 ){
      p->nValue = p->nStep;
    }
  }
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
}
static void rankValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64(pCtx,p->nValue);
    p->nValue = 0;
  }
}







static void percent_rankStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
(void)(nArg)            ; assert( nArg==0 );
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    p->nTotal++;
  }
}
static void percent_rankInvFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
(void)(nArg)            ; assert( nArg==0 );
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  p->nStep++;
}
static void percent_rankValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    p->nValue = p->nStep;
    if( p->nTotal>1 ){
sqlite_int64 r = (sqlite_int64)p->nValue/(sqlite_int64)(p->nTotal-1);
sqlite3_api->result_double (pCtx, r);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_double (pCtx, 0.0);
    }
  }
}

  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
(void)(nArg)            ; assert( nArg==0 );
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    p->nTotal++;
  }
}

  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct CallCount *p;
(void)(nArg)            ; assert( nArg==0 );
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  p->nStep++;
}
static void cume_distValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct CallCount *p;
  p = (struct CallCount*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,0);
  if( p ){
sqlite_int64 r=(sqlite_int64)(p->nStep)/(sqlite_int64)(p->nTotal);
sqlite3_api->result_double(pCtx,r);
  }
}





struct NtileCtx {
  i64 nTotal;
  i64 nParam;
  i64 iRow;
};







static void ntileStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct NtileCtx *p;
  assert( nArg==1 );(void)(nArg)           ;
  p = (struct NtileCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
    if( p->nTotal==0 ){
      p->nParam =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apArg[0]);
      if( p->nParam<=0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error   (
            pCtx, "argument of ntile must be a positive integer", -1
        );
      }
    }
    p->nTotal++;
  }
}
static void ntileInvFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct NtileCtx *p;
  assert( nArg==1 );(void)(nArg)           ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct NtileCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  p->iRow++;
}
static void ntileValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct NtileCtx *p;
  p = (struct NtileCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p && p->nParam>0 ){
    int nSize = (p->nTotal / p->nParam);
    if( nSize==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64 (pCtx, p->iRow+1);
    }else{
      i64 nLarge = p->nTotal - p->nParam*nSize;
      i64 iSmall = nLarge*(nSize+1);
      i64 iRow = p->iRow;

      assert( (nLarge*(nSize+1) + (p->nParam-nLarge)*nSize)==p->nTotal );

      if( iRow<iSmall ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64   (pCtx, 1 + iRow/(nSize+1));
      }else{
sqlite3_api->result_int64   (pCtx, 1 + nLarge + (iRow-iSmall)/nSize);
      }
    }
  }
}





struct LastValueCtx {
  sqlite3_value *pVal;
  int nVal;
};




static void last_valueStepFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct LastValueCtx *p;
(void)(nArg)            ;
  p = (struct LastValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->value_free(p->pVal);
    p->pVal =sqlite3_api->value_dup(apArg[0]);
    if( p->pVal==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (pCtx);
    }else{
      p->nVal++;
    }
  }
}
static void last_valueInvFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  struct LastValueCtx *p;
(void)(nArg)            ;
(void)(apArg)            ;
  p = (struct LastValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if((1)        ){
    p->nVal--;
    if( p->nVal==0 ){
sqlite3_api->value_free (p->pVal);
      p->pVal = 0;
    }
  }
}
static void last_valueValueFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct LastValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct LastValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,0);
  if( p && p->pVal ){
sqlite3_api->result_value(pCtx,p->pVal);
  }
}
static void last_valueFinalizeFunc(sqlite3_context *pCtx){
  struct LastValueCtx *p;
  p = (struct LastValueCtx*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(pCtx,sizeof(*p));
  if( p && p->pVal ){
sqlite3_api->result_value(pCtx,p->pVal);
sqlite3_api->value_free(p->pVal);
    p->pVal = 0;
  }
}

  static FuncDef aWindowFuncs[] = {
{ 0, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, row_numberStepFunc, row_numberValueFunc, row_numberValueFunc, noopStepFunc, row_numberName, {0} },

{ 0, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, cume_distStepFunc, cume_distValueFunc, cume_distValueFunc, cume_distInvFunc, cume_distName, {0} },
{ 1, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, ntileStepFunc, ntileValueFunc, ntileValueFunc, ntileInvFunc, ntileName, {0} },
{ 1, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, last_valueStepFunc, last_valueFinalizeFunc, last_valueValueFunc, last_valueInvFunc, last_valueName, {0} },
{ 2, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, nth_valueStepFunc, nth_valueFinalizeFunc, noopValueFunc, noopStepFunc, nth_valueName, {0} },
{ 1, (0x00800000|1|0x00010000|0), 0, 0, first_valueStepFunc, first_valueFinalizeFunc, noopValueFunc, noopStepFunc, first_valueName, {0} },
