      return i;
    }
    case 1       : {
      for(i=1; aiClass[z[i]]<=2      ; i++){}
      if(((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)z[i]]&0x46)!=0)){



        i++;
        break;
      }
      *tokenType =59    ;
      return keywordCode((char*)z, i, tokenType);
    }
    case 0   : {

if( z[0]=='x' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };if( z[0]=='X' ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
      if( z[1]=='\'' ){
        *tokenType =154     ;
        for(i=2;(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(z[i])]&0x08);i++){}
        if( z[i]!='\'' || i%2 ){
          *tokenType =184        ;
          while( z[i] && z[i]!='\'' ){ i++; }
        }
        if( z[i] ) i++;
        return i;
      }



__attribute__((fallthrough));
    }
    case 2      :
    case 27   : {
      i = 1;
      break;
    }
    case 30    : {
      if( z[1]==0xbb && z[2]==0xbf ){
        *tokenType =183      ;
        return 3;
      }
      i = 1;
      break;
    }
    case 29    : {
      *tokenType =184        ;
      return 0;
    }
    default: {
      *tokenType =184        ;
      return 1;
    }
  }
  while(((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)z[i]]&0x46)!=0)){i++;}
  *tokenType =59    ;
  return i;
}




static         int sqlite3RunParser(Parse *pParse, const char *zSql){
  int nErr = 0;
  void *pEngine;
  int n = 0;
  int tokenType;
  int lastTokenParsed = -1;
  sqlite3 *db = pParse->db;
  int mxSqlLen;
  Parse *pParentParse = 0;

  yyParser sEngine;

u8 startedWithOom = db->mallocFailed              ;

  assert( zSql!=0 );
  mxSqlLen = db->aLimit[1                      ];
  if( db->nVdbeActive==0 ){
__atomic_store_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),(0),__ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  }
  pParse->rc =0         ;
  pParse->zTail = zSql;

  if( db->flags &((u64)(0x2000000)<<32)){
    printf("parser: [[[%s]]]\n", zSql);
    sqlite3ParserTrace(stdout, "parser: ");
  }else{
    sqlite3ParserTrace(0, 0);
  }


  pEngine = &sEngine;
  sqlite3ParserInit(pEngine, pParse);

  pEngine = sqlite3ParserAlloc(sqlite3Malloc, pParse);
  if( pEngine==0 ){
    sqlite3OomFault(db);
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }

  assert( pParse->pNewTable==0 );
  assert( pParse->pNewTrigger==0 );
  assert( pParse->nVar==0 );
  assert( pParse->pVList==0 );
  pParentParse = db->pParse;
  db->pParse = pParse;
  while( 1 ){
    n = sqlite3GetToken((u8*)zSql, &tokenType);
    mxSqlLen -= n;
    if( mxSqlLen<0 ){
      pParse->rc =18            ;
      pParse->nErr++;
      break;
    }

    if( tokenType>=164       ){
      assert( tokenType==183      || tokenType==165     || tokenType==166
           || tokenType==184        || tokenType==164
      );

    if( tokenType>=183      ){
      assert( tokenType==183      || tokenType==184        );

      if(__atomic_load_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),__ATOMIC_RELAXED)){
        pParse->rc =9                ;
        pParse->nErr++;
        break;
      }
      if( tokenType==183      ){
        zSql += n;
        continue;
      }
      if( zSql[0]==0 ){


        if( lastTokenParsed==1       ){
          tokenType = 0;
        }else if( lastTokenParsed==0 ){
          break;
        }else{
          tokenType =1       ;
        }
        n = 0;

      }else if( tokenType==164       ){
        assert( n==6 );
        tokenType = analyzeWindowKeyword((const u8*)&zSql[6]);
      }else if( tokenType==165     ){
        assert( n==4 );
        tokenType = analyzeOverKeyword((const u8*)&zSql[4], lastTokenParsed);
      }else if( tokenType==166       ){
        assert( n==6 );
        tokenType = analyzeFilterKeyword((const u8*)&zSql[6], lastTokenParsed);

      }else{
        Token x;
        x.z = zSql;
        x.n = n;
        sqlite3ErrorMsg(pParse, "unrecognized token: \"%T\"", &x);
        break;
      }
    }
    pParse->sLastToken.z = zSql;
    pParse->sLastToken.n = n;
    sqlite3Parser(pEngine, tokenType, pParse->sLastToken);
    lastTokenParsed = tokenType;
    zSql += n;
    assert( db->mallocFailed==0 || pParse->rc!=0         || startedWithOom );
    if( pParse->rc!=0         ) break;
  }
  assert( nErr==0 );

                                           ;
  sqlite3StatusHighwater(6                         ,
      sqlite3ParserStackPeak(pEngine)
  );
                                           ;


  sqlite3ParserFinalize(pEngine);

  sqlite3ParserFree(pEngine,sqlite3_api->free);

  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    pParse->rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  if( pParse->zErrMsg || (pParse->rc!=0         && pParse->rc!=101        ) ){
    if( pParse->zErrMsg==0 ){
      pParse->zErrMsg = sqlite3MPrintf(db, "%s", sqlite3ErrStr(pParse->rc));
    }
sqlite3_api->log(pParse->rc,"%s in \"%s\"", pParse->zErrMsg, pParse->zTail);
    nErr++;
  }
  pParse->zTail = zSql;

sqlite3_api->free(pParse->apVtabLock);


  if( pParse->pNewTable && !0                ){




    sqlite3DeleteTable(db, pParse->pNewTable);
  }
  if( pParse->pNewTrigger && !0                ){
                                                 ;
  }
  if( pParse->pVList ) sqlite3DbNNFreeNN(db, pParse->pVList);
  db->pParse = pParentParse;
  assert( nErr==0 || pParse->rc!=0         );
  return nErr;
}







static void addSpaceSeparator(sqlite3_str *pStr){
  if( pStr->nChar && sqlite3IsIdChar(pStr->zText[pStr->nChar-1]) ){
sqlite3_api->str_append(pStr," ", 1);
  }
}






static         char *sqlite3Normalize(
  Vdbe *pVdbe,
  const char *zSql
){
  sqlite3 *db;
  int i;
  int n;
  int tokenType;
  int prevType = 0;
  int nParen;
  int iStartIN;
  int nParenAtIN;
  u32 j;
  sqlite3_str *pStr;

  db = sqlite3VdbeDb(pVdbe);
  tokenType = -1;
  nParen = iStartIN = nParenAtIN = 0;
  pStr =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
  assert( pStr!=0 );
  for(i=0; zSql[i] && pStr->accError==0; i+=n){
    if( tokenType!=183      ){
      prevType = tokenType;
    }
    n = sqlite3GetToken((unsigned char*)zSql+i, &tokenType);
    if((0)          ) break;
    switch( tokenType ){
      case 183     : {
        break;
      }
      case 121    : {
        if( prevType==45    || prevType==19     ){
sqlite3_api->str_append     (pStr, " NULL", 5);
          break;
        }

      }
      case 117      :
      case 155       :
      case 153     :
      case 156        :
      case 154    : {
sqlite3_api->str_append   (pStr, "?", 1);
        break;
      }
      case 22   : {
        nParen++;
        if( prevType==49    ){
          iStartIN = pStr->nChar;
          nParenAtIN = nParen;
        }
sqlite3_api->str_append   (pStr, "(", 1);
        break;
      }
      case 23   : {
        if( iStartIN>0 && nParen==nParenAtIN ){
          assert( pStr->nChar>=(u32)iStartIN );
          pStr->nChar = iStartIN+1;
sqlite3_api->str_append     (pStr, "?,?,?", 5);
          iStartIN = 0;
        }
        nParen--;
sqlite3_api->str_append   (pStr, ")", 1);
        break;
      }
      case 59   : {
        iStartIN = 0;
        j = pStr->nChar;
        if((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(zSql[i])]&0x80)){
          char *zId = sqlite3DbStrNDup(db, zSql+i, n);
          int nId;
          int eType = 0;
          if( zId==0 ) break;
          sqlite3Dequote(zId);
          if( zSql[i]=='"' && sqlite3VdbeUsesDoubleQuotedString(pVdbe, zId) ){
sqlite3_api->str_append       (pStr, "?", 1);
            sqlite3DbFree(db, zId);
            break;
          }
          nId = sqlite3Strlen30(zId);
          if( sqlite3GetToken((u8*)zId, &eType)==nId && eType==59    ){
            addSpaceSeparator(pStr);
sqlite3_api->str_append       (pStr, zId, nId);
          }else{
sqlite3_api->str_appendf       (pStr, "\"%w\"", zId);
          }
          sqlite3DbFree(db, zId);
        }else{
          addSpaceSeparator(pStr);
sqlite3_api->str_append     (pStr, zSql+i, n);
        }
        while( j<pStr->nChar ){
          pStr->zText[j] =(sqlite3UpperToLower[(unsigned char)(pStr->zText[j])]);
          j++;
        }
        break;
      }
      case 138      : {
        iStartIN = 0;

      }
      default: {
        if( sqlite3IsIdChar(zSql[i]) ) addSpaceSeparator(pStr);
        j = pStr->nChar;
sqlite3_api->str_append   (pStr, zSql+i, n);
        while( j<pStr->nChar ){
          pStr->zText[j] =((pStr->zText[j])&~(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(pStr->zText[j])]&0x20));
          j++;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if( tokenType!=1       )sqlite3_api->str_append(pStr,";",1);
  return sqlite3_api->str_finish(pStr);
}

           int sqlite3_api->complete(const char*zSql){
  u8 state = 0;
  u8 token;





  static const u8 trans[8][8] = {


                      {    1,  0,     2,       3,      4,    2,       2,   2, },
                      {    1,  1,     2,       3,      4,    2,       2,   2, },
                      {    1,  2,     2,       2,      2,    2,       2,   2, },
                      {    1,  3,     3,       2,      4,    2,       2,   2, },
                      {    1,  4,     2,       2,      2,    4,       5,   2, },
                      {    6,  5,     5,       5,      5,    5,       5,   5, },
                      {    6,  6,     5,       5,      5,    5,       5,   7, },
                      {    1,  7,     5,       5,      5,    5,       5,   5, },
  };




  static const u8 trans[3][3] = {


                      {    1,  0,     2, },
                      {    1,  1,     2, },
                      {    1,  2,     2, },
  };



  if( zSql==0 ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }


  while( *zSql ){
    switch( *zSql ){
      case ';': {
        token =0      ;
        break;
      }
      case ' ':
      case '\r':
      case '\t':
      case '\n':
      case '\f': {
        token =1    ;
        break;
      }
      case '/': {
        if( zSql[1]!='*' ){
          token =2       ;
          break;
        }
        zSql += 2;
        while( zSql[0] && (zSql[0]!='*' || zSql[1]!='/') ){ zSql++; }
        if( zSql[0]==0 ) return 0;
        zSql++;
        token =1    ;
        break;
      }
      case '-': {
        if( zSql[1]!='-' ){
          token =2       ;
          break;
        }
        while( *zSql && *zSql!='\n' ){ zSql++; }
        if( *zSql==0 ) return state==1;
        token =1    ;
        break;
      }
      case '[': {
        zSql++;
        while( *zSql && *zSql!=']' ){ zSql++; }
        if( *zSql==0 ) return 0;
        token =2       ;
        break;
      }
      case '`':
      case '"':
      case '\'': {
        int c = *zSql;
        zSql++;
        while( *zSql && *zSql!=c ){ zSql++; }
        if( *zSql==0 ) return 0;
        token =2       ;
        break;
      }
      default: {

        unsigned char c;

        if(((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(u8)*zSql]&0x46)!=0)){

          int nId;
          for(nId=1;((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)zSql[nId]]&0x46)!=0);nId++){}

          token =2       ;

          switch( *zSql ){
            case 'c': case 'C': {
              if( nId==6 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"create",6)==0){
                token =4        ;
              }else{
                token =2       ;
              }
              break;
            }
            case 't': case 'T': {
              if( nId==7 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"trigger",7)==0){
                token =6         ;
              }else if( nId==4 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"temp",4)==0){
                token =5      ;
              }else if( nId==9 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"temporary",9)==0){
                token =5      ;
              }else{
                token =2       ;
              }
              break;
            }
            case 'e':  case 'E': {
              if( nId==3 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"end",3)==0){
                token =7     ;
              }else

              if( nId==7 &&sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zSql,"explain",7)==0){
                token =3         ;
              }else

              {
                token =2       ;
              }
              break;
            }
            default: {
              token =2       ;
              break;
            }
          }

          zSql += nId-1;
        }else{

          token =2       ;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    state = trans[state][token];
    zSql++;
  }
  return state==1;
}







           int sqlite3_api->complete16(const void*zSql){
  sqlite3_value *pVal;
  char const *zSql8;
  int rc;


  rc = sqlite3_initialize();
  if( rc ) return rc;

  pVal = sqlite3ValueNew(0);
  sqlite3ValueSetStr(pVal, -1, zSql,3                  ,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
  zSql8 = sqlite3ValueText(pVal,1           );
  if( zSql8 ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->complete(zSql8);
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  sqlite3ValueFree(pVal);
  return rc & 0xff;
}

  }

           int sqlite3_shutdown(void){

  int rc = sqlite3_wsd_init(4096, 24);
  if( rc!=0         ){
    return rc;
  }


  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isInit){

    void SQLITE_EXTRA_SHUTDOWN(void);
    SQLITE_EXTRA_SHUTDOWN();

    sqlite3_os_end();
sqlite3_api->reset_auto_extension();
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isInit=0;
  }
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isPCacheInit){
    sqlite3PcacheShutdown();
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isPCacheInit=0;
  }
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isMallocInit){
    sqlite3MallocEnd();
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isMallocInit=0;









    sqlite3_data_directory = 0;
    sqlite3_temp_directory = 0;

  }
  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isMutexInit){
                     ;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isMutexInit=0;
  }

  return 0        ;
}










           int sqlite3_config(int op, ...){
  va_list ap;
  int rc =0         ;



  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).isInit)return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

  va_start(ap, op);
  switch( op ){





    case 1                         : {


(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex=0;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bFullMutex=0;
      break;
    }


    case 2                        : {


(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex=1;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bFullMutex=0;
      break;
    }


    case 3                       : {


(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex=1;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bFullMutex=1;
      break;
    }


    case 10                 : {

(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mutex=*va_arg(ap,sqlite3_mutex_methods*);
      break;
    }


    case 11                    : {

      *va_arg(ap, sqlite3_mutex_methods*) =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mutex;
      break;
    }


    case 4                   : {





(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m=*va_arg(ap,sqlite3_mem_methods*);
      break;
    }
    case 5                      : {




      if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m.xMalloc==0)sqlite3MemSetDefault();
      *va_arg(ap, sqlite3_mem_methods*) =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m;
      break;
    }
    case 9                      : {



(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bMemstat=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }
    case 27                        : {
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bSmallMalloc=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }
    case 7                      : {




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pPage=va_arg(ap,void*);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szPage=va_arg(ap,int);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nPage=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }
    case 24                        : {




      *va_arg(ap, int*) =
          sqlite3HeaderSizeBtree() +
          sqlite3HeaderSizePcache() +
          sqlite3HeaderSizePcache1();
      break;
    }

    case 14                  : {

      break;
    }
    case 15                     : {

      rc =1            ;
      break;
    }

    case 18                   : {




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2=*va_arg(ap,sqlite3_pcache_methods2*);
      break;
    }
    case 19                      : {




      if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2.xInit==0){
        sqlite3PCacheSetDefault();
      }
      *va_arg(ap, sqlite3_pcache_methods2*) =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pcache2;
      break;
    }





    case 8                 : {




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pHeap=va_arg(ap,void*);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nHeap=va_arg(ap,int);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mnReq=va_arg(ap,int);

      if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mnReq<1){
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mnReq=1;
      }else if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mnReq>(1<<12)){

(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mnReq=(1<<12);
      }

      if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pHeap==0){








        memset(&(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m,0,sizeof((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m));
      }else{




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m=*sqlite3MemGetMemsys3();


(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).m=*sqlite3MemGetMemsys5();

      }
      break;
    }


    case 13                     : {
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szLookaside=va_arg(ap,int);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nLookaside=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }





    case 16               : {




      typedef void(*LOGFUNC_t)(void*,int,const char*);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog=va_arg(ap,LOGFUNC_t);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pLogArg=va_arg(ap,void*);
      break;
    }






    case 17               : {




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bOpenUri=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }

    case 20                               : {




(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bUseCis=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }


    case 21                  : {
      typedef void(*SQLLOGFUNC_t)(void*, sqlite3*, const char*, int);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xSqllog=va_arg(ap,SQLLOGFUNC_t);
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pSqllogArg=va_arg(ap,void*);
      break;
    }


    case 22                     : {




      sqlite3_int64 szMmap = va_arg(ap, sqlite3_int64);
      sqlite3_int64 mxMmap = va_arg(ap, sqlite3_int64);








      if( mxMmap<0 || mxMmap>0                    ){
        mxMmap =0                    ;
      }
      if( szMmap<0 ) szMmap =0                        ;
      if( szMmap>mxMmap) szMmap = mxMmap;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMmap=mxMmap;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szMmap=szMmap;
      break;
    }


    case 23                          : {



(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nHeap=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }


    case 25                 : {
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szPma=va_arg(ap,unsigned int);
      break;
    }

    case 26                          : {
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nStmtSpill=va_arg(ap,int);
      break;
    }


    case 28                          : {
      int iVal = va_arg(ap, int);
      if( iVal<0 ){
        iVal =0x7fffffff                    ;
      }
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szSorterRef=(u32)iVal;
      break;
    }



    case 29                         : {
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).mxMemdbSize=va_arg(ap,sqlite3_int64);
      break;
    }


    default: {
      rc =1            ;
      break;
    }
  }
  va_end(ap);
  return rc;
}












static int setupLookaside(sqlite3 *db, void *pBuf, int sz, int cnt){

  void *pStart;
  sqlite3_int64 szAlloc = sz*(sqlite3_int64)cnt;
  int nBig;
  int nSm;

  if( sqlite3LookasideUsed(db,0)>0 ){
    return 5          ;
  }




  if( db->lookaside.bMalloced ){
sqlite3_api->free(db->lookaside.pStart);
  }



  sz =((sz)&~7)      ;
  if( sz<=(int)sizeof(LookasideSlot*) ) sz = 0;
  if( cnt<0 ) cnt = 0;
  if( sz==0 || cnt==0 ){
    sz = 0;
    pStart = 0;
  }else if( pBuf==0 ){
                              ;
    pStart = sqlite3Malloc( szAlloc );
                            ;
    if( pStart ) szAlloc = sqlite3MallocSize(pStart);
  }else{
    pStart = pBuf;
  }

  if( sz>=0              *3 ){
    nBig = szAlloc/(3*0              +sz);
    nSm = (szAlloc - sz*nBig)/0              ;
  }else if( sz>=0              *2 ){
    nBig = szAlloc/(0              +sz);
    nSm = (szAlloc - sz*nBig)/0              ;
  }else

  if( sz>0 ){
    nBig = szAlloc/sz;
    nSm = 0;
  }else{
    nBig = nSm = 0;
  }
  db->lookaside.pStart = pStart;
  db->lookaside.pInit = 0;
  db->lookaside.pFree = 0;
  db->lookaside.sz = (u16)sz;
  db->lookaside.szTrue = (u16)sz;
  if( pStart ){
    int i;
    LookasideSlot *p;
    assert( sz > (int)sizeof(LookasideSlot*) );
    p = (LookasideSlot*)pStart;
    for(i=0; i<nBig; i++){
      p->pNext = db->lookaside.pInit;
      db->lookaside.pInit = p;
      p = (LookasideSlot*)&((u8*)p)[sz];
    }

    db->lookaside.pSmallInit = 0;
    db->lookaside.pSmallFree = 0;
    db->lookaside.pMiddle = p;
    for(i=0; i<nSm; i++){
      p->pNext = db->lookaside.pSmallInit;
      db->lookaside.pSmallInit = p;
      p = (LookasideSlot*)&((u8*)p)[0              ];
    }

    assert( ((uptr)p)<=szAlloc + (uptr)pStart );
    db->lookaside.pEnd = p;
    db->lookaside.bDisable = 0;
    db->lookaside.bMalloced = pBuf==0 ?1:0;
    db->lookaside.nSlot = nBig+nSm;
  }else{
    db->lookaside.pStart = 0;

    db->lookaside.pSmallInit = 0;
    db->lookaside.pSmallFree = 0;
    db->lookaside.pMiddle = 0;

    db->lookaside.pEnd = 0;
    db->lookaside.bDisable = 1;
    db->lookaside.sz = 0;
    db->lookaside.bMalloced = 0;
    db->lookaside.nSlot = 0;
  }
  db->lookaside.pTrueEnd = db->lookaside.pEnd;
  assert( sqlite3LookasideUsed(db,0)==0 );

  return 0        ;
}




           sqlite3_mutex *sqlite3_api->db_mutex(sqlite3*db){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  return db->mutex;
}





           int sqlite3_api->db_release_memory(sqlite3*db){
  int i;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
                          ;
  for(i=0; i<db->nDb; i++){
    Btree *pBt = db->aDb[i].pBt;
    if( pBt ){
      Pager *pPager = sqlite3BtreePager(pBt);
      sqlite3PagerShrink(pPager);
    }
  }
                          ;
                                ;
  return 0        ;
}





           int sqlite3_api->db_cacheflush(sqlite3*db){
  int i;
  int rc =0         ;
  int bSeenBusy = 0;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
                          ;
  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<db->nDb; i++){
    Btree *pBt = db->aDb[i].pBt;
    if( pBt && sqlite3BtreeTxnState(pBt)==2                ){
      Pager *pPager = sqlite3BtreePager(pBt);
      rc = sqlite3PagerFlush(pPager);
      if( rc==5           ){
        bSeenBusy = 1;
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
  }
                          ;
                                ;
  return ((rc==0         && bSeenBusy) ?5            : rc);
}




           int sqlite3_api->db_config(sqlite3*db,int op,...){
  va_list ap;
  int rc;
                                ;
  va_start(ap, op);
  switch( op ){
    case 1000                      : {


      db->aDb[0].zDbSName = va_arg(ap,char*);
      rc =0         ;
      break;
    }
    case 1001                     : {
      void *pBuf = va_arg(ap, void*);
      int sz = va_arg(ap, int);
      int cnt = va_arg(ap, int);
      rc = setupLookaside(db, pBuf, sz, cnt);
      break;
    }
    default: {
      static const struct {
        int op;
        u32 mask;
      } aFlagOp[] = {
        {1002                        ,0x00004000                       },
        {1003                           ,0x00040000                    },
        {1015                        ,0x80000000                       },
        {1004                                  ,0x00400000             },
        {1005                                  ,0x00010000             },
        {1006                             ,0x00000800                  },
        {1007                        ,0x00800000                       },
        {1008                        ,0x01000000                       },
        {1009                           ,0x02000000                    },
        {1010                      ,0x10000000                         },
        {1011                            ,0x00000001               |
0x08000000                                                             },
        {1012                               ,0x04000000                },
        {1014                    ,0x20000000                           },
        {1013                    ,0x40000000                           },
        {1016                               ,0x00000002                },
        {1017                           ,0x00000080                    },
      };
      unsigned int i;
      rc =1            ;
      for(i=0; i<((int)(sizeof(aFlagOp)/sizeof(aFlagOp[0])));i++){
        if( aFlagOp[i].op==op ){
          int onoff = va_arg(ap, int);
          int *pRes = va_arg(ap, int*);
          u64 oldFlags = db->flags;
          if( onoff>0 ){
            db->flags |= aFlagOp[i].mask;
          }else if( onoff==0 ){
            db->flags &= ~(u64)aFlagOp[i].mask;
          }
          if( oldFlags!=db->flags ){
            sqlite3ExpirePreparedStatements(db, 0);
          }
          if( pRes ){
            *pRes = (db->flags & aFlagOp[i].mask)!=0;
          }
          rc =0         ;
          break;
        }
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  va_end(ap);
                                ;
  return rc;
}





static int binCollFunc(
  void *NotUsed,
  int nKey1, const void *pKey1,
  int nKey2, const void *pKey2
){
  int rc, n;
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  n = nKey1<nKey2 ? nKey1 : nKey2;



  assert( pKey1 && pKey2 );
  rc = memcmp(pKey1, pKey2, n);
  if( rc==0 ){
    rc = nKey1 - nKey2;
  }
  return rc;
}





static int rtrimCollFunc(
  void *pUser,
  int nKey1, const void *pKey1,
  int nKey2, const void *pKey2
){
  const u8 *pK1 = (const u8*)pKey1;
  const u8 *pK2 = (const u8*)pKey2;
  while( nKey1 && pK1[nKey1-1]==' ' ) nKey1--;
  while( nKey2 && pK2[nKey2-1]==' ' ) nKey2--;
  return binCollFunc(pUser, nKey1, pKey1, nKey2, pKey2);
}




static         int sqlite3IsBinary(const CollSeq *p){
  assert( p==0 || p->xCmp!=binCollFunc || strcmp(p->zName,"BINARY")==0 );
  return p==0 || p->xCmp==binCollFunc;
}










static int nocaseCollatingFunc(
  void *NotUsed,
  int nKey1, const void *pKey1,
  int nKey2, const void *pKey2
){
  int r =sqlite3_api->strnicmp(
      (const char *)pKey1, (const char *)pKey2, (nKey1<nKey2)?nKey1:nKey2);
(void)(NotUsed)            ;
  if( 0==r ){
    r = nKey1-nKey2;
  }
  return r;
}

static         void sqlite3CloseSavepoints(sqlite3 *db){
  while( db->pSavepoint ){
    Savepoint *pTmp = db->pSavepoint;
    db->pSavepoint = pTmp->pNext;
    sqlite3DbFree(db, pTmp);
  }
  db->nSavepoint = 0;
  db->nStatement = 0;
  db->isTransactionSavepoint = 0;
}







static void functionDestroy(sqlite3 *db, FuncDef *p){
  FuncDestructor *pDestructor;
  assert( (p->funcFlags &0x00800000          )==0 );
  pDestructor = p->u.pDestructor;
  if( pDestructor ){
    pDestructor->nRef--;
    if( pDestructor->nRef==0 ){
      pDestructor->xDestroy(pDestructor->pUserData);
      sqlite3DbFree(db, pDestructor);
    }
  }
}





static void disconnectAllVtab(sqlite3 *db){

  int i;
  HashElem *p;
                          ;
  for(i=0; i<db->nDb; i++){
    Schema *pSchema = db->aDb[i].pSchema;
    if( pSchema ){
      for(p=((&pSchema->tblHash)->first)      ; p; p=((p)->next)      ){
        Table *pTab = (Table *)((p)->data)      ;
        if(((pTab)->eTabType==1))sqlite3VtabDisconnect(db,pTab);
      }
    }
  }
  for(p=((&db->aModule)->first)      ; p; p=((p)->next)      ){
    Module *pMod = (Module *)((p)->data)      ;
    if( pMod->pEpoTab ){
      sqlite3VtabDisconnect(db, pMod->pEpoTab);
    }
  }
                           ;
                          ;

(void)(db)            ;

}





static int connectionIsBusy(sqlite3 *db){
  int j;
  assert(((void)(db->mutex),1)          );
  if( db->pVdbe ) return 1;
  for(j=0; j<db->nDb; j++){
    Btree *pBt = db->aDb[j].pBt;
    if( pBt && sqlite3BtreeIsInBackup(pBt) ) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}




static int sqlite3Close(sqlite3 *db, int forceZombie){
  if( !db ){


    return 0        ;
  }
  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
                                ;
  if( db->mTrace &0x08                ){
    db->trace.xV2(0x08              , db->pTraceArg, db, 0);
  }


  disconnectAllVtab(db);








                         ;




  if( !forceZombie && connectionIsBusy(db) ){
    sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db,5           , "unable to close due to unfinalized "
       "statements or unfinished backups");
                                  ;
    return 5          ;
  }


  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xSqllog){

(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xSqllog((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pSqllogArg,db,0,2);
  }




  db->eOpenState =0xa7                ;
  sqlite3LeaveMutexAndCloseZombie(db);
  return 0        ;
}





           int sqlite3_api->txn_state(sqlite3*db,const char*zSchema){
  int iDb, nDb;
  int iTxn = -1;

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return -1;
  }

                                ;
  if( zSchema ){
    nDb = iDb = sqlite3FindDbName(db, zSchema);
    if( iDb<0 ) nDb--;
  }else{
    iDb = 0;
    nDb = db->nDb-1;
  }
  for(; iDb<=nDb; iDb++){
    Btree *pBt = db->aDb[iDb].pBt;
    int x = pBt!=0 ? sqlite3BtreeTxnState(pBt) :0               ;
    if( x>iTxn ) iTxn = x;
  }
                                ;
  return iTxn;
}










           int sqlite3_api->close(sqlite3*db){return sqlite3Close(db,0);}
           int sqlite3_api->close_v2(sqlite3*db){return sqlite3Close(db,1);}










static         void sqlite3LeaveMutexAndCloseZombie(sqlite3 *db){
  HashElem *i;
  int j;





  if( db->eOpenState!=0xa7                || connectionIsBusy(db) ){
                                  ;
    return;
  }











  sqlite3RollbackAll(db,0         );


  sqlite3CloseSavepoints(db);


  for(j=0; j<db->nDb; j++){
    struct Db *pDb = &db->aDb[j];
    if( pDb->pBt ){
      sqlite3BtreeClose(pDb->pBt);
      pDb->pBt = 0;
      if( j!=1 ){
        pDb->pSchema = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  if( db->aDb[1].pSchema ){
    sqlite3SchemaClear(db->aDb[1].pSchema);
  }
                           ;


  sqlite3CollapseDatabaseArray(db);
  assert( db->nDb<=2 );
  assert( db->aDb==db->aDbStatic );




                             ;

  for(i=((&db->aFunc)->first)      ; i; i=((i)->next)      ){
    FuncDef *pNext, *p;
    p =((i)->data)       ;
    do{
      functionDestroy(db, p);
      pNext = p->pNext;
      sqlite3DbFree(db, p);
      p = pNext;
    }while( p );
  }
  sqlite3HashClear(&db->aFunc);
  for(i=((&db->aCollSeq)->first)      ; i; i=((i)->next)      ){
    CollSeq *pColl = (CollSeq *)((i)->data)      ;

    for(j=0; j<3; j++){
      if( pColl[j].xDel ){
        pColl[j].xDel(pColl[j].pUser);
      }
    }
    sqlite3DbFree(db, pColl);
  }
  sqlite3HashClear(&db->aCollSeq);

  for(i=((&db->aModule)->first)      ; i; i=((i)->next)      ){
    Module *pMod = (Module *)((i)->data)      ;
    sqlite3VtabEponymousTableClear(db, pMod);
                                    ;
  }
  sqlite3HashClear(&db->aModule);


  sqlite3Error(db,0         );
  sqlite3ValueFree(db->pErr);
                            ;

sqlite3_api->free(db->auth.zAuthUser);
sqlite3_api->free(db->auth.zAuthPW);


  db->eOpenState =0xd5               ;







  sqlite3DbFree(db, db->aDb[1].pSchema);
  if( db->xAutovacDestr ){
    db->xAutovacDestr(db->pAutovacPagesArg);
  }
                                ;
  db->eOpenState =0xce                ;
                               ;
  assert( sqlite3LookasideUsed(db,0)==0 );
  if( db->lookaside.bMalloced ){
sqlite3_api->free(db->lookaside.pStart);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(db);
}








static         void sqlite3RollbackAll(sqlite3 *db, int tripCode){
  int i;
  int inTrans = 0;
  int schemaChange;
  assert(((void)(db->mutex),1)          );
                            ;







                          ;
  schemaChange = (db->mDbFlags &0x0001              )!=0 && db->init.busy==0;

  for(i=0; i<db->nDb; i++){
    Btree *p = db->aDb[i].pBt;
    if( p ){
      if( sqlite3BtreeTxnState(p)==2                ){
        inTrans = 1;
      }
      sqlite3BtreeRollback(p, tripCode, !schemaChange);
    }
  }
                         ;
                          ;

  if( schemaChange ){
    sqlite3ExpirePreparedStatements(db, 0);
    sqlite3ResetAllSchemasOfConnection(db);
  }
                          ;


  db->nDeferredCons = 0;
  db->nDeferredImmCons = 0;
  db->flags &= ~(u64)(0x00080000     |((u64)(0x00002)<<32));


  if( db->xRollbackCallback && (inTrans || !db->autoCommit) ){
    db->xRollbackCallback(db->pRollbackArg);
  }
}

static         const char *sqlite3ErrStr(int rc){
  static const char* const aMsg[] = {
                             "not an error",
                             "SQL logic error",
                             0,
                             "access permission denied",
                             "query aborted",
                             "database is locked",
                             "database table is locked",
                             "out of memory",
                             "attempt to write a readonly database",
                             "interrupted",
                             "disk I/O error",
                             "database disk image is malformed",
                             "unknown operation",
                             "database or disk is full",
                             "unable to open database file",
                             "locking protocol",
                             0,
                             "database schema has changed",
                             "string or blob too big",
                             "constraint failed",
                             "datatype mismatch",
                             "bad parameter or other API misuse",

                             "large file support is disabled",

                             0,

                             "authorization denied",
                             0,
                             "column index out of range",
                             "file is not a database",
                             "notification message",
                             "warning message",
  };
  const char *zErr = "unknown error";
  switch( rc ){
    case(4 | (2<<8))          : {
      zErr = "abort due to ROLLBACK";
      break;
    }
    case 100       : {
      zErr = "another row available";
      break;
    }
    case 101        : {
      zErr = "no more rows available";
      break;
    }
    default: {
      rc &= 0xff;
      if((1)            && rc<((int)(sizeof(aMsg)/sizeof(aMsg[0])))&&aMsg[rc]!=0){
        zErr = aMsg[rc];
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  return zErr;
}










static int sqliteDefaultBusyCallback(
  void *ptr,
  int count
){



  static const u8 delays[] =
     { 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 25,  25,  50,  50, 100 };
  static const u8 totals[] =
     { 0, 1, 3,  8, 18, 33, 53, 78, 103, 128, 178, 228 };

  sqlite3 *db = (sqlite3 *)ptr;
  int tmout = db->busyTimeout;
  int delay, prior;

  assert( count>=0 );
  if( count <((int)(sizeof(delays)/sizeof(delays[0])))){
    delay = delays[count];
    prior = totals[count];
  }else{
    delay = delays[((int)(sizeof(delays)/sizeof(delays[0])))-1];
    prior = totals[((int)(sizeof(delays)/sizeof(delays[0])))-1]+delay*(count-(((int)(sizeof(delays)/sizeof(delays[0])))-1));
  }
  if( prior + delay > tmout ){
    delay = tmout - prior;
    if( delay<=0 ) return 0;
  }
  sqlite3OsSleep(db->pVfs, delay*1000);
  return 1;



  sqlite3 *db = (sqlite3 *)ptr;
  int tmout = ((sqlite3 *)ptr)->busyTimeout;
  if( (count+1)*1000 > tmout ){
    return 0;
  }
  sqlite3OsSleep(db->pVfs, 1000000);
  return 1;

}










static         int sqlite3InvokeBusyHandler(BusyHandler *p){
  int rc;
  if( p->xBusyHandler==0 || p->nBusy<0 ) return 0;
  rc = p->xBusyHandler(p->pBusyArg, p->nBusy);
  if( rc==0 ){
    p->nBusy = -1;
  }else{
    p->nBusy++;
  }
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3_api->busy_handler(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int (*xBusy)(void*,int),
  void *pArg
){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
  db->busyHandler.xBusyHandler = xBusy;
  db->busyHandler.pBusyArg = pArg;
  db->busyHandler.nBusy = 0;
  db->busyTimeout = 0;
                                ;
  return 0        ;
}







           void sqlite3_api->progress_handler(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int nOps,
  int (*xProgress)(void*),
  void *pArg
){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return;
  }

                                ;
  if( nOps>0 ){
    db->xProgress = xProgress;
    db->nProgressOps = (unsigned)nOps;
    db->pProgressArg = pArg;
  }else{
    db->xProgress = 0;
    db->nProgressOps = 0;
    db->pProgressArg = 0;
  }
                                ;
}







           int sqlite3_api->busy_timeout(sqlite3*db,int ms){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

  if( ms>0 ){
sqlite3_api->busy_handler(db,(int(*)(void*,int))sqliteDefaultBusyCallback,
                             (void*)db);
    db->busyTimeout = ms;
  }else{
sqlite3_api->busy_handler(db,0, 0);
  }
  return 0        ;
}




           void sqlite3_api->interruptx(sqlite3*db){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db)
   && (db==0 || db->eOpenState!=0xa7               )
  ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return;
  }

__atomic_store_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),(1),__ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}





           int sqlite3_api->is_interrupted(sqlite3*db){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db)
   && (db==0 || db->eOpenState!=0xa7               )
  ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

  return __atomic_load_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),__ATOMIC_RELAXED)!=0;
}







static         int sqlite3CreateFunc(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zFunctionName,
  int nArg,
  int enc,
  void *pUserData,
  void (*xSFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xValue)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xInverse)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  FuncDestructor *pDestructor
){
  FuncDef *p;
  int extraFlags;

  assert(((void)(db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( xValue==0 || xSFunc==0 );
  if( zFunctionName==0
   || (xSFunc!=0 && xFinal!=0)
   || ((xFinal==0)!=(xStep==0))
   || ((xValue==0)!=(xInverse==0))
   || (nArg<-1 || nArg>127                    )
   || (255<sqlite3Strlen30(zFunctionName))
  ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

  assert(0x0800               ==0x000000800          );
  assert(0x00080000         ==0x000080000       );
  extraFlags = enc &  (0x000000800         |0x000080000      |
0x000100000                          |0x000200000     );
  enc &= (0x0003             |5         );



  assert(0x00200000         ==0x000200000      );
  extraFlags ^=0x00200000         ;










  switch( enc ){
    case 4           :
      enc =3                  ;
      break;
    case 5         : {
      int rc;
      rc = sqlite3CreateFunc(db, zFunctionName, nArg,
           (1          |extraFlags)^0x00200000        ,
           pUserData, xSFunc, xStep, xFinal, xValue, xInverse, pDestructor);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = sqlite3CreateFunc(db, zFunctionName, nArg,
             (2             |extraFlags)^0x00200000        ,
             pUserData, xSFunc, xStep, xFinal, xValue, xInverse, pDestructor);
      }
      if( rc!=0         ){
        return rc;
      }
      enc =3              ;
      break;
    }
    case 1          :
    case 2             :
    case 3             :
      break;
    default:
      enc =1           ;
      break;
  }

  enc =1           ;







  p = sqlite3FindFunction(db, zFunctionName, nArg, (u8)enc, 0);
  if( p && (p->funcFlags &0x0003              )==(u32)enc && p->nArg==nArg ){
    if( db->nVdbeActive ){
      sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db,5           ,
        "unable to delete/modify user-function due to active statements");
      assert( !db->mallocFailed );
      return 5          ;
    }else{
      sqlite3ExpirePreparedStatements(db, 0);
    }
  }else if( xSFunc==0 && xFinal==0 ){


    return 0        ;
  }

  p = sqlite3FindFunction(db, zFunctionName, nArg, (u8)enc, 1);
  assert(p || db->mallocFailed);
  if( !p ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }



  functionDestroy(db, p);

  if( pDestructor ){
    pDestructor->nRef++;
  }
  p->u.pDestructor = pDestructor;
  p->funcFlags = (p->funcFlags &0x0003              ) | extraFlags;
if( p->funcFlags & 0x000000800 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( p->funcFlags & 0x000080000 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  p->xSFunc = xSFunc ? xSFunc : xStep;
  p->xFinalize = xFinal;
  p->xValue = xValue;
  p->xInverse = xInverse;
  p->pUserData = pUserData;
  p->nArg = (u16)nArg;
  return 0        ;
}








static int createFunctionApi(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zFunc,
  int nArg,
  int enc,
  void *p,
  void (*xSFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xValue)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xInverse)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void(*xDestroy)(void*)
){
  int rc =1            ;
  FuncDestructor *pArg = 0;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

                                ;
  if( xDestroy ){
    pArg = (FuncDestructor *)sqlite3Malloc(sizeof(FuncDestructor));
    if( !pArg ){
      sqlite3OomFault(db);
      xDestroy(p);
      goto out;
    }
    pArg->nRef = 0;
    pArg->xDestroy = xDestroy;
    pArg->pUserData = p;
  }
  rc = sqlite3CreateFunc(db, zFunc, nArg, enc, p,
      xSFunc, xStep, xFinal, xValue, xInverse, pArg
  );
  if( pArg && pArg->nRef==0 ){
    assert( rc!=0         || (xStep==0 && xFinal==0) );
    xDestroy(p);
sqlite3_api->free(pArg);
  }

 out:
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
                                ;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_api->create_function(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zFunc,
  int nArg,
  int enc,
  void *p,
  void (*xSFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*)
){
  return createFunctionApi(db, zFunc, nArg, enc, p, xSFunc, xStep,
                                    xFinal, 0, 0, 0);
}
           int sqlite3_api->create_function_v2(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zFunc,
  int nArg,
  int enc,
  void *p,
  void (*xSFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xDestroy)(void *)
){
  return createFunctionApi(db, zFunc, nArg, enc, p, xSFunc, xStep,
                                    xFinal, 0, 0, xDestroy);
}
           int sqlite3_api->create_window_function(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zFunc,
  int nArg,
  int enc,
  void *p,
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xValue)(sqlite3_context*),
  void (*xInverse)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value **),
  void (*xDestroy)(void *)
){
  return createFunctionApi(db, zFunc, nArg, enc, p, 0, xStep,
                                    xFinal, xValue, xInverse, xDestroy);
}


           int sqlite3_api->create_function16(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const void *zFunctionName,
  int nArg,
  int eTextRep,
  void *p,
  void (*xSFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*)
){
  int rc;
  char *zFunc8;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) || zFunctionName==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
  assert( !db->mallocFailed );
  zFunc8 = sqlite3Utf16to8(db, zFunctionName, -1,3                  );
  rc = sqlite3CreateFunc(db, zFunc8, nArg, eTextRep, p, xSFunc,xStep,xFinal,0,0,0);
  sqlite3DbFree(db, zFunc8);
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
                                ;
  return rc;
}











static void sqlite3InvalidFunction(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int NotUsed,
  sqlite3_value **NotUsed2
){
  const char *zName = (const char*)sqlite3_api->user_data(context);
  char *zErr;
(void)(NotUsed),(void)(NotUsed2)      ;
  zErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
      "unable to use function %s in the requested context", zName);
sqlite3_api->result_error(context,zErr,-1);
sqlite3_api->free(zErr);
}













           int sqlite3_api->overload_function(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zName,
  int nArg
){
  int rc;
  char *zCopy;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) || zName==0 || nArg<-2 ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

                                ;
  rc = sqlite3FindFunction(db, zName, nArg,1           , 0)!=0;
                                ;
  if( rc ) return 0        ;
  zCopy =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",zName);
  if( zCopy==0 ) return 7           ;
  return sqlite3_api->create_function_v2(db,zName,nArg,1        ,
                           zCopy, sqlite3InvalidFunction, 0, 0,sqlite3_api->free);
}











           void *sqlite3_api->trace(sqlite3*db,void(*xTrace)(void*,const char*),void*pArg){
  void *pOld;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

                                ;
  pOld = db->pTraceArg;
  db->mTrace = xTrace ?0x40                 : 0;
  db->trace.xLegacy = xTrace;
  db->pTraceArg = pArg;
                                ;
  return pOld;
}




           int sqlite3_api->trace_v2(
  sqlite3 *db,
  unsigned mTrace,
  int(*xTrace)(unsigned,void*,void*,void*),
  void *pArg
){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }

                                ;
  if( mTrace==0 ) xTrace = 0;
  if( xTrace==0 ) mTrace = 0;
  db->mTrace = mTrace;
  db->trace.xV2 = xTrace;
  db->pTraceArg = pArg;
                                ;
  return 0        ;
}










           void *sqlite3_api->profile(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void (*xProfile)(void*,const char*,sqlite_uint64),
  void *pArg
){
  void *pOld;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return 0;
  }

                                ;
  pOld = db->pProfileArg;
  db->xProfile = xProfile;
  db->pProfileArg = pArg;
  db->mTrace &=0x0f                        ;
  if( db->xProfile ) db->mTrace |=0x80                  ;
                                ;
  return pOld;
}








           void *sqlite3_api->commit_hook(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int (*xCallback)(void*),
  void *pArg
){
  void *pOld;

  }

                                ;
  pOld = db->pCommitArg;
  db->xCommitCallback = xCallback;
  db->pCommitArg = pArg;
                                ;
  return pOld;
}

           int sqlite3_api->wal_checkpoint_v2(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zDb,
  int eMode,
  int *pnLog,
  int *pnCkpt
){

  return 0        ;

  int rc;
  int iDb;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);



  if( pnLog ) *pnLog = -1;
  if( pnCkpt ) *pnCkpt = -1;

  assert(0                         ==0 );
  assert(1                      ==1 );
  assert(2                         ==2 );
  assert(3                          ==3 );
  if( eMode<0                         || eMode>3                          ){


    return 21           ;
  }

                                ;
  if( zDb && zDb[0] ){
    iDb = sqlite3FindDbName(db, zDb);
  }else{
    iDb =(10 +2)       ;
  }
  if( iDb<0 ){
    rc =1            ;
    sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db,1            , "unknown database: %s", zDb);
  }else{
    db->busyHandler.nBusy = 0;
    rc = sqlite3Checkpoint(db, iDb, eMode, pnLog, pnCkpt);
    sqlite3Error(db, rc);
  }
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);



  if( db->nVdbeActive==0 ){
__atomic_store_n((&db->u1.isInterrupted),(0),__ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  }

                                ;
  return rc;

}







           int sqlite3_api->wal_checkpoint(sqlite3*db,const char*zDb){


  return sqlite3_api->wal_checkpoint_v2(db,zDb,0                   ,0,0);
}






















static         int sqlite3Checkpoint(sqlite3 *db, int iDb, int eMode, int *pnLog, int *pnCkpt){
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;
  int bBusy = 0;

  assert(((void)(db->mutex),1)          );
  assert( !pnLog || *pnLog==-1 );
  assert( !pnCkpt || *pnCkpt==-1 );
if( iDb==10 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( iDb==(10 +2) ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };

  for(i=0; i<db->nDb && rc==0        ; i++){
    if( i==iDb || iDb==(10 +2)       ){
      rc = sqlite3BtreeCheckpoint(db->aDb[i].pBt, eMode, pnLog, pnCkpt);
      pnLog = 0;
      pnCkpt = 0;
      if( rc==5           ){
        bBusy = 1;
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
  }

  return (rc==0         && bBusy) ?5            : rc;
}

(void)(db)            ;

(void)(db)            ;
  return 0;

}





           const char *sqlite3_api->errmsg(sqlite3*db){
  const char *z;
  if( !db ){
    return sqlite3ErrStr(sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__));
  }
  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3ErrStr(sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__));
  }
                                ;
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    z = sqlite3ErrStr(sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__));
  }else{
if( db->pErr==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    z = db->errCode ? (char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(db->pErr):0;
    assert( !db->mallocFailed );
    if( z==0 ){
      z = sqlite3ErrStr(db->errCode);
    }
  }
                                ;
  return z;
}




           int sqlite3_api->error_offset(sqlite3*db){
  int iOffset = -1;
  if( db && sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) && db->errCode ){
                                  ;
    iOffset = db->errByteOffset;
                                  ;
  }
  return iOffset;
}






           const void *sqlite3_api->errmsg16(sqlite3*db){
  static const u16 outOfMem[] = {
    'o', 'u', 't', ' ', 'o', 'f', ' ', 'm', 'e', 'm', 'o', 'r', 'y', 0
  };
  static const u16 misuse[] = {
    'b', 'a', 'd', ' ', 'p', 'a', 'r', 'a', 'm', 'e', 't', 'e', 'r', ' ',
    'o', 'r', ' ', 'o', 't', 'h', 'e', 'r', ' ', 'A', 'P', 'I', ' ',
    'm', 'i', 's', 'u', 's', 'e', 0
  };

  const void *z;
  if( !db ){
    return (void *)outOfMem;
  }
  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) ){
    return (void *)misuse;
  }
                                ;
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    z = (void *)outOfMem;
  }else{
    z =sqlite3_api->value_text16(db->pErr);
    if( z==0 ){
      sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db, db->errCode, sqlite3ErrStr(db->errCode));
      z =sqlite3_api->value_text16(db->pErr);
    }





    sqlite3OomClear(db);
  }
                                ;
  return z;
}






           int sqlite3_api->errcode(sqlite3*db){
  if( db && !sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
  if( !db || db->mallocFailed ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  return db->errCode & db->errMask;
}
           int sqlite3_api->extended_errcode(sqlite3*db){
  if( db && !sqlite3SafetyCheckSickOrOk(db) ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }
  if( !db || db->mallocFailed ){
    return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  return db->errCode;
}
           int sqlite3_api->system_errno(sqlite3*db){
  return db ? db->iSysErrno : 0;
}

}





static int createCollation(
  sqlite3* db,
  const char *zName,
  u8 enc,
  void* pCtx,
  int(*xCompare)(void*,int,const void*,int,const void*),
  void(*xDel)(void*)
){
  CollSeq *pColl;
  int enc2;

  assert(((void)(db->mutex),1)          );





  enc2 = enc;
if( enc2==4 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( enc2==8 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( enc2==4            || enc2==8                    ){
    enc2 =3                  ;
  }
  if( enc2<1           || enc2>3              ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }





  pColl = sqlite3FindCollSeq(db, (u8)enc2, zName, 0);
  if( pColl && pColl->xCmp ){
    if( db->nVdbeActive ){
      sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db,5           ,
        "unable to delete/modify collation sequence due to active statements");
      return 5          ;
    }
    sqlite3ExpirePreparedStatements(db, 0);







    if( (pColl->enc & ~8                   )==enc2 ){
      CollSeq *aColl = sqlite3HashFind(&db->aCollSeq, zName);
      int j;
      for(j=0; j<3; j++){
        CollSeq *p = &aColl[j];
        if( p->enc==pColl->enc ){
          if( p->xDel ){
            p->xDel(p->pUser);
          }
          p->xCmp = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  pColl = sqlite3FindCollSeq(db, (u8)enc2, zName, 1);
  if( pColl==0 ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  pColl->xCmp = xCompare;
  pColl->pUser = pCtx;
  pColl->xDel = xDel;
  pColl->enc = (u8)(enc2 | (enc &8                    ));
  sqlite3Error(db,0         );
  return 0        ;
}







static const int aHardLimit[] = {
1000000000         ,
1000000000             ,
2000               ,
1000                   ,
500                         ,
250000000           ,
127                      ,
10                   ,
50000                           ,
32766                       ,
1000                      ,
0                          ,
};

















































           int sqlite3_api->limit(sqlite3*db,int limitId,int newLimit){
  int oldLimit;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ){
    (void)sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
    return -1;
  }







  assert( aHardLimit[0                  ]==1000000000        );
  assert( aHardLimit[1                      ]==1000000000            );
  assert( aHardLimit[2                  ]==2000              );
  assert( aHardLimit[3                      ]==1000                  );
  assert( aHardLimit[4                           ]==500                       );
  assert( aHardLimit[5                   ]==250000000          );
  assert( aHardLimit[6                        ]==127                     );
  assert( aHardLimit[7                    ]==10                  );
  assert( aHardLimit[8                               ]==
50000                                                                         );
  assert( aHardLimit[9                           ]==32766                     );
  assert( aHardLimit[10                        ]==1000                     );
  assert( aHardLimit[11                         ]==0                         );
  assert(11                          ==((11 +1)       -1) );


  if( limitId<0 || limitId>=(11 +1)        ){
    return -1;
  }
  oldLimit = db->aLimit[limitId];
  if( newLimit>=0 ){
    if( newLimit>aHardLimit[limitId] ){
      newLimit = aHardLimit[limitId];
    }else if( newLimit<1 && limitId==0                   ){
      newLimit = 1;
    }
    db->aLimit[limitId] = newLimit;
  }
  return oldLimit;
}



























static         int sqlite3ParseUri(
  const char *zDefaultVfs,
  const char *zUri,
  unsigned int *pFlags,
  sqlite3_vfs **ppVfs,
  char **pzFile,
  char **pzErrMsg
){
  int rc =0         ;
  unsigned int flags = *pFlags;
  const char *zVfs = zDefaultVfs;
  char *zFile;
  char c;
  int nUri = sqlite3Strlen30(zUri);

  assert( *pzErrMsg==0 );

  if( ((flags &0x00000040      )
            ||(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bOpenUri)
   && nUri>=5 && memcmp(zUri, "file:", 5)==0
  ){
    char *zOpt;
    int eState;
    int iIn;
    int iOut = 0;
    u64 nByte = nUri+8;



    flags |=0x00000040      ;

    for(iIn=0; iIn<nUri; iIn++) nByte += (zUri[iIn]=='&');
    zFile =sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
    if( !zFile ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);

    memset(zFile, 0, 4);
    zFile += 4;

    iIn = 5;

    if( strncmp(zUri+5, "///", 3)==0 ){
      iIn = 7;





      if( strncmp(zUri+7, "///", 3)==0 ){ iIn++; }
    }else if( strncmp(zUri+5, "//localhost/", 12)==0 ){
      iIn = 16;
    }


    if( zUri[5]=='/' && zUri[6]=='/' ){
      iIn = 7;
      while( zUri[iIn] && zUri[iIn]!='/' ) iIn++;
      if( iIn!=7 && (iIn!=16 || memcmp("localhost", &zUri[7], 9)) ){
        *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("invalid uri authority: %.*s",
            iIn-7, &zUri[7]);
        rc =1            ;
        goto parse_uri_out;
      }
    }












    eState = 0;
    while( (c = zUri[iIn])!=0 && c!='#' ){
      iIn++;
      if( c=='%'
       &&(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(zUri[iIn])]&0x08)
       &&(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(zUri[iIn+1])]&0x08)
      ){
        int octet = (sqlite3HexToInt(zUri[iIn++]) << 4);
        octet += sqlite3HexToInt(zUri[iIn++]);

        assert( octet>=0 && octet<256 );
        if( octet==0 ){





          while( (c = zUri[iIn])!=0 && c!='#'
              && (eState!=0 || c!='?')
              && (eState!=1 || (c!='=' && c!='&'))
              && (eState!=2 || c!='&')
          ){
            iIn++;
          }
          continue;


          *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("unexpected %%00 in uri");
          rc =1            ;
          goto parse_uri_out;

        }
        c = octet;
      }else if( eState==1 && (c=='&' || c=='=') ){
        if( zFile[iOut-1]==0 ){

          while( zUri[iIn] && zUri[iIn]!='#' && zUri[iIn-1]!='&' ) iIn++;
          continue;
        }
        if( c=='&' ){
          zFile[iOut++] = '\0';
        }else{
          eState = 2;
        }
        c = 0;
      }else if( (eState==0 && c=='?') || (eState==2 && c=='&') ){
        c = 0;
        eState = 1;
      }
      zFile[iOut++] = c;
    }
    if( eState==1 ) zFile[iOut++] = '\0';
    memset(zFile+iOut, 0, 4);





    zOpt = &zFile[sqlite3Strlen30(zFile)+1];
    while( zOpt[0] ){
      int nOpt = sqlite3Strlen30(zOpt);
      char *zVal = &zOpt[nOpt+1];
      int nVal = sqlite3Strlen30(zVal);

      if( nOpt==3 && memcmp("vfs", zOpt, 3)==0 ){
        zVfs = zVal;
      }else{
        struct OpenMode {
          const char *z;
          int mode;
        } *aMode = 0;
        char *zModeType = 0;
        int mask = 0;
        int limit = 0;

        if( nOpt==5 && memcmp("cache", zOpt, 5)==0 ){
          static struct OpenMode aCacheMode[] = {
            { "shared",0x00020000                },
            { "private",0x00040000                },
            { 0, 0 }
          };

          mask =0x00020000              |0x00040000              ;
          aMode = aCacheMode;
          limit = mask;
          zModeType = "cache";
        }
        if( nOpt==4 && memcmp("mode", zOpt, 4)==0 ){
          static struct OpenMode aOpenMode[] = {
            { "ro",0x00000001             },
            { "rw",0x00000002              },
            { "rwc",0x00000002             |0x00000004          },
            { "memory",0x00000080          },
            { 0, 0 }
          };

          mask =0x00000001            |0x00000002
                   |0x00000004          |0x00000080         ;
          aMode = aOpenMode;
          limit = mask & flags;
          zModeType = "access";
        }

        if( aMode ){
          int i;
          int mode = 0;
          for(i=0; aMode[i].z; i++){
            const char *z = aMode[i].z;
            if( nVal==sqlite3Strlen30(z) && 0==memcmp(zVal, z, nVal) ){
              mode = aMode[i].mode;
              break;
            }
          }
          if( mode==0 ){
            *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("no such %s mode: %s",zModeType,zVal);
            rc =1            ;
            goto parse_uri_out;
          }
          if( (mode & ~0x00000080        )>limit ){
            *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s mode not allowed: %s",
                                        zModeType, zVal);
            rc =3           ;
            goto parse_uri_out;
          }
          flags = (flags & ~mask) | mode;
        }
      }

      zOpt = &zVal[nVal+1];
    }

  }else{
    zFile =sqlite3_api->malloc64(nUri+8);
    if( !zFile ) return sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    memset(zFile, 0, 4);
    zFile += 4;
    if( nUri ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(zFile);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zUri); int xxn=(nUri);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }
    memset(zFile+nUri, 0, 4);
    flags &= ~0x00000040     ;
  }

  *ppVfs =sqlite3_api->vfs_find(zVfs);
  if( *ppVfs==0 ){
    *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("no such vfs: %s",zVfs);
    rc =1            ;
  }
 parse_uri_out:
  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->free_filename(zFile);
    zFile = 0;
  }
  *pFlags = flags;
  *pzFile = zFile;
  return rc;
}





static const char *uriParameter(const char *zFilename, const char *zParam){
  zFilename += sqlite3Strlen30(zFilename) + 1;
  while((1)                   && zFilename[0] ){
    int x = strcmp(zFilename, zParam);
    zFilename += sqlite3Strlen30(zFilename) + 1;
    if( x==0 ) return zFilename;
    zFilename += sqlite3Strlen30(zFilename) + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}








static int openDatabase(
  const char *zFilename,
  sqlite3 **ppDb,
  unsigned int flags,
  const char *zVfs
){
  sqlite3 *db;
  int rc;
  int isThreadsafe;
  char *zOpen = 0;
  char *zErrMsg = 0;
  int i;


  if( ppDb==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

  *ppDb = 0;

  rc = sqlite3_initialize();
  if( rc ) return rc;


  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex==0){
    isThreadsafe = 0;
  }else if( flags &0x00008000           ){
    isThreadsafe = 0;
  }else if( flags &0x00010000             ){
    isThreadsafe = 1;
  }else{
    isThreadsafe =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bFullMutex;
  }

  if( flags &0x00040000                ){
    flags &= ~0x00020000             ;
  }else if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).sharedCacheEnabled){
    flags |=0x00020000              ;
  }










  flags &=  ~(0x00000008                 |
0x00000010                           |
0x00000100                         |
0x00000200                         |
0x00000400                              |
0x00000800                              |
0x00001000                              |
0x00002000                            |
0x00004000                               |
0x00008000                         |
0x00010000                           |
0x00080000
             );


  db = sqlite3MallocZero( sizeof(sqlite3) );
  if( db==0 ) goto opendb_out;
  if( isThreadsafe

   ||(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bCoreMutex

  ){
    db->mutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                       ;
    if( db->mutex==0 ){
sqlite3_api->free (db);
      db = 0;
      goto opendb_out;
    }
    if( isThreadsafe==0 ){
                                             ;
    }
  }
                                ;
  db->errMask = (flags &0x02000000            )!=0 ? 0xffffffff : 0xff;
  db->nDb = 2;
  db->eOpenState =0x6d              ;
  db->aDb = db->aDbStatic;
  db->lookaside.bDisable = 1;
  db->lookaside.sz = 0;

  assert( sizeof(db->aLimit)==sizeof(aHardLimit) );
{char*xxd=(char*)(db->aLimit);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aHardLimit); int xxn=(sizeof(db->aLimit));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  db->aLimit[11                         ] =0                             ;
  db->autoCommit = 1;
  db->nextAutovac = -1;
  db->szMmap =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szMmap;
  db->nextPagesize = 0;
  db->init.azInit = sqlite3StdType;






  db->nMaxSorterMmap = 0x7FFFFFFF;

  db->flags |=0x00000040
                 |0x00040000
                 |0x80000000
                 |0x00000020

                 |0x00000080




















                 |0x40000000


                 |0x20000000



                 |0x00008000


                 |0x00000010


                 |0x00000002


                 |0x00010000


                 |0x00002000


                 |0x00004000


                 |0x00001000


                 |0x00200000


                 |0x00400000


                 |0x00800000


                 |0x10000000


                 |0x04000000

      ;
  sqlite3HashInit(&db->aCollSeq);

  sqlite3HashInit(&db->aModule);









  createCollation(db, sqlite3StrBINARY,1           , 0, binCollFunc, 0);
  createCollation(db, sqlite3StrBINARY,3              , 0, binCollFunc, 0);
  createCollation(db, sqlite3StrBINARY,2              , 0, binCollFunc, 0);
  createCollation(db, "NOCASE",1           , 0, nocaseCollatingFunc, 0);
  createCollation(db, "RTRIM",1           , 0, rtrimCollFunc, 0);
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    goto opendb_out;
  }



  if( zFilename && zFilename[0]==':' ){
    if( strcmp(zFilename, ":localStorage:")==0 ){
      zFilename = "file:local?vfs=kvvfs";
      flags |=0x00000040      ;
    }else if( strcmp(zFilename, ":sessionStorage:")==0 ){
      zFilename = "file:session?vfs=kvvfs";
      flags |=0x00000040      ;
    }
  }














  db->openFlags = flags;
  assert(0x00000001             == 0x01 );
  assert(0x00000002             == 0x02 );
  assert(0x00000004             == 0x04 );
if( (1<<(flags&7))==0x02 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( (1<<(flags&7))==0x04 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
if( (1<<(flags&7))==0x40 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if( ((1<<(flags&7)) & 0x46)==0 ){
    rc =sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }else{
    rc = sqlite3ParseUri(zVfs, zFilename, &flags, &db->pVfs, &zOpen, &zErrMsg);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ){
    if( rc==7            ) sqlite3OomFault(db);
    sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db, rc, zErrMsg ? "%s" : 0, zErrMsg);
sqlite3_api->free(zErrMsg);
    goto opendb_out;
  }
  assert( db->pVfs!=0 );

  if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(db->pVfs->zName,"kvvfs")==0){
    db->temp_store = 2;
  }



  rc = sqlite3BtreeOpen(db->pVfs, zOpen, db, &db->aDb[0].pBt, 0,
                        flags |0x00000100          );
  if( rc!=0         ){
    if( rc==(10 | (12<<8))     ){
      rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
    }
    sqlite3Error(db, rc);
    goto opendb_out;
  }
                                   ;
  db->aDb[0].pSchema = sqlite3SchemaGet(db, db->aDb[0].pBt);
  if( !db->mallocFailed ){
    sqlite3SetTextEncoding(db,((db)->aDb[0].pSchema->enc));
  }
                                   ;
  db->aDb[1].pSchema = sqlite3SchemaGet(db, 0);




  db->aDb[0].zDbSName = "main";
  db->aDb[0].safety_level =3                          +1;
  db->aDb[1].zDbSName = "temp";
  db->aDb[1].safety_level =0x01                  ;

  db->eOpenState =0x76              ;
  if( db->mallocFailed ){
    goto opendb_out;
  }





  sqlite3Error(db,0         );
  sqlite3RegisterPerConnectionBuiltinFunctions(db);
  rc =sqlite3_api->errcode(db);



  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<((int)(sizeof(sqlite3BuiltinExtensions)/sizeof(sqlite3BuiltinExtensions[0])));i++){
    rc = sqlite3BuiltinExtensions[i](db);
  }




  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3AutoLoadExtensions(db);
    rc =sqlite3_api->errcode(db);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto opendb_out;
    }
  }





  db->mDbFlags |=0x0020              ;







  db->dfltLockMode = SQLITE_DEFAULT_LOCKING_MODE;
  sqlite3PagerLockingMode(sqlite3BtreePager(db->aDb[0].pBt),
                          SQLITE_DEFAULT_LOCKING_MODE);


  if( rc ) sqlite3Error(db, rc);


  setupLookaside(db, 0,(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).szLookaside,
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).nLookaside);

sqlite3_api->wal_autocheckpoint(db,1000                           );

opendb_out:
  if( db ){
    assert( db->mutex!=0 || isThreadsafe==0
           ||(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).bFullMutex==0);
                                  ;
  }
  rc =sqlite3_api->errcode(db);
  assert( db!=0 || (rc&0xff)==7            );
  if( (rc&0xff)==7            ){
sqlite3_api->close(db);
    db = 0;
  }else if( rc!=0         ){
    db->eOpenState =0xba              ;
  }
  *ppDb = db;

  if((*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xSqllog){

    void *pArg =(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).pSqllogArg;
(*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xSqllog(pArg,db,zFilename,0);
  }

sqlite3_api->free_filename(zOpen);
  return rc;
}

           int sqlite3_api->open16(
  const void *zFilename,
  sqlite3 **ppDb
){
  char const *zFilename8;
  sqlite3_value *pVal;
  int rc;


  if( ppDb==0 ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

  *ppDb = 0;

  rc = sqlite3_initialize();
  if( rc ) return rc;

  if( zFilename==0 ) zFilename = "\000\000";
  pVal = sqlite3ValueNew(0);
  sqlite3ValueSetStr(pVal, -1, zFilename,3                  ,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
  zFilename8 = sqlite3ValueText(pVal,1           );
  if( zFilename8 ){
    rc = openDatabase(zFilename8, ppDb,
0x00000002                                  |0x00000004         , 0);
    assert( *ppDb || rc==7            );
    if( rc==0         && !(((*ppDb)->aDb[0].pSchema->schemaFlags&(0x0001))==(0x0001))){
((*ppDb)->aDb[0].pSchema->enc)=((*ppDb)->enc)=3          ;
    }
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3NomemError(__LINE__);
  }
  sqlite3ValueFree(pVal);

  return rc & 0xff;
}

static         int sqlite3ReportError(int iErr, int lineno, const char *zType){
sqlite3_api->log(iErr,"%s at line %d of [%.10s]",
              zType, lineno, 20 +sqlite3_api->sourceid());
  return iErr;
}
static         int sqlite3CorruptError(int lineno){
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError(11            , lineno, "database corruption");
}
static         int sqlite3MisuseError(int lineno){
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError(21           , lineno, "misuse");
}
static         int sqlite3CantopenError(int lineno){
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError(14             , lineno, "cannot open file");
}

static         int sqlite3CorruptPgnoError(int lineno, Pgno pgno){
  char zMsg[100];
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf(sizeof(zMsg),zMsg,"database corruption page %d",pgno);
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError(11            , lineno, zMsg);
}


static         int sqlite3NomemError(int lineno){
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError(7           , lineno, "OOM");
}
static         int sqlite3IoerrnomemError(int lineno){
if( (*(struct Sqlite3Config*)sqlite3_wsd_find((void*)&(sqlite3Config), sizeof(sqlite3Config))).xLog!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  return sqlite3ReportError((10 | (12<<8))    , lineno, "I/O OOM error");
}

           int sqlite3_api->table_column_metadata(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zDbName,
  const char *zTableName,
  const char *zColumnName,
  char const **pzDataType,
  char const **pzCollSeq,
  int *pNotNull,
  int *pPrimaryKey,
  int *pAutoinc
){
  int rc;
  char *zErrMsg = 0;
  Table *pTab = 0;
  Column *pCol = 0;
  int iCol = 0;
  char const *zDataType = 0;
  char const *zCollSeq = 0;
  int notnull = 0;
  int primarykey = 0;
  int autoinc = 0;



  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) || zTableName==0 ){
    return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);
  }



                                ;
                          ;
  rc = sqlite3Init(db, &zErrMsg);
  if(0         !=rc ){
    goto error_out;
  }


  pTab = sqlite3FindTable(db, zTableName, zDbName);
  if( !pTab ||((pTab)->eTabType==2)){
    pTab = 0;
    goto error_out;
  }


  if( zColumnName==0 ){

  }else{
    for(iCol=0; iCol<pTab->nCol; iCol++){
      pCol = &pTab->aCol[iCol];
      if( 0==sqlite3StrICmp(pCol->zCnName, zColumnName) ){
        break;
      }
    }
    if( iCol==pTab->nCol ){
      if((((pTab)->tabFlags & 0x00000080)==0)&&sqlite3IsRowid(zColumnName)){
        iCol = pTab->iPKey;
        pCol = iCol>=0 ? &pTab->aCol[iCol] : 0;
      }else{
        pTab = 0;
        goto error_out;
      }
    }
  }











  if( pCol ){
    zDataType = sqlite3ColumnType(pCol,0);
    zCollSeq = sqlite3ColumnColl(pCol);
    notnull = pCol->notNull!=0;
    primarykey  = (pCol->colFlags &0x0001          )!=0;
    autoinc = pTab->iPKey==iCol && (pTab->tabFlags &0x00000008       )!=0;
  }else{
    zDataType = "INTEGER";
    primarykey = 1;
  }
  if( !zCollSeq ){
    zCollSeq = sqlite3StrBINARY;
  }

error_out:
                          ;





  if( pzDataType ) *pzDataType = zDataType;
  if( pzCollSeq ) *pzCollSeq = zCollSeq;
  if( pNotNull ) *pNotNull = notnull;
  if( pPrimaryKey ) *pPrimaryKey = primarykey;
  if( pAutoinc ) *pAutoinc = autoinc;

  if(0         ==rc && !pTab ){
    sqlite3DbFree(db, zErrMsg);
    zErrMsg = sqlite3MPrintf(db, "no such table column: %s.%s", zTableName,
        zColumnName);
    rc =1            ;
  }
  sqlite3ErrorWithMsg(db, rc, (zErrMsg?"%s":0), zErrMsg);
  sqlite3DbFree(db, zErrMsg);
  rc = sqlite3ApiExit(db, rc);
                                ;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_api->sleep(int ms){
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs;
  int rc;
  pVfs =sqlite3_api->vfs_find(0);
  if( pVfs==0 ) return 0;




  rc = (sqlite3OsSleep(pVfs, 1000*ms)/1000);
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3_api->extended_result_codes(sqlite3*db,int onoff){

  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
  db->errMask = onoff ? 0xffffffff : 0xff;
                                ;
  return 0        ;
}




           int sqlite3_api->file_control(sqlite3*db,const char*zDbName,int op,void *pArg){
  int rc =1            ;
  Btree *pBtree;


  if( !sqlite3SafetyCheckOk(db) ) return sqlite3MisuseError(__LINE__);

                                ;
  pBtree = sqlite3DbNameToBtree(db, zDbName);
  if( pBtree ){
    Pager *pPager;
    sqlite3_file *fd;
                             ;
    pPager = sqlite3BtreePager(pBtree);
    assert( pPager!=0 );
    fd = sqlite3PagerFile(pPager);
    assert( fd!=0 );
    if( op==7                         ){
      *(sqlite3_file**)pArg = fd;
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( op==27                       ){
      *(sqlite3_vfs**)pArg = sqlite3PagerVfs(pPager);
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( op==28                           ){
      *(sqlite3_file**)pArg = sqlite3PagerJrnlFile(pPager);
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( op==35                        ){
      *(unsigned int*)pArg = sqlite3PagerDataVersion(pPager);
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( op==38                         ){
      int iNew = *(int*)pArg;
      *(int*)pArg = sqlite3BtreeGetRequestedReserve(pBtree);
      if( iNew>=0 && iNew<=255 ){
        sqlite3BtreeSetPageSize(pBtree, 0, iNew, 0);
      }
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( op==42                       ){
      sqlite3BtreeClearCache(pBtree);
      rc =0         ;
    }else{
      int nSave = db->busyHandler.nBusy;
      rc = sqlite3OsFileControl(fd, op, pArg);
      db->busyHandler.nBusy = nSave;
    }
                             ;
  }
                                ;
  return rc;
}

                                      unsigned char,unsigned char);

                                    ;

      *pn =0                                   ;

      break;
    }










    case 31                        : {
       int opTrace = va_arg(ap, int);
       u32 *ptr = va_arg(ap, u32*);
       switch( opTrace ){
         case 0:   *ptr = sqlite3TreeTrace;      break;
         case 1:   sqlite3TreeTrace = *ptr;      break;
         case 2:   *ptr = sqlite3WhereTrace;     break;
         case 3:   sqlite3WhereTrace = *ptr;     break;
       }
       break;
    }










    case 33                    : {
sqlite_int64 rIn = va_arg(ap,sqlite_int64);
      LogEst rLogEst = sqlite3LogEstFromDouble(rIn);
      int *pI1 = va_arg(ap,int*);
      u64 *pU64 = va_arg(ap,u64*);
      int *pI2 = va_arg(ap,int*);
      *pI1 = rLogEst;
