static int fts3PrefixCompress(
  const char *zPrev,
  int nPrev,
  const char *zNext,
  int nNext
){
  int n;
  for(n=0; n<nPrev && n<nNext && zPrev[n]==zNext[n]; n++);
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (n<nNext));
  return n;
}





static int fts3NodeAddTerm(
  Fts3Table *p,
  SegmentNode **ppTree,
  int isCopyTerm,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm
){
  SegmentNode *pTree = *ppTree;
  int rc;
  SegmentNode *pNew;




  if( pTree ){
    int nData = pTree->nData;
    int nReq = nData;
    int nPrefix;
    int nSuffix;

    nPrefix = fts3PrefixCompress(pTree->zTerm, pTree->nTerm, zTerm, nTerm);
    nSuffix = nTerm-nPrefix;




    if( nSuffix<=0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();

    nReq += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nPrefix)+sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nSuffix)+nSuffix;
    if( nReq<=p->nNodeSize || !pTree->zTerm ){

      if( nReq>p->nNodeSize ){







        assert( pTree->aData==(char *)&pTree[1] );
        pTree->aData = (char *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nReq);
        if( !pTree->aData ){
          return 7           ;
        }
      }

      if( pTree->zTerm ){

        nData += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pTree->aData[nData], nPrefix);
      }

      nData += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pTree->aData[nData], nSuffix);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pTree->aData[nData]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&zTerm[nPrefix]); int xxn=(nSuffix);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pTree->nData = nData + nSuffix;
      pTree->nEntry++;

      if( isCopyTerm ){
        if( pTree->nMalloc<nTerm ){
          char *zNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(pTree->zMalloc,(i64)nTerm*2);
          if( !zNew ){
            return 7           ;
          }
          pTree->nMalloc = nTerm*2;
          pTree->zMalloc = zNew;
        }
        pTree->zTerm = pTree->zMalloc;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pTree->zTerm);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zTerm); int xxn=(nTerm);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pTree->nTerm = nTerm;
      }else{
        pTree->zTerm = (char *)zTerm;
        pTree->nTerm = nTerm;
      }
      return 0        ;
    }
  }









  pNew = (SegmentNode *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(SegmentNode)+p->nNodeSize);
  if( !pNew ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(SegmentNode));
  pNew->nData = 1 +10              ;
  pNew->aData = (char *)&pNew[1];

  if( pTree ){
    SegmentNode *pParent = pTree->pParent;
    rc = fts3NodeAddTerm(p, &pParent, isCopyTerm, zTerm, nTerm);
    if( pTree->pParent==0 ){
      pTree->pParent = pParent;
    }
    pTree->pRight = pNew;
    pNew->pLeftmost = pTree->pLeftmost;
    pNew->pParent = pParent;
    pNew->zMalloc = pTree->zMalloc;
    pNew->nMalloc = pTree->nMalloc;
    pTree->zMalloc = 0;
  }else{
    pNew->pLeftmost = pNew;
    rc = fts3NodeAddTerm(p, &pNew, isCopyTerm, zTerm, nTerm);
  }

  *ppTree = pNew;
  return rc;
}




static int fts3TreeFinishNode(
  SegmentNode *pTree,
  int iHeight,
  sqlite3_int64 iLeftChild
){
  int nStart;
  assert( iHeight>=1 && iHeight<128 );
  nStart =10               - sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(iLeftChild);
  pTree->aData[nStart] = (char)iHeight;
  sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pTree->aData[nStart+1], iLeftChild);
  return nStart;
}














static int fts3NodeWrite(
  Fts3Table *p,
  SegmentNode *pTree,
  int iHeight,
  sqlite3_int64 iLeaf,
  sqlite3_int64 iFree,
  sqlite3_int64 *piLast,
  char **paRoot,
  int *pnRoot
){
  int rc =0         ;

  if( !pTree->pParent ){

    int nStart = fts3TreeFinishNode(pTree, iHeight, iLeaf);
    *piLast = iFree-1;
    *pnRoot = pTree->nData - nStart;
    *paRoot = &pTree->aData[nStart];
  }else{
    SegmentNode *pIter;
    sqlite3_int64 iNextFree = iFree;
    sqlite3_int64 iNextLeaf = iLeaf;
    for(pIter=pTree->pLeftmost; pIter && rc==0        ; pIter=pIter->pRight){
      int nStart = fts3TreeFinishNode(pIter, iHeight, iNextLeaf);
      int nWrite = pIter->nData - nStart;

      rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, iNextFree, &pIter->aData[nStart], nWrite);
      iNextFree++;
      iNextLeaf += (pIter->nEntry+1);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      assert( iNextLeaf==iFree );
      rc = fts3NodeWrite(
          p, pTree->pParent, iHeight+1, iFree, iNextFree, piLast, paRoot, pnRoot
      );
    }
  }

  return rc;
}




static void fts3NodeFree(SegmentNode *pTree){
  if( pTree ){
    SegmentNode *p = pTree->pLeftmost;
    fts3NodeFree(p->pParent);
    while( p ){
      SegmentNode *pRight = p->pRight;
      if( p->aData!=(char *)&p[1] ){
sqlite3_api->free   (p->aData);
      }
      assert( pRight==0 || p->zMalloc==0 );
sqlite3_api->free (p->zMalloc);
sqlite3_api->free (p);
      p = pRight;
    }
  }
}









static int fts3SegWriterAdd(
  Fts3Table *p,
  SegmentWriter **ppWriter,
  int isCopyTerm,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm,
  const char *aDoclist,
  int nDoclist
){
  int nPrefix;
  int nSuffix;
  i64 nReq;
  int nData;
  SegmentWriter *pWriter = *ppWriter;

  if( !pWriter ){
    int rc;
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;


    pWriter = (SegmentWriter *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(SegmentWriter));
    if( !pWriter ) return 7           ;
    memset(pWriter, 0, sizeof(SegmentWriter));
    *ppWriter = pWriter;


    pWriter->aData = (char *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(p->nNodeSize);
    if( !pWriter->aData ) return 7           ;
    pWriter->nSize = p->nNodeSize;


    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,10                   , &pStmt, 0);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      pWriter->iFree =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0);
      pWriter->iFirst = pWriter->iFree;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  }
  nData = pWriter->nData;

  nPrefix = fts3PrefixCompress(pWriter->zTerm, pWriter->nTerm, zTerm, nTerm);
  nSuffix = nTerm-nPrefix;




  if( nSuffix<=0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();


  nReq = sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nPrefix) +
    sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nSuffix) +
    nSuffix +
    sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nDoclist) +
    nDoclist;

  if( nData>0 && nData+nReq>p->nNodeSize ){
    int rc;


    if( pWriter->iFree==(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)))return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
    rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pWriter->iFree++, pWriter->aData, nData);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    p->nLeafAdd++;













    assert( nPrefix<nTerm );
    rc = fts3NodeAddTerm(p, &pWriter->pTree, isCopyTerm, zTerm, nPrefix+1);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

    nData = 0;
    pWriter->nTerm = 0;

    nPrefix = 0;
    nSuffix = nTerm;
    nReq = 1 +
      sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nTerm) +
      nTerm +
      sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nDoclist) +
      nDoclist;
  }


  pWriter->nLeafData += nReq;




  if( nReq>pWriter->nSize ){
    char *aNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(pWriter->aData,nReq);
    if( !aNew ) return 7           ;
    pWriter->aData = aNew;
    pWriter->nSize = nReq;
  }
  assert( nData+nReq<=pWriter->nSize );


  nData += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pWriter->aData[nData], nPrefix);
  nData += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pWriter->aData[nData], nSuffix);
  assert( nSuffix>0 );
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pWriter->aData[nData]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&zTerm[nPrefix]); int xxn=(nSuffix);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  nData += nSuffix;
  nData += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pWriter->aData[nData], nDoclist);
  assert( nDoclist>0 );
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pWriter->aData[nData]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aDoclist); int xxn=(nDoclist);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pWriter->nData = nData + nDoclist;






  if( isCopyTerm ){
    if( nTerm>pWriter->nMalloc ){
      char *zNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(pWriter->zMalloc,(i64)nTerm*2);
      if( !zNew ){
        return 7           ;
      }
      pWriter->nMalloc = nTerm*2;
      pWriter->zMalloc = zNew;
      pWriter->zTerm = zNew;
    }
    assert( pWriter->zTerm==pWriter->zMalloc );
    assert( nTerm>0 );
{char*xxd=(char*)(pWriter->zTerm);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zTerm); int xxn=(nTerm);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }else{
    pWriter->zTerm = (char *)zTerm;
  }
  pWriter->nTerm = nTerm;

  return 0        ;
}







static int fts3SegWriterFlush(
  Fts3Table *p,
  SegmentWriter *pWriter,
  sqlite3_int64 iLevel,
  int iIdx
){
  int rc;
  if( pWriter->pTree ){
    sqlite3_int64 iLast = 0;
    sqlite3_int64 iLastLeaf;
    char *zRoot = NULL;
    int nRoot = 0;

    iLastLeaf = pWriter->iFree;
    rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pWriter->iFree++, pWriter->aData, pWriter->nData);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3NodeWrite(p, pWriter->pTree, 1,
          pWriter->iFirst, pWriter->iFree, &iLast, &zRoot, &nRoot);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3WriteSegdir(p, iLevel, iIdx,
          pWriter->iFirst, iLastLeaf, iLast, pWriter->nLeafData, zRoot, nRoot);
    }
  }else{

    rc = fts3WriteSegdir(p, iLevel, iIdx,
        0, 0, 0, pWriter->nLeafData, pWriter->aData, pWriter->nData);
  }
  p->nLeafAdd++;
  return rc;
}





static void fts3SegWriterFree(SegmentWriter *pWriter){
  if( pWriter ){
sqlite3_api->free(pWriter->aData);
sqlite3_api->free(pWriter->zMalloc);
    fts3NodeFree(pWriter->pTree);
sqlite3_api->free(pWriter);
  }
}











static int fts3IsEmpty(Fts3Table *p, sqlite3_value *pRowid, int *pisEmpty){
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  int rc;
  if( p->zContentTbl ){

    *pisEmpty = 0;
    rc =0         ;
  }else{
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,1            , &pStmt, &pRowid);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
        *pisEmpty =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0);
      }
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}









static int fts3SegmentMaxLevel(
  Fts3Table *p,
  int iLangid,
  int iIndex,
  sqlite3_int64 *pnMax
){
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  int rc;
  assert( iIndex>=0 && iIndex<p->nIndex );







  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,15                          , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,1,getAbsoluteLevel(p,iLangid, iIndex, 0));
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,2,
      getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex,1024                 -1)
  );
  if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
    *pnMax =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0);
  }
  return sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
}









static int fts3SegmentIsMaxLevel(Fts3Table *p, i64 iAbsLevel, int *pbMax){







  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  int rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,15                          , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,1,iAbsLevel+1);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,2,
      (((u64)iAbsLevel/1024                )+1) *1024
  );

  *pbMax = 0;
  if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
    *pbMax =sqlite3_api->column_type(pStmt,0)==5       ;
  }
  return sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
}






static int fts3DeleteSegment(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3SegReader *pSeg
){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pSeg->iStartBlock ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pDelete;
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,17                        , &pDelete, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDelete, 1, pSeg->iStartBlock);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDelete, 2, pSeg->iEndBlock);
sqlite3_api->step (pDelete);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDelete);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}















static int fts3DeleteSegdir(
  Fts3Table *p,
  int iLangid,
  int iIndex,
  int iLevel,
  Fts3SegReader **apSegment,
  int nReader
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;
  sqlite3_stmt *pDelete = 0;

  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nReader; i++){
    rc = fts3DeleteSegment(p, apSegment[i]);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ){
    return rc;
  }

  assert( iLevel>=0 || iLevel==-2                 );
  if( iLevel==-2                 ){
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,26                      , &pDelete, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDelete, 1, getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex, 0));
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDelete, 2,
          getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex,1024                 -1)
      );
    }
  }else{
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,16                      , &pDelete, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (
          pDelete, 1, getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex, iLevel)
      );
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step(pDelete);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDelete);
  }

  return rc;
}













static void fts3ColumnFilter(
  int iCol,
  int bZero,
  char **ppList,
  int *pnList
){
  char *pList = *ppList;
  int nList = *pnList;
  char *pEnd = &pList[nList];
  int iCurrent = 0;
  char *p = pList;

  assert( iCol>=0 );
  while( 1 ){
    char c = 0;
    while( p<pEnd && (c | *p)&0xFE ) c = *p++ & 0x80;

    if( iCol==iCurrent ){
      nList = (int)(p - pList);
      break;
    }

    nList -= (int)(p - pList);
    pList = p;
    if( nList<=0 ){
      break;
    }
    p = &pList[1];
    p +=( (*(u8*)(p)&0x80) ? sqlite3Fts3GetVarint32(p, &iCurrent) : (*&iCurrent=*(u8*)(p), 1) );
  }

  if( bZero && (pEnd - &pList[nList])>0){
    memset(&pList[nList], 0, pEnd - &pList[nList]);
  }
  *ppList = pList;
  *pnList = nList;
}








static int fts3MsrBufferData(
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pMsr,
  char *pList,
  i64 nList
){
  if( (nList+(10*2)           )>pMsr->nBuffer ){
    char *pNew;
    int nNew = nList*2 +(10*2)            ;
    pNew = (char *)sqlite3_api->realloc64(pMsr->aBuffer,nNew);
    if( !pNew ) return 7           ;
    pMsr->aBuffer = pNew;
    pMsr->nBuffer = nNew;
  }

  assert( nList>0 );
{char*xxd=(char*)(pMsr->aBuffer);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pList); int xxn=(nList);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  memset(&pMsr->aBuffer[nList], 0,(10*2)            );
  return 0        ;
}

static         int sqlite3Fts3MsrIncrNext(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pMsr,
  sqlite3_int64 *piDocid,
  char **paPoslist,
  int *pnPoslist
){
  int nMerge = pMsr->nAdvance;
  Fts3SegReader **apSegment = pMsr->apSegment;
  int (*xCmp)(Fts3SegReader *, Fts3SegReader *) = (
    p->bDescIdx ? fts3SegReaderDoclistCmpRev : fts3SegReaderDoclistCmp
  );

  if( nMerge==0 ){
    *paPoslist = 0;
    return 0        ;
  }

  while( 1 ){
    Fts3SegReader *pSeg;
    pSeg = pMsr->apSegment[0];

    if( pSeg->pOffsetList==0 ){
      *paPoslist = 0;
      break;
    }else{
      int rc;
      char *pList;
      int nList;
      int j;
      sqlite3_int64 iDocid = apSegment[0]->iDocid;

      rc = fts3SegReaderNextDocid(p, apSegment[0], &pList, &nList);
      j = 1;
      while( rc==0
        && j<nMerge
        && apSegment[j]->pOffsetList
        && apSegment[j]->iDocid==iDocid
      ){
        rc = fts3SegReaderNextDocid(p, apSegment[j], 0, 0);
        j++;
      }
      if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
      fts3SegReaderSort(pMsr->apSegment, nMerge, j, xCmp);

      if( nList>0 &&((apSegment[0])->ppNextElem!=0)       ){
        rc = fts3MsrBufferData(pMsr, pList, (i64)nList+1);
        if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
        assert( (pMsr->aBuffer[nList] & 0xFE)==0x00 );
        pList = pMsr->aBuffer;
      }

      if( pMsr->iColFilter>=0 ){
        fts3ColumnFilter(pMsr->iColFilter, 1, &pList, &nList);
      }

      if( nList>0 ){
        *paPoslist = pList;
        *piDocid = iDocid;
        *pnPoslist = nList;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return 0        ;
}

static int fts3SegReaderStart(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm
){
  int i;
  int nSeg = pCsr->nSegment;







  for(i=0; pCsr->bRestart==0 && i<pCsr->nSegment; i++){
    int res = 0;
    Fts3SegReader *pSeg = pCsr->apSegment[i];
    do {
      int rc = fts3SegReaderNext(p, pSeg, 0);
      if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    }while( zTerm && (res = fts3SegReaderTermCmp(pSeg, zTerm, nTerm))<0 );

    if( pSeg->bLookup && res!=0 ){
      fts3SegReaderSetEof(pSeg);
    }
  }
  fts3SegReaderSort(pCsr->apSegment, nSeg, nSeg, fts3SegReaderCmp);

  return 0        ;
}

static         int sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStart(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr,
  Fts3SegFilter *pFilter
){
  pCsr->pFilter = pFilter;
  return fts3SegReaderStart(p, pCsr, pFilter->zTerm, pFilter->nTerm);
}

static         int sqlite3Fts3MsrIncrStart(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr,
  int iCol,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm
){
  int i;
  int rc;
  int nSegment = pCsr->nSegment;
  int (*xCmp)(Fts3SegReader *, Fts3SegReader *) = (
    p->bDescIdx ? fts3SegReaderDoclistCmpRev : fts3SegReaderDoclistCmp
  );

  assert( pCsr->pFilter==0 );
  assert( zTerm && nTerm>0 );


  rc = fts3SegReaderStart(p, pCsr, zTerm, nTerm);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;


  for(i=0; i<nSegment; i++){
    Fts3SegReader *pSeg = pCsr->apSegment[i];
    if( !pSeg->aNode || fts3SegReaderTermCmp(pSeg, zTerm, nTerm) ){
      break;
    }
  }
  pCsr->nAdvance = i;


  for(i=0; i<pCsr->nAdvance; i++){
    rc = fts3SegReaderFirstDocid(p, pCsr->apSegment[i]);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  }
  fts3SegReaderSort(pCsr->apSegment, i, i, xCmp);

  assert( iCol<0 || iCol<p->nColumn );
  pCsr->iColFilter = iCol;

  return 0        ;
}













static         int sqlite3Fts3MsrIncrRestart(Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr){
  int i;

  assert( pCsr->zTerm==0 );
  assert( pCsr->nTerm==0 );
  assert( pCsr->aDoclist==0 );
  assert( pCsr->nDoclist==0 );

  pCsr->nAdvance = 0;
  pCsr->bRestart = 1;
  for(i=0; i<pCsr->nSegment; i++){
    pCsr->apSegment[i]->pOffsetList = 0;
    pCsr->apSegment[i]->nOffsetList = 0;
    pCsr->apSegment[i]->iDocid = 0;
  }

  return 0        ;
}

static int fts3GrowSegReaderBuffer(Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr, i64 nReq){
  if( nReq>pCsr->nBuffer ){
    char *aNew;
    pCsr->nBuffer = nReq*2;
    aNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(pCsr->aBuffer,pCsr->nBuffer);
    if( !aNew ){
      return 7           ;
    }
    pCsr->aBuffer = aNew;
  }
  return 0        ;
}


static         int sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep(
  Fts3Table *p,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr
){
  int rc =0         ;

  int isIgnoreEmpty =  (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000002                );
  int isRequirePos =   (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000001               );
  int isColFilter =    (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000004                 );
  int isPrefix =       (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000008          );
  int isScan =         (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000010        );
  int isFirst =        (pCsr->pFilter->flags &0x00000020         );

  Fts3SegReader **apSegment = pCsr->apSegment;
  int nSegment = pCsr->nSegment;
  Fts3SegFilter *pFilter = pCsr->pFilter;
  int (*xCmp)(Fts3SegReader *, Fts3SegReader *) = (
    p->bDescIdx ? fts3SegReaderDoclistCmpRev : fts3SegReaderDoclistCmp
  );

  if( pCsr->nSegment==0 ) return 0        ;

  do {
    int nMerge;
    int i;




    for(i=0; i<pCsr->nAdvance; i++){
      Fts3SegReader *pSeg = apSegment[i];
      if( pSeg->bLookup ){
        fts3SegReaderSetEof(pSeg);
      }else{
        rc = fts3SegReaderNext(p, pSeg, 0);
      }
      if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
    }
    fts3SegReaderSort(apSegment, nSegment, pCsr->nAdvance, fts3SegReaderCmp);
    pCsr->nAdvance = 0;


    assert( rc==0         );
    if( apSegment[0]->aNode==0 ) break;

    pCsr->nTerm = apSegment[0]->nTerm;
    pCsr->zTerm = apSegment[0]->zTerm;








    if( pFilter->zTerm && !isScan ){
      if( pCsr->nTerm<pFilter->nTerm
       || (!isPrefix && pCsr->nTerm>pFilter->nTerm)
       || memcmp(pCsr->zTerm, pFilter->zTerm, pFilter->nTerm)
      ){
        break;
      }
    }

    nMerge = 1;
    while( nMerge<nSegment
        && apSegment[nMerge]->aNode
        && apSegment[nMerge]->nTerm==pCsr->nTerm
        && 0==memcmp(pCsr->zTerm, apSegment[nMerge]->zTerm, pCsr->nTerm)
    ){
      nMerge++;
    }

    assert( isIgnoreEmpty || (isRequirePos && !isColFilter) );
    if( nMerge==1
     && !isIgnoreEmpty
     && !isFirst
     && (p->bDescIdx==0 ||((apSegment[0])->ppNextElem!=0)      ==0)
    ){
      pCsr->nDoclist = apSegment[0]->nDoclist;
      if(((apSegment[0])->ppNextElem!=0)       ){
        rc = fts3MsrBufferData(pCsr, apSegment[0]->aDoclist,
                               (i64)pCsr->nDoclist);
        pCsr->aDoclist = pCsr->aBuffer;
      }else{
        pCsr->aDoclist = apSegment[0]->aDoclist;
      }
      if( rc==0         ) rc =100        ;
    }else{
      int nDoclist = 0;
      sqlite3_int64 iPrev = 0;





      for(i=0; i<nMerge; i++){
        fts3SegReaderFirstDocid(p, apSegment[i]);
      }
      fts3SegReaderSort(apSegment, nMerge, nMerge, xCmp);
      while( apSegment[0]->pOffsetList ){
        int j;
        char *pList = 0;
        int nList = 0;
        int nByte;
        sqlite3_int64 iDocid = apSegment[0]->iDocid;
        fts3SegReaderNextDocid(p, apSegment[0], &pList, &nList);
        j = 1;
        while( j<nMerge
            && apSegment[j]->pOffsetList
            && apSegment[j]->iDocid==iDocid
        ){
          fts3SegReaderNextDocid(p, apSegment[j], 0, 0);
          j++;
        }

        if( isColFilter ){
          fts3ColumnFilter(pFilter->iCol, 0, &pList, &nList);
        }

        if( !isIgnoreEmpty || nList>0 ){



          sqlite3_int64 iDelta;
          if( p->bDescIdx && nDoclist>0 ){
            if( iPrev<=iDocid ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
            iDelta = (i64)((u64)iPrev - (u64)iDocid);
          }else{
            if( nDoclist>0 && iPrev>=iDocid ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
            iDelta = (i64)((u64)iDocid - (u64)iPrev);
          }

          nByte = sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(iDelta) + (isRequirePos?nList+1:0);

          rc = fts3GrowSegReaderBuffer(pCsr,
                                   (i64)nByte+nDoclist+(10*2)           );
          if( rc ) return rc;

          if( isFirst ){
            char *a = &pCsr->aBuffer[nDoclist];
            int nWrite;

            nWrite = sqlite3Fts3FirstFilter(iDelta, pList, nList, a);
            if( nWrite ){
              iPrev = iDocid;
              nDoclist += nWrite;
            }
          }else{
            nDoclist += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pCsr->aBuffer[nDoclist], iDelta);
            iPrev = iDocid;
            if( isRequirePos ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pCsr->aBuffer[nDoclist]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pList); int xxn=(nList);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
              nDoclist += nList;
              pCsr->aBuffer[nDoclist++] = '\0';
            }
          }
        }

        fts3SegReaderSort(apSegment, nMerge, j, xCmp);
      }
      if( nDoclist>0 ){
        rc = fts3GrowSegReaderBuffer(pCsr, (i64)nDoclist+(10*2)           );
        if( rc ) return rc;
        memset(&pCsr->aBuffer[nDoclist], 0,(10*2)            );
        pCsr->aDoclist = pCsr->aBuffer;
        pCsr->nDoclist = nDoclist;
        rc =100        ;
      }
    }
    pCsr->nAdvance = nMerge;
  }while( rc==0         );

  return rc;
}


static         void sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFinish(
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr
){
  if( pCsr ){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<pCsr->nSegment; i++){
      sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFree(pCsr->apSegment[i]);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->apSegment);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->aBuffer);

    pCsr->nSegment = 0;
    pCsr->apSegment = 0;
    pCsr->aBuffer = 0;
  }
}











static void fts3ReadEndBlockField(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int iCol,
  i64 *piEndBlock,
  i64 *pnByte
){
  const unsigned char *zText =sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,iCol);
  if( zText ){
    int i;
    int iMul = 1;
    u64 iVal = 0;
    for(i=0; zText[i]>='0' && zText[i]<='9'; i++){
      iVal = iVal*10 + (zText[i] - '0');
    }
    *piEndBlock = (i64)iVal;
    while( zText[i]==' ' ) i++;
    iVal = 0;
    if( zText[i]=='-' ){
      i++;
      iMul = -1;
    }
    for(           ; zText[i]>='0' && zText[i]<='9'; i++){
      iVal = iVal*10 + (zText[i] - '0');
    }
    *pnByte = ((i64)iVal * (i64)iMul);
  }
}






static int fts3PromoteSegments(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  sqlite3_int64 nByte
){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_stmt *pRange;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,37                      , &pRange, 0);

  if( rc==0         ){
    int bOk = 0;
    i64 iLast = (iAbsLevel/1024                 + 1) *1024                  - 1;
    i64 nLimit = (nByte*3)/2;






sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRange,1, iAbsLevel+1);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRange,2, iLast);
    while(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pRange)){
      i64 nSize = 0, dummy;
      fts3ReadEndBlockField(pRange, 2, &dummy, &nSize);
      if( nSize<=0 || nSize>nLimit ){





        bOk = 0;
        break;
      }
      bOk = 1;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRange);

    if( bOk ){
      int iIdx = 0;
      sqlite3_stmt *pUpdate1 = 0;
      sqlite3_stmt *pUpdate2 = 0;

      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,38                   , &pUpdate1, 0);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,39               , &pUpdate2, 0);
      }

      if( rc==0         ){










sqlite3_api->bind_int64   (pRange, 1, iAbsLevel);
        while(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pRange)){
sqlite3_api->bind_int     (pUpdate1, 1, iIdx++);
sqlite3_api->bind_int     (pUpdate1, 2,sqlite3_api->column_int(pRange,0));
sqlite3_api->bind_int     (pUpdate1, 3,sqlite3_api->column_int(pRange,1));
sqlite3_api->step     (pUpdate1);
          rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUpdate1);
          if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->reset       (pRange);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRange);
      }


      if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64   (pUpdate2, 1, iAbsLevel);
sqlite3_api->step   (pUpdate2);
        rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUpdate2);
      }
    }
  }


  return rc;
}












static int fts3SegmentMerge(
  Fts3Table *p,
  int iLangid,
  int iIndex,
  int iLevel
){
  int rc;
  int iIdx = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 iNewLevel = 0;
  SegmentWriter *pWriter = 0;
  Fts3SegFilter filter;
  Fts3MultiSegReader csr;
  int bIgnoreEmpty = 0;
  i64 iMaxLevel = 0;

  assert( iLevel==-2
       || iLevel==-1
       || iLevel>=0
  );
  assert( iLevel<1024                 );
  assert( iIndex>=0 && iIndex<p->nIndex );

  rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderCursor(p, iLangid, iIndex, iLevel, 0, 0, 1, 0, &csr);
  if( rc!=0         || csr.nSegment==0 ) goto finished;

  if( iLevel!=-1                     ){
    rc = fts3SegmentMaxLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex, &iMaxLevel);
    if( rc!=0         ) goto finished;
  }

  if( iLevel==-2                 ){




    if( csr.nSegment==1 && 0==((csr.apSegment[0])->ppNextElem!=0)      ){
      rc =101         ;
      goto finished;
    }
    iNewLevel = iMaxLevel;
    bIgnoreEmpty = 1;

  }else{




    assert(-1                     ==-1 );
    iNewLevel = getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex, iLevel+1);
    rc = fts3AllocateSegdirIdx(p, iLangid, iIndex, iLevel+1, &iIdx);
    bIgnoreEmpty = (iLevel!=-1                    ) && (iNewLevel>iMaxLevel);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ) goto finished;

  assert( csr.nSegment>0 );
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (iNewLevel>=getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex, 0)));
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (
iNewLevel<getAbsoluteLevel(p, iLangid, iIndex,1024)))
   ;

  memset(&filter, 0, sizeof(Fts3SegFilter));
  filter.flags =0x00000001               ;
  filter.flags |= (bIgnoreEmpty ?0x00000002                 : 0);

  rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStart(p, &csr, &filter);
  while(0         ==rc ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep(p, &csr);
    if( rc!=100        ) break;
    rc = fts3SegWriterAdd(p, &pWriter, 1,
        csr.zTerm, csr.nTerm, csr.aDoclist, csr.nDoclist);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ) goto finished;
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (pWriter || bIgnoreEmpty));

  if( iLevel!=-1                     ){
    rc = fts3DeleteSegdir(
        p, iLangid, iIndex, iLevel, csr.apSegment, csr.nSegment
    );
    if( rc!=0         ) goto finished;
  }
  if( pWriter ){
    rc = fts3SegWriterFlush(p, pWriter, iNewLevel, iIdx);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( iLevel==-1                     || iNewLevel<iMaxLevel ){
        rc = fts3PromoteSegments(p, iNewLevel, pWriter->nLeafData);
      }
    }
  }

 finished:
  fts3SegWriterFree(pWriter);
  sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFinish(&csr);
  return rc;
}





static         int sqlite3Fts3PendingTermsFlush(Fts3Table *p){
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;

  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<p->nIndex; i++){
    rc = fts3SegmentMerge(p, p->iPrevLangid, i,-1                     );
    if( rc==101         ) rc =0         ;
  }
  sqlite3Fts3PendingTermsClear(p);




  if( rc==0         && p->bHasStat
   && p->nAutoincrmerge==0xff && p->nLeafAdd>0
  ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,22              , &pStmt, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int (pStmt, 1,2                      );
      rc =sqlite3_api->step(pStmt);
      if( rc==100        ){
        p->nAutoincrmerge =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0);
        if( p->nAutoincrmerge==1 ) p->nAutoincrmerge = 8;
      }else if( rc==101         ){
        p->nAutoincrmerge = 0;
      }
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}




static void fts3EncodeIntArray(
  int N,
  u32 *a,
  char *zBuf,
  int *pNBuf
){
  int i, j;
  for(i=j=0; i<N; i++){
    j += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&zBuf[j], (sqlite3_int64)a[i]);
  }
  *pNBuf = j;
}




static void fts3DecodeIntArray(
  int N,
  u32 *a,
  const char *zBuf,
  int nBuf
){
  int i = 0;
  if( nBuf && (zBuf[nBuf-1]&0x80)==0 ){
    int j;
    for(i=j=0; i<N && j<nBuf; i++){
      sqlite3_int64 x;
      j += sqlite3Fts3GetVarint(&zBuf[j], &x);
      a[i] = (u32)(x & 0xffffffff);
    }
  }
  while( i<N ) a[i++] = 0;
}






static void fts3InsertDocsize(
  int *pRC,
  Fts3Table *p,
  u32 *aSz
){
  char *pBlob;
  int nBlob;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  int rc;

  if( *pRC ) return;
  pBlob =sqlite3_api->malloc64(10*(sqlite3_int64)p->nColumn);
  if( pBlob==0 ){
    *pRC =7            ;
    return;
  }
  fts3EncodeIntArray(p->nColumn, aSz, pBlob, &nBlob);
  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,20                  , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc ){
sqlite3_api->free(pBlob);
    *pRC = rc;
    return;
  }
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,1,p->iPrevDocid);
sqlite3_api->bind_blob(pStmt,2,pBlob,nBlob,sqlite3_api->free);
sqlite3_api->step(pStmt);
  *pRC =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
}
















static void fts3UpdateDocTotals(
  int *pRC,
  Fts3Table *p,
  u32 *aSzIns,
  u32 *aSzDel,
  int nChng
){
  char *pBlob;
  int nBlob;
  u32 *a;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  int i;
  int rc;

  const int nStat = p->nColumn+2;

  if( *pRC ) return;
  a =sqlite3_api->malloc64((sizeof(u32)+10)*(sqlite3_int64)nStat);
  if( a==0 ){
    *pRC =7            ;
    return;
  }
  pBlob = (char*)&a[nStat];
  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,22              , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc ){
sqlite3_api->free(a);
    *pRC = rc;
    return;
  }
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pStmt,1,0               );
  if(sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)==100    ){
    fts3DecodeIntArray(nStat, a,
sqlite3_api->column_blob    (pStmt, 0),
sqlite3_api->column_bytes    (pStmt, 0));
  }else{
    memset(a, 0, sizeof(u32)*(nStat) );
  }
  rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->free(a);
    *pRC = rc;
    return;
  }
  if( nChng<0 && a[0]<(u32)(-nChng) ){
    a[0] = 0;
  }else{
    a[0] += nChng;
  }
  for(i=0; i<p->nColumn+1; i++){
    u32 x = a[i+1];
    if( x+aSzIns[i] < aSzDel[i] ){
      x = 0;
    }else{
      x = x + aSzIns[i] - aSzDel[i];
    }
    a[i+1] = x;
  }
  fts3EncodeIntArray(nStat, a, pBlob, &nBlob);
  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,23               , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc ){
sqlite3_api->free(a);
    *pRC = rc;
    return;
  }
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pStmt,1,0               );
sqlite3_api->bind_blob(pStmt,2,pBlob,nBlob,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
sqlite3_api->step(pStmt);
  *pRC =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
sqlite3_api->bind_null(pStmt,2);
sqlite3_api->free(a);
}





static int fts3DoOptimize(Fts3Table *p, int bReturnDone){
  int bSeenDone = 0;
  int rc;
  sqlite3_stmt *pAllLangid = 0;

  rc = sqlite3Fts3PendingTermsFlush(p);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,27                    , &pAllLangid, 0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pAllLangid,1, p->iPrevLangid);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pAllLangid,2, p->nIndex);
    while(sqlite3_api->step(pAllLangid)==100    ){
      int i;
      int iLangid =sqlite3_api->column_int(pAllLangid,0);
      for(i=0; rc==0         && i<p->nIndex; i++){
        rc = fts3SegmentMerge(p, iLangid, i,-2                 );
        if( rc==101         ){
          bSeenDone = 1;
          rc =0         ;
        }
      }
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pAllLangid);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  sqlite3Fts3SegmentsClose(p);

  return (rc==0         && bReturnDone && bSeenDone) ?101          : rc;
}











static int fts3DoRebuild(Fts3Table *p){
  int rc;

  rc = fts3DeleteAll(p, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    u32 *aSz = 0;
    u32 *aSzIns = 0;
    u32 *aSzDel = 0;
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
    int nEntry = 0;


    char *zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf("SELECT %s",p->zReadExprlist);
    if( !zSql ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(p->db,zSql,-1,&pStmt,0);
sqlite3_api->free (zSql);
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      sqlite3_int64 nByte = sizeof(u32) * ((sqlite3_int64)p->nColumn+1)*3;
      aSz = (u32 *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
      if( aSz==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        memset(aSz, 0, nByte);
        aSzIns = &aSz[p->nColumn+1];
        aSzDel = &aSzIns[p->nColumn+1];
      }
    }

    while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      int iCol;
      int iLangid = langidFromSelect(p, pStmt);
      rc = fts3PendingTermsDocid(p, 0, iLangid,sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0));
      memset(aSz, 0, sizeof(aSz[0]) * (p->nColumn+1));
      for(iCol=0; rc==0         && iCol<p->nColumn; iCol++){
        if( p->abNotindexed[iCol]==0 ){
          const char *z = (const char *)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,iCol+1);
          rc = fts3PendingTermsAdd(p, iLangid, z, iCol, &aSz[iCol]);
          aSz[p->nColumn] +=sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pStmt,iCol+1);
        }
      }
      if( p->bHasDocsize ){
        fts3InsertDocsize(&rc, p, aSz);
      }
      if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->finalize   (pStmt);
        pStmt = 0;
      }else{
        nEntry++;
        for(iCol=0; iCol<=p->nColumn; iCol++){
          aSzIns[iCol] += aSz[iCol];
        }
      }
    }
    if( p->bFts4 ){
      fts3UpdateDocTotals(&rc, p, aSzIns, aSzDel, nEntry);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(aSz);

    if( pStmt ){
      int rc2 =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = rc2;
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}








static int fts3IncrmergeCsr(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  int nSeg,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr
){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;


  memset(pCsr, 0, sizeof(*pCsr));
  nByte = sizeof(Fts3SegReader *) * nSeg;
  pCsr->apSegment = (Fts3SegReader **)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);

  if( pCsr->apSegment==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    memset(pCsr->apSegment, 0, nByte);
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,12               , &pStmt, 0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    int i;
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,1, iAbsLevel);
    assert( pCsr->nSegment==0 );
    for(i=0; rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)==100    && i<nSeg; i++){
      rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderNew(i, 0,
sqlite3_api->column_int64     (pStmt, 1),
sqlite3_api->column_int64     (pStmt, 2),
sqlite3_api->column_int64     (pStmt, 3),
sqlite3_api->column_blob     (pStmt, 4),
sqlite3_api->column_bytes     (pStmt, 4),
          &pCsr->apSegment[i]
      );
      pCsr->nSegment++;
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  return rc;
}

typedef struct IncrmergeWriter IncrmergeWriter;
typedef struct NodeWriter NodeWriter;
typedef struct Blob Blob;
typedef struct NodeReader NodeReader;







struct Blob {
  char *a;
  int n;
  int nAlloc;
};





struct NodeWriter {
  sqlite3_int64 iBlock;
  Blob key;
  Blob block;
};





struct IncrmergeWriter {
  int nLeafEst;
  int nWork;
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel;
  int iIdx;
  sqlite3_int64 iStart;
  sqlite3_int64 iEnd;
  sqlite3_int64 nLeafData;
  u8 bNoLeafData;
  NodeWriter aNodeWriter[16                       ];
};









struct NodeReader {
  const char *aNode;
  int nNode;
  int iOff;


  sqlite3_int64 iChild;
  Blob term;
  const char *aDoclist;
  int nDoclist;
};










static void blobGrowBuffer(Blob *pBlob, int nMin, int *pRc){
  if( *pRc==0         && nMin>pBlob->nAlloc ){
    int nAlloc = nMin;
    char *a = (char *)sqlite3_api->realloc64(pBlob->a,nAlloc);
    if( a ){
      pBlob->nAlloc = nAlloc;
      pBlob->a = a;
    }else{
      *pRc =7            ;
    }
  }
}











static int nodeReaderNext(NodeReader *p){
  int bFirst = (p->term.n==0);
  int nPrefix = 0;
  int nSuffix = 0;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( p->aNode );
  if( p->iChild && bFirst==0 ) p->iChild++;
  if( p->iOff>=p->nNode ){

    p->aNode = 0;
  }else{
    if( bFirst==0 ){
      p->iOff +=( (*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff])&0x80) ? sqlite3Fts3GetVarint32(&p->aNode[p->iOff], &nPrefix) : (*&nPrefix=*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff]), 1) );
    }
    p->iOff +=( (*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff])&0x80) ? sqlite3Fts3GetVarint32(&p->aNode[p->iOff], &nSuffix) : (*&nSuffix=*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff]), 1) );

    if( nPrefix>p->term.n || nSuffix>p->nNode-p->iOff || nSuffix==0 ){
      return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
    }
    blobGrowBuffer(&p->term, nPrefix+nSuffix, &rc);
    if( rc==0         &&(1)                   ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&p->term.a[nPrefix]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff]); int xxn=(nSuffix);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      p->term.n = nPrefix+nSuffix;
      p->iOff += nSuffix;
      if( p->iChild==0 ){
        p->iOff +=( (*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff])&0x80) ? sqlite3Fts3GetVarint32(&p->aNode[p->iOff], &p->nDoclist) : (*&p->nDoclist=*(u8*)(&p->aNode[p->iOff]), 1) );
        if( (p->nNode-p->iOff)<p->nDoclist ){
          return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
        }
        p->aDoclist = &p->aNode[p->iOff];
        p->iOff += p->nDoclist;
      }
    }
  }

assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (p->iOff<=p->nNode));
  return rc;
}




static void nodeReaderRelease(NodeReader *p){
sqlite3_api->free(p->term.a);
}








static int nodeReaderInit(NodeReader *p, const char *aNode, int nNode){
  memset(p, 0, sizeof(NodeReader));
  p->aNode = aNode;
  p->nNode = nNode;


  if( aNode && aNode[0] ){

    p->iOff = 1 + sqlite3Fts3GetVarint(&p->aNode[1], &p->iChild);
  }else{
    p->iOff = 1;
  }

  return aNode ? nodeReaderNext(p) :0         ;
}











static int fts3IncrmergePush(
  Fts3Table *p,
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm
){
  sqlite3_int64 iPtr = pWriter->aNodeWriter[0].iBlock;
  int iLayer;

  assert( nTerm>0 );
  for(iLayer=1;(1)                                      ; iLayer++){
    sqlite3_int64 iNextPtr = 0;
    NodeWriter *pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[iLayer];
    int rc =0         ;
    int nPrefix;
    int nSuffix;
    int nSpace;





    nPrefix = fts3PrefixCompress(pNode->key.a, pNode->key.n, zTerm, nTerm);
    nSuffix = nTerm - nPrefix;
    if(nSuffix<=0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
    nSpace  = sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nPrefix);
    nSpace += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nSuffix) + nSuffix;

    if( pNode->key.n==0 || (pNode->block.n + nSpace)<=p->nNodeSize ){




      Blob *pBlk = &pNode->block;
      if( pBlk->n==0 ){
        blobGrowBuffer(pBlk, p->nNodeSize, &rc);
        if( rc==0         ){
          pBlk->a[0] = (char)iLayer;
          pBlk->n = 1 + sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pBlk->a[1], iPtr);
        }
      }
      blobGrowBuffer(pBlk, pBlk->n + nSpace, &rc);
      blobGrowBuffer(&pNode->key, nTerm, &rc);

      if( rc==0         ){
        if( pNode->key.n ){
          pBlk->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pBlk->a[pBlk->n], nPrefix);
        }
        pBlk->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pBlk->a[pBlk->n], nSuffix);
        assert( nPrefix+nSuffix<=nTerm );
        assert( nPrefix>=0 );
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pBlk->a[pBlk->n]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&zTerm[nPrefix]); int xxn=(nSuffix);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pBlk->n += nSuffix;

{char*xxd=(char*)(pNode->key.a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zTerm); int xxn=(nTerm);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pNode->key.n = nTerm;
      }
    }else{



      rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pNode->iBlock, pNode->block.a, pNode->block.n);

      assert( pNode->block.nAlloc>=p->nNodeSize );
      pNode->block.a[0] = (char)iLayer;
      pNode->block.n = 1 + sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pNode->block.a[1], iPtr+1);

      iNextPtr = pNode->iBlock;
      pNode->iBlock++;
      pNode->key.n = 0;
    }

    if( rc!=0         || iNextPtr==0 ) return rc;
    iPtr = iNextPtr;
  }

  assert( 0 );
  return 0;
}

























static int fts3AppendToNode(
  Blob *pNode,
  Blob *pPrev,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm,
  const char *aDoclist,
  int nDoclist
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int bFirst = (pPrev->n==0);
  int nPrefix;
  int nSuffix;



  assert( pNode->n>0 );
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || ((pNode->a[0]=='\0')==(aDoclist!=0)));

  blobGrowBuffer(pPrev, nTerm, &rc);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

  nPrefix = fts3PrefixCompress(pPrev->a, pPrev->n, zTerm, nTerm);
  nSuffix = nTerm - nPrefix;
  if( nSuffix<=0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
{char*xxd=(char*)(pPrev->a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zTerm); int xxn=(nTerm);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pPrev->n = nTerm;

  if( bFirst==0 ){
    pNode->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pNode->a[pNode->n], nPrefix);
  }
  pNode->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pNode->a[pNode->n], nSuffix);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pNode->a[pNode->n]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&zTerm[nPrefix]); int xxn=(nSuffix);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pNode->n += nSuffix;

  if( aDoclist ){
    pNode->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pNode->a[pNode->n], nDoclist);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pNode->a[pNode->n]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aDoclist); int xxn=(nDoclist);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    pNode->n += nDoclist;
  }

  assert( pNode->n<=pNode->nAlloc );

  return 0        ;
}







static int fts3IncrmergeAppend(
  Fts3Table *p,
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr
){
  const char *zTerm = pCsr->zTerm;
  int nTerm = pCsr->nTerm;
  const char *aDoclist = pCsr->aDoclist;
  int nDoclist = pCsr->nDoclist;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nSpace;
  int nPrefix;
  int nSuffix;
  NodeWriter *pLeaf;

  pLeaf = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[0];
  nPrefix = fts3PrefixCompress(pLeaf->key.a, pLeaf->key.n, zTerm, nTerm);
  nSuffix = nTerm - nPrefix;
  if(nSuffix<=0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();

  nSpace  = sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nPrefix);
  nSpace += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nSuffix) + nSuffix;
  nSpace += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nDoclist) + nDoclist;




  if( pLeaf->block.n>0 && (pLeaf->block.n + nSpace)>p->nNodeSize ){
    rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pLeaf->iBlock, pLeaf->block.a, pLeaf->block.n);
    pWriter->nWork++;













    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3IncrmergePush(p, pWriter, zTerm, nPrefix+1);
    }


    pLeaf->iBlock++;
    pLeaf->key.n = 0;
    pLeaf->block.n = 0;

    nSuffix = nTerm;
    nSpace  = 1;
    nSpace += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nSuffix) + nSuffix;
    nSpace += sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(nDoclist) + nDoclist;
  }

  pWriter->nLeafData += nSpace;
  blobGrowBuffer(&pLeaf->block, pLeaf->block.n + nSpace, &rc);
  if( rc==0         ){
    if( pLeaf->block.n==0 ){
      pLeaf->block.n = 1;
      pLeaf->block.a[0] = '\0';
    }
    rc = fts3AppendToNode(
        &pLeaf->block, &pLeaf->key, zTerm, nTerm, aDoclist, nDoclist
    );
  }

  return rc;
}














static void fts3IncrmergeRelease(
  Fts3Table *p,
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter,
  int *pRc
){
  int i;
  int iRoot;
  NodeWriter *pRoot;
  int rc = *pRc;





  for(iRoot=16                       -1; iRoot>=0; iRoot--){
    NodeWriter *pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[iRoot];
    if( pNode->block.n>0 ) break;
    assert( *pRc || pNode->block.nAlloc==0 );
    assert( *pRc || pNode->key.nAlloc==0 );
sqlite3_api->free(pNode->block.a);
sqlite3_api->free(pNode->key.a);
  }


  if( iRoot<0 ) return;
















  if( iRoot==0 ){
    Blob *pBlock = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[1].block;
    blobGrowBuffer(pBlock, 1 +10              , &rc);
    if( rc==0         ){
      pBlock->a[0] = 0x01;
      pBlock->n = 1 + sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(
          &pBlock->a[1], pWriter->aNodeWriter[0].iBlock
      );
    }
    iRoot = 1;
  }
  pRoot = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[iRoot];


  for(i=0; i<iRoot; i++){
    NodeWriter *pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[i];
    if( pNode->block.n>0 && rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pNode->iBlock, pNode->block.a, pNode->block.n);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(pNode->block.a);
sqlite3_api->free(pNode->key.a);
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts3WriteSegdir(p,
        pWriter->iAbsLevel+1,
        pWriter->iIdx,
        pWriter->iStart,
        pWriter->aNodeWriter[0].iBlock,
        pWriter->iEnd,
        (pWriter->bNoLeafData==0 ? pWriter->nLeafData : 0),
        pRoot->block.a, pRoot->block.n
    );
  }
sqlite3_api->free(pRoot->block.a);
sqlite3_api->free(pRoot->key.a);

  *pRc = rc;
}









static int fts3TermCmp(
  const char *zLhs, int nLhs,
  const char *zRhs, int nRhs
){
  int nCmp =((nLhs)<(nRhs)?(nLhs):(nRhs));
  int res;

  if( nCmp &&(1)           &&(1)           ){
    res = memcmp(zLhs, zRhs, nCmp);
  }else{
    res = 0;
  }
  if( res==0 ) res = nLhs - nRhs;

  return res;
}














static int fts3IsAppendable(Fts3Table *p, sqlite3_int64 iEnd, int *pbRes){
  int bRes = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pCheck = 0;
  int rc;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,34                        , &pCheck, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pCheck,1, iEnd);
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pCheck))bRes=1;
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pCheck);
  }

  *pbRes = bRes;
  return rc;
}
















static int fts3IncrmergeLoad(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  int iIdx,
  const char *zKey,
  int nKey,
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter
){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_stmt *pSelect = 0;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,32                , &pSelect, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_int64 iStart = 0;
    sqlite3_int64 iLeafEnd = 0;
    sqlite3_int64 iEnd = 0;
    const char *aRoot = 0;
    int nRoot = 0;
    int rc2;
    int bAppendable = 0;


sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pSelect,1, iAbsLevel+1);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pSelect,2, iIdx);
    if(sqlite3_api->step(pSelect)==100    ){
      iStart =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pSelect,1);
      iLeafEnd =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pSelect,2);
      fts3ReadEndBlockField(pSelect, 3, &iEnd, &pWriter->nLeafData);
      if( pWriter->nLeafData<0 ){
        pWriter->nLeafData = pWriter->nLeafData * -1;
      }
      pWriter->bNoLeafData = (pWriter->nLeafData==0);
      nRoot =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pSelect,4);
      aRoot =sqlite3_api->column_blob(pSelect,4);
      if( aRoot==0 ){
sqlite3_api->reset   (pSelect);
        return nRoot ?7             :sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
      }
    }else{
      return sqlite3_api->reset(pSelect);
    }


    rc = fts3IsAppendable(p, iEnd, &bAppendable);


    if( rc==0         && bAppendable ){
      char *aLeaf = 0;
      int nLeaf = 0;

      rc = sqlite3Fts3ReadBlock(p, iLeafEnd, &aLeaf, &nLeaf, 0);
      if( rc==0         ){
        NodeReader reader;
        for(rc = nodeReaderInit(&reader, aLeaf, nLeaf);
            rc==0         && reader.aNode;
            rc = nodeReaderNext(&reader)
        ){
          assert( reader.aNode );
        }
        if( fts3TermCmp(zKey, nKey, reader.term.a, reader.term.n)<=0 ){
          bAppendable = 0;
        }
        nodeReaderRelease(&reader);
      }
sqlite3_api->free (aLeaf);
    }

    if( rc==0         && bAppendable ){


      int i;
      int nHeight = (int)aRoot[0];
      NodeWriter *pNode;
      if( nHeight<1 || nHeight>=16                        ){
sqlite3_api->reset   (pSelect);
        return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
      }

      pWriter->nLeafEst = (int)((iEnd - iStart) + 1)/16                       ;
      pWriter->iStart = iStart;
      pWriter->iEnd = iEnd;
      pWriter->iAbsLevel = iAbsLevel;
      pWriter->iIdx = iIdx;

      for(i=nHeight+1; i<16                       ; i++){
        pWriter->aNodeWriter[i].iBlock = pWriter->iStart + i*pWriter->nLeafEst;
      }

      pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[nHeight];
      pNode->iBlock = pWriter->iStart + pWriter->nLeafEst*nHeight;
      blobGrowBuffer(&pNode->block,
((nRoot)>(p->nNodeSize)?(nRoot):(p->nNodeSize))+(10*2),&rc
      );
      if( rc==0         ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pNode->block.a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aRoot); int xxn=(nRoot);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pNode->block.n = nRoot;
        memset(&pNode->block.a[nRoot], 0,(10*2)            );
      }

      for(i=nHeight; i>=0 && rc==0        ; i--){
        NodeReader reader;
        pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[i];

        if( pNode->block.a){
          rc = nodeReaderInit(&reader, pNode->block.a, pNode->block.n);
          while( reader.aNode && rc==0         ) rc = nodeReaderNext(&reader);
          blobGrowBuffer(&pNode->key, reader.term.n, &rc);
          if( rc==0         ){
assert(sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt || (reader.term.n>0 || reader.aNode==0));
            if( reader.term.n>0 ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pNode->key.a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(reader.term.a); int xxn=(reader.term.n);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
            }
            pNode->key.n = reader.term.n;
            if( i>0 ){
              char *aBlock = 0;
              int nBlock = 0;
              pNode = &pWriter->aNodeWriter[i-1];
              pNode->iBlock = reader.iChild;
              rc = sqlite3Fts3ReadBlock(p, reader.iChild, &aBlock, &nBlock,0);
              blobGrowBuffer(&pNode->block,
((nBlock)>(p->nNodeSize)?(nBlock):(p->nNodeSize))+(10*2)     , &rc
                  );
              if( rc==0         ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pNode->block.a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aBlock); int xxn=(nBlock);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
                pNode->block.n = nBlock;
                memset(&pNode->block.a[nBlock], 0,(10*2)            );
              }
sqlite3_api->free         (aBlock);
            }
          }
        }
        nodeReaderRelease(&reader);
      }
    }

    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pSelect);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  return rc;
}










static int fts3IncrmergeOutputIdx(
  Fts3Table *p,

sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pOutputIdx,1, iAbsLevel+1);
sqlite3_api->step(pOutputIdx);
    *piIdx =sqlite3_api->column_int(pOutputIdx,0);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pOutputIdx);

  return rc;
}



























static int fts3IncrmergeWriter(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  int iIdx,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr,
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter
){
  int rc;
  int i;
  int nLeafEst = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pLeafEst = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pFirstBlock = 0;


  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,29                         , &pLeafEst, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pLeafEst,1, iAbsLevel);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pLeafEst,2, pCsr->nSegment);
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pLeafEst)){
      nLeafEst =sqlite3_api->column_int(pLeafEst,0);
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pLeafEst);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;


  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,10                   , &pFirstBlock, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pFirstBlock)){
      pWriter->iStart =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pFirstBlock,0);
      pWriter->iEnd = pWriter->iStart - 1;
      pWriter->iEnd += nLeafEst *16                        ;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pFirstBlock);
  }
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;




  rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, pWriter->iEnd, 0, 0);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

  pWriter->iAbsLevel = iAbsLevel;
  pWriter->nLeafEst = nLeafEst;
  pWriter->iIdx = iIdx;


  for(i=0; i<16                       ; i++){
    pWriter->aNodeWriter[i].iBlock = pWriter->iStart + i*pWriter->nLeafEst;
  }
  return 0        ;
}

sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pDelete,1, iAbsLevel);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pDelete,2, iIdx);
sqlite3_api->step(pDelete);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDelete);

  return rc;
}






static int fts3RepackSegdirLevel(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel
){
  int rc;
  int *aIdx = 0;
  int nIdx = 0;
  int nAlloc = 0;
  int i;
  sqlite3_stmt *pSelect = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pUpdate = 0;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,35                 , &pSelect, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pSelect,1, iAbsLevel);
    while(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pSelect)){
      if( nIdx>=nAlloc ){
        int *aNew;
        nAlloc += 16;
        aNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(aIdx,nAlloc*sizeof(int));
        if( !aNew ){
          rc =7            ;
          break;
        }
        aIdx = aNew;
      }
      aIdx[nIdx++] =sqlite3_api->column_int(pSelect,0);
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pSelect);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,31                     , &pUpdate, 0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pUpdate,2, iAbsLevel);
  }

  assert( p->bIgnoreSavepoint==0 );
  p->bIgnoreSavepoint = 1;
  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nIdx; i++){
    if( aIdx[i]!=i ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int (pUpdate, 3, aIdx[i]);
sqlite3_api->bind_int (pUpdate, 1, i);
sqlite3_api->step (pUpdate);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUpdate);
    }
  }
  p->bIgnoreSavepoint = 0;

sqlite3_api->free(aIdx);
  return rc;
}

static void fts3StartNode(Blob *pNode, int iHeight, sqlite3_int64 iChild){
  pNode->a[0] = (char)iHeight;
  if( iChild ){
    assert( pNode->nAlloc>=1 +sqlite3Fts3VarintLen(iChild));
    pNode->n = 1 + sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pNode->a[1], iChild);
  }else{
    assert( pNode->nAlloc>=1 );
    pNode->n = 1;
  }
}









static int fts3TruncateNode(
  const char *aNode,
  int nNode,
  Blob *pNew,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm,
  sqlite3_int64 *piBlock
){
  NodeReader reader;
  Blob prev = {0, 0, 0};
  int rc =0         ;
  int bLeaf;

  if( nNode<1 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
  bLeaf = aNode[0]=='\0';


  blobGrowBuffer(pNew, nNode, &rc);
  if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  pNew->n = 0;


  for(rc = nodeReaderInit(&reader, aNode, nNode);
      rc==0         && reader.aNode;
      rc = nodeReaderNext(&reader)
  ){
    if( pNew->n==0 ){
      int res = fts3TermCmp(reader.term.a, reader.term.n, zTerm, nTerm);
      if( res<0 || (bLeaf==0 && res==0) ) continue;
      fts3StartNode(pNew, (int)aNode[0], reader.iChild);
      *piBlock = reader.iChild;
    }
    rc = fts3AppendToNode(
        pNew, &prev, reader.term.a, reader.term.n,
        reader.aDoclist, reader.nDoclist
    );
    if( rc!=0         ) break;
  }
  if( pNew->n==0 ){
    fts3StartNode(pNew, (int)aNode[0], reader.iChild);
    *piBlock = reader.iChild;
  }
  assert( pNew->n<=pNew->nAlloc );

  nodeReaderRelease(&reader);
sqlite3_api->free(prev.a);
  return rc;
}










static int fts3TruncateSegment(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  int iIdx,
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Blob root = {0,0,0};
  Blob block = {0,0,0};
  sqlite3_int64 iBlock = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 iNewStart = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 iOldStart = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pFetch = 0;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,32                , &pFetch, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pFetch,1, iAbsLevel);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pFetch,2, iIdx);
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pFetch)){
      const char *aRoot =sqlite3_api->column_blob(pFetch,4);
      int nRoot =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pFetch,4);
      iOldStart =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pFetch,1);
      rc = fts3TruncateNode(aRoot, nRoot, &root, zTerm, nTerm, &iBlock);
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pFetch);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  while( rc==0         && iBlock ){
    char *aBlock = 0;
    int nBlock = 0;
    iNewStart = iBlock;

    rc = sqlite3Fts3ReadBlock(p, iBlock, &aBlock, &nBlock, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3TruncateNode(aBlock, nBlock, &block, zTerm, nTerm, &iBlock);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3WriteSegment(p, iNewStart, block.a, block.n);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(aBlock);
  }


  if( rc==0         && iNewStart ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pDel = 0;
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,17                        , &pDel, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDel, 1, iOldStart);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDel, 2, iNewStart-1);
sqlite3_api->step (pDel);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDel);
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pChomp = 0;
    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,33               , &pChomp, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pChomp, 1, iNewStart);
sqlite3_api->bind_blob (pChomp, 2, root.a, root.n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pChomp, 3, iAbsLevel);
sqlite3_api->bind_int (pChomp, 4, iIdx);
sqlite3_api->step (pChomp);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pChomp);
sqlite3_api->bind_null (pChomp, 2);
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(root.a);
sqlite3_api->free(block.a);
  return rc;
}











static int fts3IncrmergeChomp(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel,
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr,
  int *pnRem
){
  int i;
  int nRem = 0;
  int rc =0         ;

  for(i=pCsr->nSegment-1; i>=0 && rc==0        ; i--){
    Fts3SegReader *pSeg = 0;
    int j;



    for(j=0;(1)                      ; j++){
      pSeg = pCsr->apSegment[j];
      if( pSeg->iIdx==i ) break;
    }
    assert( j<pCsr->nSegment && pSeg->iIdx==i );

    if( pSeg->aNode==0 ){

      rc = fts3DeleteSegment(p, pSeg);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = fts3RemoveSegdirEntry(p, iAbsLevel, pSeg->iIdx);
      }
      *pnRem = 0;
    }else{



      const char *zTerm = pSeg->zTerm;
      int nTerm = pSeg->nTerm;
      rc = fts3TruncateSegment(p, iAbsLevel, pSeg->iIdx, zTerm, nTerm);
      nRem++;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         && nRem!=pCsr->nSegment ){
    rc = fts3RepackSegdirLevel(p, iAbsLevel);
  }

  *pnRem = nRem;
  return rc;
}




static int fts3IncrmergeHintStore(Fts3Table *p, Blob *pHint){
  sqlite3_stmt *pReplace = 0;
  int rc;

  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,23               , &pReplace, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pReplace,1,1                      );
sqlite3_api->bind_blob(pReplace,2, pHint->a, pHint->n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
sqlite3_api->step(pReplace);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pReplace);
sqlite3_api->bind_null(pReplace,2);
  }

  return rc;
}









static int fts3IncrmergeHintLoad(Fts3Table *p, Blob *pHint){
  sqlite3_stmt *pSelect = 0;
  int rc;

  pHint->n = 0;
  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,22              , &pSelect, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pSelect,1,1                      );
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pSelect)){
      const char *aHint =sqlite3_api->column_blob(pSelect,0);
      int nHint =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pSelect,0);
      if( aHint ){
        blobGrowBuffer(pHint, nHint, &rc);
        if( rc==0         ){
          if((1)                  ){char*xxd=(char*)(pHint->a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aHint); int xxn=(nHint);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          pHint->n = nHint;
        }
      }
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pSelect);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  return rc;
}










static void fts3IncrmergeHintPush(
  Blob *pHint,
  i64 iAbsLevel,
  int nInput,
  int *pRc
){
  blobGrowBuffer(pHint, pHint->n + 2*10             , pRc);
  if( *pRc==0         ){
    pHint->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pHint->a[pHint->n], iAbsLevel);
    pHint->n += sqlite3Fts3PutVarint(&pHint->a[pHint->n], (i64)nInput);
  }
}









static int fts3IncrmergeHintPop(Blob *pHint, i64 *piAbsLevel, int *pnInput){
  const int nHint = pHint->n;
  int i;

  i = pHint->n-1;
  if( (pHint->a[i] & 0x80) ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
  while( i>0 && (pHint->a[i-1] & 0x80) ) i--;
  if( i==0 ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
  i--;
  while( i>0 && (pHint->a[i-1] & 0x80) ) i--;

  pHint->n = i;
  i += sqlite3Fts3GetVarint(&pHint->a[i], piAbsLevel);
  i +=( (*(u8*)(&pHint->a[i])&0x80) ? sqlite3Fts3GetVarint32(&pHint->a[i], pnInput) : (*pnInput=*(u8*)(&pHint->a[i]), 1) );
  assert( i<=nHint );
  if( i!=nHint ) return sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();

  return 0        ;
}











static         int sqlite3Fts3Incrmerge(Fts3Table *p, int nMerge, int nMin){
  int rc;
  int nRem = nMerge;
  Fts3MultiSegReader *pCsr;
  Fts3SegFilter *pFilter;
  IncrmergeWriter *pWriter;
  int nSeg = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 iAbsLevel = 0;
  Blob hint = {0, 0, 0};
  int bDirtyHint = 0;


  const int nAlloc = sizeof(*pCsr) + sizeof(*pFilter) + sizeof(*pWriter);
  pWriter = (IncrmergeWriter *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nAlloc);
  if( !pWriter ) return 7           ;
  pFilter = (Fts3SegFilter *)&pWriter[1];
  pCsr = (Fts3MultiSegReader *)&pFilter[1];

  rc = fts3IncrmergeHintLoad(p, &hint);
  while( rc==0         && nRem>0 ){
    const i64 nMod =1024                  * p->nIndex;
    sqlite3_stmt *pFindLevel = 0;
    int bUseHint = 0;
    int iIdx = 0;







    rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,28                   , &pFindLevel, 0);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pFindLevel,1,((2)>(nMin)?(2):(nMin)));
    if(sqlite3_api->step(pFindLevel)==100    ){
      iAbsLevel =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pFindLevel,0);
      nSeg =sqlite3_api->column_int(pFindLevel,1);
      assert( nSeg>=2 );
    }else{
      nSeg = -1;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pFindLevel);






    if( rc==0         && hint.n ){
      int nHint = hint.n;
      sqlite3_int64 iHintAbsLevel = 0;
      int nHintSeg = 0;

      rc = fts3IncrmergeHintPop(&hint, &iHintAbsLevel, &nHintSeg);
      if( nSeg<0 || (iAbsLevel % nMod) >= (iHintAbsLevel % nMod) ){






        iAbsLevel = iHintAbsLevel;
        nSeg =((((nMin)>(nSeg)?(nMin):(nSeg)))<(nHintSeg)?(((nMin)>(nSeg)?(nMin):(nSeg))):(nHintSeg));
        bUseHint = 1;
        bDirtyHint = 1;
      }else{


        hint.n = nHint;
      }
    }




    if( nSeg<=0 ) break;

    assert( nMod<=0x7FFFFFFF );
    if( iAbsLevel<0 || iAbsLevel>(nMod<<32) ){
      rc =sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
      break;
    }







    memset(pWriter, 0, nAlloc);
    pFilter->flags =0x00000001               ;

    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3IncrmergeOutputIdx(p, iAbsLevel, &iIdx);
      assert( bUseHint==1 || bUseHint==0 );
      if( iIdx==0 || (bUseHint && iIdx==1) ){
        int bIgnore = 0;
        rc = fts3SegmentIsMaxLevel(p, iAbsLevel+1, &bIgnore);
        if( bIgnore ){
          pFilter->flags |=0x00000002                ;
        }
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3IncrmergeCsr(p, iAbsLevel, nSeg, pCsr);
    }
    if(0         ==rc && pCsr->nSegment==nSeg
     &&0         ==(rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStart(p, pCsr, pFilter))
    ){
      int bEmpty = 0;
      rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep(p, pCsr);
      if( rc==0         ){
        bEmpty = 1;
      }else if( rc!=100        ){
        sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFinish(pCsr);
        break;
      }
      if( bUseHint && iIdx>0 ){
        const char *zKey = pCsr->zTerm;
        int nKey = pCsr->nTerm;
        rc = fts3IncrmergeLoad(p, iAbsLevel, iIdx-1, zKey, nKey, pWriter);
      }else{
        rc = fts3IncrmergeWriter(p, iAbsLevel, iIdx, pCsr, pWriter);
      }

      if( rc==0         && pWriter->nLeafEst ){
                                     ;
        if( bEmpty==0 ){
          do {
            rc = fts3IncrmergeAppend(p, pWriter, pCsr);
            if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep(p, pCsr);
            if( pWriter->nWork>=nRem && rc==100        ) rc =0         ;
          }while( rc==100        );
        }


        if( rc==0         ){
          nRem -= (1 + pWriter->nWork);
          rc = fts3IncrmergeChomp(p, iAbsLevel, pCsr, &nSeg);
          if( nSeg!=0 ){
            bDirtyHint = 1;
            fts3IncrmergeHintPush(&hint, iAbsLevel, nSeg, &rc);
          }
        }
      }

      if( nSeg!=0 ){
        pWriter->nLeafData = pWriter->nLeafData * -1;
      }
      fts3IncrmergeRelease(p, pWriter, &rc);
      if( nSeg==0 && pWriter->bNoLeafData==0 ){
        fts3PromoteSegments(p, iAbsLevel+1, pWriter->nLeafData);
      }
    }

    sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFinish(pCsr);
  }


  if( bDirtyHint && rc==0         ){
    rc = fts3IncrmergeHintStore(p, &hint);
  }

sqlite3_api->free(pWriter);
sqlite3_api->free(hint.a);
  return rc;
}









static int fts3Getint(const char **pz){
  const char *z = *pz;
  int i = 0;
  while( (*z)>='0' && (*z)<='9' && i<214748363 ) i = 10*i + *(z++) - '0';
  *pz = z;
  return i;
}










static int fts3DoIncrmerge(
  Fts3Table *p,
  const char *zParam
){
  int rc;
  int nMin = (((p)->nMergeCount)/2);
  int nMerge = 0;
  const char *z = zParam;


  nMerge = fts3Getint(&z);



  if( z[0]==',' && z[1]!='\0' ){
    z++;
    nMin = fts3Getint(&z);
  }

  if( z[0]!='\0' || nMin<2 ){
    rc =1            ;
  }else{
    rc =0         ;
    if( !p->bHasStat ){
      assert( p->bFts4==0 );
      sqlite3Fts3CreateStatTable(&rc, p);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sqlite3Fts3Incrmerge(p, nMerge, nMin);
    }
    sqlite3Fts3SegmentsClose(p);
  }
  return rc;
}









static int fts3DoAutoincrmerge(
  Fts3Table *p,
  const char *zParam
){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  p->nAutoincrmerge = fts3Getint(&zParam);
  if( p->nAutoincrmerge==1 || p->nAutoincrmerge>((p)->nMergeCount)){
    p->nAutoincrmerge = 8;
  }
  if( !p->bHasStat ){
    assert( p->bFts4==0 );
    sqlite3Fts3CreateStatTable(&rc, p);
    if( rc ) return rc;
  }
  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,23               , &pStmt, 0);
  if( rc ) return rc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pStmt,1,2                    );
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pStmt,2,p->nAutoincrmerge);
sqlite3_api->step(pStmt);
  rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
  return rc;
}





static u64 fts3ChecksumEntry(
  const char *zTerm,
  int nTerm,
  int iLangid,
  int iIndex,
  i64 iDocid,
  int iCol,
  int iPos
){
  int i;
  u64 ret = (u64)iDocid;

  ret += (ret<<3) + iLangid;
  ret += (ret<<3) + iIndex;
  ret += (ret<<3) + iCol;
  ret += (ret<<3) + iPos;
  for(i=0; i<nTerm; i++) ret += (ret<<3) + zTerm[i];

  return ret;
}










static u64 fts3ChecksumIndex(
  Fts3Table *p,
  int iLangid,
  int iIndex,
  int *pRc
){
  Fts3SegFilter filter;
  Fts3MultiSegReader csr;
  int rc;
  u64 cksum = 0;

  assert( *pRc==0         );

  memset(&filter, 0, sizeof(filter));
  memset(&csr, 0, sizeof(csr));
  filter.flags =0x00000001                |0x00000002               ;
  filter.flags |=0x00000010        ;

  rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderCursor(
      p, iLangid, iIndex,-2                 , 0, 0, 0, 1,&csr
  );
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStart(p, &csr, &filter);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    while(100        ==(rc = sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep(p, &csr)) ){
      char *pCsr = csr.aDoclist;
      char *pEnd = &pCsr[csr.nDoclist];

      i64 iDocid = 0;
      i64 iCol = 0;
      u64 iPos = 0;

      pCsr += sqlite3Fts3GetVarint(pCsr, &iDocid);
      while( pCsr<pEnd ){
        u64 iVal = 0;
        pCsr += sqlite3Fts3GetVarintU(pCsr, &iVal);
        if( pCsr<pEnd ){
          if( iVal==0 || iVal==1 ){
            iCol = 0;
            iPos = 0;
            if( iVal ){
              pCsr += sqlite3Fts3GetVarint(pCsr, &iCol);
            }else{
              pCsr += sqlite3Fts3GetVarintU(pCsr, &iVal);
              if( p->bDescIdx ){
                iDocid = (i64)((u64)iDocid - iVal);
              }else{
                iDocid = (i64)((u64)iDocid + iVal);
              }
            }
          }else{
            iPos += (iVal - 2);
            cksum = cksum ^ fts3ChecksumEntry(
                csr.zTerm, csr.nTerm, iLangid, iIndex, iDocid,
                (int)iCol, (int)iPos
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFinish(&csr);

  *pRc = rc;
  return cksum;
}










static int fts3IntegrityCheck(Fts3Table *p, int *pbOk){
  int rc =0         ;
  u64 cksum1 = 0;
  u64 cksum2 = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pAllLangid = 0;


  rc = fts3SqlStmt(p,27                    , &pAllLangid, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pAllLangid,1, p->iPrevLangid);
sqlite3_api->bind_int(pAllLangid,2, p->nIndex);
    while( rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->step(pAllLangid)==100    ){
      int iLangid =sqlite3_api->column_int(pAllLangid,0);
      int i;
      for(i=0; i<p->nIndex; i++){
        cksum1 = cksum1 ^ fts3ChecksumIndex(p, iLangid, i, &rc);
      }
    }
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pAllLangid);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_tokenizer_module const *pModule = p->pTokenizer->pModule;
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
    char *zSql;

    zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf("SELECT %s",p->zReadExprlist);
    if( !zSql ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(p->db,zSql,-1,&pStmt,0);
sqlite3_api->free (zSql);
    }

    while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      i64 iDocid =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0);
      int iLang = langidFromSelect(p, pStmt);
      int iCol;

      for(iCol=0; rc==0         && iCol<p->nColumn; iCol++){
        if( p->abNotindexed[iCol]==0 ){
          const char *zText = (const char *)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,iCol+1);
          sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor *pT = 0;

          rc = sqlite3Fts3OpenTokenizer(p->pTokenizer, iLang, zText, -1, &pT);
          while( rc==0         ){
            char const *zToken;
            int nToken = 0;
            int iDum1 = 0, iDum2 = 0;
            int iPos = 0;

            rc = pModule->xNext(pT, &zToken, &nToken, &iDum1, &iDum2, &iPos);
            if( rc==0         ){
              int i;
              cksum2 = cksum2 ^ fts3ChecksumEntry(
                  zToken, nToken, iLang, 0, iDocid, iCol, iPos
              );
              for(i=1; i<p->nIndex; i++){
                if( p->aIndex[i].nPrefix<=nToken ){
                  cksum2 = cksum2 ^ fts3ChecksumEntry(
                      zToken, p->aIndex[i].nPrefix, iLang, i, iDocid, iCol, iPos
                  );
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if( pT ) pModule->xClose(pT);
          if( rc==101         ) rc =0         ;
        }
      }
    }

sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
  }

  *pbOk = (cksum1==cksum2);
  return rc;
}
































static int fts3DoIntegrityCheck(
  Fts3Table *p
){
  int rc;
  int bOk = 0;
  rc = fts3IntegrityCheck(p, &bOk);
  if( rc==0         && bOk==0 ) rc =sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
  return rc;
}









static int fts3SpecialInsert(Fts3Table *p, sqlite3_value *pVal){
  int rc =1            ;
  const char *zVal = (const char *)sqlite3_api->value_text(pVal);
  int nVal =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(pVal);

  if( !zVal ){
    return 7           ;
  }else if( nVal==8 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"optimize",8)){
    rc = fts3DoOptimize(p, 0);
  }else if( nVal==7 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"rebuild",7)){
    rc = fts3DoRebuild(p);
  }else if( nVal==15 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"integrity-check",15)){
    rc = fts3DoIntegrityCheck(p);
  }else if( nVal>6 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"merge=",6)){
    rc = fts3DoIncrmerge(p, &zVal[6]);
  }else if( nVal>10 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"automerge=",10)){
    rc = fts3DoAutoincrmerge(p, &zVal[10]);

  }else{
    int v;
    if( nVal>9 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"nodesize=",9)){
      v = atoi(&zVal[9]);
      if( v>=24 && v<=p->nPgsz-35 ) p->nNodeSize = v;
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( nVal>11 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"maxpending=",9)){
      v = atoi(&zVal[11]);
      if( v>=64 && v<=(1*1024*1024)         ) p->nMaxPendingData = v;
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( nVal>21 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"test-no-incr-doclist=",21)){
      p->bNoIncrDoclist = atoi(&zVal[21]);
      rc =0         ;
    }else if( nVal>11 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zVal,"mergecount=",11)){
      v = atoi(&zVal[11]);
      if( v>=4 && v<=16               && (v&1)==0 ) p->nMergeCount = v;
      rc =0         ;
    }

  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts3DeleteByRowid(
  Fts3Table *p,
  sqlite3_value *pRowid,
  int *pnChng,
  u32 *aSzDel
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int bFound = 0;

  fts3DeleteTerms(&rc, p, pRowid, aSzDel, &bFound);
  if( bFound && rc==0         ){
    int isEmpty = 0;
    rc = fts3IsEmpty(p, pRowid, &isEmpty);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( isEmpty ){



        rc = fts3DeleteAll(p, 1);
        *pnChng = 0;
        memset(aSzDel, 0, sizeof(u32) * (p->nColumn+1) * 2);
      }else{
        *pnChng = *pnChng - 1;
        if( p->zContentTbl==0 ){
          fts3SqlExec(&rc, p,0                  , &pRowid);
        }
        if( p->bHasDocsize ){
          fts3SqlExec(&rc, p,19                 , &pRowid);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}














static         int sqlite3Fts3UpdateMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apVal,
  sqlite_int64 *pRowid
){
  Fts3Table *p = (Fts3Table *)pVtab;
  int rc =0         ;
  u32 *aSzIns = 0;
  u32 *aSzDel = 0;
  int nChng = 0;
  int bInsertDone = 0;



  assert( p->bHasStat==0 || p->bHasStat==1 );

  assert( p->pSegments==0 );
  assert(
      nArg==1
   || nArg==(2 + p->nColumn + 3)
  );





  if( nArg>1
   &&sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0])==5
   &&sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[p->nColumn+2])!=5
  ){
    rc = fts3SpecialInsert(p, apVal[p->nColumn+2]);
    goto update_out;
  }

  if( nArg>1 &&sqlite3_api->value_int(apVal[2 +p->nColumn+2])<0){
    rc =19                ;
    goto update_out;
  }


  aSzDel =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(aSzDel[0])*((sqlite3_int64)p->nColumn+1)*2);
  if( aSzDel==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
    goto update_out;
  }
  aSzIns = &aSzDel[p->nColumn+1];
  memset(aSzDel, 0, sizeof(aSzDel[0])*(p->nColumn+1)*2);

  rc = fts3Writelock(p);
  if( rc!=0         ) goto update_out;










  if( nArg>1 && p->zContentTbl==0 ){

    sqlite3_value *pNewRowid = apVal[3 +p->nColumn];
    if(sqlite3_api->value_type(pNewRowid)==5       ){
      pNewRowid = apVal[1];
    }

    if(sqlite3_api->value_type(pNewRowid)!=5       && (
sqlite3_api->value_type   (apVal[0])==5
     ||sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[0])!=sqlite3_api->value_int64(pNewRowid)
    )){

















      if(sqlite3_api->vtab_on_conflict(p->db)==5          ){
        rc = fts3DeleteByRowid(p, pNewRowid, &nChng, aSzDel);
      }else{
        rc = fts3InsertData(p, apVal, pRowid);
        bInsertDone = 1;
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc!=0         ){
    goto update_out;
  }


  if(sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0])!=5       ){
    assert(sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0])==1          );
    rc = fts3DeleteByRowid(p, apVal[0], &nChng, aSzDel);
  }


  if( nArg>1 && rc==0         ){
    int iLangid =sqlite3_api->value_int(apVal[2 +p->nColumn+2]);
    if( bInsertDone==0 ){
      rc = fts3InsertData(p, apVal, pRowid);
      if( rc==19                && p->zContentTbl==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3Fts3Corrupt();
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts3PendingTermsDocid(p, 0, iLangid, *pRowid);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      assert( p->iPrevDocid==*pRowid );
      rc = fts3InsertTerms(p, iLangid, apVal, aSzIns);
    }
    if( p->bHasDocsize ){
      fts3InsertDocsize(&rc, p, aSzIns);
    }
    nChng++;
  }

  if( p->bFts4 ){
    fts3UpdateDocTotals(&rc, p, aSzIns, aSzDel, nChng);
  }

 update_out:
sqlite3_api->free(aSzDel);
  sqlite3Fts3SegmentsClose(p);
  return rc;
}






static         int sqlite3Fts3Optimize(Fts3Table *p){
  int rc;
  rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->db,"SAVEPOINT fts3",0,0,0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts3DoOptimize(p, 1);
    if( rc==0         || rc==101         ){
      int rc2 =sqlite3_api->exec(p->db,"RELEASE fts3",0,0,0);
      if( rc2!=0         ) rc = rc2;
    }else{
sqlite3_api->exec (p->db, "ROLLBACK TO fts3", 0, 0, 0);
sqlite3_api->exec (p->db, "RELEASE fts3", 0, 0, 0);
    }
  }
  sqlite3Fts3SegmentsClose(p);
  return rc;
}

























typedef sqlite3_int64 i64;

};
