static void jsonArrayStep(
  sqlite3_context *ctx,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  JsonString *pStr;
(void)(argc)            ;
  pStr = (JsonString*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(ctx,sizeof(*pStr));
  if( pStr ){
    if( pStr->zBuf==0 ){
      jsonInit(pStr, ctx);
      jsonAppendChar(pStr, '[');
    }else if( pStr->nUsed>1 ){
      jsonAppendChar(pStr, ',');
    }
    pStr->pCtx = ctx;
    jsonAppendValue(pStr, argv[0]);
  }
}
static void jsonArrayCompute(sqlite3_context *ctx, int isFinal){
  JsonString *pStr;
  pStr = (JsonString*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(ctx,0);
  if( pStr ){
    pStr->pCtx = ctx;
    jsonAppendChar(pStr, ']');
    if( pStr->bErr ){
      if( pStr->bErr==1 )sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(ctx);
      assert( pStr->bStatic );
    }else if( isFinal ){
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, pStr->zBuf, (int)pStr->nUsed,
                          pStr->bStatic ?((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1):sqlite3_api->free);
      pStr->bStatic = 1;
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, pStr->zBuf, (int)pStr->nUsed,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
      pStr->nUsed--;
    }
  }else{
sqlite3_api->result_text(ctx,"[]", 2,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
  }
sqlite3_api->result_subtype(ctx,74        );
}
static void jsonArrayValue(sqlite3_context *ctx){
  jsonArrayCompute(ctx, 0);
}
static void jsonArrayFinal(sqlite3_context *ctx){
  jsonArrayCompute(ctx, 1);
}








static void jsonGroupInverse(
  sqlite3_context *ctx,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  unsigned int i;
  int inStr = 0;
  int nNest = 0;
  char *z;
  char c;
  JsonString *pStr;
(void)(argc)            ;
(void)(argv)            ;
  pStr = (JsonString*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(ctx,0);



  if((0)           ) return;

  z = pStr->zBuf;
  for(i=1; i<pStr->nUsed && ((c = z[i])!=',' || inStr || nNest); i++){
    if( c=='"' ){
      inStr = !inStr;
    }else if( c=='\\' ){
      i++;
    }else if( !inStr ){
      if( c=='{' || c=='[' ) nNest++;
      if( c=='}' || c==']' ) nNest--;
    }
  }
  if( i<pStr->nUsed ){
    pStr->nUsed -= i;
    memmove(&z[1], &z[i+1], (size_t)pStr->nUsed-1);
    z[pStr->nUsed] = 0;
  }else{
    pStr->nUsed = 1;
  }
}

  }
}

typedef struct JsonEachCursor JsonEachCursor;
struct JsonEachCursor {
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor base;
  u32 iRowid;
  u32 iBegin;
  u32 i;
  u32 iEnd;
  u8 eType;
  u8 bRecursive;
  char *zJson;
  char *zRoot;
  JsonParse sParse;
};


static int jsonEachConnect(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  sqlite3_vtab *pNew;
  int rc;
















(void)(pzErr)            ;
(void)(argv)            ;
(void)(argc)            ;
(void)(pAux)            ;
  rc =sqlite3_api->declare_vtab(db,
     "CREATE TABLE x(key,value,type,atom,id,parent,fullkey,path,"
                    "json HIDDEN,root HIDDEN)");
  if( rc==0         ){
    pNew = *ppVtab =sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(*pNew));
    if( pNew==0 ) return 7           ;
    memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(*pNew));
sqlite3_api->vtab_config(db,2                    );
  }
  return rc;
}


static int jsonEachDisconnect(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
sqlite3_api->free(pVtab);
  return 0        ;
}


static int jsonEachOpenEach(sqlite3_vtab *p, sqlite3_vtab_cursor **ppCursor){
  JsonEachCursor *pCur;

(void)(p)            ;
  pCur =sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(*pCur));
  if( pCur==0 ) return 7           ;
  memset(pCur, 0, sizeof(*pCur));
  *ppCursor = &pCur->base;
  return 0        ;
}


static int jsonEachOpenTree(sqlite3_vtab *p, sqlite3_vtab_cursor **ppCursor){
  int rc = jsonEachOpenEach(p, ppCursor);
  if( rc==0         ){
    JsonEachCursor *pCur = (JsonEachCursor*)*ppCursor;
    pCur->bRecursive = 1;
  }
  return rc;
}



static void jsonEachCursorReset(JsonEachCursor *p){
sqlite3_api->free(p->zJson);
sqlite3_api->free(p->zRoot);
  jsonParseReset(&p->sParse);
  p->iRowid = 0;
  p->i = 0;
  p->iEnd = 0;
  p->eType = 0;
  p->zJson = 0;
  p->zRoot = 0;
}


static int jsonEachClose(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur){
  JsonEachCursor *p = (JsonEachCursor*)cur;
  jsonEachCursorReset(p);
sqlite3_api->free(cur);
  return 0        ;
}



static int jsonEachEof(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur){
  JsonEachCursor *p = (JsonEachCursor*)cur;
  return p->i >= p->iEnd;
}


static int jsonEachNext(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur){
  JsonEachCursor *p = (JsonEachCursor*)cur;
  if( p->bRecursive ){
    if( p->sParse.aNode[p->i].jnFlags &0x40         ) p->i++;
    p->i++;
    p->iRowid++;
    if( p->i<p->iEnd ){
      u32 iUp = p->sParse.aUp[p->i];
      JsonNode *pUp = &p->sParse.aNode[iUp];
      p->eType = pUp->eType;
      if( pUp->eType==6          ){
        assert( pUp->eU==0 || pUp->eU==3 );
if( pUp->eU==3 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
                          ;
        if( iUp==p->i-1 ){
          pUp->u.iKey = 0;
        }else{
          pUp->u.iKey++;
        }
      }
    }
  }else{
    switch( p->eType ){
      case 6         : {
        p->i += jsonNodeSize(&p->sParse.aNode[p->i]);
        p->iRowid++;
        break;
      }
      case 7          : {
        p->i += 1 + jsonNodeSize(&p->sParse.aNode[p->i+1]);
        p->iRowid++;
        break;
      }
      default: {
        p->i = p->iEnd;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0        ;
}




static void jsonAppendObjectPathElement(
  JsonString *pStr,
  JsonNode *pNode
){
  int jj, nn;
  const char *z;
  assert( pNode->eType==5           );
  assert( pNode->jnFlags &0x40         );
  assert( pNode->eU==1 );
  z = pNode->u.zJContent;
  nn = pNode->n;
  assert( nn>=2 );
  assert( z[0]=='"' );
  assert( z[nn-1]=='"' );
  if( nn>2 &&(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(z[1])]&0x02)){
    for(jj=2; jj<nn-1 &&(sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(z[jj])]&0x06);jj++){}
    if( jj==nn-1 ){
      z++;
      nn -= 2;
    }
  }
  jsonPrintf(nn+2, pStr, ".%.*s", nn, z);
}



static void jsonEachComputePath(
  JsonEachCursor *p,
  JsonString *pStr,
  u32 i
){
  JsonNode *pNode, *pUp;
  u32 iUp;
  if( i==0 ){
    jsonAppendChar(pStr, '$');
    return;
  }
  iUp = p->sParse.aUp[i];
  jsonEachComputePath(p, pStr, iUp);
  pNode = &p->sParse.aNode[i];
  pUp = &p->sParse.aNode[iUp];
  if( pUp->eType==6          ){
    assert( pUp->eU==3 || (pUp->eU==0 && pUp->u.iKey==0) );
if( pUp->eU==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    jsonPrintf(30, pStr, "[%d]", pUp->u.iKey);
  }else{
    assert( pUp->eType==7           );
    if( (pNode->jnFlags &0x40        )==0 ) pNode--;
    jsonAppendObjectPathElement(pStr, pNode);
  }
}


static int jsonEachColumn(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur,
  sqlite3_context *ctx,
  int i
){
  JsonEachCursor *p = (JsonEachCursor*)cur;
  JsonNode *pThis = &p->sParse.aNode[p->i];
  switch( i ){
    case 0        : {
      if( p->i==0 ) break;
      if( p->eType==7           ){
        jsonReturn(pThis, ctx, 0);
      }else if( p->eType==6          ){
        u32 iKey;
        if( p->bRecursive ){
          if( p->iRowid==0 ) break;
          assert( p->sParse.aNode[p->sParse.aUp[p->i]].eU==3 );
          iKey = p->sParse.aNode[p->sParse.aUp[p->i]].u.iKey;
        }else{
          iKey = p->iRowid;
        }
sqlite3_api->result_int64   (ctx, (sqlite3_int64)iKey);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 1          : {
      if( pThis->jnFlags &0x40         ) pThis++;
      jsonReturn(pThis, ctx, 0);
      break;
    }
    case 2         : {
      if( pThis->jnFlags &0x40         ) pThis++;
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, jsonType[pThis->eType], -1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
      break;
    }
    case 3         : {
      if( pThis->jnFlags &0x40         ) pThis++;
      if( pThis->eType>=6          ) break;
      jsonReturn(pThis, ctx, 0);
      break;
    }
    case 4       : {
sqlite3_api->result_int64 (ctx,
         (sqlite3_int64)p->i + ((pThis->jnFlags &0x40        )!=0));
      break;
    }
    case 5           : {
      if( p->i>p->iBegin && p->bRecursive ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64   (ctx, (sqlite3_int64)p->sParse.aUp[p->i]);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 6            : {
      JsonString x;
      jsonInit(&x, ctx);
      if( p->bRecursive ){
        jsonEachComputePath(p, &x, p->i);
      }else{
        if( p->zRoot ){
          jsonAppendRaw(&x, p->zRoot, (int)strlen(p->zRoot));
        }else{
          jsonAppendChar(&x, '$');
        }
        if( p->eType==6          ){
          jsonPrintf(30, &x, "[%d]", p->iRowid);
        }else if( p->eType==7           ){
          jsonAppendObjectPathElement(&x, pThis);
        }
      }
      jsonResult(&x);
      break;
    }
    case 7         : {
      if( p->bRecursive ){
        JsonString x;
        jsonInit(&x, ctx);
        jsonEachComputePath(p, &x, p->sParse.aUp[p->i]);
        jsonResult(&x);
        break;
      }


__attribute__((fallthrough));
    }
    default: {
      const char *zRoot = p->zRoot;
      if( zRoot==0 ) zRoot = "$";
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, zRoot, -1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
      break;
    }
    case 8         : {
      assert( i==8          );
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, p->sParse.zJson, -1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
      break;
    }
  }
  return 0        ;
}

  *pRowid = p->iRowid;

}






static int jsonEachBestIndex(
  sqlite3_vtab *tab,
  sqlite3_index_info *pIdxInfo
){
  int i;
  int aIdx[2];
  int unusableMask = 0;
  int idxMask = 0;
  const struct sqlite3_index_constraint *pConstraint;



  assert(9           ==8          +1 );
(void)(tab)            ;
  aIdx[0] = aIdx[1] = -1;
  pConstraint = pIdxInfo->aConstraint;
  for(i=0; i<pIdxInfo->nConstraint; i++, pConstraint++){
    int iCol;
    int iMask;
    if( pConstraint->iColumn <8           ) continue;
    iCol = pConstraint->iColumn -8          ;
    assert( iCol==0 || iCol==1 );
if( iCol==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
    iMask = 1 << iCol;
    if( pConstraint->usable==0 ){
      unusableMask |= iMask;
    }else if( pConstraint->op==2                          ){
      aIdx[iCol] = i;
      idxMask |= iMask;
    }
  }
  if( pIdxInfo->nOrderBy>0
   && pIdxInfo->aOrderBy[0].iColumn<0
   && pIdxInfo->aOrderBy[0].desc==0
  ){
    pIdxInfo->orderByConsumed = 1;
  }

  if( (unusableMask & ~idxMask)!=0 ){


    return 19               ;
  }
  if( aIdx[0]<0 ){



    pIdxInfo->idxNum = 0;
  }else{
    pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = 1.0;
    i = aIdx[0];
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = 1;
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].omit = 1;
    if( aIdx[1]<0 ){
      pIdxInfo->idxNum = 1;
    }else{
      i = aIdx[1];
      pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = 2;
      pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].omit = 1;
      pIdxInfo->idxNum = 3;
    }
  }
  return 0        ;
}


static int jsonEachFilter(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur,
  int idxNum, const char *idxStr,
  int argc, sqlite3_value **argv
){
  JsonEachCursor *p = (JsonEachCursor*)cur;
  const char *z;
  const char *zRoot = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 n;

(void)(idxStr)            ;
(void)(argc)            ;
  jsonEachCursorReset(p);
  if( idxNum==0 ) return 0        ;
  z = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[0]);
  if( z==0 ) return 0        ;
  n =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(argv[0]);
  p->zJson =sqlite3_api->malloc64(n+1);
  if( p->zJson==0 ) return 7           ;
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zJson);const char*xxs=(const char*)(z); int xxn=((size_t)n+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  if( jsonParse(&p->sParse, 0, p->zJson) ){
    int rc =7            ;
    if( p->sParse.oom==0 ){

      cur->pVtab->zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("malformed JSON");
      if( cur->pVtab->zErrMsg ) rc =1            ;
    }
    jsonEachCursorReset(p);
    return rc;
  }else if( p->bRecursive && jsonParseFindParents(&p->sParse) ){
    jsonEachCursorReset(p);
    return 7           ;
  }else{
    JsonNode *pNode = 0;
    if( idxNum==3 ){
      const char *zErr = 0;
      zRoot = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[1]);
      if( zRoot==0 ) return 0        ;
      n =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(argv[1]);
      p->zRoot =sqlite3_api->malloc64(n+1);
      if( p->zRoot==0 ) return 7           ;
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zRoot);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zRoot); int xxn=((size_t)n+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      if( zRoot[0]!='$' ){
        zErr = zRoot;
      }else{
        pNode = jsonLookupStep(&p->sParse, 0, p->zRoot+1, 0, &zErr);
      }
      if( zErr ){
sqlite3_api->free   (cur->pVtab->zErrMsg);
        cur->pVtab->zErrMsg = jsonPathSyntaxError(zErr);
        jsonEachCursorReset(p);
        return cur->pVtab->zErrMsg ?1             :7            ;
      }else if( pNode==0 ){
        return 0        ;
      }
    }else{
      pNode = p->sParse.aNode;
    }
    p->iBegin = p->i = (int)(pNode - p->sParse.aNode);
    p->eType = pNode->eType;
    if( p->eType>=6          ){
      assert( pNode->eU==0 );
                          ;
      pNode->u.iKey = 0;
      p->iEnd = p->i + pNode->n + 1;
      if( p->bRecursive ){
        p->eType = p->sParse.aNode[p->sParse.aUp[p->i]].eType;
        if( p->i>0 && (p->sParse.aNode[p->i-1].jnFlags &0x40        )!=0 ){
          p->i--;
        }
      }else{
        p->i++;
      }
    }else{
      p->iEnd = p->i+1;
    }
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static void nodeReference(RtreeNode *p){
  if( p ){
    assert( p->nRef>0 );
    p->nRef++;
  }
}




static void nodeZero(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *p){
  memset(&p->zData[2], 0, pRtree->iNodeSize-2);
  p->isDirty = 1;
}





static unsigned int nodeHash(i64 iNode){
  return ((unsigned)iNode) %97       ;
}





static RtreeNode *nodeHashLookup(Rtree *pRtree, i64 iNode){
  RtreeNode *p;
  for(p=pRtree->aHash[nodeHash(iNode)]; p && p->iNode!=iNode; p=p->pNext);
  return p;
}




static void nodeHashInsert(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  int iHash;
  assert( pNode->pNext==0 );
  iHash = nodeHash(pNode->iNode);
  pNode->pNext = pRtree->aHash[iHash];
  pRtree->aHash[iHash] = pNode;
}




static void nodeHashDelete(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  RtreeNode **pp;
  if( pNode->iNode!=0 ){
    pp = &pRtree->aHash[nodeHash(pNode->iNode)];
    for( ; (*pp)!=pNode; pp = &(*pp)->pNext){ assert(*pp); }
    *pp = pNode->pNext;
    pNode->pNext = 0;
  }
}







static RtreeNode *nodeNew(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pParent){
  RtreeNode *pNode;
  pNode = (RtreeNode *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(RtreeNode)+pRtree->iNodeSize);
  if( pNode ){
    memset(pNode, 0, sizeof(RtreeNode) + pRtree->iNodeSize);
    pNode->zData = (u8 *)&pNode[1];
    pNode->nRef = 1;
    pRtree->nNodeRef++;
    pNode->pParent = pParent;
    pNode->isDirty = 1;
    nodeReference(pParent);
  }
  return pNode;
}




static void nodeBlobReset(Rtree *pRtree){
  if( pRtree->pNodeBlob && pRtree->inWrTrans==0 && pRtree->nCursor==0 ){
    sqlite3_blob *pBlob = pRtree->pNodeBlob;
    pRtree->pNodeBlob = 0;
sqlite3_api->blob_close(pBlob);
  }
}




static int nodeAcquire(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  i64 iNode,
  RtreeNode *pParent,
  RtreeNode **ppNode
){
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeNode *pNode = 0;




  if( (pNode = nodeHashLookup(pRtree, iNode))!=0 ){
    if( pParent && pParent!=pNode->pParent ){
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
      return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
    }
    pNode->nRef++;
    *ppNode = pNode;
    return 0        ;
  }

  if( pRtree->pNodeBlob ){
    sqlite3_blob *pBlob = pRtree->pNodeBlob;
    pRtree->pNodeBlob = 0;
    rc =sqlite3_api->blob_reopen(pBlob,iNode);
    pRtree->pNodeBlob = pBlob;
    if( rc ){
      nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
      if( rc==7            ) return 7           ;
    }
  }
  if( pRtree->pNodeBlob==0 ){
    char *zTab =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s_node",pRtree->zName);
    if( zTab==0 ) return 7           ;
    rc =sqlite3_api->blob_open(pRtree->db,pRtree->zDb,zTab,"data",iNode, 0,
                           &pRtree->pNodeBlob);
sqlite3_api->free(zTab);
  }
  if( rc ){
    nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
    *ppNode = 0;


    if( rc==1            ){
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
    }
  }else if( pRtree->iNodeSize==sqlite3_api->blob_bytes(pRtree->pNodeBlob)){
    pNode = (RtreeNode *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(RtreeNode)+pRtree->iNodeSize);
    if( !pNode ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      pNode->pParent = pParent;
      pNode->zData = (u8 *)&pNode[1];
      pNode->nRef = 1;
      pRtree->nNodeRef++;
      pNode->iNode = iNode;
      pNode->isDirty = 0;
      pNode->pNext = 0;
      rc =sqlite3_api->blob_read(pRtree->pNodeBlob,pNode->zData,
                             pRtree->iNodeSize, 0);
    }
  }







  if( rc==0         && pNode && iNode==1 ){
    pRtree->iDepth = readInt16(pNode->zData);
    if( pRtree->iDepth>40              ){
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
    }
  }





  if( pNode && rc==0         ){
    if(readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2])>((pRtree->iNodeSize-4)/pRtree->nBytesPerCell)){
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( pNode!=0 ){
      nodeReference(pParent);
      nodeHashInsert(pRtree, pNode);
    }else{
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
    }
    *ppNode = pNode;
  }else{
    if( pNode ){
      pRtree->nNodeRef--;
sqlite3_api->free (pNode);
    }
    *ppNode = 0;
  }

  return rc;
}




static void nodeOverwriteCell(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell,
  int iCell
){
  int ii;
  u8 *p = &pNode->zData[4 + pRtree->nBytesPerCell*iCell];
  p += writeInt64(p, pCell->iRowid);
  for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nDim2; ii++){
    p += writeCoord(p, &pCell->aCoord[ii]);
  }
  pNode->isDirty = 1;
}




static void nodeDeleteCell(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode, int iCell){
  u8 *pDst = &pNode->zData[4 + pRtree->nBytesPerCell*iCell];
  u8 *pSrc = &pDst[pRtree->nBytesPerCell];
  int nByte = (readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2])-iCell-1)*pRtree->nBytesPerCell;
  memmove(pDst, pSrc, nByte);
  writeInt16(&pNode->zData[2],readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2])-1);
  pNode->isDirty = 1;
}







static int nodeInsertCell(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell
){
  int nCell;
  int nMaxCell;

  nMaxCell = (pRtree->iNodeSize-4)/pRtree->nBytesPerCell;
  nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);

  assert( nCell<=nMaxCell );
  if( nCell<nMaxCell ){
    nodeOverwriteCell(pRtree, pNode, pCell, nCell);
    writeInt16(&pNode->zData[2], nCell+1);
    pNode->isDirty = 1;
  }

  return (nCell==nMaxCell);
}




static int nodeWrite(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pNode->isDirty ){
    sqlite3_stmt *p = pRtree->pWriteNode;
    if( pNode->iNode ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (p, 1, pNode->iNode);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->bind_null (p, 1);
    }
sqlite3_api->bind_blob(p,2, pNode->zData, pRtree->iNodeSize,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
sqlite3_api->step(p);
    pNode->isDirty = 0;
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(p);
sqlite3_api->bind_null(p,2);
    if( pNode->iNode==0 && rc==0         ){
      pNode->iNode =sqlite3_api->last_insert_rowid(pRtree->db);
      nodeHashInsert(pRtree, pNode);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}





static int nodeRelease(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pNode ){
    assert( pNode->nRef>0 );
    assert( pRtree->nNodeRef>0 );
    pNode->nRef--;
    if( pNode->nRef==0 ){
      pRtree->nNodeRef--;
      if( pNode->iNode==1 ){
        pRtree->iDepth = -1;
      }
      if( pNode->pParent ){
        rc = nodeRelease(pRtree, pNode->pParent);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = nodeWrite(pRtree, pNode);
      }
      nodeHashDelete(pRtree, pNode);
sqlite3_api->free (pNode);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}






static i64 nodeGetRowid(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  int iCell
){
  assert( iCell<readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]));
  return readInt64(&pNode->zData[4 + pRtree->nBytesPerCell*iCell]);
}




static void nodeGetCoord(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  int iCell,
  int iCoord,
  RtreeCoord *pCoord
){
  readCoord(&pNode->zData[12 + pRtree->nBytesPerCell*iCell + 4*iCoord], pCoord);
}





static void nodeGetCell(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  int iCell,
  RtreeCell *pCell
){
  u8 *pData;
  RtreeCoord *pCoord;
  int ii = 0;
  pCell->iRowid = nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pNode, iCell);
  pData = pNode->zData + (12 + pRtree->nBytesPerCell*iCell);
  pCoord = pCell->aCoord;
  do{
    readCoord(pData, &pCoord[ii]);
    readCoord(pData+4, &pCoord[ii+1]);
    pData += 8;
    ii += 2;
  }while( ii<pRtree->nDim2 );
}





static int rtreeInit(
  sqlite3 *, void *, int, const char *const*, sqlite3_vtab **, char **, int
);




static int rtreeCreate(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return rtreeInit(db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr, 1);
}




static int rtreeConnect(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return rtreeInit(db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr, 0);
}




static void rtreeReference(Rtree *pRtree){
  pRtree->nBusy++;
}





static void rtreeRelease(Rtree *pRtree){
  pRtree->nBusy--;
  if( pRtree->nBusy==0 ){
    pRtree->inWrTrans = 0;
    assert( pRtree->nCursor==0 );
    nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
    assert( pRtree->nNodeRef==0 || pRtree->bCorrupt );
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pWriteNode);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pDeleteNode);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pReadRowid);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pWriteRowid);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pDeleteRowid);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pReadParent);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pWriteParent);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pDeleteParent);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pRtree->pWriteAux);
sqlite3_api->free(pRtree->zReadAuxSql);
sqlite3_api->free(pRtree);
  }
}




static int rtreeDisconnect(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  rtreeRelease((Rtree *)pVtab);
  return 0        ;
}




static int rtreeDestroy(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  int rc;
  char *zCreate =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
    "DROP TABLE '%q'.'%q_node';"
    "DROP TABLE '%q'.'%q_rowid';"
    "DROP TABLE '%q'.'%q_parent';",
    pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName,
    pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName,
    pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName
  );
  if( !zCreate ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(pRtree->db,zCreate,0,0,0);
sqlite3_api->free(zCreate);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  }

  return rc;
}




static int rtreeOpen(sqlite3_vtab *pVTab, sqlite3_vtab_cursor **ppCursor){
  int rc =7            ;
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVTab;
  RtreeCursor *pCsr;

  pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(RtreeCursor));
  if( pCsr ){
    memset(pCsr, 0, sizeof(RtreeCursor));
    pCsr->base.pVtab = pVTab;
    rc =0         ;
    pRtree->nCursor++;
  }
  *ppCursor = (sqlite3_vtab_cursor *)pCsr;

  return rc;
}





static void resetCursor(RtreeCursor *pCsr){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  int ii;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  if( pCsr->aConstraint ){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<pCsr->nConstraint; i++){
      sqlite3_rtree_query_info *pInfo = pCsr->aConstraint[i].pInfo;
      if( pInfo ){
        if( pInfo->xDelUser ) pInfo->xDelUser(pInfo->pUser);
sqlite3_api->free   (pInfo);
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->aConstraint);
    pCsr->aConstraint = 0;
  }
  for(ii=0; ii<5             ; ii++) nodeRelease(pRtree, pCsr->aNode[ii]);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->aPoint);
  pStmt = pCsr->pReadAux;
  memset(pCsr, 0, sizeof(RtreeCursor));
  pCsr->base.pVtab = (sqlite3_vtab*)pRtree;
  pCsr->pReadAux = pStmt;

}




static int rtreeClose(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)(cur->pVtab);
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)cur;
  assert( pRtree->nCursor>0 );
  resetCursor(pCsr);
sqlite3_api->finalize(pCsr->pReadAux);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr);
  pRtree->nCursor--;
  nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
  return 0        ;
}







static int rtreeEof(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur){
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)cur;
  return pCsr->atEOF;
}



















































static int rtreeCallbackConstraint(
  RtreeConstraint *pConstraint,
  int eInt,
  u8 *pCellData,
  RtreeSearchPoint *pSearch,
  sqlite3_rtree_dbl *prScore,
  int *peWithin
){
  sqlite3_rtree_query_info *pInfo = pConstraint->pInfo;
  int nCoord = pInfo->nCoord;
  int rc;
  RtreeCoord c;
  sqlite3_rtree_dbl aCoord[5                   *2];

  assert( pConstraint->op==0x46        || pConstraint->op==0x47        );
  assert( nCoord==2 || nCoord==4 || nCoord==6 || nCoord==8 || nCoord==10 );

  if( pConstraint->op==0x47        && pSearch->iLevel==1 ){
    pInfo->iRowid = readInt64(pCellData);
  }
  pCellData += 8;

  if( eInt==0 ){
    switch( nCoord ){
      case 10:  readCoord(pCellData+36, &c); aCoord[9] = c.f;
                readCoord(pCellData+32, &c); aCoord[8] = c.f;
      case 8:   readCoord(pCellData+28, &c); aCoord[7] = c.f;
                readCoord(pCellData+24, &c); aCoord[6] = c.f;
      case 6:   readCoord(pCellData+20, &c); aCoord[5] = c.f;
                readCoord(pCellData+16, &c); aCoord[4] = c.f;
      case 4:   readCoord(pCellData+12, &c); aCoord[3] = c.f;
                readCoord(pCellData+8,  &c); aCoord[2] = c.f;
      default:  readCoord(pCellData+4,  &c); aCoord[1] = c.f;
                readCoord(pCellData,    &c); aCoord[0] = c.f;
    }
  }else

  {
    switch( nCoord ){
      case 10:  readCoord(pCellData+36, &c); aCoord[9] = c.i;
                readCoord(pCellData+32, &c); aCoord[8] = c.i;
      case 8:   readCoord(pCellData+28, &c); aCoord[7] = c.i;
                readCoord(pCellData+24, &c); aCoord[6] = c.i;
      case 6:   readCoord(pCellData+20, &c); aCoord[5] = c.i;
                readCoord(pCellData+16, &c); aCoord[4] = c.i;
      case 4:   readCoord(pCellData+12, &c); aCoord[3] = c.i;
                readCoord(pCellData+8,  &c); aCoord[2] = c.i;
      default:  readCoord(pCellData+4,  &c); aCoord[1] = c.i;
                readCoord(pCellData,    &c); aCoord[0] = c.i;
    }
  }
  if( pConstraint->op==0x46        ){
    int eWithin = 0;
    rc = pConstraint->u.xGeom((sqlite3_rtree_geometry*)pInfo,
                              nCoord, aCoord, &eWithin);
    if( eWithin==0 ) *peWithin =0          ;
    *prScore =0          ;
  }else{
    pInfo->aCoord = aCoord;
    pInfo->iLevel = pSearch->iLevel - 1;
    pInfo->rScore = pInfo->rParentScore = pSearch->rScore;
    pInfo->eWithin = pInfo->eParentWithin = pSearch->eWithin;
    rc = pConstraint->u.xQueryFunc(pInfo);
    if( pInfo->eWithin<*peWithin ) *peWithin = pInfo->eWithin;
    if( pInfo->rScore<*prScore || *prScore<0          ){
      *prScore = pInfo->rScore;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}






static void rtreeNonleafConstraint(
  RtreeConstraint *p,
  int eInt,
  u8 *pCellData,
  int *peWithin
){
  sqlite3_rtree_dbl val;




  pCellData += 8 + 4*(p->iCoord&0xfe);

  assert(p->op==0x42     || p->op==0x43     || p->op==0x44
      || p->op==0x45     || p->op==0x41     || p->op==0x3f
      || p->op==0x40        );
  assert( (((sqlite3_uint64)pCellData)&3)==0 );
  switch( p->op ){
    case 0x3f      :  return;
    case 0x40       : break;
    case 0x41    :
{ RtreeCoord c; c.u = _byteswap_ulong(*(u32*)pCellData); val = eInt ? (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.i : (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.f; };

      if( p->u.rValue>=val ){
        pCellData += 4;
{ RtreeCoord c; c.u = _byteswap_ulong(*(u32*)pCellData); val = eInt ? (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.i : (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.f; };

        if( p->u.rValue<=val ) return;
      }
      break;
    case 0x42    :
    case 0x43    :
{ RtreeCoord c; c.u = _byteswap_ulong(*(u32*)pCellData); val = eInt ? (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.i : (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.f; };

      if( p->u.rValue>=val ) return;
      break;

    default:
      pCellData += 4;
{ RtreeCoord c; c.u = _byteswap_ulong(*(u32*)pCellData); val = eInt ? (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.i : (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.f; };

      if( p->u.rValue<=val ) return;
      break;
  }
  *peWithin =0          ;
}











static void rtreeLeafConstraint(
  RtreeConstraint *p,
  int eInt,
  u8 *pCellData,
  int *peWithin
){
  RtreeDValue xN;

  assert(p->op==0x42     || p->op==0x43     || p->op==0x44
      || p->op==0x45     || p->op==0x41     || p->op==0x3f
      || p->op==0x40        );
  pCellData += 8 + p->iCoord*4;
  assert( (((sqlite3_uint64)pCellData)&3)==0 );
{ RtreeCoord c; c.u = _byteswap_ulong(*(u32*)pCellData); xN = eInt ? (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.i : (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)c.f; };
  switch( p->op ){
    case 0x3f      :  return;
    case 0x40       : break;
    case 0x42    :    if( xN <= p->u.rValue ) return;  break;
    case 0x43    :    if( xN <  p->u.rValue ) return;  break;
    case 0x44    :    if( xN >= p->u.rValue ) return;  break;
    case 0x45    :    if( xN >  p->u.rValue ) return;  break;
    default:          if( xN == p->u.rValue ) return;  break;
  }
  *peWithin =0          ;
}





static int nodeRowidIndex(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  i64 iRowid,
  int *piIndex
){
  int ii;
  int nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);
  assert( nCell<200 );
  for(ii=0; ii<nCell; ii++){
    if( nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pNode, ii)==iRowid ){
      *piIndex = ii;
      return 0        ;
    }
  }
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)  ;
  return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
}





static int nodeParentIndex(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode, int *piIndex){
  RtreeNode *pParent = pNode->pParent;
  if((1)              ){
    return nodeRowidIndex(pRtree, pParent, pNode->iNode, piIndex);
  }else{
    *piIndex = -1;
    return 0        ;
  }
}











static int rtreeSearchPointCompare(
  const RtreeSearchPoint *pA,
  const RtreeSearchPoint *pB
){
  if( pA->rScore<pB->rScore ) return -1;
  if( pA->rScore>pB->rScore ) return +1;
  if( pA->iLevel<pB->iLevel ) return -1;
  if( pA->iLevel>pB->iLevel ) return +1;
  return 0;
}




static void rtreeSearchPointSwap(RtreeCursor *p, int i, int j){
  RtreeSearchPoint t = p->aPoint[i];
  assert( i<j );
  p->aPoint[i] = p->aPoint[j];
  p->aPoint[j] = t;
  i++; j++;
  if( i<5              ){
    if( j>=5              ){
      nodeRelease(((Rtree*)((p)->base.pVtab)),p->aNode[i]);
      p->aNode[i] = 0;
    }else{
      RtreeNode *pTemp = p->aNode[i];
      p->aNode[i] = p->aNode[j];
      p->aNode[j] = pTemp;
    }
  }
}




static RtreeSearchPoint *rtreeSearchPointFirst(RtreeCursor *pCur){
  return pCur->bPoint ? &pCur->sPoint : pCur->nPoint ? pCur->aPoint : 0;
}




static RtreeNode *rtreeNodeOfFirstSearchPoint(RtreeCursor *pCur, int *pRC){
  sqlite3_int64 id;
  int ii = 1 - pCur->bPoint;
  assert( ii==0 || ii==1 );
  assert( pCur->bPoint || pCur->nPoint );
  if( pCur->aNode[ii]==0 ){
    assert( pRC!=0 );
    id = ii ? pCur->aPoint[0].id : pCur->sPoint.id;
    *pRC = nodeAcquire(((Rtree*)((pCur)->base.pVtab)),id,0,&pCur->aNode[ii]);
  }
  return pCur->aNode[ii];
}




static RtreeSearchPoint *rtreeEnqueue(
  RtreeCursor *pCur,
  RtreeDValue rScore,
  u8 iLevel
){
  int i, j;
  RtreeSearchPoint *pNew;
  if( pCur->nPoint>=pCur->nPointAlloc ){
    int nNew = pCur->nPointAlloc*2 + 8;
    pNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(pCur->aPoint,nNew*sizeof(pCur->aPoint[0]));
    if( pNew==0 ) return 0;
    pCur->aPoint = pNew;
    pCur->nPointAlloc = nNew;
  }
  i = pCur->nPoint++;
  pNew = pCur->aPoint + i;
  pNew->rScore = rScore;
  pNew->iLevel = iLevel;
  assert( iLevel<=40              );
  while( i>0 ){
    RtreeSearchPoint *pParent;
    j = (i-1)/2;
    pParent = pCur->aPoint + j;
    if( rtreeSearchPointCompare(pNew, pParent)>=0 ) break;
    rtreeSearchPointSwap(pCur, j, i);
    i = j;
    pNew = pParent;
  }
  return pNew;
}





static RtreeSearchPoint *rtreeSearchPointNew(
  RtreeCursor *pCur,
  RtreeDValue rScore,
  u8 iLevel
){
  RtreeSearchPoint *pNew, *pFirst;
  pFirst = rtreeSearchPointFirst(pCur);
  pCur->anQueue[iLevel]++;
  if( pFirst==0
   || pFirst->rScore>rScore
   || (pFirst->rScore==rScore && pFirst->iLevel>iLevel)
  ){
    if( pCur->bPoint ){
      int ii;
      pNew = rtreeEnqueue(pCur, rScore, iLevel);
      if( pNew==0 ) return 0;
      ii = (int)(pNew - pCur->aPoint) + 1;
      assert( ii==1 );
      if((1)                        ){
        assert( pCur->aNode[ii]==0 );
        pCur->aNode[ii] = pCur->aNode[0];
      }else{
        nodeRelease(((Rtree*)((pCur)->base.pVtab)),pCur->aNode[0]);
      }
      pCur->aNode[0] = 0;
      *pNew = pCur->sPoint;
    }
    pCur->sPoint.rScore = rScore;
    pCur->sPoint.iLevel = iLevel;
    pCur->bPoint = 1;
    return &pCur->sPoint;
  }else{
    return rtreeEnqueue(pCur, rScore, iLevel);
  }
}



static void tracePoint(RtreeSearchPoint *p, int idx, RtreeCursor *pCur){
  if( idx<0 ){ printf(" s"); }else{ printf("%2d", idx); }
  printf(" %d.%05lld.%02d %g %d",
    p->iLevel, p->id, p->iCell, p->rScore, p->eWithin
  );
  idx++;
  if( idx<5              ){
    printf(" %p\n", pCur->aNode[idx]);
  }else{
    printf("\n");
  }
}
static void traceQueue(RtreeCursor *pCur, const char *zPrefix){
  int ii;
  printf("=== %9s ", zPrefix);
  if( pCur->bPoint ){
    tracePoint(&pCur->sPoint, -1, pCur);
  }
  for(ii=0; ii<pCur->nPoint; ii++){
    if( ii>0 || pCur->bPoint ) printf("              ");
    tracePoint(&pCur->aPoint[ii], ii, pCur);
  }
}







static void rtreeSearchPointPop(RtreeCursor *p){
  int i, j, k, n;
  i = 1 - p->bPoint;
  assert( i==0 || i==1 );
  if( p->aNode[i] ){
    nodeRelease(((Rtree*)((p)->base.pVtab)),p->aNode[i]);
    p->aNode[i] = 0;
  }
  if( p->bPoint ){
    p->anQueue[p->sPoint.iLevel]--;
    p->bPoint = 0;
  }else if((1)                ){
    p->anQueue[p->aPoint[0].iLevel]--;
    n = --p->nPoint;
    p->aPoint[0] = p->aPoint[n];
    if( n<5             -1 ){
      p->aNode[1] = p->aNode[n+1];
      p->aNode[n+1] = 0;
    }
    i = 0;
    while( (j = i*2 +1)<n){
      k = j+1;
      if( k<n && rtreeSearchPointCompare(&p->aPoint[k], &p->aPoint[j])<0 ){
        if( rtreeSearchPointCompare(&p->aPoint[k], &p->aPoint[i])<0 ){
          rtreeSearchPointSwap(p, i, k);
          i = k;
        }else{
          break;
        }
      }else{
        if( rtreeSearchPointCompare(&p->aPoint[j], &p->aPoint[i])<0 ){
          rtreeSearchPointSwap(p, i, j);
          i = j;
        }else{
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}








static int rtreeStepToLeaf(RtreeCursor *pCur){
  RtreeSearchPoint *p;
  Rtree *pRtree =((Rtree*)((pCur)->base.pVtab));
  RtreeNode *pNode;
  int eWithin;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nCell;
  int nConstraint = pCur->nConstraint;
  int ii;
  int eInt;
  RtreeSearchPoint x;

  eInt = pRtree->eCoordType==1                ;
  while( (p = rtreeSearchPointFirst(pCur))!=0 && p->iLevel>0 ){
    u8 *pCellData;
    pNode = rtreeNodeOfFirstSearchPoint(pCur, &rc);
    if( rc ) return rc;
    nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);
    assert( nCell<200 );
    pCellData = pNode->zData + (4 +pRtree->nBytesPerCell*p->iCell);
    while( p->iCell<nCell ){
      sqlite3_rtree_dbl rScore = (sqlite3_rtree_dbl)-1;
      eWithin =2            ;
      for(ii=0; ii<nConstraint; ii++){
        RtreeConstraint *pConstraint = pCur->aConstraint + ii;
        if( pConstraint->op>=0x46        ){
          rc = rtreeCallbackConstraint(pConstraint, eInt, pCellData, p,
                                       &rScore, &eWithin);
          if( rc ) return rc;
        }else if( p->iLevel==1 ){
          rtreeLeafConstraint(pConstraint, eInt, pCellData, &eWithin);
        }else{
          rtreeNonleafConstraint(pConstraint, eInt, pCellData, &eWithin);
        }
        if( eWithin==0          ){
          p->iCell++;
          pCellData += pRtree->nBytesPerCell;
          break;
        }
      }
      if( eWithin==0          ) continue;
      p->iCell++;
      x.iLevel = p->iLevel - 1;
      if( x.iLevel ){
        x.id = readInt64(pCellData);
        for(ii=0; ii<pCur->nPoint; ii++){
          if( pCur->aPoint[ii].id==x.id ){
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)            ;
            return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
          }
        }
        x.iCell = 0;
      }else{
        x.id = p->id;
        x.iCell = p->iCell - 1;
      }
      if( p->iCell>=nCell ){
traceQueue(pCur,"POP-S:")                ;
        rtreeSearchPointPop(pCur);
      }
      if( rScore<0          ) rScore =0          ;
      p = rtreeSearchPointNew(pCur, rScore, x.iLevel);
      if( p==0 ) return 7           ;
      p->eWithin = (u8)eWithin;
      p->id = x.id;
      p->iCell = x.iCell;
traceQueue(pCur,"PUSH-S:")              ;
      break;
    }
    if( p->iCell>=nCell ){
traceQueue(pCur,"POP-Se:")              ;
      rtreeSearchPointPop(pCur);
    }
  }
  pCur->atEOF = p==0;
  return 0        ;
}




static int rtreeNext(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pVtabCursor){
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)pVtabCursor;
  int rc =0         ;


traceQueue(pCsr,"POP-Nx:")          ;
  if( pCsr->bAuxValid ){
    pCsr->bAuxValid = 0;
sqlite3_api->reset(pCsr->pReadAux);
  }
  rtreeSearchPointPop(pCsr);
  rc = rtreeStepToLeaf(pCsr);
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeRowid(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pVtabCursor, sqlite_int64 *pRowid){
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)pVtabCursor;
  RtreeSearchPoint *p = rtreeSearchPointFirst(pCsr);
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeNode *pNode = rtreeNodeOfFirstSearchPoint(pCsr, &rc);
  if( rc==0         &&(1)        ){
    *pRowid = nodeGetRowid(((Rtree*)((pCsr)->base.pVtab)),pNode,p->iCell);
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeColumn(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur, sqlite3_context *ctx, int i){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)cur->pVtab;
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)cur;
  RtreeSearchPoint *p = rtreeSearchPointFirst(pCsr);
  RtreeCoord c;
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeNode *pNode = rtreeNodeOfFirstSearchPoint(pCsr, &rc);

  if( rc ) return rc;
  if((0)          ) return 0        ;
  if( i==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64(ctx,nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pNode, p->iCell));
  }else if( i<=pRtree->nDim2 ){
    nodeGetCoord(pRtree, pNode, p->iCell, i-1, &c);

    if( pRtree->eCoordType==0                  ){
sqlite3_api->result_double (ctx, c.f);
    }else

    {
      assert( pRtree->eCoordType==1                 );
sqlite3_api->result_int (ctx, c.i);
    }
  }else{
    if( !pCsr->bAuxValid ){
      if( pCsr->pReadAux==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(pRtree->db,pRtree->zReadAuxSql,-1,0,
                                &pCsr->pReadAux, 0);
        if( rc ) return rc;
      }
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pCsr->pReadAux, 1,
          nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pNode, p->iCell));
      rc =sqlite3_api->step(pCsr->pReadAux);
      if( rc==100        ){
        pCsr->bAuxValid = 1;
      }else{
sqlite3_api->reset   (pCsr->pReadAux);
        if( rc==101         ) rc =0         ;
        return rc;
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->result_value(ctx,
sqlite3_api->column_value    (pCsr->pReadAux, i - pRtree->nDim2 + 1));
  }
  return 0        ;
}








static int findLeafNode(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  i64 iRowid,
  RtreeNode **ppLeaf,
  sqlite3_int64 *piNode
){
  int rc;
  *ppLeaf = 0;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRtree->pReadRowid,1,iRowid);
  if(sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pReadRowid)==100    ){
    i64 iNode =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pRtree->pReadRowid,0);
    if( piNode ) *piNode = iNode;
    rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, iNode, 0, ppLeaf);
sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pReadRowid);
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pReadRowid);
  }
  return rc;
}







static int deserializeGeometry(sqlite3_value *pValue, RtreeConstraint *pCons){
  RtreeMatchArg *pBlob, *pSrc;
  sqlite3_rtree_query_info *pInfo;

  pSrc =sqlite3_api->value_pointer(pValue,"RtreeMatchArg");
  if( pSrc==0 ) return 1           ;
  pInfo = (sqlite3_rtree_query_info*)
sqlite3_api->malloc64           ( sizeof(*pInfo)+pSrc->iSize );
  if( !pInfo ) return 7           ;
  memset(pInfo, 0, sizeof(*pInfo));
  pBlob = (RtreeMatchArg*)&pInfo[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBlob);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pSrc); int xxn=(pSrc->iSize);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  pInfo->pContext = pBlob->cb.pContext;
  pInfo->nParam = pBlob->nParam;
  pInfo->aParam = pBlob->aParam;
  pInfo->apSqlParam = pBlob->apSqlParam;

  if( pBlob->cb.xGeom ){
    pCons->u.xGeom = pBlob->cb.xGeom;
  }else{
    pCons->op =0x47        ;
    pCons->u.xQueryFunc = pBlob->cb.xQueryFunc;
  }
  pCons->pInfo = pInfo;
  return 0        ;
}




static int rtreeFilter(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pVtabCursor,
  int idxNum, const char *idxStr,
  int argc, sqlite3_value **argv
){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtabCursor->pVtab;
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)pVtabCursor;
  RtreeNode *pRoot = 0;
  int ii;
  int rc =0         ;
  int iCell = 0;

  rtreeReference(pRtree);


  resetCursor(pCsr);

  pCsr->iStrategy = idxNum;
  if( idxNum==1 ){

    RtreeNode *pLeaf;
    RtreeSearchPoint *p;
    i64 iRowid =sqlite3_api->value_int64(argv[0]);
    i64 iNode = 0;
    int eType =sqlite3_api->value_numeric_type(argv[0]);
    if( eType==1
     || (eType==2            &&sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[0])==iRowid)
    ){
      rc = findLeafNode(pRtree, iRowid, &pLeaf, &iNode);
    }else{
      rc =0         ;
      pLeaf = 0;
    }
    if( rc==0         && pLeaf!=0 ){
      p = rtreeSearchPointNew(pCsr,0          , 0);
      assert( p!=0 );
      pCsr->aNode[0] = pLeaf;
      p->id = iNode;
      p->eWithin =1             ;
      rc = nodeRowidIndex(pRtree, pLeaf, iRowid, &iCell);
      p->iCell = (u8)iCell;
traceQueue(pCsr,"PUSH-F1:")              ;
    }else{
      pCsr->atEOF = 1;
    }
  }else{



    rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, 1, 0, &pRoot);
    if( rc==0         && argc>0 ){
      pCsr->aConstraint =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(RtreeConstraint)*argc);
      pCsr->nConstraint = argc;
      if( !pCsr->aConstraint ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        memset(pCsr->aConstraint, 0, sizeof(RtreeConstraint)*argc);
        memset(pCsr->anQueue, 0, sizeof(u32)*(pRtree->iDepth + 1));
        assert( (idxStr==0 && argc==0)
                || (idxStr && (int)strlen(idxStr)==argc*2) );
        for(ii=0; ii<argc; ii++){
          RtreeConstraint *p = &pCsr->aConstraint[ii];
          int eType =sqlite3_api->value_numeric_type(argv[ii]);
          p->op = idxStr[ii*2];
          p->iCoord = idxStr[ii*2 +1]-'0';
          if( p->op>=0x46        ){




            rc = deserializeGeometry(argv[ii], p);
            if( rc!=0         ){
              break;
            }
            p->pInfo->nCoord = pRtree->nDim2;
            p->pInfo->anQueue = pCsr->anQueue;
            p->pInfo->mxLevel = pRtree->iDepth + 1;
          }else if( eType==1              || eType==2            ){

            p->u.rValue =sqlite3_api->value_int64(argv[ii]);

            p->u.rValue =sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[ii]);

          }else{
            p->u.rValue =0          ;
            if( eType==5           ){
              p->op =0x40        ;
            }else if( p->op==0x43     || p->op==0x42     ){
              p->op =0x3f       ;
            }else{
              p->op =0x40        ;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      RtreeSearchPoint *pNew;
      assert( pCsr->bPoint==0 );
      pNew = rtreeSearchPointNew(pCsr,0          , (u8)(pRtree->iDepth+1));
      if((0)             ){
        return 7           ;
      }
      pNew->id = 1;
      pNew->iCell = 0;
      pNew->eWithin =1             ;
      assert( pCsr->bPoint==1 );
      pCsr->aNode[0] = pRoot;
      pRoot = 0;
traceQueue(pCsr,"PUSH-Fm:")              ;
      rc = rtreeStepToLeaf(pCsr);
    }
  }

  nodeRelease(pRtree, pRoot);
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}



































static int rtreeBestIndex(sqlite3_vtab *tab, sqlite3_index_info *pIdxInfo){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree*)tab;
  int rc =0         ;
  int ii;
  int bMatch = 0;
  i64 nRow;

  int iIdx = 0;
  char zIdxStr[5                   *8 +1];
  memset(zIdxStr, 0, sizeof(zIdxStr));





  for(ii=0; ii<pIdxInfo->nConstraint; ii++){
    if( pIdxInfo->aConstraint[ii].op==64                            ){
      bMatch = 1;
    }
  }

  assert( pIdxInfo->idxStr==0 );
  for(ii=0; ii<pIdxInfo->nConstraint && iIdx<(int)(sizeof(zIdxStr)-1); ii++){
    struct sqlite3_index_constraint *p = &pIdxInfo->aConstraint[ii];

    if( bMatch==0 && p->usable
     && p->iColumn<=0 && p->op==2
    ){

      int jj;
      for(jj=0; jj<ii; jj++){
        pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[jj].argvIndex = 0;
        pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[jj].omit = 0;
      }
      pIdxInfo->idxNum = 1;
      pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[ii].argvIndex = 1;
      pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[jj].omit = 1;







      pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = 30.0;
      pIdxInfo->estimatedRows = 1;
      pIdxInfo->idxFlags =1                        ;
      return 0        ;
    }

    if( p->usable
    && ((p->iColumn>0 && p->iColumn<=pRtree->nDim2)
        || p->op==64                           )
    ){
      u8 op;
      switch( p->op ){
        case 2                         :    op =0x41     ;    break;
        case 4                         :    op =0x45     ;    break;
        case 8                         :    op =0x42     ;    break;
        case 16                        :    op =0x43     ;    break;
        case 32                        :    op =0x44     ;    break;
        case 64                           : op =0x46        ; break;
        default:                            op = 0;           break;
      }
      if( op ){
        zIdxStr[iIdx++] = op;
        zIdxStr[iIdx++] = (char)(p->iColumn - 1 + '0');
        pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[ii].argvIndex = (iIdx/2);
        pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[ii].omit = 1;
      }
    }
  }

  pIdxInfo->idxNum = 2;
  pIdxInfo->needToFreeIdxStr = 1;
  if( iIdx>0 && 0==(pIdxInfo->idxStr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",zIdxStr))){
    return 7           ;
  }

  nRow = pRtree->nRowEst >> (iIdx/2);
  pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = (sqlite_int64)6.0*(sqlite_int64)nRow;
  pIdxInfo->estimatedRows = nRow;

  return rc;
}




static RtreeDValue cellArea(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeCell *p){
  RtreeDValue area = (RtreeDValue)1;
  assert( pRtree->nDim>=1 && pRtree->nDim<=5 );

  if( pRtree->eCoordType==0                  ){
    switch( pRtree->nDim ){
      case 5:  area  = p->aCoord[9].f - p->aCoord[8].f;
      case 4:  area *= p->aCoord[7].f - p->aCoord[6].f;
      case 3:  area *= p->aCoord[5].f - p->aCoord[4].f;
      case 2:  area *= p->aCoord[3].f - p->aCoord[2].f;
      default: area *= p->aCoord[1].f - p->aCoord[0].f;
    }
  }else

  {
    switch( pRtree->nDim ){
      case 5:  area  = (i64)p->aCoord[9].i - (i64)p->aCoord[8].i;
      case 4:  area *= (i64)p->aCoord[7].i - (i64)p->aCoord[6].i;
      case 3:  area *= (i64)p->aCoord[5].i - (i64)p->aCoord[4].i;
      case 2:  area *= (i64)p->aCoord[3].i - (i64)p->aCoord[2].i;
      default: area *= (i64)p->aCoord[1].i - (i64)p->aCoord[0].i;
    }
  }
  return area;
}





static RtreeDValue cellMargin(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeCell *p){
  RtreeDValue margin = 0;
  int ii = pRtree->nDim2 - 2;
  do{
    margin += (((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[ii+1].i)-((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[ii].i));
    ii -= 2;
  }while( ii>=0 );
  return margin;
}




static void cellUnion(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeCell *p1, RtreeCell *p2){
  int ii = 0;
  if( pRtree->eCoordType==0                  ){
    do{
      p1->aCoord[ii].f =((p1->aCoord[ii].f)<(p2->aCoord[ii].f)?(p1->aCoord[ii].f):(p2->aCoord[ii].f));
      p1->aCoord[ii+1].f =((p1->aCoord[ii+1].f)>(p2->aCoord[ii+1].f)?(p1->aCoord[ii+1].f):(p2->aCoord[ii+1].f));
      ii += 2;
    }while( ii<pRtree->nDim2 );
  }else{
    do{
      p1->aCoord[ii].i =((p1->aCoord[ii].i)<(p2->aCoord[ii].i)?(p1->aCoord[ii].i):(p2->aCoord[ii].i));
      p1->aCoord[ii+1].i =((p1->aCoord[ii+1].i)>(p2->aCoord[ii+1].i)?(p1->aCoord[ii+1].i):(p2->aCoord[ii+1].i));
      ii += 2;
    }while( ii<pRtree->nDim2 );
  }
}





static int cellContains(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeCell *p1, RtreeCell *p2){
  int ii;
  int isInt = (pRtree->eCoordType==1                );
  for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nDim2; ii+=2){
    RtreeCoord *a1 = &p1->aCoord[ii];
    RtreeCoord *a2 = &p2->aCoord[ii];
    if( (!isInt && (a2[0].f<a1[0].f || a2[1].f>a1[1].f))
     || ( isInt && (a2[0].i<a1[0].i || a2[1].i>a1[1].i))
    ){
      return 0;
    }
  }
  return 1;
}




static RtreeDValue cellGrowth(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeCell *p, RtreeCell *pCell){
  RtreeDValue area;
  RtreeCell cell;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&cell);const char*xxs=(const char*)(p); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  area = cellArea(pRtree, &cell);
  cellUnion(pRtree, &cell, pCell);
  return (cellArea(pRtree, &cell)-area);
}

static RtreeDValue cellOverlap(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeCell *p,
  RtreeCell *aCell,
  int nCell
){
  int ii;
  RtreeDValue overlap =0          ;
  for(ii=0; ii<nCell; ii++){
    int jj;
    RtreeDValue o = (RtreeDValue)1;
    for(jj=0; jj<pRtree->nDim2; jj+=2){
      RtreeDValue x1, x2;
      x1 =((((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[jj].i))>(((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[jj].i))?(((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[jj].i)):(((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[jj].i)));
      x2 =((((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[jj+1].i))<(((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[jj+1].i))?(((RtreeDValue)p->aCoord[jj+1].i)):(((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[jj+1].i)));
      if( x2<x1 ){
        o = (RtreeDValue)0;
        break;
      }else{
        o = o * (x2-x1);
      }
    }
    overlap += o;
  }
  return overlap;
}






static int ChooseLeaf(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeCell *pCell,
  int iHeight,
  RtreeNode **ppLeaf
){
  int rc;
  int ii;
  RtreeNode *pNode = 0;
  rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, 1, 0, &pNode);

  for(ii=0; rc==0         && ii<(pRtree->iDepth-iHeight); ii++){
    int iCell;
    sqlite3_int64 iBest = 0;

    RtreeDValue fMinGrowth =0          ;
    RtreeDValue fMinArea =0          ;

    int nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);
    RtreeCell cell;
    RtreeNode *pChild = 0;

    RtreeCell *aCell = 0;





    for(iCell=0; iCell<nCell; iCell++){
      int bBest = 0;
      RtreeDValue growth;
      RtreeDValue area;
      nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, iCell, &cell);
      growth = cellGrowth(pRtree, &cell, pCell);
      area = cellArea(pRtree, &cell);
      if( iCell==0||growth<fMinGrowth||(growth==fMinGrowth && area<fMinArea) ){
        bBest = 1;
      }
      if( bBest ){
        fMinGrowth = growth;
        fMinArea = area;
        iBest = cell.iRowid;
      }
    }

sqlite3_api->free(aCell);
    rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, iBest, pNode, &pChild);
    nodeRelease(pRtree, pNode);
    pNode = pChild;
  }

  *ppLeaf = pNode;
  return rc;
}






static int AdjustTree(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell
){
  RtreeNode *p = pNode;
  int cnt = 0;
  int rc;
  while( p->pParent ){
    RtreeNode *pParent = p->pParent;
    RtreeCell cell;
    int iCell;

    cnt++;
    if((0)             ){
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
      return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
    }
    rc = nodeParentIndex(pRtree, p, &iCell);
    if((0)                   ){
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
      return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
    }

    nodeGetCell(pRtree, pParent, iCell, &cell);
    if( !cellContains(pRtree, &cell, pCell) ){
      cellUnion(pRtree, &cell, pCell);
      nodeOverwriteCell(pRtree, pParent, &cell, iCell);
    }

    p = pParent;
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static void SortByDistance(
  int *aIdx,
  int nIdx,
  RtreeDValue *aDistance,
  int *aSpare
){
  if( nIdx>1 ){
    int iLeft = 0;
    int iRight = 0;

    int nLeft = nIdx/2;
    int nRight = nIdx-nLeft;
    int *aLeft = aIdx;
    int *aRight = &aIdx[nLeft];

    SortByDistance(aLeft, nLeft, aDistance, aSpare);
    SortByDistance(aRight, nRight, aDistance, aSpare);

{char*xxd=(char*)(aSpare);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aLeft); int xxn=(sizeof(int)*nLeft);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    aLeft = aSpare;

    while( iLeft<nLeft || iRight<nRight ){
      if( iLeft==nLeft ){
        aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aRight[iRight];
        iRight++;
      }else if( iRight==nRight ){
        aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aLeft[iLeft];
        iLeft++;
      }else{
        RtreeDValue fLeft = aDistance[aLeft[iLeft]];
        RtreeDValue fRight = aDistance[aRight[iRight]];
        if( fLeft<fRight ){
          aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aLeft[iLeft];
          iLeft++;
        }else{
          aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aRight[iRight];
          iRight++;
        }
      }
    }



    {
      int jj;
      for(jj=1; jj<nIdx; jj++){
        RtreeDValue left = aDistance[aIdx[jj-1]];
        RtreeDValue right = aDistance[aIdx[jj]];
        assert( left<=right );
      }
    }

  }
}












static void SortByDimension(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  int *aIdx,
  int nIdx,
  int iDim,
  RtreeCell *aCell,
  int *aSpare
){
  if( nIdx>1 ){

    int iLeft = 0;
    int iRight = 0;

    int nLeft = nIdx/2;
    int nRight = nIdx-nLeft;
    int *aLeft = aIdx;
    int *aRight = &aIdx[nLeft];

    SortByDimension(pRtree, aLeft, nLeft, iDim, aCell, aSpare);
    SortByDimension(pRtree, aRight, nRight, iDim, aCell, aSpare);

{char*xxd=(char*)(aSpare);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aLeft); int xxn=(sizeof(int)*nLeft);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    aLeft = aSpare;
    while( iLeft<nLeft || iRight<nRight ){
      RtreeDValue xleft1 =((RtreeDValue)aCell[aLeft[iLeft]].aCoord[iDim*2].i);
      RtreeDValue xleft2 =((RtreeDValue)aCell[aLeft[iLeft]].aCoord[iDim*2 +1].i);
      RtreeDValue xright1 =((RtreeDValue)aCell[aRight[iRight]].aCoord[iDim*2].i);
      RtreeDValue xright2 =((RtreeDValue)aCell[aRight[iRight]].aCoord[iDim*2 +1].i);
      if( (iLeft!=nLeft) && ((iRight==nRight)
       || (xleft1<xright1)
       || (xleft1==xright1 && xleft2<xright2)
      )){
        aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aLeft[iLeft];
        iLeft++;
      }else{
        aIdx[iLeft+iRight] = aRight[iRight];
        iRight++;
      }
    }



    {
      int jj;
      for(jj=1; jj<nIdx; jj++){
        RtreeDValue xleft1 = aCell[aIdx[jj-1]].aCoord[iDim*2];
        RtreeDValue xleft2 = aCell[aIdx[jj-1]].aCoord[iDim*2 +1];
        RtreeDValue xright1 = aCell[aIdx[jj]].aCoord[iDim*2];
        RtreeDValue xright2 = aCell[aIdx[jj]].aCoord[iDim*2 +1];
        assert( xleft1<=xright1 && (xleft1<xright1 || xleft2<=xright2) );
      }
    }

  }
}




static int splitNodeStartree(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeCell *aCell,
  int nCell,
  RtreeNode *pLeft,
  RtreeNode *pRight,
  RtreeCell *pBboxLeft,
  RtreeCell *pBboxRight
){
  int **aaSorted;
  int *aSpare;
  int ii;

  int iBestDim = 0;
  int iBestSplit = 0;
  RtreeDValue fBestMargin =0          ;

  sqlite3_int64 nByte = (pRtree->nDim+1)*(sizeof(int*)+nCell*sizeof(int));

  aaSorted = (int **)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( !aaSorted ){
    return 7           ;
  }

  aSpare = &((int *)&aaSorted[pRtree->nDim])[pRtree->nDim*nCell];
  memset(aaSorted, 0, nByte);
  for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nDim; ii++){
    int jj;
    aaSorted[ii] = &((int *)&aaSorted[pRtree->nDim])[ii*nCell];
    for(jj=0; jj<nCell; jj++){
      aaSorted[ii][jj] = jj;
    }
    SortByDimension(pRtree, aaSorted[ii], nCell, ii, aCell, aSpare);
  }

  for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nDim; ii++){
    RtreeDValue margin =0          ;
    RtreeDValue fBestOverlap =0          ;
    RtreeDValue fBestArea =0          ;
    int iBestLeft = 0;
    int nLeft;

    for(
      nLeft=((((pRtree)->iNodeSize-4)/(pRtree)->nBytesPerCell)/3);
      nLeft<=(nCell-((((pRtree)->iNodeSize-4)/(pRtree)->nBytesPerCell)/3));
      nLeft++
    ){
      RtreeCell left;
      RtreeCell right;
      int kk;
      RtreeDValue overlap;
      RtreeDValue area;

{char*xxd=(char*)(&left);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aCell[aaSorted[ii][0]]); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
{char*xxd=(char*)(&right);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aCell[aaSorted[ii][nCell-1]]); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      for(kk=1; kk<(nCell-1); kk++){
        if( kk<nLeft ){
          cellUnion(pRtree, &left, &aCell[aaSorted[ii][kk]]);
        }else{
          cellUnion(pRtree, &right, &aCell[aaSorted[ii][kk]]);
        }
      }
      margin += cellMargin(pRtree, &left);
      margin += cellMargin(pRtree, &right);
      overlap = cellOverlap(pRtree, &left, &right, 1);
      area = cellArea(pRtree, &left) + cellArea(pRtree, &right);
      if( (nLeft==((((pRtree)->iNodeSize-4)/(pRtree)->nBytesPerCell)/3))
       || (overlap<fBestOverlap)
       || (overlap==fBestOverlap && area<fBestArea)
      ){
        iBestLeft = nLeft;
        fBestOverlap = overlap;
        fBestArea = area;
      }
    }

    if( ii==0 || margin<fBestMargin ){
      iBestDim = ii;
      fBestMargin = margin;
      iBestSplit = iBestLeft;
    }
  }

{char*xxd=(char*)(pBboxLeft);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aCell[aaSorted[iBestDim][0]]); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBboxRight);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&aCell[aaSorted[iBestDim][iBestSplit]]); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  for(ii=0; ii<nCell; ii++){
    RtreeNode *pTarget = (ii<iBestSplit)?pLeft:pRight;
    RtreeCell *pBbox = (ii<iBestSplit)?pBboxLeft:pBboxRight;
    RtreeCell *pCell = &aCell[aaSorted[iBestDim][ii]];
    nodeInsertCell(pRtree, pTarget, pCell);
    cellUnion(pRtree, pBbox, pCell);
  }

sqlite3_api->free(aaSorted);
  return 0        ;
}


static int updateMapping(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  i64 iRowid,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  int iHeight
){
  int (*xSetMapping)(Rtree *, sqlite3_int64, sqlite3_int64);
  xSetMapping = ((iHeight==0)?rowidWrite:parentWrite);
  if( iHeight>0 ){
    RtreeNode *pChild = nodeHashLookup(pRtree, iRowid);
    RtreeNode *p;
    for(p=pNode; p; p=p->pParent){
      if( p==pChild ) return(11 | (1<<8))       ;
    }
    if( pChild ){
      nodeRelease(pRtree, pChild->pParent);
      nodeReference(pNode);
      pChild->pParent = pNode;
    }
  }
  if((0)              ) return 1           ;
  return xSetMapping(pRtree, iRowid, pNode->iNode);
}

static int SplitNode(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell,
  int iHeight
){
  int i;
  int newCellIsRight = 0;

  int rc =0         ;
  int nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);
  RtreeCell *aCell;
  int *aiUsed;

  RtreeNode *pLeft = 0;
  RtreeNode *pRight = 0;

  RtreeCell leftbbox;
  RtreeCell rightbbox;




  aCell =sqlite3_api->malloc64((sizeof(RtreeCell)+sizeof(int))*(nCell+1));
  if( !aCell ){
    rc =7            ;
    goto splitnode_out;
  }
  aiUsed = (int *)&aCell[nCell+1];
  memset(aiUsed, 0, sizeof(int)*(nCell+1));
  for(i=0; i<nCell; i++){
    nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, i, &aCell[i]);
  }
  nodeZero(pRtree, pNode);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&aCell[nCell]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pCell); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  nCell++;

  if( pNode->iNode==1 ){
    pRight = nodeNew(pRtree, pNode);
    pLeft = nodeNew(pRtree, pNode);
    pRtree->iDepth++;
    pNode->isDirty = 1;
    writeInt16(pNode->zData, pRtree->iDepth);
  }else{
    pLeft = pNode;
    pRight = nodeNew(pRtree, pLeft->pParent);
    pLeft->nRef++;
  }

  if( !pLeft || !pRight ){
    rc =7            ;
    goto splitnode_out;
  }

  memset(pLeft->zData, 0, pRtree->iNodeSize);
  memset(pRight->zData, 0, pRtree->iNodeSize);

  rc = splitNodeStartree(pRtree, aCell, nCell, pLeft, pRight,
                         &leftbbox, &rightbbox);
  if( rc!=0         ){
    goto splitnode_out;
  }






  if(0         !=(rc = nodeWrite(pRtree, pRight))
   || (0==pLeft->iNode &&0         !=(rc = nodeWrite(pRtree, pLeft)))
  ){
    goto splitnode_out;
  }

  rightbbox.iRowid = pRight->iNode;
  leftbbox.iRowid = pLeft->iNode;

  if( pNode->iNode==1 ){
    rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pLeft->pParent, &leftbbox, iHeight+1);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto splitnode_out;
    }
  }else{
    RtreeNode *pParent = pLeft->pParent;
    int iCell;
    rc = nodeParentIndex(pRtree, pLeft, &iCell);
    if((1)                    ){
      nodeOverwriteCell(pRtree, pParent, &leftbbox, iCell);
      rc = AdjustTree(pRtree, pParent, &leftbbox);
      assert( rc==0         );
    }
    if((0)                   ){
      goto splitnode_out;
    }
  }
  if( (rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pRight->pParent, &rightbbox, iHeight+1)) ){
    goto splitnode_out;
  }

  for(i=0; i<readInt16(&(pRight)->zData[2]);i++){
    i64 iRowid = nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pRight, i);
    rc = updateMapping(pRtree, iRowid, pRight, iHeight);
    if( iRowid==pCell->iRowid ){
      newCellIsRight = 1;
    }
    if( rc!=0         ){
      goto splitnode_out;
    }
  }
  if( pNode->iNode==1 ){
    for(i=0; i<readInt16(&(pLeft)->zData[2]);i++){
      i64 iRowid = nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pLeft, i);
      rc = updateMapping(pRtree, iRowid, pLeft, iHeight);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        goto splitnode_out;
      }
    }
  }else if( newCellIsRight==0 ){
    rc = updateMapping(pRtree, pCell->iRowid, pLeft, iHeight);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = nodeRelease(pRtree, pRight);
    pRight = 0;
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = nodeRelease(pRtree, pLeft);
    pLeft = 0;
  }

splitnode_out:
  nodeRelease(pRtree, pRight);
  nodeRelease(pRtree, pLeft);
sqlite3_api->free(aCell);
  return rc;
}












static int fixLeafParent(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pLeaf){
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeNode *pChild = pLeaf;
  while( rc==0         && pChild->iNode!=1 && pChild->pParent==0 ){
    int rc2 =0         ;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRtree->pReadParent,1, pChild->iNode);
    rc =sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pReadParent);
    if( rc==100        ){
      RtreeNode *pTest;
      i64 iNode;






      iNode =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pRtree->pReadParent,0);
      for(pTest=pLeaf; pTest && pTest->iNode!=iNode; pTest=pTest->pParent);
      if( pTest==0 ){
        rc2 = nodeAcquire(pRtree, iNode, 0, &pChild->pParent);
      }
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pReadParent);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
    if( rc==0         && !pChild->pParent ){
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
    }
    pChild = pChild->pParent;
  }
  return rc;
}

static int deleteCell(Rtree *, RtreeNode *, int, int);

static int removeNode(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode, int iHeight){
  int rc;
  int rc2;
  RtreeNode *pParent = 0;
  int iCell;

  assert( pNode->nRef==1 );


  rc = nodeParentIndex(pRtree, pNode, &iCell);
  if( rc==0         ){
    pParent = pNode->pParent;
    pNode->pParent = 0;
    rc = deleteCell(pRtree, pParent, iCell, iHeight+1);
if( rc!=0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  }
  rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pParent);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = rc2;
  }
  if( rc!=0         ){
    return rc;
  }


sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRtree->pDeleteNode,1,pNode->iNode);
sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pDeleteNode);
  if(0         !=(rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pDeleteNode))){
    return rc;
  }


sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRtree->pDeleteParent,1,pNode->iNode);
sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pDeleteParent);
  if(0         !=(rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pDeleteParent))){
    return rc;
  }




  nodeHashDelete(pRtree, pNode);
  pNode->iNode = iHeight;
  pNode->pNext = pRtree->pDeleted;
  pNode->nRef++;
  pRtree->pDeleted = pNode;

  return 0        ;
}

static int fixBoundingBox(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  RtreeNode *pParent = pNode->pParent;
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pParent ){
    int ii;
    int nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);
    RtreeCell box;
    nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, 0, &box);
    for(ii=1; ii<nCell; ii++){
      RtreeCell cell;
      nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, ii, &cell);
      cellUnion(pRtree, &box, &cell);
    }
    box.iRowid = pNode->iNode;
    rc = nodeParentIndex(pRtree, pNode, &ii);
    if( rc==0         ){
      nodeOverwriteCell(pRtree, pParent, &box, ii);
      rc = fixBoundingBox(pRtree, pParent);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}





static int deleteCell(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode, int iCell, int iHeight){
  RtreeNode *pParent;
  int rc;

  if(0         !=(rc = fixLeafParent(pRtree, pNode)) ){
    return rc;
  }




  nodeDeleteCell(pRtree, pNode, iCell);






  pParent = pNode->pParent;
  assert( pParent || pNode->iNode==1 );
  if( pParent ){
    if(readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2])<((((pRtree)->iNodeSize-4)/(pRtree)->nBytesPerCell)/3)){
      rc = removeNode(pRtree, pNode, iHeight);
    }else{
      rc = fixBoundingBox(pRtree, pNode);
    }
  }

  return rc;
}

static int Reinsert(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell,
  int iHeight
){
  int *aOrder;
  int *aSpare;
  RtreeCell *aCell;
  RtreeDValue *aDistance;
  int nCell;
  RtreeDValue aCenterCoord[5                   ];
  int iDim;
  int ii;
  int rc =0         ;
  int n;

  memset(aCenterCoord, 0, sizeof(RtreeDValue)*5                   );

  nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2])+1;
  n = (nCell+1)&(~1);




  aCell = (RtreeCell *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(n*(
    sizeof(RtreeCell)     +
    sizeof(int)           +
    sizeof(int)           +
    sizeof(RtreeDValue)
  ));
  if( !aCell ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  aOrder    = (int *)&aCell[n];
  aSpare    = (int *)&aOrder[n];
  aDistance = (RtreeDValue *)&aSpare[n];

  for(ii=0; ii<nCell; ii++){
    if( ii==(nCell-1) ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(&aCell[ii]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pCell); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCell));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }else{
      nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, ii, &aCell[ii]);
    }
    aOrder[ii] = ii;
    for(iDim=0; iDim<pRtree->nDim; iDim++){
      aCenterCoord[iDim] +=((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[iDim*2].i);
      aCenterCoord[iDim] +=((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[iDim*2 +1].i);
    }
  }
  for(iDim=0; iDim<pRtree->nDim; iDim++){
    aCenterCoord[iDim] = (aCenterCoord[iDim]/(nCell*(RtreeDValue)2));
  }

  for(ii=0; ii<nCell; ii++){
    aDistance[ii] =0          ;
    for(iDim=0; iDim<pRtree->nDim; iDim++){
      RtreeDValue coord = (((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[iDim*2 +1].i)-
((RtreeDValue)aCell[ii].aCoord[iDim*2].i)                      );
      aDistance[ii] += (coord-aCenterCoord[iDim])*(coord-aCenterCoord[iDim]);
    }
  }

  SortByDistance(aOrder, nCell, aDistance, aSpare);
  nodeZero(pRtree, pNode);

  for(ii=0; rc==0         && ii<(nCell-(((((pRtree)->iNodeSize-4)/(pRtree)->nBytesPerCell)/3)+1));ii++){
    RtreeCell *p = &aCell[aOrder[ii]];
    nodeInsertCell(pRtree, pNode, p);
    if( p->iRowid==pCell->iRowid ){
      if( iHeight==0 ){
        rc = rowidWrite(pRtree, p->iRowid, pNode->iNode);
      }else{
        rc = parentWrite(pRtree, p->iRowid, pNode->iNode);
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fixBoundingBox(pRtree, pNode);
  }
  for(; rc==0         && ii<nCell; ii++){



    RtreeNode *pInsert;
    RtreeCell *p = &aCell[aOrder[ii]];
    rc = ChooseLeaf(pRtree, p, iHeight, &pInsert);
    if( rc==0         ){
      int rc2;
      rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pInsert, p, iHeight);
      rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pInsert);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = rc2;
      }
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(aCell);
  return rc;
}





static int rtreeInsertCell(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  RtreeNode *pNode,
  RtreeCell *pCell,
  int iHeight
){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( iHeight>0 ){
    RtreeNode *pChild = nodeHashLookup(pRtree, pCell->iRowid);
    if( pChild ){
      nodeRelease(pRtree, pChild->pParent);
      nodeReference(pNode);
      pChild->pParent = pNode;
    }
  }
  if( nodeInsertCell(pRtree, pNode, pCell) ){
    if( iHeight<=pRtree->iReinsertHeight || pNode->iNode==1){
      rc = SplitNode(pRtree, pNode, pCell, iHeight);
    }else{
      pRtree->iReinsertHeight = iHeight;
      rc = Reinsert(pRtree, pNode, pCell, iHeight);
    }
  }else{
    rc = AdjustTree(pRtree, pNode, pCell);
    if((1)                    ){
      if( iHeight==0 ){
        rc = rowidWrite(pRtree, pCell->iRowid, pNode->iNode);
      }else{
        rc = parentWrite(pRtree, pCell->iRowid, pNode->iNode);
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static int reinsertNodeContent(Rtree *pRtree, RtreeNode *pNode){
  int ii;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nCell =readInt16(&(pNode)->zData[2]);

  for(ii=0; rc==0         && ii<nCell; ii++){
    RtreeNode *pInsert;
    RtreeCell cell;
    nodeGetCell(pRtree, pNode, ii, &cell);




    rc = ChooseLeaf(pRtree, &cell, (int)pNode->iNode, &pInsert);
    if( rc==0         ){
      int rc2;
      rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pInsert, &cell, (int)pNode->iNode);
      rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pInsert);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = rc2;
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeNewRowid(Rtree *pRtree, i64 *piRowid){
  int rc;
sqlite3_api->bind_null(pRtree->pWriteRowid,1);
sqlite3_api->bind_null(pRtree->pWriteRowid,2);
sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pWriteRowid);
  rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pWriteRowid);
  *piRowid =sqlite3_api->last_insert_rowid(pRtree->db);
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeDeleteRowid(Rtree *pRtree, sqlite3_int64 iDelete){
  int rc;
  RtreeNode *pLeaf = 0;
  int iCell;
  RtreeNode *pRoot = 0;



  rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, 1, 0, &pRoot);




  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = findLeafNode(pRtree, iDelete, &pLeaf, 0);
  }


  assert( pLeaf!=0 || rc!=0         ||(sqlite3Config.neverCorrupt==0));



  if( rc==0         && pLeaf ){
    int rc2;
    rc = nodeRowidIndex(pRtree, pLeaf, iDelete, &iCell);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = deleteCell(pRtree, pLeaf, iCell, 0);
    }
    rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pLeaf);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = rc2;
    }
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pRtree->pDeleteRowid,1, iDelete);
sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pDeleteRowid);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pDeleteRowid);
  }









  if( rc==0         && pRtree->iDepth>0 &&readInt16(&(pRoot)->zData[2])==1){
    int rc2;
    RtreeNode *pChild = 0;
    i64 iChild = nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pRoot, 0);
    rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, iChild, pRoot, &pChild);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = removeNode(pRtree, pChild, pRtree->iDepth-1);
    }
    rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pChild);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
    if( rc==0         ){
      pRtree->iDepth--;
      writeInt16(pRoot->zData, pRtree->iDepth);
      pRoot->isDirty = 1;
    }
  }


  for(pLeaf=pRtree->pDeleted; pLeaf; pLeaf=pRtree->pDeleted){
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = reinsertNodeContent(pRtree, pLeaf);
    }
    pRtree->pDeleted = pLeaf->pNext;
    pRtree->nNodeRef--;
sqlite3_api->free(pLeaf);
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = nodeRelease(pRtree, pRoot);
  }else{
    nodeRelease(pRtree, pRoot);
  }

  return rc;
}












static RtreeValue rtreeValueDown(sqlite3_value *v){
sqlite_int64 d=sqlite3_api->value_double(v);
sqlite_int64 f=(sqlite_int64)d;
  if( f>d ){
    f = (sqlite_int64)(d*(d<0?(1.0 + 1.0/8388608.0):(1.0 - 1.0/8388608.0)));
  }
  return f;
}
static RtreeValue rtreeValueUp(sqlite3_value *v){
sqlite_int64 d=sqlite3_api->value_double(v);
sqlite_int64 f=(sqlite_int64)d;
  if( f<d ){
    f = (sqlite_int64)(d*(d<0?(1.0 - 1.0/8388608.0):(1.0 + 1.0/8388608.0)));
  }
  return f;
}















static int rtreeConstraintError(Rtree *pRtree, int iCol){
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  char *zSql;
  int rc;

  assert( iCol==0 || iCol%2 );
  zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf("SELECT * FROM %Q.%Q",pRtree->zDb,pRtree->zName);
  if( zSql ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(pRtree->db,zSql,-1,&pStmt,0);
  }else{
    rc =7            ;
  }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( iCol==0 ){
      const char *zCol =sqlite3_api->column_name(pStmt,0);
      pRtree->base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
          "UNIQUE constraint failed: %s.%s", pRtree->zName, zCol
      );
    }else{
      const char *zCol1 =sqlite3_api->column_name(pStmt,iCol);
      const char *zCol2 =sqlite3_api->column_name(pStmt,iCol+1);
      pRtree->base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
          "rtree constraint failed: %s.(%s<=%s)", pRtree->zName, zCol1, zCol2
      );
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
  return (rc==0         ?19                 : rc);
}






static int rtreeUpdate(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nData,
  sqlite3_value **aData,
  sqlite_int64 *pRowid
){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeCell cell;
  int bHaveRowid = 0;

  if( pRtree->nNodeRef ){



    return(6 | (2<<8))       ;
  }
  rtreeReference(pRtree);
  assert(nData>=1);

  memset(&cell, 0, sizeof(cell));












  if( nData>1 ){
    int ii;
    int nn = nData - 4;

    if( nn > pRtree->nDim2 ) nn = pRtree->nDim2;










    if( pRtree->eCoordType==0                  ){
      for(ii=0; ii<nn; ii+=2){
        cell.aCoord[ii].f = rtreeValueDown(aData[ii+3]);
        cell.aCoord[ii+1].f = rtreeValueUp(aData[ii+4]);
        if( cell.aCoord[ii].f>cell.aCoord[ii+1].f ){
          rc = rtreeConstraintError(pRtree, ii+1);
          goto constraint;
        }
      }
    }else

    {
      for(ii=0; ii<nn; ii+=2){
        cell.aCoord[ii].i =sqlite3_api->value_int(aData[ii+3]);
        cell.aCoord[ii+1].i =sqlite3_api->value_int(aData[ii+4]);
        if( cell.aCoord[ii].i>cell.aCoord[ii+1].i ){
          rc = rtreeConstraintError(pRtree, ii+1);
          goto constraint;
        }
      }
    }



    if(sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[2])!=5       ){
      cell.iRowid =sqlite3_api->value_int64(aData[2]);
      if(sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[0])==5
       ||sqlite3_api->value_int64(aData[0])!=cell.iRowid
      ){
        int steprc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64   (pRtree->pReadRowid, 1, cell.iRowid);
        steprc =sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pReadRowid);
        rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pReadRowid);
        if(100        ==steprc ){
          if(sqlite3_api->vtab_on_conflict(pRtree->db)==5          ){
            rc = rtreeDeleteRowid(pRtree, cell.iRowid);
          }else{
            rc = rtreeConstraintError(pRtree, 0);
            goto constraint;
          }
        }
      }
      bHaveRowid = 1;
    }
  }





  if(sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[0])!=5       ){
    rc = rtreeDeleteRowid(pRtree,sqlite3_api->value_int64(aData[0]));
  }





  if( rc==0         && nData>1 ){

    RtreeNode *pLeaf = 0;


    if( bHaveRowid==0 ){
      rc = rtreeNewRowid(pRtree, &cell.iRowid);
    }
    *pRowid = cell.iRowid;

    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = ChooseLeaf(pRtree, &cell, 0, &pLeaf);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      int rc2;
      pRtree->iReinsertHeight = -1;
      rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pLeaf, &cell, 0);
      rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pLeaf);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = rc2;
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         && pRtree->nAux ){
      sqlite3_stmt *pUp = pRtree->pWriteAux;
      int jj;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pUp, 1, *pRowid);
      for(jj=0; jj<pRtree->nAux; jj++){
sqlite3_api->bind_value   (pUp, jj+2, aData[pRtree->nDim2+3 +jj]);
      }
sqlite3_api->step (pUp);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUp);
    }
  }

constraint:
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeBeginTransaction(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  assert( pRtree->inWrTrans==0 );
  pRtree->inWrTrans++;
  return 0        ;
}





static int rtreeEndTransaction(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  pRtree->inWrTrans = 0;
  nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
  return 0        ;
}




static int rtreeRename(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab, const char *zNewName){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  int rc =7            ;
  char *zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
    "ALTER TABLE %Q.'%q_node'   RENAME TO \"%w_node\";"
    "ALTER TABLE %Q.'%q_parent' RENAME TO \"%w_parent\";"
    "ALTER TABLE %Q.'%q_rowid'  RENAME TO \"%w_rowid\";"
    , pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName, zNewName
    , pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName, zNewName
    , pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName, zNewName
  );
  if( zSql ){
    nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(pRtree->db,zSql,0,0,0);
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  }
  return rc;
}















static int rtreeSavepoint(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab, int iSavepoint){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  u8 iwt = pRtree->inWrTrans;
(void)(iSavepoint)            ;
  pRtree->inWrTrans = 0;
  nodeBlobReset(pRtree);
  pRtree->inWrTrans = iwt;
  return 0        ;
}






static int rtreeQueryStat1(sqlite3 *db, Rtree *pRtree){
  const char *zFmt = "SELECT stat FROM %Q.sqlite_stat1 WHERE tbl = '%q_rowid'";
  char *zSql;
  sqlite3_stmt *p;
  int rc;
  i64 nRow =100              ;

  rc =sqlite3_api->table_column_metadata(
      db, pRtree->zDb, "sqlite_stat1",0,0,0,0,0,0
  );
  if( rc!=0         ){
    pRtree->nRowEst =1048576              ;
    return rc==1            ?0          : rc;
  }
  zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(zFmt,pRtree->zDb,pRtree->zName);
  if( zSql==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(db,zSql,-1,&p,0);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if(sqlite3_api->step(p)==100    ) nRow =sqlite3_api->column_int64(p,0);
      rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(p);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  }
  pRtree->nRowEst =((nRow)>(100)?(nRow):(100)) ;
  return rc;
}






static int rtreeShadowName(const char *zName){
  static const char *azName[] = {
    "node", "parent", "rowid"
  };
  unsigned int i;
  for(i=0; i<sizeof(azName)/sizeof(azName[0]); i++){
    if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,azName[i])==0)return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}
