static int rtreeSqlInit(
  Rtree *pRtree,
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zDb,
  const char *zPrefix,
  int isCreate
){
  int rc =0         ;


  static const char *azSql[8          ] = {

    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO '%q'.'%q_node' VALUES(?1, ?2)",
    "DELETE FROM '%q'.'%q_node' WHERE nodeno = ?1",


    "SELECT nodeno FROM '%q'.'%q_rowid' WHERE rowid = ?1",
    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO '%q'.'%q_rowid' VALUES(?1, ?2)",
    "DELETE FROM '%q'.'%q_rowid' WHERE rowid = ?1",


    "SELECT parentnode FROM '%q'.'%q_parent' WHERE nodeno = ?1",
    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO '%q'.'%q_parent' VALUES(?1, ?2)",
    "DELETE FROM '%q'.'%q_parent' WHERE nodeno = ?1"
  };
  sqlite3_stmt **appStmt[8          ];
  int i;
  const int f =0x01                      |0x04                  ;

  pRtree->db = db;

  if( isCreate ){
    char *zCreate;
    sqlite3_str *p =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
    int ii;
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(p,
       "CREATE TABLE \"%w\".\"%w_rowid\"(rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,nodeno",
       zDb, zPrefix);
    for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nAux; ii++){
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (p,",a%d",ii);
    }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(p,
      ");CREATE TABLE \"%w\".\"%w_node\"(nodeno INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,data);",
      zDb, zPrefix);
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(p,
    "CREATE TABLE \"%w\".\"%w_parent\"(nodeno INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,parentnode);",
      zDb, zPrefix);
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(p,
       "INSERT INTO \"%w\".\"%w_node\"VALUES(1,zeroblob(%d))",
       zDb, zPrefix, pRtree->iNodeSize);
    zCreate =sqlite3_api->str_finish(p);
    if( !zCreate ){
      return 7           ;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,zCreate,0,0,0);
sqlite3_api->free(zCreate);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      return rc;
    }
  }

  appStmt[0] = &pRtree->pWriteNode;
  appStmt[1] = &pRtree->pDeleteNode;
  appStmt[2] = &pRtree->pReadRowid;
  appStmt[3] = &pRtree->pWriteRowid;
  appStmt[4] = &pRtree->pDeleteRowid;
  appStmt[5] = &pRtree->pReadParent;
  appStmt[6] = &pRtree->pWriteParent;
  appStmt[7] = &pRtree->pDeleteParent;

  rc = rtreeQueryStat1(db, pRtree);
  for(i=0; i<8           && rc==0        ; i++){
    char *zSql;
    const char *zFormat;
    if( i!=3 || pRtree->nAux==0 ){
       zFormat = azSql[i];
    }else {


       zFormat = "INSERT INTO\"%w\".\"%w_rowid\"(rowid,nodeno)VALUES(?1,?2)"
                  "ON CONFLICT(rowid)DO UPDATE SET nodeno=excluded.nodeno";
    }
    zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(zFormat,zDb,zPrefix);
    if( zSql ){
      rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(db,zSql,-1,f,appStmt[i], 0);
    }else{
      rc =7            ;
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  }
  if( pRtree->nAux ){
    pRtree->zReadAuxSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
       "SELECT * FROM \"%w\".\"%w_rowid\" WHERE rowid=?1",
       zDb, zPrefix);
    if( pRtree->zReadAuxSql==0 ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      sqlite3_str *p =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
      int ii;
      char *zSql;
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (p, "UPDATE \"%w\".\"%w_rowid\"SET ", zDb, zPrefix);
      for(ii=0; ii<pRtree->nAux; ii++){
        if( ii )sqlite3_api->str_append(p,",",1);

        if( ii<pRtree->nAuxNotNull ){
sqlite3_api->str_appendf     (p,"a%d=coalesce(?%d,a%d)",ii,ii+2,ii);
        }else

        {
sqlite3_api->str_appendf     (p,"a%d=?%d",ii,ii+2);
        }
      }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (p, " WHERE rowid=?1");
      zSql =sqlite3_api->str_finish(p);
      if( zSql==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(db,zSql,-1,f,&pRtree->pWriteAux, 0);
sqlite3_api->free   (zSql);
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}








static int getIntFromStmt(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSql, int *piVal){
  int rc =7            ;
  if( zSql ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(db,zSql,-1,&pStmt,0);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
        *piVal =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0);
      }
      rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}
















static int getNodeSize(
  sqlite3 *db,
  Rtree *pRtree,
  int isCreate,
  char **pzErr
){
  int rc;
  char *zSql;
  if( isCreate ){
    int iPageSize = 0;
    zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf("PRAGMA %Q.page_size",pRtree->zDb);
    rc = getIntFromStmt(db, zSql, &iPageSize);
    if( rc==0         ){
      pRtree->iNodeSize = iPageSize-64;
      if( (4 +pRtree->nBytesPerCell*51           )<pRtree->iNodeSize ){
        pRtree->iNodeSize = 4 +pRtree->nBytesPerCell*51           ;
      }
    }else{
      *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
    }
  }else{
    zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
        "SELECT length(data) FROM '%q'.'%q_node' WHERE nodeno = 1",
        pRtree->zDb, pRtree->zName
    );
    rc = getIntFromStmt(db, zSql, &pRtree->iNodeSize);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
    }else if( pRtree->iNodeSize<(512 -64)){
      rc =(11 | (1<<8))       ;
((pRtree)->bCorrupt = 1)      ;
      *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("undersize RTree blobs in \"%q_node\"",
                               pRtree->zName);
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  return rc;
}




static int rtreeTokenLength(const char *z){
  int dummy = 0;
  return sqlite3GetToken((const unsigned char*)z,&dummy);
}










static int rtreeInit(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr,
  int isCreate
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Rtree *pRtree;
  int nDb;
  int nName;
  int eCoordType = (pAux ?1                  :0                  );
  sqlite3_str *pSql;
  char *zSql;
  int ii = 4;
  int iErr;

  const char *aErrMsg[] = {
    0,
    "Wrong number of columns for an rtree table",
    "Too few columns for an rtree table",
    "Too many columns for an rtree table",
    "Auxiliary rtree columns must be last"
  };

  assert(100                  <256 );
  if( argc<6 || argc>100                 +3 ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",aErrMsg[2 +(argc>=6)]);
    return 1           ;
  }

sqlite3_api->vtab_config(db,1                           , 1);


  nDb = (int)strlen(argv[1]);
  nName = (int)strlen(argv[2]);
  pRtree = (Rtree *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(Rtree)+nDb+nName+2);
  if( !pRtree ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  memset(pRtree, 0, sizeof(Rtree)+nDb+nName+2);
  pRtree->nBusy = 1;
  pRtree->base.pModule = &rtreeModule;
  pRtree->zDb = (char *)&pRtree[1];
  pRtree->zName = &pRtree->zDb[nDb+1];
  pRtree->eCoordType = (u8)eCoordType;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pRtree->zDb);const char*xxs=(const char*)(argv[1]); int xxn=(nDb);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
{char*xxd=(char*)(pRtree->zName);const char*xxs=(const char*)(argv[2]); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};






  pSql =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pSql,"CREATE TABLE x(%.*s INT",
                      rtreeTokenLength(argv[3]), argv[3]);
  for(ii=4; ii<argc; ii++){
    const char *zArg = argv[ii];
    if( zArg[0]=='+' ){
      pRtree->nAux++;
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (pSql, ",%.*s", rtreeTokenLength(zArg+1), zArg+1);
    }else if( pRtree->nAux>0 ){
      break;
    }else{
      static const char *azFormat[] = {",%.*s REAL", ",%.*s INT"};
      pRtree->nDim2++;
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (pSql, azFormat[eCoordType],
                          rtreeTokenLength(zArg), zArg);
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pSql,");");
  zSql =sqlite3_api->str_finish(pSql);
  if( !zSql ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else if( ii<argc ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",aErrMsg[4]);
    rc =1            ;
  }else if(0         !=(rc =sqlite3_api->declare_vtab(db,zSql))){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
  }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  if( rc ) goto rtreeInit_fail;
  pRtree->nDim = pRtree->nDim2/2;
  if( pRtree->nDim<1 ){
    iErr = 2;
  }else if( pRtree->nDim2>5                   *2 ){
    iErr = 3;
  }else if( pRtree->nDim2 % 2 ){
    iErr = 1;
  }else{
    iErr = 0;
  }
  if( iErr ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",aErrMsg[iErr]);
    goto rtreeInit_fail;
  }
  pRtree->nBytesPerCell = 8 + pRtree->nDim2*4;


  rc = getNodeSize(db, pRtree, isCreate, pzErr);
  if( rc ) goto rtreeInit_fail;
  rc = rtreeSqlInit(pRtree, db, argv[1], argv[2], isCreate);
  if( rc ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
    goto rtreeInit_fail;
  }

  *ppVtab = (sqlite3_vtab *)pRtree;
  return 0        ;

rtreeInit_fail:
  if( rc==0         ) rc =1            ;
  assert( *ppVtab==0 );
  assert( pRtree->nBusy==1 );
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}


















static void rtreenode(sqlite3_context *ctx, int nArg, sqlite3_value **apArg){
  RtreeNode node;
  Rtree tree;
  int ii;
  int nData;
  int errCode;
  sqlite3_str *pOut;

(void)(nArg)            ;
  memset(&node, 0, sizeof(RtreeNode));
  memset(&tree, 0, sizeof(Rtree));
  tree.nDim = (u8)sqlite3_api->value_int(apArg[0]);
  if( tree.nDim<1 || tree.nDim>5 ) return;
  tree.nDim2 = tree.nDim*2;
  tree.nBytesPerCell = 8 + 8 * tree.nDim;
  node.zData = (u8 *)sqlite3_api->value_blob(apArg[1]);
  if( node.zData==0 ) return;
  nData =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(apArg[1]);
  if( nData<4 ) return;
  if( nData<readInt16(&(&node)->zData[2])*tree.nBytesPerCell)return;

  pOut =sqlite3_api->str_new(0);
  for(ii=0; ii<readInt16(&(&node)->zData[2]);ii++){
    RtreeCell cell;
    int jj;

    nodeGetCell(&tree, &node, ii, &cell);
    if( ii>0 )sqlite3_api->str_append(pOut," ",1);
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pOut,"{%lld", cell.iRowid);
    for(jj=0; jj<tree.nDim2; jj++){

sqlite3_api->str_appendf (pOut, " %g", (sqlite_int64)cell.aCoord[jj].f);

sqlite3_api->str_appendf (pOut, " %d", cell.aCoord[jj].i);

    }
sqlite3_api->str_append(pOut,"}", 1);
  }
  errCode =sqlite3_api->str_errcode(pOut);
sqlite3_api->result_text(ctx,sqlite3_api->str_finish(pOut),-1,sqlite3_api->free);
sqlite3_api->result_error_code(ctx,errCode);
}










static void rtreedepth(sqlite3_context *ctx, int nArg, sqlite3_value **apArg){
(void)(nArg)            ;
  if(sqlite3_api->value_type(apArg[0])!=4
   ||sqlite3_api->value_bytes(apArg[0])<2

  ){
sqlite3_api->result_error(ctx,"Invalid argument to rtreedepth()", -1);
  }else{
    u8 *zBlob = (u8 *)sqlite3_api->value_blob(apArg[0]);
    if( zBlob ){
sqlite3_api->result_int (ctx, readInt16(zBlob));
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (ctx);
    }
  }
}





typedef struct RtreeCheck RtreeCheck;
struct RtreeCheck {
  sqlite3 *db;
  const char *zDb;
  const char *zTab;
  int bInt;
  int nDim;
  sqlite3_stmt *pGetNode;
  sqlite3_stmt *aCheckMapping[2];
  int nLeaf;
  int nNonLeaf;
  int rc;
  char *zReport;
  int nErr;
};







static void rtreeCheckReset(RtreeCheck *pCheck, sqlite3_stmt *pStmt){
  int rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pStmt);
  if( pCheck->rc==0         ) pCheck->rc = rc;
}









static sqlite3_stmt *rtreeCheckPrepare(
  RtreeCheck *pCheck,
  const char *zFmt, ...
){
  va_list ap;
  char *z;
  sqlite3_stmt *pRet = 0;

  va_start(ap, zFmt);
  z =sqlite3_api->vmprintf(zFmt,ap);

  if( pCheck->rc==0         ){
    if( z==0 ){
      pCheck->rc =7            ;
    }else{
      pCheck->rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(pCheck->db,z,-1,&pRet,0);
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(z);
  va_end(ap);
  return pRet;
}






static void rtreeCheckAppendMsg(RtreeCheck *pCheck, const char *zFmt, ...){
  va_list ap;
  va_start(ap, zFmt);
  if( pCheck->rc==0         && pCheck->nErr<100                   ){
    char *z =sqlite3_api->vmprintf(zFmt,ap);
    if( z==0 ){
      pCheck->rc =7            ;
    }else{
      pCheck->zReport =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%z%s%z",
          pCheck->zReport, (pCheck->zReport ? "\n" : ""), z
      );
      if( pCheck->zReport==0 ){
        pCheck->rc =7            ;
      }
    }
    pCheck->nErr++;
  }
  va_end(ap);
}















static u8 *rtreeCheckGetNode(RtreeCheck *pCheck, i64 iNode, int *pnNode){
  u8 *pRet = 0;

  if( pCheck->rc==0         && pCheck->pGetNode==0 ){
    pCheck->pGetNode = rtreeCheckPrepare(pCheck,
        "SELECT data FROM %Q.'%q_node' WHERE nodeno=?",
        pCheck->zDb, pCheck->zTab
    );
  }

  if( pCheck->rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pCheck->pGetNode,1, iNode);
    if(sqlite3_api->step(pCheck->pGetNode)==100    ){
      int nNode =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pCheck->pGetNode,0);
      const u8 *pNode = (const u8*)sqlite3_api->column_blob(pCheck->pGetNode,0);
      pRet =sqlite3_api->malloc64(nNode);
      if( pRet==0 ){
        pCheck->rc =7            ;
      }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(pRet);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pNode); int xxn=(nNode);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        *pnNode = nNode;
      }
    }
    rtreeCheckReset(pCheck, pCheck->pGetNode);
    if( pCheck->rc==0         && pRet==0 ){
      rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck, "Node %lld missing from database", iNode);
    }
  }

  return pRet;
}













static void rtreeCheckMapping(
  RtreeCheck *pCheck,
  int bLeaf,
  i64 iKey,
  i64 iVal
){
  int rc;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  const char *azSql[2] = {
    "SELECT parentnode FROM %Q.'%q_parent' WHERE nodeno=?1",
    "SELECT nodeno FROM %Q.'%q_rowid' WHERE rowid=?1"
  };

  assert( bLeaf==0 || bLeaf==1 );
  if( pCheck->aCheckMapping[bLeaf]==0 ){
    pCheck->aCheckMapping[bLeaf] = rtreeCheckPrepare(pCheck,
        azSql[bLeaf], pCheck->zDb, pCheck->zTab
    );
  }
  if( pCheck->rc!=0         ) return;

  pStmt = pCheck->aCheckMapping[bLeaf];
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pStmt,1,iKey);
  rc =sqlite3_api->step(pStmt);
  if( rc==101         ){
    rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck, "Mapping (%lld -> %lld) missing from %s table",
        iKey, iVal, (bLeaf ? "%_rowid" : "%_parent")
    );
  }else if( rc==100        ){
    i64 ii =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0);
    if( ii!=iVal ){
      rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck,
          "Found (%lld -> %lld) in %s table, expected (%lld -> %lld)",
          iKey, ii, (bLeaf ? "%_rowid" : "%_parent"), iKey, iVal
      );
    }
  }
  rtreeCheckReset(pCheck, pStmt);
}













static void rtreeCheckCellCoord(
  RtreeCheck *pCheck,
  i64 iNode,
  int iCell,
  u8 *pCell,
  u8 *pParent
){
  RtreeCoord c1, c2;
  RtreeCoord p1, p2;
  int i;

  for(i=0; i<pCheck->nDim; i++){
    readCoord(&pCell[4*2*i], &c1);
    readCoord(&pCell[4*(2*i + 1)], &c2);


    if( pCheck->bInt ? c1.i>c2.i : c1.f>c2.f ){
      rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck,
          "Dimension %d of cell %d on node %lld is corrupt", i, iCell, iNode
      );
    }

    if( pParent ){
      readCoord(&pParent[4*2*i], &p1);
      readCoord(&pParent[4*(2*i + 1)], &p2);

      if( (pCheck->bInt ? c1.i<p1.i : c1.f<p1.f)
       || (pCheck->bInt ? c2.i>p2.i : c2.f>p2.f)
      ){
        rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck,
            "Dimension %d of cell %d on node %lld is corrupt relative to parent"
            , i, iCell, iNode
        );
      }
    }
  }
}









static void rtreeCheckNode(
  RtreeCheck *pCheck,
  int iDepth,
  u8 *aParent,
  i64 iNode
){
  u8 *aNode = 0;
  int nNode = 0;

  assert( iNode==1 || aParent!=0 );
  assert( pCheck->nDim>0 );

  aNode = rtreeCheckGetNode(pCheck, iNode, &nNode);
  if( aNode ){
    if( nNode<4 ){
      rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck,
          "Node %lld is too small (%d bytes)", iNode, nNode
      );
    }else{
      int nCell;
      int i;
      if( aParent==0 ){
        iDepth = readInt16(aNode);
        if( iDepth>40              ){
          rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck, "Rtree depth out of range (%d)", iDepth);
sqlite3_api->free     (aNode);
          return;
        }
      }
      nCell = readInt16(&aNode[2]);
      if( (4 + nCell*(8 + pCheck->nDim*2*4))>nNode ){
        rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck,
            "Node %lld is too small for cell count of %d (%d bytes)",
            iNode, nCell, nNode
        );
      }else{
        for(i=0; i<nCell; i++){
          u8 *pCell = &aNode[4 + i*(8 + pCheck->nDim*2*4)];
          i64 iVal = readInt64(pCell);
          rtreeCheckCellCoord(pCheck, iNode, i, &pCell[8], aParent);

          if( iDepth>0 ){
            rtreeCheckMapping(pCheck, 0, iVal, iNode);
            rtreeCheckNode(pCheck, iDepth-1, &pCell[8], iVal);
            pCheck->nNonLeaf++;
          }else{
            rtreeCheckMapping(pCheck, 1, iVal, iNode);
            pCheck->nLeaf++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->free(aNode);
  }
}








static void rtreeCheckCount(RtreeCheck *pCheck, const char *zTbl, i64 nExpect){
  if( pCheck->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pCount;
    pCount = rtreeCheckPrepare(pCheck, "SELECT count(*) FROM %Q.'%q%s'",
        pCheck->zDb, pCheck->zTab, zTbl
    );
    if( pCount ){
      if(sqlite3_api->step(pCount)==100    ){
        i64 nActual =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pCount,0);
        if( nActual!=nExpect ){
          rtreeCheckAppendMsg(pCheck, "Wrong number of entries in %%%s table"
              " - expected %lld, actual %lld" , zTbl, nExpect, nActual
          );
        }
      }
      pCheck->rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pCount);
    }
  }
}





static int rtreeCheckTable(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zDb,
  const char *zTab,
  char **pzReport
){
  RtreeCheck check;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  int bEnd = 0;
  int nAux = 0;


  memset(&check, 0, sizeof(check));
  check.db = db;
  check.zDb = zDb;
  check.zTab = zTab;




  if(sqlite3_api->get_autocommit(db)){
    check.rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"BEGIN",0,0,0);
    bEnd = 1;
  }


  if( check.rc==0         ){
    pStmt = rtreeCheckPrepare(&check, "SELECT * FROM %Q.'%q_rowid'", zDb, zTab);
    if( pStmt ){
      nAux =sqlite3_api->column_count(pStmt)-2;
sqlite3_api->finalize (pStmt);
    }else
    if( check.rc!=7            ){
      check.rc =0         ;
    }
  }


  pStmt = rtreeCheckPrepare(&check, "SELECT * FROM %Q.%Q", zDb, zTab);
  if( pStmt ){
    int rc;
    check.nDim = (sqlite3_api->column_count(pStmt)-1 -nAux)/2;
    if( check.nDim<1 ){
      rtreeCheckAppendMsg(&check, "Schema corrupt or not an rtree");
    }else if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      check.bInt = (sqlite3_api->column_type(pStmt,1)==1         );
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
    if( rc!=11             ) check.rc = rc;
  }


  if( check.nDim>=1 ){
    if( check.rc==0         ){
      rtreeCheckNode(&check, 0, 0, 1);
    }
    rtreeCheckCount(&check, "_rowid", check.nLeaf);
    rtreeCheckCount(&check, "_parent", check.nNonLeaf);
  }


sqlite3_api->finalize(check.pGetNode);
sqlite3_api->finalize(check.aCheckMapping[0]);
sqlite3_api->finalize(check.aCheckMapping[1]);


  if( bEnd ){
    int rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"END",0,0,0);
    if( check.rc==0         ) check.rc = rc;
  }
  *pzReport = check.zReport;
  return check.rc;
}


































static void rtreecheck(
  sqlite3_context *ctx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  if( nArg!=1 && nArg!=2 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error(ctx,
        "wrong number of arguments to function rtreecheck()", -1
    );
  }else{
    int rc;
    char *zReport = 0;
    const char *zDb = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apArg[0]);
    const char *zTab;
    if( nArg==1 ){
      zTab = zDb;
      zDb = "main";
    }else{
      zTab = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apArg[1]);
    }
    rc = rtreeCheckTable(sqlite3_api->context_db_handle(ctx),zDb,zTab,&zReport);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->result_text (ctx, zReport ? zReport : "ok", -1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_error_code (ctx, rc);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zReport);
  }
}

typedef sqlite_int64 GeoCoord;























typedef struct GeoPoly GeoPoly;
struct GeoPoly {
  int nVertex;
  unsigned char hdr[4];
  GeoCoord a[8];
};

















typedef struct GeoParse GeoParse;
struct GeoParse {
  const unsigned char *z;
  int nVertex;
  int nAlloc;
  int nErr;
  GeoCoord *a;
};


static void geopolySwab32(unsigned char *a){
  unsigned char t = a[0];
  a[0] = a[3];
  a[3] = t;
  t = a[1];
  a[1] = a[2];
  a[2] = t;
}


static char geopolySkipSpace(GeoParse *p){
  while((jsonIsSpace[(unsigned char)p->z[0]]))p->z++;
  return p->z[0];
}




static int geopolyParseNumber(GeoParse *p, GeoCoord *pVal){
  char c = geopolySkipSpace(p);
  const unsigned char *z = p->z;
  int j = 0;
  int seenDP = 0;
  int seenE = 0;
  if( c=='-' ){
    j = 1;
    c = z[j];
  }
  if( c=='0' && z[j+1]>='0' && z[j+1]<='9' ) return 0;
  for(;; j++){
    c = z[j];
    if((sqlite3CtypeMap[(unsigned char)(c)]&0x04))continue;
    if( c=='.' ){
      if( z[j-1]=='-' ) return 0;
      if( seenDP ) return 0;
      seenDP = 1;
      continue;
    }
    if( c=='e' || c=='E' ){
      if( z[j-1]<'0' ) return 0;
      if( seenE ) return -1;
      seenDP = seenE = 1;
      c = z[j+1];
      if( c=='+' || c=='-' ){
        j++;
        c = z[j+1];
      }
      if( c<'0' || c>'9' ) return 0;
      continue;
    }
    break;
  }
  if( z[j-1]<'0' ) return 0;
  if( pVal ){



sqlite_int64 r;
     (void)sqlite3AtoF((const char*)p->z, &r, j,1           );
     *pVal = r;

     *pVal = (GeoCoord)atof((const char*)p->z);

  }
  p->z += j;
  return 1;
}









static GeoPoly *geopolyParseJson(const unsigned char *z, int *pRc){
  GeoParse s;
  int rc =0         ;
  memset(&s, 0, sizeof(s));
  s.z = z;
  if( geopolySkipSpace(&s)=='[' ){
    s.z++;
    while( geopolySkipSpace(&s)=='[' ){
      int ii = 0;
      char c;
      s.z++;
      if( s.nVertex>=s.nAlloc ){
        GeoCoord *aNew;
        s.nAlloc = s.nAlloc*2 + 16;
        aNew =sqlite3_api->realloc64(s.a,s.nAlloc*sizeof(GeoCoord)*2);
        if( aNew==0 ){
          rc =7            ;
          s.nErr++;
          break;
        }
        s.a = aNew;
      }
      while( geopolyParseNumber(&s, ii<=1 ? &s.a[s.nVertex*2 +ii]: 0) ){
        ii++;
        if( ii==2 ) s.nVertex++;
        c = geopolySkipSpace(&s);
        s.z++;
        if( c==',' ) continue;
        if( c==']' && ii>=2 ) break;
        s.nErr++;
        rc =1            ;
        goto parse_json_err;
      }
      if( geopolySkipSpace(&s)==',' ){
        s.z++;
        continue;
      }
      break;
    }
    if( geopolySkipSpace(&s)==']'
     && s.nVertex>=4
     && s.a[0]==s.a[s.nVertex*2 -2]
     && s.a[1]==s.a[s.nVertex*2 -1]
     && (s.z++, geopolySkipSpace(&s)==0)
    ){
      GeoPoly *pOut;
      int x = 1;
      s.nVertex--;
      pOut =sqlite3_api->malloc64((sizeof(GeoPoly) + sizeof(GeoCoord)*2*(((sqlite3_int64)s.nVertex)-4)));
      x = 1;
      if( pOut==0 ) goto parse_json_err;
      pOut->nVertex = s.nVertex;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut->a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(s.a); int xxn=(s.nVertex*2*sizeof(GeoCoord));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pOut->hdr[0] = *(unsigned char*)&x;
      pOut->hdr[1] = (s.nVertex>>16)&0xff;
      pOut->hdr[2] = (s.nVertex>>8)&0xff;
      pOut->hdr[3] = s.nVertex&0xff;
sqlite3_api->free (s.a);
      if( pRc ) *pRc =0         ;
      return pOut;
    }else{
      s.nErr++;
      rc =1            ;
    }
  }
parse_json_err:
  if( pRc ) *pRc = rc;
sqlite3_api->free(s.a);
  return 0;
}







static GeoPoly *geopolyFuncParam(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  sqlite3_value *pVal,
  int *pRc
){
  GeoPoly *p = 0;
  int nByte;
if( pCtx==0 ){ sqlite3CoverageCounter += (unsigned)__LINE__; };
  if(sqlite3_api->value_type(pVal)==4
   && (nByte =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(pVal))>=(int)(4 +6*sizeof(GeoCoord))
  ){
    const unsigned char *a =sqlite3_api->value_blob(pVal);
    int nVertex;
    if( a==0 ){
      if( pCtx )sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(pCtx);
      return 0;
    }
    nVertex = (a[1]<<16) + (a[2]<<8) + a[3];
    if( (a[0]==0 || a[0]==1)
     && (nVertex*2*sizeof(GeoCoord) + 4)==(unsigned int)nByte
    ){
      p =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(*p)+(nVertex-1)*2*sizeof(GeoCoord));
      if( p==0 ){
        if( pRc ) *pRc =7            ;
        if( pCtx )sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(pCtx);
      }else{
        int x = 1;
        p->nVertex = nVertex;
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->hdr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a); int xxn=(nByte);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        if( a[0] != *(unsigned char*)&x ){
          int ii;
          for(ii=0; ii<nVertex; ii++){
            geopolySwab32((unsigned char*)&(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2]));
            geopolySwab32((unsigned char*)&(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]));
          }
          p->hdr[0] ^= 1;
        }
      }
    }
    if( pRc ) *pRc =0         ;
    return p;
  }else if(sqlite3_api->value_type(pVal)==3       ){
    const unsigned char *zJson =sqlite3_api->value_text(pVal);
    if( zJson==0 ){
      if( pRc ) *pRc =7            ;
      return 0;
    }
    return geopolyParseJson(zJson, pRc);
  }else{
    if( pRc ) *pRc =1            ;
    return 0;
  }
}








static void geopolyBlobFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,
       4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}







static void geopolyJsonFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
    sqlite3 *db =sqlite3_api->context_db_handle(context);
    sqlite3_str *x =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
    int i;
sqlite3_api->str_append(x,"[", 1);
    for(i=0; i<p->nVertex; i++){
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (x, "[%!g,%!g],",(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2 +1]));
    }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(x,"[%!g,%!g]]",(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2 +1]));
sqlite3_api->result_text(context,sqlite3_api->str_finish(x),-1,sqlite3_api->free);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}







static void geopolySvgFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p;
  if( argc<1 ) return;
  p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  if( p ){
    sqlite3 *db =sqlite3_api->context_db_handle(context);
    sqlite3_str *x =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
    int i;
    char cSep = '\'';
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(x,"<polyline points=");
    for(i=0; i<p->nVertex; i++){
sqlite3_api->str_appendf (x, "%c%g,%g", cSep,(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2 +1]));
      cSep = ' ';
    }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(x," %g,%g'",(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2 +1]));
    for(i=1; i<argc; i++){
      const char *z = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[i]);
      if( z && z[0] ){
sqlite3_api->str_appendf   (x, " %s", z);
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(x,"></polyline>");
sqlite3_api->result_text(context,sqlite3_api->str_finish(x),-1,sqlite3_api->free);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}

















static void geopolyXformFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
sqlite_int64 A=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[1]);
sqlite_int64 B=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[2]);
sqlite_int64 C=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[3]);
sqlite_int64 D=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[4]);
sqlite_int64 E=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[5]);
sqlite_int64 F=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[6]);
  GeoCoord x1, y1, x0, y0;
  int ii;
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
    for(ii=0; ii<p->nVertex; ii++){
      x0 =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2]);
      y0 =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]);
      x1 = (GeoCoord)(A*x0 + B*y0 + E);
      y1 = (GeoCoord)(C*x0 + D*y0 + F);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2])=x1;
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1])=y1;
    }
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,
       4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}








static sqlite_int64 geopolyArea(GeoPoly*p){
sqlite_int64 rArea=0.0;
  int ii;
  for(ii=0; ii<p->nVertex-1; ii++){
    rArea += ((((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2])-(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii+1)*2]))
              * ((((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1])+(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii+1)*2 +1]))
              * 0.5;
  }
  rArea += ((((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2])-(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2]))
           * ((((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1])+(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2 +1]))
           * 0.5;
  return rArea;
}









static void geopolyAreaFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->result_double(context,geopolyArea(p));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}














static void geopolyCcwFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
    if( geopolyArea(p)<0.0 ){
      int ii, jj;
      for(ii=1, jj=p->nVertex-1; ii<jj; ii++, jj--){
        GeoCoord t =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2]);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2])=(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(jj)*2]);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(jj)*2])=t;
        t =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1])=(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(jj)*2 +1]);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(jj)*2 +1])=t;
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,
       4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}





static sqlite_int64 geopolySine(sqlite_int64 r){
  assert( r>=-0.5*3.1415926535897932385&&r<=2.0*3.1415926535897932385);
  if( r>=1.5*3.1415926535897932385){
    r -= 2.0*3.1415926535897932385;
  }
  if( r>=0.5*3.1415926535897932385){
    return -geopolySine(r-3.1415926535897932385);
  }else{
sqlite_int64 r2=r*r;
sqlite_int64 r3=r2*r;
sqlite_int64 r5=r3*r2;
    return 0.9996949*r - 0.1656700*r3 + 0.0075134*r5;
  }
}







static void geopolyRegularFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
sqlite_int64 x=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[0]);
sqlite_int64 y=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[1]);
sqlite_int64 r=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[2]);
  int n =sqlite3_api->value_int(argv[3]);
  int i;
  GeoPoly *p;
  (void)argc;

  if( n<3 || r<=0.0 ) return;
  if( n>1000 ) n = 1000;
  p =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(*p)+(n-1)*2*sizeof(GeoCoord));
  if( p==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(context);
    return;
  }
  i = 1;
  p->hdr[0] = *(unsigned char*)&i;
  p->hdr[1] = 0;
  p->hdr[2] = (n>>8)&0xff;
  p->hdr[3] = n&0xff;
  for(i=0; i<n; i++){
sqlite_int64 rAngle=2.0*3.1415926535897932385*i/n;
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2])=x-r*geopolySine(rAngle-0.5*3.1415926535897932385);
(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(i)*2 +1])=y+r*geopolySine(rAngle);
  }
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,4 +8*n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
}











static GeoPoly *geopolyBBox(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  sqlite3_value *pPoly,
  RtreeCoord *aCoord,
  int *pRc
){
  GeoPoly *pOut = 0;
  GeoPoly *p;
sqlite_int64 mnX,mxX,mnY,mxY;
  if( pPoly==0 && aCoord!=0 ){
    p = 0;
    mnX = aCoord[0].f;
    mxX = aCoord[1].f;
    mnY = aCoord[2].f;
    mxY = aCoord[3].f;
    goto geopolyBboxFill;
  }else{
    p = geopolyFuncParam(context, pPoly, pRc);
  }
  if( p ){
    int ii;
    mnX = mxX =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2]);
    mnY = mxY =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(0)*2 +1]);
    for(ii=1; ii<p->nVertex; ii++){
sqlite_int64 r =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2]);
      if( r<mnX ) mnX = (sqlite_int64)r;
      else if( r>mxX ) mxX = (sqlite_int64)r;
      r =(((GeoCoord*)(p)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]);
      if( r<mnY ) mnY = (sqlite_int64)r;
      else if( r>mxY ) mxY = (sqlite_int64)r;
    }
    if( pRc ) *pRc =0         ;
    if( aCoord==0 ){
      geopolyBboxFill:
      pOut =sqlite3_api->realloc64(p,(sizeof(GeoPoly) + sizeof(GeoCoord)*2*((4)-4)));
      if( pOut==0 ){
sqlite3_api->free   (p);
        if( context )sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(context);
        if( pRc ) *pRc =7            ;
        return 0;
      }
      pOut->nVertex = 4;
      ii = 1;
      pOut->hdr[0] = *(unsigned char*)&ii;
      pOut->hdr[1] = 0;
      pOut->hdr[2] = 0;
      pOut->hdr[3] = 4;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(0)*2])=mnX;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(0)*2 +1])=mnY;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(1)*2])=mxX;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(1)*2 +1])=mnY;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(2)*2])=mxX;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(2)*2 +1])=mxY;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(3)*2])=mnX;
(((GeoCoord*)(pOut)->a)[(3)*2 +1])=mxY;
    }else{
sqlite3_api->free (p);
      aCoord[0].f = mnX;
      aCoord[1].f = mxX;
      aCoord[2].f = mnY;
      aCoord[3].f = mxY;
    }
  }else if( aCoord ){
    memset(aCoord, 0, sizeof(RtreeCoord)*4);
  }
  return pOut;
}




static void geopolyBBoxFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p = geopolyBBox(context, argv[0], 0, 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,
       4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}




typedef struct GeoBBox GeoBBox;
struct GeoBBox {
  int isInit;
  RtreeCoord a[4];
};





static void geopolyBBoxStep(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  RtreeCoord a[4];
  int rc =0         ;
  (void)argc;
  (void)geopolyBBox(context, argv[0], a, &rc);
  if( rc==0         ){
    GeoBBox *pBBox;
    pBBox = (GeoBBox*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(context,sizeof(*pBBox));
    if( pBBox==0 ) return;
    if( pBBox->isInit==0 ){
      pBBox->isInit = 1;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pBBox->a);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a); int xxn=(sizeof(RtreeCoord)*4);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }else{
      if( a[0].f < pBBox->a[0].f ) pBBox->a[0] = a[0];
      if( a[1].f > pBBox->a[1].f ) pBBox->a[1] = a[1];
      if( a[2].f < pBBox->a[2].f ) pBBox->a[2] = a[2];
      if( a[3].f > pBBox->a[3].f ) pBBox->a[3] = a[3];
    }
  }
}
static void geopolyBBoxFinal(
  sqlite3_context *context
){
  GeoPoly *p;
  GeoBBox *pBBox;
  pBBox = (GeoBBox*)sqlite3_api->aggregate_context(context,0);
  if( pBBox==0 ) return;
  p = geopolyBBox(context, 0, pBBox->a, 0);
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->result_blob(context,p->hdr,
       4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}
















static int pointBeneathLine(
sqlite_int64 x0,sqlite_int64 y0,
sqlite_int64 x1,sqlite_int64 y1,
sqlite_int64 x2,sqlite_int64 y2
){
sqlite_int64 y;
  if( x0==x1 && y0==y1 ) return 2;
  if( x1<x2 ){
    if( x0<=x1 || x0>x2 ) return 0;
  }else if( x1>x2 ){
    if( x0<=x2 || x0>x1 ) return 0;
  }else{

    if( x0!=x1 ) return 0;
    if( y0<y1 && y0<y2 ) return 0;
    if( y0>y1 && y0>y2 ) return 0;
    return 2;
  }
  y = y1 + (y2-y1)*(x0-x1)/(x2-x1);
  if( y0==y ) return 2;
  if( y0<y ) return 1;
  return 0;
}








static void geopolyContainsPointFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p1 = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
sqlite_int64 x0=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[1]);
sqlite_int64 y0=sqlite3_api->value_double(argv[2]);
  int v = 0;
  int cnt = 0;
  int ii;
  (void)argc;

  if( p1==0 ) return;
  for(ii=0; ii<p1->nVertex-1; ii++){
    v = pointBeneathLine(x0,y0,(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]),
(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii+1)*2])            ,(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii+1)*2 +1]));
    if( v==2 ) break;
    cnt += v;
  }
  if( v!=2 ){
    v = pointBeneathLine(x0,y0,(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii)*2]),(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(ii)*2 +1]),
(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(0)*2])            ,(((GeoCoord*)(p1)->a)[(0)*2 +1]));
  }
  if( v==2 ){
sqlite3_api->result_int(context,1);
  }else if( ((v+cnt)&1)==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_int(context,0);
  }else{
sqlite3_api->result_int(context,2);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(p1);
}

static void geopolyWithinFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p1 = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  GeoPoly *p2 = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[1], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p1 && p2 ){
    int x = geopolyOverlap(p1, p2);
    if( x<0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (context);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_int (context, x==2 ? 1 : x==4 ? 2 : 0);
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->free(p1);
sqlite3_api->free(p2);
}


typedef struct GeoEvent GeoEvent;
typedef struct GeoSegment GeoSegment;
typedef struct GeoOverlap GeoOverlap;
struct GeoEvent {
sqlite_int64 x;
  int eType;
  GeoSegment *pSeg;
  GeoEvent *pNext;
};
struct GeoSegment {
sqlite_int64 C,B;
sqlite_int64 y;
sqlite_int64 y0;
  unsigned char side;
  unsigned int idx;
  GeoSegment *pNext;
};
struct GeoOverlap {
  GeoEvent *aEvent;
  GeoSegment *aSegment;
  int nEvent;
  int nSegment;
};




static void geopolyAddOneSegment(
  GeoOverlap *p,
  GeoCoord x0,
  GeoCoord y0,
  GeoCoord x1,
  GeoCoord y1,
  unsigned char side,
  unsigned int idx
){
  GeoSegment *pSeg;
  GeoEvent *pEvent;
  if( x0==x1 ) return;
  if( x0>x1 ){
    GeoCoord t = x0;
    x0 = x1;
    x1 = t;
    t = y0;
    y0 = y1;
    y1 = t;
  }
  pSeg = p->aSegment + p->nSegment;
  p->nSegment++;
  pSeg->C = (y1-y0)/(x1-x0);
  pSeg->B = y1 - x1*pSeg->C;
  pSeg->y0 = y0;
  pSeg->side = side;
  pSeg->idx = idx;
  pEvent = p->aEvent + p->nEvent;
  p->nEvent++;
  pEvent->x = x0;
  pEvent->eType = 0;
  pEvent->pSeg = pSeg;
  pEvent = p->aEvent + p->nEvent;
  p->nEvent++;
  pEvent->x = x1;
  pEvent->eType = 1;
  pEvent->pSeg = pSeg;
}






static void geopolyAddSegments(
  GeoOverlap *p,
  GeoPoly *pPoly,
  unsigned char side
){
  unsigned int i;
  GeoCoord *x;
  for(i=0; i<(unsigned)pPoly->nVertex-1; i++){
    x = &(((GeoCoord*)(pPoly)->a)[(i)*2]);
    geopolyAddOneSegment(p, x[0], x[1], x[2], x[3], side, i);
  }
  x = &(((GeoCoord*)(pPoly)->a)[(i)*2]);
  geopolyAddOneSegment(p, x[0], x[1], pPoly->a[0], pPoly->a[1], side, i);
}




static GeoEvent *geopolyEventMerge(GeoEvent *pLeft, GeoEvent *pRight){
  GeoEvent head, *pLast;
  head.pNext = 0;
  pLast = &head;
  while( pRight && pLeft ){
    if( pRight->x <= pLeft->x ){
      pLast->pNext = pRight;
      pLast = pRight;
      pRight = pRight->pNext;
    }else{
      pLast->pNext = pLeft;
      pLast = pLeft;
      pLeft = pLeft->pNext;
    }
  }
  pLast->pNext = pRight ? pRight : pLeft;
  return head.pNext;
}




static GeoEvent *geopolySortEventsByX(GeoEvent *aEvent, int nEvent){
  int mx = 0;
  int i, j;
  GeoEvent *p;
  GeoEvent *a[50];
  for(i=0; i<nEvent; i++){
    p = &aEvent[i];
    p->pNext = 0;
    for(j=0; j<mx && a[j]; j++){
      p = geopolyEventMerge(a[j], p);
      a[j] = 0;
    }
    a[j] = p;
    if( j>=mx ) mx = j+1;
  }
  p = 0;
  for(i=0; i<mx; i++){
    p = geopolyEventMerge(a[i], p);
  }
  return p;
}




static GeoSegment *geopolySegmentMerge(GeoSegment *pLeft, GeoSegment *pRight){
  GeoSegment head, *pLast;
  head.pNext = 0;
  pLast = &head;
  while( pRight && pLeft ){
sqlite_int64 r=pRight->y - pLeft->y;
    if( r==0.0 ) r = pRight->C - pLeft->C;
    if( r<0.0 ){
      pLast->pNext = pRight;
      pLast = pRight;
      pRight = pRight->pNext;
    }else{
      pLast->pNext = pLeft;
      pLast = pLeft;
      pLeft = pLeft->pNext;
    }
  }
  pLast->pNext = pRight ? pRight : pLeft;
  return head.pNext;
}





static GeoSegment *geopolySortSegmentsByYAndC(GeoSegment *pList){
  int mx = 0;
  int i;
  GeoSegment *p;
  GeoSegment *a[50];
  while( pList ){
    p = pList;
    pList = pList->pNext;
    p->pNext = 0;
    for(i=0; i<mx && a[i]; i++){
      p = geopolySegmentMerge(a[i], p);
      a[i] = 0;
    }
    a[i] = p;
    if( i>=mx ) mx = i+1;
  }
  p = 0;
  for(i=0; i<mx; i++){
    p = geopolySegmentMerge(a[i], p);
  }
  return p;
}




static int geopolyOverlap(GeoPoly *p1, GeoPoly *p2){
  sqlite3_int64 nVertex = p1->nVertex + p2->nVertex + 2;
  GeoOverlap *p;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;
  GeoEvent *pThisEvent;
sqlite_int64 rX;
  int rc = 0;
  int needSort = 0;
  GeoSegment *pActive = 0;
  GeoSegment *pSeg;
  unsigned char aOverlap[4];

  nByte = sizeof(GeoEvent)*nVertex*2
           + sizeof(GeoSegment)*nVertex
           + sizeof(GeoOverlap);
  p =sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( p==0 ) return -1;
  p->aEvent = (GeoEvent*)&p[1];
  p->aSegment = (GeoSegment*)&p->aEvent[nVertex*2];
  p->nEvent = p->nSegment = 0;
  geopolyAddSegments(p, p1, 1);
  geopolyAddSegments(p, p2, 2);
  pThisEvent = geopolySortEventsByX(p->aEvent, p->nEvent);
  rX = pThisEvent && pThisEvent->x==0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0;
  memset(aOverlap, 0, sizeof(aOverlap));
  while( pThisEvent ){
    if( pThisEvent->x!=rX ){
      GeoSegment *pPrev = 0;
      int iMask = 0;
if(geo_debug)printf ("Distinct X: %g\n", pThisEvent->x);
      rX = pThisEvent->x;
      if( needSort ){
if(geo_debug)printf ("SORT\n");
        pActive = geopolySortSegmentsByYAndC(pActive);
        needSort = 0;
      }
      for(pSeg=pActive; pSeg; pSeg=pSeg->pNext){
        if( pPrev ){
          if( pPrev->y!=pSeg->y ){
if(geo_debug)printf ("MASK: %d\n", iMask)  ;
            aOverlap[iMask] = 1;
          }
        }
        iMask ^= pSeg->side;
        pPrev = pSeg;
      }
      pPrev = 0;
      for(pSeg=pActive; pSeg; pSeg=pSeg->pNext){
sqlite_int64   y = pSeg->C*rX + pSeg->B;
if(geo_debug)printf ("Segment %d.%d %g->%g\n", pSeg->side, pSeg->idx, pSeg->y, y);
        pSeg->y = y;
        if( pPrev ){
          if( pPrev->y>pSeg->y && pPrev->side!=pSeg->side ){
            rc = 1;
if(geo_debug)printf ("Crossing: %d.%d and %d.%d\n", 
pPrev->side, pPrev->idx, 
pSeg->side, pSeg->idx)                     ;
            goto geopolyOverlapDone;
          }else if( pPrev->y!=pSeg->y ){
if(geo_debug)printf ("MASK: %d\n", iMask)  ;
            aOverlap[iMask] = 1;
          }
        }
        iMask ^= pSeg->side;
        pPrev = pSeg;
      }
    }
if(geo_debug)printf ("%s %d.%d C=%g B=%g\n", 
pThisEvent->eType ? "RM " : "ADD", 
pThisEvent->pSeg->side, pThisEvent->pSeg->idx, 
pThisEvent->pSeg->C, 
pThisEvent->pSeg->B)       ;
    if( pThisEvent->eType==0 ){

      pSeg = pThisEvent->pSeg;
      pSeg->y = pSeg->y0;
      pSeg->pNext = pActive;
      pActive = pSeg;
      needSort = 1;
    }else{

      if( pActive==pThisEvent->pSeg ){
        pActive =(1)              ? pActive->pNext : 0;
      }else{
        for(pSeg=pActive; pSeg; pSeg=pSeg->pNext){
          if( pSeg->pNext==pThisEvent->pSeg ){
            pSeg->pNext =(1)                  ? pSeg->pNext->pNext : 0;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    pThisEvent = pThisEvent->pNext;
  }
  if( aOverlap[3]==0 ){
    rc = 0;
  }else if( aOverlap[1]!=0 && aOverlap[2]==0 ){
    rc = 3;
  }else if( aOverlap[1]==0 && aOverlap[2]!=0 ){
    rc = 2;
  }else if( aOverlap[1]==0 && aOverlap[2]==0 ){
    rc = 4;
  }else{
    rc = 1;
  }

geopolyOverlapDone:
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  return rc;
}













static void geopolyOverlapFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  GeoPoly *p1 = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[0], 0);
  GeoPoly *p2 = geopolyFuncParam(context, argv[1], 0);
  (void)argc;
  if( p1 && p2 ){
    int x = geopolyOverlap(p1, p2);
    if( x<0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (context);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_int (context, x);
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->free(p1);
sqlite3_api->free(p2);
}

  (void)context;

  geo_debug =sqlite3_api->value_int(argv[0]);

}










static int geopolyInit(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr,
  int isCreate
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Rtree *pRtree;
  sqlite3_int64 nDb;
  sqlite3_int64 nName;
  sqlite3_str *pSql;
  char *zSql;
  int ii;
  (void)pAux;

sqlite3_api->vtab_config(db,1                           , 1);


  nDb = strlen(argv[1]);
  nName = strlen(argv[2]);
  pRtree = (Rtree *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(Rtree)+nDb+nName+2);
  if( !pRtree ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  memset(pRtree, 0, sizeof(Rtree)+nDb+nName+2);
  pRtree->nBusy = 1;
  pRtree->base.pModule = &rtreeModule;
  pRtree->zDb = (char *)&pRtree[1];
  pRtree->zName = &pRtree->zDb[nDb+1];
  pRtree->eCoordType =0                  ;
  pRtree->nDim = 2;
  pRtree->nDim2 = 4;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pRtree->zDb);const char*xxs=(const char*)(argv[1]); int xxn=(nDb);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
{char*xxd=(char*)(pRtree->zName);const char*xxs=(const char*)(argv[2]); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};






  pSql =sqlite3_api->str_new(db);
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pSql,"CREATE TABLE x(_shape");
  pRtree->nAux = 1;
  pRtree->nAuxNotNull = 1;
  for(ii=3; ii<argc; ii++){
    pRtree->nAux++;
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pSql,",%s", argv[ii]);
  }
sqlite3_api->str_appendf(pSql,");");
  zSql =sqlite3_api->str_finish(pSql);
  if( !zSql ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else if(0         !=(rc =sqlite3_api->declare_vtab(db,zSql))){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
  }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  if( rc ) goto geopolyInit_fail;
  pRtree->nBytesPerCell = 8 + pRtree->nDim2*4;


  rc = getNodeSize(db, pRtree, isCreate, pzErr);
  if( rc ) goto geopolyInit_fail;
  rc = rtreeSqlInit(pRtree, db, argv[1], argv[2], isCreate);
  if( rc ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
    goto geopolyInit_fail;
  }

  *ppVtab = (sqlite3_vtab *)pRtree;
  return 0        ;

geopolyInit_fail:
  if( rc==0         ) rc =1            ;
  assert( *ppVtab==0 );
  assert( pRtree->nBusy==1 );
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}





static int geopolyCreate(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return geopolyInit(db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr, 1);
}




static int geopolyConnect(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc, const char *const*argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return geopolyInit(db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr, 0);
}














static int geopolyFilter(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pVtabCursor,
  int idxNum,
  const char *idxStr,
  int argc, sqlite3_value **argv
){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtabCursor->pVtab;
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)pVtabCursor;
  RtreeNode *pRoot = 0;
  int rc =0         ;
  int iCell = 0;
  (void)idxStr;

  rtreeReference(pRtree);


  resetCursor(pCsr);

  pCsr->iStrategy = idxNum;
  if( idxNum==1 ){

    RtreeNode *pLeaf;
    RtreeSearchPoint *p;
    i64 iRowid =sqlite3_api->value_int64(argv[0]);
    i64 iNode = 0;
    rc = findLeafNode(pRtree, iRowid, &pLeaf, &iNode);
    if( rc==0         && pLeaf!=0 ){
      p = rtreeSearchPointNew(pCsr,0          , 0);
      assert( p!=0 );
      pCsr->aNode[0] = pLeaf;
      p->id = iNode;
      p->eWithin =1             ;
      rc = nodeRowidIndex(pRtree, pLeaf, iRowid, &iCell);
      p->iCell = (u8)iCell;
traceQueue(pCsr,"PUSH-F1:")              ;
    }else{
      pCsr->atEOF = 1;
    }
  }else{



    rc = nodeAcquire(pRtree, 1, 0, &pRoot);
    if( rc==0         && idxNum<=3 ){
      RtreeCoord bbox[4];
      RtreeConstraint *p;
      assert( argc==1 );
      assert( argv[0]!=0 );
      geopolyBBox(0, argv[0], bbox, &rc);
      if( rc ){
        goto geopoly_filter_end;
      }
      pCsr->aConstraint = p =sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(RtreeConstraint)*4);
      pCsr->nConstraint = 4;
      if( p==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        memset(pCsr->aConstraint, 0, sizeof(RtreeConstraint)*4);
        memset(pCsr->anQueue, 0, sizeof(u32)*(pRtree->iDepth + 1));
        if( idxNum==2 ){

          p->op = 'B';
          p->iCoord = 0;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[1].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'D';
          p->iCoord = 1;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[0].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'B';
          p->iCoord = 2;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[3].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'D';
          p->iCoord = 3;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[2].f;
        }else{

          p->op = 'D';
          p->iCoord = 0;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[0].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'B';
          p->iCoord = 1;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[1].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'D';
          p->iCoord = 2;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[2].f;
          p++;
          p->op = 'B';
          p->iCoord = 3;
          p->u.rValue = bbox[3].f;
        }
      }
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      RtreeSearchPoint *pNew;
      pNew = rtreeSearchPointNew(pCsr,0          , (u8)(pRtree->iDepth+1));
      if( pNew==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
        goto geopoly_filter_end;
      }
      pNew->id = 1;
      pNew->iCell = 0;
      pNew->eWithin =1             ;
      assert( pCsr->bPoint==1 );
      pCsr->aNode[0] = pRoot;
      pRoot = 0;
traceQueue(pCsr,"PUSH-Fm:")              ;
      rc = rtreeStepToLeaf(pCsr);
    }
  }

geopoly_filter_end:
  nodeRelease(pRtree, pRoot);
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}














static int geopolyBestIndex(sqlite3_vtab *tab, sqlite3_index_info *pIdxInfo){
  int ii;
  int iRowidTerm = -1;
  int iFuncTerm = -1;
  int idxNum = 0;
  (void)tab;

  for(ii=0; ii<pIdxInfo->nConstraint; ii++){
    struct sqlite3_index_constraint *p = &pIdxInfo->aConstraint[ii];
    if( !p->usable ) continue;
    if( p->iColumn<0 && p->op==2                           ){
      iRowidTerm = ii;
      break;
    }
    if( p->iColumn==0 && p->op>=150                              ){



      iFuncTerm = ii;
      idxNum = p->op -150                               + 2;
    }
  }

  if( iRowidTerm>=0 ){
    pIdxInfo->idxNum = 1;
    pIdxInfo->idxStr = "rowid";
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[iRowidTerm].argvIndex = 1;
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[iRowidTerm].omit = 1;
    pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = 30.0;
    pIdxInfo->estimatedRows = 1;
    pIdxInfo->idxFlags =1                        ;
    return 0        ;
  }
  if( iFuncTerm>=0 ){
    pIdxInfo->idxNum = idxNum;
    pIdxInfo->idxStr = "rtree";
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[iFuncTerm].argvIndex = 1;
    pIdxInfo->aConstraintUsage[iFuncTerm].omit = 0;
    pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = 300.0;
    pIdxInfo->estimatedRows = 10;
    return 0        ;
  }
  pIdxInfo->idxNum = 4;
  pIdxInfo->idxStr = "fullscan";
  pIdxInfo->estimatedCost = 3000000.0;
  pIdxInfo->estimatedRows = 100000;
  return 0        ;
}





static int geopolyColumn(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *cur, sqlite3_context *ctx, int i){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)cur->pVtab;
  RtreeCursor *pCsr = (RtreeCursor *)cur;
  RtreeSearchPoint *p = rtreeSearchPointFirst(pCsr);
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeNode *pNode = rtreeNodeOfFirstSearchPoint(pCsr, &rc);

  if( rc ) return rc;
  if( p==0 ) return 0        ;
  if( i==0 &&sqlite3_api->vtab_nochange(ctx))return 0      ;
  if( i<=pRtree->nAux ){
    if( !pCsr->bAuxValid ){
      if( pCsr->pReadAux==0 ){
        rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(pRtree->db,pRtree->zReadAuxSql,-1,0,
                                &pCsr->pReadAux, 0);
        if( rc ) return rc;
      }
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pCsr->pReadAux, 1,
          nodeGetRowid(pRtree, pNode, p->iCell));
      rc =sqlite3_api->step(pCsr->pReadAux);
      if( rc==100        ){
        pCsr->bAuxValid = 1;
      }else{
sqlite3_api->reset   (pCsr->pReadAux);
        if( rc==101         ) rc =0         ;
        return rc;
      }
    }
sqlite3_api->result_value(ctx,sqlite3_api->column_value(pCsr->pReadAux,i+2));
  }
  return 0        ;
}























static int geopolyUpdate(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nData,
  sqlite3_value **aData,
  sqlite_int64 *pRowid
){
  Rtree *pRtree = (Rtree *)pVtab;
  int rc =0         ;
  RtreeCell cell;
  i64 oldRowid;
  int oldRowidValid;
  i64 newRowid;
  int newRowidValid;
  int coordChange = 0;

  if( pRtree->nNodeRef ){



    return(6 | (2<<8))       ;
  }
  rtreeReference(pRtree);
  assert(nData>=1);

  oldRowidValid =sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[0])!=5      ;;
  oldRowid = oldRowidValid ?sqlite3_api->value_int64(aData[0]):0;
  newRowidValid = nData>1 &&sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[1])!=5      ;
  newRowid = newRowidValid ?sqlite3_api->value_int64(aData[1]):0;
  cell.iRowid = newRowid;

  if( nData>1
   && (!oldRowidValid
        || !sqlite3_api->value_nochange(aData[2])
        || oldRowid!=newRowid)
  ){
    assert( aData[2]!=0 );
    geopolyBBox(0, aData[2], cell.aCoord, &rc);
    if( rc ){
      if( rc==1            ){
        pVtab->zErrMsg =
sqlite3_api->mprintf     ("_shape does not contain a valid polygon");
      }
      goto geopoly_update_end;
    }
    coordChange = 1;



    if( newRowidValid && (!oldRowidValid || oldRowid!=newRowid) ){
      int steprc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pRtree->pReadRowid, 1, cell.iRowid);
      steprc =sqlite3_api->step(pRtree->pReadRowid);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pRtree->pReadRowid);
      if(100        ==steprc ){
        if(sqlite3_api->vtab_on_conflict(pRtree->db)==5          ){
          rc = rtreeDeleteRowid(pRtree, cell.iRowid);
        }else{
          rc = rtreeConstraintError(pRtree, 0);
        }
      }
    }
  }





  if( rc==0         && (nData==1 || (coordChange && oldRowidValid)) ){
    rc = rtreeDeleteRowid(pRtree, oldRowid);
  }





  if( rc==0         && nData>1 && coordChange ){

    RtreeNode *pLeaf = 0;
    if( !newRowidValid ){
      rc = rtreeNewRowid(pRtree, &cell.iRowid);
    }
    *pRowid = cell.iRowid;
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = ChooseLeaf(pRtree, &cell, 0, &pLeaf);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      int rc2;
      pRtree->iReinsertHeight = -1;
      rc = rtreeInsertCell(pRtree, pLeaf, &cell, 0);
      rc2 = nodeRelease(pRtree, pLeaf);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = rc2;
      }
    }
  }


  if( rc==0         && nData>1 ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pUp = pRtree->pWriteAux;
    int jj;
    int nChange = 0;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pUp,1, cell.iRowid);
    assert( pRtree->nAux>=1 );
    if(sqlite3_api->value_nochange(aData[2])){
sqlite3_api->bind_null (pUp, 2);
    }else{
      GeoPoly *p = 0;
      if(sqlite3_api->value_type(aData[2])==3
       && (p = geopolyFuncParam(0, aData[2], &rc))!=0
       && rc==0
      ){
sqlite3_api->bind_blob   (pUp, 2, p->hdr, 4 +8*p->nVertex,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
      }else{
sqlite3_api->bind_value   (pUp, 2, aData[2]);
      }
sqlite3_api->free (p);
      nChange = 1;
    }
    for(jj=1; jj<nData-2; jj++){
      nChange++;
sqlite3_api->bind_value (pUp, jj+2, aData[jj+2]);
    }
    if( nChange ){
sqlite3_api->step (pUp);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUp);
    }
  }

geopoly_update_end:
  rtreeRelease(pRtree);
  return rc;
}





static int geopolyFindFunction(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nArg,
  const char *zName,
  void (**pxFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void **ppArg
){
  (void)pVtab;
  (void)nArg;
  if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,"geopoly_overlap")==0){
    *pxFunc = geopolyOverlapFunc;
    *ppArg = 0;
    return 150                             ;
  }
  if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,"geopoly_within")==0){
    *pxFunc = geopolyWithinFunc;
    *ppArg = 0;
    return 150                             +1;
  }
  return 0;
}

static int sqlite3_geopoly_init(sqlite3 *db){
  int rc =0         ;
  static const struct {
    void (*xFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**);
    signed char nArg;
    unsigned char bPure;
    const char *zName;
  } aFunc[] = {
     { geopolyAreaFunc,          1, 1,    "geopoly_area"             },
     { geopolyBlobFunc,          1, 1,    "geopoly_blob"             },
     { geopolyJsonFunc,          1, 1,    "geopoly_json"             },
     { geopolySvgFunc,          -1, 1,    "geopoly_svg"              },
     { geopolyWithinFunc,        2, 1,    "geopoly_within"           },
     { geopolyContainsPointFunc, 3, 1,    "geopoly_contains_point"   },
     { geopolyOverlapFunc,       2, 1,    "geopoly_overlap"          },
     { geopolyDebugFunc,         1, 0,    "geopoly_debug"            },
     { geopolyBBoxFunc,          1, 1,    "geopoly_bbox"             },
     { geopolyXformFunc,         7, 1,    "geopoly_xform"            },
     { geopolyRegularFunc,       4, 1,    "geopoly_regular"          },
     { geopolyCcwFunc,           1, 1,    "geopoly_ccw"              },
  };
  static const struct {
    void (*xStep)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**);
    void (*xFinal)(sqlite3_context*);
    const char *zName;
  } aAgg[] = {
     { geopolyBBoxStep, geopolyBBoxFinal, "geopoly_group_bbox"    },
  };
  unsigned int i;
  for(i=0; i<sizeof(aFunc)/sizeof(aFunc[0]) && rc==0        ; i++){
    int enc;
    if( aFunc[i].bPure ){
      enc =1           |0x000000800         |0x000200000     ;
    }else{
      enc =1           |0x000080000      ;
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(db,aFunc[i].zName,aFunc[i].nArg,
                                 enc, 0,
                                 aFunc[i].xFunc, 0, 0);
  }
  for(i=0; i<sizeof(aAgg)/sizeof(aAgg[0]) && rc==0        ; i++){
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(db,aAgg[i].zName,1,
1                        |0x000000800         |0x000200000     , 0,
              0, aAgg[i].xStep, aAgg[i].xFinal);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_module_v2(db,"geopoly",&geopolyModule,0,0);
  }
  return rc;
}










static         int sqlite3RtreeInit(sqlite3 *db){
  const int utf8 =1           ;
  int rc;

  rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(db,"rtreenode",2,utf8,0, rtreenode, 0, 0);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(db,"rtreedepth",1,utf8,0,rtreedepth, 0, 0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(db,"rtreecheck",-1,utf8,0,rtreecheck, 0,0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){

    void *c = (void *)1                ;

    void *c = (void *)0                 ;

    rc =sqlite3_api->create_module_v2(db,"rtree",&rtreeModule,c,0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    void *c = (void *)1                ;
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_module_v2(db,"rtree_i32",&rtreeModule,c,0);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3_geopoly_init(db);
  }


  return rc;
}








static void rtreeFreeCallback(void *p){
  RtreeGeomCallback *pInfo = (RtreeGeomCallback*)p;
  if( pInfo->xDestructor ) pInfo->xDestructor(pInfo->pContext);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
}




static void rtreeMatchArgFree(void *pArg){
  int i;
  RtreeMatchArg *p = (RtreeMatchArg*)pArg;
  for(i=0; i<p->nParam; i++){
sqlite3_api->value_free(p->apSqlParam[i]);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(p);
}















static void geomCallback(sqlite3_context *ctx, int nArg, sqlite3_value **aArg){
  RtreeGeomCallback *pGeomCtx = (RtreeGeomCallback *)sqlite3_api->user_data(ctx);
  RtreeMatchArg *pBlob;
  sqlite3_int64 nBlob;
  int memErr = 0;

  nBlob = sizeof(RtreeMatchArg) + (nArg-1)*sizeof(RtreeDValue)
           + nArg*sizeof(sqlite3_value*);
  pBlob = (RtreeMatchArg *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nBlob);
  if( !pBlob ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem(ctx);
  }else{
    int i;
    pBlob->iSize = nBlob;
    pBlob->cb = pGeomCtx[0];
    pBlob->apSqlParam = (sqlite3_value**)&pBlob->aParam[nArg];
    pBlob->nParam = nArg;
    for(i=0; i<nArg; i++){
      pBlob->apSqlParam[i] =sqlite3_api->value_dup(aArg[i]);
      if( pBlob->apSqlParam[i]==0 ) memErr = 1;

      pBlob->aParam[i] =sqlite3_api->value_int64(aArg[i]);

      pBlob->aParam[i] =sqlite3_api->value_double(aArg[i]);

    }
    if( memErr ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (ctx);
      rtreeMatchArgFree(pBlob);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_pointer (ctx, pBlob, "RtreeMatchArg", rtreeMatchArgFree);
    }
  }
}




           int sqlite3_rtree_geometry_callback(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zGeom,
  int (*xGeom)(sqlite3_rtree_geometry*,int,RtreeDValue*,int*),
  void *pContext
){
  RtreeGeomCallback *pGeomCtx;


  pGeomCtx = (RtreeGeomCallback *)sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(RtreeGeomCallback));
  if( !pGeomCtx ) return 7           ;
  pGeomCtx->xGeom = xGeom;
  pGeomCtx->xQueryFunc = 0;
  pGeomCtx->xDestructor = 0;
  pGeomCtx->pContext = pContext;
  return sqlite3_api->create_function_v2(db,zGeom,-1,5       ,
      (void *)pGeomCtx, geomCallback, 0, 0, rtreeFreeCallback
  );
}





           int sqlite3_rtree_query_callback(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zQueryFunc,
  int (*xQueryFunc)(sqlite3_rtree_query_info*),
  void *pContext,
  void (*xDestructor)(void*)
){
  RtreeGeomCallback *pGeomCtx;


  pGeomCtx = (RtreeGeomCallback *)sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(RtreeGeomCallback));
  if( !pGeomCtx ){
    if( xDestructor ) xDestructor(pContext);
    return 7           ;
  }
  pGeomCtx->xGeom = 0;
  pGeomCtx->xQueryFunc = xQueryFunc;
  pGeomCtx->xDestructor = xDestructor;
  pGeomCtx->pContext = pContext;
  return sqlite3_api->create_function_v2(db,zQueryFunc,-1,5       ,
      (void *)pGeomCtx, geomCallback, 0, 0, rtreeFreeCallback
  );
}

){
sqlite3_api=pApi;
  return sqlite3RtreeInit(db);
}

static void icuFunctionError(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  const char *zName,
  UErrorCode e
){
  char zBuf[128];
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf(128,zBuf,"ICU error: %s(): %s",zName,u_errorName(e));
  zBuf[127] = '\0';
sqlite3_api->result_error(pCtx,zBuf,-1);
}














static void xFree(void *p){
sqlite3_api->free(p);
}






static const unsigned char icuUtf8Trans1[] = {
  0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07,
  0x08, 0x09, 0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0d, 0x0e, 0x0f,
  0x10, 0x11, 0x12, 0x13, 0x14, 0x15, 0x16, 0x17,
  0x18, 0x19, 0x1a, 0x1b, 0x1c, 0x1d, 0x1e, 0x1f,
  0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07,
  0x08, 0x09, 0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0d, 0x0e, 0x0f,
  0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07,
  0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00,
};






















static int icuLikeCompare(
  const uint8_t *zPattern,
  const uint8_t *zString,
  const UChar32 uEsc
){
  static const uint32_t MATCH_ONE = (uint32_t)'_';
  static const uint32_t MATCH_ALL = (uint32_t)'%';

  int prevEscape = 0;

  while( 1 ){


    uint32_t uPattern;
uPattern = *(zPattern++); if( uPattern>=0xc0 ){ uPattern = icuUtf8Trans1[uPattern-0xc0]; while( (*zPattern & 0xc0)==0x80 ){ uPattern = (uPattern<<6) + (0x3f & *(zPattern++)); } };
    if( uPattern==0 ) break;








    if( uPattern==MATCH_ALL && !prevEscape && uPattern!=(uint32_t)uEsc ){

      uint8_t c;





      while( (c=*zPattern) == MATCH_ALL || c == MATCH_ONE ){
        if( c==MATCH_ONE ){
          if( *zString==0 ) return 0;
assert( *zString ); if( *(zString++)>=0xc0 ){ while( (*zString & 0xc0)==0x80 ){zString++;} };
        }
        zPattern++;
      }

      if( *zPattern==0 ) return 1;

      while( *zString ){
        if( icuLikeCompare(zPattern, zString, uEsc) ){
          return 1;
        }
assert( *zString ); if( *(zString++)>=0xc0 ){ while( (*zString & 0xc0)==0x80 ){zString++;} };
      }
      return 0;

    }else if( uPattern==MATCH_ONE && !prevEscape && uPattern!=(uint32_t)uEsc ){

      if( *zString==0 ) return 0;
assert( *zString ); if( *(zString++)>=0xc0 ){ while( (*zString & 0xc0)==0x80 ){zString++;} };

    }else if( uPattern==(uint32_t)uEsc && !prevEscape ){

      prevEscape = 1;

    }else{

      uint32_t uString;
uString = *(zString++); if( uString>=0xc0 ){ uString = icuUtf8Trans1[uString-0xc0]; while( (*zString & 0xc0)==0x80 ){ uString = (uString<<6) + (0x3f & *(zString++)); } };
      uString = (uint32_t)u_foldCase((UChar32)uString, U_FOLD_CASE_DEFAULT);
      uPattern = (uint32_t)u_foldCase((UChar32)uPattern, U_FOLD_CASE_DEFAULT);
      if( uString!=uPattern ){
        return 0;
      }
      prevEscape = 0;
    }
  }

  return *zString==0;
}














static void icuLikeFunc(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  const unsigned char *zA =sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[0]);
  const unsigned char *zB =sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[1]);
  UChar32 uEsc = 0;




  if(sqlite3_api->value_bytes(argv[0])>50000                      ){
sqlite3_api->result_error(context,"LIKE or GLOB pattern too complex", -1);
    return;
  }


  if( argc==3 ){



    int nE=sqlite3_api->value_bytes(argv[2]);
    const unsigned char *zE =sqlite3_api->value_text(argv[2]);
    int i = 0;
    if( zE==0 ) return;
    U8_NEXT(zE, i, nE, uEsc);
    if( i!=nE){
sqlite3_api->result_error (context,
          "ESCAPE expression must be a single character", -1);
      return;
    }
  }

  if( zA && zB ){
sqlite3_api->result_int(context,icuLikeCompare(zA, zB, uEsc));
  }
}





static void icuRegexpDelete(void *p){
  URegularExpression *pExpr = (URegularExpression *)p;
  uregex_close(pExpr);
}




















static void icuRegexpFunc(sqlite3_context *p, int nArg, sqlite3_value **apArg){
  UErrorCode status = U_ZERO_ERROR;
  URegularExpression *pExpr;
  UBool res;
  const UChar *zString =sqlite3_api->value_text16(apArg[1]);

  (void)nArg;




  if( !zString ){
    return;
  }

  pExpr =sqlite3_api->get_auxdata(p,0);
  if( !pExpr ){
    const UChar *zPattern =sqlite3_api->value_text16(apArg[0]);
    if( !zPattern ){
      return;
    }
    pExpr = uregex_open(zPattern, -1, 0, 0, &status);

    if( U_SUCCESS(status) ){
sqlite3_api->set_auxdata (p, 0, pExpr, icuRegexpDelete);
      pExpr =sqlite3_api->get_auxdata(p,0);
    }
    if( !pExpr ){
      icuFunctionError(p, "uregex_open", status);
      return;
    }
  }


  uregex_setText(pExpr, zString, -1, &status);
  if( !U_SUCCESS(status) ){
    icuFunctionError(p, "uregex_setText", status);
    return;
  }


  res = uregex_matches(pExpr, 0, &status);
  if( !U_SUCCESS(status) ){
    icuFunctionError(p, "uregex_matches", status);
    return;
  }






  uregex_setText(pExpr, 0, 0, &status);


sqlite3_api->result_int(p,res?1 : 0);
}



























static void icuCaseFunc16(sqlite3_context *p, int nArg, sqlite3_value **apArg){
  const UChar *zInput;
  UChar *zOutput = 0;
  int nInput;
  int nOut;
  int cnt;
  int bToUpper;
  UErrorCode status;
  const char *zLocale = 0;

  assert(nArg==1 || nArg==2);
  bToUpper = (sqlite3_api->user_data(p)!=0);
  if( nArg==2 ){
    zLocale = (const char *)sqlite3_api->value_text(apArg[1]);
  }

  zInput =sqlite3_api->value_text16(apArg[0]);
  if( !zInput ){
    return;
  }
  nOut = nInput =sqlite3_api->value_bytes16(apArg[0]);
  if( nOut==0 ){
sqlite3_api->result_text16(p,"", 0,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
    return;
  }

  for(cnt=0; cnt<2; cnt++){
    UChar *zNew =sqlite3_api->realloc(zOutput,nOut);
    if( zNew==0 ){
sqlite3_api->free (zOutput);
sqlite3_api->result_error_nomem (p);
      return;
    }
    zOutput = zNew;
    status = U_ZERO_ERROR;
    if( bToUpper ){
      nOut = 2*u_strToUpper(zOutput,nOut/2,zInput,nInput/2,zLocale,&status);
    }else{
      nOut = 2*u_strToLower(zOutput,nOut/2,zInput,nInput/2,zLocale,&status);
    }

    if( U_SUCCESS(status) ){
sqlite3_api->result_text16 (p, zOutput, nOut, xFree);
    }else if( status==U_BUFFER_OVERFLOW_ERROR ){
      assert( cnt==0 );
      continue;
    }else{
      icuFunctionError(p, bToUpper ? "u_strToUpper" : "u_strToLower", status);
    }
    return;
  }
  assert( 0 );
}







static void icuCollationDel(void *pCtx){
  UCollator *p = (UCollator *)pCtx;
  ucol_close(p);
}





static int icuCollationColl(
  void *pCtx,
  int nLeft,
  const void *zLeft,
  int nRight,
  const void *zRight
){
  UCollationResult res;
  UCollator *p = (UCollator *)pCtx;
  res = ucol_strcoll(p, (UChar *)zLeft, nLeft/2, (UChar *)zRight, nRight/2);
  switch( res ){
    case UCOL_LESS:    return -1;
    case UCOL_GREATER: return +1;
    case UCOL_EQUAL:   return 0;
  }
  assert(!"Unexpected return value from ucol_strcoll()");
  return 0;
}














static void icuLoadCollation(
  sqlite3_context *p,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  sqlite3 *db = (sqlite3 *)sqlite3_api->user_data(p);
  UErrorCode status = U_ZERO_ERROR;
  const char *zLocale;
  const char *zName;
  UCollator *pUCollator;
  int rc;

  assert(nArg==2);
  (void)nArg;
  zLocale = (const char *)sqlite3_api->value_text(apArg[0]);
  zName = (const char *)sqlite3_api->value_text(apArg[1]);

  if( !zLocale || !zName ){
    return;
  }

  pUCollator = ucol_open(zLocale, &status);
  if( !U_SUCCESS(status) ){
    icuFunctionError(p, "ucol_open", status);
    return;
  }
  assert(p);

  rc =sqlite3_api->create_collation_v2(db,zName,4         , (void *)pUCollator,
      icuCollationColl, icuCollationDel
  );
  if( rc!=0         ){
    ucol_close(pUCollator);
sqlite3_api->result_error(p,"Error registering collation function", -1);
  }
}




static         int sqlite3IcuInit(sqlite3 *db){

  static const struct IcuScalar {
    const char *zName;
    unsigned char nArg;
    unsigned int enc;
    unsigned char iContext;
    void (*xFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**);
  } scalars[] = {
    {"icu_load_collation",2,1          |0x000080000      ,1, icuLoadCollation},

    {"regexp", 2,5          |(0x000000800|0x000200000),    0, icuRegexpFunc},
    {"lower",  1,4            |(0x000000800|0x000200000),  0, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"lower",  2,4            |(0x000000800|0x000200000),  0, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"upper",  1,4            |(0x000000800|0x000200000),  1, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"upper",  2,4            |(0x000000800|0x000200000),  1, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"lower",  1,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   0, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"lower",  2,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   0, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"upper",  1,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   1, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"upper",  2,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   1, icuCaseFunc16},
    {"like",   2,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   0, icuLikeFunc},
    {"like",   3,1           |(0x000000800|0x000200000),   0, icuLikeFunc},

  };
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;

  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<(int)(sizeof(scalars)/sizeof(scalars[0])); i++){
    const struct IcuScalar *p = &scalars[i];
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(
        db, p->zName, p->nArg, p->enc,
        p->iContext ? (void*)db : (void*)0,
        p->xFunc, 0, 0
    );
  }

  return rc;
}



__declspec(dllexport)

           int sqlite3_icu_init(
  sqlite3 *db,
  char **pzErrMsg,
  const sqlite3_api_routines *pApi
){
sqlite3_api=pApi;
  return sqlite3IcuInit(db);
}
































typedef struct IcuTokenizer IcuTokenizer;

  sqlite3_tokenizer base;
  char *zLocale;
};

struct IcuCursor {
  sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor base;

  UBreakIterator *pIter;
  int nChar;
  UChar *aChar;
  int *aOffset;

  int nBuffer;
  char *zBuffer;

  int iToken;
};




static int icuCreate(
  int argc,
  const char * const *argv,
  sqlite3_tokenizer **ppTokenizer
){
  IcuTokenizer *p;
  int n = 0;

  if( argc>0 ){
    n = strlen(argv[0])+1;
  }
  p = (IcuTokenizer *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(IcuTokenizer)+n);
  if( !p ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  memset(p, 0, sizeof(IcuTokenizer));

  if( n ){
    p->zLocale = (char *)&p[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zLocale);const char*xxs=(const char*)(argv[0]); int xxn=(n);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }

  *ppTokenizer = (sqlite3_tokenizer *)p;

  return 0        ;
}




static int icuDestroy(sqlite3_tokenizer *pTokenizer){
  IcuTokenizer *p = (IcuTokenizer *)pTokenizer;
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  return 0        ;
}







static int icuOpen(
  sqlite3_tokenizer *pTokenizer,
  const char *zInput,
  int nInput,
  sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor **ppCursor
){
  IcuTokenizer *p = (IcuTokenizer *)pTokenizer;
  IcuCursor *pCsr;

  const int32_t opt = U_FOLD_CASE_DEFAULT;
  UErrorCode status = U_ZERO_ERROR;
  int nChar;

  UChar32 c;
  int iInput = 0;
  int iOut = 0;

  *ppCursor = 0;

  if( zInput==0 ){
    nInput = 0;
    zInput = "";
  }else if( nInput<0 ){
    nInput = strlen(zInput);
  }
  nChar = nInput+1;
  pCsr = (IcuCursor *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(
      sizeof(IcuCursor) +
      ((nChar+3)&~3) * sizeof(UChar) +
      (nChar+1) * sizeof(int)
  );
  if( !pCsr ){
    return 7           ;
  }
  memset(pCsr, 0, sizeof(IcuCursor));
  pCsr->aChar = (UChar *)&pCsr[1];
  pCsr->aOffset = (int *)&pCsr->aChar[(nChar+3)&~3];

  pCsr->aOffset[iOut] = iInput;
  U8_NEXT(zInput, iInput, nInput, c);
  while( c>0 ){
    int isError = 0;
    c = u_foldCase(c, opt);
    U16_APPEND(pCsr->aChar, iOut, nChar, c, isError);
    if( isError ){
sqlite3_api->free (pCsr);
      return 1           ;
    }
    pCsr->aOffset[iOut] = iInput;

    if( iInput<nInput ){
      U8_NEXT(zInput, iInput, nInput, c);
    }else{
      c = 0;
    }
  }

  pCsr->pIter = ubrk_open(UBRK_WORD, p->zLocale, pCsr->aChar, iOut, &status);
  if( !U_SUCCESS(status) ){
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr);
    return 1           ;
  }
  pCsr->nChar = iOut;

  ubrk_first(pCsr->pIter);
  *ppCursor = (sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor *)pCsr;
  return 0        ;
}




static int icuClose(sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor *pCursor){
  IcuCursor *pCsr = (IcuCursor *)pCursor;
  ubrk_close(pCsr->pIter);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->zBuffer);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr);
  return 0        ;
}




static int icuNext(
  sqlite3_tokenizer_cursor *pCursor,
  const char **ppToken,
  int *pnBytes,
  int *piStartOffset,
  int *piEndOffset,
  int *piPosition
){
  IcuCursor *pCsr = (IcuCursor *)pCursor;

  int iStart = 0;
  int iEnd = 0;
  int nByte = 0;

  while( iStart==iEnd ){
    UChar32 c;

    iStart = ubrk_current(pCsr->pIter);
    iEnd = ubrk_next(pCsr->pIter);
    if( iEnd==UBRK_DONE ){
      return 101        ;
    }

    while( iStart<iEnd ){
      int iWhite = iStart;
      U16_NEXT(pCsr->aChar, iWhite, pCsr->nChar, c);
      if( u_isspace(c) ){
        iStart = iWhite;
      }else{
        break;
      }
    }
    assert(iStart<=iEnd);
  }

  do {
    UErrorCode status = U_ZERO_ERROR;
    if( nByte ){
      char *zNew =sqlite3_api->realloc(pCsr->zBuffer,nByte);
      if( !zNew ){
        return 7           ;
      }
      pCsr->zBuffer = zNew;
      pCsr->nBuffer = nByte;
    }

    u_strToUTF8(
        pCsr->zBuffer, pCsr->nBuffer, &nByte,
        &pCsr->aChar[iStart], iEnd-iStart,
        &status
    );
  } while( nByte>pCsr->nBuffer );

  *ppToken = pCsr->zBuffer;
  *pnBytes = nByte;
  *piStartOffset = pCsr->aOffset[iStart];
  *piEndOffset = pCsr->aOffset[iEnd];
  *piPosition = pCsr->iToken++;

  return 0        ;
}




static const sqlite3_tokenizer_module icuTokenizerModule = {

  icuOpen,
  icuClose,
  icuNext,
  0,
};




static         void sqlite3Fts3IcuTokenizerModule(
  sqlite3_tokenizer_module const**ppModule
){
  *ppModule = &icuTokenizerModule;
}
