  if( p->rc==0         && pIter->eType!=5           ){
    int tnum = pIter->iTnum;
    const char *zComma = "";
    char *zSql = 0;
    int iCol;
sqlite3_api->test_control(25                     , p->dbMain, "main", 0, 1);

    for(iCol=0; p->rc==0         && iCol<pIter->nTblCol; iCol++){
      const char *zPk = "";
      const char *zCol = pIter->azTblCol[iCol];
      const char *zColl = 0;

      p->rc =sqlite3_api->table_column_metadata(
          p->dbMain, "main", pIter->zTbl, zCol, 0, &zColl, 0, 0, 0
      );

      if( pIter->eType==2          && pIter->abTblPk[iCol] ){


        zPk = "PRIMARY KEY ";
      }
      zSql = rbuMPrintf(p, "%z%s\"%w\" %s %sCOLLATE %Q%s",
          zSql, zComma, zCol, pIter->azTblType[iCol], zPk, zColl,
          (pIter->abNotNull[iCol] ? " NOT NULL" : "")
      );
      zComma = ", ";
    }

    if( pIter->eType==4                    ){
      char *zPk = rbuWithoutRowidPK(p, pIter);
      if( zPk ){
        zSql = rbuMPrintf(p, "%z, %z", zSql, zPk);
      }
    }

sqlite3_api->test_control(25                     , p->dbMain, "main", 1, tnum);
    rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain, "CREATE TABLE \"rbu_imp_%w\"(%z)%s",
        pIter->zTbl, zSql,
        (pIter->eType==4                    ? " WITHOUT ROWID" : "")
    );
sqlite3_api->test_control(25                     , p->dbMain, "main", 0, 0);
  }
}












static void rbuObjIterPrepareTmpInsert(
  sqlite3rbu *p,
  RbuObjIter *pIter,
  const char *zCollist,
  const char *zRbuRowid
){
  int bRbuRowid = (pIter->eType==3               || pIter->eType==1          );
  char *zBind = rbuObjIterGetBindlist(p, pIter->nTblCol + 1 + bRbuRowid);
  if( zBind ){
    assert( pIter->pTmpInsert==0 );
    p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(
        p->dbRbu, &pIter->pTmpInsert, &p->zErrmsg,sqlite3_api->mprintf(
          "INSERT INTO %s.'rbu_tmp_%q'(rbu_control,%s%s) VALUES(%z)",
          p->zStateDb, pIter->zDataTbl, zCollist, zRbuRowid, zBind
    ));
  }
}

static void rbuTmpInsertFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nVal,
  sqlite3_value **apVal
){
  sqlite3rbu *p =sqlite3_api->user_data(pCtx);
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;

  assert(sqlite3_api->value_int(apVal[0])!=0
      || p->objiter.eType==3
      || p->objiter.eType==1
  );
  if(sqlite3_api->value_int(apVal[0])!=0){
    p->nPhaseOneStep += p->objiter.nIndex;
  }

  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nVal; i++){
    rc =sqlite3_api->bind_value(p->objiter.pTmpInsert,i+1,apVal[i]);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step(p->objiter.pTmpInsert);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(p->objiter.pTmpInsert);
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->result_error_code(pCtx,rc);
  }
}

static char *rbuObjIterGetIndexWhere(sqlite3rbu *p, RbuObjIter *pIter){
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  int rc = p->rc;
  char *zRet = 0;

  assert( pIter->zIdxSql==0 && pIter->nIdxCol==0 && pIter->aIdxCol==0 );

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbMain, &pStmt, &p->zErrmsg,
        "SELECT trim(sql) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='index' AND name=?"
    );
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
    rc =sqlite3_api->bind_text(pStmt,1,pIter->zIdx,-1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
    if( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      char *zSql = (char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,0);
      if( zSql ){
        pIter->zIdxSql = zSql = rbuStrndup(zSql, &rc);
      }
      if( zSql ){
        int nParen = 0;
        int i;
        int iIdxCol = 0;
        int nIdxAlloc = 0;
        for(i=0; zSql[i]; i++){
          char c = zSql[i];


          if( iIdxCol==nIdxAlloc ){
            RbuSpan *aIdxCol = (RbuSpan*)sqlite3_api->realloc(
                pIter->aIdxCol, (nIdxAlloc+16)*sizeof(RbuSpan)
            );
            if( aIdxCol==0 ){
              rc =7            ;
              break;
            }
            pIter->aIdxCol = aIdxCol;
            nIdxAlloc += 16;
          }

          if( c=='(' ){
            if( nParen==0 ){
              assert( iIdxCol==0 );
              pIter->aIdxCol[0].zSpan = &zSql[i+1];
            }
            nParen++;
          }
          else if( c==')' ){
            nParen--;
            if( nParen==0 ){
              int nSpan = &zSql[i] - pIter->aIdxCol[iIdxCol].zSpan;
              pIter->aIdxCol[iIdxCol++].nSpan = nSpan;
              i++;
              break;
            }
          }else if( c==',' && nParen==1 ){
            int nSpan = &zSql[i] - pIter->aIdxCol[iIdxCol].zSpan;
            pIter->aIdxCol[iIdxCol++].nSpan = nSpan;
            pIter->aIdxCol[iIdxCol].zSpan = &zSql[i+1];
          }else if( c=='"' || c=='\'' || c=='`' ){
            for(i++; 1; i++){
              if( zSql[i]==c ){
                if( zSql[i+1]!=c ) break;
                i++;
              }
            }
          }else if( c=='[' ){
            for(i++; 1; i++){
              if( zSql[i]==']' ) break;
            }
          }else if( c=='-' && zSql[i+1]=='-' ){
            for(i=i+2; zSql[i] && zSql[i]!='\n'; i++);
            if( zSql[i]=='\0' ) break;
          }else if( c=='/' && zSql[i+1]=='*' ){
            for(i=i+2; zSql[i] && (zSql[i]!='*' || zSql[i+1]!='/'); i++);
            if( zSql[i]=='\0' ) break;
            i++;
          }
        }
        if( zSql[i] ){
          zRet = rbuStrndup(&zSql[i], &rc);
        }
        pIter->nIdxCol = iIdxCol;
      }
    }

    rc2 =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  }

  p->rc = rc;
  return zRet;
}






static int rbuObjIterPrepareAll(
  sqlite3rbu *p,
  RbuObjIter *pIter,
  int nOffset
){
  assert( pIter->bCleanup==0 );
  if( pIter->pSelect==0 && rbuObjIterCacheTableInfo(p, pIter)==0         ){
    const int tnum = pIter->iTnum;
    char *zCollist = 0;
    char **pz = &p->zErrmsg;
    const char *zIdx = pIter->zIdx;
    char *zLimit = 0;

    if( nOffset ){
      zLimit =sqlite3_api->mprintf(" LIMIT -1 OFFSET %d",nOffset);
      if( !zLimit ) p->rc =7            ;
    }

    if( zIdx ){
      const char *zTbl = pIter->zTbl;
      char *zImposterCols = 0;
      char *zImposterPK = 0;
      char *zWhere = 0;
      char *zBind = 0;
      char *zPart = 0;
      int nBind = 0;

      assert( pIter->eType!=5           );
      zPart = rbuObjIterGetIndexWhere(p, pIter);
      zCollist = rbuObjIterGetIndexCols(
          p, pIter, &zImposterCols, &zImposterPK, &zWhere, &nBind
      );
      zBind = rbuObjIterGetBindlist(p, nBind);


sqlite3_api->test_control (25                      , p->dbMain, "main", 0, 1);
sqlite3_api->test_control (25                      , p->dbMain, "main", 1,tnum);
      rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain,
          "CREATE TABLE \"rbu_imp_%w\"( %s, PRIMARY KEY( %s ) ) WITHOUT ROWID",
          zTbl, zImposterCols, zImposterPK
      );
sqlite3_api->test_control (25                      , p->dbMain, "main", 0, 0);


      pIter->nCol = nBind;
      if( p->rc==0         ){
        p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(
            p->dbMain, &pIter->pInsert, &p->zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf     ("INSERT INTO \"rbu_imp_%w\" VALUES(%s)", zTbl, zBind)
        );
      }


      if(((p)->zTarget==0)==0&&p->rc==0         ){
        p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(
            p->dbMain, &pIter->pDelete, &p->zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf     ("DELETE FROM \"rbu_imp_%w\" WHERE %s", zTbl, zWhere)
        );
      }


      if( p->rc==0         ){
        char *zSql;
        if(((p)->zTarget==0)){
          char *zStart = 0;
          if( nOffset ){
            zStart = rbuVacuumIndexStart(p, pIter);
            if( zStart ){
sqlite3_api->free         (zLimit);
              zLimit = 0;
            }
          }

          zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
              "SELECT %s, 0 AS rbu_control FROM '%q' %s %s %s ORDER BY %s%s",
              zCollist,
              pIter->zDataTbl,
              zPart,
              (zStart ? (zPart ? "AND" : "WHERE") : ""), zStart,
              zCollist, zLimit
          );
sqlite3_api->free     (zStart);
        }else

        if( pIter->eType==3               || pIter->eType==1           ){
          zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
              "SELECT %s, rbu_control FROM %s.'rbu_tmp_%q' %s ORDER BY %s%s",
              zCollist, p->zStateDb, pIter->zDataTbl,
              zPart, zCollist, zLimit
          );
        }else{
          zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
              "SELECT %s, rbu_control FROM %s.'rbu_tmp_%q' %s "
              "UNION ALL "
              "SELECT %s, rbu_control FROM '%q' "
              "%s %s typeof(rbu_control)='integer' AND rbu_control!=1 "
              "ORDER BY %s%s",
              zCollist, p->zStateDb, pIter->zDataTbl, zPart,
              zCollist, pIter->zDataTbl,
              zPart,
              (zPart ? "AND" : "WHERE"),
              zCollist, zLimit
          );
        }
        if( p->rc==0         ){
          p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbRbu,&pIter->pSelect,pz,zSql);
        }else{
sqlite3_api->free     (zSql);
        }
      }

sqlite3_api->free (zImposterCols);
sqlite3_api->free (zImposterPK);
sqlite3_api->free (zWhere);
sqlite3_api->free (zBind);
sqlite3_api->free (zPart);
    }else{
      int bRbuRowid = (pIter->eType==5          )
                    ||(pIter->eType==1          )
                    ||(pIter->eType==3               &&((p)->zTarget==0));
      const char *zTbl = pIter->zTbl;
      const char *zWrite;

      char *zBindings = rbuObjIterGetBindlist(p, pIter->nTblCol + bRbuRowid);
      char *zWhere = rbuObjIterGetWhere(p, pIter);
      char *zOldlist = rbuObjIterGetOldlist(p, pIter, "old");
      char *zNewlist = rbuObjIterGetOldlist(p, pIter, "new");

      zCollist = rbuObjIterGetCollist(p, pIter);
      pIter->nCol = pIter->nTblCol;


      rbuCreateImposterTable(p, pIter);
      rbuCreateImposterTable2(p, pIter);
      zWrite = (pIter->eType==5           ? "" : "rbu_imp_");


      if( p->rc==0         ){
        p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbMain, &pIter->pInsert, pz,
sqlite3_api->mprintf       (
              "INSERT INTO \"%s%w\"(%s%s) VALUES(%s)",
              zWrite, zTbl, zCollist, (bRbuRowid ? ", _rowid_" : ""), zBindings
            )
        );
      }




      if(((p)->zTarget==0)==0&&p->rc==0         ){
        p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbMain, &pIter->pDelete, pz,
sqlite3_api->mprintf       (
              "DELETE FROM \"%s%w\" WHERE %s", zWrite, zTbl, zWhere
            )
        );
      }

      if(((p)->zTarget==0)==0&&pIter->abIndexed ){
        const char *zRbuRowid = "";
        if( pIter->eType==3               || pIter->eType==1           ){
          zRbuRowid = ", rbu_rowid";
        }


        rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbRbu,
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %s.'rbu_tmp_%q' AS "
            "SELECT *%s FROM '%q' WHERE 0;"
            , p->zStateDb, pIter->zDataTbl
            , (pIter->eType==3               ? ", 0 AS rbu_rowid" : "")
            , pIter->zDataTbl
        );

        rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain,
            "CREATE TEMP TRIGGER rbu_delete_tr BEFORE DELETE ON \"%s%w\" "
            "BEGIN "
            "  SELECT rbu_tmp_insert(3, %s);"
            "END;"

            "CREATE TEMP TRIGGER rbu_update1_tr BEFORE UPDATE ON \"%s%w\" "
            "BEGIN "
            "  SELECT rbu_tmp_insert(3, %s);"
            "END;"

            "CREATE TEMP TRIGGER rbu_update2_tr AFTER UPDATE ON \"%s%w\" "
            "BEGIN "
            "  SELECT rbu_tmp_insert(4, %s);"
            "END;",
            zWrite, zTbl, zOldlist,
            zWrite, zTbl, zOldlist,
            zWrite, zTbl, zNewlist
        );

        if( pIter->eType==3               || pIter->eType==1           ){
          rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain,
              "CREATE TEMP TRIGGER rbu_insert_tr AFTER INSERT ON \"%s%w\" "
              "BEGIN "
              "  SELECT rbu_tmp_insert(0, %s);"
              "END;",
              zWrite, zTbl, zNewlist
          );
        }

        rbuObjIterPrepareTmpInsert(p, pIter, zCollist, zRbuRowid);
      }


      if( p->rc==0         ){
        const char *zRbuRowid = "";
        char *zStart = 0;
        char *zOrder = 0;
        if( bRbuRowid ){
          zRbuRowid =((p)->zTarget==0)?",_rowid_ " : ",rbu_rowid";
        }

        if(((p)->zTarget==0)){
          if( nOffset ){
            zStart = rbuVacuumTableStart(p, pIter, bRbuRowid, zWrite);
            if( zStart ){
sqlite3_api->free         (zLimit);
              zLimit = 0;
            }
          }
          if( bRbuRowid ){
            zOrder = rbuMPrintf(p, "_rowid_");
          }else{
            zOrder = rbuObjIterGetPkList(p, pIter, "", ", ", "");
          }
        }

        if( p->rc==0         ){
          p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pIter->pSelect, pz,
sqlite3_api->mprintf         (
                "SELECT %s,%s rbu_control%s FROM '%q'%s %s %s %s",
                zCollist,
                (((p)->zTarget==0)?"0 AS ": ""),
                zRbuRowid,
                pIter->zDataTbl, (zStart ? zStart : ""),
                (zOrder ? "ORDER BY" : ""), zOrder,
                zLimit
              )
          );
        }
sqlite3_api->free   (zStart);
sqlite3_api->free   (zOrder);
      }

sqlite3_api->free (zWhere);
sqlite3_api->free (zOldlist);
sqlite3_api->free (zNewlist);
sqlite3_api->free (zBindings);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zCollist);
sqlite3_api->free(zLimit);
  }

  return p->rc;
}










static int rbuGetUpdateStmt(
  sqlite3rbu *p,
  RbuObjIter *pIter,
  const char *zMask,
  sqlite3_stmt **ppStmt
){
  RbuUpdateStmt **pp;
  RbuUpdateStmt *pUp = 0;
  int nUp = 0;


  *ppStmt = 0;





  for(pp=&pIter->pRbuUpdate; *pp; pp=&((*pp)->pNext)){
    pUp = *pp;
    if( strcmp(pUp->zMask, zMask)==0 ){
      *pp = pUp->pNext;
      pUp->pNext = pIter->pRbuUpdate;
      pIter->pRbuUpdate = pUp;
      *ppStmt = pUp->pUpdate;
      return 0        ;
    }
    nUp++;
  }
  assert( pUp==0 || pUp->pNext==0 );

  if( nUp>=16                          ){
    for(pp=&pIter->pRbuUpdate; *pp!=pUp; pp=&((*pp)->pNext));
    *pp = 0;
sqlite3_api->finalize(pUp->pUpdate);
    pUp->pUpdate = 0;
  }else{
    pUp = (RbuUpdateStmt*)rbuMalloc(p, sizeof(RbuUpdateStmt)+pIter->nTblCol+1);
  }

  if( pUp ){
    char *zWhere = rbuObjIterGetWhere(p, pIter);
    char *zSet = rbuObjIterGetSetlist(p, pIter, zMask);
    char *zUpdate = 0;

    pUp->zMask = (char*)&pUp[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pUp->zMask);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zMask); int xxn=(pIter->nTblCol);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    pUp->pNext = pIter->pRbuUpdate;
    pIter->pRbuUpdate = pUp;

    if( zSet ){
      const char *zPrefix = "";

      if( pIter->eType!=5           ) zPrefix = "rbu_imp_";
      zUpdate =sqlite3_api->mprintf("UPDATE \"%s%w\" SET %s WHERE %s",
          zPrefix, pIter->zTbl, zSet, zWhere
      );
      p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(
          p->dbMain, &pUp->pUpdate, &p->zErrmsg, zUpdate
      );
      *ppStmt = pUp->pUpdate;
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zWhere);
sqlite3_api->free(zSet);
  }

  return p->rc;
}

static sqlite3 *rbuOpenDbhandle(
  sqlite3rbu *p,
  const char *zName,
  int bUseVfs
){
  sqlite3 *db = 0;
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    const int flags =0x00000002            |0x00000004        |0x00000040     ;
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->open_v2(zName,&db,flags,bUseVfs? p->zVfsName : 0);
    if( p->rc ){
      p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(db));
sqlite3_api->close (db);
      db = 0;
    }
  }
  return db;
}




static void rbuFreeState(RbuState *p){
  if( p ){
sqlite3_api->free(p->zTbl);
sqlite3_api->free(p->zDataTbl);
sqlite3_api->free(p->zIdx);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}










static RbuState *rbuLoadState(sqlite3rbu *p){
  RbuState *pRet = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  int rc;
  int rc2;

  pRet = (RbuState*)rbuMalloc(p, sizeof(RbuState));
  if( pRet==0 ) return 0;

  rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pStmt, &p->zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf ("SELECT k, v FROM %s.rbu_state", p->zStateDb)
  );
  while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
    switch(sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0)){
      case 1              :
        pRet->eStage =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,1);
        if( pRet->eStage!=1
         && pRet->eStage!=2
         && pRet->eStage!=4
        ){
          p->rc =11             ;
        }
        break;

      case 2            :
        pRet->zTbl = rbuStrndup((char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,1),&rc);
        break;

      case 3            :
        pRet->zIdx = rbuStrndup((char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,1),&rc);
        break;

      case 4            :
        pRet->nRow =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 5                 :
        pRet->nProgress =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 6             :
        pRet->iWalCksum =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 7               :
        pRet->iCookie = (u32)sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 8              :
        pRet->iOalSz =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 9                     :
        pRet->nPhaseOneStep =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,1);
        break;

      case 10               :
        pRet->zDataTbl = rbuStrndup((char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pStmt,1),&rc);
        break;

      default:
        rc =11             ;
        break;
    }
  }
  rc2 =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
  if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;

  p->rc = rc;
  return pRet;
}










static void rbuOpenDatabase(sqlite3rbu *p, sqlite3 *dbMain, int *pbRetry){
  assert( p->rc || (p->dbMain==0 && p->dbRbu==0) );
  assert( p->rc ||((p)->zTarget==0)||p->zTarget!=0 );
  assert( dbMain==0 ||((p)->zTarget==0)==0);


  p->dbRbu = rbuOpenDbhandle(p, p->zRbu, 1);
  p->dbMain = dbMain;

  if( p->rc==0         &&((p)->zTarget==0)){
sqlite3_api->file_control(p->dbRbu,"main",5149216             , (void*)p);
    if( p->zState==0 ){
      const char *zFile =sqlite3_api->db_filename(p->dbRbu,"main");
      p->zState = rbuMPrintf(p, "file:///%s-vacuum?modeof=%s", zFile, zFile);
    }
  }



  if( p->zState ){
    rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbRbu, "ATTACH %Q AS stat", p->zState);
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zStateDb);const char*xxs=(const char*)("stat"); int xxn=(4);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zStateDb);const char*xxs=(const char*)("main"); int xxn=(4);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  }


  if( p->rc==0         &&((p)->zTarget==0)){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"BEGIN",0,0,0);
  }



  rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbRbu,"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %s.rbu_state(k INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, v)",p->zStateDb);


  if(((p)->zTarget==0)){
    if( p->rc==0         ){
      int rc2;
      int bOk = 0;
      sqlite3_stmt *pCnt = 0;
      p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pCnt, &p->zErrmsg,
          "SELECT count(*) FROM stat.sqlite_schema"
      );
      if( p->rc==0
       &&sqlite3_api->step(pCnt)==100
       && 1==sqlite3_api->column_int(pCnt,0)
      ){
        bOk = 1;
      }
      rc2 =sqlite3_api->finalize(pCnt);
      if( p->rc==0         ) p->rc = rc2;

      if( p->rc==0         && bOk==0 ){
        p->rc =1            ;
        p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("invalid state database");
      }

      if( p->rc==0         ){
        p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"COMMIT",0,0,0);
      }
    }
  }


  if( p->rc==0         &&((p)->zTarget==0)){
    int bOpen = 0;
    int rc;
    p->nRbu = 0;
    p->pRbuFd = 0;
    rc =sqlite3_api->file_control(p->dbRbu,"main",5149216          , (void*)p);
    if( rc!=12              ) p->rc = rc;
    if( p->eStage>=2              ){
      bOpen = 1;
    }else{
      RbuState *pState = rbuLoadState(p);
      if( pState ){
        bOpen = (pState->eStage>=2             );
        rbuFreeState(pState);
      }
    }
    if( bOpen ) p->dbMain = rbuOpenDbhandle(p, p->zRbu, p->nRbu<=1);
  }

  p->eStage = 0;
  if( p->rc==0         && p->dbMain==0 ){
    if( !((p)->zTarget==0)){
      p->dbMain = rbuOpenDbhandle(p, p->zTarget, 1);
    }else if( p->pRbuFd->pWalFd ){
      if( pbRetry ){
        p->pRbuFd->bNolock = 0;
sqlite3_api->close   (p->dbRbu);
sqlite3_api->close   (p->dbMain);
        p->dbMain = 0;
        p->dbRbu = 0;
        *pbRetry = 1;
        return;
      }
      p->rc =1            ;
      p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("cannot vacuum wal mode database");
    }else{
      char *zTarget;
      char *zExtra = 0;
      if( strlen(p->zRbu)>=5 && 0==memcmp("file:", p->zRbu, 5) ){
        zExtra = &p->zRbu[5];
        while( *zExtra ){
          if( *zExtra++=='?' ) break;
        }
        if( *zExtra=='\0' ) zExtra = 0;
      }

      zTarget =sqlite3_api->mprintf("file:%s-vactmp?rbu_memory=1%s%s",
sqlite3_api->db_filename     (p->dbRbu, "main"),
          (zExtra==0 ? "" : "&"), (zExtra==0 ? "" : zExtra)
      );

      if( zTarget==0 ){
        p->rc =7            ;
        return;
      }
      p->dbMain = rbuOpenDbhandle(p, zTarget, p->nRbu<=1);
sqlite3_api->free (zTarget);
    }
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(p->dbMain,
        "rbu_tmp_insert", -1,1           , (void*)p, rbuTmpInsertFunc, 0, 0
    );
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(p->dbMain,
        "rbu_fossil_delta", 2,1           , 0, rbuFossilDeltaFunc, 0, 0
    );
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(p->dbRbu,
        "rbu_target_name", -1,1           , (void*)p, rbuTargetNameFunc, 0, 0
    );
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->file_control(p->dbMain,"main",26            , (void*)p);
  }
  rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain, "SELECT * FROM sqlite_schema");




  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->file_control(p->dbMain,"main",26            , (void*)p);
  }

  if( p->rc==12              ){
    p->rc =1            ;
    p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("rbu vfs not found");
  }
}





















static void rbuFileSuffix3(const char *zBase, char *z){


  if(sqlite3_api->uri_boolean(zBase,"8_3_names",0))

  {
    int i, sz;
    sz = (int)strlen(z)&0xffffff;
    for(i=sz-1; i>0 && z[i]!='/' && z[i]!='.'; i--){}
    if( z[i]=='.' && sz>i+4 ) memmove(&z[i+1], &z[sz-3], 4);
  }

}








static i64 rbuShmChecksum(sqlite3rbu *p){
  i64 iRet = 0;
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;
    u32 volatile *ptr;
    p->rc = pDb->pMethods->xShmMap(pDb, 0, 32*1024, 0, (void volatile**)&ptr);
    if( p->rc==0         ){
      iRet = ((i64)ptr[10] << 32) + ptr[11];
    }
  }
  return iRet;
}

















static void rbuSetupCheckpoint(sqlite3rbu *p, RbuState *pState){




  if( pState==0 ){
    p->eStage = 0;
    if( p->rc==0         ){
      p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"SELECT * FROM sqlite_schema",0,0,0);
    }
  }





























  if( p->rc==0         ){
    int rc2;
    p->eStage =3                 ;
    rc2 =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"PRAGMA main.wal_checkpoint=restart",0,0,0);
    if( rc2!=27            ) p->rc = rc2;
  }

  if( p->rc==0         && p->nFrame>0 ){
    p->eStage =4              ;
    p->nStep = (pState ? pState->nRow : 0);
    p->aBuf = rbuMalloc(p, p->pgsz);
    p->iWalCksum = rbuShmChecksum(p);
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    if( p->nFrame==0 || (pState && pState->iWalCksum!=p->iWalCksum) ){
      p->rc =101         ;
      p->eStage =5              ;
    }else{
      int nSectorSize;
      sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;
      sqlite3_file *pWal = p->pTargetFd->pWalFd->pReal;
      assert( p->nPagePerSector==0 );
      nSectorSize = pDb->pMethods->xSectorSize(pDb);
      if( nSectorSize>p->pgsz ){
        p->nPagePerSector = nSectorSize / p->pgsz;
      }else{
        p->nPagePerSector = 1;
      }





      p->rc = pWal->pMethods->xSync(pWal,0x00002            );
    }
  }
}






static int rbuCaptureWalRead(sqlite3rbu *pRbu, i64 iOff, int iAmt){
  const u32 mReq = (1<<0             )|(1<<1            )|(1<<3             );
  u32 iFrame;

  if( pRbu->mLock!=mReq ){
    pRbu->rc =5           ;
    return(27 | (3<<8))     ;
  }

  pRbu->pgsz = iAmt;
  if( pRbu->nFrame==pRbu->nFrameAlloc ){
    int nNew = (pRbu->nFrameAlloc ? pRbu->nFrameAlloc : 64) * 2;
    RbuFrame *aNew;
    aNew = (RbuFrame*)sqlite3_api->realloc64(pRbu->aFrame,nNew*sizeof(RbuFrame));
    if( aNew==0 ) return 7           ;
    pRbu->aFrame = aNew;
    pRbu->nFrameAlloc = nNew;
  }

  iFrame = (u32)((iOff-32) / (i64)(iAmt+24)) + 1;
  if( pRbu->iMaxFrame<iFrame ) pRbu->iMaxFrame = iFrame;
  pRbu->aFrame[pRbu->nFrame].iWalFrame = iFrame;
  pRbu->aFrame[pRbu->nFrame].iDbPage = 0;
  pRbu->nFrame++;
  return 0        ;
}






static int rbuCaptureDbWrite(sqlite3rbu *pRbu, i64 iOff){
  pRbu->aFrame[pRbu->nFrame-1].iDbPage = (u32)(iOff / pRbu->pgsz) + 1;
  return 0        ;
}






static void rbuCheckpointFrame(sqlite3rbu *p, RbuFrame *pFrame){
  sqlite3_file *pWal = p->pTargetFd->pWalFd->pReal;
  sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;
  i64 iOff;

  assert( p->rc==0         );
  iOff = (i64)(pFrame->iWalFrame-1) * (p->pgsz + 24) + 32 + 24;
  p->rc = pWal->pMethods->xRead(pWal, p->aBuf, p->pgsz, iOff);
  if( p->rc ) return;

  iOff = (i64)(pFrame->iDbPage-1) * p->pgsz;
  p->rc = pDb->pMethods->xWrite(pDb, p->aBuf, p->pgsz, iOff);
}






static int rbuLockDatabase(sqlite3 *db){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_file *fd = 0;
sqlite3_api->file_control(db,"main",7                       , &fd);

  if( fd->pMethods ){
    rc = fd->pMethods->xLock(fd,1                  );
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fd->pMethods->xLock(fd,4                     );
    }
  }
  return rc;
}






static int rbuExclusiveCheckpoint(sqlite3 *db){
  const char *zUri =sqlite3_api->db_filename(db,0);
  return sqlite3_api->uri_boolean(zUri,"rbu_exclusive_checkpoint",0);
}


static LPWSTR rbuWinUtf8ToUnicode(const char *zFilename){
  int nChar;
  LPWSTR zWideFilename;

  nChar = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, zFilename, -1, NULL, 0);
  if( nChar==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  zWideFilename =sqlite3_api->malloc64(nChar*sizeof(zWideFilename[0]));
  if( zWideFilename==0 ){
    return 0;
  }
  memset(zWideFilename, 0, nChar*sizeof(zWideFilename[0]));
  nChar = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, zFilename, -1, zWideFilename,
                                nChar);
  if( nChar==0 ){
sqlite3_api->free(zWideFilename);
    zWideFilename = 0;
  }
  return zWideFilename;
}









static void rbuMoveOalFile(sqlite3rbu *p){
  const char *zBase =sqlite3_api->db_filename(p->dbMain,"main");
  const char *zMove = zBase;
  char *zOal;
  char *zWal;

  if(((p)->zTarget==0)){
    zMove =sqlite3_api->db_filename(p->dbRbu,"main");
  }
  zOal =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s-oal",zMove);
  zWal =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s-wal",zMove);

  assert( p->eStage==2              );
  assert( p->rc==0         && p->zErrmsg==0 );
  if( zWal==0 || zOal==0 ){
    p->rc =7            ;
  }else{







    sqlite3 *dbMain = 0;
    rbuFileSuffix3(zBase, zWal);
    rbuFileSuffix3(zBase, zOal);


    rbuObjIterFinalize(&p->objiter);
sqlite3_api->close(p->dbRbu);
sqlite3_api->close(p->dbMain);
    p->dbMain = 0;
    p->dbRbu = 0;

    dbMain = rbuOpenDbhandle(p, p->zTarget, 1);
    if( dbMain ){
      assert( p->rc==0         );
      p->rc = rbuLockDatabase(dbMain);
    }

    if( p->rc==0         ){
      p->rc = p->xRename(p->pRenameArg, zOal, zWal);
    }

    if( p->rc!=0
     ||((p)->zTarget==0)
     || rbuExclusiveCheckpoint(dbMain)==0
    ){
sqlite3_api->close (dbMain);
      dbMain = 0;
    }

    if( p->rc==0         ){
      rbuOpenDatabase(p, dbMain, 0);
      rbuSetupCheckpoint(p, 0);
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(zWal);
sqlite3_api->free(zOal);
}


















static int rbuStepType(sqlite3rbu *p, const char **pzMask){
  int iCol = p->objiter.nCol;
  int res = 0;

  switch(sqlite3_api->column_type(p->objiter.pSelect,iCol)){
    case 1             : {
      int iVal =sqlite3_api->column_int(p->objiter.pSelect,iCol);
      switch( iVal ){
        case 0: res =1          ;     break;
        case 1: res =2          ;     break;
        case 2: res =3           ;    break;
        case 3: res =4              ; break;
        case 4: res =5              ; break;
      }
      break;
    }

    case 3          : {
      const unsigned char *z =sqlite3_api->column_text(p->objiter.pSelect,iCol);
      if( z==0 ){
        p->rc =7            ;
      }else{
        *pzMask = (const char*)z;
      }
      res =6          ;

      break;
    }

    default:
      break;
  }

  if( res==0 ){
    rbuBadControlError(p);
  }
  return res;
}





static void assertColumnName(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int iCol, const char *zName){
  const char *zCol =sqlite3_api->column_name(pStmt,iCol);
  assert( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,zCol));
}









static void rbuStepOneOp(sqlite3rbu *p, int eType){
  RbuObjIter *pIter = &p->objiter;
  sqlite3_value *pVal;
  sqlite3_stmt *pWriter;
  int i;

  assert( p->rc==0         );
  assert( eType!=2          || pIter->zIdx==0 );
  assert( eType==2          || eType==4
       || eType==1          || eType==5
  );





  if( eType==2          ){
    p->nPhaseOneStep -= p->objiter.nIndex;
  }

  if( eType==4              || eType==2          ){
    pWriter = pIter->pDelete;
  }else{
    pWriter = pIter->pInsert;
  }

  for(i=0; i<pIter->nCol; i++){



    if( eType==1
     && pIter->zIdx==0 && pIter->eType==2          && pIter->abTblPk[i]
     &&sqlite3_api->column_type(pIter->pSelect,i)==5
    ){
      p->rc =20              ;
      p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("datatype mismatch");
      return;
    }

    if( eType==2          && pIter->abTblPk[i]==0 ){
      continue;
    }

    pVal =sqlite3_api->column_value(pIter->pSelect,i);
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->bind_value(pWriter,i+1,pVal);
    if( p->rc ) return;
  }
  if( pIter->zIdx==0 ){
    if( pIter->eType==5
     || pIter->eType==1
     || (pIter->eType==3               &&((p)->zTarget==0))
    ){









       ;
      pVal =sqlite3_api->column_value(pIter->pSelect,pIter->nCol+1);
      p->rc =sqlite3_api->bind_value(pWriter,pIter->nCol+1,pVal);
    }
  }
  if( p->rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step(pWriter);
    p->rc = resetAndCollectError(pWriter, &p->zErrmsg);
  }
}












static int rbuStep(sqlite3rbu *p){
  RbuObjIter *pIter = &p->objiter;
  const char *zMask = 0;
  int eType = rbuStepType(p, &zMask);

  if( eType ){
    assert( eType==1              || eType==2
         || eType==3              || eType==4
         || eType==5              || eType==6
    );
    assert( eType!=6          || pIter->zIdx==0 );

    if( pIter->zIdx==0 && (eType==4              || eType==5             ) ){
      rbuBadControlError(p);
    }
    else if( eType==3           ){
      if( pIter->zIdx==0 ){
        p->nPhaseOneStep += p->objiter.nIndex;
        rbuStepOneOp(p,2          );
      }
      if( p->rc==0         ) rbuStepOneOp(p,1          );
    }
    else if( eType!=6          ){
      rbuStepOneOp(p, eType);
    }
    else{
      sqlite3_value *pVal;
      sqlite3_stmt *pUpdate = 0;
      assert( eType==6          );
      p->nPhaseOneStep -= p->objiter.nIndex;
      rbuGetUpdateStmt(p, pIter, zMask, &pUpdate);
      if( pUpdate ){
        int i;
        for(i=0; p->rc==0         && i<pIter->nCol; i++){
          char c = zMask[pIter->aiSrcOrder[i]];
          pVal =sqlite3_api->column_value(pIter->pSelect,i);
          if( pIter->abTblPk[i] || c!='.' ){
            p->rc =sqlite3_api->bind_value(pUpdate,i+1,pVal);
          }
        }
        if( p->rc==0
         && (pIter->eType==5           || pIter->eType==1          )
        ){

                                                                      ;
          pVal =sqlite3_api->column_value(pIter->pSelect,pIter->nCol+1);
          p->rc =sqlite3_api->bind_value(pUpdate,pIter->nCol+1,pVal);
        }
        if( p->rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step     (pUpdate);
          p->rc = resetAndCollectError(pUpdate, &p->zErrmsg);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return p->rc;
}








static void rbuIncrSchemaCookie(sqlite3rbu *p){
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3 *dbread = (((p)->zTarget==0)?p->dbRbu: p->dbMain);
    int iCookie = 1000000;
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;

    p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(dbread, &pStmt, &p->zErrmsg,
        "PRAGMA schema_version"
    );
    if( p->rc==0         ){





      if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
        iCookie =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0);
      }
      rbuFinalize(p, pStmt);
    }
    if( p->rc==0         ){
      rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain, "PRAGMA schema_version = %d", iCookie+1);
    }
  }
}






static void rbuSaveState(sqlite3rbu *p, int eStage){
  if( p->rc==0         || p->rc==101         ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pInsert = 0;
    rbu_file *pFd = (((p)->zTarget==0)?p->pRbuFd: p->pTargetFd);
    int rc;

    assert( p->zErrmsg==0 );
    rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pInsert, &p->zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf   (
          "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO %s.rbu_state(k, v) VALUES "
          "(%d, %d), "
          "(%d, %Q), "
          "(%d, %Q), "
          "(%d, %d), "
          "(%d, %d), "
          "(%d, %lld), "
          "(%d, %lld), "
          "(%d, %lld), "
          "(%d, %lld), "
          "(%d, %Q)  ",
          p->zStateDb,
1                        , eStage,
2                      , p->objiter.zTbl,
3                      , p->objiter.zIdx,
4                      , p->nStep,
5                           , p->nProgress,
6                       , p->iWalCksum,
7                         , (i64)pFd->iCookie,
8                        , p->iOalSz,
9                               , p->nPhaseOneStep,
10                         , p->objiter.zDataTbl
      )
    );
    assert( pInsert==0 || rc==0         );

    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step (pInsert);
      rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pInsert);
    }
    if( rc!=0         ) p->rc = rc;
  }
}



















static void rbuCopyPragma(sqlite3rbu *p, const char *zPragma){
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pPragma = 0;
    p->rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pPragma, &p->zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf   ("PRAGMA main.%s", zPragma)
    );
    if( p->rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pPragma)){
      p->rc = rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbMain, "PRAGMA main.%s = %d",
          zPragma,sqlite3_api->column_int(pPragma,0)
      );
    }
    rbuFinalize(p, pPragma);
  }
}






static void rbuCreateTargetSchema(sqlite3rbu *p){
  sqlite3_stmt *pSql = 0;
  sqlite3_stmt *pInsert = 0;

  assert(((p)->zTarget==0));
  p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"PRAGMA writable_schema=1",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pSql, &p->zErrmsg,
      "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE sql!='' AND rootpage!=0"
      " AND name!='sqlite_sequence' "
      " ORDER BY type DESC"
    );
  }

  while( p->rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->step(pSql)==100    ){
    const char *zSql = (const char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pSql,0);
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,zSql,0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
  }
  rbuFinalize(p, pSql);
  if( p->rc!=0         ) return;

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pSql, &p->zErrmsg,
        "SELECT * FROM sqlite_schema WHERE rootpage=0 OR rootpage IS NULL"
    );
  }

  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbMain, &pInsert, &p->zErrmsg,
        "INSERT INTO sqlite_schema VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)"
    );
  }

  while( p->rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->step(pSql)==100    ){
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<5; i++){
sqlite3_api->bind_value (pInsert, i+1,sqlite3_api->column_value(pSql,i));
    }
sqlite3_api->step(pInsert);
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pInsert);
  }
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"PRAGMA writable_schema=0",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
  }

  rbuFinalize(p, pSql);
  rbuFinalize(p, pInsert);
}




           int sqlite3rbu_step(sqlite3rbu *p){
  if( p ){
    switch( p->eStage ){
      case 1            : {
        RbuObjIter *pIter = &p->objiter;



        if(((p)->zTarget==0)&&p->nProgress==0 && p->rc==0         ){
          rbuCreateTargetSchema(p);
          rbuCopyPragma(p, "user_version");
          rbuCopyPragma(p, "application_id");
        }

        while( p->rc==0         && pIter->zTbl ){

          if( pIter->bCleanup ){



            if(((p)->zTarget==0)==0&&pIter->abIndexed ){
              rbuMPrintfExec(p, p->dbRbu,
                  "DELETE FROM %s.'rbu_tmp_%q'", p->zStateDb, pIter->zDataTbl
              );
            }
          }else{
            rbuObjIterPrepareAll(p, pIter, 0);


            if( p->rc==0         ){
              int rc =sqlite3_api->step(pIter->pSelect);
              if( rc==100        ){
                p->nProgress++;
                p->nStep++;
                return rbuStep(p);
              }
              p->rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pIter->pSelect);
              p->nStep = 0;
            }
          }

          rbuObjIterNext(p, pIter);
        }

        if( p->rc==0         ){
          assert( pIter->zTbl==0 );
          rbuSaveState(p,2              );
          rbuIncrSchemaCookie(p);
          if( p->rc==0         ){
            p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"COMMIT",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
          }
          if( p->rc==0         ){
            p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"COMMIT",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
          }
          p->eStage =2              ;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 2             : {
        if( p->rc==0         ){
          rbuMoveOalFile(p);
          p->nProgress++;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 4             : {
        if( p->rc==0         ){
          if( p->nStep>=p->nFrame ){
            sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;


            p->rc = pDb->pMethods->xSync(pDb,0x00002            );


            if( p->rc==0         ){
              void volatile *ptr;
              p->rc = pDb->pMethods->xShmMap(pDb, 0, 32*1024, 0, &ptr);
              if( p->rc==0         ){
                ((u32 volatile*)ptr)[24] = p->iMaxFrame;
              }
            }

            if( p->rc==0         ){
              p->eStage =5              ;
              p->rc =101         ;
            }
          }else{










            u32 iSector;
            do{
              RbuFrame *pFrame = &p->aFrame[p->nStep];
              iSector = (pFrame->iDbPage-1) / p->nPagePerSector;
              rbuCheckpointFrame(p, pFrame);
              p->nStep++;
            }while( p->nStep<p->nFrame
                 && iSector==((p->aFrame[p->nStep].iDbPage-1) / p->nPagePerSector)
                 && p->rc==0
            );
          }
          p->nProgress++;
        }
        break;
      }

      default:
        break;
    }
    return p->rc;
  }else{
    return 7           ;
  }
}






static int rbuStrCompare(const char *z1, const char *z2){
  if( z1==0 && z2==0 ) return 0;
  if( z1==0 || z2==0 ) return 1;
  return (sqlite3_api->stricmp(z1,z2)!=0);
}











static void rbuSetupOal(sqlite3rbu *p, RbuState *pState){
  assert( p->rc==0         );
  if( pState->zTbl ){
    RbuObjIter *pIter = &p->objiter;
    int rc =0         ;

    while( rc==0         && pIter->zTbl && (pIter->bCleanup
       || rbuStrCompare(pIter->zIdx, pState->zIdx)
       || (pState->zDataTbl==0 && rbuStrCompare(pIter->zTbl, pState->zTbl))
       || (pState->zDataTbl && rbuStrCompare(pIter->zDataTbl, pState->zDataTbl))
    )){
      rc = rbuObjIterNext(p, pIter);
    }

    if( rc==0         && !pIter->zTbl ){
      rc =1            ;
      p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("rbu_state mismatch error");
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      p->nStep = pState->nRow;
      rc = rbuObjIterPrepareAll(p, &p->objiter, p->nStep);
    }

    p->rc = rc;
  }
}






static void rbuDeleteOalFile(sqlite3rbu *p){
  char *zOal = rbuMPrintf(p, "%s-oal", p->zTarget);
  if( zOal ){
    sqlite3_vfs *pVfs = 0;
sqlite3_api->file_control(p->dbMain,"main",27                       , &pVfs);
    assert( pVfs && p->rc==0         && p->zErrmsg==0 );
    pVfs->xDelete(pVfs, zOal, 0);
sqlite3_api->free(zOal);
  }
}







static void rbuCreateVfs(sqlite3rbu *p){
  int rnd;
  char zRnd[64];

  assert( p->rc==0         );
sqlite3_api->randomness(sizeof(int),(void*)&rnd);
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf(sizeof(zRnd),zRnd,"rbu_vfs_%d",rnd);
  p->rc = sqlite3rbu_create_vfs(zRnd, 0);
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_vfs *pVfs =sqlite3_api->vfs_find(zRnd);
    assert( pVfs );
    p->zVfsName = pVfs->zName;
    ((rbu_vfs*)pVfs)->pRbu = p;
  }
}





static void rbuDeleteVfs(sqlite3rbu *p){
  if( p->zVfsName ){
    sqlite3rbu_destroy_vfs(p->zVfsName);
    p->zVfsName = 0;
  }
}






static void rbuIndexCntFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nVal,
  sqlite3_value **apVal
){
  sqlite3rbu *p = (sqlite3rbu*)sqlite3_api->user_data(pCtx);
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
  char *zErrmsg = 0;
  int rc;
  sqlite3 *db = (((p)->zTarget==0)?p->dbRbu: p->dbMain);

  assert( nVal==1 );

  rc = prepareFreeAndCollectError(db, &pStmt, &zErrmsg,
sqlite3_api->mprintf ("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema "
        "WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name = %Q",sqlite3_api->value_text(apVal[0]))
  );
  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->result_error(pCtx,zErrmsg, -1);
  }else{
    int nIndex = 0;
    if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
      nIndex =sqlite3_api->column_int(pStmt,0);
    }
    rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->result_int (pCtx, nIndex);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->result_error (pCtx,sqlite3_api->errmsg(db),-1);
    }
  }

sqlite3_api->free(zErrmsg);
}
















static void rbuInitPhaseOneSteps(sqlite3rbu *p){
  if( p->rc==0         ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
    int bExists = 0;

    p->nPhaseOneStep = -1;

    p->rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(p->dbRbu,
        "rbu_index_cnt", 1,1           , (void*)p, rbuIndexCntFunc, 0, 0
    );



    if( p->rc==0         ){
      p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pStmt, &p->zErrmsg,
          "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE tbl_name = 'rbu_count'"
      );
    }
    if( p->rc==0         ){
      if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
        bExists = 1;
      }
      p->rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
    }

    if( p->rc==0         && bExists ){
      p->rc = prepareAndCollectError(p->dbRbu, &pStmt, &p->zErrmsg,
          "SELECT sum(cnt * (1 + rbu_index_cnt(rbu_target_name(tbl))))"
          "FROM rbu_count"
      );
      if( p->rc==0         ){
        if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
          p->nPhaseOneStep =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pStmt,0);
        }
        p->rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
      }
    }
  }
}


static sqlite3rbu *openRbuHandle(
  const char *zTarget,
  const char *zRbu,
  const char *zState
){
  sqlite3rbu *p;
  size_t nTarget = zTarget ? strlen(zTarget) : 0;
  size_t nRbu = strlen(zRbu);
  size_t nByte = sizeof(sqlite3rbu) + nTarget+1 + nRbu+1;

  p = (sqlite3rbu*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( p ){
    RbuState *pState = 0;


    memset(p, 0, sizeof(sqlite3rbu));
    sqlite3rbu_rename_handler(p, 0, 0);
    rbuCreateVfs(p);


    if( p->rc==0         ){
      char *pCsr = (char*)&p[1];
      int bRetry = 0;
      if( zTarget ){
        p->zTarget = pCsr;
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zTarget);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zTarget); int xxn=(nTarget+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pCsr += nTarget+1;
      }
      p->zRbu = pCsr;
{char*xxd=(char*)(p->zRbu);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zRbu); int xxn=(nRbu+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pCsr += nRbu+1;
      if( zState ){
        p->zState = rbuMPrintf(p, "%s", zState);
      }








      rbuOpenDatabase(p, 0, &bRetry);
      if( bRetry ){
        rbuOpenDatabase(p, 0, 0);
      }
    }

    if( p->rc==0         ){
      pState = rbuLoadState(p);
      assert( pState || p->rc!=0         );
      if( p->rc==0         ){

        if( pState->eStage==0 ){
          rbuDeleteOalFile(p);
          rbuInitPhaseOneSteps(p);
          p->eStage =1             ;
        }else{
          p->eStage = pState->eStage;
          p->nPhaseOneStep = pState->nPhaseOneStep;
        }
        p->nProgress = pState->nProgress;
        p->iOalSz = pState->iOalSz;
      }
    }
    assert( p->rc!=0         || p->eStage!=0 );

    if( p->rc==0         && p->pTargetFd->pWalFd ){
      if( p->eStage==1             ){
        p->rc =1            ;
        p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("cannot update wal mode database");
      }else if( p->eStage==2              ){
        p->eStage =4              ;
        p->nStep = 0;
      }
    }

    if( p->rc==0
     && (p->eStage==1             || p->eStage==2             )
     && pState->eStage!=0
    ){
      rbu_file *pFd = (((p)->zTarget==0)?p->pRbuFd: p->pTargetFd);
      if( pFd->iCookie!=pState->iCookie ){




        p->rc =5           ;
        p->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("database modified during rbu %s",
            (((p)->zTarget==0)?"vacuum": "update")
        );
      }
    }

    if( p->rc==0         ){
      if( p->eStage==1             ){
        sqlite3 *db = p->dbMain;
        p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"BEGIN",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);


        if( p->rc==0         ){
          p->rc = rbuObjIterFirst(p, &p->objiter);
        }



        if( p->rc==0         && p->objiter.zTbl==0 ){
          p->rc =101         ;
          p->eStage =5              ;
        }else{
          if( p->rc==0         && pState->eStage==0 &&((p)->zTarget==0)){
            rbuCopyPragma(p, "page_size");
            rbuCopyPragma(p, "auto_vacuum");
          }



          if( p->rc==0         ){
            p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"BEGIN IMMEDIATE",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
          }




          if( p->rc==0         ){
            int frc =sqlite3_api->file_control(db,"main",25               , 0);
            if( frc==0         ){
              p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(
                db, "PRAGMA journal_mode=off",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
            }
          }

          if( p->rc==0         ){
            rbuSetupOal(p, pState);
          }
        }
      }else if( p->eStage==2              ){

      }else if( p->eStage==4              ){
        if( !((p)->zTarget==0)&&rbuExclusiveCheckpoint(p->dbMain)){



          p->eStage =5              ;
          rbuLockDatabase(p->dbMain);
          p->eStage =4              ;
        }
        rbuSetupCheckpoint(p, pState);
      }else if( p->eStage==5              ){
        p->rc =101         ;
      }else{
        p->rc =11             ;
      }
    }

    rbuFreeState(pState);
  }

  return p;
}





static sqlite3rbu *rbuMisuseError(void){
  sqlite3rbu *pRet;
  pRet =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(sqlite3rbu));
  if( pRet ){
    memset(pRet, 0, sizeof(sqlite3rbu));
    pRet->rc =21            ;
  }
  return pRet;
}




           sqlite3rbu *sqlite3rbu_open(
  const char *zTarget,
  const char *zRbu,
  const char *zState
){
  if( zTarget==0 || zRbu==0 ){ return rbuMisuseError(); }
  return openRbuHandle(zTarget, zRbu, zState);
}




           sqlite3rbu *sqlite3rbu_vacuum(
  const char *zTarget,
  const char *zState
){
  if( zTarget==0 ){ return rbuMisuseError(); }
  if( zState ){
    int n = strlen(zState);
    if( n>=7 && 0==memcmp("-vactmp", &zState[n-7], 7) ){
      return rbuMisuseError();
    }
  }

  return openRbuHandle(0, zTarget, zState);
}




           sqlite3 *sqlite3rbu_db(sqlite3rbu *pRbu, int bRbu){
  sqlite3 *db = 0;
  if( pRbu ){
    db = (bRbu ? pRbu->dbRbu : pRbu->dbMain);
  }
  return db;
}







static void rbuEditErrmsg(sqlite3rbu *p){
  if( p->rc==19                && p->zErrmsg ){
    unsigned int i;
    size_t nErrmsg = strlen(p->zErrmsg);
    for(i=0; i<(nErrmsg-8); i++){
      if( memcmp(&p->zErrmsg[i], "rbu_imp_", 8)==0 ){
        int nDel = 8;
        while( p->zErrmsg[i+nDel]>='0' && p->zErrmsg[i+nDel]<='9' ) nDel++;
        memmove(&p->zErrmsg[i], &p->zErrmsg[i+nDel], nErrmsg + 1 - i - nDel);
        nErrmsg -= nDel;
      }
    }
  }
}




           int sqlite3rbu_close(sqlite3rbu *p, char **pzErrmsg){
  int rc;
  if( p ){


    if( p->rc==0         && p->eStage==1             ){
      p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"COMMIT",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
    }


    if( p->rc==0         && p->eStage==4              ){
      sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;
      p->rc = pDb->pMethods->xSync(pDb,0x00002            );
    }

    rbuSaveState(p, p->eStage);

    if( p->rc==0         && p->eStage==1             ){
      p->rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"COMMIT",0,0,&p->zErrmsg);
    }


    rbuObjIterFinalize(&p->objiter);






    if(((p)->zTarget==0)&&p->rc!=0         && p->dbRbu ){
      int rc2 =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"DELETE FROM stat.rbu_state",0,0,0);
      if( p->rc==101         && rc2!=0         ) p->rc = rc2;
    }


sqlite3_api->close(p->dbRbu);
sqlite3_api->close(p->dbMain);
    assert( p->szTemp==0 );
    rbuDeleteVfs(p);
sqlite3_api->free(p->aBuf);
sqlite3_api->free(p->aFrame);

    rbuEditErrmsg(p);
    rc = p->rc;
    if( pzErrmsg ){
      *pzErrmsg = p->zErrmsg;
    }else{
sqlite3_api->free (p->zErrmsg);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(p->zState);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }else{
    rc =7            ;
    *pzErrmsg = 0;
  }
  return rc;
}






           sqlite3_int64 sqlite3rbu_progress(sqlite3rbu *pRbu){
  return pRbu->nProgress;
}





           void sqlite3rbu_bp_progress(sqlite3rbu *p, int *pnOne, int *pnTwo){
  const int MAX_PROGRESS = 10000;
  switch( p->eStage ){
    case 1            :
      if( p->nPhaseOneStep>0 ){
        *pnOne = (int)(MAX_PROGRESS * (i64)p->nProgress/(i64)p->nPhaseOneStep);
      }else{
        *pnOne = -1;
      }
      *pnTwo = 0;
      break;

    case 2             :
      *pnOne = MAX_PROGRESS;
      *pnTwo = 0;
      break;

    case 4             :
      *pnOne = MAX_PROGRESS;
      *pnTwo = (int)(MAX_PROGRESS * (i64)p->nStep / (i64)p->nFrame);
      break;

    case 5             :
      *pnOne = MAX_PROGRESS;
      *pnTwo = MAX_PROGRESS;
      break;

    default:
      assert( 0 );
  }
}




           int sqlite3rbu_state(sqlite3rbu *p){
  int aRes[] = {
    0,1                    ,2                     ,
    0,3                           ,4
  };

  assert(1             ==1 );
  assert(2              ==2 );
  assert(4              ==4 );
  assert(5              ==5 );
  assert( aRes[1            ]==1                    );
  assert( aRes[2             ]==2                     );
  assert( aRes[4             ]==3                           );
  assert( aRes[5             ]==4                     );

  if( p->rc!=0         && p->rc!=101         ){
    return 5                     ;
  }else{
    assert( p->rc!=101         || p->eStage==5              );
    assert( p->eStage==1
         || p->eStage==2
         || p->eStage==4
         || p->eStage==5
    );
    return aRes[p->eStage];
  }
}

           int sqlite3rbu_savestate(sqlite3rbu *p){
  int rc = p->rc;
  if( rc==101         ) return 0        ;

  assert( p->eStage>=1             && p->eStage<=5              );
  if( p->eStage==1             ){
    assert( rc!=101         );
    if( rc==0         ) rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"COMMIT",0,0,0);
  }


  if( rc==0         && p->eStage==4              ){
    sqlite3_file *pDb = p->pTargetFd->pReal;
    rc = pDb->pMethods->xSync(pDb,0x00002            );
  }

  p->rc = rc;
  rbuSaveState(p, p->eStage);
  rc = p->rc;

  if( p->eStage==1             ){
    assert( rc!=101         );
    if( rc==0         ) rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,"COMMIT",0,0,0);
    if( rc==0         ){
      const char *zBegin =((p)->zTarget==0)?"BEGIN" : "BEGIN IMMEDIATE";
      rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbRbu,zBegin,0,0,0);
    }
    if( rc==0         ) rc =sqlite3_api->exec(p->dbMain,"BEGIN IMMEDIATE",0,0,0);
  }

  p->rc = rc;
  return rc;
}




static int xDefaultRename(void *pArg, const char *zOld, const char *zNew){
  int rc =0         ;

  {
    LPWSTR zWideOld;
    LPWSTR zWideNew;

    zWideOld = rbuWinUtf8ToUnicode(zOld);
    if( zWideOld ){
      zWideNew = rbuWinUtf8ToUnicode(zNew);
      if( zWideNew ){
        if( MoveFileW(zWideOld, zWideNew) ){
          rc =0         ;
        }else{
          rc =10           ;
        }
sqlite3_api->free   (zWideNew);
      }else{
        rc =(10 | (12<<8))     ;
      }
sqlite3_api->free (zWideOld);
    }else{
      rc =(10 | (12<<8))     ;
    }
  }

  rc = rename(zOld, zNew) ?10            :0         ;

  return rc;
}

           void sqlite3rbu_rename_handler(
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu,
  void *pArg,
  int (*xRename)(void *pArg, const char *zOld, const char *zNew)
){
  if( xRename ){
    pRbu->xRename = xRename;
    pRbu->pRenameArg = pArg;
  }else{
    pRbu->xRename = xDefaultRename;
    pRbu->pRenameArg = 0;
  }
}




























































static void rbuUnlockShm(rbu_file *p){
  assert( p->openFlags &0x00000100           );
  if( p->pRbu ){
    int (*xShmLock)(sqlite3_file*,int,int,int) = p->pReal->pMethods->xShmLock;
    int i;
    for(i=0; i<8               ;i++){
      if( (1<<i) & p->pRbu->mLock ){
        xShmLock(p->pReal, i, 1,1                 |8                   );
      }
    }
    p->pRbu->mLock = 0;
  }
}



static int rbuUpdateTempSize(rbu_file *pFd, sqlite3_int64 nNew){
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu = pFd->pRbu;
  i64 nDiff = nNew - pFd->sz;
  pRbu->szTemp += nDiff;
  pFd->sz = nNew;
  assert( pRbu->szTemp>=0 );
  if( pRbu->szTempLimit && pRbu->szTemp>pRbu->szTempLimit ) return 13         ;
  return 0        ;
}









static void rbuMainlistAdd(rbu_file *p){
  rbu_vfs *pRbuVfs = p->pRbuVfs;
  rbu_file *pIter;
  assert( (p->openFlags &0x00000100          ) );
                                     ;
  if( p->pRbu==0 ){
    for(pIter=pRbuVfs->pMain; pIter; pIter=pIter->pMainNext);
    p->pMainNext = pRbuVfs->pMain;
    pRbuVfs->pMain = p;
  }else{
    for(pIter=pRbuVfs->pMainRbu; pIter && pIter!=p; pIter=pIter->pMainRbuNext){}
    if( pIter==0 ){
      p->pMainRbuNext = pRbuVfs->pMainRbu;
      pRbuVfs->pMainRbu = p;
    }
  }
                                     ;
}




static void rbuMainlistRemove(rbu_file *p){
  rbu_file **pp;
                                        ;
  for(pp=&p->pRbuVfs->pMain; *pp && *pp!=p; pp=&((*pp)->pMainNext)){}
  if( *pp ) *pp = p->pMainNext;
  p->pMainNext = 0;
  for(pp=&p->pRbuVfs->pMainRbu; *pp && *pp!=p; pp=&((*pp)->pMainRbuNext)){}
  if( *pp ) *pp = p->pMainRbuNext;
  p->pMainRbuNext = 0;
                                        ;
}










static rbu_file *rbuFindMaindb(rbu_vfs *pRbuVfs, const char *zWal, int bRbu){
  rbu_file *pDb;
                                     ;
  if( bRbu ){
    for(pDb=pRbuVfs->pMainRbu; pDb && pDb->zWal!=zWal; pDb=pDb->pMainRbuNext){}
  }else{
    for(pDb=pRbuVfs->pMain; pDb && pDb->zWal!=zWal; pDb=pDb->pMainNext){}
  }
                                     ;
  return pDb;
}




static int rbuVfsClose(sqlite3_file *pFile){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  int rc;
  int i;


  for(i=0; i<p->nShm; i++){
sqlite3_api->free(p->apShm[i]);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(p->apShm);
  p->apShm = 0;
sqlite3_api->free(p->zDel);

  if( p->openFlags &0x00000100           ){
    const sqlite3_io_methods *pMeth = p->pReal->pMethods;
    rbuMainlistRemove(p);
    rbuUnlockShm(p);
    if( pMeth->iVersion>1 && pMeth->xShmUnmap ){
      pMeth->xShmUnmap(p->pReal, 0);
    }
  }
  else if( (p->openFlags &0x00000008                ) && p->pRbu ){
    rbuUpdateTempSize(p, 0);
  }
  assert( p->pMainNext==0 && p->pRbuVfs->pMain!=p );


  rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xClose(p->pReal);
  return rc;
}






static u32 rbuGetU32(u8 *aBuf){
  return ((u32)aBuf[0] << 24)
       + ((u32)aBuf[1] << 16)
       + ((u32)aBuf[2] <<  8)
       + ((u32)aBuf[3]);
}





static void rbuPutU32(u8 *aBuf, u32 iVal){
  aBuf[0] = (iVal >> 24) & 0xFF;
  aBuf[1] = (iVal >> 16) & 0xFF;
  aBuf[2] = (iVal >>  8) & 0xFF;
  aBuf[3] = (iVal >>  0) & 0xFF;
}

static void rbuPutU16(u8 *aBuf, u16 iVal){
  aBuf[0] = (iVal >>  8) & 0xFF;
  aBuf[1] = (iVal >>  0) & 0xFF;
}




static int rbuVfsRead(
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  void *zBuf,
  int iAmt,
  sqlite_int64 iOfst
){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu = p->pRbu;
  int rc;

  if( pRbu && pRbu->eStage==3                 ){
    assert( p->openFlags &0x00080000       );
    rc = rbuCaptureWalRead(p->pRbu, iOfst, iAmt);
  }else{
    if( pRbu && pRbu->eStage==1
     && (p->openFlags &0x00080000      )
     && iOfst>=pRbu->iOalSz
    ){
      rc =0         ;
      memset(zBuf, 0, iAmt);
    }else{
      rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xRead(p->pReal, zBuf, iAmt, iOfst);





      if( pRbu &&((pRbu)->zTarget==0)
          && rc==(10 | (2<<8))           && iOfst==0
          && (p->openFlags &0x00000100          )
          && pRbu->rc==0
      ){
        sqlite3_file *pFd = (sqlite3_file*)pRbu->pRbuFd;
        rc = pFd->pMethods->xRead(pFd, zBuf, iAmt, iOfst);
        if( rc==0         ){
          u8 *aBuf = (u8*)zBuf;
          u32 iRoot = rbuGetU32(&aBuf[52]) ? 1 : 0;
          rbuPutU32(&aBuf[52], iRoot);
          rbuPutU32(&aBuf[36], 0);
          rbuPutU32(&aBuf[32], 0);
          rbuPutU32(&aBuf[28], 1);
          rbuPutU32(&aBuf[24], pRbu->pRbuFd->iCookie+1);

          if( iAmt>100 ){
            memset(&aBuf[100], 0, iAmt-100);
            rbuPutU16(&aBuf[105], iAmt & 0xFFFF);
            aBuf[100] = 0x0D;
          }
        }
      }

    }
    if( rc==0         && iOfst==0 && (p->openFlags &0x00000100          ) ){


      u8 *pBuf = (u8*)zBuf;
      p->iCookie = rbuGetU32(&pBuf[24]);
      p->iWriteVer = pBuf[19];
    }
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsWrite(
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  const void *zBuf,
  int iAmt,
  sqlite_int64 iOfst
){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu = p->pRbu;
  int rc;

  if( pRbu && pRbu->eStage==3                 ){
    assert( p->openFlags &0x00000100           );
    rc = rbuCaptureDbWrite(p->pRbu, iOfst);
  }else{
    if( pRbu ){
      if( pRbu->eStage==1
       && (p->openFlags &0x00080000      )
       && iOfst>=pRbu->iOalSz
      ){
        pRbu->iOalSz = iAmt + iOfst;
      }else if( p->openFlags &0x00000008                 ){
        i64 szNew = iAmt+iOfst;
        if( szNew>p->sz ){
          rc = rbuUpdateTempSize(p, szNew);
          if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
        }
      }
    }
    rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xWrite(p->pReal, zBuf, iAmt, iOfst);
    if( rc==0         && iOfst==0 && (p->openFlags &0x00000100          ) ){


      u8 *pBuf = (u8*)zBuf;
      p->iCookie = rbuGetU32(&pBuf[24]);
      p->iWriteVer = pBuf[19];
    }
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsTruncate(sqlite3_file *pFile, sqlite_int64 size){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  if( (p->openFlags &0x00000008                ) && p->pRbu ){
    int rc = rbuUpdateTempSize(p, size);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
  }
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xTruncate(p->pReal, size);
}




static int rbuVfsSync(sqlite3_file *pFile, int flags){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  if( p->pRbu && p->pRbu->eStage==3                 ){
    if( p->openFlags &0x00000100           ){
      return(27 | (3<<8))     ;
    }
    return 0        ;
  }
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xSync(p->pReal, flags);
}




static int rbuVfsFileSize(sqlite3_file *pFile, sqlite_int64 *pSize){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  int rc;
  rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xFileSize(p->pReal, pSize);





  if( rc==0         && *pSize==0
   && p->pRbu &&((p->pRbu)->zTarget==0)
   && (p->openFlags &0x00000100          )
  ){
    *pSize = 1024;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsLock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int eLock){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu = p->pRbu;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( p->openFlags & (0x00000100         |0x00000200         ) );
  if( eLock==4
   && (p->bNolock || (pRbu && pRbu->eStage!=5             ))
  ){


    rc =5           ;
  }else{
    rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xLock(p->pReal, eLock);
  }

  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsUnlock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int eLock){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xUnlock(p->pReal, eLock);
}




static int rbuVfsCheckReservedLock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int *pResOut){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xCheckReservedLock(p->pReal, pResOut);
}




static int rbuVfsFileControl(sqlite3_file *pFile, int op, void *pArg){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  int (*xControl)(sqlite3_file*,int,void*) = p->pReal->pMethods->xFileControl;
  int rc;

  assert( p->openFlags & (0x00000100         |0x00000200         )
       || p->openFlags & (0x00000400              |0x00001000              )
  );
  if( op==26               ){
    sqlite3rbu *pRbu = (sqlite3rbu*)pArg;




    rc = xControl(p->pReal, op, pArg);

    if( rc==12              ){


      void *dummy = 0;
      rc = xControl(p->pReal,25                  , &dummy);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc =1            ;
        pRbu->zErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("rbu/zipvfs setup error");
      }else if( rc==12              ){
        pRbu->pTargetFd = p;
        p->pRbu = pRbu;
        rbuMainlistAdd(p);
        if( p->pWalFd ) p->pWalFd->pRbu = pRbu;
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
    return rc;
  }
  else if( op==5149216             ){
    sqlite3rbu *pRbu = (sqlite3rbu*)pArg;
    pRbu->nRbu++;
    pRbu->pRbuFd = p;
    p->bNolock = 1;
  }

  rc = xControl(p->pReal, op, pArg);
  if( rc==0         && op==12                   ){
    rbu_vfs *pRbuVfs = p->pRbuVfs;
    char *zIn = *(char**)pArg;
    char *zOut =sqlite3_api->mprintf("rbu(%s)/%z",pRbuVfs->base.zName,zIn);
    *(char**)pArg = zOut;
    if( zOut==0 ) rc =7            ;
  }

  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsSectorSize(sqlite3_file *pFile){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xSectorSize(p->pReal);
}




static int rbuVfsDeviceCharacteristics(sqlite3_file *pFile){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  return p->pReal->pMethods->xDeviceCharacteristics(p->pReal);
}




static int rbuVfsShmLock(sqlite3_file *pFile, int ofst, int n, int flags){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  sqlite3rbu *pRbu = p->pRbu;
  int rc =0         ;


    assert(1             ==1 );


  assert( p->openFlags & (0x00000100         |0x00000200         ) );
  if( pRbu && (
       pRbu->eStage==1
    || pRbu->eStage==2
    || pRbu->eStage==5
  )){



    if( ofst==1             && n==1 ) rc =5           ;
  }else{
    int bCapture = 0;
    if( pRbu && pRbu->eStage==3                 ){
      bCapture = 1;
    }
    if( bCapture==0 || 0==(flags &1                 ) ){
      rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xShmLock(p->pReal, ofst, n, flags);
      if( bCapture && rc==0         ){
        pRbu->mLock |= ((1<<n) - 1) << ofst;
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsShmMap(
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  int iRegion,
  int szRegion,
  int isWrite,
  void volatile **pp
){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  int rc =0         ;
  int eStage = (p->pRbu ? p->pRbu->eStage : 0);




  assert( p->openFlags & (0x00000100         |0x00000200         ) );
  if( eStage==1             ){
    sqlite3_int64 nByte = (iRegion+1) * sizeof(char*);
    char **apNew = (char**)sqlite3_api->realloc64(p->apShm,nByte);





    assert( iRegion==p->nShm );
    if( apNew==0 ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      memset(&apNew[p->nShm], 0, sizeof(char*) * (1 + iRegion - p->nShm));
      p->apShm = apNew;
      p->nShm = iRegion+1;
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      char *pNew = (char*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(szRegion);
      if( pNew==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        memset(pNew, 0, szRegion);
        p->apShm[iRegion] = pNew;
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      *pp = p->apShm[iRegion];
    }else{
      *pp = 0;
    }
  }else{
    assert( p->apShm==0 );
    rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xShmMap(p->pReal, iRegion, szRegion, isWrite, pp);
  }

  return rc;
}




static void rbuVfsShmBarrier(sqlite3_file *pFile){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  p->pReal->pMethods->xShmBarrier(p->pReal);
}




static int rbuVfsShmUnmap(sqlite3_file *pFile, int delFlag){
  rbu_file *p = (rbu_file*)pFile;
  int rc =0         ;
  int eStage = (p->pRbu ? p->pRbu->eStage : 0);

  assert( p->openFlags & (0x00000100         |0x00000200         ) );
  if( eStage==1             || eStage==2              ){

  }else{

    rbuUnlockShm(p);
    rc = p->pReal->pMethods->xShmUnmap(p->pReal, delFlag);
  }
  return rc;
}




static int rbuVfsOpen(
  sqlite3_vfs *pVfs,
  const char *zName,
  sqlite3_file *pFile,
  int flags,
  int *pOutFlags
){
  static sqlite3_io_methods rbuvfs_io_methods = {
    2,
    rbuVfsClose,
    rbuVfsRead,
    rbuVfsWrite,
    rbuVfsTruncate,
    rbuVfsSync,
    rbuVfsFileSize,
    rbuVfsLock,
    rbuVfsUnlock,
    rbuVfsCheckReservedLock,
    rbuVfsFileControl,
    rbuVfsSectorSize,
    rbuVfsDeviceCharacteristics,
    rbuVfsShmMap,
    rbuVfsShmLock,
    rbuVfsShmBarrier,
    rbuVfsShmUnmap,
    0, 0
  };
  static sqlite3_io_methods rbuvfs_io_methods1 = {
    1,
    rbuVfsClose,
    rbuVfsRead,
    rbuVfsWrite,
    rbuVfsTruncate,
    rbuVfsSync,
    rbuVfsFileSize,
    rbuVfsLock,
    rbuVfsUnlock,
    rbuVfsCheckReservedLock,
    rbuVfsFileControl,
    rbuVfsSectorSize,
    rbuVfsDeviceCharacteristics,
    0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  };



  rbu_vfs *pRbuVfs = (rbu_vfs*)pVfs;
  sqlite3_vfs *pRealVfs = pRbuVfs->pRealVfs;
  rbu_file *pFd = (rbu_file *)pFile;
  int rc =0         ;
  const char *zOpen = zName;
  int oflags = flags;

  memset(pFd, 0, sizeof(rbu_file));
  pFd->pReal = (sqlite3_file*)&pFd[1];
  pFd->pRbuVfs = pRbuVfs;
  pFd->openFlags = flags;
  if( zName ){
    if( flags &0x00000100           ){





      pFd->zWal =sqlite3_api->filename_wal(zName);
    }
    else if( flags &0x00080000       ){
      rbu_file *pDb = rbuFindMaindb(pRbuVfs, zName, 0);
      if( pDb ){
        if( pDb->pRbu && pDb->pRbu->eStage==1             ){

          size_t nOpen;
          if(((pDb->pRbu)->zTarget==0)){
            zOpen =sqlite3_api->db_filename(pDb->pRbu->dbRbu,"main");
            zOpen =sqlite3_api->filename_wal(zOpen);
          }
          nOpen = strlen(zOpen);
          ((char*)zOpen)[nOpen-3] = 'o';
          pFd->pRbu = pDb->pRbu;
        }
        pDb->pWalFd = pFd;
      }
    }
  }else{
    pFd->pRbu = pRbuVfs->pRbu;
  }

  if( oflags &0x00000100
   &&sqlite3_api->uri_boolean(zName,"rbu_memory",0)
  ){
    assert( oflags &0x00000100           );
    oflags =0x00000200            |0x00000002             |0x00000004          |
0x00000010                          |0x00000008                ;
    zOpen = 0;
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = pRealVfs->xOpen(pRealVfs, zOpen, pFd->pReal, oflags, pOutFlags);
  }
  if( pFd->pReal->pMethods ){
    const sqlite3_io_methods *pMeth = pFd->pReal->pMethods;



    if( pMeth->iVersion<2 || pMeth->xShmLock==0 ){
      pFile->pMethods = &rbuvfs_io_methods1;
    }else{
      pFile->pMethods = &rbuvfs_io_methods;
    }
    if( flags &0x00000100           ){
      rbuMainlistAdd(pFd);
    }
  }else{
sqlite3_api->free(pFd->zDel);
  }

  return rc;
}

  rc = pRealVfs->xAccess(pRealVfs, zPath, flags, pResOut);















  if( rc==0         && flags==0                    ){
    rbu_file *pDb = rbuFindMaindb(pRbuVfs, zPath, 1);
    if( pDb && pDb->pRbu->eStage==1             ){
      assert( pDb->pRbu );
      if( *pResOut ){
        rc =14              ;
      }else{
        sqlite3_int64 sz = 0;
        rc = rbuVfsFileSize(&pDb->base, &sz);
        *pResOut = (sz>0);
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}

           int sqlite3rbu_create_vfs(const char *zName, const char *zParent){

  rbu_vfs *pNew = 0;

  nName = strlen(zName);
  nByte = sizeof(rbu_vfs) + nName + 1;
  pNew = (rbu_vfs*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( pNew==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    sqlite3_vfs *pParent;
    memset(pNew, 0, nByte);
    pParent =sqlite3_api->vfs_find(zParent);
    if( pParent==0 ){
      rc =12              ;
    }else{
      char *zSpace;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&pNew->base);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&vfs_template); int xxn=(sizeof(sqlite3_vfs));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pNew->base.mxPathname = pParent->mxPathname;
      pNew->base.szOsFile = sizeof(rbu_file) + pParent->szOsFile;
      pNew->pRealVfs = pParent;
      pNew->base.zName = (const char*)(zSpace = (char*)&pNew[1]);
{char*xxd=(char*)(zSpace);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zName); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};


      pNew->mutex =((sqlite3_mutex*)8)                         ;

                                     ;
