  return sessionChangesetStart(pp, xInput, pIn, 0, 0, bInvert, 0);
}





static void sessionDiscardData(SessionInput *pIn){
  if( pIn->xInput && pIn->iNext>=sessions_strm_chunk_size ){
    int nMove = pIn->buf.nBuf - pIn->iNext;
    assert( nMove>=0 );
    if( nMove>0 ){
      memmove(pIn->buf.aBuf, &pIn->buf.aBuf[pIn->iNext], nMove);
    }
    pIn->buf.nBuf -= pIn->iNext;
    pIn->iNext = 0;
    pIn->nData = pIn->buf.nBuf;
  }
}








static int sessionInputBuffer(SessionInput *pIn, int nByte){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pIn->xInput ){
    while( !pIn->bEof && (pIn->iNext+nByte)>=pIn->nData && rc==0         ){
      int nNew = sessions_strm_chunk_size;

      if( pIn->bNoDiscard==0 ) sessionDiscardData(pIn);
      if(0         ==sessionBufferGrow(&pIn->buf, nNew, &rc) ){
        rc = pIn->xInput(pIn->pIn, &pIn->buf.aBuf[pIn->buf.nBuf], &nNew);
        if( nNew==0 ){
          pIn->bEof = 1;
        }else{
          pIn->buf.nBuf += nNew;
        }
      }

      pIn->aData = pIn->buf.aBuf;
      pIn->nData = pIn->buf.nBuf;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}






static void sessionSkipRecord(
  u8 **ppRec,
  int nCol
){
  u8 *aRec = *ppRec;
  int i;
  for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
    int eType = *aRec++;
    if( eType==3           || eType==4           ){
      int nByte;
      aRec += sessionVarintGet((u8*)aRec, &nByte);
      aRec += nByte;
    }else if( eType==1              || eType==2            ){
      aRec += 8;
    }
  }

  *ppRec = aRec;
}







static int sessionValueSetStr(
  sqlite3_value *pVal,
  u8 *aData,
  int nData,
  u8 enc
){




  u8 *aCopy =sqlite3_api->malloc64((sqlite3_int64)nData+1);
  if( aCopy==0 ) return 7           ;
{char*xxd=(char*)(aCopy);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aData); int xxn=(nData);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
  sqlite3ValueSetStr(pVal, nData, (char*)aCopy, enc,sqlite3_api->free);
  return 0        ;
}

























static int sessionReadRecord(
  SessionInput *pIn,
  int nCol,
  u8 *abPK,
  sqlite3_value **apOut,
  int *pbEmpty
){
  int i;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( pbEmpty==0 || *pbEmpty==0 );
  if( pbEmpty ) *pbEmpty = 1;
  for(i=0; i<nCol && rc==0        ; i++){
    int eType = 0;
    if( abPK && abPK[i]==0 ) continue;
    rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, 9);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( pIn->iNext>=pIn->nData ){
        rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
      }else{
        eType = pIn->aData[pIn->iNext++];
        assert( apOut[i]==0 );
        if( eType ){
          if( pbEmpty ) *pbEmpty = 0;
          apOut[i] = sqlite3ValueNew(0);
          if( !apOut[i] ) rc =7            ;
        }
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      u8 *aVal = &pIn->aData[pIn->iNext];
      if( eType==3           || eType==4           ){
        int nByte;
        pIn->iNext += sessionVarintGet(aVal, &nByte);
        rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, nByte);
        if( rc==0         ){
          if( nByte<0 || nByte>pIn->nData-pIn->iNext ){
            rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
          }else{
            u8 enc = (eType==3           ?1            : 0);
            rc = sessionValueSetStr(apOut[i],&pIn->aData[pIn->iNext],nByte,enc);
            pIn->iNext += nByte;
          }
        }
      }
      if( eType==1              || eType==2            ){
        sqlite3_int64 v = sessionGetI64(aVal);
        if( eType==1              ){
          sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64(apOut[i], v);
        }else{
sqlite_int64     d;
{char*xxd=(char*)(&d);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&v); int xxn=(8);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
sqlite3VdbeMemSetInt64           (apOut[i], d);
        }
        pIn->iNext += 8;
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}














static int sessionChangesetBufferTblhdr(SessionInput *pIn, int *pnByte){
  int rc =0         ;
  int nCol = 0;
  int nRead = 0;

  rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, 9);
  if( rc==0         ){
    nRead += sessionVarintGet(&pIn->aData[pIn->iNext + nRead], &nCol);







    if( nCol<0 || nCol>65536 ){
      rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
    }else{
      rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, nRead+nCol+100);
      nRead += nCol;
    }
  }

  while( rc==0         ){
    while( (pIn->iNext + nRead)<pIn->nData && pIn->aData[pIn->iNext + nRead] ){
      nRead++;
    }
    if( (pIn->iNext + nRead)<pIn->nData ) break;
    rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, nRead + 100);
  }
  *pnByte = nRead+1;
  return rc;
}










static int sessionChangesetBufferRecord(
  SessionInput *pIn,
  int nCol,
  int *pnByte
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int nByte = 0;
  int i;
  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nCol; i++){
    int eType;
    rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, nByte + 10);
    if( rc==0         ){
      eType = pIn->aData[pIn->iNext + nByte++];
      if( eType==3           || eType==4           ){
        int n;
        nByte += sessionVarintGet(&pIn->aData[pIn->iNext+nByte], &n);
        nByte += n;
        rc = sessionInputBuffer(pIn, nByte);
      }else if( eType==1              || eType==2            ){
        nByte += 8;
      }
    }
  }
  *pnByte = nByte;
  return rc;
}


















static int sessionChangesetReadTblhdr(sqlite3_changeset_iter *p){
  int rc;
  int nCopy;
  assert( p->rc==0         );

  rc = sessionChangesetBufferTblhdr(&p->in, &nCopy);
  if( rc==0         ){
    int nByte;
    int nVarint;
    nVarint = sessionVarintGet(&p->in.aData[p->in.iNext], &p->nCol);
    if( p->nCol>0 ){
      nCopy -= nVarint;
      p->in.iNext += nVarint;
      nByte = p->nCol * sizeof(sqlite3_value*) * 2 + nCopy;
      p->tblhdr.nBuf = 0;
      sessionBufferGrow(&p->tblhdr, nByte, &rc);
    }else{
      rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    size_t iPK = sizeof(sqlite3_value*)*p->nCol*2;
    memset(p->tblhdr.aBuf, 0, iPK);
{char*xxd=(char*)(&p->tblhdr.aBuf[iPK]);const char*xxs=(const char*)(&p->in.aData[p->in.iNext]); int xxn=(nCopy);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    p->in.iNext += nCopy;
  }

  p->apValue = (sqlite3_value**)p->tblhdr.aBuf;
  if( p->apValue==0 ){
    p->abPK = 0;
    p->zTab = 0;
  }else{
    p->abPK = (u8*)&p->apValue[p->nCol*2];
    p->zTab = p->abPK ? (char*)&p->abPK[p->nCol] : 0;
  }
  return (p->rc = rc);
}











static int sessionChangesetNextOne(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *p,
  u8 **paRec,
  int *pnRec,
  int *pbNew,
  int *pbEmpty
){
  int i;
  u8 op;

  assert( (paRec==0 && pnRec==0) || (paRec && pnRec) );
  assert( pbEmpty==0 || *pbEmpty==0 );


  if( p->rc!=0         ) return p->rc;


  if( p->apValue ){
    for(i=0; i<p->nCol*2; i++){
      sqlite3ValueFree(p->apValue[i]);
    }
    memset(p->apValue, 0, sizeof(sqlite3_value*)*p->nCol*2);
  }





  p->rc = sessionInputBuffer(&p->in, 2);
  if( p->rc!=0         ) return p->rc;


  if( p->in.iNext>=p->in.nData ){
    return 101        ;
  }

  sessionDiscardData(&p->in);
  p->in.iCurrent = p->in.iNext;

  op = p->in.aData[p->in.iNext++];
  while( op=='T' || op=='P' ){
    if( pbNew ) *pbNew = 1;
    p->bPatchset = (op=='P');
    if( sessionChangesetReadTblhdr(p) ) return p->rc;
    if( (p->rc = sessionInputBuffer(&p->in, 2)) ) return p->rc;
    p->in.iCurrent = p->in.iNext;
    if( p->in.iNext>=p->in.nData ) return 101        ;
    op = p->in.aData[p->in.iNext++];
  }

  if( p->zTab==0 || (p->bPatchset && p->bInvert) ){


    assert( p->in.iNext==1 || p->zTab );
    return (p->rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__));
  }

  p->op = op;
  p->bIndirect = p->in.aData[p->in.iNext++];
  if( p->op!=23            && p->op!=9             && p->op!=18            ){
    return (p->rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__));
  }

  if( paRec ){
    int nVal;
    if( p->bPatchset==0 && op==23            ){
      nVal = p->nCol * 2;
    }else if( p->bPatchset && op==9             ){
      nVal = 0;
      for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++) if( p->abPK[i] ) nVal++;
    }else{
      nVal = p->nCol;
    }
    p->rc = sessionChangesetBufferRecord(&p->in, nVal, pnRec);
    if( p->rc!=0         ) return p->rc;
    *paRec = &p->in.aData[p->in.iNext];
    p->in.iNext += *pnRec;
  }else{
    sqlite3_value **apOld = (p->bInvert ? &p->apValue[p->nCol] : p->apValue);
    sqlite3_value **apNew = (p->bInvert ? p->apValue : &p->apValue[p->nCol]);


    if( p->op!=18            && (p->bPatchset==0 || p->op==9            ) ){
      u8 *abPK = p->bPatchset ? p->abPK : 0;
      p->rc = sessionReadRecord(&p->in, p->nCol, abPK, apOld, 0);
      if( p->rc!=0         ) return p->rc;
    }


    if( p->op!=9             ){
      p->rc = sessionReadRecord(&p->in, p->nCol, 0, apNew, pbEmpty);
      if( p->rc!=0         ) return p->rc;
    }

    if( (p->bPatchset || p->bInvert) && p->op==23            ){




      for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
        assert( p->bPatchset==0 || p->apValue[i]==0 );
        if( p->abPK[i] ){
          assert( p->apValue[i]==0 );
          p->apValue[i] = p->apValue[i+p->nCol];
          if( p->apValue[i]==0 ) return (p->rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__));
          p->apValue[i+p->nCol] = 0;
        }
      }
    }else if( p->bInvert ){
      if( p->op==18            ) p->op =9             ;
      else if( p->op==9             ) p->op =18            ;
    }








    if( p->bPatchset==0 && p->op==23           ){
      for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
        if( p->abPK[i]==0 && p->apValue[i+p->nCol]==0 ){
          sqlite3ValueFree(p->apValue[i]);
          p->apValue[i] = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return 100       ;
}

















static int sessionChangesetNext(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *p,
  u8 **paRec,
  int *pnRec,
  int *pbNew
){
  int bEmpty;
  int rc;
  do {
    bEmpty = 0;
    rc = sessionChangesetNextOne(p, paRec, pnRec, pbNew, &bEmpty);
  }while( rc==100        && p->bSkipEmpty && bEmpty);
  return rc;
}









           int sqlite3changeset_next(sqlite3_changeset_iter *p){
  return sessionChangesetNext(p, 0, 0, 0);
}






           int sqlite3changeset_op(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  const char **pzTab,
  int *pnCol,
  int *pOp,
  int *pbIndirect
){
  *pOp = pIter->op;
  *pnCol = pIter->nCol;
  *pzTab = pIter->zTab;
  if( pbIndirect ) *pbIndirect = pIter->bIndirect;
  return 0        ;
}







           int sqlite3changeset_pk(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  unsigned char **pabPK,
  int *pnCol
){
  *pabPK = pIter->abPK;
  if( pnCol ) *pnCol = pIter->nCol;
  return 0        ;
}














           int sqlite3changeset_old(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int iVal,
  sqlite3_value **ppValue
){
  if( pIter->op!=23            && pIter->op!=9             ){
    return 21           ;
  }
  if( iVal<0 || iVal>=pIter->nCol ){
    return 25          ;
  }
  *ppValue = pIter->apValue[iVal];
  return 0        ;
}














           int sqlite3changeset_new(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int iVal,
  sqlite3_value **ppValue
){
  if( pIter->op!=23            && pIter->op!=18            ){
    return 21           ;
  }
  if( iVal<0 || iVal>=pIter->nCol ){
    return 25          ;
  }
  *ppValue = pIter->apValue[pIter->nCol+iVal];
  return 0        ;
}




















           int sqlite3changeset_conflict(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int iVal,
  sqlite3_value **ppValue
){
  if( !pIter->pConflict ){
    return 21           ;
  }
  if( iVal<0 || iVal>=pIter->nCol ){
    return 25          ;
  }
  *ppValue =sqlite3_api->column_value(pIter->pConflict,iVal);
  return 0        ;
}









           int sqlite3changeset_fk_conflicts(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int *pnOut
){
  if( pIter->pConflict || pIter->apValue ){
    return 21           ;
  }
  *pnOut = pIter->nCol;
  return 0        ;
}








           int sqlite3changeset_finalize(sqlite3_changeset_iter *p){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( p ){
    int i;
    rc = p->rc;
    if( p->apValue ){
      for(i=0; i<p->nCol*2; i++) sqlite3ValueFree(p->apValue[i]);
    }
sqlite3_api->free(p->tblhdr.aBuf);
sqlite3_api->free(p->in.buf.aBuf);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
  return rc;
}

static int sessionChangesetInvert(
  SessionInput *pInput,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut,
  int *pnInverted,
  void **ppInverted
){
  int rc =0         ;
  SessionBuffer sOut;
  int nCol = 0;
  u8 *abPK = 0;
  sqlite3_value **apVal = 0;
  SessionBuffer sPK = {0, 0, 0};


  memset(&sOut, 0, sizeof(SessionBuffer));


  if( ppInverted ){
    *ppInverted = 0;
    *pnInverted = 0;
  }

  while( 1 ){
    u8 eType;


    if( (rc = sessionInputBuffer(pInput, 2)) ) goto finished_invert;
    if( pInput->iNext>=pInput->nData ) break;
    eType = pInput->aData[pInput->iNext];

    switch( eType ){
      case 'T': {







        int nByte;
        int nVar;
        pInput->iNext++;
        if( (rc = sessionChangesetBufferTblhdr(pInput, &nByte)) ){
          goto finished_invert;
        }
        nVar = sessionVarintGet(&pInput->aData[pInput->iNext], &nCol);
        sPK.nBuf = 0;
        sessionAppendBlob(&sPK, &pInput->aData[pInput->iNext+nVar], nCol, &rc);
        sessionAppendByte(&sOut, eType, &rc);
        sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, &pInput->aData[pInput->iNext], nByte, &rc);
        if( rc ) goto finished_invert;

        pInput->iNext += nByte;
sqlite3_api->free   (apVal);
        apVal = 0;
        abPK = sPK.aBuf;
        break;
      }

      case 18           :
      case 9            : {
        int nByte;
        int bIndirect = pInput->aData[pInput->iNext+1];
        int eType2 = (eType==9             ?18             :9             );
        pInput->iNext += 2;
        assert( rc==0         );
        rc = sessionChangesetBufferRecord(pInput, nCol, &nByte);
        sessionAppendByte(&sOut, eType2, &rc);
        sessionAppendByte(&sOut, bIndirect, &rc);
        sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, &pInput->aData[pInput->iNext], nByte, &rc);
        pInput->iNext += nByte;
        if( rc ) goto finished_invert;
        break;
      }

      case 23           : {
        int iCol;

        if( 0==apVal ){
          apVal = (sqlite3_value **)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(apVal[0])*nCol*2);
          if( 0==apVal ){
            rc =7            ;
            goto finished_invert;
          }
          memset(apVal, 0, sizeof(apVal[0])*nCol*2);
        }


        sessionAppendByte(&sOut, eType, &rc);
        sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pInput->aData[pInput->iNext+1], &rc);


        pInput->iNext += 2;
        rc = sessionReadRecord(pInput, nCol, 0, &apVal[0], 0);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = sessionReadRecord(pInput, nCol, 0, &apVal[nCol], 0);
        }




        for(iCol=0; iCol<nCol; iCol++){
          sqlite3_value *pVal = apVal[iCol + (abPK[iCol] ? 0 : nCol)];
          sessionAppendValue(&sOut, pVal, &rc);
        }




        for(iCol=0; iCol<nCol; iCol++){
          sqlite3_value *pVal = (abPK[iCol] ? 0 : apVal[iCol]);
          sessionAppendValue(&sOut, pVal, &rc);
        }

        for(iCol=0; iCol<nCol*2; iCol++){
          sqlite3ValueFree(apVal[iCol]);
        }
        memset(apVal, 0, sizeof(apVal[0])*nCol*2);
        if( rc!=0         ){
          goto finished_invert;
        }

        break;
      }

      default:
        rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
        goto finished_invert;
    }

    assert( rc==0         );
    if( xOutput && sOut.nBuf>=sessions_strm_chunk_size ){
      rc = xOutput(pOut, sOut.aBuf, sOut.nBuf);
      sOut.nBuf = 0;
      if( rc!=0         ) goto finished_invert;
    }
  }

  assert( rc==0         );
  if( pnInverted &&(1)                 ){
    *pnInverted = sOut.nBuf;
    *ppInverted = sOut.aBuf;
    sOut.aBuf = 0;
  }else if( sOut.nBuf>0 &&(1)                 ){
    rc = xOutput(pOut, sOut.aBuf, sOut.nBuf);
  }

 finished_invert:
sqlite3_api->free(sOut.aBuf);
sqlite3_api->free(apVal);
sqlite3_api->free(sPK.aBuf);
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3changeset_invert(
  int nChangeset,
  const void *pChangeset,
  int *pnInverted,
  void **ppInverted
){
  SessionInput sInput;


  memset(&sInput, 0, sizeof(SessionInput));
  sInput.nData = nChangeset;
  sInput.aData = (u8*)pChangeset;

  return sessionChangesetInvert(&sInput, 0, 0, pnInverted, ppInverted);
}




           int sqlite3changeset_invert_strm(
  int (*xInput)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pIn,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut
){
  SessionInput sInput;
  int rc;


  memset(&sInput, 0, sizeof(SessionInput));
  sInput.xInput = xInput;
  sInput.pIn = pIn;

  rc = sessionChangesetInvert(&sInput, xOutput, pOut, 0, 0);
sqlite3_api->free(sInput.buf.aBuf);
  return rc;
}


typedef struct SessionUpdate SessionUpdate;
struct SessionUpdate {
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  u32 *aMask;
  SessionUpdate *pNext;
};

typedef struct SessionApplyCtx SessionApplyCtx;
struct SessionApplyCtx {
  sqlite3 *db;
  sqlite3_stmt *pDelete;
  sqlite3_stmt *pInsert;
  sqlite3_stmt *pSelect;
  int nCol;
  const char **azCol;
  u8 *abPK;
  u32 *aUpdateMask;
  SessionUpdate *pUp;
  int bStat1;
  int bDeferConstraints;
  int bInvertConstraints;
  SessionBuffer constraints;
  SessionBuffer rebase;
  u8 bRebaseStarted;
  u8 bRebase;
};










static int sessionUpdateFind(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  SessionApplyCtx *p,
  int bPatchset,
  sqlite3_stmt **ppStmt
){
  int rc =0         ;
  SessionUpdate *pUp = 0;
  int nCol = pIter->nCol;
  int nU32 = (pIter->nCol+33)/32;
  int ii;

  if( p->aUpdateMask==0 ){
    p->aUpdateMask =sqlite3_api->malloc(nU32*sizeof(u32));
    if( p->aUpdateMask==0 ){
      rc =7            ;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    memset(p->aUpdateMask, 0, nU32*sizeof(u32));
    rc =11             ;
    for(ii=0; ii<pIter->nCol; ii++){
      if((pIter)->apValue[(pIter)->nCol+(ii)]){
        p->aUpdateMask[ii/32] |= (1<<(ii%32));
        rc =0         ;
      }
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( bPatchset ) p->aUpdateMask[nCol/32] |= (1<<(nCol%32));

    if( p->pUp ){
      int nUp = 0;
      SessionUpdate **pp = &p->pUp;
      while( 1 ){
        nUp++;
        if( 0==memcmp(p->aUpdateMask, (*pp)->aMask, nU32*sizeof(u32)) ){
          pUp = *pp;
          *pp = pUp->pNext;
          pUp->pNext = p->pUp;
          p->pUp = pUp;
          break;
        }

        if( (*pp)->pNext ){
          pp = &(*pp)->pNext;
        }else{
          if( nUp>=12                      ){
sqlite3_api->finalize       ((*pp)->pStmt);
sqlite3_api->free       (*pp);
            *pp = 0;
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if( pUp==0 ){
      int nByte = sizeof(SessionUpdate) * nU32*sizeof(u32);
      int bStat1 = (sqlite3_api->stricmp(pIter->zTab,"sqlite_stat1")==0);
      pUp = (SessionUpdate*)sqlite3_api->malloc(nByte);
      if( pUp==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        const char *zSep = "";
        SessionBuffer buf;

        memset(&buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
        pUp->aMask = (u32*)&pUp[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pUp->aMask);const char*xxs=(const char*)(p->aUpdateMask); int xxn=(nU32*sizeof(u32));while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};

        sessionAppendStr(&buf, "UPDATE main.", &rc);
        sessionAppendIdent(&buf, pIter->zTab, &rc);
        sessionAppendStr(&buf, " SET ", &rc);


        for(ii=0; ii<pIter->nCol; ii++){
          if( p->abPK[ii]==0 &&(pIter)->apValue[(pIter)->nCol+(ii)]){
            sessionAppendStr(&buf, zSep, &rc);
            sessionAppendIdent(&buf, p->azCol[ii], &rc);
            sessionAppendStr(&buf, " = ?", &rc);
            sessionAppendInteger(&buf, ii*2 +1,&rc);
            zSep = ", ";
          }
        }


        zSep = "";
        sessionAppendStr(&buf, " WHERE ", &rc);
        for(ii=0; ii<pIter->nCol; ii++){
          if( p->abPK[ii] || (bPatchset==0 &&(pIter)->apValue[(ii)]         ) ){
            sessionAppendStr(&buf, zSep, &rc);
            if( bStat1 && ii==1 ){
              assert(sqlite3_api->stricmp(p->azCol[ii],"idx")==0);
              sessionAppendStr(&buf,
                  "idx IS CASE "
                  "WHEN length(?4)=0 AND typeof(?4)='blob' THEN NULL "
                  "ELSE ?4 END ", &rc
              );
            }else{
              sessionAppendIdent(&buf, p->azCol[ii], &rc);
              sessionAppendStr(&buf, " IS ?", &rc);
              sessionAppendInteger(&buf, ii*2 +2,&rc);
            }
            zSep = " AND ";
          }
        }

        if( rc==0         ){
          char *zSql = (char*)buf.aBuf;
          rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(p->db,zSql,buf.nBuf,&pUp->pStmt,0);
        }

        if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->free     (pUp);
          pUp = 0;
        }else{
          pUp->pNext = p->pUp;
          p->pUp = pUp;
        }
sqlite3_api->free   (buf.aBuf);
      }
    }
  }

  assert( (rc==0        )==(pUp!=0) );
  if( pUp ){
    *ppStmt = pUp->pStmt;
  }else{
    *ppStmt = 0;
  }
  return rc;
}




static void sessionUpdateFree(SessionApplyCtx *p){
  SessionUpdate *pUp;
  SessionUpdate *pNext;
  for(pUp=p->pUp; pUp; pUp=pNext){
    pNext = pUp->pNext;
sqlite3_api->finalize(pUp->pStmt);
sqlite3_api->free(pUp);
  }
  p->pUp = 0;
sqlite3_api->free(p->aUpdateMask);
  p->aUpdateMask = 0;
}


















static int sessionDeleteRow(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zTab,
  SessionApplyCtx *p
){
  int i;
  const char *zSep = "";
  int rc =0         ;
  SessionBuffer buf = {0, 0, 0};
  int nPk = 0;

  sessionAppendStr(&buf, "DELETE FROM main.", &rc);
  sessionAppendIdent(&buf, zTab, &rc);
  sessionAppendStr(&buf, " WHERE ", &rc);

  for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
    if( p->abPK[i] ){
      nPk++;
      sessionAppendStr(&buf, zSep, &rc);
      sessionAppendIdent(&buf, p->azCol[i], &rc);
      sessionAppendStr(&buf, " = ?", &rc);
      sessionAppendInteger(&buf, i+1, &rc);
      zSep = " AND ";
    }
  }

  if( nPk<p->nCol ){
    sessionAppendStr(&buf, " AND (?", &rc);
    sessionAppendInteger(&buf, p->nCol+1, &rc);
    sessionAppendStr(&buf, " OR ", &rc);

    zSep = "";
    for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
      if( !p->abPK[i] ){
        sessionAppendStr(&buf, zSep, &rc);
        sessionAppendIdent(&buf, p->azCol[i], &rc);
        sessionAppendStr(&buf, " IS ?", &rc);
        sessionAppendInteger(&buf, i+1, &rc);
        zSep = "AND ";
      }
    }
    sessionAppendStr(&buf, ")", &rc);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(db,(char*)buf.aBuf,buf.nBuf,&p->pDelete, 0);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(buf.aBuf);

  return rc;
}














static int sessionSelectRow(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zTab,
  SessionApplyCtx *p
){
  return sessionSelectStmt(
      db, "main", zTab, p->nCol, p->azCol, p->abPK, &p->pSelect);
}










static int sessionInsertRow(
  sqlite3 *db,
  const char *zTab,
  SessionApplyCtx *p
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int i;
  SessionBuffer buf = {0, 0, 0};

  sessionAppendStr(&buf, "INSERT INTO main.", &rc);
  sessionAppendIdent(&buf, zTab, &rc);
  sessionAppendStr(&buf, "(", &rc);
  for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
    if( i!=0 ) sessionAppendStr(&buf, ", ", &rc);
    sessionAppendIdent(&buf, p->azCol[i], &rc);
  }

  sessionAppendStr(&buf, ") VALUES(?", &rc);
  for(i=1; i<p->nCol; i++){
    sessionAppendStr(&buf, ", ?", &rc);
  }
  sessionAppendStr(&buf, ")", &rc);

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(db,(char*)buf.aBuf,buf.nBuf,&p->pInsert, 0);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(buf.aBuf);
  return rc;
}

static int sessionPrepare(sqlite3 *db, sqlite3_stmt **pp, const char *zSql){
  return sqlite3_api->prepare_v2(db,zSql,-1,pp,0);
}







static int sessionStat1Sql(sqlite3 *db, SessionApplyCtx *p){
  int rc = sessionSelectRow(db, "sqlite_stat1", p);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionPrepare(db, &p->pInsert,
        "INSERT INTO main.sqlite_stat1 VALUES(?1, "
        "CASE WHEN length(?2)=0 AND typeof(?2)='blob' THEN NULL ELSE ?2 END, "
        "?3)"
    );
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionPrepare(db, &p->pDelete,
        "DELETE FROM main.sqlite_stat1 WHERE tbl=?1 AND idx IS "
        "CASE WHEN length(?2)=0 AND typeof(?2)='blob' THEN NULL ELSE ?2 END "
        "AND (?4 OR stat IS ?3)"
    );
  }
  return rc;
}





static int sessionBindValue(
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt,
  int i,
  sqlite3_value *pVal
){
  int eType =sqlite3_api->value_type(pVal);




  if( (eType==3           || eType==4          ) && pVal->z==0 ){



    return 7           ;
  }
  return sqlite3_api->bind_value(pStmt,i,pVal);
}















static int sessionBindRow(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int(*xValue)(sqlite3_changeset_iter *, int, sqlite3_value **),
  int nCol,
  u8 *abPK,
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt
){
  int i;
  int rc =0         ;





  assert( xValue==sqlite3changeset_old || xValue==sqlite3changeset_new );

  for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nCol; i++){
    if( !abPK || abPK[i] ){
      sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
      (void)xValue(pIter, i, &pVal);
      if( pVal==0 ){


        rc =sqlite3CorruptError(__LINE__);
      }else{
        rc = sessionBindValue(pStmt, i+1, pVal);
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}


















static int sessionSeekToRow(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  u8 *abPK,
  sqlite3_stmt *pSelect
){
  int rc;
  int nCol;
  int op;
  const char *zDummy;

  sqlite3changeset_op(pIter, &zDummy, &nCol, &op, 0);
  rc = sessionBindRow(pIter,
      op==18            ? sqlite3changeset_new : sqlite3changeset_old,
      nCol, abPK, pSelect
  );

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->step(pSelect);
    if( rc!=100        ) rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pSelect);
  }

  return rc;
}











static int sessionRebaseAdd(
  SessionApplyCtx *p,
  int eType,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter
){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( p->bRebase ){
    int i;
    int eOp = pIter->op;
    if( p->bRebaseStarted==0 ){

      const char *zTab = pIter->zTab;
      sessionAppendByte(&p->rebase, 'T', &rc);
      sessionAppendVarint(&p->rebase, p->nCol, &rc);
      sessionAppendBlob(&p->rebase, p->abPK, p->nCol, &rc);
      sessionAppendBlob(&p->rebase, (u8*)zTab, (int)strlen(zTab)+1, &rc);
      p->bRebaseStarted = 1;
    }

    assert( eType==1                       ||eType==0                     );
    assert( eOp==9             || eOp==18            || eOp==23            );

    sessionAppendByte(&p->rebase,
        (eOp==9             ?9              :18            ), &rc
        );
    sessionAppendByte(&p->rebase, (eType==1                       ), &rc);
    for(i=0; i<p->nCol; i++){
      sqlite3_value *pVal = 0;
      if( eOp==9             || (eOp==23            && p->abPK[i]) ){
        sqlite3changeset_old(pIter, i, &pVal);
      }else{
        sqlite3changeset_new(pIter, i, &pVal);
      }
      sessionAppendValue(&p->rebase, pVal, &rc);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}




































static int sessionConflictHandler(
  int eType,
  SessionApplyCtx *p,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int(*xConflict)(void *, int, sqlite3_changeset_iter*),
  void *pCtx,
  int *pbReplace
){
  int res = 0;
  int rc;
  int nCol;
  int op;
  const char *zDummy;

  sqlite3changeset_op(pIter, &zDummy, &nCol, &op, 0);

  assert( eType==3                         || eType==1                     );
  assert(3                         +1==4                           );
  assert(1                     +1==2                         );


  if( pbReplace ){
    rc = sessionSeekToRow(pIter, p->abPK, p->pSelect);
  }else{
    rc =0         ;
  }

  if( rc==100        ){

    pIter->pConflict = p->pSelect;
    res = xConflict(pCtx, eType, pIter);
    pIter->pConflict = 0;
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(p->pSelect);
  }else if( rc==0         ){
    if( p->bDeferConstraints && eType==3                         ){


      u8 *aBlob = &pIter->in.aData[pIter->in.iCurrent];
      int nBlob = pIter->in.iNext - pIter->in.iCurrent;
      sessionAppendBlob(&p->constraints, aBlob, nBlob, &rc);
      return 0        ;
    }else{

      res = xConflict(pCtx, eType+1, pIter);
      if( res==1                        ) rc =21            ;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    switch( res ){
      case 1                       :
        assert( pbReplace );
        *pbReplace = 1;
        break;

      case 0                    :
        break;

      case 2                     :
        rc =4            ;
        break;

      default:
        rc =21            ;
        break;
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sessionRebaseAdd(p, res, pIter);
    }
  }

  return rc;
}

























static int sessionApplyOneOp(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  SessionApplyCtx *p,
  int(*xConflict)(void *, int, sqlite3_changeset_iter *),
  void *pCtx,
  int *pbReplace,
  int *pbRetry
){
  const char *zDummy;
  int op;
  int nCol;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert( p->pDelete && p->pInsert && p->pSelect );
  assert( p->azCol && p->abPK );
  assert( !pbReplace || *pbReplace==0 );

  sqlite3changeset_op(pIter, &zDummy, &nCol, &op, 0);

  if( op==9             ){












    u8 *abPK = (pIter->bPatchset ? p->abPK : 0);
    rc = sessionBindRow(pIter, sqlite3changeset_old, nCol, abPK, p->pDelete);
    if( rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->bind_parameter_count(p->pDelete)>nCol){
      rc =sqlite3_api->bind_int(p->pDelete,nCol+1,(pbRetry==0||abPK));
    }
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

sqlite3_api->step(p->pDelete);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(p->pDelete);
    if( rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->changes(p->db)==0){
      rc = sessionConflictHandler(
1                              , p, pIter, xConflict, pCtx, pbRetry
      );
    }else if( (rc&0xff)==19                ){
      rc = sessionConflictHandler(
3                                  , p, pIter, xConflict, pCtx, 0
      );
    }

  }else if( op==23            ){
    int i;
    sqlite3_stmt *pUp = 0;
    int bPatchset = (pbRetry==0 || pIter->bPatchset);

    rc = sessionUpdateFind(pIter, p, bPatchset, &pUp);


    for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nCol; i++){
      sqlite3_value *pOld =(pIter)->apValue[(i)]         ;
      sqlite3_value *pNew =(pIter)->apValue[(pIter)->nCol+(i)];
      if( p->abPK[i] || (bPatchset==0 && pOld) ){
        rc = sessionBindValue(pUp, i*2 +2,pOld);
      }
      if( rc==0         && pNew ){
        rc = sessionBindValue(pUp, i*2 +1,pNew);
      }
    }
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;



sqlite3_api->step(pUp);
    rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pUp);

    if( rc==0         &&sqlite3_api->changes(p->db)==0){




      rc = sessionConflictHandler(
1                              , p, pIter, xConflict, pCtx, pbRetry
      );

    }else if( (rc&0xff)==19                ){

      rc = sessionConflictHandler(
3                                  , p, pIter, xConflict, pCtx, 0
      );
    }

  }else{
    assert( op==18            );
    if( p->bStat1 ){



      rc = sessionSeekToRow(pIter, p->abPK, p->pSelect);
      if( rc==100        ){
        rc =19                ;
sqlite3_api->reset   (p->pSelect);
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sessionBindRow(pIter, sqlite3changeset_new, nCol, 0, p->pInsert);
      if( rc!=0         ) return rc;

sqlite3_api->step (p->pInsert);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(p->pInsert);
    }

    if( (rc&0xff)==19                ){
      rc = sessionConflictHandler(
3                                  , p, pIter, xConflict, pCtx, pbReplace
      );
    }
  }

  return rc;
}











static int sessionApplyOneWithRetry(
  sqlite3 *db,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  SessionApplyCtx *pApply,
  int(*xConflict)(void*, int, sqlite3_changeset_iter*),
  void *pCtx
){
  int bReplace = 0;
  int bRetry = 0;
  int rc;

  rc = sessionApplyOneOp(pIter, pApply, xConflict, pCtx, &bReplace, &bRetry);
  if( rc==0         ){







    if( bRetry ){
      assert( pIter->op==23            || pIter->op==9             );
      rc = sessionApplyOneOp(pIter, pApply, xConflict, pCtx, 0, 0);
    }






    else if( bReplace ){
      assert( pIter->op==18            );
      rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"SAVEPOINT replace_op",0,0,0);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = sessionBindRow(pIter,
            sqlite3changeset_new, pApply->nCol, pApply->abPK, pApply->pDelete);
sqlite3_api->bind_int   (pApply->pDelete, pApply->nCol+1, 1);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->step   (pApply->pDelete);
        rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pApply->pDelete);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc = sessionApplyOneOp(pIter, pApply, xConflict, pCtx, 0, 0);
      }
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"RELEASE replace_op",0,0,0);
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}




static int sessionRetryConstraints(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int bPatchset,
  const char *zTab,
  SessionApplyCtx *pApply,
  int(*xConflict)(void*, int, sqlite3_changeset_iter*),
  void *pCtx
){
  int rc =0         ;

  while( pApply->constraints.nBuf ){
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter2 = 0;
    SessionBuffer cons = pApply->constraints;
    memset(&pApply->constraints, 0, sizeof(SessionBuffer));

    rc = sessionChangesetStart(
        &pIter2, 0, 0, cons.nBuf, cons.aBuf, pApply->bInvertConstraints, 1
    );
    if( rc==0         ){
      size_t nByte = 2*pApply->nCol*sizeof(sqlite3_value*);
      int rc2;
      pIter2->bPatchset = bPatchset;
      pIter2->zTab = (char*)zTab;
      pIter2->nCol = pApply->nCol;
      pIter2->abPK = pApply->abPK;
      sessionBufferGrow(&pIter2->tblhdr, nByte, &rc);
      pIter2->apValue = (sqlite3_value**)pIter2->tblhdr.aBuf;
      if( rc==0         ) memset(pIter2->apValue, 0, nByte);

      while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3changeset_next(pIter2) ){
        rc = sessionApplyOneWithRetry(db, pIter2, pApply, xConflict, pCtx);
      }

      rc2 = sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter2);
      if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
    }
    assert( pApply->bDeferConstraints || pApply->constraints.nBuf==0 );

sqlite3_api->free(cons.aBuf);
    if( rc!=0         ) break;
    if( pApply->constraints.nBuf>=cons.nBuf ){

      pApply->bDeferConstraints = 0;
    }
  }

  return rc;
}








static int sessionChangesetApply(
  sqlite3 *db,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int(*xFilter)(
    void *pCtx,
    const char *zTab
  ),
  int(*xConflict)(
    void *pCtx,
    int eConflict,
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *p
  ),
  void *pCtx,
  void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase,
  int flags
){
  int schemaMismatch = 0;
  int rc =0         ;
  const char *zTab = 0;
  int nTab = 0;
  SessionApplyCtx sApply;
  int bPatchset;

  assert( xConflict!=0 );

  pIter->in.bNoDiscard = 1;
  memset(&sApply, 0, sizeof(sApply));
  sApply.bRebase = (ppRebase && pnRebase);
  sApply.bInvertConstraints = !!(flags &0x0002                       );
                                           ;
  if( (flags &0x0001                            )==0 ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"SAVEPOINT changeset_apply",0,0,0);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = 1",0,0,0);
  }
  while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3changeset_next(pIter) ){
    int nCol;
    int op;
    const char *zNew;

    sqlite3changeset_op(pIter, &zNew, &nCol, &op, 0);

    if( zTab==0 ||sqlite3_api->strnicmp(zNew,zTab,nTab+1)){
      u8 *abPK;

      rc = sessionRetryConstraints(
          db, pIter->bPatchset, zTab, &sApply, xConflict, pCtx
      );
      if( rc!=0         ) break;

      sessionUpdateFree(&sApply);
sqlite3_api->free ((char*)sApply.azCol);
sqlite3_api->finalize (sApply.pDelete);
sqlite3_api->finalize (sApply.pInsert);
sqlite3_api->finalize (sApply.pSelect);
      sApply.db = db;
      sApply.pDelete = 0;
      sApply.pInsert = 0;
      sApply.pSelect = 0;
      sApply.nCol = 0;
      sApply.azCol = 0;
      sApply.abPK = 0;
      sApply.bStat1 = 0;
      sApply.bDeferConstraints = 1;
      sApply.bRebaseStarted = 0;
      memset(&sApply.constraints, 0, sizeof(SessionBuffer));




      schemaMismatch = (xFilter && (0==xFilter(pCtx, zNew)));
      if( schemaMismatch ){
        zTab =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",zNew);
        if( zTab==0 ){
          rc =7            ;
          break;
        }
        nTab = (int)strlen(zTab);
        sApply.azCol = (const char **)zTab;
      }else{
        int nMinCol = 0;
        int i;

        sqlite3changeset_pk(pIter, &abPK, 0);
        rc = sessionTableInfo(0,
            db, "main", zNew, &sApply.nCol, &zTab, &sApply.azCol, &sApply.abPK
        );
        if( rc!=0         ) break;
        for(i=0; i<sApply.nCol; i++){
          if( sApply.abPK[i] ) nMinCol = i+1;
        }

        if( sApply.nCol==0 ){
          schemaMismatch = 1;
sqlite3_api->log     (17           ,
              "sqlite3changeset_apply(): no such table: %s", zTab
          );
        }
        else if( sApply.nCol<nCol ){
          schemaMismatch = 1;
sqlite3_api->log     (17           ,
              "sqlite3changeset_apply(): table %s has %d columns, "
              "expected %d or more",
              zTab, sApply.nCol, nCol
          );
        }
        else if( nCol<nMinCol || memcmp(sApply.abPK, abPK, nCol)!=0 ){
          schemaMismatch = 1;
sqlite3_api->log     (17           , "sqlite3changeset_apply(): "
              "primary key mismatch for table %s", zTab
          );
        }
        else{
          sApply.nCol = nCol;
          if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp(zTab,"sqlite_stat1")){
            if( (rc = sessionStat1Sql(db, &sApply) ) ){
              break;
            }
            sApply.bStat1 = 1;
          }else{
            if( (rc = sessionSelectRow(db, zTab, &sApply))
             || (rc = sessionDeleteRow(db, zTab, &sApply))
             || (rc = sessionInsertRow(db, zTab, &sApply))
            ){
              break;
            }
            sApply.bStat1 = 0;
          }
        }
        nTab = sqlite3Strlen30(zTab);
      }
    }



    if( schemaMismatch ) continue;

    rc = sessionApplyOneWithRetry(db, pIter, &sApply, xConflict, pCtx);
  }

  bPatchset = pIter->bPatchset;
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  }else{
    sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionRetryConstraints(db, bPatchset, zTab, &sApply, xConflict, pCtx);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    int nFk, notUsed;
sqlite3_api->db_status(db,10                          , &nFk, &notUsed, 0);
    if( nFk!=0 ){
      int res =2                      ;
      sqlite3_changeset_iter sIter;
      memset(&sIter, 0, sizeof(sIter));
      sIter.nCol = nFk;
      res = xConflict(pCtx,5                            , &sIter);
      if( res!=0                     ){
        rc =19                ;
      }
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->exec(db,"PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = 0",0,0, 0);

  if( (flags &0x0001                            )==0 ){
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,"RELEASE changeset_apply",0,0,0);
    }else{
sqlite3_api->exec (db, "ROLLBACK TO changeset_apply", 0, 0, 0);
sqlite3_api->exec (db, "RELEASE changeset_apply", 0, 0, 0);
    }
  }

  assert( sApply.bRebase || sApply.rebase.nBuf==0 );
  if( rc==0         && bPatchset==0 && sApply.bRebase ){
    *ppRebase = (void*)sApply.rebase.aBuf;
    *pnRebase = sApply.rebase.nBuf;
    sApply.rebase.aBuf = 0;
  }
  sessionUpdateFree(&sApply);
sqlite3_api->finalize(sApply.pInsert);
sqlite3_api->finalize(sApply.pDelete);
sqlite3_api->finalize(sApply.pSelect);
sqlite3_api->free((char*)sApply.azCol);
sqlite3_api->free((char*)sApply.constraints.aBuf);
sqlite3_api->free((char*)sApply.rebase.aBuf);
                                           ;
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3changeset_apply_v2(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int nChangeset,
  void *pChangeset,
  int(*xFilter)(
    void *pCtx,
    const char *zTab
  ),
  int(*xConflict)(
    void *pCtx,
    int eConflict,
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *p
  ),
  void *pCtx,
  void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase,
  int flags
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter;
  int bInv = !!(flags &0x0002                       );
  int rc = sessionChangesetStart(&pIter, 0, 0, nChangeset, pChangeset, bInv, 1);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionChangesetApply(
        db, pIter, xFilter, xConflict, pCtx, ppRebase, pnRebase, flags
    );
  }
  return rc;
}






           int sqlite3changeset_apply(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int nChangeset,
  void *pChangeset,
  int(*xFilter)(
    void *pCtx,
    const char *zTab
  ),
  int(*xConflict)(
    void *pCtx,
    int eConflict,
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *p
  ),
  void *pCtx
){
  return sqlite3changeset_apply_v2(
      db, nChangeset, pChangeset, xFilter, xConflict, pCtx, 0, 0, 0
  );
}






           int sqlite3changeset_apply_v2_strm(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int (*xInput)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pIn,
  int(*xFilter)(
    void *pCtx,
    const char *zTab
  ),
  int(*xConflict)(
    void *pCtx,
    int eConflict,
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *p
  ),
  void *pCtx,
  void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase,
  int flags
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter;
  int bInverse = !!(flags &0x0002                       );
  int rc = sessionChangesetStart(&pIter, xInput, pIn, 0, 0, bInverse, 1);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionChangesetApply(
        db, pIter, xFilter, xConflict, pCtx, ppRebase, pnRebase, flags
    );
  }
  return rc;
}
           int sqlite3changeset_apply_strm(
  sqlite3 *db,
  int (*xInput)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pIn,
  int(*xFilter)(
    void *pCtx,
    const char *zTab
  ),
  int(*xConflict)(
    void *pCtx,
    int eConflict,
    sqlite3_changeset_iter *p
  ),
  void *pCtx
){
  return sqlite3changeset_apply_v2_strm(
      db, xInput, pIn, xFilter, xConflict, pCtx, 0, 0, 0
  );
}




struct sqlite3_changegroup {
  int rc;
  int bPatch;
  SessionTable *pList;
};






static int sessionChangeMerge(
  SessionTable *pTab,
  int bRebase,
  int bPatchset,
  SessionChange *pExist,
  int op2,
  int bIndirect,
  u8 *aRec,
  int nRec,
  SessionChange **ppNew
){
  SessionChange *pNew = 0;
  int rc =0         ;

  if( !pExist ){
    pNew = (SessionChange *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(SessionChange)+nRec);
    if( !pNew ){
      return 7           ;
    }
    memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(SessionChange));
    pNew->op = op2;
    pNew->bIndirect = bIndirect;
    pNew->aRecord = (u8*)&pNew[1];
    if( bIndirect==0 || bRebase==0 ){
      pNew->nRecord = nRec;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pNew->aRecord);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aRec); int xxn=(nRec);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    }else{
      int i;
      u8 *pIn = aRec;
      u8 *pOut = pNew->aRecord;
      for(i=0; i<pTab->nCol; i++){
        int nIn = sessionSerialLen(pIn);
        if( *pIn==0 ){
          *pOut++ = 0;
        }else if( pTab->abPK[i]==0 ){
          *pOut++ = 0xFF;
        }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(pIn); int xxn=(nIn);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          pOut += nIn;
        }
        pIn += nIn;
      }
      pNew->nRecord = pOut - pNew->aRecord;
    }
  }else if( bRebase ){
    if( pExist->op==9             && pExist->bIndirect ){
      *ppNew = pExist;
    }else{
      sqlite3_int64 nByte = nRec + pExist->nRecord + sizeof(SessionChange);
      pNew = (SessionChange*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
      if( pNew==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        int i;
        u8 *a1 = pExist->aRecord;
        u8 *a2 = aRec;
        u8 *pOut;

        memset(pNew, 0, nByte);
        pNew->bIndirect = bIndirect || pExist->bIndirect;
        pNew->op = op2;
        pOut = pNew->aRecord = (u8*)&pNew[1];

        for(i=0; i<pTab->nCol; i++){
          int n1 = sessionSerialLen(a1);
          int n2 = sessionSerialLen(a2);
          if( *a1==0xFF || (pTab->abPK[i]==0 && bIndirect) ){
            *pOut++ = 0xFF;
          }else if( *a2==0 ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a1); int xxn=(n1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
            pOut += n1;
          }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a2); int xxn=(n2);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
            pOut += n2;
          }
          a1 += n1;
          a2 += n2;
        }
        pNew->nRecord = pOut - pNew->aRecord;
      }
sqlite3_api->free (pExist);
    }
  }else{
    int op1 = pExist->op;














    if( (op1==18            && op2==18           )
     || (op1==23            && op2==18           )
     || (op1==9             && op2==23           )
     || (op1==9             && op2==9            )
    ){
      pNew = pExist;
    }else if( op1==18            && op2==9             ){
sqlite3_api->free (pExist);
      assert( pNew==0 );
    }else{
      u8 *aExist = pExist->aRecord;
      sqlite3_int64 nByte;
      u8 *aCsr;




      nByte = sizeof(SessionChange) + pExist->nRecord + nRec;
      pNew = (SessionChange *)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
      if( !pNew ){
sqlite3_api->free   (pExist);
        return 7           ;
      }
      memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(SessionChange));
      pNew->bIndirect = (bIndirect && pExist->bIndirect);
      aCsr = pNew->aRecord = (u8 *)&pNew[1];

      if( op1==18            ){
        u8 *a1 = aRec;
        assert( op2==23            );
        pNew->op =18            ;
        if( bPatchset==0 ) sessionSkipRecord(&a1, pTab->nCol);
        sessionMergeRecord(&aCsr, pTab->nCol, aExist, a1);
      }else if( op1==9             ){
        assert( op2==18            );
        pNew->op =23            ;
        if( bPatchset ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(aCsr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aRec); int xxn=(nRec);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          aCsr += nRec;
        }else{
          if( 0==sessionMergeUpdate(&aCsr, pTab, bPatchset, aExist, 0,aRec,0) ){
sqlite3_api->free       (pNew);
            pNew = 0;
          }
        }
      }else if( op2==23            ){
        u8 *a1 = aExist;
        u8 *a2 = aRec;
        assert( op1==23            );
        if( bPatchset==0 ){
          sessionSkipRecord(&a1, pTab->nCol);
          sessionSkipRecord(&a2, pTab->nCol);
        }
        pNew->op =23            ;
        if( 0==sessionMergeUpdate(&aCsr, pTab, bPatchset, aRec, aExist,a1,a2) ){
sqlite3_api->free     (pNew);
          pNew = 0;
        }
      }else{
        assert( op1==23            && op2==9             );
        pNew->op =9             ;
        if( bPatchset ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(aCsr);const char*xxs=(const char*)(aRec); int xxn=(nRec);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          aCsr += nRec;
        }else{
          sessionMergeRecord(&aCsr, pTab->nCol, aRec, aExist);
        }
      }

      if( pNew ){
        pNew->nRecord = (int)(aCsr - pNew->aRecord);
      }
sqlite3_api->free (pExist);
    }
  }

  *ppNew = pNew;
  return rc;
}





static int sessionChangesetToHash(
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp,
  int bRebase
){
  u8 *aRec;
  int nRec;
  int rc =0         ;
  SessionTable *pTab = 0;

  while(100        ==sessionChangesetNext(pIter, &aRec, &nRec, 0) ){
    const char *zNew;
    int nCol;
    int op;
    int iHash;
    int bIndirect;
    SessionChange *pChange;
    SessionChange *pExist = 0;
    SessionChange **pp;

    if( pGrp->pList==0 ){
      pGrp->bPatch = pIter->bPatchset;
    }else if( pIter->bPatchset!=pGrp->bPatch ){
      rc =1            ;
      break;
    }

    sqlite3changeset_op(pIter, &zNew, &nCol, &op, &bIndirect);
    if( !pTab ||sqlite3_api->stricmp(zNew,pTab->zName)){

      int nNew = (int)strlen(zNew);
      u8 *abPK;

      sqlite3changeset_pk(pIter, &abPK, 0);
      for(pTab = pGrp->pList; pTab; pTab=pTab->pNext){
        if( 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp(pTab->zName,zNew,nNew+1))break;
      }
      if( !pTab ){
        SessionTable **ppTab;

        pTab =sqlite3_api->malloc64(sizeof(SessionTable)+nCol+nNew+1);
        if( !pTab ){
          rc =7            ;
          break;
        }
        memset(pTab, 0, sizeof(SessionTable));
        pTab->nCol = nCol;
        pTab->abPK = (u8*)&pTab[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pTab->abPK);const char*xxs=(const char*)(abPK); int xxn=(nCol);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pTab->zName = (char*)&pTab->abPK[nCol];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pTab->zName);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zNew); int xxn=(nNew+1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};





        for(ppTab=&pGrp->pList; *ppTab; ppTab=&(*ppTab)->pNext);
        *ppTab = pTab;
      }else if( pTab->nCol!=nCol || memcmp(pTab->abPK, abPK, nCol) ){
        rc =17            ;
        break;
      }
    }

    if( sessionGrowHash(0, pIter->bPatchset, pTab) ){
      rc =7            ;
      break;
    }
    iHash = sessionChangeHash(
        pTab, (pIter->bPatchset && op==9            ), aRec, pTab->nChange
    );




    for(pp=&pTab->apChange[iHash]; *pp; pp=&(*pp)->pNext){
      int bPkOnly1 = 0;
      int bPkOnly2 = 0;
      if( pIter->bPatchset ){
        bPkOnly1 = (*pp)->op==9            ;
        bPkOnly2 = op==9            ;
      }
      if( sessionChangeEqual(pTab, bPkOnly1, (*pp)->aRecord, bPkOnly2, aRec) ){
        pExist = *pp;
        *pp = (*pp)->pNext;
        pTab->nEntry--;
        break;
      }
    }

    rc = sessionChangeMerge(pTab, bRebase,
        pIter->bPatchset, pExist, op, bIndirect, aRec, nRec, &pChange
    );
    if( rc ) break;
    if( pChange ){
      pChange->pNext = pTab->apChange[iHash];
      pTab->apChange[iHash] = pChange;
      pTab->nEntry++;
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ) rc = pIter->rc;
  return rc;
}



















static int sessionChangegroupOutput(
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut,
  int *pnOut,
  void **ppOut
){
  int rc =0         ;
  SessionBuffer buf = {0, 0, 0};
  SessionTable *pTab;
  assert( xOutput==0 || (ppOut==0 && pnOut==0) );




  for(pTab=pGrp->pList; rc==0         && pTab; pTab=pTab->pNext){
    int i;
    if( pTab->nEntry==0 ) continue;

    sessionAppendTableHdr(&buf, pGrp->bPatch, pTab, &rc);
    for(i=0; i<pTab->nChange; i++){
      SessionChange *p;
      for(p=pTab->apChange[i]; p; p=p->pNext){
        sessionAppendByte(&buf, p->op, &rc);
        sessionAppendByte(&buf, p->bIndirect, &rc);
        sessionAppendBlob(&buf, p->aRecord, p->nRecord, &rc);
        if( rc==0         && xOutput && buf.nBuf>=sessions_strm_chunk_size ){
          rc = xOutput(pOut, buf.aBuf, buf.nBuf);
          buf.nBuf = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( xOutput ){
      if( buf.nBuf>0 ) rc = xOutput(pOut, buf.aBuf, buf.nBuf);
    }else if( ppOut ){
      *ppOut = buf.aBuf;
      if( pnOut ) *pnOut = buf.nBuf;
      buf.aBuf = 0;
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->free(buf.aBuf);

  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3changegroup_new(sqlite3_changegroup **pp){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_changegroup *p;
  p = (sqlite3_changegroup*)sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(sqlite3_changegroup));
  if( p==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(sqlite3_changegroup));
  }
  *pp = p;
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3changegroup_add(sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp, int nData, void *pData){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter;
  int rc;

  rc = sqlite3changeset_start(&pIter, nData, pData);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionChangesetToHash(pIter, pGrp, 0);
  }
  sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  return rc;
}





           int sqlite3changegroup_output(
    sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp,
    int *pnData,
    void **ppData
){
  return sessionChangegroupOutput(pGrp, 0, 0, pnData, ppData);
}




           int sqlite3changegroup_add_strm(
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp,
  int (*xInput)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pIn
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter;
  int rc;

  rc = sqlite3changeset_start_strm(&pIter, xInput, pIn);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionChangesetToHash(pIter, pGrp, 0);
  }
  sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3changegroup_output_strm(
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut
){
  return sessionChangegroupOutput(pGrp, xOutput, pOut, 0, 0);
}




           void sqlite3changegroup_delete(sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp){
  if( pGrp ){
    sessionDeleteTable(0, pGrp->pList);
sqlite3_api->free(pGrp);
  }
}




           int sqlite3changeset_concat(
  int nLeft,
  void *pLeft,
  int nRight                                                        ,
  void *pRight,
  int *pnOut,
  void **ppOut
){
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp;
  int rc;

  rc = sqlite3changegroup_new(&pGrp);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_add(pGrp, nLeft, pLeft);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_add(pGrp, nRight, pRight);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_output(pGrp, pnOut, ppOut);
  }
  sqlite3changegroup_delete(pGrp);

  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3changeset_concat_strm(
  int (*xInputA)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pInA,
  int (*xInputB)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pInB,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut
){
  sqlite3_changegroup *pGrp;
  int rc;

  rc = sqlite3changegroup_new(&pGrp);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_add_strm(pGrp, xInputA, pInA);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_add_strm(pGrp, xInputB, pInB);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3changegroup_output_strm(pGrp, xOutput, pOut);
  }
  sqlite3changegroup_delete(pGrp);

  return rc;
}




struct sqlite3_rebaser {
  sqlite3_changegroup grp;
};







static void sessionAppendRecordMerge(
  SessionBuffer *pBuf,
  int nCol,
  u8 *a1, int n1,
  u8 *a2, int n2,
  int *pRc
){
  sessionBufferGrow(pBuf, n1+n2, pRc);
  if( *pRc==0         ){
    int i;
    u8 *pOut = &pBuf->aBuf[pBuf->nBuf];
    for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
      int nn1 = sessionSerialLen(a1);
      int nn2 = sessionSerialLen(a2);
      if( *a1==0 || *a1==0xFF ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a2); int xxn=(nn2);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pOut += nn2;
      }else{
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a1); int xxn=(nn1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pOut += nn1;
      }
      a1 += nn1;
      a2 += nn2;
    }

    pBuf->nBuf = pOut-pBuf->aBuf;
    assert( pBuf->nBuf<=pBuf->nAlloc );
  }
}




















static void sessionAppendPartialUpdate(
  SessionBuffer *pBuf,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  u8 *aRec, int nRec,
  u8 *aChange, int nChange,
  int *pRc
){
  sessionBufferGrow(pBuf, 2 +nRec+nChange,pRc);
  if( *pRc==0         ){
    int bData = 0;
    u8 *pOut = &pBuf->aBuf[pBuf->nBuf];
    int i;
    u8 *a1 = aRec;
    u8 *a2 = aChange;

    *pOut++ =23            ;
    *pOut++ = pIter->bIndirect;
    for(i=0; i<pIter->nCol; i++){
      int n1 = sessionSerialLen(a1);
      int n2 = sessionSerialLen(a2);
      if( pIter->abPK[i] || a2[0]==0 ){
        if( !pIter->abPK[i] && a1[0] ) bData = 1;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a1); int xxn=(n1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pOut += n1;
      }else if( a2[0]!=0xFF && a1[0] ){
        bData = 1;
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a2); int xxn=(n2);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
        pOut += n2;
      }else{
        *pOut++ = '\0';
      }
      a1 += n1;
      a2 += n2;
    }
    if( bData ){
      a2 = aChange;
      for(i=0; i<pIter->nCol; i++){
        int n1 = sessionSerialLen(a1);
        int n2 = sessionSerialLen(a2);
        if( pIter->abPK[i] || a2[0]!=0xFF ){
{char*xxd=(char*)(pOut);const char*xxs=(const char*)(a1); int xxn=(n1);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
          pOut += n1;
        }else{
          *pOut++ = '\0';
        }
        a1 += n1;
        a2 += n2;
      }
      pBuf->nBuf = (pOut - pBuf->aBuf);
    }
  }
}
















static int sessionRebase(
  sqlite3_rebaser *p,
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut,
  int *pnOut,
  void **ppOut
){
  int rc =0         ;
  u8 *aRec = 0;
  int nRec = 0;
  int bNew = 0;
  SessionTable *pTab = 0;
  SessionBuffer sOut = {0,0,0};

  while(100        ==sessionChangesetNext(pIter, &aRec, &nRec, &bNew) ){
    SessionChange *pChange = 0;
    int bDone = 0;

    if( bNew ){
      const char *zTab = pIter->zTab;
      for(pTab=p->grp.pList; pTab; pTab=pTab->pNext){
        if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp(pTab->zName,zTab))break;
      }
      bNew = 0;


      if( pIter->bPatchset ){
        rc =1            ;
      }


      sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->bPatchset ? 'P' : 'T', &rc);
      sessionAppendVarint(&sOut, pIter->nCol, &rc);
      sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, pIter->abPK, pIter->nCol, &rc);
      sessionAppendBlob(&sOut,(u8*)pIter->zTab,(int)strlen(pIter->zTab)+1,&rc);
    }

    if( pTab && rc==0         ){
      int iHash = sessionChangeHash(pTab, 0, aRec, pTab->nChange);

      for(pChange=pTab->apChange[iHash]; pChange; pChange=pChange->pNext){
        if( sessionChangeEqual(pTab, 0, aRec, 0, pChange->aRecord) ){
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if( pChange ){
      assert( pChange->op==9             || pChange->op==18            );
      switch( pIter->op ){
        case 18           :
          if( pChange->op==18            ){
            bDone = 1;
            if( pChange->bIndirect==0 ){
              sessionAppendByte(&sOut,23            , &rc);
              sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->bIndirect, &rc);
              sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, pChange->aRecord, pChange->nRecord, &rc);
              sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, aRec, nRec, &rc);
            }
          }
          break;

        case 23           :
          bDone = 1;
          if( pChange->op==9             ){
            if( pChange->bIndirect==0 ){
              u8 *pCsr = aRec;
              sessionSkipRecord(&pCsr, pIter->nCol);
              sessionAppendByte(&sOut,18            , &rc);
              sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->bIndirect, &rc);
              sessionAppendRecordMerge(&sOut, pIter->nCol,
                  pCsr, nRec-(pCsr-aRec),
                  pChange->aRecord, pChange->nRecord, &rc
              );
            }
          }else{
            sessionAppendPartialUpdate(&sOut, pIter,
                aRec, nRec, pChange->aRecord, pChange->nRecord, &rc
            );
          }
          break;

        default:
          assert( pIter->op==9             );
          bDone = 1;
          if( pChange->op==18            ){
            sessionAppendByte(&sOut,9             , &rc);
            sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->bIndirect, &rc);
            sessionAppendRecordMerge(&sOut, pIter->nCol,
                pChange->aRecord, pChange->nRecord, aRec, nRec, &rc
            );
          }
          break;
      }
    }

    if( bDone==0 ){
      sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->op, &rc);
      sessionAppendByte(&sOut, pIter->bIndirect, &rc);
      sessionAppendBlob(&sOut, aRec, nRec, &rc);
    }
    if( rc==0         && xOutput && sOut.nBuf>sessions_strm_chunk_size ){
      rc = xOutput(pOut, sOut.aBuf, sOut.nBuf);
      sOut.nBuf = 0;
    }
    if( rc ) break;
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->free(sOut.aBuf);
    memset(&sOut, 0, sizeof(sOut));
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    if( xOutput ){
      if( sOut.nBuf>0 ){
        rc = xOutput(pOut, sOut.aBuf, sOut.nBuf);
      }
    }else if( ppOut ){
      *ppOut = (void*)sOut.aBuf;
      *pnOut = sOut.nBuf;
      sOut.aBuf = 0;
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->free(sOut.aBuf);
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3rebaser_create(sqlite3_rebaser **ppNew){
  int rc =0         ;
  sqlite3_rebaser *pNew;

  pNew =sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(sqlite3_rebaser));
  if( pNew==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    memset(pNew, 0, sizeof(sqlite3_rebaser));
  }
  *ppNew = pNew;
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3rebaser_configure(
  sqlite3_rebaser *p,
  int nRebase, const void *pRebase
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter = 0;
  int rc;
  rc = sqlite3changeset_start(&pIter, nRebase, (void*)pRebase);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionChangesetToHash(pIter, &p->grp, 1);
  }
  sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3rebaser_rebase(
  sqlite3_rebaser *p,
  int nIn, const void *pIn,
  int *pnOut, void **ppOut
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter = 0;
  int rc = sqlite3changeset_start(&pIter, nIn, (void*)pIn);

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionRebase(p, pIter, 0, 0, pnOut, ppOut);
    sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  }

  return rc;
}




           int sqlite3rebaser_rebase_strm(
  sqlite3_rebaser *p,
  int (*xInput)(void *pIn, void *pData, int *pnData),
  void *pIn,
  int (*xOutput)(void *pOut, const void *pData, int nData),
  void *pOut
){
  sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter = 0;
  int rc = sqlite3changeset_start_strm(&pIter, xInput, pIn);

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sessionRebase(p, pIter, xOutput, pOut, 0, 0);
    sqlite3changeset_finalize(pIter);
  }

  return rc;
}




           void sqlite3rebaser_delete(sqlite3_rebaser *p){
  if( p ){
    sessionDeleteTable(0, p->grp.pList);
sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
}




           int sqlite3session_config(int op, void *pArg){
  int rc =0         ;
  switch( op ){
    case 1                             : {
      int *pInt = (int*)pArg;
      if( *pInt>0 ){
        sessions_strm_chunk_size = *pInt;
      }
      *pInt = sessions_strm_chunk_size;
      break;
    }
    default:
      rc =21            ;
      break;
  }
  return rc;
}

struct fts5yyStackEntry {
unsigned char      stateno;
unsigned char    major;

  fts5YYMINORTYPE minor;

};
typedef struct fts5yyStackEntry fts5yyStackEntry;



struct fts5yyParser {
  fts5yyStackEntry *fts5yytos;

  int fts5yyhwm;


  int fts5yyerrcnt;

Fts5Parse *pParse;


  int fts5yystksz;
  fts5yyStackEntry *fts5yystack;
  fts5yyStackEntry fts5yystk0;

  fts5yyStackEntry fts5yystack[100             ];
  fts5yyStackEntry *fts5yystackEnd;

};
typedef struct fts5yyParser fts5yyParser;




static FILE *fts5yyTraceFILE = 0;
static char *fts5yyTracePrompt = 0;




















static void sqlite3Fts5ParserTrace(FILE *TraceFILE, char *zTracePrompt){
  fts5yyTraceFILE = TraceFILE;
  fts5yyTracePrompt = zTracePrompt;
  if( fts5yyTraceFILE==0 ) fts5yyTracePrompt = 0;
  else if( fts5yyTracePrompt==0 ) fts5yyTraceFILE = 0;
}

             "$",
             "OR",
             "AND",
             "NOT",
             "TERM",
             "COLON",
             "MINUS",
             "LCP",
             "RCP",

static const char *const fts5yyRuleName[] = {
           "input ::= expr",
           "colset ::= MINUS LCP colsetlist RCP",
           "colset ::= LCP colsetlist RCP",
           "colset ::= STRING",
           "colset ::= MINUS STRING",
           "colsetlist ::= colsetlist STRING",
           "colsetlist ::= STRING",
           "expr ::= expr AND expr",
           "expr ::= expr OR expr",
           "expr ::= expr NOT expr",
           "expr ::= colset COLON LP expr RP",
           "expr ::= LP expr RP",
           "expr ::= exprlist",
           "exprlist ::= cnearset",
           "exprlist ::= exprlist cnearset",
           "cnearset ::= nearset",
           "cnearset ::= colset COLON nearset",
           "nearset ::= phrase",
           "nearset ::= CARET phrase",
           "nearset ::= STRING LP nearphrases neardist_opt RP",
           "nearphrases ::= phrase",
           "nearphrases ::= nearphrases phrase",

           "neardist_opt ::= COMMA STRING",
           "phrase ::= phrase PLUS STRING star_opt",
           "phrase ::= STRING star_opt",
           "star_opt ::= STAR",
           "star_opt ::=",
};








static int fts5yyGrowStack(fts5yyParser *p){
  int newSize;
  int idx;
  fts5yyStackEntry *pNew;

  newSize = p->fts5yystksz*2 + 100;
  idx = p->fts5yytos ? (int)(p->fts5yytos - p->fts5yystack) : 0;
  if( p->fts5yystack==&p->fts5yystk0 ){
    pNew = malloc(newSize*sizeof(pNew[0]));
    if( pNew ) pNew[0] = p->fts5yystk0;
  }else{
    pNew = realloc(p->fts5yystack, newSize*sizeof(pNew[0]));
  }
  if( pNew ){
    p->fts5yystack = pNew;
    p->fts5yytos = &p->fts5yystack[idx];

    if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sStack grows from %d to %d entries.\n",
              fts5yyTracePrompt, p->fts5yystksz, newSize);
    }

    p->fts5yystksz = newSize;
  }
  return pNew==0;
}













static void sqlite3Fts5ParserInit(void *fts5yypRawParser                           ){
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser = (fts5yyParser*)fts5yypRawParser;


  fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm = 0;


  fts5yypParser->fts5yytos = NULL;
  fts5yypParser->fts5yystack = NULL;
  fts5yypParser->fts5yystksz = 0;
  if( fts5yyGrowStack(fts5yypParser) ){
    fts5yypParser->fts5yystack = &fts5yypParser->fts5yystk0;
    fts5yypParser->fts5yystksz = 1;
  }


  fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = -1;

  fts5yypParser->fts5yytos = fts5yypParser->fts5yystack;
  fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[0].stateno = 0;
  fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[0].major = 0;

  fts5yypParser->fts5yystackEnd = &fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[100             -1];

}














static void *sqlite3Fts5ParserAlloc(void *(*mallocProc)(u64                )                           ){
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser;
  fts5yypParser = (fts5yyParser*)(*mallocProc)( (u64                )sizeof(fts5yyParser) );
  if( fts5yypParser ){

    sqlite3Fts5ParserInit(fts5yypParser                           );
  }
  return (void*)fts5yypParser;
}










static void fts5yy_destructor(
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser,
unsigned char    fts5yymajor,
  fts5YYMINORTYPE *fts5yypminor
){
Fts5Parse *pParse=fts5yypParser->pParse;

  switch( fts5yymajor ){











    case 16:
{
 (void)pParse;
}
      break;
    case 17:
    case 18:
    case 19:
{
 sqlite3Fts5ParseNodeFree((fts5yypminor->fts5yy24));
}
      break;
    case 20:
    case 21:
{
sqlite3_api->free((fts5yypminor->fts5yy11));
}
      break;
    case 22:
    case 23:
{
 sqlite3Fts5ParseNearsetFree((fts5yypminor->fts5yy46));
}
      break;
    case 24:
{
 sqlite3Fts5ParsePhraseFree((fts5yypminor->fts5yy53));
}
      break;

    default:  break;
  }
}







static void fts5yy_pop_parser_stack(fts5yyParser *pParser){
  fts5yyStackEntry *fts5yytos;
  assert( pParser->fts5yytos!=0 );
  assert( pParser->fts5yytos > pParser->fts5yystack );
  fts5yytos = pParser->fts5yytos--;

  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sPopping %s\n",
      fts5yyTracePrompt,
      fts5yyTokenName[fts5yytos->major]);
  }

  fts5yy_destructor(pParser, fts5yytos->major, &fts5yytos->minor);
}




static void sqlite3Fts5ParserFinalize(void *p){
  fts5yyParser *pParser = (fts5yyParser*)p;
  while( pParser->fts5yytos>pParser->fts5yystack ) fts5yy_pop_parser_stack(pParser);

  if( pParser->fts5yystack!=&pParser->fts5yystk0 ) free(pParser->fts5yystack);

}










static void sqlite3Fts5ParserFree(
  void *p,
  void (*freeProc)(void*)
){

  if( p==0 ) return;

  sqlite3Fts5ParserFinalize(p);
  (*freeProc)(p);
}






static int sqlite3Fts5ParserStackPeak(void *p){
  fts5yyParser *pParser = (fts5yyParser*)p;
  return pParser->fts5yyhwm;
}








static unsigned char fts5yycoverage[35          ][16              ];











static int sqlite3Fts5ParserCoverage(FILE *out){
  int stateno, iLookAhead, i;
  int nMissed = 0;
  for(stateno=0; stateno<35          ; stateno++){
    i = fts5yy_shift_ofst[stateno];
    for(iLookAhead=0; iLookAhead<16              ; iLookAhead++){
      if( fts5yy_lookahead[i+iLookAhead]!=iLookAhead ) continue;
      if( fts5yycoverage[stateno][iLookAhead]==0 ) nMissed++;
      if( out ){
        fprintf(out,"State %d lookahead %s %s\n", stateno,
                fts5yyTokenName[iLookAhead],
                fts5yycoverage[stateno][iLookAhead] ? "ok" : "missed");
      }
    }
  }
  return nMissed;
}






static unsigned char    fts5yy_find_shift_action(
unsigned char    iLookAhead,
unsigned char      stateno
){
  int i;

  if( stateno>34               ) return stateno;
  assert( stateno <=(34)                );

  fts5yycoverage[stateno][iLookAhead] = 1;

  do{
    i = fts5yy_shift_ofst[stateno];
    assert( i>=0 );
    assert( i<=(105)               );
    assert( i+16              <=(int)((int)(sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead)/sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead[0]))));
    assert( iLookAhead!=27           );
    assert( iLookAhead <16                );
    i += iLookAhead;
    assert( i<(int)((int)(sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead)/sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead[0]))));
    if( fts5yy_lookahead[i]!=iLookAhead ){

unsigned char        iFallback;
      assert( iLookAhead<sizeof(fts5yyFallback)/sizeof(fts5yyFallback[0]) );
      iFallback = fts5yyFallback[iLookAhead];
      if( iFallback!=0 ){

        if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
          fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE, "%sFALLBACK %s => %s\n",
             fts5yyTracePrompt, fts5yyTokenName[iLookAhead], fts5yyTokenName[iFallback]);
        }

        assert( fts5yyFallback[iFallback]==0 );
        iLookAhead = iFallback;
        continue;
      }


      {
        int j = i - iLookAhead + fts5YYWILDCARD;
        assert( j<(int)(sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead)/sizeof(fts5yy_lookahead[0])) );
        if( fts5yy_lookahead[j]==fts5YYWILDCARD && iLookAhead>0 ){

          if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
            fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE, "%sWILDCARD %s => %s\n",
               fts5yyTracePrompt, fts5yyTokenName[iLookAhead],
               fts5yyTokenName[fts5YYWILDCARD]);
          }

          return fts5yy_action[j];
        }
      }

      return fts5yy_default[stateno];
    }else{
      assert( i>=0 && i<(int)(sizeof(fts5yy_action)/sizeof(fts5yy_action[0])) );
      return fts5yy_action[i];
    }
  }while(1);
}





static unsigned char    fts5yy_find_reduce_action(
unsigned char      stateno,
unsigned char    iLookAhead
){
  int i;

  if( stateno>(17)                ){
    return fts5yy_default[stateno];
  }

  assert( stateno<=(17)                );

  i = fts5yy_reduce_ofst[stateno];
  assert( iLookAhead!=27           );
  i += iLookAhead;

  if( i<0 || i>=(105)               || fts5yy_lookahead[i]!=iLookAhead ){
    return fts5yy_default[stateno];
  }

  assert( i>=0 && i<(105)               );
  assert( fts5yy_lookahead[i]==iLookAhead );

  return fts5yy_action[i];
}




static void fts5yyStackOverflow(fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser){
Fts5Parse *pParse=fts5yypParser->pParse;


   if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
     fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sStack Overflow!\n",fts5yyTracePrompt);
   }

   while( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>fts5yypParser->fts5yystack ) fts5yy_pop_parser_stack(fts5yypParser);




  sqlite3Fts5ParseError(pParse, "fts5: parser stack overflow");

fts5yypParser->pParse=pParse;

}





static void fts5yyTraceShift(fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser, int fts5yyNewState, const char *zTag){
  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    if( fts5yyNewState<35           ){
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%s%s '%s', go to state %d\n",
         fts5yyTracePrompt, zTag, fts5yyTokenName[fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->major],
         fts5yyNewState);
    }else{
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%s%s '%s', pending reduce %d\n",
         fts5yyTracePrompt, zTag, fts5yyTokenName[fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->major],
         fts5yyNewState -83                );
    }
  }
}







static void fts5yy_shift(
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser,
unsigned char      fts5yyNewState,
unsigned char    fts5yyMajor,
Fts5Token                        fts5yyMinor
){
  fts5yyStackEntry *fts5yytos;
  fts5yypParser->fts5yytos++;

  if( (int)(fts5yypParser->fts5yytos - fts5yypParser->fts5yystack)>fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm ){
    fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm++;
    assert( fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm == (int)(fts5yypParser->fts5yytos - fts5yypParser->fts5yystack) );
  }


  if( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>fts5yypParser->fts5yystackEnd ){
    fts5yypParser->fts5yytos--;
    fts5yyStackOverflow(fts5yypParser);
    return;
  }

  if( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>=&fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[fts5yypParser->fts5yystksz] ){
    if( fts5yyGrowStack(fts5yypParser) ){
      fts5yypParser->fts5yytos--;
      fts5yyStackOverflow(fts5yypParser);
      return;
    }
  }

  if( fts5yyNewState >34                ){
    fts5yyNewState +=83                 -52                     ;
  }
  fts5yytos = fts5yypParser->fts5yytos;
  fts5yytos->stateno = fts5yyNewState;
  fts5yytos->major = fts5yyMajor;
  fts5yytos->minor.fts5yy0 = fts5yyMinor;
                                                          ;
}

        fts5YYMINORTYPE fts5yylhsminor;

        break;

{

  fts5yymsp[-2].minor.fts5yy24 = fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy24;

{fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy24 = fts5yymsp[0].minor.fts5yy24;}
  fts5yymsp[0].minor.fts5yy24 = fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy24;

  sqlite3Fts5ParseSetColset(pParse, fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy24, fts5yymsp[-2].minor.fts5yy11);

  fts5yymsp[-2].minor.fts5yy24 = fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy24;
        break;
      case 17:
{ fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy46 = sqlite3Fts5ParseNearset(pParse, 0, fts5yymsp[0].minor.fts5yy53); }

        break;

  fts5yylhsminor.fts5yy46 = fts5yymsp[-2].minor.fts5yy46;

static void fts5yy_parse_failed(
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser
){
Fts5Parse *pParse=fts5yypParser->pParse;


  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sFail!\n",fts5yyTracePrompt);
  }

  while( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>fts5yypParser->fts5yystack ) fts5yy_pop_parser_stack(fts5yypParser);




fts5yypParser->pParse=pParse;

}





static void fts5yy_syntax_error(
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser,
  int fts5yymajor,
Fts5Token                        fts5yyminor
){
Fts5Parse *pParse=fts5yypParser->pParse;




(void)(fts5yymajor)        ;
  sqlite3Fts5ParseError(
    pParse, "fts5: syntax error near \"%.*s\"",fts5yyminor.n,fts5yyminor.p
  );

fts5yypParser->pParse=pParse;

}




static void fts5yy_accept(
  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser
){
Fts5Parse *pParse=fts5yypParser->pParse;


  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sAccept!\n",fts5yyTracePrompt);
  }


  fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = -1;

  assert( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos==fts5yypParser->fts5yystack );




fts5yypParser->pParse=pParse;

}




















static void sqlite3Fts5Parser(
  void *fts5yyp,
  int fts5yymajor,
Fts5Token                        fts5yyminor
,Fts5Parse *pParse
){
  fts5YYMINORTYPE fts5yyminorunion;
unsigned char      fts5yyact;

  int fts5yyendofinput;


  int fts5yyerrorhit = 0;

  fts5yyParser *fts5yypParser = (fts5yyParser*)fts5yyp;

fts5yypParser->pParse=pParse;

  assert( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos!=0 );

  fts5yyendofinput = (fts5yymajor==0);


  fts5yyact = fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->stateno;

  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    if( fts5yyact <83                 ){
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sInput '%s' in state %d\n",
              fts5yyTracePrompt,fts5yyTokenName[fts5yymajor],fts5yyact);
    }else{
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sInput '%s' with pending reduce %d\n",
              fts5yyTracePrompt,fts5yyTokenName[fts5yymajor],fts5yyact-83               );
    }
  }


  while(1){
    assert( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>=fts5yypParser->fts5yystack );
    assert( fts5yyact==fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->stateno );
    fts5yyact = fts5yy_find_shift_action((unsigned char )fts5yymajor,fts5yyact);
    if( fts5yyact >=83                 ){
      unsigned int fts5yyruleno = fts5yyact -83                ;

      assert( fts5yyruleno<(int)(sizeof(fts5yyRuleName)/sizeof(fts5yyRuleName[0])) );
      if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
        int fts5yysize = fts5yyRuleInfoNRhs[fts5yyruleno];
        if( fts5yysize ){
          fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE, "%sReduce %d [%s]%s, pop back to state %d.\n",
            fts5yyTracePrompt,
            fts5yyruleno, fts5yyRuleName[fts5yyruleno],
            fts5yyruleno<28                      ? "" : " without external action",
            fts5yypParser->fts5yytos[fts5yysize].stateno);
        }else{
          fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE, "%sReduce %d [%s]%s.\n",
            fts5yyTracePrompt, fts5yyruleno, fts5yyRuleName[fts5yyruleno],
            fts5yyruleno<28                      ? "" : " without external action");
        }
      }





      if( fts5yyRuleInfoNRhs[fts5yyruleno]==0 ){

        if( (int)(fts5yypParser->fts5yytos - fts5yypParser->fts5yystack)>fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm ){
          fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm++;
          assert( fts5yypParser->fts5yyhwm ==
                  (int)(fts5yypParser->fts5yytos - fts5yypParser->fts5yystack));
        }


        if( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>=fts5yypParser->fts5yystackEnd ){
          fts5yyStackOverflow(fts5yypParser);
          break;
        }

        if( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos>=&fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[fts5yypParser->fts5yystksz-1] ){
          if( fts5yyGrowStack(fts5yypParser) ){
            fts5yyStackOverflow(fts5yypParser);
            break;
          }
        }

      }
      fts5yyact = fts5yy_reduce(fts5yypParser,fts5yyruleno,fts5yymajor,fts5yyminor                           );
    }else if( fts5yyact <=79                      ){
      fts5yy_shift(fts5yypParser,fts5yyact,(unsigned char )fts5yymajor,fts5yyminor);

      fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt--;

      break;
    }else if( fts5yyact==81                   ){
      fts5yypParser->fts5yytos--;
      fts5yy_accept(fts5yypParser);
      return;
    }else{
      assert( fts5yyact ==80                   );
      fts5yyminorunion.fts5yy0 = fts5yyminor;

      int fts5yymx;


      if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
        fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sSyntax Error!\n",fts5yyTracePrompt);
      }





















      if( fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt<0 ){
        fts5yy_syntax_error(fts5yypParser,fts5yymajor,fts5yyminor);
      }
      fts5yymx = fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->major;
      if( fts5yymx==fts5YYERRORSYMBOL || fts5yyerrorhit ){

        if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
          fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sDiscard input token %s\n",
             fts5yyTracePrompt,fts5yyTokenName[fts5yymajor]);
        }

        fts5yy_destructor(fts5yypParser, (unsigned char )fts5yymajor, &fts5yyminorunion);
        fts5yymajor =27           ;
      }else{
        while( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos > fts5yypParser->fts5yystack ){
          fts5yyact = fts5yy_find_reduce_action(fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->stateno,
                                        fts5YYERRORSYMBOL);
          if( fts5yyact<=79                     ) break;
          fts5yy_pop_parser_stack(fts5yypParser);
        }
        if( fts5yypParser->fts5yytos <= fts5yypParser->fts5yystack || fts5yymajor==0 ){
          fts5yy_destructor(fts5yypParser,(unsigned char )fts5yymajor,&fts5yyminorunion);
          fts5yy_parse_failed(fts5yypParser);

          fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = -1;

          fts5yymajor =27           ;
        }else if( fts5yymx!=fts5YYERRORSYMBOL ){
          fts5yy_shift(fts5yypParser,fts5yyact,fts5YYERRORSYMBOL,fts5yyminor);
        }
      }
      fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = 3;
      fts5yyerrorhit = 1;
      if( fts5yymajor==27           ) break;
      fts5yyact = fts5yypParser->fts5yytos->stateno;








      fts5yy_syntax_error(fts5yypParser,fts5yymajor, fts5yyminor);
      fts5yy_destructor(fts5yypParser,(unsigned char )fts5yymajor,&fts5yyminorunion);
      break;










      if( fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt<=0 ){
        fts5yy_syntax_error(fts5yypParser,fts5yymajor, fts5yyminor);
      }
      fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = 3;
      fts5yy_destructor(fts5yypParser,(unsigned char )fts5yymajor,&fts5yyminorunion);
      if( fts5yyendofinput ){
        fts5yy_parse_failed(fts5yypParser);

        fts5yypParser->fts5yyerrcnt = -1;

      }
      break;

    }
  }

  if( fts5yyTraceFILE ){
    fts5yyStackEntry *i;
    char cDiv = '[';
    fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%sReturn. Stack=",fts5yyTracePrompt);
    for(i=&fts5yypParser->fts5yystack[1]; i<=fts5yypParser->fts5yytos; i++){
      fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"%c%s", cDiv, fts5yyTokenName[i->major]);
      cDiv = ' ';
    }
    fprintf(fts5yyTraceFILE,"]\n");
  }

  return;
}





static int sqlite3Fts5ParserFallback(int iToken){

  assert( iToken<(int)(sizeof(fts5yyFallback)/sizeof(fts5yyFallback[0])) );
  return fts5yyFallback[iToken];

  (void)iToken;
  return 0;

}





































typedef struct CInstIter CInstIter;
struct CInstIter {
  const Fts5ExtensionApi *pApi;
  Fts5Context *pFts;
  int iCol;
  int iInst;
  int nInst;


  int iStart;
  int iEnd;
};





static int fts5CInstIterNext(CInstIter *pIter){
  int rc =0         ;
  pIter->iStart = -1;
  pIter->iEnd = -1;

  while( rc==0         && pIter->iInst<pIter->nInst ){
    int ip; int ic; int io;
    rc = pIter->pApi->xInst(pIter->pFts, pIter->iInst, &ip, &ic, &io);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( ic==pIter->iCol ){
