struct Fts5Cursor {
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor base;
  Fts5Cursor *pNext;
  int *aColumnSize;
  i64 iCsrId;


  int ePlan;
  int bDesc;
  i64 iFirstRowid;
  i64 iLastRowid;
  sqlite3_stmt *pStmt;
  Fts5Expr *pExpr;
  Fts5Sorter *pSorter;
  int csrflags;
  i64 iSpecial;


  char *zRank;
  char *zRankArgs;
  Fts5Auxiliary *pRank;
  int nRankArg;
  sqlite3_value **apRankArg;
  sqlite3_stmt *pRankArgStmt;


  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;
  Fts5Auxdata *pAuxdata;


  Fts5PoslistReader *aInstIter;
  int nInstAlloc;
  int nInstCount;
  int *aInst;
};





































struct Fts5Auxdata {
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;
  void *pPtr;
  void(*xDelete)(void*);
  Fts5Auxdata *pNext;
};









static void fts5CheckTransactionState(Fts5FullTable *p, int op, int iSavepoint){
  switch( op ){
    case 1         :
      assert( p->ts.eState==0 );
      p->ts.eState = 1;
      p->ts.iSavepoint = -1;
      break;

    case 2        :
      assert( p->ts.eState==1 || p->ts.eState==2 );
      p->ts.eState = 2;
      break;

    case 3          :
      assert( p->ts.eState==2 );
      p->ts.eState = 0;
      break;

    case 4            :
      assert( p->ts.eState==1 || p->ts.eState==2 || p->ts.eState==0 );
      p->ts.eState = 0;
      break;

    case 5             :
      assert( p->ts.eState>=1 );
      assert( iSavepoint>=0 );
      assert( iSavepoint>=p->ts.iSavepoint );
      p->ts.iSavepoint = iSavepoint;
      break;

    case 6           :
      assert( p->ts.eState>=1 );
      assert( iSavepoint>=0 );
      assert( iSavepoint<=p->ts.iSavepoint );
      p->ts.iSavepoint = iSavepoint-1;
      break;

    case 7              :
      assert( p->ts.eState>=1 );
      assert( iSavepoint>=-1 );




      p->ts.iSavepoint = iSavepoint;
      break;
  }
}







static int fts5IsContentless(Fts5FullTable *pTab){
  return pTab->p.pConfig->eContent==1                ;
}




static void fts5FreeVtab(Fts5FullTable *pTab){
  if( pTab ){
    sqlite3Fts5IndexClose(pTab->p.pIndex);
    sqlite3Fts5StorageClose(pTab->pStorage);
    sqlite3Fts5ConfigFree(pTab->p.pConfig);
sqlite3_api->free(pTab);
  }
}




static int fts5DisconnectMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  fts5FreeVtab((Fts5FullTable*)pVtab);
  return 0        ;
}




static int fts5DestroyMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  Fts5Table *pTab = (Fts5Table*)pVtab;
  int rc = sqlite3Fts5DropAll(pTab->pConfig);
  if( rc==0         ){
    fts5FreeVtab((Fts5FullTable*)pVtab);
  }
  return rc;
}












static int fts5InitVtab(
  int bCreate,
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc,
  const char * const *argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVTab,
  char **pzErr
){
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)pAux;
  const char **azConfig = (const char**)argv;
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = 0;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = 0;


  pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)sqlite3Fts5MallocZero(&rc, sizeof(Fts5FullTable));
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5ConfigParse(pGlobal, db, argc, azConfig, &pConfig, pzErr);
    assert( (rc==0         && *pzErr==0) || pConfig==0 );
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    pTab->p.pConfig = pConfig;
    pTab->pGlobal = pGlobal;
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexOpen(pConfig, bCreate, &pTab->p.pIndex, pzErr);
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageOpen(
        pConfig, pTab->p.pIndex, bCreate, &pTab->pStorage, pzErr
    );
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5ConfigDeclareVtab(pConfig);
  }


  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( pConfig->pzErrmsg==0 );
    pConfig->pzErrmsg = pzErr;
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexLoadConfig(pTab->p.pIndex);
    sqlite3Fts5IndexRollback(pTab->p.pIndex);
    pConfig->pzErrmsg = 0;
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
    fts5FreeVtab(pTab);
    pTab = 0;
  }else if( bCreate ){
                                                  ;
  }
  *ppVTab = (sqlite3_vtab*)pTab;
  return rc;
}





static int fts5ConnectMethod(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc,
  const char * const *argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return fts5InitVtab(0, db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr);
}
static int fts5CreateMethod(
  sqlite3 *db,
  void *pAux,
  int argc,
  const char * const *argv,
  sqlite3_vtab **ppVtab,
  char **pzErr
){
  return fts5InitVtab(1, db, pAux, argc, argv, ppVtab, pzErr);
}
















static void fts5SetUniqueFlag(sqlite3_index_info *pIdxInfo){


  if(sqlite3_api->libversion_number()>=3008012)

  {
    pIdxInfo->idxFlags |=1                        ;
  }

}

static int fts5UsePatternMatch(
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  struct sqlite3_index_constraint *p
){
  assert(66                ==66                           );
  assert(65                ==65                           );
  if( pConfig->ePattern==66                && p->op==66                ){
    return 1;
  }
  if( pConfig->ePattern==65
   && (p->op==65                || p->op==66               )
  ){
    return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}






























































static int fts5BestIndexMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVTab, sqlite3_index_info *pInfo){
  Fts5Table *pTab = (Fts5Table*)pVTab;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->pConfig;
  const int nCol = pConfig->nCol;
  int idxFlags = 0;
  int i;

  char *idxStr;
  int iIdxStr = 0;
  int iCons = 0;

  int bSeenEq = 0;
  int bSeenGt = 0;
  int bSeenLt = 0;
  int bSeenMatch = 0;
  int bSeenRank = 0;


  assert(2                          <64                            );
  assert(4                          <64                            );
  assert(8                          <64                            );
  assert(32                         <64                            );
  assert(8                          <64                            );

  if( pConfig->bLock ){
    pTab->base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
        "recursively defined fts5 content table"
    );
    return 1           ;
  }

  idxStr = (char*)sqlite3_api->malloc(pInfo->nConstraint*8 +1);
  if( idxStr==0 ) return 7           ;
  pInfo->idxStr = idxStr;
  pInfo->needToFreeIdxStr = 1;

  for(i=0; i<pInfo->nConstraint; i++){
    struct sqlite3_index_constraint *p = &pInfo->aConstraint[i];
    int iCol = p->iColumn;
    if( p->op==64
     || (p->op==2                          && iCol>=nCol)
    ){

      if( p->usable==0 || iCol<0 ){


        pInfo->estimatedCost = 1e50;
        assert( iIdxStr < pInfo->nConstraint*6 + 1 );
        idxStr[iIdxStr] = 0;
        return 0        ;
      }else{
        if( iCol==nCol+1 ){
          if( bSeenRank ) continue;
          idxStr[iIdxStr++] = 'r';
          bSeenRank = 1;
        }else if( iCol>=0 ){
          bSeenMatch = 1;
          idxStr[iIdxStr++] = 'M';
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf    (6, &idxStr[iIdxStr], "%d", iCol);
          idxStr += strlen(&idxStr[iIdxStr]);
          assert( idxStr[iIdxStr]=='\0' );
        }
        pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = ++iCons;
        pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].omit = 1;
      }
    }else if( p->usable ){
      if( iCol>=0 && iCol<nCol && fts5UsePatternMatch(pConfig, p) ){
        assert( p->op==65                || p->op==66                );
        idxStr[iIdxStr++] = p->op==65                ? 'L' : 'G';
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf  (6, &idxStr[iIdxStr], "%d", iCol);
        idxStr += strlen(&idxStr[iIdxStr]);
        pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = ++iCons;
        assert( idxStr[iIdxStr]=='\0' );
      }else if( bSeenEq==0 && p->op==2                          && iCol<0 ){
        idxStr[iIdxStr++] = '=';
        bSeenEq = 1;
        pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = ++iCons;
      }
    }
  }

  if( bSeenEq==0 ){
    for(i=0; i<pInfo->nConstraint; i++){
      struct sqlite3_index_constraint *p = &pInfo->aConstraint[i];
      if( p->iColumn<0 && p->usable ){
        int op = p->op;
        if( op==16                         || op==8                          ){
          if( bSeenLt ) continue;
          idxStr[iIdxStr++] = '<';
          pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = ++iCons;
          bSeenLt = 1;
        }else
        if( op==4                          || op==32                         ){
          if( bSeenGt ) continue;
          idxStr[iIdxStr++] = '>';
          pInfo->aConstraintUsage[i].argvIndex = ++iCons;
          bSeenGt = 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  idxStr[iIdxStr] = '\0';


  if( pInfo->nOrderBy==1 ){
    int iSort = pInfo->aOrderBy[0].iColumn;
    if( iSort==(pConfig->nCol+1) && bSeenMatch ){
      idxFlags |=0x0020             ;
    }else if( iSort==-1 ){
      idxFlags |=0x0040              ;
    }
    if((((idxFlags) & (0x0020|0x0040))!=0)                            ){
      pInfo->orderByConsumed = 1;
      if( pInfo->aOrderBy[0].desc ){
        idxFlags |=0x0080             ;
      }
    }
  }


  if( bSeenEq ){
    pInfo->estimatedCost = bSeenMatch ? 100.0 : 10.0;
    if( bSeenMatch==0 ) fts5SetUniqueFlag(pInfo);
  }else if( bSeenLt && bSeenGt ){
    pInfo->estimatedCost = bSeenMatch ? 500.0 : 250000.0;
  }else if( bSeenLt || bSeenGt ){
    pInfo->estimatedCost = bSeenMatch ? 750.0 : 750000.0;
  }else{
    pInfo->estimatedCost = bSeenMatch ? 1000.0 : 1000000.0;
  }

  pInfo->idxNum = idxFlags;
  return 0        ;
}

static int fts5NewTransaction(Fts5FullTable *pTab){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr;
  for(pCsr=pTab->pGlobal->pCsr; pCsr; pCsr=pCsr->pNext){
    if( pCsr->base.pVtab==(sqlite3_vtab*)pTab ) return 0        ;
  }
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageReset(pTab->pStorage);
}




static int fts5OpenMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVTab, sqlite3_vtab_cursor **ppCsr){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVTab;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = 0;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;
  int rc;

  rc = fts5NewTransaction(pTab);
  if( rc==0         ){
    nByte = sizeof(Fts5Cursor) + pConfig->nCol * sizeof(int);
    pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
    if( pCsr ){
      Fts5Global *pGlobal = pTab->pGlobal;
      memset(pCsr, 0, (size_t)nByte);
      pCsr->aColumnSize = (int*)&pCsr[1];
      pCsr->pNext = pGlobal->pCsr;
      pGlobal->pCsr = pCsr;
      pCsr->iCsrId = ++pGlobal->iNextId;
    }else{
      rc =7            ;
    }
  }
  *ppCsr = (sqlite3_vtab_cursor*)pCsr;
  return rc;
}

static int fts5StmtType(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  if( pCsr->ePlan==5              ){
    return (pCsr->bDesc) ?1                    :0                  ;
  }
  return 2               ;
}






static void fts5CsrNewrow(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (
0x02 
| 0x04 
| 0x08 
| 0x40))
   ;
}

static void fts5FreeCursorComponents(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  Fts5Auxdata *pData;
  Fts5Auxdata *pNext;

sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->aInstIter);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->aInst);
  if( pCsr->pStmt ){
    int eStmt = fts5StmtType(pCsr);
    sqlite3Fts5StorageStmtRelease(pTab->pStorage, eStmt, pCsr->pStmt);
  }
  if( pCsr->pSorter ){
    Fts5Sorter *pSorter = pCsr->pSorter;
sqlite3_api->finalize(pSorter->pStmt);
sqlite3_api->free(pSorter);
  }

  if( pCsr->ePlan!=2                ){
    sqlite3Fts5ExprFree(pCsr->pExpr);
  }

  for(pData=pCsr->pAuxdata; pData; pData=pNext){
    pNext = pData->pNext;
    if( pData->xDelete ) pData->xDelete(pData->pPtr);
sqlite3_api->free(pData);
  }

sqlite3_api->finalize(pCsr->pRankArgStmt);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->apRankArg);

  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x10))            ){
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->zRank);
sqlite3_api->free(pCsr->zRankArgs);
  }

  sqlite3Fts5IndexCloseReader(pTab->p.pIndex);
  memset(&pCsr->ePlan, 0, sizeof(Fts5Cursor) - ((u8*)&pCsr->ePlan - (u8*)pCsr));
}






static int fts5CloseMethod(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor){
  if( pCursor ){
    Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCursor->pVtab);
    Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
    Fts5Cursor **pp;

    fts5FreeCursorComponents(pCsr);

    for(pp=&pTab->pGlobal->pCsr; (*pp)!=pCsr; pp=&(*pp)->pNext);
    *pp = pCsr->pNext;

sqlite3_api->free(pCsr);
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static int fts5SorterNext(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  Fts5Sorter *pSorter = pCsr->pSorter;
  int rc;

  rc =sqlite3_api->step(pSorter->pStmt);
  if( rc==101         ){
    rc =0         ;
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x01|0x02))                        ;
  }else if( rc==100        ){
    const u8 *a;
    const u8 *aBlob;
    int nBlob;
    int i;
    int iOff = 0;
    rc =0         ;

    pSorter->iRowid =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pSorter->pStmt,0);
    nBlob =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pSorter->pStmt,1);
    aBlob = a =sqlite3_api->column_blob(pSorter->pStmt,1);


    if( nBlob>0 ){
      for(i=0; i<(pSorter->nIdx-1); i++){
        int iVal;
        a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(a,(u32*)&iVal);
        iOff += iVal;
        pSorter->aIdx[i] = iOff;
      }
      pSorter->aIdx[i] = &aBlob[nBlob] - a;
      pSorter->aPoslist = a;
    }

    fts5CsrNewrow(pCsr);
  }

  return rc;
}






static void fts5TripCursors(Fts5FullTable *pTab){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr;
  for(pCsr=pTab->pGlobal->pCsr; pCsr; pCsr=pCsr->pNext){
    if( pCsr->ePlan==1
     && pCsr->base.pVtab==(sqlite3_vtab*)pTab
    ){
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x20))                  ;
    }
  }
}













static int fts5CursorReseek(Fts5Cursor *pCsr, int *pbSkip){
  int rc =0         ;
  assert( *pbSkip==0 );
  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x20))                ){
    Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
    int bDesc = pCsr->bDesc;
    i64 iRowid = sqlite3Fts5ExprRowid(pCsr->pExpr);

    rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprFirst(pCsr->pExpr, pTab->p.pIndex, iRowid, bDesc);
    if( rc==0         &&  iRowid!=sqlite3Fts5ExprRowid(pCsr->pExpr) ){
      *pbSkip = 1;
    }

((pCsr)->csrflags &= ~(0x20))                 ;
    fts5CsrNewrow(pCsr);
    if( sqlite3Fts5ExprEof(pCsr->pExpr) ){
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x01))       ;
      *pbSkip = 1;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}










static int fts5NextMethod(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
  int rc;

  assert( (pCsr->ePlan<3)==
          (pCsr->ePlan==1               || pCsr->ePlan==2               )
  );
  assert( !((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x01))    );

  if( pCsr->ePlan<3 ){
    int bSkip = 0;
    if( (rc = fts5CursorReseek(pCsr, &bSkip)) || bSkip ) return rc;
    rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprNext(pCsr->pExpr, pCsr->iLastRowid);
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (sqlite3Fts5ExprEof(pCsr->pExpr)));
    fts5CsrNewrow(pCsr);
  }else{
    switch( pCsr->ePlan ){
      case 3                : {
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x01))         ;
        rc =0         ;
        break;
      }

      case 4                     : {
        rc = fts5SorterNext(pCsr);
        break;
      }

      default: {
        Fts5Config *pConfig = ((Fts5Table*)pCursor->pVtab)->pConfig;
        pConfig->bLock++;
        rc =sqlite3_api->step(pCsr->pStmt);
        pConfig->bLock--;
        if( rc!=100        ){
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x01))           ;
          rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pCsr->pStmt);
          if( rc!=0         ){
            pCursor->pVtab->zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
                "%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(pConfig->db)
            );
          }
        }else{
          rc =0         ;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}


static int fts5PrepareStatement(
  sqlite3_stmt **ppStmt,
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  const char *zFmt,
  ...
){
  sqlite3_stmt *pRet = 0;
  int rc;
  char *zSql;
  va_list ap;

  va_start(ap, zFmt);
  zSql =sqlite3_api->vmprintf(zFmt,ap);
  if( zSql==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(pConfig->db,zSql,-1,
0x01                                                 , &pRet, 0);
    if( rc!=0         ){
      *pConfig->pzErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(pConfig->db));
    }
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  }

  va_end(ap);
  *ppStmt = pRet;
  return rc;
}

static int fts5CursorFirstSorted(
  Fts5FullTable *pTab,
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr,
  int bDesc
){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  Fts5Sorter *pSorter;
  int nPhrase;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;
  int rc;
  const char *zRank = pCsr->zRank;
  const char *zRankArgs = pCsr->zRankArgs;

  nPhrase = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCount(pCsr->pExpr);
  nByte = sizeof(Fts5Sorter) + sizeof(int) * (nPhrase-1);
  pSorter = (Fts5Sorter*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( pSorter==0 ) return 7           ;
  memset(pSorter, 0, (size_t)nByte);
  pSorter->nIdx = nPhrase;








  rc = fts5PrepareStatement(&pSorter->pStmt, pConfig,
      "SELECT rowid, rank FROM %Q.%Q ORDER BY %s(\"%w\"%s%s) %s",
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName, zRank, pConfig->zName,
      (zRankArgs ? ", " : ""),
      (zRankArgs ? zRankArgs : ""),
      bDesc ? "DESC" : "ASC"
  );

  pCsr->pSorter = pSorter;
  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( pTab->pSortCsr==0 );
    pTab->pSortCsr = pCsr;
    rc = fts5SorterNext(pCsr);
    pTab->pSortCsr = 0;
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
sqlite3_api->finalize(pSorter->pStmt);
sqlite3_api->free(pSorter);
    pCsr->pSorter = 0;
  }

  return rc;
}

static int fts5CursorFirst(Fts5FullTable *pTab, Fts5Cursor *pCsr, int bDesc){
  int rc;
  Fts5Expr *pExpr = pCsr->pExpr;
  rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprFirst(pExpr, pTab->p.pIndex, pCsr->iFirstRowid, bDesc);
  if( sqlite3Fts5ExprEof(pExpr) ){
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x01))     ;
  }
  fts5CsrNewrow(pCsr);
  return rc;
}







static int fts5SpecialMatch(
  Fts5FullTable *pTab,
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr,
  const char *zQuery
){
  int rc =0         ;
  const char *z = zQuery;
  int n;

  while( z[0]==' ' ) z++;
  for(n=0; z[n] && z[n]!=' '; n++);

  assert( pTab->p.base.zErrMsg==0 );
  pCsr->ePlan =3                 ;

  if( n==5 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp("reads",z,n)){
    pCsr->iSpecial = sqlite3Fts5IndexReads(pTab->p.pIndex);
  }
  else if( n==2 && 0==sqlite3_api->strnicmp("id",z,n)){
    pCsr->iSpecial = pCsr->iCsrId;
  }
  else{

    pTab->p.base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("unknown special query: %.*s",n,z);
    rc =1            ;
  }

  return rc;
}






static Fts5Auxiliary *fts5FindAuxiliary(Fts5FullTable *pTab, const char *zName){
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;

  for(pAux=pTab->pGlobal->pAux; pAux; pAux=pAux->pNext){
    if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,pAux->zFunc)==0)return pAux;
  }


  return 0;
}


static int fts5FindRankFunction(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux = 0;
  const char *zRank = pCsr->zRank;
  const char *zRankArgs = pCsr->zRankArgs;

  if( zRankArgs ){
    char *zSql = sqlite3Fts5Mprintf(&rc, "SELECT %s", zRankArgs);
    if( zSql ){
      sqlite3_stmt *pStmt = 0;
      rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(pConfig->db,zSql,-1,
0x01                                                   , &pStmt, 0);
sqlite3_api->free (zSql);
      assert( rc==0         || pCsr->pRankArgStmt==0 );
      if( rc==0         ){
        if(100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pStmt)){
          sqlite3_int64 nByte;
          pCsr->nRankArg =sqlite3_api->column_count(pStmt);
          nByte = sizeof(sqlite3_value*)*pCsr->nRankArg;
          pCsr->apRankArg = (sqlite3_value**)sqlite3Fts5MallocZero(&rc, nByte);
          if( rc==0         ){
            int i;
            for(i=0; i<pCsr->nRankArg; i++){
              pCsr->apRankArg[i] =sqlite3_api->column_value(pStmt,i);
            }
          }
          pCsr->pRankArgStmt = pStmt;
        }else{
          rc =sqlite3_api->finalize(pStmt);
          assert( rc!=0         );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    pAux = fts5FindAuxiliary(pTab, zRank);
    if( pAux==0 ){
      assert( pTab->p.base.zErrMsg==0 );
      pTab->p.base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("no such function: %s",zRank);
      rc =1            ;
    }
  }

  pCsr->pRank = pAux;
  return rc;
}


static int fts5CursorParseRank(
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr,
  sqlite3_value *pRank
){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( pRank ){
    const char *z = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(pRank);
    char *zRank = 0;
    char *zRankArgs = 0;

    if( z==0 ){
      if(sqlite3_api->value_type(pRank)==5       ) rc =1            ;
    }else{
      rc = sqlite3Fts5ConfigParseRank(z, &zRank, &zRankArgs);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      pCsr->zRank = zRank;
      pCsr->zRankArgs = zRankArgs;
((pCsr)->csrflags |= (0x10))              ;
    }else if( rc==1            ){
      pCsr->base.pVtab->zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
          "parse error in rank function: %s", z
      );
    }
  }else{
    if( pConfig->zRank ){
      pCsr->zRank = (char*)pConfig->zRank;
      pCsr->zRankArgs = (char*)pConfig->zRankArgs;
    }else{
      pCsr->zRank = (char*)"bm25"           ;
      pCsr->zRankArgs = 0;
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static i64 fts5GetRowidLimit(sqlite3_value *pVal, i64 iDefault){
  if( pVal ){
    int eType =sqlite3_api->value_numeric_type(pVal);
    if( eType==1              ){
      return sqlite3_api->value_int64(pVal);
    }
  }
  return iDefault;
}












static int fts5FilterMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor,
  int idxNum,
  const char *idxStr,
  int nVal,
  sqlite3_value **apVal
){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCursor->pVtab);
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
  int rc =0         ;
  int bDesc;
  int bOrderByRank;
  sqlite3_value *pRank = 0;
  sqlite3_value *pRowidEq = 0;
  sqlite3_value *pRowidLe = 0;
  sqlite3_value *pRowidGe = 0;
  int iCol;
  char **pzErrmsg = pConfig->pzErrmsg;
  int i;
  int iIdxStr = 0;
  Fts5Expr *pExpr = 0;

  if( pConfig->bLock ){
    pTab->p.base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
        "recursively defined fts5 content table"
    );
    return 1           ;
  }

  if( pCsr->ePlan ){
    fts5FreeCursorComponents(pCsr);
    memset(&pCsr->ePlan, 0, sizeof(Fts5Cursor) - ((u8*)&pCsr->ePlan-(u8*)pCsr));
  }

  assert( pCsr->pStmt==0 );
  assert( pCsr->pExpr==0 );
  assert( pCsr->csrflags==0 );
  assert( pCsr->pRank==0 );
  assert( pCsr->zRank==0 );
  assert( pCsr->zRankArgs==0 );
  assert( pTab->pSortCsr==0 || nVal==0 );

  assert( pzErrmsg==0 || pzErrmsg==&pTab->p.base.zErrMsg );
  pConfig->pzErrmsg = &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg;


  for(i=0; i<nVal; i++){
    switch( idxStr[iIdxStr++] ){
      case 'r':
        pRank = apVal[i];
        break;
      case 'M': {
        const char *zText = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apVal[i]);
        if( zText==0 ) zText = "";
        iCol = 0;
        do{
          iCol = iCol*10 + (idxStr[iIdxStr]-'0');
          iIdxStr++;
        }while( idxStr[iIdxStr]>='0' && idxStr[iIdxStr]<='9' );

        if( zText[0]=='*' ){



          rc = fts5SpecialMatch(pTab, pCsr, &zText[1]);
          goto filter_out;
        }else{
          char **pzErr = &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg;
          rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprNew(pConfig, 0, iCol, zText, &pExpr, pzErr);
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprAnd(&pCsr->pExpr, pExpr);
            pExpr = 0;
          }
          if( rc!=0         ) goto filter_out;
        }

        break;
      }
      case 'L':
      case 'G': {
        int bGlob = (idxStr[iIdxStr-1]=='G');
        const char *zText = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apVal[i]);
        iCol = 0;
        do{
          iCol = iCol*10 + (idxStr[iIdxStr]-'0');
          iIdxStr++;
        }while( idxStr[iIdxStr]>='0' && idxStr[iIdxStr]<='9' );
        if( zText ){
          rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprPattern(pConfig, bGlob, iCol, zText, &pExpr);
        }
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprAnd(&pCsr->pExpr, pExpr);
          pExpr = 0;
        }
        if( rc!=0         ) goto filter_out;
        break;
      }
      case '=':
        pRowidEq = apVal[i];
        break;
      case '<':
        pRowidLe = apVal[i];
        break;
      default: assert( idxStr[iIdxStr-1]=='>' );
        pRowidGe = apVal[i];
        break;
    }
  }
  bOrderByRank = ((idxNum &0x0020             ) ? 1 : 0);
  pCsr->bDesc = bDesc = ((idxNum &0x0080             ) ? 1 : 0);





  if( pRowidEq ){
    pRowidLe = pRowidGe = pRowidEq;
  }
  if( bDesc ){
    pCsr->iFirstRowid = fts5GetRowidLimit(pRowidLe,(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));
    pCsr->iLastRowid = fts5GetRowidLimit(pRowidGe,(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))));
  }else{
    pCsr->iLastRowid = fts5GetRowidLimit(pRowidLe,(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));
    pCsr->iFirstRowid = fts5GetRowidLimit(pRowidGe,(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))));
  }

  if( pTab->pSortCsr ){






    assert( pRowidEq==0 && pRowidLe==0 && pRowidGe==0 && pRank==0 );
    assert( nVal==0 && bOrderByRank==0 && bDesc==0 );
    assert( pCsr->iLastRowid==(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));
    assert( pCsr->iFirstRowid==(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32))));
    if( pTab->pSortCsr->bDesc ){
      pCsr->iLastRowid = pTab->pSortCsr->iFirstRowid;
      pCsr->iFirstRowid = pTab->pSortCsr->iLastRowid;
    }else{
      pCsr->iLastRowid = pTab->pSortCsr->iLastRowid;
      pCsr->iFirstRowid = pTab->pSortCsr->iFirstRowid;
    }
    pCsr->ePlan =2                ;
    pCsr->pExpr = pTab->pSortCsr->pExpr;
    rc = fts5CursorFirst(pTab, pCsr, bDesc);
  }else if( pCsr->pExpr ){
    rc = fts5CursorParseRank(pConfig, pCsr, pRank);
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( bOrderByRank ){
        pCsr->ePlan =4                      ;
        rc = fts5CursorFirstSorted(pTab, pCsr, bDesc);
      }else{
        pCsr->ePlan =1               ;
        rc = fts5CursorFirst(pTab, pCsr, bDesc);
      }
    }
  }else if( pConfig->zContent==0 ){
    *pConfig->pzErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
        "%s: table does not support scanning", pConfig->zName
    );
    rc =1            ;
  }else{


    pCsr->ePlan = (pRowidEq ?6                :5              );
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageStmt(
        pTab->pStorage, fts5StmtType(pCsr), &pCsr->pStmt, &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg
    );
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( pRowidEq!=0 ){
        assert( pCsr->ePlan==6               );
sqlite3_api->bind_value   (pCsr->pStmt, 1, pRowidEq);
      }else{
sqlite3_api->bind_int64   (pCsr->pStmt, 1, pCsr->iFirstRowid);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64   (pCsr->pStmt, 2, pCsr->iLastRowid);
      }
      rc = fts5NextMethod(pCursor);
    }
  }

 filter_out:
  sqlite3Fts5ExprFree(pExpr);
  pConfig->pzErrmsg = pzErrmsg;
  return rc;
}





static int fts5EofMethod(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
  return (((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x01))    ? 1 : 0);
}




static i64 fts5CursorRowid(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  assert( pCsr->ePlan==1
       || pCsr->ePlan==4
       || pCsr->ePlan==2
  );
  if( pCsr->pSorter ){
    return pCsr->pSorter->iRowid;
  }else{
    return sqlite3Fts5ExprRowid(pCsr->pExpr);
  }
}







static int fts5RowidMethod(sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor, sqlite_int64 *pRowid){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
  int ePlan = pCsr->ePlan;

  assert(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x01))    ==0 );
  switch( ePlan ){
    case 3                :
      *pRowid = 0;
      break;

    case 2               :
    case 1              :
    case 4                     :
      *pRowid = fts5CursorRowid(pCsr);
      break;

    default:
      *pRowid =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pCsr->pStmt,0);
      break;
  }

  return 0        ;
}








static int fts5SeekCursor(Fts5Cursor *pCsr, int bErrormsg){
  int rc =0         ;


  if( pCsr->pStmt==0 ){
    Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
    int eStmt = fts5StmtType(pCsr);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageStmt(
        pTab->pStorage, eStmt, &pCsr->pStmt, (bErrormsg?&pTab->p.base.zErrMsg:0)
    );
    assert( rc!=0         || pTab->p.base.zErrMsg==0 );
    assert(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x02))                 );
  }

  if( rc==0         &&((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x02))                 ){
    Fts5Table *pTab = (Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
    assert( pCsr->pExpr );
sqlite3_api->reset(pCsr->pStmt);
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pCsr->pStmt,1, fts5CursorRowid(pCsr));
    pTab->pConfig->bLock++;
    rc =sqlite3_api->step(pCsr->pStmt);
    pTab->pConfig->bLock--;
    if( rc==100        ){
      rc =0         ;
((pCsr)->csrflags &= ~(0x02))                    ;
    }else{
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pCsr->pStmt);
      if( rc==0         ){
        rc =sqlite3Fts5Corrupt();
      }else if( pTab->pConfig->pzErrmsg ){
        *pTab->pConfig->pzErrmsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
            "%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(pTab->pConfig->db)
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static void fts5SetVtabError(Fts5FullTable *p, const char *zFormat, ...){
  va_list ap;
  va_start(ap, zFormat);
  assert( p->p.base.zErrMsg==0 );
  p->p.base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->vmprintf(zFormat,ap);
  va_end(ap);
}
















static int fts5SpecialInsert(
  Fts5FullTable *pTab,
  const char *zCmd,
  sqlite3_value *pVal
){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  int rc =0         ;
  int bError = 0;

  if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("delete-all",zCmd)){
    if( pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
      fts5SetVtabError(pTab,
          "'delete-all' may only be used with a "
          "contentless or external content fts5 table"
      );
      rc =1            ;
    }else{
      rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDeleteAll(pTab->pStorage);
    }
  }else if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("rebuild",zCmd)){
    if( pConfig->eContent==1                 ){
      fts5SetVtabError(pTab,
          "'rebuild' may not be used with a contentless fts5 table"
      );
      rc =1            ;
    }else{
      rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageRebuild(pTab->pStorage);
    }
  }else if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("optimize",zCmd)){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageOptimize(pTab->pStorage);
  }else if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("merge",zCmd)){
    int nMerge =sqlite3_api->value_int(pVal);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageMerge(pTab->pStorage, nMerge);
  }else if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("integrity-check",zCmd)){
    int iArg =sqlite3_api->value_int(pVal);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageIntegrity(pTab->pStorage, iArg);

  }else if( 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("prefix-index",zCmd)){
    pConfig->bPrefixIndex =sqlite3_api->value_int(pVal);

  }else{
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexLoadConfig(pTab->p.pIndex);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sqlite3Fts5ConfigSetValue(pTab->p.pConfig, zCmd, pVal, &bError);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      if( bError ){
        rc =1            ;
      }else{
        rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageConfigValue(pTab->pStorage, zCmd, pVal, 0);
      }
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts5SpecialDelete(
  Fts5FullTable *pTab,
  sqlite3_value **apVal
){
  int rc =0         ;
  int eType1 =sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[1]);
  if( eType1==1              ){
    sqlite3_int64 iDel =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[1]);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iDel, &apVal[2]);
  }
  return rc;
}

static void fts5StorageInsert(
  int *pRc,
  Fts5FullTable *pTab,
  sqlite3_value **apVal,
  i64 *piRowid
){
  int rc = *pRc;
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageContentInsert(pTab->pStorage, apVal, piRowid);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageIndexInsert(pTab->pStorage, apVal, *piRowid);
  }
  *pRc = rc;
}















static int fts5UpdateMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apVal,
  sqlite_int64 *pRowid
){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  int eType0;
  int rc =0         ;


  assert( pTab->ts.eState==1 || pTab->ts.eState==2 );

  assert( pVtab->zErrMsg==0 );
  assert( nArg==1 || nArg==(2 +pConfig->nCol+2));
  assert(sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0])==1
       ||sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0])==5
  );
  assert( pTab->p.pConfig->pzErrmsg==0 );
  pTab->p.pConfig->pzErrmsg = &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg;


  fts5TripCursors(pTab);

  eType0 =sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[0]);
  if( eType0==5
   &&sqlite3_api->value_type(apVal[2 +pConfig->nCol])!=5
  ){

    const char *z = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apVal[2 +pConfig->nCol]);
    if( pConfig->eContent!=0
      && 0==sqlite3_api->stricmp("delete",z)
    ){
      rc = fts5SpecialDelete(pTab, apVal);
    }else{
      rc = fts5SpecialInsert(pTab, z, apVal[2 + pConfig->nCol + 1]);
    }
  }else{











    int eConflict =4            ;
    if( pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
      eConflict =sqlite3_api->vtab_on_conflict(pConfig->db);
    }

    assert( eType0==1              || eType0==5           );
    assert( nArg!=1 || eType0==1              );



    if( eType0==1              && fts5IsContentless(pTab) ){
      pTab->p.base.zErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
          "cannot %s contentless fts5 table: %s",
          (nArg>1 ? "UPDATE" : "DELETE from"), pConfig->zName
      );
      rc =1            ;
    }


    else if( nArg==1 ){
      i64 iDel =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[0]);
      rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iDel, 0);
    }


    else{
      int eType1 =sqlite3_api->value_numeric_type(apVal[1]);

      if( eType1!=1              && eType1!=5           ){
        rc =20              ;
      }

      else if( eType0!=1              ){

        if( eConflict==5              && eType1==1              ){
          i64 iNew =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[1]);
          rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iNew, 0);
        }
        fts5StorageInsert(&rc, pTab, apVal, pRowid);
      }


      else{
        i64 iOld =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[0]);
        i64 iNew =sqlite3_api->value_int64(apVal[1]);
        if( eType1==1              && iOld!=iNew ){
          if( eConflict==5              ){
            rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iOld, 0);
            if( rc==0         ){
              rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iNew, 0);
            }
            fts5StorageInsert(&rc, pTab, apVal, pRowid);
          }else{
            rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageContentInsert(pTab->pStorage, apVal, pRowid);
            if( rc==0         ){
              rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iOld, 0);
            }
            if( rc==0         ){
              rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageIndexInsert(pTab->pStorage, apVal,*pRowid);
            }
          }
        }else{
          rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(pTab->pStorage, iOld, 0);
          fts5StorageInsert(&rc, pTab, apVal, pRowid);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  pTab->p.pConfig->pzErrmsg = 0;
  return rc;
}




static int fts5SyncMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  int rc;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
                                               ;
  pTab->p.pConfig->pzErrmsg = &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg;
  fts5TripCursors(pTab);
  rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageSync(pTab->pStorage);
  pTab->p.pConfig->pzErrmsg = 0;
  return rc;
}




static int fts5BeginMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
                                                                 ;
  fts5NewTransaction((Fts5FullTable*)pVtab);
  return 0        ;
}






static int fts5CommitMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
(void)(pVtab)        ;
                                                                  ;
  return 0        ;
}





static int fts5RollbackMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab){
  int rc;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
                                                   ;
  rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageRollback(pTab->pStorage);
  return rc;
}

static int fts5CsrPoslist(Fts5Cursor*, int, const u8**, int*);

static void *fts5ApiUserData(Fts5Context *pCtx){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  return pCsr->pAux->pUserData;
}

static int fts5ApiColumnCount(Fts5Context *pCtx){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  return ((Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))->pConfig->nCol;
}

static int fts5ApiColumnTotalSize(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iCol,
  sqlite3_int64 *pnToken
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageSize(pTab->pStorage, iCol, pnToken);
}

static int fts5ApiRowCount(Fts5Context *pCtx, i64 *pnRow){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageRowCount(pTab->pStorage, pnRow);
}

static int fts5ApiTokenize(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  const char *pText, int nText,
  void *pUserData,
  int (*xToken)(void*, int, const char*, int, int, int)
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5Table *pTab = (Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  return sqlite3Fts5Tokenize(
      pTab->pConfig,0x0008            , pText, nText, pUserData, xToken
  );
}

static int fts5ApiPhraseCount(Fts5Context *pCtx){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  return sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCount(pCsr->pExpr);
}

static int fts5ApiPhraseSize(Fts5Context *pCtx, int iPhrase){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  return sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseSize(pCsr->pExpr, iPhrase);
}

static int fts5ApiColumnText(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iCol,
  const char **pz,
  int *pn
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  if( fts5IsContentless((Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))
   || pCsr->ePlan==3
  ){
    *pz = 0;
    *pn = 0;
  }else{
    rc = fts5SeekCursor(pCsr, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
      *pz = (const char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pCsr->pStmt,iCol+1);
      *pn =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pCsr->pStmt,iCol+1);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts5CsrPoslist(
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr,
  int iPhrase,
  const u8 **pa,
  int *pn
){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = ((Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))->pConfig;
  int rc =0         ;
  int bLive = (pCsr->pSorter==0);

  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x40))                 ){

    if( pConfig->eDetail!=0                ){
      Fts5PoslistPopulator *aPopulator;
      int i;
      aPopulator = sqlite3Fts5ExprClearPoslists(pCsr->pExpr, bLive);
      if( aPopulator==0 ) rc =7            ;
      for(i=0; i<pConfig->nCol && rc==0        ; i++){
        int n; const char *z;
        rc = fts5ApiColumnText((Fts5Context*)pCsr, i, &z, &n);
        if( rc==0         ){
          rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprPopulatePoslists(
              pConfig, pCsr->pExpr, aPopulator, i, z, n
          );
        }
      }
sqlite3_api->free (aPopulator);

      if( pCsr->pSorter ){
        sqlite3Fts5ExprCheckPoslists(pCsr->pExpr, pCsr->pSorter->iRowid);
      }
    }
((pCsr)->csrflags &= ~(0x40))                  ;
  }

  if( pCsr->pSorter && pConfig->eDetail==0                ){
    Fts5Sorter *pSorter = pCsr->pSorter;
    int i1 = (iPhrase==0 ? 0 : pSorter->aIdx[iPhrase-1]);
    *pn = pSorter->aIdx[iPhrase] - i1;
    *pa = &pSorter->aPoslist[i1];
  }else{
    *pn = sqlite3Fts5ExprPoslist(pCsr->pExpr, iPhrase, pa);
  }

  return rc;
}






static int fts5CacheInstArray(Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5PoslistReader *aIter;
  int nIter;
  int nCol = ((Fts5Table*)pCsr->base.pVtab)->pConfig->nCol;

  nIter = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCount(pCsr->pExpr);
  if( pCsr->aInstIter==0 ){
    sqlite3_int64 nByte = sizeof(Fts5PoslistReader) * nIter;
    pCsr->aInstIter = (Fts5PoslistReader*)sqlite3Fts5MallocZero(&rc, nByte);
  }
  aIter = pCsr->aInstIter;

  if( aIter ){
    int nInst = 0;
    int i;


    for(i=0; i<nIter && rc==0        ; i++){
      const u8 *a;
      int n;
      rc = fts5CsrPoslist(pCsr, i, &a, &n);
      if( rc==0         ){
        sqlite3Fts5PoslistReaderInit(a, n, &aIter[i]);
      }
    }

    if( rc==0         ){
      while( 1 ){
        int *aInst;
        int iBest = -1;
        for(i=0; i<nIter; i++){
          if( (aIter[i].bEof==0)
              && (iBest<0 || aIter[i].iPos<aIter[iBest].iPos)
            ){
            iBest = i;
          }
        }
        if( iBest<0 ) break;

        nInst++;
        if( nInst>=pCsr->nInstAlloc ){
          int nNewSize = pCsr->nInstAlloc ? pCsr->nInstAlloc*2 : 32;
          aInst = (int*)sqlite3_api->realloc64(
              pCsr->aInst, nNewSize*sizeof(int)*3
              );
          if( aInst ){
            pCsr->aInst = aInst;
            pCsr->nInstAlloc = nNewSize;
          }else{
            nInst--;
            rc =7            ;
            break;
          }
        }

        aInst = &pCsr->aInst[3 * (nInst-1)];
        aInst[0] = iBest;
        aInst[1] =(int)(aIter[iBest].iPos >> 32)     ;
        aInst[2] =(int)(aIter[iBest].iPos & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        if( aInst[1]<0 || aInst[1]>=nCol ){
          rc =sqlite3Fts5Corrupt();
          break;
        }
        sqlite3Fts5PoslistReaderNext(&aIter[iBest]);
      }
    }

    pCsr->nInstCount = nInst;
((pCsr)->csrflags &= ~(0x08))               ;
  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts5ApiInstCount(Fts5Context *pCtx, int *pnInst){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  int rc =0         ;
  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x08))             ==0
   ||0         ==(rc = fts5CacheInstArray(pCsr)) ){
    *pnInst = pCsr->nInstCount;
  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts5ApiInst(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iIdx,
  int *piPhrase,
  int *piCol,
  int *piOff
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  int rc =0         ;
  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x08))             ==0
   ||0         ==(rc = fts5CacheInstArray(pCsr))
  ){
    if( iIdx<0 || iIdx>=pCsr->nInstCount ){
      rc =25           ;

    }else if( fts5IsOffsetless((Fts5Table*)pCsr->base.pVtab) ){
      *piPhrase = pCsr->aInst[iIdx*3];
      *piCol = pCsr->aInst[iIdx*3 + 2];
      *piOff = -1;

    }else{
      *piPhrase = pCsr->aInst[iIdx*3];
      *piCol = pCsr->aInst[iIdx*3 + 1];
      *piOff = pCsr->aInst[iIdx*3 + 2];
    }
  }
  return rc;
}

static sqlite3_int64 fts5ApiRowid(Fts5Context *pCtx){
  return fts5CursorRowid((Fts5Cursor*)pCtx);
}

static int fts5ColumnSizeCb(
  void *pContext,
  int tflags,
  const char *pUnused,
  int nUnused,
  int iUnused1,
  int iUnused2
){
  int *pCnt = (int*)pContext;
(void)(pUnused), (void)(nUnused) ;
(void)(iUnused1), (void)(iUnused2) ;
  if( (tflags &0x0001               )==0 ){
    (*pCnt)++;
  }
  return 0        ;
}

static int fts5ApiColumnSize(Fts5Context *pCtx, int iCol, int *pnToken){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  int rc =0         ;

  if(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x04))                 ){
    if( pConfig->bColumnsize ){
      i64 iRowid = fts5CursorRowid(pCsr);
      rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDocsize(pTab->pStorage, iRowid, pCsr->aColumnSize);
    }else if( pConfig->zContent==0 ){
      int i;
      for(i=0; i<pConfig->nCol; i++){
        if( pConfig->abUnindexed[i]==0 ){
          pCsr->aColumnSize[i] = -1;
        }
      }
    }else{
      int i;
      for(i=0; rc==0         && i<pConfig->nCol; i++){
        if( pConfig->abUnindexed[i]==0 ){
          const char *z; int n;
          void *p = (void*)(&pCsr->aColumnSize[i]);
          pCsr->aColumnSize[i] = 0;
          rc = fts5ApiColumnText(pCtx, i, &z, &n);
          if( rc==0         ){
            rc = sqlite3Fts5Tokenize(
                pConfig,0x0008            , z, n, p, fts5ColumnSizeCb
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }
((pCsr)->csrflags &= ~(0x04))                  ;
  }
  if( iCol<0 ){
    int i;
    *pnToken = 0;
    for(i=0; i<pConfig->nCol; i++){
      *pnToken += pCsr->aColumnSize[i];
    }
  }else if( iCol<pConfig->nCol ){
    *pnToken = pCsr->aColumnSize[iCol];
  }else{
    *pnToken = 0;
    rc =25           ;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int fts5ApiSetAuxdata(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  void *pPtr,
  void(*xDelete)(void*)
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5Auxdata *pData;



  for(pData=pCsr->pAuxdata; pData; pData=pData->pNext){
    if( pData->pAux==pCsr->pAux ) break;
  }

  if( pData ){
    if( pData->xDelete ){
      pData->xDelete(pData->pPtr);
    }
  }else{
    int rc =0         ;
    pData = (Fts5Auxdata*)sqlite3Fts5MallocZero(&rc, sizeof(Fts5Auxdata));
    if( pData==0 ){
      if( xDelete ) xDelete(pPtr);
      return rc;
    }
    pData->pAux = pCsr->pAux;
    pData->pNext = pCsr->pAuxdata;
    pCsr->pAuxdata = pData;
  }

  pData->xDelete = xDelete;
  pData->pPtr = pPtr;
  return 0        ;
}

static void *fts5ApiGetAuxdata(Fts5Context *pCtx, int bClear){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5Auxdata *pData;
  void *pRet = 0;

  for(pData=pCsr->pAuxdata; pData; pData=pData->pNext){
    if( pData->pAux==pCsr->pAux ) break;
  }

  if( pData ){
    pRet = pData->pPtr;
    if( bClear ){
      pData->pPtr = 0;
      pData->xDelete = 0;
    }
  }

  return pRet;
}

static void fts5ApiPhraseNext(
  Fts5Context *pUnused,
  Fts5PhraseIter *pIter,
  int *piCol, int *piOff
){
(void)(pUnused)        ;
  if( pIter->a>=pIter->b ){
    *piCol = -1;
    *piOff = -1;
  }else{
    int iVal;
    pIter->a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(pIter->a,(u32*)&iVal);
    if( iVal==1 ){
      pIter->a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(pIter->a,(u32*)&iVal);
      *piCol = iVal;
      *piOff = 0;
      pIter->a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(pIter->a,(u32*)&iVal);
    }
    *piOff += (iVal-2);
  }
}

static int fts5ApiPhraseFirst(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iPhrase,
  Fts5PhraseIter *pIter,
  int *piCol, int *piOff
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  int n;
  int rc = fts5CsrPoslist(pCsr, iPhrase, &pIter->a, &n);
  if( rc==0         ){
    assert( pIter->a || n==0 );
    pIter->b = (pIter->a ? &pIter->a[n] : 0);
    *piCol = 0;
    *piOff = 0;
    fts5ApiPhraseNext(pCtx, pIter, piCol, piOff);
  }
  return rc;
}

static void fts5ApiPhraseNextColumn(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  Fts5PhraseIter *pIter,
  int *piCol
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = ((Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))->pConfig;

  if( pConfig->eDetail==2                   ){
    if( pIter->a>=pIter->b ){
      *piCol = -1;
    }else{
      int iIncr;
      pIter->a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(&pIter->a[0],(u32*)&iIncr);
      *piCol += (iIncr-2);
    }
  }else{
    while( 1 ){
      int dummy;
      if( pIter->a>=pIter->b ){
        *piCol = -1;
        return;
      }
      if( pIter->a[0]==0x01 ) break;
      pIter->a +=sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(pIter->a,(u32*)&dummy);
    }
    pIter->a += 1 +sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(&pIter->a[1],(u32*)&*piCol);
  }
}

static int fts5ApiPhraseFirstColumn(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iPhrase,
  Fts5PhraseIter *pIter,
  int *piCol
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5Config *pConfig = ((Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))->pConfig;

  if( pConfig->eDetail==2                   ){
    Fts5Sorter *pSorter = pCsr->pSorter;
    int n;
    if( pSorter ){
      int i1 = (iPhrase==0 ? 0 : pSorter->aIdx[iPhrase-1]);
      n = pSorter->aIdx[iPhrase] - i1;
      pIter->a = &pSorter->aPoslist[i1];
    }else{
      rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCollist(pCsr->pExpr, iPhrase, &pIter->a, &n);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      assert( pIter->a || n==0 );
      pIter->b = (pIter->a ? &pIter->a[n] : 0);
      *piCol = 0;
      fts5ApiPhraseNextColumn(pCtx, pIter, piCol);
    }
  }else{
    int n;
    rc = fts5CsrPoslist(pCsr, iPhrase, &pIter->a, &n);
    if( rc==0         ){
      assert( pIter->a || n==0 );
      pIter->b = (pIter->a ? &pIter->a[n] : 0);
      if( n<=0 ){
        *piCol = -1;
      }else if( pIter->a[0]==0x01 ){
        pIter->a += 1 +sqlite3Fts5GetVarint32(&pIter->a[1],(u32*)&*piCol);
      }else{
        *piCol = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  return rc;
}


static int fts5ApiQueryPhrase(Fts5Context*, int, void*,
    int(*)(const Fts5ExtensionApi*, Fts5Context*, void*)
);

static const Fts5ExtensionApi sFts5Api = {
  2,
  fts5ApiUserData,
  fts5ApiColumnCount,
  fts5ApiRowCount,
  fts5ApiColumnTotalSize,
  fts5ApiTokenize,
  fts5ApiPhraseCount,
  fts5ApiPhraseSize,
  fts5ApiInstCount,
  fts5ApiInst,
  fts5ApiRowid,
  fts5ApiColumnText,
  fts5ApiColumnSize,
  fts5ApiQueryPhrase,
  fts5ApiSetAuxdata,
  fts5ApiGetAuxdata,
  fts5ApiPhraseFirst,
  fts5ApiPhraseNext,
  fts5ApiPhraseFirstColumn,
  fts5ApiPhraseNextColumn,
};




static int fts5ApiQueryPhrase(
  Fts5Context *pCtx,
  int iPhrase,
  void *pUserData,
  int(*xCallback)(const Fts5ExtensionApi*, Fts5Context*, void*)
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCtx;
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCsr->base.pVtab);
  int rc;
  Fts5Cursor *pNew = 0;

  rc = fts5OpenMethod(pCsr->base.pVtab, (sqlite3_vtab_cursor**)&pNew);
  if( rc==0         ){
    pNew->ePlan =1               ;
    pNew->iFirstRowid =(((i64)-1) - (0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32)));
    pNew->iLastRowid =(0xffffffff|(((i64)0x7fffffff)<<32));
    pNew->base.pVtab = (sqlite3_vtab*)pTab;
    rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprClonePhrase(pCsr->pExpr, iPhrase, &pNew->pExpr);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    for(rc = fts5CursorFirst(pTab, pNew, 0);
        rc==0         &&((pNew)->csrflags & (0x01))    ==0;
        rc = fts5NextMethod((sqlite3_vtab_cursor*)pNew)
    ){
      rc = xCallback(&sFts5Api, (Fts5Context*)pNew, pUserData);
      if( rc!=0         ){
        if( rc==101         ) rc =0         ;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  fts5CloseMethod((sqlite3_vtab_cursor*)pNew);
  return rc;
}

static void fts5ApiInvoke(
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux,
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr,
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){
  assert( pCsr->pAux==0 );
  pCsr->pAux = pAux;
  pAux->xFunc(&sFts5Api, (Fts5Context*)pCsr, context, argc, argv);
  pCsr->pAux = 0;
}

static Fts5Cursor *fts5CursorFromCsrid(Fts5Global *pGlobal, i64 iCsrId){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr;
  for(pCsr=pGlobal->pCsr; pCsr; pCsr=pCsr->pNext){
    if( pCsr->iCsrId==iCsrId ) break;
  }
  return pCsr;
}

static void fts5ApiCallback(
  sqlite3_context *context,
  int argc,
  sqlite3_value **argv
){

  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr;
  i64 iCsrId;

  assert( argc>=1 );
  pAux = (Fts5Auxiliary*)sqlite3_api->user_data(context);
  iCsrId =sqlite3_api->value_int64(argv[0]);

  pCsr = fts5CursorFromCsrid(pAux->pGlobal, iCsrId);
  if( pCsr==0 || pCsr->ePlan==0 ){
    char *zErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("no such cursor: %lld",iCsrId);
sqlite3_api->result_error(context,zErr, -1);
sqlite3_api->free(zErr);
  }else{
    fts5ApiInvoke(pAux, pCsr, context, argc-1, &argv[1]);
  }
}






static Fts5Table *sqlite3Fts5TableFromCsrid(
  Fts5Global *pGlobal,
  i64 iCsrId
){
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr;
  pCsr = fts5CursorFromCsrid(pGlobal, iCsrId);
  if( pCsr ){
    return (Fts5Table*)pCsr->base.pVtab;
  }
  return 0;
}
















static int fts5PoslistBlob(sqlite3_context *pCtx, Fts5Cursor *pCsr){
  int i;
  int rc =0         ;
  int nPhrase = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCount(pCsr->pExpr);
  Fts5Buffer val;

  memset(&val, 0, sizeof(Fts5Buffer));
  switch( ((Fts5Table*)(pCsr->base.pVtab))->pConfig->eDetail ){
    case 0               :


      for(i=0; i<(nPhrase-1); i++){
        const u8 *dummy;
        int nByte = sqlite3Fts5ExprPoslist(pCsr->pExpr, i, &dummy);
        sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendVarint(&rc, &val, nByte);
      }


      for(i=0; i<nPhrase; i++){
        const u8 *pPoslist;
        int nPoslist;
        nPoslist = sqlite3Fts5ExprPoslist(pCsr->pExpr, i, &pPoslist);
        sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendBlob(&rc, &val, nPoslist, pPoslist);
      }
      break;

    case 2                  :


      for(i=0; rc==0         && i<(nPhrase-1); i++){
        const u8 *dummy;
        int nByte;
        rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCollist(pCsr->pExpr, i, &dummy, &nByte);
        sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendVarint(&rc, &val, nByte);
      }


      for(i=0; rc==0         && i<nPhrase; i++){
        const u8 *pPoslist;
        int nPoslist;
        rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprPhraseCollist(pCsr->pExpr, i, &pPoslist, &nPoslist);
        sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendBlob(&rc, &val, nPoslist, pPoslist);
      }
      break;

    default:
      break;
  }

sqlite3_api->result_blob(pCtx,val.p,val.n,sqlite3_api->free);
  return rc;
}





static int fts5ColumnMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab_cursor *pCursor,
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int iCol
){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)(pCursor->pVtab);
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pTab->p.pConfig;
  Fts5Cursor *pCsr = (Fts5Cursor*)pCursor;
  int rc =0         ;

  assert(((pCsr)->csrflags & (0x01))    ==0 );

  if( pCsr->ePlan==3                 ){
    if( iCol==pConfig->nCol ){
sqlite3_api->result_int64 (pCtx, pCsr->iSpecial);
    }
  }else

  if( iCol==pConfig->nCol ){




sqlite3_api->result_int64(pCtx,pCsr->iCsrId);
  }else if( iCol==pConfig->nCol+1 ){


    if( pCsr->ePlan==2                ){
      fts5PoslistBlob(pCtx, pCsr);
    }else if(
        pCsr->ePlan==1
     || pCsr->ePlan==4
    ){
      if( pCsr->pRank ||0         ==(rc = fts5FindRankFunction(pCsr)) ){
        fts5ApiInvoke(pCsr->pRank, pCsr, pCtx, pCsr->nRankArg, pCsr->apRankArg);
      }
    }
  }else if( !fts5IsContentless(pTab) ){
    pConfig->pzErrmsg = &pTab->p.base.zErrMsg;
    rc = fts5SeekCursor(pCsr, 1);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->result_value (pCtx,sqlite3_api->column_value(pCsr->pStmt,iCol+1));
    }
    pConfig->pzErrmsg = 0;
  }
  return rc;
}






static int fts5FindFunctionMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  int nUnused,
  const char *zName,
  void (**pxFunc)(sqlite3_context*,int,sqlite3_value**),
  void **ppArg
){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;

(void)(nUnused)        ;
  pAux = fts5FindAuxiliary(pTab, zName);
  if( pAux ){
    *pxFunc = fts5ApiCallback;
    *ppArg = (void*)pAux;
    return 1;
  }


  return 0;
}




static int fts5RenameMethod(
  sqlite3_vtab *pVtab,
  const char *zName
){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageRename(pTab->pStorage, zName);
}

static int sqlite3Fts5FlushToDisk(Fts5Table *pTab){
  fts5TripCursors((Fts5FullTable*)pTab);
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageSync(((Fts5FullTable*)pTab)->pStorage);
}






static int fts5SavepointMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab, int iSavepoint){
(void)(iSavepoint)        ;
                                                                              ;
  return sqlite3Fts5FlushToDisk((Fts5Table*)pVtab);
}






static int fts5ReleaseMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab, int iSavepoint){
(void)(iSavepoint)        ;
                                                                            ;
  return sqlite3Fts5FlushToDisk((Fts5Table*)pVtab);
}






static int fts5RollbackToMethod(sqlite3_vtab *pVtab, int iSavepoint){
  Fts5FullTable *pTab = (Fts5FullTable*)pVtab;
(void)(iSavepoint)        ;
                                                              ;
  fts5TripCursors(pTab);
  return sqlite3Fts5StorageRollback(pTab->pStorage);
}




static int fts5CreateAux(
  fts5_api *pApi,
  const char *zName,
  void *pUserData,
  fts5_extension_function xFunc,
  void(*xDestroy)(void*)
){
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)pApi;
  int rc =sqlite3_api->overload_function(pGlobal->db,zName,-1);
  if( rc==0         ){
    Fts5Auxiliary *pAux;
    sqlite3_int64 nName;
    sqlite3_int64 nByte;

    nName = strlen(zName) + 1;
    nByte = sizeof(Fts5Auxiliary) + nName;
    pAux = (Fts5Auxiliary*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
    if( pAux ){
      memset(pAux, 0, (size_t)nByte);
      pAux->zFunc = (char*)&pAux[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pAux->zFunc);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zName); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
      pAux->pGlobal = pGlobal;
      pAux->pUserData = pUserData;
      pAux->xFunc = xFunc;
      pAux->xDestroy = xDestroy;
      pAux->pNext = pGlobal->pAux;
      pGlobal->pAux = pAux;
    }else{
      rc =7            ;
    }
  }

  return rc;
}





static int fts5CreateTokenizer(
  fts5_api *pApi,
  const char *zName,
  void *pUserData,
  fts5_tokenizer *pTokenizer,
  void(*xDestroy)(void*)
){
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)pApi;
  Fts5TokenizerModule *pNew;
  sqlite3_int64 nName;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;
  int rc =0         ;

  nName = strlen(zName) + 1;
  nByte = sizeof(Fts5TokenizerModule) + nName;
  pNew = (Fts5TokenizerModule*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( pNew ){
    memset(pNew, 0, (size_t)nByte);
    pNew->zName = (char*)&pNew[1];
{char*xxd=(char*)(pNew->zName);const char*xxs=(const char*)(zName); int xxn=(nName);while(xxn-->0)*(xxd++)=*(xxs++);};
    pNew->pUserData = pUserData;
    pNew->x = *pTokenizer;
    pNew->xDestroy = xDestroy;
    pNew->pNext = pGlobal->pTok;
    pGlobal->pTok = pNew;
    if( pNew->pNext==0 ){
      pGlobal->pDfltTok = pNew;
    }
  }else{
    rc =7            ;
  }

  return rc;
}

static Fts5TokenizerModule *fts5LocateTokenizer(
  Fts5Global *pGlobal,
  const char *zName
){
  Fts5TokenizerModule *pMod = 0;

  if( zName==0 ){
    pMod = pGlobal->pDfltTok;
  }else{
    for(pMod=pGlobal->pTok; pMod; pMod=pMod->pNext){
      if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,pMod->zName)==0)break;
    }
  }

  return pMod;
}





static int fts5FindTokenizer(
  fts5_api *pApi,
  const char *zName,
  void **ppUserData,
  fts5_tokenizer *pTokenizer
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5TokenizerModule *pMod;

  pMod = fts5LocateTokenizer((Fts5Global*)pApi, zName);
  if( pMod ){
    *pTokenizer = pMod->x;
    *ppUserData = pMod->pUserData;
  }else{
    memset(pTokenizer, 0, sizeof(fts5_tokenizer));
    rc =1            ;
  }

  return rc;
}

static int sqlite3Fts5GetTokenizer(
  Fts5Global *pGlobal,
  const char **azArg,
  int nArg,
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  char **pzErr
){
  Fts5TokenizerModule *pMod;
  int rc =0         ;

  pMod = fts5LocateTokenizer(pGlobal, nArg==0 ? 0 : azArg[0]);
  if( pMod==0 ){
    assert( nArg>0 );
    rc =1            ;
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("no such tokenizer: %s",azArg[0]);
  }else{
    rc = pMod->x.xCreate(
        pMod->pUserData, (azArg?&azArg[1]:0), (nArg?nArg-1:0), &pConfig->pTok
    );
    pConfig->pTokApi = &pMod->x;
    if( rc!=0         ){
      if( pzErr ) *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf("error in tokenizer constructor");
    }else{
      pConfig->ePattern = sqlite3Fts5TokenizerPattern(
          pMod->x.xCreate, pConfig->pTok
      );
    }
  }

  if( rc!=0         ){
    pConfig->pTokApi = 0;
    pConfig->pTok = 0;
  }

  return rc;
}

static void fts5ModuleDestroy(void *pCtx){
  Fts5TokenizerModule *pTok, *pNextTok;
  Fts5Auxiliary *pAux, *pNextAux;
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)pCtx;

  for(pAux=pGlobal->pAux; pAux; pAux=pNextAux){
    pNextAux = pAux->pNext;
    if( pAux->xDestroy ) pAux->xDestroy(pAux->pUserData);
sqlite3_api->free(pAux);
  }

  for(pTok=pGlobal->pTok; pTok; pTok=pNextTok){
    pNextTok = pTok->pNext;
    if( pTok->xDestroy ) pTok->xDestroy(pTok->pUserData);
sqlite3_api->free(pTok);
  }

sqlite3_api->free(pGlobal);
}

static void fts5Fts5Func(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apArg
){
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)sqlite3_api->user_data(pCtx);
  fts5_api **ppApi;
(void)(nArg)        ;
  assert( nArg==1 );
  ppApi = (fts5_api**)sqlite3_api->value_pointer(apArg[0],"fts5_api_ptr");
  if( ppApi ) *ppApi = &pGlobal->api;
}




static void fts5SourceIdFunc(
  sqlite3_context *pCtx,
  int nArg,
  sqlite3_value **apUnused
){
  assert( nArg==0 );
(void)(nArg), (void)(apUnused) ;
sqlite3_api->result_text(pCtx,"fts5: 2023-03-22 11:56:21 0d1fc92f94cb6b76bffe3ec34d69cffde2924203304e8ffc4155597af0c191da",-1,((sqlite3_destructor_type)-1));
}





static int fts5ShadowName(const char *zName){
  static const char *azName[] = {
    "config", "content", "data", "docsize", "idx"
  };
  unsigned int i;
  for(i=0; i<sizeof(azName)/sizeof(azName[0]); i++){
    if(sqlite3_api->stricmp(zName,azName[i])==0)return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

static int fts5Init(sqlite3 *db){
  static const sqlite3_module fts5Mod = {
                        3,
                        fts5CreateMethod,
                        fts5ConnectMethod,
                        fts5BestIndexMethod,
                        fts5DisconnectMethod,
                        fts5DestroyMethod,
                        fts5OpenMethod,
                        fts5CloseMethod,
                        fts5FilterMethod,
                        fts5NextMethod,
                        fts5EofMethod,
                        fts5ColumnMethod,
                        fts5RowidMethod,
                        fts5UpdateMethod,
                        fts5BeginMethod,
                        fts5SyncMethod,
                        fts5CommitMethod,
                        fts5RollbackMethod,
                        fts5FindFunctionMethod,
                        fts5RenameMethod,
                        fts5SavepointMethod,
                        fts5ReleaseMethod,
                        fts5RollbackToMethod,
                        fts5ShadowName
  };

  int rc;
  Fts5Global *pGlobal = 0;

  pGlobal = (Fts5Global*)sqlite3_api->malloc(sizeof(Fts5Global));
  if( pGlobal==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    void *p = (void*)pGlobal;
    memset(pGlobal, 0, sizeof(Fts5Global));
    pGlobal->db = db;
    pGlobal->api.iVersion = 2;
    pGlobal->api.xCreateFunction = fts5CreateAux;
    pGlobal->api.xCreateTokenizer = fts5CreateTokenizer;
    pGlobal->api.xFindTokenizer = fts5FindTokenizer;
    rc =sqlite3_api->create_module_v2(db,"fts5",&fts5Mod,p,fts5ModuleDestroy);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexInit(db);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts5ExprInit(pGlobal, db);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts5AuxInit(&pGlobal->api);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts5TokenizerInit(&pGlobal->api);
    if( rc==0         ) rc = sqlite3Fts5VocabInit(pGlobal, db);
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(
          db, "fts5", 1,1           , p, fts5Fts5Func, 0, 0
      );
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc =sqlite3_api->create_function(
          db, "fts5_source_id", 0,
1                    |0x000000800         |0x000200000     ,
          p, fts5SourceIdFunc, 0, 0
      );
    }
  }





  if( rc==0         ){
    extern int sqlite3Fts5TestRegisterMatchinfo(sqlite3*);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5TestRegisterMatchinfo(db);
  }


  return rc;
}

           int sqlite3_fts_init(

  char **pzErrMsg,
  const sqlite3_api_routines *pApi
){
sqlite3_api=pApi;             ;
  (void)pzErrMsg;
  return fts5Init(db);
}

           int sqlite3_fts5_init(

  const sqlite3_api_routines *pApi
){
sqlite3_api=pApi;             ;
  (void)pzErrMsg;
  return fts5Init(db);
}

static         int sqlite3Fts5Init(sqlite3 *db){
  return fts5Init(db);
}




















struct Fts5Storage {
  Fts5Config *pConfig;
  Fts5Index *pIndex;
  int bTotalsValid;
  i64 nTotalRow;
  i64 *aTotalSize;
  sqlite3_stmt *aStmt[11];
};



























static int fts5StorageGetStmt(
  Fts5Storage *p,
  int eStmt,
  sqlite3_stmt **ppStmt,
  char **pzErrMsg
){
  int rc =0         ;



  assert( p->pConfig->bColumnsize || (
        eStmt!=6
     && eStmt!=7
     && eStmt!=8
  ));

  assert( eStmt>=0 && eStmt<((int)(sizeof(p->aStmt)/sizeof(p->aStmt[0]))));
  if( p->aStmt[eStmt]==0 ){
    const char *azStmt[] = {
      "SELECT %s FROM %s T WHERE T.%Q >= ? AND T.%Q <= ? ORDER BY T.%Q ASC",
      "SELECT %s FROM %s T WHERE T.%Q <= ? AND T.%Q >= ? ORDER BY T.%Q DESC",
      "SELECT %s FROM %s T WHERE T.%Q=?",

      "INSERT INTO %Q.'%q_content' VALUES(%s)",
      "REPLACE INTO %Q.'%q_content' VALUES(%s)",
      "DELETE FROM %Q.'%q_content' WHERE id=?",
      "REPLACE INTO %Q.'%q_docsize' VALUES(?,?)",
      "DELETE FROM %Q.'%q_docsize' WHERE id=?",

      "SELECT sz FROM %Q.'%q_docsize' WHERE id=?",

      "REPLACE INTO %Q.'%q_config' VALUES(?,?)",
      "SELECT %s FROM %s AS T",
    };
    Fts5Config *pC = p->pConfig;
    char *zSql = 0;

    switch( eStmt ){
      case 10            :
        zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(azStmt[eStmt],
            pC->zContentExprlist, pC->zContent
        );
        break;

      case 0                 :
      case 1                  :
        zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(azStmt[eStmt],pC->zContentExprlist,
            pC->zContent, pC->zContentRowid, pC->zContentRowid,
            pC->zContentRowid
        );
        break;

      case 2               :
        zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(azStmt[eStmt],
            pC->zContentExprlist, pC->zContent, pC->zContentRowid
        );
        break;

      case 3                       :
      case 4                        : {
        int nCol = pC->nCol + 1;
        char *zBind;
        int i;

        zBind =sqlite3_api->malloc64(1 +nCol*2);
        if( zBind ){
          for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
            zBind[i*2] = '?';
            zBind[i*2 + 1] = ',';
          }
          zBind[i*2 -1]= '\0';
          zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(azStmt[eStmt],pC->zDb,pC->zName,zBind);
sqlite3_api->free     (zBind);
        }
        break;
      }

      default:
        zSql =sqlite3_api->mprintf(azStmt[eStmt],pC->zDb,pC->zName);
        break;
    }

    if( zSql==0 ){
      rc =7            ;
    }else{
      int f =0x01                      ;
      if( eStmt>2                ) f |=0x04                   ;
      p->pConfig->bLock++;
      rc =sqlite3_api->prepare_v3(pC->db,zSql,-1,f,&p->aStmt[eStmt], 0);
      p->pConfig->bLock--;
sqlite3_api->free (zSql);
      if( rc!=0         && pzErrMsg ){
        *pzErrMsg =sqlite3_api->mprintf("%s",sqlite3_api->errmsg(pC->db));
      }
    }
  }

  *ppStmt = p->aStmt[eStmt];
sqlite3_api->reset(*ppStmt);
  return rc;
}


static int fts5ExecPrintf(
  sqlite3 *db,
  char **pzErr,
  const char *zFormat,
  ...
){
  int rc;
  va_list ap;
  char *zSql;

  va_start(ap, zFormat);
  zSql =sqlite3_api->vmprintf(zFormat,ap);

  if( zSql==0 ){
    rc =7            ;
  }else{
    rc =sqlite3_api->exec(db,zSql,0,0,pzErr);
sqlite3_api->free(zSql);
  }

  va_end(ap);
  return rc;
}





static int sqlite3Fts5DropAll(Fts5Config *pConfig){
  int rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
      "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %Q.'%q_data';"
      "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %Q.'%q_idx';"
      "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %Q.'%q_config';",
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName,
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName,
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName
  );
  if( rc==0         && pConfig->bColumnsize ){
    rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %Q.'%q_docsize';",
        pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName
    );
  }
  if( rc==0         && pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
    rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %Q.'%q_content';",
        pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName
    );
  }
  return rc;
}

static void fts5StorageRenameOne(
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  int *pRc,
  const char *zTail,
  const char *zName
){
  if( *pRc==0         ){
    *pRc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
        "ALTER TABLE %Q.'%q_%s' RENAME TO '%q_%s';",
        pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName, zTail, zName, zTail
    );
  }
}

static int sqlite3Fts5StorageRename(Fts5Storage *pStorage, const char *zName){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = pStorage->pConfig;
  int rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageSync(pStorage);

  fts5StorageRenameOne(pConfig, &rc, "data", zName);
  fts5StorageRenameOne(pConfig, &rc, "idx", zName);
  fts5StorageRenameOne(pConfig, &rc, "config", zName);
  if( pConfig->bColumnsize ){
    fts5StorageRenameOne(pConfig, &rc, "docsize", zName);
  }
  if( pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
    fts5StorageRenameOne(pConfig, &rc, "content", zName);
  }
  return rc;
}





static int sqlite3Fts5CreateTable(
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  const char *zPost,
  const char *zDefn,
  int bWithout,
  char **pzErr
){
  int rc;
  char *zErr = 0;

  rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, &zErr, "CREATE TABLE %Q.'%q_%q'(%s)%s",
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName, zPost, zDefn,

      bWithout?" WITHOUT ROWID":

      ""
  );
  if( zErr ){
    *pzErr =sqlite3_api->mprintf(
        "fts5: error creating shadow table %q_%s: %s",
        pConfig->zName, zPost, zErr
    );
sqlite3_api->free(zErr);
  }

  return rc;
}








static int sqlite3Fts5StorageOpen(
  Fts5Config *pConfig,
  Fts5Index *pIndex,
  int bCreate,
  Fts5Storage **pp,
  char **pzErr
){
  int rc =0         ;
  Fts5Storage *p;
  sqlite3_int64 nByte;

  nByte = sizeof(Fts5Storage)
        + pConfig->nCol * sizeof(i64);
  *pp = p = (Fts5Storage*)sqlite3_api->malloc64(nByte);
  if( !p ) return 7           ;

  memset(p, 0, (size_t)nByte);
  p->aTotalSize = (i64*)&p[1];
  p->pConfig = pConfig;
  p->pIndex = pIndex;

  if( bCreate ){
    if( pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
      int nDefn = 32 + pConfig->nCol*10;
      char *zDefn =sqlite3_api->malloc64(32 +(sqlite3_int64)pConfig->nCol*10);
      if( zDefn==0 ){
        rc =7            ;
      }else{
        int i;
        int iOff;
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf  (nDefn, zDefn, "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY");
        iOff = (int)strlen(zDefn);
        for(i=0; i<pConfig->nCol; i++){
sqlite3_api->xsnprintf    (nDefn-iOff, &zDefn[iOff], ", c%d", i);
          iOff += (int)strlen(&zDefn[iOff]);
        }
        rc = sqlite3Fts5CreateTable(pConfig, "content", zDefn, 0, pzErr);
      }
sqlite3_api->free (zDefn);
    }

    if( rc==0         && pConfig->bColumnsize ){
      rc = sqlite3Fts5CreateTable(
          pConfig, "docsize", "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB", 0, pzErr
      );
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sqlite3Fts5CreateTable(
          pConfig, "config", "k PRIMARY KEY, v", 1, pzErr
      );
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageConfigValue(p, "version", 0,4                    );
    }
  }

  if( rc ){
    sqlite3Fts5StorageClose(p);
    *pp = 0;
  }
  return rc;
}




static int sqlite3Fts5StorageClose(Fts5Storage *p){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( p ){
    int i;


    for(i=0; i<((int)(sizeof(p->aStmt)/sizeof(p->aStmt[0])));i++){
sqlite3_api->finalize (p->aStmt[i]);
    }

sqlite3_api->free(p);
  }
  return rc;
}

typedef struct Fts5InsertCtx Fts5InsertCtx;
struct Fts5InsertCtx {
  Fts5Storage *pStorage;
  int iCol;
  int szCol;
};




static int fts5StorageInsertCallback(
  void *pContext,
  int tflags,
  const char *pToken,
  int nToken,
  int iUnused1,
  int iUnused2
){
  Fts5InsertCtx *pCtx = (Fts5InsertCtx*)pContext;
  Fts5Index *pIdx = pCtx->pStorage->pIndex;
(void)(iUnused1), (void)(iUnused2) ;
  if( nToken>32768               ) nToken =32768               ;
  if( (tflags &0x0001               )==0 || pCtx->szCol==0 ){
    pCtx->szCol++;
  }
  return sqlite3Fts5IndexWrite(pIdx, pCtx->iCol, pCtx->szCol-1, pToken, nToken);
}






static int fts5StorageDeleteFromIndex(
  Fts5Storage *p,
  i64 iDel,
  sqlite3_value **apVal
){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = p->pConfig;
  sqlite3_stmt *pSeek = 0;
  int rc;
  int rc2;
  int iCol;
  Fts5InsertCtx ctx;

  if( apVal==0 ){
    rc = fts5StorageGetStmt(p,2                , &pSeek, 0);
    if( rc!=0         ) return rc;
sqlite3_api->bind_int64(pSeek,1, iDel);
    if(sqlite3_api->step(pSeek)!=100    ){
      return sqlite3_api->reset(pSeek);
    }
  }

  ctx.pStorage = p;
  ctx.iCol = -1;
  rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexBeginWrite(p->pIndex, 1, iDel);
  for(iCol=1; rc==0         && iCol<=pConfig->nCol; iCol++){
    if( pConfig->abUnindexed[iCol-1]==0 ){
      const char *zText;
      int nText;
      assert( pSeek==0 || apVal==0 );
      assert( pSeek!=0 || apVal!=0 );
      if( pSeek ){
        zText = (const char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pSeek,iCol);
        nText =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pSeek,iCol);
      }else if((1)            ){
        zText = (const char*)sqlite3_api->value_text(apVal[iCol-1]);
        nText =sqlite3_api->value_bytes(apVal[iCol-1]);
      }else{
        continue;
      }
      ctx.szCol = 0;
      rc = sqlite3Fts5Tokenize(pConfig,0x0004                 ,
          zText, nText, (void*)&ctx, fts5StorageInsertCallback
      );
      p->aTotalSize[iCol-1] -= (i64)ctx.szCol;
      if( p->aTotalSize[iCol-1]<0 ){
        rc =sqlite3Fts5Corrupt();
      }
    }
  }
  if( rc==0         && p->nTotalRow<1 ){
    rc =sqlite3Fts5Corrupt();
  }else{
    p->nTotalRow--;
  }

  rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pSeek);
  if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;
  return rc;
}










static int fts5StorageInsertDocsize(
  Fts5Storage *p,
  i64 iRowid,
  Fts5Buffer *pBuf
){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( p->pConfig->bColumnsize ){
    sqlite3_stmt *pReplace = 0;
    rc = fts5StorageGetStmt(p,6                         , &pReplace, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pReplace, 1, iRowid);
sqlite3_api->bind_blob (pReplace, 2, pBuf->p, pBuf->n,((sqlite3_destructor_type)0));
sqlite3_api->step (pReplace);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pReplace);
sqlite3_api->bind_null (pReplace, 2);
    }
  }
  return rc;
}











static int fts5StorageLoadTotals(Fts5Storage *p, int bCache){
  int rc =0         ;
  if( p->bTotalsValid==0 ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexGetAverages(p->pIndex, &p->nTotalRow, p->aTotalSize);
    p->bTotalsValid = bCache;
  }
  return rc;
}








static int fts5StorageSaveTotals(Fts5Storage *p){
  int nCol = p->pConfig->nCol;
  int i;
  Fts5Buffer buf;
  int rc =0         ;
  memset(&buf, 0, sizeof(buf));

  sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendVarint(&rc, &buf, p->nTotalRow);
  for(i=0; i<nCol; i++){
    sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendVarint(&rc, &buf, p->aTotalSize[i]);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexSetAverages(p->pIndex, buf.p, buf.n);
  }
sqlite3_api->free(buf.p);

  return rc;
}




static int sqlite3Fts5StorageDelete(Fts5Storage *p, i64 iDel, sqlite3_value **apVal){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = p->pConfig;
  int rc;
  sqlite3_stmt *pDel = 0;

  assert( pConfig->eContent!=0                   || apVal==0 );
  rc = fts5StorageLoadTotals(p, 1);


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts5StorageDeleteFromIndex(p, iDel, apVal);
  }


  if( rc==0         && pConfig->bColumnsize ){
    rc = fts5StorageGetStmt(p,7                        , &pDel, 0);
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDel, 1, iDel);
sqlite3_api->step (pDel);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDel);
    }
  }


  if( pConfig->eContent==0                   ){
    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts5StorageGetStmt(p,5                        , &pDel, 0);
    }
    if( rc==0         ){
sqlite3_api->bind_int64 (pDel, 1, iDel);
sqlite3_api->step (pDel);
      rc =sqlite3_api->reset(pDel);
    }
  }

  return rc;
}




static int sqlite3Fts5StorageDeleteAll(Fts5Storage *p){
  Fts5Config *pConfig = p->pConfig;
  int rc;

  p->bTotalsValid = 0;


  rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
      "DELETE FROM %Q.'%q_data';"
      "DELETE FROM %Q.'%q_idx';",
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName,
      pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName
  );
  if( rc==0         && pConfig->bColumnsize ){
    rc = fts5ExecPrintf(pConfig->db, 0,
        "DELETE FROM %Q.'%q_docsize';",
        pConfig->zDb, pConfig->zName
    );
  }



  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexReinit(p->pIndex);
  }
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageConfigValue(p, "version", 0,4                    );
  }
  return rc;
}

static int sqlite3Fts5StorageRebuild(Fts5Storage *p){
  Fts5Buffer buf = {0,0,0};
  Fts5Config *pConfig = p->pConfig;
  sqlite3_stmt *pScan = 0;
  Fts5InsertCtx ctx;
  int rc, rc2;

  memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(Fts5InsertCtx));
  ctx.pStorage = p;
  rc = sqlite3Fts5StorageDeleteAll(p);
  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts5StorageLoadTotals(p, 1);
  }

  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts5StorageGetStmt(p,10             , &pScan, 0);
  }

  while( rc==0         &&100        ==sqlite3_api->step(pScan)){
    i64 iRowid =sqlite3_api->column_int64(pScan,0);

    sqlite3Fts5BufferZero(&buf);
    rc = sqlite3Fts5IndexBeginWrite(p->pIndex, 0, iRowid);
    for(ctx.iCol=0; rc==0         && ctx.iCol<pConfig->nCol; ctx.iCol++){
      ctx.szCol = 0;
      if( pConfig->abUnindexed[ctx.iCol]==0 ){
        const char *zText = (const char*)sqlite3_api->column_text(pScan,ctx.iCol+1);
        int nText =sqlite3_api->column_bytes(pScan,ctx.iCol+1);
        rc = sqlite3Fts5Tokenize(pConfig,
0x0004                            ,
            zText, nText,
            (void*)&ctx,
            fts5StorageInsertCallback
        );
      }
      sqlite3Fts5BufferAppendVarint(&rc, &buf, ctx.szCol);
      p->aTotalSize[ctx.iCol] += (i64)ctx.szCol;
    }
    p->nTotalRow++;

    if( rc==0         ){
      rc = fts5StorageInsertDocsize(p, iRowid, &buf);
    }
  }
sqlite3_api->free(buf.p);
  rc2 =sqlite3_api->reset(pScan);
  if( rc==0         ) rc = rc2;


  if( rc==0         ){
    rc = fts5StorageSaveTotals(p);
  }
  return rc;
}

static int fts5StorageNewRowid(Fts5Storage *p, i64 *piRowid){
